content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Discipline-Wise Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification provides separate position counts for each engineering branch, academic discipline and technical trade. Applicants should select the category matching their completed qualification rather than applying for an unrelated trade or discipline.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Category-Wise Reservation
content_sections.text: The official notification specifies reservation across Unreserved (UR), Other Backward Classes (OBC), Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS). Reservation is applied at the apprenticeship category level according to Government of India norms.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the educational qualifications prescribed for their apprenticeship category. Engineering and Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentices require the relevant degree, while Technician, Trade and Vocational Apprentices must possess the specified diploma, trade or vocational qualification. Important Eligibility Conditions: Graduate and Diploma Apprenticeship candidates must have passed their relevant qualifications in 2022 or later . Applicants with sandwich-course certificates, short-term/certificate courses or those pursuing higher studies are not eligible under the stated conditions. Candidates who have already completed or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training, have one year or more of experience in an organization, or have been terminated from or withdrawn from apprenticeship training are also not eligible. Only Indian nationals may apply.

rows.educational_qualification: B.E./B.Tech in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
B.Sc in Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Electronics or Computer Science, or B.Com/B.A. from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
Diploma in the relevant discipline from a recognized university/institute, first class with at least 60% marks or 6.32 CGPA.
SSLC/SSC with ITI/NTC in the relevant trade from NCVT.
Certificate in the relevant vocational course involving two years of study after secondary school education, recognized by AICTE.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The uploaded apprenticeship notification does not specify a separate minimum or maximum numerical age limit. Candidates should follow the eligibility requirements under the applicable apprenticeship rules and the official application portals. Applicants should not assume an age relaxation or upper age limit unless it is officially prescribed.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Salary / Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend according to their category during the prescribed training period. The highest specified stipend is Rs. 12,300 per month for Graduate Apprentices, while Trade and Vocational Apprentices receive Rs. 9,600 per month. Note: The notification lists DCCP as a separate vacancy category but does not separately specify its stipend in the educational qualification and stipend table. Candidates should verify the applicable amount through SDSC SHAR.

rows.monthly_stipend: Refer to the applicable category details in the official portal

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not prescribe a separate application fee amount. Candidates should refer to the official apprenticeship registration portals for any applicable instructions before submitting their applications.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprenticeship 2026 will be based on academic merit and document verification. The notification provides for category-wise merit lists using the marks obtained in the relevant educational qualification. It does not announce a separate written examination or interview as part of the stated selection procedure. Academic Merit List: Merit lists will be prepared based on academic scores separately for UR, OBC, SC, ST and EWS categories. Discipline-Wise Shortlisting: Applicants will be shortlisted according to their position in the merit list for the relevant discipline, branch, trade or subject. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates will be required to attend document verification with original certificates. Final Consideration: Only candidates who attend verification and satisfy all prescribed eligibility requirements will be considered for apprenticeship engagement. No travelling allowance will be provided to candidates attending document verification. Selection is subject to satisfactory verification of qualifications, marks and supporting documents.

content_sections.heading: ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026 Training Duration
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training duration is 12 months , commencing from the execution of the apprenticeship contract. Selected candidates must execute the contract in accordance with the Apprentices Act and submit a medical fitness certificate at the time of joining. Completion of apprenticeship training does not provide any claim to temporary, ad hoc or permanent employment at SDSC SHAR or any other ISRO/Department of Space centre or unit.

Upload the required photograph, signature and category certificates in the format prescribed on UMANG. Carefully verify the educational qualification, marks, passing year, category and other details before submitting the application. Submit the online application on or before 26 November 2026 and retain a copy for future reference. Important: No changes will be permitted after final submission. Applications submitted through any mode other than the prescribed online portal will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ISRO SDSC SHAR Apprentice 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should prepare the documents applicable to their apprenticeship category before beginning registration. The notification requires relevant educational certificates, identification documents and supporting category documents, where applicable. 10th / SSC Certificate Intermediate Certificate, where applicable ITI / NTC Certificate, where applicable Diploma Certificate and Marksheets, where applicable B.E./B.Tech, B.Sc, B.Com or B.A. Certificates and Marksheets, where applicable Relevant Vocational Course Certificate, where applicable Valid Government-Issued Identity Proof Recent Photograph and Signature Valid SC/ST/OBC Certificate, if applicable EWS Income and Asset Certificate valid for 2026-27, if applicable PwBD Certificate and Unique Disability Identity Card, if applicable NATS / Apprenticeship Registration Number The notification specifies JPG/JPEG/PNG format with a maximum file size of 1 MB for the listed supporting educational documents. Photograph, signature and category documents must follow the format and size instructions displayed on UMANG.

content_sections.text: Eligible candidates should use the official apprenticeship registration portals and UMANG application portal. The notification also directs candidates to the ISRO/SDSC SHAR website for subsequent updates, corrigenda and additional instructions.

faq.answer: It depends on the post: 12300 for Engineering Graduate Apprentice, 12300 for Non-Engineering Graduate Apprentice, 10900 for Technician Apprentice (Diploma), 9600 for Trade Apprentice, 9600 for Vocational Apprentice.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E/B.Tech, or B.Sc./B.Com./B.A., or Diploma in first class with minimum 60% marks/6.32 CGPA (passed in 2022 or later); SSLC/SSC+ITI/NTC from NCVT for Trade Apprentice; AICTE-recognised two-year vocational certificate for Vocational Apprentice. faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only Indian Nationals need to apply. Aadhaar number must be seeded with bank account and enabled for DBT. Graduate and Diploma applicants must have passed the qualification in 2022 or thereafter.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Holders of sandwich course certificates, short term/certificate courses, etc. Applicants pursuing higher studies. Those who have already undergone or are currently undergoing apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Those having experience of one year or more in any organisation.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Category-wise (UR/OBC/SC/ST/EWS) merit list based on academic score for each apprenticeship category. Reservation as per Government of India norms applied at apprenticeship category level.

content_sections.text: The notice lists 8 posts with 1 vacancy each, all in the Unreserved (UR) category, for a total of 8 vacancies.

rows.post: Ayush Doctor – Mobile Medical Unit (For Tribal Dominated Population)
Multipurpose Worker (MPW) – Mobile Medical Unit (For Tribal Dominated Population)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: All applicants must be permanent residents of West Bengal and must possess adequate knowledge of the local language. The notice states that the prescribed conditions are non-relaxable. Each post's own conditions are below. Essential: Graduate from any recognized university and have completed at least 1 year Diploma Course in Computer (including MS Office – MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel) from a Govt. registered Institution. Desirable: Exposure in social sector schemes/Govt. Missions at National, State and District level. Age: Minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential: Graduate degree in Homeopathy (BHMS) from a recognized university. Desirable: Working experience in Public Health Programme of Government / PSUs or reputed private organization. Desirable: Exposure in social sector schemes/Govt. Missions at National, State and District level; computer knowledge including MS Office – MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel. Age: Minimum 21 years and maximum 50 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential criteria: Retired State Govt. Employees; Computer Literate Person. Desirable: Experience of working in the Health & FW Dept will be given preference (experience of working at clerical posts like LDC/accounts clerk etc.). Age: Maximum age limit 62 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential: Retired State Government Employees with experiences in the related field. Class X Pass. Computer Knowledge. Must be fit physically and mentally. Age: Maximum age limit 62 years as on date 01.04.2026. Essential: Graduation in Computer Application/IT/Business Administration/B.Tech (C.S) or (I.T)/BCA/BBA/B.Sc-IT/Graduation with one year Diploma/Certificate course in Computer Application from a Government registered institute or university. Working knowledge of computer with operating knowledge of MS Word, MS Power Point, MS Excel, MS Access and Internet. Essential experience: Minimum 1 year of post-qualification experience in a Government or any other reputed organization. Desirable: Typing speed of English – 30 WPM and Bengali – 25 WPM; exposure in social sector schemes at National, State and District level. Residence: Candidates shall be the permanent resident of the district concerned or within the same Revenue Division. Age: Minimum 21 years and maximum 40 years as on date 01.04.2026. Age relaxation for reserved categories shall be admissible as per the prevailing rules/orders of the Government of West Bengal, and only for candidates of the categories for which such relaxation is permissible under the prevailing Government rules. For the full eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for every post is a consolidated remuneration per month: Rs. 40,000/- for each Ayush Doctor, 25,000/- for the Data Entry Operator, Rs. 15,000/- for each Multipurpose Worker (MPW), Rs.12,000/- for the Accountant and Rs.10,000/- for the Lower Division Clerk. The LDC and Accountant posts, open only to retired State Government employees, carry the same fixed consolidated amount given in the table. The engagement is purely contractual and temporary in nature. Selected candidates may be posted at any health facility/institution/unit under the administrative control of the District AYUSH Samity/District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, as decided by the competent authority, and no claim for posting at a particular place shall be entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.wbhealth.gov.in and open Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment. Complete online registration by 18.11.2026; online applications are accepted from 05.11.2026 (10:00 hrs) to 19.11.2026. Submit only one online application for a particular post. A candidate may apply for more than one post if eligible for each, but more than one application for the same post cancels all applications for that post. Check every entry before final submission: no modification or correction is allowed after the application is finally submitted. Do not send any physical documents to the office. Appear in person for document verification with the online-generated application form signed by you, the originals and self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Online-generated application form, duly signed, with one recent passport-size photograph pasted on it. Madhyamik (or equivalent) Admit Card/Certificate as proof of age. All relevant mark sheets and pass certificates; where DGPA/CGPA or Grade Point is awarded, the conversion formula. Voter ID/Aadhaar Card/any other valid address proof. All relevant experience certificates, with salary slips for the last three months against each claimed period of experience. Valid EWS certificate issued by the competent authority, and caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Government of West Bengal, wherever applicable. LDC and Accountant: documents related to retirement [PPO] of State Govt. employees (as per Proforma enclosed – Annexure-A), experience certificate from the last employer, age proof, identity proof (Voter ID card/Aadhar card/Driving license/Passport/Pan card), caste certificate and two passport size recent colour photographs, with 2 sets of self-attested photocopies of all relevant documents. The experience certificate must clearly mention the duration of experience, post held, nature of work, and the employer's signature with date; otherwise it will be treated as invalid. The District Level Selection Committee (DLSC) may ask for other documents, with prior notice.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection is conducted by the District Level Selection Committee, Purulia. The marking for each post is printed in the notice as follows. Data Entry Operator (AYUSH) marking: Class X – 10 marks (proportionate marking) Class XII – 10 marks (proportionate marking) Bachelor degree – 10 marks (proportionate marking) Post Graduation – 10 marks Experience – 10 marks: 2 marks for the essential experience plus 2 marks for each completed year of experience over and above the essential experience Computer Test – 50 marks Interview – 10 marks Being named in the list of candidates called for the Computer Test/Interview/Document Verification does not confer any right to appointment; candidature remains provisional until all original documents are verified and all eligibility conditions are met. No TA/DA is admissible for the Computer Test, Written Test, Interview, Document Verification or any other stage.

Total 100: 85 marks based on % of marks in the total BHMS examination; Experience 15 marks (1 mark for each completed year up to 5 years and 2 marks for each completed year above 5 years, maximum 15)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Any omission or suppression of information will result in rejection of the application or cancellation of candidature at any stage without further intimation. If any information is found false, incorrect or misleading, or any document forged/fabricated, at any stage or during engagement, the candidature/engagement will be cancelled forthwith, without prejudice to other action under the applicable rules/law. Incomplete online applications are liable to result in cancellation of candidature. Failure to produce any requisite document at verification may result in cancellation of candidature. The District Health & Family Welfare Samiti reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason. Updates will be posted on the official website of the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal, and the concerned district website. The office email printed on the notice is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be called for a written examination (Computer Based Test/Tablet Based Test); those who qualify undergo Document Verification, and the panel is formed on merit of the written examination and the marks on certificates. Candidates recommended for appointment must pass the prescribed medical fitness standards. The examination is in Hindi or English. Negative marking: 1/3rd of the marks for the question deducted for every wrong objective answer. Minimum 40% marks in the written examination are needed for the next stage; relaxation for reserved categories as per Railway Board's rules. Candidates equal to 5 times the notified vacancies will be called for Document Verification on merit. Written Examination and Document Verification will be held in Delhi only. The syllabus (Annexure-II) covers History of Scouting/Guiding; Law & Promise; organisation at district, state and national level; training centres; Scouting for Boys/Guiding for Girls in India; motto, left hand shake, salute, prayer, flag song, National Anthem and flags; social services; hiking; proficiency badges; stages in Scouting/Guiding; Thinking Day; progressive training; pioneering; handicrafts; Indian Railway Jamborette, National Jamboree and Jamboree on the Air; WAGGGS/WOSM; Uprashtrapati Award and Prime Minister Shield competitions; community development programmes; and the aims and methods of Scouting.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RRC NR Scouts & Guides quota 2026?
faq.answer: There are 27 vacancies: 05 Group 'C' (Level 2) and 22 Group 'D' (Erstwhile) (Level 1), with no reservation for any community.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application opens on 6 November 2026 and closes on 6 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Group 'D' (Erstwhile)?
faq.answer: 10th pass with NAC granted by NCVT, or 10th pass with ITI, or 10th pass or ITI or equivalent or NAC, plus the scouting qualification (President Scout/Guide/Rover/Ranger or HWB, 5 years' active membership and the required events).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: As on 01.01.2027, Group 'C' (Level 2) is 18 to 30 years for UR, 18 to 33 for OBC and 18 to 35 for SC/ST; Group 'D' (Erstwhile) (Level 1) is 18 to 33 for UR, 18 to 36 for OBC and 18 to 38 for SC/ST.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Group 'C' is in Level 2 and Group 'D' (Erstwhile) in Level 1 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, with appointment at the minimum of the scale.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 500 for general candidates, of which Rs. 400 is refunded on appearing in the exam, and Rs. 250 for SC/ST/Ex-Serviceman/PwBD/Transgender/Women/Minorities/Economically Backward Classes, refunded on appearing, less bank charges in both cases.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection made?
faq.answer: Through a 60-mark written test (CBT/TBT) and 40 marks on Scouts & Guides certificates, followed by Document Verification and a medical examination; a minimum of 40% in the written test is needed.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking?
faq.answer: Yes, 1/3rd of the marks of a question is deducted for every wrong answer in the objective questions.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both Level 1 and Level 2?
faq.answer: Yes, if eligible, but a separate application and fee is needed for each; the two exams are tentatively on the same day in two shifts.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the exam be held?
faq.answer: The Written Examination and Document Verification will be held in Delhi only, with the exam expected in January 2027.

content_sections.heading: About Chamarajanagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment fills vacant posts at Anganwadi centres run by the Women and Child Development Department in Chamarajanagar district, Karnataka. The Deputy Commissioner's office has asked the National Informatics Centre (NIC), Chamarajanagar, to invite the applications online. Selection follows the Karnataka Government guidelines in Government Order No. ಮಮಇ 154 ಐಸಿಡಿ 2020 dated 03-12-2022 and its modification order dated 18-11-2024, both attached to the notice.

content_sections.heading: Chamarajanagar Anganwadi Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The documents are attached to the online application itself, so 4 December 2026 is the single deadline for both the form and the documents.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: Most of the posts, 271 of 390, are Anganwadi Helper posts. The vacancies are spread over the 5 taluk Child Development Projects of the district. The notice does not give a project-wise or centre-wise list.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only women and transgender minority women are eligible to apply for the Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts. Applicants for both posts must be within the age limit of 19-35 years. Persons with disabilities get an age relaxation of 10 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. For an Anganwadi centre in a rural area, the applicant must live in that revenue village. For an Anganwadi centre in an urban area, the applicant must live in that revenue ward and must have a residence certificate from the competent authority. Election wards are not considered. Residence is confirmed by a three-year residence certificate from the Tahsildar or Deputy Tahsildar, supported by an Aadhaar card, ration card or voter identity card. Applicants from a local majire, tanda or hadi must get the relevant residence certificate from the competent authority. In Anganwadi centres in areas where the minority community makes up 25 per cent of the population, applicants who know that community's language along with Kannada are selected. Preference for Anganwadi Worker: candidates holding an ECCE diploma course from D.S.E.R.T., JOC course or N.T.T. course from Government-recognised institutions, a Diploma in Nutrition, a Home Science certificate course, or one-year nursery or pre-primary training certificate related to Anganwadi activities get first preference and +5 bonus marks. Further rules for Anganwadi Helper: Candidates who passed S.S.L.C. from schools or open schools under the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board must have studied Kannada as first or second language and general mathematics and social science; they are considered if the certificate or marks card shows maximum 625 and minimum 219 marks. For candidates who studied in other states with Kannada as first or second language, if the maximum and minimum SSLC marks fixed in that state differ from those fixed in Karnataka, only candidates who studied in Karnataka are considered. Whatever the medium or state of study, Anganwadi Helpers must have studied Kannada as first or second language. For candidates whose mother tongue is not Kannada, the selection committee may hold an interview and, if needed, test reading and writing in Kannada before deciding. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility rules of each post.

Minimum SSLC or equivalent pass. Must have studied Kannada as first or second language.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for both posts is on merit: a combined list is prepared online on the total of the marks in the prescribed qualification and the bonus marks. The notice describes no written examination. When widows apply, they are selected directly at third priority, after acid attack survivors and residents of department institutions, without considering the other applications. A woman who becomes a widow after applying is not considered. Among widows, the widow of a farmer who died by suicide gets first priority. The place where the widow currently lives, as shown in her residence certificate, is taken as her residence. If two widows apply for one post, the one with the higher marks may be selected. Widows must attach the husband's death certificate or the widow certificate. The notice fixes the extent of physical disability as not more than 40 per cent. The place shown in the residence certificate is taken as the candidate's residence. If there is doubt about the extent of disability, the candidate is asked to appear in person before the selection committee, which decides whether she can do the job. The taluk-level verification committee, headed by the Tahsildar, checks the applications and sends the list to the Deputy Director. The district selection committee, chaired by the Deputy Commissioner, meets within 7 working days after the last date. Applications without any required document are rejected; unclear or incomplete documents are not considered. Candidates with the highest marks are selected and a provisional selection list is published on the notice board the same day. Seven days are given for objections; the final selection list is published on the notice board after they are considered. If more than one candidate has equal marks, the older candidate is preferred; if the age is also equal, a widow or divorced woman is preferred. The decision of the selection committee is final.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The posts are in a research project at the Department of Neurology, Neuro Science Centre, AIIMS, New Delhi, led by Dr. Anu Gupta, Associate Professor, Department of Neurology. The project, funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), is a cluster randomized controlled trial that compares holistic lifestyle education with physical and cognitive training against the existing rural Indian lifestyle, to improve cognition and prevent dementia in cognitively normal, high-risk rural older adults. It is part of the SMRUTHI INDIA initiative.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice gives 5 provisional vacancies for Office Attendant, divided by reservation category. Of these, 3 posts are for women under 35% horizontal reservation. The notice states that the number of advertised posts may decrease or increase. Reservation is given only to candidates whose permanent residence is in Bihar. Residents of other states do not get reservation benefit. Reservation must be claimed in the marked column of the online form; the permanent address filled in the online form is taken for reservation purposes. SC and ST candidates claiming reservation must have a caste certificate and a permanent residence (domicile) certificate. For unmarried or married women, the caste certificate must be issued from the father's permanent address. BC and EBC candidates claiming reservation must have a caste certificate, a permanent residence certificate and a non-creamy layer certificate (women: issued from the father's permanent address). EWS gets 10% reservation as per rules when a vacancy is available; the income and asset certificate must be in Annexure-1 (Form-1) of the General Administration Department notification No. 2622 dated 26.02.2019. Women get 35% horizontal reservation as per rules when a vacancy is available. The reservation category cannot be changed while the appointment process is under way.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates for the Office Attendant post will be interviewed. The interview carries 100 marks, and the merit list will be prepared on interview marks. If applications exceed 40,000, a preliminary examination (OMR answer-sheet based, objective multiple choice) may be held. In that case, about 10 times the number of vacancies, from among candidates who obtain the fixed qualifying marks, will be selected for the interview. Candidates who do not reach these marks will be out of the competition. Equal marks: the older candidate is placed higher. Equal marks and same date of birth: the candidate with the higher educational qualification is placed higher. Still equal: the order follows the Devanagari alphabetical order of the name as written in the Class 10 board certificate. Information on the examination or interview programme will be published on the Bihar Vidhan Sabha website.

basic_details.short_information: The recruitment is being conducted for Despatch Rider (Group-C) positions at the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court. Selected candidates will receive remuneration under Pay Level-2. The important recruitment details are provided below.

application_fee.details: Candidates must pay the prescribed application fee according to their category. The fee must be paid before the notified deadline. | Fee Payment Last Date: 27 November 2026, within bank transaction hours. | Note: The application fee is non-refundable and cannot be carried forward to another examination or selection process.

age_limit.details: The minimum age for applicants is 18 years. The maximum age limit depends on the candidate's category and will be calculated as of the last date for receipt of online applications, 21 November 2026. | Age Calculation Date: 21 November 2026. | Candidates should check the official notification for all applicable eligibility and category-related conditions before submitting their applications.

qualification.education_qualification: Middle School Leaving Certificate
qualification.details: Applicants must satisfy the educational qualification, driving licence and language requirements prescribed under the Mizoram Despatch Rider Recruitment Rules, 2002. | Important: Possessing both the prescribed driving licences and working knowledge of the Mizo language is essential. Candidates who do not meet these requirements should not apply.

salary_details.details: The notification specifies the pay structure but does not provide an exact in-hand salary figure.

selection_process: Stage Selection Test Marks
Stage I Written Examination 60
Stage II Two-Wheeler Skill Test 40
Stage III Interview / Viva-Voce 20
Subject Marks
Road Sign Recognition 10
General English (Middle School Standard) 20
General Knowledge 10
Mizo Language Proficiency 20
Total 60
Skill Test Component Marks
Starting 10
Riding 10
Parking 10
After Riding 10
Total 40
The selection process consists of three stages: a Written Examination
a Two-Wheeler Skill Test and an Interview/Viva-Voce. Final selection will be based on marks obtained in the prescribed stages
subject to the qualifying conditions.
The written examination will be an objective-type test conducted on an OMR sheet. The duration is 60 minutes
and the paper carries 60 marks.
The Mizo language proficiency section is qualifying in nature. Candidates must obtain at least 40% marks
equivalent to 8 out of 20
in this section. Marks scored in the Mizo language segment will not be considered while preparing the merit list.

Candidates shortlisted in a ratio of 1:5 based on their written examination merit will be called for the skill test. The skill test carries 40 marks and evaluates practical two-wheeler riding abilities.
The riding test will be conducted using a two-wheeler vehicle with or without gear. Candidates must secure at least 50% marks
equivalent to 20 out of 40
to qualify for the skill test.
Candidates will be shortlisted for the Interview/Viva-Voce in a ratio of 1:3 based on their performance in the written examination and skill test. The interview carries 20 marks.
Applicants must secure at least 12 out of 20 marks (60%) to qualify for the interview stage. Document verification will also be conducted as part of the selection process.
Final selection will be based on the combined marks obtained in the written examination
skill test and interview
excluding the qualifying Mizo language component from the merit calculation.
In the event of a tie
preference will be given first to the candidate securing higher written examination marks
followed by higher skill test marks. If a tie still remains
the older candidate will receive preference.
The Gauhati High Court reserves the right to fix or modify the cutoff marks for the selection stages.
how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the Gauhati High Court website or the Aizawl Bench website. Applicants must have an active email address and mobile number before starting the registration process.
Visit the official website at ghconline.gov.in or ghcazlbench.nic.in.
Find the link titled "Online application for the post of Despatch Rider (Group-C) in the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court".
Open the application portal and complete registration using a valid email address and mobile number.
Note down the Registration Code generated during registration.
Fill in the required personal details, educational qualification details and other information in the application form.
Upload clear scanned copies of the required certificates and supporting documents.
Check all entered information carefully before final submission.
Submit the online application before 21 November 2026, within office working hours.
Pay the prescribed application fee before 27 November 2026, within bank transaction hours.
Save the application details, Registration Code and payment confirmation for future reference.
Important: No changes or corrections to the application form will be permitted after submission. Applications submitted through any mode other than the prescribed online process will be rejected.
Candidates must upload the prescribed scanned documents when submitting their online applications.
Age proof such as Birth Certificate or Class X Admit Card
Educational qualification mark sheet or pass certificate
SC/ST Certificate, if applicable
No Objection Certificate (NOC), if employed in Government Service
Applicants must also produce their original certificates and other relevant records whenever required during subsequent stages of the recruitment process.
important_instructions: Candidates must fulfil all prescribed educational, age, driving licence and language requirements. Incomplete applications, including those without the required photograph or signature, may be rejected. All details provided in the online application must be accurate and supported by valid documents. Candidates already employed in Government Service must comply with the prescribed employer intimation and NOC requirements. No travelling allowance or daily allowance (TA/DA) will be provided for attending the written examination, skill test or interview. The number of vacancies may change at the time of final selection. The High Court may publish provisional lists of eligible and rejected candidates on its official website.

content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Eligibility Criteria 2027
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess all three of the following qualifications in the relevant trade: Class 10 or Matriculation. National Trade Certificate (NTC/ITI). National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC). The qualification cut-off date is 1 October 2026 . Candidates must have obtained the required ITI/NTC and NAC certificates or marksheets by this date. content_sections.heading: BHEL Artisan Selection Process 2027

Final Merit: Based on CBE marks among candidates found eligible in document verification and qualified in the Skill Test. content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from local residents of Kondagaon district. Candidates must be not less than 18 years and not more than 28 years old on 1 January 2026. SC, ST and OBC candidates: upper age limit relaxed by up to 5 years. Local women candidates of Kondagaon district: upper age limit relaxable by up to 10 years, under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Special Provisions for Appointment of Women) Rules, 1997. The qualification must be held on the last date for submitting the form, and attaching the certificate is the applicant's own responsibility. All candidates measured for chest must show at least 5 cm of expansion. Women candidates are exempt from this requirement. The selection committee's decision on height and chest measurement is final. Candidates must not be physically disabled and must be medically fit. Knock-knee and flat-foot are not allowed. Candidates must have no eye disease and must be able to distinguish the main colours. The competent officer decides these cases by inspection and may consult the District Chief Medical Officer if needed. Third gender candidates follow the men's standards if their certificate states male and the women's standards if it states female. Producing this certificate is compulsory. Selection is carried out in several stages
in this order:
Document verification Physical measurement Physical Efficiency Test (100 marks) Written examination (50 marks) Interview (20 marks) Bonus marks (up to 30)

each worth 20 marks
for a total of 100 marks:
Long jump High jump Shot put 100 metre race 800 metre race

and the committee's decision is final.
The interview carries a maximum of 20 marks. Up to 3 times the number of advertised posts will be called for the interview. All candidates with the same cut-off marks will be included.
A maximum of 30 bonus marks may be awarded:
Candidates must hold the certificates for bonus marks on the last date of application.
The final merit list will be prepared from the total of the marks obtained in the PET
the written examination and the interview
plus any bonus marks earned.

content_sections.heading: Bastar Police Bastar Fighter Constable Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is carried out in several stages, in this order: Document verification Physical measurement Physical Efficiency Test (100 marks) Written examination (50 marks) Interview (20 marks) Bonus marks (up to 30) The test has five events, each worth 20 marks, for a total of 100 marks: Long jump High jump Shot put 100 metre race 800 metre race Rules for the test: Candidates get only one chance in each event. Taking part in all events is compulsory. Unreserved candidates must score 60% of the 100 marks. SC, ST and OBC candidates must score 50% of the 100 marks. A candidate who is not satisfied with the assessment may appeal to the selection committee. The appeal will be decided immediately, and the committee's decision is final. The interview carries a maximum of 20 marks. Up to 3 times the number of advertised posts will be called for the interview. All candidates with the same cut-off marks will be included. A maximum of 30 bonus marks may be awarded: Candidates must hold the certificates for bonus marks on the last date of application. The final merit list will be prepared from the total of the marks obtained in the PET, the written examination and the interview, plus any bonus marks earned.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Bastar Police Bastar Fighter Constable Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: There is no online application. Candidates must submit a paper form offline, by hand or by registered post. Get the prescribed application form. A sample is attached to the notice. The form, physical standards, physical test, written exam and other details are also displayed on the notice boards of all police stations, police outposts and SDOP offices in Bastar district, and of the Superintendent of Police office. Fill in the form yourself, in clear handwriting. The form is addressed to the Superintendent of Police, District Bastar, Jagdalpur. Paste a recent passport-size photograph that is not older than 3 months. Attach the certificates listed below and write their details and number in the enclosure list. Sign the form and the declaration. Submit the form on working days during office hours at one of these offices: Reserve Centre (Rakshit Kendra), Jagdalpur, District Bastar Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Keshloor (Parpa) Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Lohandiguda Office of the Sub-Divisional Officer (Police), Bhanpuri Alternatively, send the form only by registered Indian Post to: Office of the Superintendent of Police, Jagdalpur, District Bastar, PIN 494001. Postal applications must reach the office by 12.12.2026 within office hours. Applications received after that will not be accepted. If you apply by post, keep the registered post receipt and bring it with you on the date fixed for recruitment. Doing so is compulsory. Recent passport-size photograph, not older than 3 months, pasted on the form Self-attested copies of mark sheets/certificates of 5th, 8th, 10th, 12th, graduation or other qualifications, as applicable Certificate for age proof, and a certificate for age relaxation if claimed Certificate of local residence of Bastar district, issued by the competent authority OBC/SC/ST certificate, issued by the competent authority, if applicable Certificate showing membership of a Naxal-victim family or a relief-camp family, if applicable Assistant Constable, ex-serviceman or ex-Agniveer certificate, issued by the competent authority, if applicable For Home Guards (Nagar Sainik), present or past: a service period certificate issued by the District Commandant, Home Guard Third gender certificate, if applicable Heavy motor vehicle driving licence, NCC-C or NSS-C certificate, if held For government, semi-government or Chhattisgarh state, corporation or board employees (permanent or temporary): full details and a No Objection Certificate from the head of department Aadhaar card number or Voter ID number Full details, if the candidate was ever declared unfit for government service by a medical board, was arrested, prosecuted, fined or convicted in a criminal case, or has a case pending in a court, university or educational authority The form also includes an acknowledgement slip (Pavti), which the receiving official signs with the date of receipt.

content_sections.heading: About Punjab and Haryana High Court
content_sections.text: The High Court of Punjab and Haryana sits at Chandigarh, and these posts are on its own establishment. Terms not covered in the notice are regulated by the High Court Establishment (Appointment and Conditions of Service) Rules, 1973, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Punjab and Haryana High Court Chowkidar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants of all categories should be not less than 18 years and not more than 35 years as on 21 November 2026. For Ex-Servicemen, the upper age limit is relaxed by the number of years of their defence service plus 03 years. Only two documents are accepted as proof of date of birth: the Matriculation Certificate from a recognized Education Board, for candidates who are matriculate or above, or the Birth Certificate from the Registrar of Births and Deaths, for those qualified below Matric. Minimum Middle Standard and maximum 10+2 from a recognized School Education Board or recognized School. All eligibility conditions must be met on the last date of online submission. Candidates must also give an affidavit that they are not qualified above 10+2. Concealing a higher qualification can lead to criminal action and termination from service. SC/ST/BC reservation and fee relaxation are only for candidates holding a certificate from Punjab, Haryana or U.T. Chandigarh who are also domiciled or permanent residents there. SC/ST/BC applicants from other areas or states must apply under General Category. BC candidates must not fall in the creamy layer, and their certificate must be the latest one. Reservation, fee and age relaxation under the Ex-Servicemen category are for Ex-Servicemen themselves, not their dependents. No man who has more than one wife living, and no woman married to a man already having a wife living, is eligible for appointment. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for the post of Chowkidar.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online and is non-refundable, and online transaction charges are extra. Dependents claiming the exemption must upload proof with the application and produce the original at testimonials checking or when called by the High Court.

rows.category: Dependents of Ex-Servicemen disabled or deceased during the active operation

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected on their performance in the interview. Depending on the number of applications, any suitable shortlisting criterion can be followed, and candidates will be told about it at the appropriate time. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not by itself entitle an applicant to an interview call. The date, time and venue of the interview will be published on the High Court website. Original documents will be checked at testimonials checking. The E-Admit Card link for provisionally eligible candidates will be uploaded on the website, and candidates will also receive an email or SMS. Admit cards are not sent by post. Paste a photograph on the E-Admit Card, attested by a Gazetted Officer or self-attested. It must match the one uploaded with the application, or entry to the venue will be refused. Mobile phones, other electronic devices, watches, ornaments and other baggage are not allowed in the interview center. No TA/DA is paid for any stage of the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The posts are on the establishment of the High Court at Chandigarh. Duty hours may extend beyond normal working hours and even at odd hours.

faq.answer: No. The maximum qualification is 10+2, and applicants with anything higher are not eligible.

faq.answer: 19 of the 22 posts are in the General Category, though the total may change by the time the merit list is prepared.

faq.answer: You must apply under General Category and pay the General fee of Rs. 700.

faq.answer: Half of the 50 marks are for suitability to the job and half are for etiquettes/manners.

faq.answer: Their upper age limit rises by their years of defence service plus 03 years.

content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the minimum height and chest measurements specified for their category and gender. Male candidates must meet the prescribed minimum expansion of 5 cm. Candidates must not have knock knees or flat feet. Applicants must possess medically acceptable eyesight. content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The notified selection procedure includes physical measurement, a Physical Efficiency Test, written examination and interview , followed by the applicable verification and final selection procedures. Application Scrutiny: Checking the prescribed educational qualification, age, residence and other eligibility conditions. Physical Measurement: Verification of height, chest measurement for male candidates and prescribed medical standards. Physical Efficiency Test: Assessment of the notified physical events. Written Examination: Examination of general knowledge, intelligence, reasoning, analytical ability and related subjects. Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Bonus Marks: Awarded to eligible candidates possessing the specifically recognized certificates or qualifications. Final Selection: Preparation of the merit list under the applicable recruitment and reservation rules.

content_sections.heading: CG Police Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test carries 100 marks . It includes different events designed to assess the candidate's physical ability and fitness. All candidates are required to participate in the prescribed physical events. Candidates who do not meet the applicable qualifying standards will not proceed under the notified selection conditions. The written examination carries 50 marks and covers subjects including General Knowledge, Intelligence, Reasoning, Analytical Ability and General Studies. The interview carries a maximum of 20 marks . Candidates will be shortlisted according to the notified selection procedure. The recognized certificate must be possessed by the application closing date. Bonus marks will be awarded only after verification of eligibility and the relevant certificate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Narayanpur Bastar Fighter Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Narayanpur Police website at narayanpur.cgpolice.gov.in . Locate the Bastar Fighter Constable Recruitment 2026 notification and application form. content_sections.text: Eligibility differs across the 12 notified categories. The Pathology notification provides additional accepted experience pathways for certain tutors, demonstrators, Armed Forces specialists and other qualified medical professionals. content_sections.heading: RRC SER Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: South Eastern Railway has 54 posts under the Sports Quota for 2026-27: 05 (Five) Group 'C' Level-4/Level-5, 16 (Sixteen) Group 'C' Level-2/Level-3 and 33 (Thirty three) Group 'D' Level-1. Each post is any post of that level in any of the units of South Eastern Railway. For Level-1, the notice refers to Annexure-A of RBE No 79/2026, which is available in the public domain. No post is reserved for SC/ST/OBC/EWS communities. Candidates with the required performance or achievement in the sports discipline will be selected on overall merit, whatever their community. Candidates may still upload the community they belong to, as required by chapter 13 of the brochure published by the Govt. of India, Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievance of Pensions, Deptt. of Personnel Training, New Delhi. For SC/ST/OBC, the caste certificate must be issued by a Competent Authority not below the rank of Tehsildar. OBC candidates must also upload an OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the Central Govt. format, issued not before than 01 year by the competent authority.

content_sections.text: Applications are open only to Indian nationals. Candidates must have both the academic qualification and the minimum sports norms for the level they apply for. Candidates who are appearing in, or waiting for the results of, final examinations are not eligible. The educational qualification must be from a recognised institution. Level-2/Level-3 qualification, as printed: Passed class 12th (10+2 stage) or its equivalent examination. The qualification must be from a Govt. recognized Board / Council / Institutions etc. OR Passed Matriculation from a recognized Board plus Course Completed Act Apprenticeship OR Passed class 10th from a Govt. recognized Board / Council / Institutions etc. plus ITI passed OR its equivalent examination OR National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT. The minimum educational qualification should be as applicable to the post offered. Notes on qualification: For a Group-C appointment against the Sports Quota in Technician-III, the minimum educational qualification is 10th pass. The training period for these appointees will follow RBE no. 92/2024, based on the selected candidate's educational qualification. No relaxation in the minimum educational qualification is allowed. Candidates must submit photocopies of the documents for their educational qualification with the application form. They must also produce the original certificate on the day of the trials. (a) Represented the country in Olympic Games (Senior Category) OR (b) At least 3rd Position in any of the Championships/events in the World Cup (Junior/Youth/Senior Category) / World Championships (Junior/ Senior Category)/ Asian Games (Senior Category)/ Commonwealth Games (Senior Category), Youth Olympics, Davis Cup (Tennis), Champions Trophy (Hockey), Thomas/Uber Cup (Badminton). content_sections.heading: RRC SER Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The fee must be paid online through Internet Banking or a Debit or Credit Card. Candidates bear the service charges for the payment. Fees paid in Cash, by Cheque, Money Order, Central Recruitment Fee Stamps or Demand Draft are not accepted, and such applications will be rejected. Rs. 400 for UR/OBC and Rs. 250 for SC/ST/Ex-Servicemen/Persons with Disabilities (PWDs), Women, Minorities and Economically Backward Classes will be refunded to eligible candidates who actually appear in the trial. Bank charges are deducted from the refund. In the application, candidates choose whether the refund goes to the account used for payment. If not, they give a beneficiary account: beneficiary name, account number, name of the bank and IFSC code. Candidates seeking a fee exemption as Economically Backward Classes must have Annexure-III filled in and certified by the proper authority. Economically Backward Classes are candidates whose family income is less than Rs 50,000 per annum. Minority candidates must make a self-declaration in the Annexure-V format to claim the fee waiver. They must also furnish a Minority Community declaration affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper of Rs.10/-, sworn before an Executive Magistrate. The notice lists the minorities as Muslim/Sikh/Christian/Buddhist/Parsis.

faq.question: Q1. Which MSCPS post pays the most?
faq.answer: Project Coordinator (Child Helpline Unit) has the highest pay at Rs. 25,000/- a month, though it carries no annual increment.

faq.question: Q2. Which posts can I apply for with Class VIII?
faq.answer: Cook, Helper cum Night Watchman and Housekeeper need a minimum of Class VIII. Knowledge of Mizo up to Middle School Standard is also required.

faq.question: Q3. Can men apply for the Nurse posts?
faq.answer: No. All 23 Nurse posts are marked Female only, and the qualification is General Nursing and Midwifery (GNM).

faq.question: Q4. Does pay increase every year?
faq.answer: Fourteen of the 16 posts carry a 3% annual increment. Project Coordinator and Case Worker (Child Helpline Unit) have no annual increment.

faq.question: Q5. What do Special Educator/ Therapist applicants need besides the degree or diploma?
faq.answer: Each qualifying route needs a valid RCI CRR number. Applicants also need computer proficiency with CCC/ DCA 1st Sem.

faq.question: Q7. What computer qualification does the Data Analyst post need?
faq.answer: Candidates with a Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics or Economics need 'O' Level in Computer. The alternative is a Bachelor in Computer Application.

faq.answer: The filled form goes to the respective District Child Protection Unit (DCPU) office, not to a website.

selection_process: Selection will be based on a two-stage examination comprising a theory test and a practical test assessing motor mechanism and driving ability.
Stage I - Theory Examination: Objective questions covering General Knowledge
Reasoning
Arithmetic
Road Sense

Traffic Rules and Vehicle Maintenance. Stage II - Practical Test: Assessment of motor mechanism knowledge and light/heavy vehicle driving skills. Final Merit: Prepared from the total marks obtained in both stages
subject to the prescribed qualifying standards.
Only candidates who qualify in Stage I will be eligible to appear in Stage II.

exam_pattern.details: The theory examination consists of 80 multiple-choice questions carrying 80 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes. | The practical examination carries 20 marks and assesses the candidate's motor mechanism knowledge and ability to drive light and heavy vehicles. | The qualifying standards apply to each prescribed examination paper as specified in Annexure-I. syllabus.details: The examination syllabus includes the following subjects: | Current Events Sports in India History and Culture of India Geography and Economy General Polity Indian Constitution Who's Who of India | Analytical Aptitude and Analogies Similarities and Differences Space Visualization and Visual Memory Number System and Fundamental Arithmetic Percentages, Ratios and Averages Profit and Loss, Interest and Discount Time and Distance, Time and Work | Road Signs, Signals and Markings Motor Vehicle Rules and Regulations Driving Licence Requirements Vehicle Registration and Insurance Accident Claims Basic Vehicle Maintenance Mechanical Vehicles and Their Components

Pay the Rs. 100 application fee through the prescribed post office e-payment procedure, if applicable.

content_sections.text: India Post has announced 24 Staff Car Driver vacancies across four regions of Tamil Nadu Circle. Ex-Servicemen Reservation: Two vacancies are earmarked for Ex-Servicemen. These are horizontal reservations included within the total of 24 posts and must not be added separately.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have passed 10th standard from a recognized Board or Institute , possess valid LMV and HMV driving licences, and have at least three years of experience driving light and heavy motor vehicles. Candidates must provide a valid experience certificate issued by a Gazetted Officer of a Central or State Government office or by the head of a registered firm, company, agency or institution. The certificate must include the organization's full address, door number, PIN code, issuing officer's name and designation, and date of issue. It must clearly specify the periods of LMV and HMV driving experience. Important: The claimed driving experience must fall within the validity period of the relevant driving licence.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for Unreserved and EWS candidates is 18 to 27 years as on 30 November 2026 . Relaxation applies to eligible reserved categories and other specified applicants. For Ex-Servicemen, the notification provides age relaxation after deduction of qualifying military service, subject to category-specific conditions.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a pay scale of Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200 under Level 2 of the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix, along with admissible allowances. The advertised pay scale represents basic pay progression and does not specify a fixed in-hand salary.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 100 . Women, SC and ST candidates are exempted from the application fee. Non-exempt candidates must pay the fee through e-payment at a computerized post office using the prescribed challan form. The payment should be made under E-Biller Name: Senior Manager, MMS Chennai, CPMG Tamil Nadu Circle , with E-Biller ID 1000099022 . The original postal payment receipt must be pasted on the application form. Payment through any other mode will not be accepted. The fee is non-refundable.

rows.category: General / OBC / EWS and Other Non-Exempt Candidates

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a two-stage examination comprising a theory test and a practical test assessing motor mechanism and driving ability. Stage I - Theory Examination: Objective questions covering General Knowledge, Reasoning, Arithmetic, Road Sense, Traffic Rules and Vehicle Maintenance. Stage II - Practical Test: Assessment of motor mechanism knowledge and light/heavy vehicle driving skills. Final Merit: Prepared from the total marks obtained in both stages, subject to the prescribed qualifying standards. Only candidates who qualify in Stage I will be eligible to appear in Stage II.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The theory examination consists of 80 multiple-choice questions carrying 80 marks , with a duration of 90 minutes. The practical examination carries 20 marks and assesses the candidate's motor mechanism knowledge and ability to drive light and heavy vehicles. The qualifying standards apply to each prescribed examination paper as specified in Annexure-I. Meeting the minimum standard does not guarantee final selection.

rows.subject: Road Sense, Vehicle Maintenance, Traffic Rules and Environmental Pollution

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The examination syllabus includes the following subjects: Current Events Sports in India History and Culture of India Geography and Economy General Polity Indian Constitution Who's Who of India Analytical Aptitude and Analogies Similarities and Differences Space Visualization and Visual Memory Number System and Fundamental Arithmetic Percentages, Ratios and Averages Profit and Loss, Interest and Discount Time and Distance, Time and Work Road Signs, Signals and Markings Motor Vehicle Rules and Regulations Driving Licence Requirements Vehicle Registration and Insurance Accident Claims Basic Vehicle Maintenance Mechanical Vehicles and Their Components

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Apply Offline 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit the prescribed application form through Speed Post only to the Senior Manager, Mail Motor Service, Chennai. To, The Senior Manager, Mail Motor Service, No. 37, Greams Road, Chennai - 600006. Last Date for Receipt: 30 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Applications submitted through courier, ordinary post, hand delivery or any other mode will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official India Post website at indiapost.gov.in . Refer to the Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) recruitment notification dated 29 October 2026 issued by Mail Motor Service, Chennai. Download or print the prescribed application form included in the recruitment notification. Fill in the application form in English, Hindi or Tamil with accurate personal and educational details. Provide the LMV and HMV licence details, including issue dates and validity. Enter the required light and heavy motor vehicle driving experience details. Affix one recent passport-size photograph and self-attest it. Attach another self-attested photograph and the required supporting documents. Pay the Rs. 100 application fee through the prescribed post office e-payment procedure, if applicable. Paste the original postal payment receipt on the application form. Review the completed application and sign it. Send the application and supporting documents through Speed Post only to the Senior Manager, Mail Motor Service, No. 37, Greams Road, Chennai - 600006. Ensure delivery by 30 November 2026 at 5:00 PM . Important: Candidates must use the prescribed application format. Applications with missing signatures, invalid licences, incomplete experience certificates or missing documents may be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Completed and signed prescribed application form. Age-proof certificate. 10th Pass certificate. Valid LMV and HMV driving licences or detailed licence extract. Driving experience certificate showing separate LMV and HMV experience periods. Valid SC/ST/OBC-NCL certificate, if applicable. Valid EWS Income and Asset Certificate for 2025-26, if applicable. Ex-Serviceman service and trade documents, if applicable. Two recent self-attested passport-size photographs. Original postal fee payment receipt, if applicable. All required photocopies must be self-attested. Applicants must not send original educational, licence or experience certificates.

content_sections.heading: India Post Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted through Speed Post only. Candidates must possess valid LMV and HMV driving licences. At least three years of relevant driving experience is mandatory. The driving experience certificate must contain the employer's complete address and issuing authority details. Women, SC and ST candidates are exempted from the application fee. Non-exempt candidates must pay the fee using the prescribed postal e-payment method. The last date for receipt of applications is 30 November 2026 at 5:00 PM. Only eligible candidates will receive Hall Permits. Original certificates must not be enclosed with the application. The number of vacancies may change according to departmental requirements.

content_sections.heading: About Kalakshetra Foundation
content_sections.text: Kalakshetra Foundation describes itself as an Institution of National Importance and an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Culture, Govt. of India, located at Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai. The post advertised here is in its Rukmini Devi College of Fine Arts (RDCFA), which teaches Diploma and Post-Diploma courses and stages Kalakshetra productions and dance dramas.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: According to the notice, the following candidates will be considered for the post: Eminent artists/private persons who meet the essential qualifications and also have the desirable qualifications that apply to an Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) level appointee in a Central/State Government/autonomous institution. Assistant Professor (Bharatanatyam) in Central/State Government/autonomous institutions holding analogous posts, or with 8 years' regular service in Pay Level 16 (Rs.36400 - 115700) of the Tamil Nadu Government State Pay Scales, or an equivalent level. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications for the Kalakshetra Library Attendant post are accepted only by post. The application, with self-attested copies of the testimonials, must reach the following address by 05.30 PM on 23 November 2026: The Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai – 600 041 Use the prescribed proforma given as Annexure – I of the notification ("Application for the post of Library Attendant in BASS School"). Fill in the form with a blue or black ball point pen. The form asks for your name in block letters, category, parents' names, address, two mobile numbers, email, Aadhar number (optional), PAN, date of birth, age as on 23-11-2026, nationality, gender, educational qualifications from Class X onwards, library work experience, knowledge of Indian languages, and why you consider yourself suitable for the post. Paste one recent passport size photograph on the application form. Put one more passport size photograph in a separate cover. It will be fixed on the call letter. Sign the declaration and write the place and date. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures, using the check list printed in the notification. Write "Application for the post of Library Attendant in BASS" on the cover. Post the cover so that it reaches the Director, Kalakshetra Foundation, by 05.30 PM on 23 November 2026 (Monday). Applications received after the closing date, or sent by email, will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Laboratory Technician: Rs 28000 + HRA, with increments as admissible as per DST Norms. HRA, if admissible under the funding agency's guidelines, will be paid at the rate for Rajkot city (Class 'Y'). Multi-tasking Staff: Rs. 18000, consolidated without any allowances. He or she is not entitled to any other financial or non-financial benefits or facilities, or to any special allowances, beyond the fixed consolidated emoluments prescribed by the funding agency. The posts are purely on contract for an externally funded research project. The person engaged will have no claim at any time to a regular post at AIIMS Rajkot, or to continued service in the same or any other project. The assignment is purely temporary for 11 months. It can be extended depending on the candidate's performance, continuation of the scheme and the budget grant from the funding agency. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: For both posts, selection has three stages: screening of the applications, an MCQ-based written test, and an interview. Selection is based purely on merit. Interview: The final merit is worked out with a weightage of 80% for the written exam and 20% for the interview. Date and reporting: 10 December 2026, reporting time 9 AM, at Research Cell, Academic block, 3rd Floor, AIIMS Rajkot. What to bring: The documents listed above, in original. selection_process: Stage Details
1. Scrutiny of applications Applications are scrutinized and suitable applicants are shortlisted
2. Data Entry Speed Test For shortlisted candidates who applied for Tax Assistant
3. Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Test For shortlisted candidates who applied for Havaldar
4. Medical fitness Medical fitness of candidates will be ascertained before their formal appointment
Subject to fulfilling the educational qualification

the applications will be scrutinized and suitable applicants will be shortlisted for the further selection procedure. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Tax Assistant will be called for a data entry speed test. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Havaldar will be called for the Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Test.
The Data Entry test and the Physical Efficiency/Physical Standard test will be held in Lucknow. Shortlisted candidates must appear at their own expenses
and the date
time and venue will be communicated in due course. Success in the test confers no right to appointment unless the Department is satisfied
after such enquiry as may be considered necessary
that the applicant is suitable in all respects for appointment to the post.
The merit of sportspersons who fulfil the eligibility conditions will be considered/decided in the following order of preference:
First preference to those candidates who have represented the country in an International Competition with the clearance of the Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/U.T. in the Senior or Junior level national Championships organized by the National Sports Federations recognized by Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports or National Games organized by Indian Olympics Association and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Between the candidates participating in Senior and Junior National Championships/games

the candidates having participated and won a medal in Senior National Championship should be given preference. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a University in an Inter-University competition conducted by Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board or Khelo India University Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years) or Khelo India Winter Games or Khelo India Para Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports

Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented the State Schools in the National sports/games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Next preference may be given to those who represented a State/Union Territory/University/State Schools Teams at the level mentioned in categories 2 to 5 above but could not win a medal or position
in the same order of preference.
Note 1: In the event of a tie

those who have secured a higher position or won more than one medal may be given the preference. Note 2: Participation in individual and team event/item may be given the same preference. Note 3: No preference may be given for winning more than one medal/position. Note 4: In case of any doubt about the status of a tournament
the matter will be decided by the Department of Personnel & Training in consultation with the Department of Sports
Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.

content_sections.heading: CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be considered, a candidate must satisfy the age limit, the educational qualification for the post applied for, and the sports eligibility conditions. The educational qualification must be held on the closing date of submission of the application form. The candidate must be 18 to 27 years of age on 23.11.2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit by five (5) years is allowed in each case. In addition, a further relaxation of five years is allowed only to candidates belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC)/Scheduled Tribe (ST) in each case. A total of 10 years of age relaxation is therefore allowed to SC/ST candidates only. Although the additional age relaxation is provided to SC/ST candidates, the notification states that no post shall be reserved for any category of candidates. Age relaxation is admissible only to sportspersons who satisfy all other eligibility conditions related to education and sports qualifications, backed by a certificate in the prescribed form from the authority detailed in the notification. Appointment can be made of a sportsperson considered meritorious with reference to the following criteria. The sportsperson should have represented: A State or the country in a National or International competition; or medal winners in Junior National Championships; or medal winners in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years); or Khelo India Winter Games; or Khelo India Para Games; or medal winners in Khelo India University Games; or medal winners in School Games Federation of India (SGFI), in any of the games/sports mentioned in the DoPT Office Memorandum No. DOPT-1720781414772 dated 04.03.2024. Their University in the Inter-University Tournaments conducted by the Inter-University Sports Boards in any of the sports/games specified in the same DoPT Office Memorandum. The State School Teams in the National Sports/games for schools conducted by the All India School Games Federation in any of the games/sports mentioned in the same DoPT Office Memorandum. For Chess: Grand Master (GM) Title, International Master (IM) Title, Chess Olympiad. IM/GM title should be in Open Category like Woman Grandmaster (WGM) etc. While National Open Chess Championship is treated as National Championships, the medal winning performance in National Team Chess Championship will also be considered for recruitment. Only certificates awarded by the authorities listed below will be taken into account as evidence of participation in competitions. The applicant may submit self-attested copies of at least one merit certificate issued by one of these authorities along with the application. The applicant must submit Forms 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 (whichever is applicable), complete in all respects. Specimens of these forms are given in Annexure B of the notification. Certificates of sports achievements submitted in any other form, or from authorities other than those listed above, will be ignored.

content_sections.heading: CGST Lucknow Sports Quota Selection Process
content_sections.text: Subject to fulfilling the educational qualification, the applications will be scrutinized and suitable applicants will be shortlisted for the further selection procedure. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Tax Assistant will be called for a data entry speed test. Shortlisted candidates who applied for Havaldar will be called for the Physical Standards and Physical Efficiency Test. The Data Entry test and the Physical Efficiency/Physical Standard test will be held in Lucknow. Shortlisted candidates must appear at their own expenses, and the date, time and venue will be communicated in due course. Success in the test confers no right to appointment unless the Department is satisfied, after such enquiry as may be considered necessary, that the applicant is suitable in all respects for appointment to the post. The merit of sportspersons who fulfil the eligibility conditions will be considered/decided in the following order of preference: First preference to those candidates who have represented the country in an International Competition with the clearance of the Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/U.T. in the Senior or Junior level national Championships organized by the National Sports Federations recognized by Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports or National Games organized by Indian Olympics Association and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Between the candidates participating in Senior and Junior National Championships/games, the candidates having participated and won a medal in Senior National Championship should be given preference. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a University in an Inter-University competition conducted by Association of Indian Universities/Inter University Sports Board or Khelo India University Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented a State/UT in Khelo India Youth Games (age category above 18 years) or Khelo India Winter Games or Khelo India Para Games conducted with authorization of Department of Sports, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place in finals. Next preference may be given to those who have represented the State Schools in the National sports/games for Schools conducted by the All-India School Games Federation and have won medals or positions up to 3rd place. Next preference may be given to those who represented a State/Union Territory/University/State Schools Teams at the level mentioned in categories 2 to 5 above but could not win a medal or position, in the same order of preference.
