Candidates who have been awarded a Ph.D. Degree under the University Grants Commission (Minimum Standards and Procedure for Award of M.Phil./Ph.D. Degree) Regulations, 2009 or 2016, and their amendments, may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET. Candidates who registered for the Ph.D. programme before July 11, 2009 are governed by the Ordinances, Bye-laws and Regulations that applied at that time. They are exempted from NET/SLET/SET only if they meet all of these conditions: The Registrar or the Dean (Academic Affairs) of the university concerned must certify that these conditions are met. NET/SLET/SET is not required for Master's programmes in disciplines for which the UGC, CSIR or a similar UGC-accredited test (like SLET/SET) does not conduct NET/SLET/SET. B. A Ph.D. degree from a foreign university or institution ranked among the top 500 in the World University Ranking, at any time, by any one of these: Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) The Times Higher Education (THE) The Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai) The notice also sets these rules for Assistant Professor: A minimum of 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale) at the Master's level is the essential qualification for direct recruitment of teachers. A 5% relaxation is allowed at both the Bachelor's and the Master's level for Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Other Backward Classes (OBC) (Non-creamy Layer) candidates. The same 5% relaxation applies to Differently abled candidates: (a) blindness and low vision; (b) deaf and hard of hearing; (c) locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid-attack victims and muscular dystrophy; (d) autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; (e) multiple disabilities from amongst (a) to (d), including deaf-blindness. The 55% eligibility marks and the 5% relaxation are based only on the qualifying marks, without any grace mark procedure. Ph.D. Degree holders who obtained their Master's Degree before 19 September 1991 get a 5% relaxation, from 55% to 50% of the marks. Candidates should check the conditions for the post they are applying for. | Essential: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or Institute in (a) Materials Engineering/Materials Science & Engineering/Metallurgical Engineering/Materials & Metallurgical Engineering, or (b) Mechanical Engineering. Desirable: (i) Master's Degree from a recognized University or Institute in any of the above disciplines; (ii) one year experience in Research and Development in Industry or R&D or Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations. Job requirement: Work in ongoing R&D projects in broad areas of Energy materials and Systems, Surface Engineering, Ceramics, Carbon Materials, Powder Metallurgy etc. | Essential: (i) B.Sc. in Physical Sciences (with Chemistry as one of the subjects) or equivalent from a recognized University/Institute; OR (ii) three (3) years' full-time Diploma in Metallurgy/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering or equivalent from a recognized Board of Technical Education of Central or State Government. Desirable: (i) Prior technical experience in Industry/R&D laboratories; (ii) good interpersonal and communication skills with multi-tasking ability. Job requirement: Attached to one of the Centres to assist and provide technical support to Scientific & Technical Staff in R&D projects/programmes; operate and maintain R&D equipment/instruments; look after laboratory facilities including SOPs and Safety Protocols; assist in other allied works. Note: This is an entry-level post in the technical category. Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as M.Sc./B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech./M.E./M.S./Ph.D. in any subject or discipline as on the crucial date of eligibility will not be considered, and candidates with branches other than those specified will also not be considered. If, after verification of certificates at joining or thereafter, a selected candidate does not fulfil the essential qualifications, possesses higher qualifications, or any claim/certificate/document is found forged/invalid/fraudulent or information is suppressed, the appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated at any time and legal action may be initiated. | Essential qualification: (i) 10th/SSC pass; plus (ii) 2 years full-time ITI in Fitter/Turner/Electrician trade from a recognized Board of Technical Education of Central or State Government. Essential experience: Three (3) years' technical experience in Industry/R&D laboratories. Desirable: (i) Sound knowledge of industrial equipment used for fabrication of components and assembly of systems; (ii) good interpersonal and communication skills with multi-tasking ability. Job requirement: Attached to one of the Centres/Sections to assist Scientific and Technical staff in operation and maintenance of R&D equipment and instruments including SOPs and Safety Protocols; maintain cleanliness and upkeep of laboratory facilities. Selected candidates may be assigned to any non-technical Centre/Section depending on work requirements and shall be willing to undertake any duties assigned, including work of a non-technical nature. Notes: This is an entry-level post in the technician category. Candidates possessing higher qualifications such as Diploma/B.Sc. or equivalent degree OR M.Sc./B.Tech./B.E./M.Tech./M.E./M.S. in any subject or discipline as on the crucial date of eligibility will not be considered, nor will candidates with branches other than those specified. Appointment is liable to be cancelled/terminated, and legal action may be initiated, if the selected candidate does not fulfil the essential qualifications, possesses higher qualifications, or any claim/certificate/document is found forged/invalid/fraudulent or information is suppressed. Experience includes Apprenticeship training/trainee experience and/or experience in Government Departments/Academic/Scientific Institutions/Autonomous Bodies/Research laboratories/Registered companies/Industries/Societies/MNCs/Private limited companies etc., and shall be supported by NPS/EPF & ESI membership. Without proper experience certificate, or with an experience certificate from unregistered companies/industries and/or individuals, experience will not be accepted. Part-time experience will not be considered for calculating years of experience. | Essential: (i) Pass in 10th/SSC or equivalent from a recognized Board; (ii) valid driving license to drive light and heavy vehicles; (iii) knowledge of motor mechanism (able to identify and rectify minor defects in vehicles); (iv) experience of driving light vehicles for at least three (3) years and heavy vehicles for at least six (6) years; (v) knowledge to maintain vehicle logbooks, journey records, fuel consumption details and other related documents. Desirable: (i) Sound knowledge of traffic rules, road safety regulations, vehicle documents and safe driving practices; (ii) capable of operating material-handling equipment such as forklifts and battery-operated trucks; (iii) basic knowledge of vehicle maintenance and troubleshooting of brakes, clutch, tyres, batteries and engine performance and other essential components; (iv) responsible for upkeep and cleanliness of vehicles operated by the Motor Transport Section; (v) attend official duties on holidays/during odd hours as and when required; (vi) good interpersonal and communication skills (in Hindi/Telugu) with multi-tasking ability. Job description: Attached to the Motor Transport Section; drive staff car, bus and other vehicles as assigned; ensure safe and timely transportation of officers, staff, research students, guests and materials; maintain upkeep, cleanliness and roadworthiness of vehicles and logbooks, journey records and fuel consumption details; promptly report vehicle defects and maintenance requirements; perform other duties assigned. Notes: Total prescribed experience should be after obtaining a valid LMV and HMV license. Experience certificates should only be from Army/Navy/Airforce (for Ex-servicemen)/Government Departments/Academic/Scientific Institutions/Autonomous Bodies/Research laboratories/State Road Transport Corporations/Registered Companies/Industries/Societies/Trusts/MNCs/Private limited companies etc., supported by NPS/EPF & ESI membership. Certificates without proper details or from unregistered companies/industries and/or individuals, and part-time experience, will not be accepted. | The crucial date of eligibility (cut-off date for qualification, experience and age) is not specified in the provided notification pages.

faq.question: What is DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: How many vacancies are available in DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 100 vacancies available for Para Legal Volunteers across Sheohar district.

faq.question: What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the filled application form is 30 November 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: What is the educational qualification required for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matriculation (Class 10) from a recognized board.

faq.question: What is the age limit for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: The minimum and maximum age limits are not specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Is there any application fee for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: What is the pay or honorarium for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteers?
faq.answer: Para Legal Volunteers receive Rs. 750 per day, which is payable only on specific days when assigned tasks by the authority or when bringing individuals to the ADR center for legal aid / participating in awareness camps.

faq.question: How can I apply for DLSA Sheohar Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must download the application form from the website, fill it out completely, attach self-attested documents, and send it by registered post or submit it by hand to the Secretary, District Legal Services Authority, ADR Bhavan, Sheohar.

faq.question: Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is explicitly a voluntary service assignment and not a regular government job appointment.

faq.question: Who is eligible to apply as a Para Legal Volunteer in Sheohar?
faq.answer: Permanent residents of Sheohar district who are Matric pass and possess an interest in social service without financial gain—including retired teachers, government servants, senior citizens, Anganwadi workers, doctors, students, and club members—are eligible to apply, excluding practicing advocates.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only through the LAHDC-KSSRB online portal from 27 October 2026 to 27 November 2026. Applications sent by post, by hand, by mail or by any other means will be summarily rejected.

Open the portal www.dssrbkargil.in and click the "New User Registration" link for one-time registration. Use your own mobile number and a valid, active personal e-mail ID, and keep both active during the recruitment cycle.

Fill in the basic and contact details and upload a scanned passport-size photograph and signature in JPEG format. The notice's application section allows 20 KB to 100 KB, while its instructions to candidates say 20 KB to 50 KB. The photograph should be about 3.5 cm (width) x 4.5 cm (height) and no more than three months old, with the face covering about 40% of the area (samples in Annexure-XV(A)).
Log in with the user ID and password sent to your registered e-mail. Check the advertisements and click "Apply Now" against the post.

Fill in the application. Write your name, father's name and date of birth exactly as in the Matriculation/Secondary certificate. Apply separately for each category of post, and submit only one application per category of post.
Pay the fee online (₹250 Unreserved, ₹200 other categories) by 27 November 2026.
Read the declaration at the end of the form, then submit. The application is then accepted provisionally, and no corrections are allowed after final submission.
Print the application form. You do not send it to the Board. A duly signed printed copy must be produced, with self-attested documents, at the scrutiny or Document Verification stage.

content_sections.heading: About LAHDC-KSSRB
content_sections.text: The Kargil Subordinate Service Recruitment Board works under the Office of the Secretary, Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council, Kargil, in the Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh. Its job is to select candidates and recommend them to departments, based on the vacancies those departments report. The departments, not the Board, decide the number of vacancies and the reservation roster. The Board's Chairman is the Deputy Commissioner/CEO, LAHDC, Kargil, and its e-mail address is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Department
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 181 posts across 20 items in six departments. Category-wise, there are 4 UR, 155 ST, 1 SC, 6 ALC and 15 EWS posts. The horizontal reservation is 5 posts for PwD, 8 for ESM and 5 for OSP. Most of the posts are in the School Education Department (107 posts, 70 of them Class-IV). The Ladakh Power Development Department has the next largest share (47 posts, 45 of them Technician-III). The other departments have 13 posts (Animal Husbandry), 8 (Rural Development Department & PR), 5 (PHE/I&FC) and 1 (Handicraft). Vertical reservation is for Scheduled Castes (SC), Scheduled Tribes (ST), Actual Line of Control (ALC) and Economically Weaker Sections (EWS). Horizontal reservation is 6% for Ex-Servicemen (ESM), 4% for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) and 4% for Outstanding Sportsperson (OSP), vide S.O 247 dated 18.08.2026. The Indenting Departments decide and communicate where it applies. Reservation follows the Reservation Rules notified vide S.O 77 dated 27-06-2025 of the Social & Tribal Welfare Department, read with the Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Regulation, 2025. A candidate eligible under more than one category (ST and ALC, ALC and EWS, or SC and ALC) must choose only ONE category in the online form, as per section-19 of the J&K Reservation Act, 2004. The choice cannot be changed after submission. Only candidates with a benchmark disability count as PwD. Their selection depends on the posts being identified as suitable for their category and on the vacancies the departments report. Sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen get no age relaxation or reservation and should not mark themselves as ex-servicemen. The number of vacancies comes from the departments. The Board is not responsible if a department withdraws or changes them.

Candidates still awaiting the result of the final examination on that date are NOT eligible and should not apply. Selection follows the Recruitment Rules of each post. Equivalency is not allowed unless the prescribed essential qualification mentions it. Where it is allowed, the candidate must submit the equivalence order or letter (with number and date) from the Government of India, a State Government or the Competent Authority. content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only through the LAHDC-KSSRB online portal from 27 October 2026 to 27 November 2026. Applications sent by post, by hand, by mail or by any other means will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: A printed admit card, downloaded from the website (admit cards will not be sent by post) Two recent passport-size colour photographs A valid original photo ID, such as an Aadhaar Card or e-Aadhaar printout, Driving License, Voter Card, PAN Card, an identity card issued by a University/College/Government, an Employer ID Card, or any photo ID issued by the Central/State Government An additional original certificate proving date of birth, if the photo ID does not show it A signed printout of the online application form Self-attested copies of supporting documents, and original certificates A Domicile Certificate (Annexure-V), issued by the Tehsildar An SC certificate (Annexure-III), ST certificate (Annexure-IV) or ALC certificate (Annexure-XV), issued by the Tehsildar. The ALC certificate is valid for five years from the date of issue. An EWS Income & Asset Certificate (Annexure-XIII), issued by the District Magistrate/Additional District Magistrate/Sub-Divisional Magistrate/Tehsildar. It requires gross annual family income below Rs. 8 lakh. The family must not own 5 acres or more of agricultural land, a residential flat of 1000 sq. ft. or more, a residential plot of 100 sq. yards or more in notified municipalities, or 200 sq. yards or more elsewhere. A PwD certificate (Annexure-VI to IX), from the Members/Chairperson of the Medical Board and countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital. It must be issued under the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 and the Union Territory of Ladakh Reservation (Amendment) Regulation, 2025. An Ex-Serviceman certificate (Annexure-X), from the Zila Sainik Welfare Officer/Commanding Officer OSP certificates (Annexure-A, B, C, D and E: Forms 1 to 5 for international, national, inter-university, national school and Khelo India competitions). They must be issued by the authorities specified in paragraph A.V of DoPT O.M. No. 14034/1/2020-Pers. Policy (D)Pt. Vol.II dated 4 March 2024. For government employees: a No Objection Certificate (Annexure-XI) through proper channel from the Head of Department, and a declaration (Annexure-XII) signed by the applicant. Without the NOC, the candidature is liable to be cancelled. For equivalent or distance-mode qualifications: the equivalence order or letter, or the UGC/distance education bureau approval Reservation and age-relaxation claims are considered only if the certificates are in the prescribed format and are submitted when LAHDC-KSSRB asks for them.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 181 vacancies across 20 post items in six departments. They include Class-IV (70), Technician-III (45), Laboratory Assistant (31), Attendant (9) and Library Assistant (5).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and to pay the fee online is 27 November 2026. Applications open on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for LAHDC-KSSRB posts?
faq.answer: It depends on the post. Class-IV, Mirab, Store Khalasi and Attendant need Matriculation/Std. X pass. Junior Assistant needs graduation with a 200-hour or 6-month computer course and a typing speed of 35 words per minute. Technician-III needs a two-year NTC/STC in the relevant trade from NCVT/SCVT.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18-40 years as on 1 January 2026. The upper limit is 45 years for SC/ST/ALC, 50 years for PwBD and 55 years for PwBD who are also SC/ST/ALC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for LAHDC-KSSRB posts?
faq.answer: The notice gives pay levels, not amounts. Junior Assistant, Receptionist, Veterinary Pharmacist and other L-4 posts are at Level L-4. Laboratory Assistant, Technician-III and other L-2 posts are at Level L-2. Class-IV, Mirab, Bearer, Store Khalasi and Attendant are at Level SL-1.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹250 for Unreserved candidates and ₹200 for other categories. It is paid online by 27 November 2026, separately for each category of post, and is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register through "New User Registration" on www.dssrbkargil.in and log in with the ID sent to your e-mail. Then click "Apply Now" against the post and pay the fee online. Applications by post, by hand or by mail are rejected.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for LAHDC-KSSRB posts?
faq.answer: Selection is through a CBT/TBT/OMR objective exam of 100 questions, with 0.25 negative marking and 20% minimum qualifying marks. Shortlisted candidates then go to Document Verification. A qualifying skill test is held where the essential qualification prescribes one.

faq.question: Q9. Who can apply for LAHDC-KSSRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only residents of Kargil District (Erstwhile District Kargil) who hold a Domicile Certificate in the Annexure-V format can apply.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the LAHDC-KSSRB exam be held?
faq.answer: Exam centres will be in Kargil, Drass, Zanskar and Sankoo districts only. The exam date will be announced on the LAHDC-KSSRB website, and admit cards are expected there tentatively one week before the exam.

basic_details.short_information: North Western Railway (NWR) has released the revised Notice No. 04/2026 (NWR/AA), dated 21.10.2026, for NWR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026. The Railway Recruitment Cell (RRC), Jaipur is inviting online applications for the engagement of Act Apprentices under the Apprentices Act 1961 for the year 2026-27 against 2008 slots in the designated trades at the workshops and units of North Western Railway.

application_fee.details: The NWR Act Apprentice application fee is Rs. 100 for all candidates except those exempted. SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Women candidates do not have to pay any fee. The fee is non-refundable. | The fee is paid online through the payment gateway after the online application is complete at www.rrcjaipur.in. After a successful payment, the candidate is redirected to the RRC Jaipur website to complete the application and download the application form. Payment can be made by debit card, credit card or internet banking. Transaction charges for online payment, if any, are borne by the candidate. If the amount is deducted but the application cannot be downloaded, the candidate should click the "Verify Payment" button to reconfirm the payment from the payment gateway. An e-receipt is generated on successful payment and should be printed and retained. If the transaction is not completed, the candidate should log in again and pay online. No change or edit is allowed after the fee payment. RRC/NWR is not responsible for incomplete or pending online fee transactions.

age_limit.details: The NWR Act Apprentice age limit is 15 to 24 years as on 22.11.2026. A candidate should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age on that date. The upper age limit is relaxable as shown below. | The Ex-Servicemen relaxation does not apply to Ex-Servicemen who have already joined Government service on the civil side after availing the Ex-Servicemen status. Regardless of community, Ex-Servicemen are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota, if available. If UR vacancies are not available, only Ex-Servicemen of the communities where vacancies are available are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota. | Reservation is also provided for the following, who will be engaged as per the details in the notification: children of deceased/disabled Ex-Servicemen including those killed/disabled during peace time, children of Ex-Servicemen, children of serving jawans, children of serving officers, and Ex-Servicemen. An Ex-Servicemen candidate selected under the reservation is placed in the appropriate category (UR/SC/ST/OBC) to which he belongs.

qualification.details: To meet the NWR Act Apprentice eligibility, candidates must satisfy the qualification and age conditions given below. Before applying, candidates should ensure that they fulfil all the eligibility norms and hold the requisite educational and technical qualifications from a recognized Board/Government University/Institute as on the date of submission of the application. Those awaiting results of the final exams need not apply. | Candidates must choose only one unit and should check the available training slots against their ITI trade before selecting the unit. Candidates should hold an Aadhaar Card, as the 12-digit Aadhaar number has to be entered at the time of registration. Candidates seeking reservation must produce the relevant certificates in the prescribed format at the time of Document Verification (see the documents section). Candidates who are not Persons with Benchmark Disability of the types mentioned in the notification should not apply as PwBD. | The NWR Act Apprentice qualification requires Class 10 and an ITI trade certificate in the notified trade.

salary_details.details: The notification does not state a fixed stipend amount. The training period and stipend will be as per the extant rules and directives issued by the Railway Board from time to time. | No hostel accommodation is provided. Selected candidates have to make their own arrangement during the training, as per the Apprentices Act 1961, and are released on completion of the training. Before the training begins, the selected candidate (or the guardian, if the candidate is a minor) has to enter into a Contract of Apprenticeship with the employer. Training in the Railway does not give any right to absorption in the Railway after completing the training.

selection_process: The NWR Act Apprentice selection process is based on a merit list. The notification does not mention any written examination or interview.
The merit list is prepared for all candidates who apply

on the basis of the percentage of marks in Matriculation (with minimum 50% aggregate marks) and the ITI marks in the trade in which the apprenticeship is to be done. The panel is prepared on the basis of the simple average of the marks in Matriculation and ITI. For the Matriculation percentage
the marks obtained in all subjects are counted
not the marks of any subject or group of subjects. For the ITI percentage
the marks mentioned in the provisional/final certificate are counted. If two candidates have the same marks
the older candidate is preferred. If the dates of birth are also the same
the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier is considered first. The final merit list is prepared division/unit-wise
trade-wise and community-wise
equal to the number of slots
in the descending order of the percentage of marks. No centralized merit list is formed. After the merit list is prepared
it is advised to the respective divisions/units
and Document Verification and Medical Examination are held in the opted divisions/units based on merit
trade and vacancy. Candidates finally enlisted are subject to verification of original testimonials and production of the medical certificate as per Annexure-IV.
how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online only on the RRC Jaipur website. The detailed instructions for filling the online application will be available on the website.
Check the eligibility, the trade-wise slots and the unit in which your ITI trade has a training slot. Only one unit can be chosen.
Visit the RRC Jaipur website, www.rrcjaipur.in, and follow the online application instructions available from 23.10.2026.
Fill in the personal details and bio-data carefully. Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar number, an active mobile number and a valid e-mail ID.

Upload the colour photograph (3.5 cm x 3.5 cm, not older than three months, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20 KB to 70 KB, clear front view without cap and sunglasses) and the signature (3.5 cm x 2.5 cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20 KB to 30 KB).
After checking the details, pay the fee online through the payment gateway if applicable, and download the application form.
Note the Registration Number issued at submission, and keep the printout and the e-receipt. Do not send any printout or copy to RRC by post.

For any problem in the online submission and printing of the application, a helpline number will be available on the website from 23.10.2026, between 10:00 a.m. and 17:00 p.m. till the last date (except Sundays and holidays).
important_instructions: This is a centralized notification, and RRC/NWR is the nodal agency for receiving online applications and preparing the merit list. Candidates trying to submit more than one application with different particulars (such as name, father's name, community, photo, qualifications, e-mail ID or mobile number) will have all such applications summarily rejected. No changes are allowed after the final submission, so candidates must choose the unit carefully. A change of division/unit/trade after selection will not be considered. Candidates should submit the application well before the closing date to avoid website load issues. RRC does not accept responsibility if a candidate cannot submit the application on the last day. Any deviation in the name, father's name or date of birth from the Matriculation certificate found during Document Verification leads to cancellation of candidature and debarment. All important messages are sent by e-mail/SMS and are treated as read by the candidates. Candidature is cancelled if the required original testimonials are not produced or any discrepancy is noticed. Wrong or fake certificates can lead to discharge at any stage, even after selection. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidature. No daily allowance, conveyance allowance or travelling allowance is paid for Document Verification. The decision of the Railway administration on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications and the mode of selection is final. The administration is not responsible for printing errors, and no correspondence is entertained.

Those awaiting results of the final exams need not apply. Candidates must choose only one unit and should check the available training slots against their ITI trade before selecting the unit. Candidates should hold an Aadhaar Card, as the 12-digit Aadhaar number has to be entered at the time of registration. Candidates seeking reservation must produce the relevant certificates in the prescribed format at the time of Document Verification (see the documents section). Candidates who are not Persons with Benchmark Disability of the types mentioned in the notification should not apply as PwBD. The NWR Act Apprentice qualification requires Class 10 and an ITI trade certificate in the notified trade.

rows.details: Passed Class 10 examination or its equivalent (under the 10+2 examination system) with minimum 50% marks in aggregate from a recognized Board (no rounding off will be done)
National Trade Certificate in the notified trade issued by the National Council for Vocational Training (NCVT) / State Council for Vocational Training (SCVT)
ITI Pass in the relevant trade to be eligible for consideration

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: The NWR Act Apprentice age limit is 15 to 24 years as on 22.11.2026. A candidate should have completed 15 years of age and should not have completed 24 years of age on that date. The upper age limit is relaxable as shown below. The Ex-Servicemen relaxation does not apply to Ex-Servicemen who have already joined Government service on the civil side after availing the Ex-Servicemen status. Regardless of community, Ex-Servicemen are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota, if available. If UR vacancies are not available, only Ex-Servicemen of the communities where vacancies are available are considered against the Ex-Servicemen quota. Reservation is also provided for the following, who will be engaged as per the details in the notification: children of deceased/disabled Ex-Servicemen including those killed/disabled during peace time, children of Ex-Servicemen, children of serving jawans, children of serving officers, and Ex-Servicemen. An Ex-Servicemen candidate selected under the reservation is placed in the appropriate category (UR/SC/ST/OBC) to which he belongs.

rows.upper_age_relaxation: Up to an additional 10 years, to the extent of service rendered in the Defence Forces plus 3 years, provided they have put in a minimum of 6 months service at a stretch

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Stipend and Training Details
content_sections.text: The notification does not state a fixed stipend amount. The training period and stipend will be as per the extant rules and directives issued by the Railway Board from time to time. No hostel accommodation is provided. Selected candidates have to make their own arrangement during the training, as per the Apprentices Act 1961, and are released on completion of the training. Before the training begins, the selected candidate (or the guardian, if the candidate is a minor) has to enter into a Contract of Apprenticeship with the employer. Training in the Railway does not give any right to absorption in the Railway after completing the training.

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Application Fee
content_sections.text: The NWR Act Apprentice application fee is Rs. 100 for all candidates except those exempted. SC/ST, Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) and Women candidates do not have to pay any fee. The fee is non-refundable. The fee is paid online through the payment gateway after the online application is complete at www.rrcjaipur.in. After a successful payment, the candidate is redirected to the RRC Jaipur website to complete the application and download the application form. Payment can be made by debit card, credit card or internet banking. Transaction charges for online payment, if any, are borne by the candidate. If the amount is deducted but the application cannot be downloaded, the candidate should click the "Verify Payment" button to reconfirm the payment from the payment gateway. An e-receipt is generated on successful payment and should be printed and retained. If the transaction is not completed, the candidate should log in again and pay online. No change or edit is allowed after the fee payment. RRC/NWR is not responsible for incomplete or pending online fee transactions.

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: The NWR Act Apprentice selection process is based on a merit list. The notification does not mention any written examination or interview. The merit list is prepared for all candidates who apply, on the basis of the percentage of marks in Matriculation (with minimum 50% aggregate marks) and the ITI marks in the trade in which the apprenticeship is to be done. The panel is prepared on the basis of the simple average of the marks in Matriculation and ITI. For the Matriculation percentage, the marks obtained in all subjects are counted, not the marks of any subject or group of subjects. For the ITI percentage, the marks mentioned in the provisional/final certificate are counted. If two candidates have the same marks, the older candidate is preferred. If the dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier is considered first. The final merit list is prepared division/unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise, equal to the number of slots, in the descending order of the percentage of marks. No centralized merit list is formed. After the merit list is prepared, it is advised to the respective divisions/units, and Document Verification and Medical Examination are held in the opted divisions/units based on merit, trade and vacancy. Candidates finally enlisted are subject to verification of original testimonials and production of the medical certificate as per Annexure-IV.

content_sections.heading: Standards of Fitness for Persons with Disability
content_sections.text: Locomotor Disability or Cerebral Palsy (LD): Only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible. Hearing Impairment (HI): Loss of 60 decibels or more in the better ear in the conversational range of frequencies. This includes persons who are Deaf, Dumb, Deaf and Dumb. Visually Impaired (VI): For the trades Mechanic (Diesel) and Fitter, low vision means impairment of vision of less than 6/18 to 6/60 with best correction in the better eye, or impairment of field (reduction of fields less than 50 degrees, hemianopia with macular involvement, or altitudinal defect involving lower fields). Multiple Disabilities (MD): PwBD candidates with more than one disability. A PwBD candidate who wants to avail the reservation must produce a disability certificate issued by a competent authority (a Medical Board constituted by the Central or State Government) in the format of Annexure-V(A), V(B), V(C) or V(D).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NWR Act Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply online only on the RRC Jaipur website. The detailed instructions for filling the online application will be available on the website. Check the eligibility, the trade-wise slots and the unit in which your ITI trade has a training slot. Only one unit can be chosen. Visit the RRC Jaipur website, www.rrcjaipur.in, and follow the online application instructions available from 23.10.2026. Fill in the personal details and bio-data carefully. Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar number, an active mobile number and a valid e-mail ID. Upload the colour photograph (3.5 cm x 3.5 cm, not older than three months, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20 KB to 70 KB, clear front view without cap and sunglasses) and the signature (3.5 cm x 2.5 cm, JPG/JPEG, 100 DPI, 20 KB to 30 KB). After checking the details, pay the fee online through the payment gateway if applicable, and download the application form. Note the Registration Number issued at submission, and keep the printout and the e-receipt. Do not send any printout or copy to RRC by post. For any problem in the online submission and printing of the application, a helpline number will be available on the website from 23.10.2026, between 10:00 a.m. and 17:00 p.m. till the last date (except Sundays and holidays).

content_sections.heading: NWR Act Apprentice Important Instructions
content_sections.text: This is a centralized notification, and RRC/NWR is the nodal agency for receiving online applications and preparing the merit list. Candidates trying to submit more than one application with different particulars (such as name, father's name, community, photo, qualifications, e-mail ID or mobile number) will have all such applications summarily rejected. No changes are allowed after the final submission, so candidates must choose the unit carefully. A change of division/unit/trade after selection will not be considered. Candidates should submit the application well before the closing date to avoid website load issues. RRC does not accept responsibility if a candidate cannot submit the application on the last day. Any deviation in the name, father's name or date of birth from the Matriculation certificate found during Document Verification leads to cancellation of candidature and debarment. All important messages are sent by e-mail/SMS and are treated as read by the candidates. Candidature is cancelled if the required original testimonials are not produced or any discrepancy is noticed. Wrong or fake certificates can lead to discharge at any stage, even after selection. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidature. No daily allowance, conveyance allowance or travelling allowance is paid for Document Verification. The decision of the Railway administration on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications and the mode of selection is final. The administration is not responsible for printing errors, and no correspondence is entertained.

basic_details.short_information: Integrated Child Development Services, Buxar (ICDS Buxar) has announced 22 vacancies for Lady Supervisor posts on a contract basis under advertisement number 01/2026. Applicants for these positions in Buxar must possess a Matric or equivalent qualification and 10 years of experience as an Anganwadi Sevika, with a pay of Rs. 25,000 per month. Candidates can submit their online application from 21 October 2026 to 19 November 2026. Additionally, applicants must send the printout of the submitted online application form along with required certificates by registered post on or before 19 November 2

selection_process: Selection for the Lady Supervisor post is based on a merit list prepared according to the marks obtained in educational qualifications (Matric
Intermediate
graduation

and postgraduate exams) and bonus marks assigned for continuous service. Bonus marks are awarded at the rate of 1 mark for each completed year of continuous service as an Anganwadi Sevika up to a maximum of 10 years (10 marks). Additional bonus marks are granted for national or state awards received as an Anganwadi Sevika
and for higher educational degrees (intermediate
and post-graduation) and academic achievements for candidates with National/State awards
subject to prior official departmental permission for acquiring higher qualifications. Final selection excludes candidates with adverse records or disciplinary action.
how_to_apply: Visit the official district website at buxar.nic.in or the portal at 125.16.175.140:88/VacancyList.aspx to access the online application form.
Complete the online registration and fill out all required details accurately on the portal before 19.11.2026 (05:00 PM).
Take two hard copies of the successfully submitted online application form.

Enclose self-attested copies of required documents including marksheets, certificates, caste certificate, residential certificate, character certificate issued by a gazetted officer, and experience certificate countersigned by the Child Development Project Officer (CDPO).
Write "Application for Lady Supervisor post under Anganwadi Sevika" prominently on the top of the envelope.

Send the application by registered post only to the office of the District Programme Officer, Buxar so that it reaches on or before 19.11.2026 by 05:00 PM. Hand-delivered applications or submissions through normal post will not be accepted.
important_instructions: Only working Anganwadi Sevikas of Buxar district with at least 10 years of service as of 01.01.2026 are eligible to apply. The application must be submitted online and a printed hard copy along with all mandatory enclosures must be sent via registered post. Applications received after the final closing date (19.11.2026, 05:00 PM) or sent by normal post or delivered by hand will be rejected summarily. Candidates must bring the original registered postal receipt for verification during counselling. The fixed monthly honorarium/remuneration for the Lady Supervisor post is Rs. 25,000, along with an additional Rs. 120 per month as Anganwadi Centre travel allowance (maximum Rs. 9,000 per month). Selected candidates must submit a medical fitness certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon before final appointment. Engagement is purely on a contract basis under departmental guidelines, and candidates cannot claim regular appointment.

Additional bonus marks are granted for national or state awards received as an Anganwadi Sevika, and for higher educational degrees (intermediate, graduation, and post-graduation) and academic achievements for candidates with National/State awards, subject to prior official departmental permission for acquiring higher qualifications. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed format, Annexure-A, which is printed with the notice. The form can be downloaded from the official website of District Court Balangir (balangir.dcourts.gov.in) and from the official website of the District Magistrate-cum-Collector, Balangir (balangir.odisha.gov.in). Fill all columns of the Annexure-A form carefully in your own handwriting: name in block letters, father's or husband's name, gender, marital status, date of birth, age as on 04.11.2026, permanent and present address, mobile number and e-mail ID (if any), religion, nationality, experience (if any) and the list of documents attached. Affix a self-attested recent passport-size photograph in the box on the form, and sign the declaration with place and date. Attach self-attested copies of the relevant certificates and the documents listed under Enclosures below. Superscribe the envelope: "Application for Engagement on Daily Wage Basis" . Send the envelope by Speed Post only (not by any other mode) to: The Registrar, Civil Courts, Balangir (Patnagarh Road), P.O. / Dist. - Balangir, PIN - 767001, Odisha. The application must reach the office on or before 18 November 2026 (by 5:00 P.M.). Incomplete applications or those received after the last date and time will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All 30 engagements are for Group-D services on a daily-wage, purely temporary basis. A candidate, in order to be eligible, must: Age relaxation is not specified in the notice. Candidates having proficiency in Cooking (unskilled), Driving (unskilled) and House Chores, and who may have knowledge in Electric work (unskilled) and Plumbing work (unskilled), shall be given preference, subject to overall merit. Payment will be the minimum wages of unskilled labour as fixed by the Government of Odisha from time to time as per the Government Rules/Notifications. Payment shall be made on the basis of actual attendance. No other allowances shall be admissible. The engagement is purely temporary and on daily-wage basis. It shall not confer any right for regular appointment, regularisation or absorption in service. The person engaged may be disengaged at any point of time without any prior notice. Place of posting may be at Headquarters or any outlying station of the Judgeship of Balangir, as per requirement and at the discretion of the Authority. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Documents to be submitted along with the application: Duly filled-in application form in the prescribed format Self-attested photocopy of the educational certificate(s) Self-attested photocopy of Voter ID Card / Aadhaar Card or any other Government-issued identity proof Two recent passport-size colour photographs Two self-addressed envelopes affixing postage stamp worth Rs.30/- each An undertaking that he/she shall not claim regular appointment in future An undertaking that there is no criminal case pending against him or her and that he or she has not been convicted in any case Two character certificates from any Gazetted Officers

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection shall be made through a Walk-in Interview of the eligible candidates whose applications have been received within the prescribed period and found complete in all respects. The date, time and venue of the interview will be notified later on the District Court website and on the notice boards of the District Court. Preference for cooking, driving, house chores, electric and plumbing skills applies subject to overall merit. The decision of the Authority regarding shortlisting and selection shall be final and binding, and no correspondence in this regard shall be entertained. No TA/DA will be paid to applicants for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.heading: WCD Bastar Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Security Guard/Night Guard will work in shifts to provide 24 hour service at OSC. The Security Guard/Night Guard would be responsible for the overall security of OSC. She/he would be responsible for safety of all capital assets, furniture and equipment at OSC.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application must be submitted in the prescribed format (printed with the notice) at the district office on the walk-in date. Certificates, mark sheets and other documents must be attested by a gazetted officer or self-attested, and the originals with self-attested copies must be brought at the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: A district-level selection committee follows a marks-based system and recommends candidates to the District Collector, who is the appointing authority and issues the appointment orders. The marks are given as follows: From the merit list prepared on 80 marks, applicants are to be invited for the walk-in interview in a 1:10 ratio for each post. Knowledge of the local language/dialect is also judged during the walk-in interview. The final selection list is then prepared, and if candidates have equal marks, the older candidate gets preference. The decision of the District Collector on selection is final. No travel allowance or other allowance is paid for attending the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: India Post Skilled Artisan Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a recognized certificate in the relevant trade or have passed 8th standard with at least one year of experience in that trade. MV Mechanic applicants must additionally hold a valid Heavy Motor Vehicle driving licence. Important: The notification provides two alternative educational qualification routes. how_to_apply: You need a valid e-mail ID and mobile number to register. Keep the e-mail ID active. The system is meant to send an e-mail with the Registration Code, but the notice says this e-mail may not arrive because of network congestion. Write down your Registration Code yourself.

Click on "Online application for the post of Group-D (MTS) in the Aizawl Bench of the Gauhati High Court".
Register with your e-mail ID and mobile number, and note down the Registration Code.
Fill in the form with your photograph and signature. An incomplete form is liable to be rejected summarily, unless the High Court decides otherwise.
Upload clear scanned copies of the documents listed below.
Pay the application fee by 20 November 2026, within bank transaction hours.

Age proof (Birth certificate / Class X admit card)
Educational qualification documents (Marksheet/Pass certificate)
SC/ST certificate (only for SC/ST candidates)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages: a written examination (Stage-I, 70 marks) and then an interview/viva-voce with document verification (Stage-II, 20 marks). The written examination has objective multiple-choice questions, answered on an OMR sheet. It lasts 1½ hours (90 minutes). The Mizo language part is qualifying only. To pass the written examination, a candidate must score at least 40% in it, i.e. 8 out of 20 marks. Marks from the Mizo part are not counted when the merit list is prepared. Candidates are called for the interview/viva-voce and document verification on the basis of their written-examination merit, in the ratio of 1:3 (3 candidates for each post). To qualify, a candidate must score at least 60% in the interview, i.e. 12 out of 20 marks. Final selection is based on the total marks from the written examination and the interview/viva-voce. If two or more candidates have the same total, the one with more written-examination marks is preferred. If those marks are also equal, the older candidate is preferred. The High Court reserves the right to fix or change the cut-off marks for the written examination and the viva-voce. Selected candidates may be assigned any Group-D position(s) based on administrative convenience.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Online registration for Nagaland Police Constable GD Recruitment 2026 will begin on 31 October 2026. Candidates must complete the application and pay the examination fee by the closing date of 30 November 2026. Admit cards will be generated after successful completion of the online application and may be downloaded immediately thereafter. Written examination and interview schedules will be communicated through the official Nagaland Police website and local newspapers.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Nagaland Police has advertised 1,137 Constable GD vacancies. Of these, 1,053 vacancies are allocated through the current recruitment under the approved tribal ratio, while 84 are backlog vacancies from the previous recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable District-wise Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The 1,053 regular recruitment vacancies are distributed among participating districts according to the approved tribal ratio based on the 2011 Census. The district allocation also includes separate male and female vacancies. The original notification provides detailed tribe-wise allocations within these districts in Annexure I. Applicants must check the specific tribe and district allocation before selecting their application district.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Backlog Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification also provides 84 backlog Constable GD vacancies reserved for specific tribes and districts whose vacancies remained unfilled in the preceding recruitment. All 84 backlog vacancies are allocated to male candidates. Special Condition: The single Phom backlog vacancy under Mokokchung is restricted to eligible members of the Phom tribe belonging to Anaki (Old) and Anaki 'C' villages. Candidates applying for backlog posts must satisfy the exact district, residence and tribe conditions provided in Annexure III.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The educational qualification for Nagaland Police Constable GD Recruitment 2026 depends on the applicant's tribe classification. Candidates must also possess valid documents establishing their Indigenous Inhabitant and tribal eligibility. The educational qualification must be from a recognized board or educational authority. Where a pass certificate or provisional pass certificate has not been issued, the notification requires an appropriate certificate or letter from the concerned educational institution or authority. The recruitment is open to eligible male and female candidates from Indigenous Inhabitant Tribes of Nagaland who meet the prescribed age, education, district and physical fitness requirements. Applicants must possess an Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate and relevant tribal certificates issued by the competent authority. Eligible natives or residents of Dimapur, Chumoukedima and Niuland can apply under the combined allocation for these three districts, provided they possess the prescribed supporting certificates. The notification also provides specific arrangements for members of the Chang, Sumi and Phom tribes from identified villages in Mokokchung, Wokha and Shamator districts. Candidates affected by these provisions should refer to the detailed conditions in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Serving Government employees may receive upper-age relaxation equivalent to their qualifying service, subject to a maximum of five years and the applicable Government policy. The notification also provides age-relaxation conditions for certain incumbent Nagaland Police Constables and petitioners covered by the specified Gauhati High Court judgments and orders.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The advertised Constable GD posts carry Pay Level 3, with Grade Pay Rs. 1,800 under the specified pay-band structure of Rs. 5,200–20,200.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The examination fee for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026 is Rs. 300 . Applicants must pay the fee online as part of the application process.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for the Constable GD posts involves physical and medical screening, outdoor physical efficiency tests, an objective-type written examination, interview and NCC certification assessment. Candidates must qualify in the required physical and medical standards before participating in outdoor tests. Only candidates who qualify the PET will be called for the written examination.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Physical Standard Test 2026
content_sections.text: The notification prescribes different minimum height and chest measurements for male and female candidates. Candidates who do not meet the physical requirements may be disqualified during the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Physical Efficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test carries 45 marks and includes running, pull-ups, high jump and long jump. Male and female candidates have separate qualifying standards. Disqualification: Male candidates taking longer than 12 minutes 30 seconds and female candidates taking longer than 12 minutes will be disqualified. Nagaland Police Constable Syllabus 2026 Male candidates completing fewer than six pull-ups and female candidates completing fewer than three pull-ups will be disqualified. A maximum of three attempts is permitted. Candidates who fail to meet the required qualifying standard in any of the outdoor tests will not be permitted to continue in the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Written Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Nagaland Police Constable written examination will consist of 80 multiple-choice questions carrying 40 marks. Candidates will receive two hours to complete the question paper, which will be set in English.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Written Exam Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination may cover the following subjects and knowledge areas specified in the official notification: General Awareness and General Knowledge General Science Indian History Indian Polity Social Sciences Elementary Mathematics Sports Naga Culture and Heritage Nagaland State and Naga Tribes General Mental Aptitude

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Interview and NCC Marks 2026
content_sections.text: After the PET and written examination, candidates will be shortlisted for interview based on the aggregate marks obtained in these two stages. The shortlisting ratio is three candidates for each available post. The interview carries 10 marks, and NCC certification may contribute up to 5 additional marks to the overall merit assessment.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Medical Fitness Requirements
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the medical fitness standards prescribed for police service. Medical examination includes assessment of height, weight, chest, vision, hearing and physical fitness. The notification identifies several disqualifying conditions, including: Eyesight below the prescribed standard. Colour blindness. Deafness or serious hearing impairment. Varicose veins. Squint eyes. Amputated limbs or physical extremities. Physical deformities, including flat feet and knocked knees. Adverse drug screening or alcohol abuse test findings. Candidates must also satisfy the medical and physical requirements during the recruitment process and subsequent training.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Nagaland Police Constable Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible applicants must submit their applications through the Nagaland Police Registration Portal between 31 October and 30 November 2026. Offline applications will not be accepted. Important: Applicants must submit only through the official online recruitment portal. Applications submitted to police offices or other establishments will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Documents Required 2026
content_sections.text: Original documents must be produced whenever required during the recruitment process. Applicants should ensure that the details submitted online match their supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: Nagaland Police Constable Probation and Posting
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will undergo a probation period of two years. Service confirmation will depend on satisfactory completion of probation, medical clearance and verification of antecedents under the applicable rules. Fresh recruits will initially be deployed in India Reserve (IR) Battalions and may be required to serve within or outside Nagaland according to the instructions of the Nagaland Police Department.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC 12th Pass application process starts on 15 October 2026. Candidates must submit the online form by 13 November, while the examination fee can be paid until 15 November 2026. A separate correction window is available after the application closing date. RRBs will announce CBT dates, document verification and medical examination schedules through the unified official Railway Recruitment Board website.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Vacancy 2026 Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Railway Recruitment Boards have announced 1,688 undergraduate vacancies across four posts. Commercial cum Ticket Clerk has the highest number of vacancies at 700, followed by Junior Clerk cum Typist with 600 posts. The detailed RRB-wise, Railway Zone-wise and post-wise vacancy distribution is provided in Annexure B of the official notification on pages 33–40. Candidates should check vacancies for their preferred RRB before submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants for RRB NTPC Undergraduate Recruitment 2026 must have passed Class 12 or an equivalent examination from a recognized board. The notification normally requires at least 50% aggregate marks, but specified candidates are exempt from this minimum-percentage condition. Qualification Cut-off: The required educational qualification must be completed by 15 November 2026. Candidates awaiting final examination results are not eligible to apply. Normally, candidates must secure at least 50% aggregate marks in Class 12. However, the minimum 50% condition is not applicable to the following candidates: Scheduled Caste candidates. Scheduled Tribe candidates. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. Ex-Servicemen. Candidates possessing qualifications higher than Class 12. Yes. Candidates with qualifications higher than Class 12 can apply for the undergraduate posts if they satisfy the prescribed age, medical and other eligibility conditions. The 50% Class 12 minimum marks condition is not insisted upon for such candidates.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Salary 2026
content_sections.text: RRB NTPC Undergraduate posts are placed under Pay Levels 2 and 3 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. The Commercial cum Ticket Clerk post carries initial basic pay of Rs. 21,700, while the remaining three posts carry Rs. 19,900. These are initial basic pay figures, not the total monthly take-home salary.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC Undergraduate application fee is Rs. 500 for general applicants and Rs. 250 for the eligible concessional categories listed in the notification. Part or all of the examination fee is refundable, after deduction of applicable bank charges, only to candidates who appear in the first-stage CBT. Payment Methods: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card and UPI. Only candidates appearing in CBT-1 are eligible for the prescribed refund. The refund is subject to deduction of applicable bank charges. Refunds are processed to an Aadhaar-seeded bank account as provided in the notification. Candidates must ensure their bank account is correctly linked with Aadhaar. Rejected or incomplete applications do not qualify for a fee refund. Important: Economically Backward Class (EBC), Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Other Backward Class (OBC) are different categories. EBC concession is based on the conditions specified in the notification and does not itself provide job reservation.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment process consists of two Computer Based Tests, followed by document verification and medical examination. Unlike several previous NTPC recruitment cycles, CEN 07/2026 does not require a separate Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist or Accounts Clerk cum Typist. CBT-1: First-stage Computer Based Test for all four posts. CBT-2: Second-stage Computer Based Test for shortlisted candidates. Document Verification: Verification of original educational, identity, category and other required documents. Medical Examination: Candidates must pass the prescribed medical fitness standard for their allotted post. No. The Computer Based Typing Skill Test for Junior Clerk cum Typist and Accounts Clerk cum Typist has been dispensed with under CEN 07/2026. Candidates are still expected to possess basic computer and adequate typing proficiency, which may be assessed after joining.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-1 Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC Undergraduate first-stage CBT contains 100 objective-type questions for 100 marks. The examination duration is 90 minutes, and one-third of a mark is deducted for every incorrect answer. Duration: 90 Minutes. Negative Marking: 1/3 mark per incorrect answer. Scribe-eligible Candidates: 120 Minutes.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate CBT-2 Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted through CBT-1 will appear for CBT-2. The second-stage CBT contains 120 questions carrying 120 marks, with a duration of 90 minutes. Duration: 90 Minutes. Negative Marking: 1/3 mark per incorrect answer. Scribe-eligible Candidates: 120 Minutes. These minimum qualifying percentages apply to the CBTs. PwBD candidates may receive the specified relaxation when the notification's conditions are met. Qualifying marks alone do not guarantee shortlisting.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB NTPC Undergraduate syllabus for CBT-1 and CBT-2 covers Mathematics, General Intelligence and Reasoning, and General Awareness. Both stages have the same broad subjects but different question distributions. Number System, Decimals and Fractions LCM and HCF Ratio and Proportion Percentages Mensuration Time and Work Time and Distance Simple and Compound Interest Profit and Loss Elementary Algebra Geometry and Trigonometry Elementary Statistics Analogies Number and Alphabetical Series Coding and Decoding Mathematical Operations Similarities and Differences Relationships and Analytical Reasoning Syllogism Venn Diagrams Puzzles and Data Sufficiency Statement and Conclusion Decision Making Maps and Graph Interpretation Current Affairs - National and International Indian History and Freedom Struggle Indian and World Geography Indian Polity and Constitution Indian Economy General Science up to Class 10 Level Sports, Art, Culture and Literature Computer Basics and Applications Science and Technology Developments Government Schemes and Programmes Environmental Issues Indian Transport Systems Important National and International Organizations

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Medical Standards 2026
content_sections.text: Each undergraduate post has a prescribed railway medical standard. Candidates must satisfy the required fitness and vision conditions for the post they select. Candidates who have undergone LASIK or another procedure to correct refractive error are not eligible for posts requiring A-3 medical standards under this notification. For B-2 and C-2 posts, eligibility is subject to the medical conditions specified in the official notification.

content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit only one online application through the unified official RRB website from 15 October to 15 November 2026. Candidates must carefully choose the RRB and their post preferences because important details cannot be changed later. Visit https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/ . Click Create an Account if you are a new applicant. Candidates who already created an RRB account for earlier CENs should use their existing login credentials. Register using the required personal details, active mobile number and email address. Complete Aadhaar or other permitted identity verification as directed by the application portal. Choose one Railway Recruitment Board. Enter the required personal, educational and reservation details. Select eligible posts, Railway Zones and Production Unit preferences carefully. Complete the live photograph capture as instructed by the portal. Upload the scanned signature and applicable supporting documents. Review the information and declaration carefully. Pay the prescribed examination fee using the available online payment method. Submit the application and retain the confirmation details. Important: The selected RRB and details entered during Create an Account cannot be modified later. Candidates must not submit multiple applications.

content_sections.heading: RRB NTPC Undergraduate Photo and Signature Requirements 2026
content_sections.text: The RRB application process includes live photograph capture and upload of the candidate's signature. Candidates should follow the exact instructions to avoid application rejection. The candidate's photograph must be captured live through the application system. Do not upload or photograph an existing printed photograph. Follow the portal's instructions for face positioning, lighting and identity matching. The notification also requires eligible SC/ST candidates seeking a free train travel pass to upload the prescribed community certificate in PDF format.

content_sections.heading: About SAIL CFP
content_sections.text: Chandrapur Ferro Alloy Plant (CFP), Mul Road, Chandrapur, is a unit of Steel Authority of India Limited, which the notice describes as a Maharatna company. The notice invites eligible Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) candidates for Proficiency Training in the Occupational Health Centre (OHS) and CFP Dispensary and OHS under the M&HS department.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice lists these alternative qualifications for the post, all valid on the date of the walk-in interview: Intermediate (10+2) with Science from any university / institution recognized by the Central or State Govt (with working experience in any Hospital / Nursing Home / Registered Doctor); OR Diploma or Certificate Course in Dresser / Compounder from any university / institution recognized by the Central or State Govt; OR B.Sc (Nursing); OR Diploma or Certificate course in General / Auxiliary Nursing & Midwife (GNM / ANM) from a recognized Institute / College affiliated to Indian Nursing Council (INC), with Certificate of Registration. The upper age limit is 30 years, valid as on the date of the walk-in interview. The minimum age of engagement as Proficiency Trainee Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) is 18 years. The upper limit is relaxed by 3 years for OBC-NCL (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates and by 5 years for SC and ST candidates. The candidate must be an Indian national with the requisite qualification from an Institute recognized by the State or Central Govt. Certificates for qualification, experience, caste/category and proof of date of birth must be valid on the date of the walk-in interview. OBC-NCL and EWS (Income & Asset) certificates should be valid for Financial Year 2025-26, that is, issued on or after 1st April, 2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the full qualification wording before attending.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Filled-in and signed application in the prescribed format (Annexure-A), with a recent passport size colour photograph pasted on it Letter of undertaking (Annexure-B) on non-judicial stamp paper (Rs.10/-) Qualification documents; the application form asks for self-attested pass certificates and mark sheets for educational and professional qualification (all years / semesters) Aadhar Card and PAN Card Birth Certificate; the form names the Matriculation / Secondary / Class X pass certificate as proof of date of birth Caste Certificate (SC / ST / OBC-NCL / EWS candidates) Address Proof and passport size photo Experience Certificate, and Internship Certificate if applicable State Nursing Council Registration certificate, which the form lists for Trainee Nurse Originals are checked at the interview and at joining. The notice gives no postal address or email for sending applications.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at 10.00 AM for document verification; the interview is at 02:30 PM. Screened candidates, chosen on a first-cum-first-serve basis, are interviewed. If more candidates appear, the interview may continue on another day, subject to their appearance at the scheduled time. Selection for Proficiency Training is made by judging performance in the interview. In case of a tie in the final cut-off score, the candidate with the higher percentage of marks in the aggregate of the qualifying qualification is selected. Selected candidates undergo a medical check-up by SAIL-CFP Hospital / Dispensary and report for training at the plant with immediate effect. Training starts shortly after selection is completed and an Offer of Admittance as Proficiency Trainee Dresser Cum Compounder (Male) is issued.
