content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: These are deputation posts. Only serving officials of the organisations named for each post can apply, and their applications must be forwarded by their employer. Educational qualification: Bachelor degree in Engineering or Technology in Electrical or Electronics or Electrical Communications or Electronics Communications or Computer Science or Telecommunications or Information Technology or Instrumentation from a recognised University or Institute. Candidates who passed Sections A and B of the Institution Examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India), or the Graduate Membership Examination of the Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (India), or Associate Membership Examination Parts II and III or Sections A and B of the Aeronautical Society of India, are also eligible if they were enrolled with these institutions up to 31 May 2013. Service required: Officers of the Central Government or State Government or Union Territories or autonomous bodies or statutory organisations or public sector undertakings or Universities or recognised research institutions: holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; OR with six years service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in Level-5 in the pay matrix (Rs. 29,200 - 92,300) or equivalent in the parent cadre or department. The period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Educational qualification: 12th pass from a recognised Board. Skill Test Norms: Dictation: 10 minutes at 80 words per minute. Transcription: 50 minutes (English), 65 minutes (Hindi) - only on computer. Service required: Employees of Central Government, State Government, Union Territories, Central autonomous or statutory organisation, Central Public Sector Undertakings, Central Government University or Recognized Central Research Institutions: holding analogous posts on a regular basis in the parent cadre or Department; OR with eight years' service rendered after appointment to the post on a regular basis in Level-2 in the pay matrix (Rs. 19,900 - 63,200) or equivalent in the parent cadre or Department. The period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years. For both posts, the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The deputation for both posts shall be for three years or till a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. Further extension is governed by the applicable rules and guidelines. The terms and conditions are regulated by DoT OM No. 20-01/2023-SEA-II dated 31.10.2023, its corrigendum dated 01.11.2023 and DoPT OM No. DOPT-1726140763694 dated 28.03.2024, which are attached to the circular. The DoT terms include: Pay fixed in accordance with DoPT instructions; DA as applicable to Central Government employees. HRA and Transport Allowance at the rate admissible under DoT rules; Children Education Allowance as per Central Government rules. Joining time pay for both ways, and transfer travelling allowance for joining and repatriation, borne by DoT. Leave Rules of the parent department apply; DoT pays the Leave Salary Contribution. LTC under Central Government LTC Rules at DoT's cost. Medical facilities as per the policy of the borrowing organisation; the CGHS card is surrendered at repatriation. Accommodation as per DoT officials, with standard licence fee; EPF, gratuity, insurance and (for BSNL staff) Superannuation Pension Scheme contributions handled as set out in the OM.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DoT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application form at Annexure-I(A) for Junior Engineer (Telecom) or Annexure-I(B) for Stenographer Grade-II, with a recent self-attested photo. Sign the declaration at Annexure-II. Get the employer or competent authority to complete the certification at Annexure-III and countersign the form with seal. Attach the documents in the Annexure-IV checklist. Have the Head of Department or Cadre Controlling Authority forward the application through proper channel to: ADG (Admin & HR), O/o Special DGT Delhi LSA, 5th Floor, Mahanagar Doorsanchar Bhawan, Near Zakir Hussain College, Jawaharlal Nehru Marg (Old Minto Road), New Delhi - 110002. Optionally, send an advance copy by email to [email protected] with copy to [email protected] ; it is considered only if the duly signed physical copy is received through proper channel. Annexure-I(A) / I(B) Application Form duly filled Annexure-II (Declaration) Annexure-III duly attested (Certification by Employer), covering vigilance clearance, integrity and penalties in the last 5 years Attested copies of last 5 years APAR (attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary or above) Copy of latest month salary slip Copy of official ID card Copy of proof of present address

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A Selection Committee will first shortlist applications on the basis of the eligibility criteria. The committee may then hold a personal interaction (interview) with shortlisted candidates. The criteria for selection may include experience in the relevant field, depth of knowledge and qualification. The decision of the Head of Delhi LSA (Special DGT, Delhi LSA) shall be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after the last date, not forwarded through proper channel, without prescribed documents or otherwise incomplete will be summarily rejected. The competent authority of the lending organisation must certify that the details are verified from service records and countersign with the office seal. Only candidates whose services can be spared on deputation immediately on selection should be forwarded. Selected officials have no claim to seniority for deputation service and no entitlement to absorption in DoT (Annexure-II). An official is liable to be repatriated to the parent organisation for any inaccuracy in the details or contravention of deputation rules. The Head of Delhi LSA reserves the right to accept or reject any or all responses without assigning reasons.

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure

The consolidated salary of the post may vary from time to time, and no other allowance or facilities other than the consolidated salary shall be extended. The likely duration is till the end of the project, 31 December 2026, extendable till June 2027 after approval of project extension. The engagement may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide technical support for the project Assist in data collection, data entry, and management Blood sample collection through door-to-door visits Intervention administration Support fieldwork, including coordination with healthcare facilities and community stakeholders Maintain accurate project records, documentation, and assist in preparing regular reports and updates Logistics management Assist in organizing workshops, training sessions, and dissemination activities Perform any other duties assigned by the Principal Investigator (PI) to support project goals

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are received from individuals by hand on the date of the walk-in interview. No online form or email address is given in the notice. Fill in the application format REC-03 (Application for the post of Project Technician-III/Nurse, for the project IR-CALM), printed on A4 paper, in block letters with a blue pen. Affix a recent passport size photo in the space given. Do not staple it. Give a valid email ID and mobile number, which are compulsory. Attach one set of photocopies of all certificates, self-attested, in the order of the checklist. Bring all original certificates for verification. Without them, candidature cannot be considered. Hand in the application on 16 November 2026 at Ground floor, JISPH, JIPMER. Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card/Voter ID/Passport/Driving License) Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent/High School Certificate) Degrees/Diplomas Experience certificates Any other relevant document, specified in the form Proof, if the applicant states SC/ST/OBC status The form also asks for details of previous employment with proof of work, and contact details of previous employers. Candidates may attach a CV with the form, but an application with a CV alone, without the prescribed form and certificates, will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: After evaluation of the application form, eligible candidates will attend a written test and walk-in interview. The interview is for candidates who qualify in the written test. The written test is at 9:00 AM. It covers basics of public health, epidemiology, data collection and management, research ethics, community engagement, field implementation, MS Office, and phlebotomy with safe sample collection and handling procedures. The interview starts at 2:00 PM onwards. Topics are communication skills, managerial skills, technical knowledge, past project experience and research experience.

content_sections.heading: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Assistant Professor (Physical Education), candidates generally require a Master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grading-system qualification in the concerned or allied discipline from a recognized university. The notification refers to UGC Regulations, 2018, and subsequent applicable amendments. Applicants claiming Ph.D. exemption must meet the notified conditions rather than relying on possession of a Ph.D. degree alone. Applicants must have a recognized Ph.D., a Master's degree with at least 55% marks, a minimum of eight years of relevant teaching or research experience and at least seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals. A research score of at least 75 under the applicable UGC Academic/Research Score provisions is also required. Candidates must possess a graduate degree in any discipline along with the prescribed Sports Coaching qualification from a recognized institution such as SAI, NIS or another approved sports university or institute. The notice also requires relevant coaching experience and participation or achievement in recognized sporting competitions. Important: The candidate's sports specialization must match the discipline or game for which the trainer is being recruited. Candidates must possess a graduate degree from a recognized university with at least 55% marks and the prescribed Yoga qualification, including a relevant postgraduate Yoga diploma or recognized Yoga certification. The notification also requires a minimum of two years of practical experience in Yoga and the prescribed Matriculation-level Punjabi language qualification. Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Science from a recognized Board/University/Institute and possess a Bachelor's degree in Physiotherapy. Applicants must possess a B.E./B.Tech. degree in Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Computer Science or another specifically accepted discipline, or the prescribed postgraduate qualification in Computer Applications. Candidates must possess a B.Com. degree from a recognized university or a degree with the applicable ICWA/CMA qualification, together with the prescribed relevant experience. Experience in accounts, audit, finance or Government/PSU/university accounts administration is required as specified for the post. Candidates must possess a recognized Bachelor's degree, relevant administrative or office supervisory experience and working computer knowledge. Storekeeper candidates need a recognized Bachelor's degree and the prescribed experience or computer qualification under the notified alternatives. Candidates need 10+2 from a recognized Board/University with an equivalent Science subject qualification and the prescribed diploma or degree in sports-related or laboratory fields, including Sports Science, Sports Technology, Sports Physiotherapy or Physical Education, as applicable. The parent office's competent authority signs and seals a certificate at the end of the proforma. The certificate states that the information is correct, that the official's services will be spared on selection, that the official is clear from the vigilance angle, that no vigilance case is pending or contemplated, that there is no doubt about integrity and that cadre clearance has been obtained. The notice does not mention any marking to write on the envelope or any specific postal mode. The contact number printed under the Deputy Director (Admn)'s signature is 011-23312854. content_sections.text: The Odisha Sub-ordinate Staff Selection Commission has issued the for recruitment of 238 District Cadre Group-C Ophthalmic Officers. The detailed 15-page notification contains district-wise vacancies, reservation, educational qualifications, professional registration, age limit, salary, examination fee, written-test pattern, negative marking, merit rules and online application instructions. content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed +2 Science or its equivalent and successfully completed the prescribed two-year certified ophthalmic training programme. Valid registration with the Ophthalmic Officers' Council in Odisha is also mandatory. Yes. The notification requires a two-year certified Ophthalmic Assistant Training Course or certified Ophthalmic Surgical Assistant Course from a Government or Government-recognized institution of Odisha. Candidates who have passed +2 Science but do not possess the prescribed professional training qualification are not eligible. Yes. Candidates must have registered their names with the Ophthalmic Officers' Council in Odisha and possess a valid registration certificate when submitting the online application form. The registration certificate must be uploaded as required by the application portal. Candidates should not assume they can obtain the mandatory registration only after the recruitment examination. Candidates must be able to read, write and speak Odia and must satisfy at least one of the prescribed language-related qualification conditions. Passed the Middle School Examination with Odia as a language subject. Passed Matriculation or equivalent with Odia as the medium of examination in non-language subjects. Passed Odia as a language subject in the final examination of Class VII from a recognized institution. Passed the prescribed Odia language test at M.E. School standard conducted by the competent authority. Important: Knowing conversational Odia alone does not replace the required supporting language qualification or certificate. Candidates must be Indian citizens, possess good character and satisfy the marriage-related and other eligibility conditions prescribed under the relevant Odisha Government service rules.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a 100-mark written examination , followed by the applicable document verification, screening and district-allotment process. Online Registration: Candidates register or re-register through the OSSSC website. Application Submission: Complete the recruitment-specific online application and pay the applicable fee. Written Examination: Appear for the 100-mark objective examination. Provisional Merit List: OSSSC prepares the relevant category-wise merit list from normalized or raw examination marks, as applicable. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates present original qualification, registration, category and other supporting certificates. District Allotment: Allocation is carried out according to merit, district vacancies, reservation and available preferences. Final Selection: Appointment is subject to successful verification and the recommendation and appointment procedures prescribed by the competent authorities.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination carries 100 marks and has a duration of two hours . It will be held in objective multiple-choice format through OMR or CBRE mode, as notified later. Meeting the minimum qualifying marks does not guarantee selection. Final shortlisting depends on examination performance, category-wise merit and the number of vacancies. If two or more candidates obtain equal written examination scores, the commission will apply the prescribed tie-breaking criteria. Higher percentage marks in the qualifying Ophthalmic Assistant or Ophthalmic Surgical Assistant examination. Higher age, where the professional qualification percentage is also equal. Higher Class 12 examination marks, if the tie continues. Other criteria determined by the commission where the preceding stages do not resolve the tie.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.osssc.gov.in . Open the Apply Online section. Select the Ophthalmic Officer Recruitment 2026 application. If you are a new user, select New User Registration . If you have registered previously for OSSSC recruitment, select the prescribed Re-registration option. Carefully complete the registration or re-registration process. Keep the generated User ID and other login credentials secure. Log in to the OSSSC applicant portal. Open the Ophthalmic Officer online application form. Enter the requested personal, educational and professional qualification details. Provide the relevant Ophthalmic Officers' Council registration information. Enter the applicable category, reservation and other eligibility details. Complete the district preference section as provided in the application form. Upload the required photograph, signature and supporting documents. Pay the applicable examination fee through the online payment gateway. Check that the payment and application confirmation have been generated. Review the application carefully and complete final submission. Save the application details for future reference. Complete registration by 29 November 2026 and final application submission by 5 December 2026 . Important: Candidates must submit a complete online application. Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. More than one application submitted by the same candidate may also result in cancellation of the candidature.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Documents Required 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep their original certificates and supporting records ready for application and subsequent verification. Class 10 certificate or equivalent age proof. +2 Science certificate and marksheet. Two-year certified Ophthalmic Assistant Training Course or Ophthalmic Surgical Assistant Course certificate. Valid registration certificate from the Ophthalmic Officers' Council, Odisha. Odia language qualification certificate or prescribed language-test evidence. Valid photo identity proof. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature. SC/ST/SEBC certificate, where applicable. PwD certificate or UDID card, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen discharge and service documents, where applicable. Sports qualification certificate, if claiming the applicable reservation. Appointment letters and relevant employment documents for eligible contractual Ophthalmic Assistants claiming the notified age relaxation. Other documents prescribed by the commission during verification. The photograph must be clear and recent. Candidates should keep the same photograph available throughout the recruitment process. The exact upload requirements displayed on the official application portal must be followed.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer District Preference and Posting 2026
content_sections.text: Ophthalmic Officer is a District Cadre post . Candidates are recruited for district establishments under the Health & Family Welfare Department. The commission will consider the district preference, merit position, applicable reservation and vacancies during the final allocation process. The commission may notify an option to revise or re-exercise district preferences before the allotment stage. If a candidate does not use the available revision facility, the district preferences already submitted may be treated as final. Candidates should monitor official recruitment notices and meet any specified preference-revision deadlines.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Document Verification 2026
content_sections.text: After the written examination, OSSSC will prepare a provisional merit list and shortlist eligible candidates for document verification. The commission may shortlist candidates for verification based on the number of vacancies and the applicable category-wise requirements, including a minimum shortlisting ratio of 1.25 times the notified category-wise vacancies where applicable. Original qualification, council registration, age, language and reservation certificates must be produced before the competent verification authority. Important: Provisional inclusion in the merit list does not guarantee appointment. Any discrepancy between the online application and original documents may lead to rejection.

content_sections.heading: OSSSC Ophthalmic Officer Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: OSSSC will announce the written examination date and admit card availability through its official website. Eligible candidates must download their admission letter using the designated applicant login or admission-letter facility. The commission will not send admission letters by post. Applicants should regularly check official notices, their registered mobile number and their email account.

faq.question: How will candidates be selected?

faq.question: Is the DHS Ramgarh job permanent?

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Notification 2026: Three Official Notifications
content_sections.text: Do not treat all 2,721 posts as one teacher category. The recruitment has three separate notifications with different managements, qualifications and selection provisions.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Vacancy 2026 Post-Wise
content_sections.text: Secondary Grade Teacher is the largest individual category with 1,205 regular posts. The table below also identifies special education and residential-school vacancies separately.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC 2026 District-Wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The 26-district breakup below covers 2,461 regular and special education posts . Society vacancies (260 posts) are counted separately, not added to any district in this table. Kurnool has 404 posts, followed by Prakasam (291) and YSR Kadapa (227).

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Societies Vacancies 2026
content_sections.text: These posts are under residential education societies, model schools and the Welfare of Differently Abled, Transgender and Senior Citizens Department. The vacancy distribution varies by society and cadre.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for AP DSC 2026? Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Educational qualifications are post-specific and governed by the relevant recruitment rules and Information Bulletin. Applicants should not assume that qualification for SGT also qualifies them for SA, TGT, PGT, Principal, PD, PET or Special Education posts. Check the appropriate bulletin for the required academic degree, professional teacher-training qualification, subject or medium, TET eligibility where applicable, and any special education recognition requirements. The notifications direct candidates to the Information Bulletin for the complete post-wise qualifications. Applicants must meet the prescribed qualifications by the applicable notification cutoff; check the relevant bulletin before paying the fee.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Age is calculated as on 1 July 2026 . The detailed notifications provide an ordinary upper limit of 44 years, with higher limits for specified reserved categories.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is ₹1,000 for each post . Candidates applying for more than one post should check the relevant application instructions and the total payable amount before submitting payment. The official payment window runs from 11 to 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: AP DSC Selection Process and Minimum Qualifying Marks
content_sections.text: The selection method depends on the post. The regular SA (except Physical Education) and SGT notifications specify aggregate TRT (80%) and qualifying TET (20%) marks. The societies notification specifies TRT (80%) and TET (20%) for TGT, while Principal, PGT, PD and PET qualifying marks are based on TRT (100%). Do not apply the same weightage mechanically to every post. These are minimum qualifying thresholds, not guaranteed selection cutoffs. The societies notification also provides an English Language Proficiency screening test for Principal, non-language PGT and non-language TGT candidates: 60/100 marks for OC, BC and EWS; 50/100 for SC, ST, PwBD and ex-servicemen. The notification excludes TGT Special Education (Special Schools) from this English screening test. The Special Education notification separately provides certain eligible service candidates with service weightage of 0.5 marks per completed year, up to 5 marks , subject to the stated conditions and overall maximum. Candidates must refer to that notification for eligible service categories and proof requirements. Also Check: AP DSC Syllabus 2026

The official syllabus also includes separate subject coverage for School Assistant languages, Mathematics, Physical Science, Biological Science and Social Studies; distinct TGT and PGT papers; English proficiency where applicable; Principals; PET; and SA-PE/PD. Open the official syllabus PDF rather than relying on a generic common syllabus.

content_sections.heading: About BSF
content_sections.text: The Border Security Force is a Central Armed Police Force under the Ministry of Home Affairs. This circular was issued by its Medical Directorate at the Directorate General, Block-9, Level-4, East Block, Sector-1, R K Puram, New Delhi - 110066, and signed by Dr. Umesh Tiwari, Inspector General/Director(Medical). The posts are in the BSF Medical Set-up, which the subject line calls the BSF paramedical set-up.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Nominations of eligible and willing candidates go in the enclosed proforma to this address: Inspector General/Director(Medical), Directorate General, BSF, Block No. 9, Level-04, East Block, Sector-1, R K Puram, New Delhi-110066. Fill in the Bio-Data proforma (page 5 of the circular) and paste a photograph in the space provided. Sign the proforma, write your address, and get it counter-signed by your Head of Office (HOO) with seal. Get the "Certificate to be furnished by the Employer/Head of Office/Forwarding Authority" (page 6) completed and signed by the HOO with the official seal. Attach duly attested copies of your CR dossiers/APARs for the last five years, attested on each page. Your department forwards the nomination to the address above, so that it reaches BSF by the 60th day from publication in the Employment News. Applications received directly from candidates will not be entertained. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope or a particular postal mode.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the vacancies. Officers of the Central Armed Police Forces or the Central Government or the State Government or the Union territory administration, (a) (i) holding an analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with six years regular service in Level-5 (Rs. 29200-92300) in the pay-matrix in the parent cadre or department; and (b) possessing the educational qualifications and experience given below for the post; and (c) shall be medically fit. Basic Nursing Assistant or Medic Course; Advance Nursing Assistant or Advance Medic Course; and Experience of minimum six years as Nursing Assistant in a hundred bedded Hospital or institute recognised by the Central Government or a State Government or Central Armed Police Forces Hospitals. 12th Class passed from a recognised Board; and Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician or Technology of two years duration from an institution recognised by the Central Government or a State Government; and Experience of minimum six years as Laboratory Technician from a Laboratory Diagnostic Centre or minimum hundred bedded hospital or an institution recognised by the Central Government or a State Government. 12th Class passed from a recognised Board; and Diploma in Physiotherapy of two years duration from an institute recognised by the Central Government or a State Government; and Experience of minimum six years as Physiotherapist from a Physiotherapy Centre or minimum hundred bedded Hospital or Institute recognised by the Central Government or the State Government. Preference will be given to those with a certificate or diploma in the trade from a recognized Institute. Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for appointment on deputation. Deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. For all three posts, the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not exceed 56 years (fifty-six years) as on the closing date of receipt of applications. The notice lists no age relaxation. The crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date prescribed for receipt of nominations, in accordance with DoP&T OM No. AB-14017/71/89-Estt.RR dated 03.10.1989. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Deputation
content_sections.text: The period of deputation in the BSF Medical Set-up shall ordinarily not exceed three years. This period includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment, in the same or another organisation or department of the Central Government. Selected candidates are governed by DOP&T OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010 and MHA (Police-II Division) L/No. I-21022/03/2016-Pers-II dated 22.11.2016, as amended from time to time. Deputation gives no right to claim seniority, pay and allowances or any other pecuniary or service benefits over others. Seniority continues to be counted in the original cadre/department for all purposes, including promotion and financial up-gradation. Deputationists have no inherent right to claim absorption, because the discretion to absorb them rests solely with the BSF. BSF may return a deputationist early to the parent cadre for unsuitability, indiscipline, exigency of service or other unforeseen factors. This requires three months' advance notice to the lending Ministry/Department and the employee.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Bio-Data proforma with photograph, signed by the candidate and counter-signed by HOO with seal Photocopy of the Diploma/Degree in the respective trade Photocopy of the SC/ST certificate, if the candidate belongs to SC/ST Duly attested copies of CR dossiers/APARs for the last five years (attested on each page) Copy of the health card, with the medical category certified by the HOO Certificate from the Employer/Head of Office/Forwarding Authority A separate sheet for additional information, if the space in the form is insufficient The Bio-Data form asks for the name, date of birth, educational qualifications, and employment details in chronological order (office, post held, period, scale of pay and basic pay, nature of duties). It also asks for the present pay with next increment, penalties if any, training programmes attended, and the nature of present employment. For candidates already on deputation or contract, it asks for deputation/contract details, any revised scale of pay, and total emoluments per month now drawn. In the employer certificate, the HOO confirms the following: The particulars furnished are correct. No disciplinary or vigilance case is pending or contemplated against the candidate. The candidate's integrity is beyond doubt. No major or minor penalties have been imposed on the candidate during the last 10 years. The candidate will be relieved to join on selection.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: For candidates posted in BSF under-command Units/SHQrs, the circular directs the BSF Frontier HQrs, Training Institutions and Composite Hospitals to assemble a Departmental Screening Committee (DSC). The DSC assesses and selects candidates as per existing instructions/RRs and sends its proceedings to the Directorate. The notice does not describe the selection method for nominations from other organisations.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in BSF Recruitment 2026 for paramedical Sub-Inspectors?
faq.answer: There are 34 posts: 14 Sub-Inspector (Medic), 12 Sub-Inspector (Lab Technician) and 08 Sub-Inspector (Physiotherapist), all to be filled on deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for these BSF deputation posts?
faq.answer: Nominations must be received by the 60th day from the date the advertisement is published in the Employment News. Counted from the circular date of 17 September 2026, this is about 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Sub-Inspector (Medic)?
faq.answer: The candidate needs a Basic Nursing Assistant or Medic Course and an Advance Nursing Assistant or Advance Medic Course. The candidate also needs at least six years' experience as Nursing Assistant in a hundred bedded Hospital, a recognised institute or a CAPF Hospital.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Sub-Inspector (Lab Technician) and Sub-Inspector (Physiotherapist)?
faq.answer: Both posts require 12th Class from a recognised Board and a two-year diploma from a recognised institution: Medical Laboratory Technician or Technology for Lab Technician, and Physiotherapy for Physiotherapist. Each post also requires at least six years' experience in that trade.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. This limit applies to all three posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of BSF Sub-Inspector on deputation?
faq.answer: All three posts are in Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs. 35400-112400).

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply directly to BSF?
faq.answer: No. Applications received directly from candidates will not be entertained. The nomination must be forwarded by your department in the enclosed proforma, with attested APARs of the last five years.

faq.question: Q8. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Officers of the CAPFs, the Central or State Government or a UT administration can apply. They must hold an analogous post on regular basis, or have six years' regular service in Level-5 (Rs. 29200-92300), and must meet the post's qualification and medical fitness conditions.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The deputation period, including any ex-cadre deputation held immediately before, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Deputationists have no inherent right to absorption, because this is at BSF's discretion.

faq.question: Q10. Can a nominated official withdraw later?
faq.answer: No. Officials who volunteer and are sponsored will not be permitted to withdraw their names at a later stage.

content_sections.heading: About District Programme Officer, ICDS, Ballia
content_sections.text: The District Programme Officer, ICDS, Ballia runs the Integrated Child Development Services in Ballia district of Uttar Pradesh through 18 child development projects (Bal Vikas Pariyojana). This recruitment is being held under Government Order No. 1/1092245/2025/3313/58-1-2025(1917687) dated 17 September 2025, with the approval of the District Magistrate dated 3 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Ballia Anganwadi Worker Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice prints a total of 242 vacancies. These are the project-wise figures it gives, with the category break-up for each project (UR = Unreserved, OBC = Other Backward Class, SC = Scheduled Caste, ST = Scheduled Tribe). The notice also attaches centre-wise lists signed by the Child Development Project Officers of Bairia, Bansdih, Belhari, Beruarbari, City, Chilkahar, Dubhad, Garwar and Hanumanganj. These lists give each vacant Anganwadi centre, its gram panchayat or ward, its unique code and its reserved category. The complete gram sabha and ward-wise details, with reservation, are posted on the notice boards of the Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil and Block offices, and are uploaded on upanganwadibharti.in. The notice warns that the number of posts may go up or down.

content_sections.heading: Ballia Anganwadi Worker Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum is 35 years. A candidate must be 18 years old on 1 July 2026. Only the date of birth recorded in the High School marksheet and certificate is accepted. The minimum educational qualification is Intermediate or equivalent. The merit list is prepared on the basis of educational qualification up to a maximum of Postgraduate. Only women candidates are eligible. Two women from one family will not be appointed at the same Anganwadi centre. Residence and caste certificates are valid only if the Tehsil has issued them online with a digital signature and they can be verified online. The income certificate must be issued by the competent authority under Revenue Section-9 Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Raj-9 dated 30 September 2011 (as amended). It must be verifiable online and must have been issued within three years before 26 November 2026. Income, caste and residence certificates issued after 26 November 2026 will not be accepted. Check the official notification and the centre-wise lists for the category and location of each vacancy.

content_sections.heading: Ballia Anganwadi Worker Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection follows the Government Order dated 17 September 2025. Merit is based on educational qualification. For each centre, candidates are considered in this order of preference: Widowed, legally divorced or abandoned women from below-poverty-line (BPL) families who live in the same gram sabha, or in the same ward in urban areas. If there are none, BPL women from the same gram sabha or ward. If there are none, widowed, legally divorced or abandoned women from above-poverty-line (APL) families of the same gram sabha or ward. If there are none, women from APL families of the same gram sabha or ward. If no eligible candidate in any of these groups is found in the gram sabha, selection is made category-wise from the concerned Nyay Panchayat in the same order. A widow must provide a death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer or the urban local body, along with a certified copy of the family register. A divorced or abandoned woman must provide a legal order issued by a court. The BPL income limit for rural and urban areas follows Social Welfare Section-2 Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015 (as amended). The selection committee or appointing authority has the power to cancel any selection.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. By the last date of the online application, candidates must have passed Intermediate or an equivalent examination in any subject from an Intermediate Council or Board recognised by the State Government or the Central Government. The notice treats Hindi and English typing at 30 words per minute each as desirable. Please see the official notification for the full eligibility details for the post. The minimum age is 18 years as on 01 August 2026. Age is counted from the date of birth recorded in the matriculation or equivalent certificate. Candidates who claim any of these relaxations must submit a certificate from the competent authority. For persons with disabilities, the certificate must be valid on the last date of application. Only permanent residents (natives) of Bihar get the reservation benefit. Residents of other states cannot claim reservation. Reservation must be claimed in the column marked for it in the online form. The permanent address entered in the online form is the only address accepted for reservation. SC and ST candidates must hold a caste certificate and a permanent residence (domicile) certificate. BC and EBC candidates must hold a caste certificate, a permanent residence certificate and a non-creamy layer certificate. For unmarried and married women, the caste and non-creamy layer certificates must be issued from the father's permanent address. Certificates must be issued by the officer notified by the state government for the area of permanent residence. EWS candidates get 10% reservation where vacancies exist. They must submit an income and asset certificate in Annexure-1 (Format-1), issued by the competent authority. Women get 35% horizontal reservation where vacancies exist. The reservation category cannot be changed once the appointment process has started. The secretariat will fix the last date for submitting all certificates for the claims made in the online form. No claim will be accepted after that date. Candidates who have been debarred from examinations for misconduct by the UPSC, any State Public Service Commission or another selection commission cannot appear for the period of that order. The secretariat's decision on eligibility to sit the examination is final.

content_sections.heading: About ITI Geedam
content_sections.text: Government Industrial Training Institute Geedam is a government ITI run in Dantewada district of Chhattisgarh. The Guest Lecturer is engaged against the institute's sanctioned, vacant Training Officer posts, under the orders of the Directorate of Employment and Training (Training Wing), Atal Nagar, Raipur, and order no. 931 dated 06.08.2026 of the Joint Director (Training), ITIs, Regional Office Bastar Region, Jagdalpur. The institute's email printed on the letterhead is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made only in the prescribed format. The format is attached to the notice and can also be obtained from the Office of the Principal, Government Industrial Training Institute Geedam, District Dantewada (C.G.). Fill in the prescribed application format, with a self-certified photograph, and mention the institute and the post/trade applied for (Guest Lecturer / Stenographer and Secretarial Assistant (Hindi)). Fill in the educational and technical qualification table and the list of enclosed certificates in the form. Sign the affidavit attached to the form, on plain paper. Attach self-attested copies of all qualification-related certificates. Write the name of the institute and the trade on the envelope / application form. Submit it in person or send it by registered post / speed post to: Office of the Principal, Industrial Training Institute, Geedam, District Dantewada, C.G. - 494441. The application must reach by 18 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications received after the last date will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Guest Lecturer for the Stenographer and Secretarial Assistant (Hindi) trade at Government ITI Geedam. (10+2) examination passed from a recognised board, OR the old Higher Secondary examination together with the first-year examination of a graduation course passed from a recognised university. Speed of 100/80 words per minute from a recognised board / institution / Shorthand Typewriting Council. A skill test will be taken for the speed. One-year diploma/certificate in Data Entry Operator / Programming from a recognised institution, and a data-entry speed of 10,000 key depressions per hour. A skill test will be taken for the speed. Candidates who passed ATI / CTI / NVTI / RVTI / IToT from DGT higher training institutes will get preference in selection. For the full eligibility of this trade, refer to the official notification. The applicant's minimum age must not be less than 18 years as on 01/01/2026. The notice does not mention an upper age limit or any age relaxation. The applicant must be a native (domicile) of Chhattisgarh. No reservation rules apply to this engagement. As per the directions of the Director, Employment and Training, Chhattisgarh, Atal Nagar, Nava Raipur, the Guest Lecturer gets an honorarium of Rs. 140/- (one hundred forty rupees) per hour for training work, for a maximum of five hours per working day. The maximum honorarium is Rs. 15,000/- (fifteen thousand rupees) per month. The rate can change as revised by the government from time to time. Absence on working days of the month leads to a deduction from the honorarium as per rules, and the honorarium is paid only when budget is available under the head fixed by the government.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copy of the marksheet of the educational qualification Self-attested copy of the technical qualification certificate Self-attested ATI/CTI certificate (where held) Self-attested domicile (residence) certificate Self-attested copies of other qualification certificates on which the application is based Affidavit (shapath patra) on plain paper, in the format attached to the application form Self-certified photograph on the application form

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a merit list followed by a skill test and a speed test. For posts where CTI/ATI is required, a merit list is prepared giving priority to one-year CTI/ATI certificate holders, on the marks of their technical qualification (ITI/Diploma/Degree). If no CTI/ATI certificate holder is available, candidates with the prescribed technical qualification are selected on the marks of that qualification. If a candidate holds more than one prescribed technical certificate (such as National Trade Certificate, National Apprenticeship Certificate, degree or diploma), the certificate/marksheet with the highest marks is used. After the merit list is approved by the Joint Director (Training), Regional Office Jagdalpur, candidates will be called in the ratio 1:10 for a skill test and speed test. Candidates who pass these tests and get a place in merit will be selected. The selection list will be displayed on the institute notice board, the institute website portal and the district NIC portal. Selected candidates must accept the invitation given by telephone and complete the training work. The main-list candidate gets the chance to join within the period fixed from the date the list is displayed; after that, the next serial number in the list is offered the chance.

content_sections.text: In the KEA SDA FDA Recruitment 2026 , FDA stands for First Division Assistant , while SDA stands for Second Division Assistant . content_sections.text: BECIL first scrutinises the applications, then forwards a shortlist to the Client/Principal Employer, who decides the further selection process. Scrutiny and shortlisting: Applications are scrutinised and shortlisted on the eligibility criteria prescribed for the post. BECIL reserves the right to adopt suitable shortlisting criteria, including but not limited to higher qualifications, greater relevant experience or any other criteria deemed appropriate. No automatic call: Possessing the prescribed qualifications, experience and other requirements does not entitle a candidate to be called for any stage of selection. Further selection: The further process includes interview, assessment, skill test or any other evaluation method as may be decided by the Client. Intimation: Shortlisted candidates are told the date, time and venue/mode of the interview, assessment or skill test (if any) through registered email and/or telephone. Result: Candidates selected by the Client/Principal Employer are informed of their selection and subsequent formalities through email and/or telephone. BECIL is not obliged to publish interim results, stage-wise shortlists or marks. Only the final result, listing the selected candidates, is published on the official website of BECIL. Decisions of the Client/Principal Employer and BECIL on eligibility, shortlisting, selection and engagement are final and binding, and no correspondence on them is entertained.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 age limit depends on the post. The maximum age ranges from 30 years for Primary Teacher and Balvatika Teacher posts to 50 years for Principal. Other age concessions apply to eligible AEES employees, government servants and ex-servicemen according to the official notification. Where multiple concessions apply, only the highest permissible relaxation is granted under the notification's rules.

rows.upper_age_relaxation: 10 Years for Specified Teaching and Librarian Posts

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Salary 2026 - PRT, TGT, PGT Pay Scale
content_sections.text: The AEES Teacher Salary 2026 depends on the post and pay level under the applicable pay matrix. The starting basic pay ranges from Rs. 35,400 for PRT and Balvatika Teacher posts to Rs. 78,800 for Principal. The starting basic pay for AEES Primary Teachers is Rs. 35,400 per month under Pay Level 6. The pay matrix extends up to Rs. 1,12,400. Actual gross salary and take-home salary will depend on applicable allowances and deductions. AEES TGT teachers receive a pay scale of Rs. 44,900 to Rs. 1,42,400 under Pay Level 7. The starting basic pay is Rs. 44,900 per month. The AEES PGT pay scale is Rs. 47,600 to Rs. 1,51,100 under Pay Level 8. The starting basic pay is Rs. 47,600 per month, excluding applicable allowances.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The AEES Recruitment 2026 application fee consists of an application fee and a processing fee. The fee amount depends on the candidate's category. Note: Applicable GST is charged additionally by the bank. Payment must be made online through the prescribed payment gateway. Candidates applying for different permitted posts must pay the required fee separately for each post.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by an interview or skill test, as applicable to the post. Computer Based Test (CBT) Interview or Skill Test, depending on the post Document Verification Other prescribed appointment formalities For Principal and Vice-Principal posts, selection includes CBT and interview. For other notified posts, AEES applies the relevant CBT merit, skill test or interview requirements specified in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Syllabus and Exam Pattern
content_sections.text: The AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 syllabus covers general knowledge, reasoning, language ability, computer knowledge, teaching methodology and subject-related knowledge. The examination pattern differs between school leadership posts and other teaching posts. AEES Teacher Syllabus 2026 Exam Duration: 2 Hours Negative Marking: No negative marking The CBT for Principal and Vice-Principal posts comprises 150 questions for 150 marks with a duration of 2 hours and 30 minutes . There is no negative marking. The syllabus includes General English, General Hindi, Reasoning, General Knowledge, Basic Computer Literacy, Numerical Ability, Teaching and Learning, School Organization, Leadership, Management, Administration and Finance. Candidates can access the detailed post-wise AEES syllabus through the official AEES application portal .

content_sections.heading: AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit the AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026 application form online through the official recruitment portal. Applications are accepted from 2 November 2026 at 10:00 AM until 22 November 2026 at 11:50 PM. Apply Online: AEES Recruitment 2026 Online Application Portal Important: Candidates may apply for more than one permitted post by paying the respective fees separately. However, applicants can select only one subject within the PGT category and only one subject within the TGT category.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for AEES Teacher Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official AEES application portal at aees.onlineregistrationforms.com . Read AEES Recruitment Notification 01/2026 carefully. Register using your personal email ID and mobile number. Log in and select the eligible post and subject. Enter the required personal, educational and other application details. Upload the prescribed photograph, certificates and documents as instructed. Check the category-wise application fee and processing fee. Pay the required fee through the online payment gateway. Review all entered details and complete application submission. Download and print the confirmation page for future reference. Note: AEES states that an application without a generated confirmation page will be treated as incomplete. Candidates do not need to send a printed application to AEES by post.

content_sections.heading: About MNLU Mumbai
content_sections.text: Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai was set up on 27th June 2014 by the Government of Maharashtra under Act VI of 2014. It is on the 2nd Floor of the MTNL-CETTM Building, Technology Street, Hiranandani Gardens, Powai, Mumbai - 400 076. These posts are for the University's hostel.

content_sections.text: Both posts are full-time and residential.

Essential qualification: 10 + 2 Class Pass. Desirable: a Diploma or Certificate of at least 6 months in Housekeeping/ Home Science or any other relevant subject from a recognized educational institute. Essential experience: one year in a similar field or area, with a certificate as proof. Desirable: a Diploma or Certificate of at least 6 months in Housekeeping/ Home Science or any other relevant subject from a recognized educational institute. Desirable: working knowledge of computers. Reserved category candidates get up to five (05) years of relaxation in the upper age limit. To claim it, they must produce a valid caste or category certificate issued by the competent authority, and the relaxation follows the applicable government rules. In exceptional cases, the University may also relax age, qualification or experience for a candidate it finds particularly suitable. This is at its sole discretion. content_sections.text: The fee is paid online and cannot be refunded. Keep the payment receipt (UTR no.) because it goes with your printed application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview. Shortlisted candidates receive call letters. At the interview you must bring your original documents for verification, plus two sets of photocopies of all of them. The Selection Committee may relax or change the eligibility criteria or selection requirements for suitable candidates, subject to the rules and the Competent Authority's approval.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary, contractual and ad-hoc. It gives no right to a regular appointment, continuation, permanency or absorption in the University. The contract runs for one year. Any extension depends on satisfactory performance, the University's continuing needs and the prior written approval of the Competent Authority. Extensions are never automatic. Both posts are full-time residential service. The rules and regulations of the University and the Government, and the directives of the Government of Maharashtra, apply to these posts. The University may fill or not fill any post, or withdraw any post, without giving a reason.

content_sections.text: Download and fill in the application form from the University website, www.mnlumumbai.edu.in . It is available from 30 October 2026. Write "Application for the post of (name of the post)" on the envelope. Deliver it in person or send it by post to: Registrar, Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai, 2nd Floor, CETTM MTNL Building, Technology Street, Hiranandani Gardens, Powai, Mumbai- 400076 (Maharashtra). Tel. no. 022- 25703188. The University only accepts the printout of the prescribed online form. A bio-data, a CV or any other offline application will not be considered. eligibility and supporting documents.

Enter personal details, date of birth, category and other information requested in the form.

content_sections.heading: UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The notification prescribes relevant academic qualifications, an NCTE-recognized teaching qualification and a qualifying Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) for the upper-primary level. Subject combinations and recognized alternative qualifications vary by post. For the standard academic subjects, the notification generally specifies a Bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks in the relevant subject or a Postgraduate degree with at least 45% marks, along with B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognized course and the prescribed TET qualification. Certain subjects have additional or different conditions. Teacher Training and TET: Candidates must also satisfy the NCTE-recognized B.Ed. or other professional training requirement applicable to their subject and must have passed the Teacher Eligibility Test conducted for the upper-primary level (Classes 6 to 8) by the Government of Uttar Pradesh or Government of India, as specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: UPESSC TGT Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The notification specifies the Level 7 pay range but does not provide a fixed in-hand salary. Actual take-home pay will depend on the applicable allowances and deductions.

content_sections.heading: UPESSC TGT Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process is based on the merit of candidates in the 360-mark written examination , followed by the prescribed verification of educational qualifications, eligibility and supporting documents. Written examination consisting of objective-type questions. Preparation of merit based on written examination marks. Application of the prescribed tie-breaking rules, where necessary. Verification of original educational, teacher-training, TET and reservation certificates. Further selection and recommendation according to the Commission's rules. Where candidates obtain equal examination marks, the notification gives precedence to higher Graduation percentage, followed by training qualification percentage and then the older candidate, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: UP TGT Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination comprises 120 multiple-choice questions for 360 marks with a duration of two hours. The question paper will be available in Hindi and English, except for language subjects. Candidates must use a black ballpoint pen for the OMR answer sheet according to the examination instructions. The written examination includes General Knowledge and the subject selected by the candidate. UPESSC states that the detailed syllabus is available on its official website at upessc.up.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: About ICAR IARI
content_sections.text: ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI), New Delhi-110012, is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR). This recruitment is for its Division of Environmental Sciences. The posts serve the Division's project on the impact assessment and valorisation of iron ore tailing into a mineral-rich, crop-safe soil conditioner for agri-application (Code 79-241).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The recruitment process involves two stages. Stage I consists of a Written Test / OMR / CBT comprising objective-type multiple-choice questions covering General Knowledge, General Science, General Mathematics, General English, Official Language, Professional Knowledge, Reasoning, and Aptitude. The duration is 60 minutes with a 1/3rd negative marking for incorrect answers and a qualifying percentage of 40%. Candidates qualifying Stage I are called for Stage II in a 1:5 ratio, which involves an assessment of talent comprising a practical demonstration in the applied discipline (35 marks) and testimonials/prizes in the applied discipline (15 marks).

content_sections.heading: About ARIA
content_sections.text: AI Research & Innovation Arena (ARIA) is a registered Section 8 company hosted at the Indian Institute of Information Technology Raichur (IIIT Raichur). The Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence is being set up for innovation and entrepreneurship for regional development. Its stated aims include AI model development and prototyping, experimentation, training programs, incubation support, regional outreach, and partnerships with government, industry and academia.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 positions in total. It states that vacancies are tentative, and that remuneration is consolidated and indicative, as per the approved CoE-AI project budget.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice calls the criteria below the minimum eligibility. The shortlisting committee may impose additional criteria as deemed necessary. Experience is counted as on the last date of application. All degrees should be from a recognized University / Institute. Chief Executive Officer (CEO): experience in stakeholder engagement, fundraising, startup ecosystem building, technology commercialization and government liaison. Finance / Admin / Incubation Management Staff: knowledge of project accounting, utilization certificates, procurement and startup incubation processes. AI / Network Engineer: hands-on experience with deep learning, NLP, computer vision or Generative AI, and with cloud deployment. Lab Technician: knowledge of computing hardware, networking, GPU servers and lab safety. Candidates should have good communication skills and a commitment to the objectives of the Centre. Candidates working in Government organizations or autonomous institutions should either have their application forwarded through proper channel or submit a No Objection Certificate from their employer at the time of the interview, if shortlisted. content_sections.heading: ARIA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide overall leadership to the CoE-AI and execute its vision, strategy, annual plans and milestones. Manage key stakeholders, including government departments, industry, academia, startups and the public, and act as the primary liaison between the Centre and IIIT Raichur. Foster the innovation and startup ecosystem, and promote incubation and technology commercialization in the region. Raise funds, develop partnerships, and ensure financial and administrative compliance. Lead and mentor the Centre's team, and report periodically to the directors/governing body. Manage project finances, budgets, bills, procurement and utilization certificates. Handle administration, records, recruitment formalities and day-to-day office management. Support incubation activities, including onboarding, mentoring schedules and documentation of incubatees. Design, develop, test and deploy AI/ML solutions and prototypes for the Centre's programs and projects. Build and maintain data pipelines, models and applications, following sound software engineering practices (code quality, security, CI/CD). Provide technical support for training programs, workshops and projects. Guide project interns and incubatees whenever required. Document all work and function under the guidance of the Directors/CEO. Operate and maintain the Centre's laboratory, computing hardware, GPU servers and networking equipment. Operate and maintain the Centre's laboratory, computing hardware, GPU servers and networking equipment under the guidance of the AI/ network engineer. Provide technical support to staff, interns and trainees; maintain inventory and ensure lab safety.

content_sections.heading: About SAI
content_sections.text: The Sports Authority of India is an autonomous organisation under the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports (MYAS), registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, with the mandate of development and promotion of sports in the country. Its main objects are to achieve excellence in sports and to train and prepare sportspersons for international competitions, using sports infrastructure spread across the country and trained coaches. The Authority is substantially funded by the Government of India. This recruitment is issued by its Human Resources Division-II at the Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium Complex, New Delhi, and follows the guidelines in DoE O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.III A dated 09.12.2020.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for the engagement of services of retired persons, and only from Indian citizens who meet the essential educational qualification and the essential work experience given in Table-I of the notice. Applicants must be officers who worked under the Central Government, State Government or Union Territory Administrations and who: were holding the post of Junior Engineer or equivalent in their parent cadre/department; OR were holding at least 5 years of regular service in Level-5 in an engineering cadre (Rs. 25500-81100) (PB-1, Rs. 5200-20200 + GP 2800/-). Diploma in Civil Engineering from any recognized University or Institute; OR Diploma in Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute; OR Degree in Civil Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE; OR Degree in Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE. Masters' Degree in Civil Engineering from recognized University/Institute/AICTE; OR Masters' Degree in Electrical Engineering from any recognized University or Institute/AICTE. Minimum one year experience in the various aspects of maintenance and constructions of civil infrastructure, preferably sports infrastructure works; OR Minimum one year experience in the various aspects of electrical works, preferably with electrical works in sports infrastructure. The age must be not exceeding 64 years as on the opening date for receipt of applications (the online application opens on 16 November 2026). The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Junior Engineer post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: a fixed monthly amount arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement. The pension deducted is the pension fixed at retirement; if the employee has commuted part of the pension, the commuted portion is also deducted. The remuneration so fixed remains unchanged for the term of the contract. No annual increment, percentage increase or Dearness Allowance is allowed during the contract. Transport Allowance: Rs. 10,800/- per month during the contract, unchanged during the term of appointment. No TA/DA for joining the assignment or on its completion. No DA, accommodation, residential phone, personal staff, medical reimbursement, HRA, LTC or similar facilities are admissible. On official tour away from the place of posting, TA/DA is admissible under the rules for officers of equivalent level in SAI (Pay Grade Level 06). Income Tax or any other tax is deducted at source, and SAI will issue TDS/Service Tax Certificates as applicable. Leave: 1.5 days per month on a pro-rata basis in a calendar year; no remuneration for absence beyond 18 days in a year; unused leave lapses and is not carried forward. Tenure: 01 year or till the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, based on the performance review/requirement of SAI. The engagement is purely on contract and gives no right to claim regular employment in SAI or as a government employee.

content_sections.heading: SAI Junior Engineer Job Description
content_sections.text: Supervise, monitor and coordinate civil and electrical works related to construction, renovation, maintenance and upgradation of sports infrastructure and allied facilities. Prepare and scrutinize estimates, technical specifications, drawings and tender documents. Inspect works for quality control and compliance with prescribed standards. Verify measurements and bills. Coordinate with contractors, consultants and executing agencies. Monitor project progress and ensure timely completion of works. Perform any other duties related to civil and electrical engineering works assigned by the competent authority from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SAI Junior Engineer
content_sections.text: Apply only online through the link https://sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in/saijobs between 16 November 2026 and 15 December 2026. Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. Use a valid e-mail ID in the online form. It must stay active until the recruitment process is completed, and it cannot be changed once entered. Upload the self-attested documents listed below while submitting the application. Proof of date of birth: Aadhar Card/10th class mark sheet/12th class mark sheet Certificates of essential educational qualifications and experience Scanned copy of passport size colour photograph and signature Scanned copy of No Objection Certificate from the present employer, in case working in Central/State Government/Autonomous Organizations Latest Last pay drawn certificate Applications not in the prescribed format, incomplete or unsigned, or without a copy of the essential qualification certificates, experience certificates and mark-sheet of Board/University are liable to be rejected. SAI reserves the right to discard experience certificates that do not provide correct details.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be scrutinized/shortlisted on the basis of relevant experience and job description. Eligible candidates will be called for an interview at their own cost, and no TA/DA will be paid. Meeting the eligibility criteria does not mean a candidate will be called for interview. Selection will be made on the recommendations of a duly appointed Selection/Interview Committee. Candidature remains provisional at all stages and will be cancelled if, at any stage before or after the interview, a candidate is found not to meet any eligibility condition.

content_sections.heading: About the Recruiting Company
content_sections.text: Cement Corporation of India Ltd. is a Central Govt. Public Sector Undertaking engaged in manufacturing and marketing of cement. Its registered office is at Core-V, Scope Complex, 7-Lodhi Road, New Delhi-110003. The notice says it proposes to engage qualified and experienced professionals on Fixed Term contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in the prescribed form, in hard copy by post. No other mode is accepted, and applications in other formats will be rejected. The form can be downloaded in Word/PDF format from www.cciltd.in , career section. If possible, candidates may type the form and take a print for sending. Download the prescribed application form from the career section of www.cciltd.in . Complete the form in all respects and attach self attested copies of the certificates listed under Enclosures. Attach a Demand Draft of Rs. 100/- if you belong to UR/OBC/EWS. Write "Application for the post of ______" on the cover. Send it by ordinary post to: HOD (HR), Cement Corporation of India Limited, Post Box No.: 3061, Lodhi Road Post Office, New Delhi-110003. The notice says applications received after the due date will not be considered, and CCI is not responsible for any postal delay or loss/non-delivery.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Qualification: Full time 2 years MBA/PG Degree/Diploma/MSW in HR / Personnel Management/ Labour Welfare/IR. Experience: 2 years minimum post-qualification experience in HR, Industrial Relations, Welfare, Labour Laws, administrative functions in a company of repute. Age: upper age 35 years. The cut-off date for age and experience is 28.11.2026. Nationality: only Indian nationals can apply. Computer knowledge is essential for all posts. Post qualification experience is counted from the date of passing the exam, that is, issuance of the degree or the marksheet. Other things being equal, eligible candidates with additional relevant professional qualification and added experience in the cement industry etc. will be given preference. SC/ST: 5 years. OBC (Non-creamy layer): 3 years. Both apply against reserved positions only. PwD: 5 years, over and above the relaxation for SC/ST/OBC. Candidates ordinarily domiciled in Jammu & Kashmir between 01.01.1980 and 31.12.1989: 5 years. Ex-servicemen / Commissioned Officers / ECOs / SSCOs with at least 5 years of Defence service, released on completion of assignment: relaxation as per rules. For posts against UR, SC/ST/OBC candidates may also apply, strictly meeting the UR eligibility criteria. The consolidated contractual fee is ₹40,000/- for posting in Units and also for posting in Corporate Office / Regional Office / Zonal Office. For Unit posting, accommodation is to be provided as per entitlement, subject to availability of quarters. For Corporate, Regional or Zonal Office posting, ₹10,000/- shall be provided for accommodation. After successful completion of 01 year, candidates will be eligible for an annual increment of 5%. Medical: IPD facility, for self only, as per CCI rules. Leave: 20 days per year, non-encashable, but can be accumulated if CCI extends the contract. Provident Fund: as per EPF Act. T.A.: governed by TA rules of the Corporation as applicable to E-1 level employees. Maternity leave: as per Government of India Rules. The appointment is purely on Fixed Term contract and not permanent; it gives no claim to regular employment. The initial tenure is one year, extendable for another 3 years based on performance, up to a maximum of 04 years. Either side can end the contract by giving one month's notice or contractual fee in lieu of notice. All appointments are subject to medical fitness as per company rules. The notice states the post, category-wise vacancies and eligibility above; candidates should check the official notification for any further detail on eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through a Demand Draft in favour of Cement Corporation of India Limited, payable at New Delhi, enclosed with the other documents. Applications without the Demand Draft will be summarily rejected. Fee once paid is not refunded under any circumstance.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self attested copies of the following are to be enclosed: Proof of age: Matriculation certificate having date of birth. Qualification: all certificates and marksheets from 10th, 12th, Graduation and above. Caste certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates, in the prescribed format for Central Govt. EWS certificate as per DoPT guidelines. Experience certificate issued by the employer, with clear date of joining and relieving. Latest salary slip for Govt. and Public Sector Undertakings employees. Aadhaar Card and PAN Card. Certificate of CTC from the latest employer for private candidates; if it is not enclosed, only the salary slip will be considered to determine annual CTC. The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and EWS certificates must be issued not more than 01 year before the last date of submission of application. Candidates have to furnish the certificate number and date of issue for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/EWS/Ex-servicemen to avail benefits.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates shortlisted for the post will be called for interview based on the declaration made in the application form. If a large number of applications are received against one post, shortlisting is done on relevant experience, current CTC/monthly pay and higher qualification, based on documents enclosed with the application. Candidates called for interview are eligible for sleeper class train fare by the shortest route, limited to the journey between the correspondence address declared in the form and the interview venue. The distance travelled must be more than 50 kms to claim it. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified, and mere fulfilment of eligibility does not confer any right to be called.
