content_sections.heading: About Project Nilgiri Tahr
content_sections.text: Project Nilgiri Tahr is a project of the Tamilnadu Forest Department with its office at Forest campus, Coimbatore. According to the notice, the Project Nilgiri Tahr office in Coimbatore serves as the nodal office for implementing the activities of the project. The Senior Research Fellow will carry out Nilgiri Tahr project work in the entire Nilgiri Tahr habitat across Tamil Nadu state.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Sc. Degree in Wildlife biology/Wildlife science/Wildlife studies/Wildlife ecology/Zoology/Forestry/Wildlife biology and conservation/Wildlife conservation action/M.V.Sc. in Wildlife science, or M.Sc. degree in Botany/Life science/Environmental science/Ornithology with Post Graduate Diploma in Advanced Wildlife Management, or B.V.Sc. degree with a Post Graduate Diploma in Advanced Wildlife Management or a Postgraduate Diploma in Wild Animal Disease Management. Minimum one year of research experience in wildlife management, translocation of wild life, spatial data analysis, GIS experience, research in wildlife, field works, publication of research and management plan preparation. A proven record of 01 published research article in a peer-reviewed journal. Knowledge of R and other related statistical software. Good oral presentation and writing skills. Very good physical endurance and the ability to stay in forest and wildlife areas to work in the mountain environment. Fluency in the Tamil language is preferable. The maximum age limit for Senior Research Fellow is 30 years as on 20 November 2026. The upper age limit may be relaxed up to 5 years for candidates belonging to the SC/ST/BC and Women category, as per Government of Tamil Nadu norms. Candidates seeking relaxation must enclose a community certificate. The post is open to Indian nationals only. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Senior Research Fellow gets a consolidated pay of Rs.35,000/- per month. The engagement is on a contractual basis and the position is purely on a temporary basis. The length of the contract is not specified in the notice. Selected candidates are expected to join immediately, as the project has very strict timelines.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Project Nilgiri Tahr Senior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form: it is printed with the notification and can be downloaded from http://forests.tn.nic.in , https://tnprojectnilgiritahr.com/notification/ or https://www.aiwc.res.in/ . Fill in the form: post code, post, project name, notification number, category, addresses, date of birth and age as on 20.11.2026, academic record, fellowships received, employment held, publications, seminars, extracurricular activities and three referees with full postal address and phone number. Affix a recent passport size photograph and sign the form. Attach separate sheets for your biodata as a research worker (creative achievement) and for the national parks, sanctuaries and forest areas visited with a paragraph on your interest in wildlife conservation and research. Enclose the self-attested copies listed below. Send the hard copy only by post to: Project Director, Project Nilgiri Tahr, Bharathi Park Road, Coimbatore - 641 043. Make sure the application is received by 20 November 2026 (Friday) up to 5.00 PM. Self-attested copies of educational qualification documents and mark sheets of all examinations (academic documents are compulsory). Proof of research experience and of employment held so far (compulsory). Proof of date of birth. Documents on extracurricular activities. Community certificate if seeking relaxation; for SC/ST/BC/MBC, a photocopy of the caste certificate issued by the competent authority. Reprints of research publications and proof of seminars, symposiums, workshops or conferences attended (optional, "may be enclosed").

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for a personal interview. The date and time of the interview will be intimated individually by email to the shortlisted candidates, and the interview will be in either online or physical mode. The Forest Department will not provide accommodation, and no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jodhpur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur is located in Rajasthan. This recruitment is for an Extramural Research project under Principal Investigator Dr. Kuldeep Singh, Professor and Head of the Department of Pediatrics.

content_sections.heading: About the Project and the Role
content_sections.text: The HTAIn Resource Centre aims to: Build HTA capacity for individuals, institutions and governments. Provide technical assistance on HTA to state governments and MoHFW. Complete HTA studies assigned by the DHR, MoHFW. Publish systematic reviews, scientific papers, policy briefs and communication materials for stakeholders. Present HTA findings at national and international forums. Evidence synthesis: Conduct targeted and systematic reviews, develop protocols, run search strategies, appraise quality, synthesize data and perform meta-analysis. Costing and economic evaluation: Collect and analyze cost data, develop economic evaluation protocols and decision-analytic models with sensitivity analysis, validation and calibration, and collect and analyze model input data. Research and data: Contribute to other assigned HTA research, conduct basic statistical analysis, collect data and supervise data collection sites. Training and workshop: Develop training agendas and communication materials, ensure successful delivery of training, and contribute to teaching and training. Reporting and dissemination: Prepare project reports, manuscripts and policy briefs, and present at conferences, workshops and meetings. Other duties: Perform other tasks assigned by the PI/Co-PI.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Scientist C Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice describes the salary as a consolidated sum without any other benefits, based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skill set and similar factors.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Scientist C Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates need any one of the following: MBBS/BDS with 6 years' experience, or Post Graduate Diploma in medical subjects after MBBS/BDS with 5 years' experience in the relevant field. Post Graduate (MD/MS/DNB/MPH/MDS) after MBBS/BDS with 4 years' research experience in the relevant field. MPH/Master in any branch of Life Science/Master in Health Economics or a related discipline/MHA/M. Pharm with 4 years of experience in the relevant field. Capability of undertaking systematic reviews and/or developing decision analysis models. Minimum 2 years' experience in conducting HTA or health economics-related research. Candidates must have published, in peer-reviewed journals, at least one systematic review and/or meta-analysis and/or HTA study as first author, or more than two as co-author. PhD in the relevant subject (Community Medicine, Preventive and Social Medicine, Pediatrics, Medicine, Tropical Medicine, Community Health Administration, Health administration, Family Medicine, Epidemiology or Public Health), or PhD in Microbiology, Biochemistry or Biotechnology from a recognized institute(s). Knowledge of Computer Applications, IT tools, statistical tools, etc. Knowledge of computer tools like Canva/Bio-render, Rayyan/Covidence, Rob2, Robins, RevMan and EndNote/Zotero, and statistical software like SPSS, STATA, R and TreeAge. Detailed knowledge of PRISMA, CONSORT, STROBE, CHEERS and similar guidelines. 1-2 publications in peer-reviewed journals of systematic review and/or meta-analysis and/or HTA study. All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and be full-time. The required experience should be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualifications for the post. Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-by-case basis. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.text: The initial recruitment is for 6 months and may be extended further based on performance. The position is purely temporary/contractual, based on the project and co-terminus with it. There is no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS, Jodhpur, or continuation of services in any other project. Contract service does not confer any right to further assignment or regular appointment in the institute. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. No inquiries shall be entertained after the due date.

content_sections.text: Salary will be commensurate with the qualification and experience of the Consultant and will be discussed at the time of engagement. The notification does not give a post-wise salary figure.

content_sections.heading: WAPCOS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification does not describe selection stages such as a written test or interview. It states that the Management reserves the right to fix the criteria to restrict the number of candidates if otherwise found suitable. Selected candidates must bring original certificates along with CVs at the time of joining, for verification purpose only.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the notice and note the post, qualification and experience conditions for the group (Indian Projects or Overseas Projects – Africa Region) you want to apply for. Get the WAPCOS format and further details from the website www.wapcos.co.in. Applications in other formats will be rejected. Fill in the prescribed proforma and attach self-attested photocopies of documents in support of Date of birth, Qualification, Experience and Proof of category etc. Send your CV to [email protected] on or before 25.11.2026. Other conditions in the notification: The posts are purely on temporary basis for WAPCOS Project requirement. Place of posting will be finalized at the time of engagement. The number of posts is variable and will be decided as per requirement of projects of the company. Selected candidates are liable to be posted anywhere in India or abroad as per exigencies of works of the company. Original certificates along with CVs are required to be brought at the time of joining, for verification purpose only. The Company is not responsible for returning any original copy/copies of certificates/testimonials submitted with the application. Candidates working in Govt. Departments/PSU/Autonomous bodies must produce a no objection/relieving certificate at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: WAPCOS Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention an online application portal. Candidates are asked to send their CV by email to [email protected] , in the WAPCOS format, on or before 25.11.2026 (Extended).

faq.question: Q1. What is the full form of WAPCOS?
faq.answer: WAPCOS stands for Water and Power Consultancy Services, a premier Public Sector Undertaking under the aegis of the Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India, providing consultancy services globally.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 29 project-based vacancies have been announced under this notification for various technical and non-technical expert positions for domestic and international projects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 25 November 2026. Candidates are advised to send their CVs well before the deadline to avoid technical issues.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted strictly via email to the designated address ([email protected]) in the prescribed WAPCOS format along with all mandatory supporting documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the engagement of Consultants across all advertised posts is 67 years as on 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for the Transmission Expert post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Transmission Expert position must hold a B.E./B.Tech degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for WAPCOS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned or required to be paid by candidates submitting their candidature for these project-based consultant openings.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: Selected candidates may be deployed across India or abroad based on project requirements, as WAPCOS undertakes various domestic and international assignments.

faq.question: Q9. What documents need to be attached with the application email?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach the prescribed proforma application form along with self-attested photocopies of certificates supporting date of birth, qualifications, experience, and category proof.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply in any format other than the prescribed one?
faq.answer: No, applications submitted in formats other than the official WAPCOS proforma will be summarily rejected by the recruiting authority.

content_sections.heading: AAI Consultant Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: AAI will select eligible candidates through document verification and interview. According to the official notification, candidates must secure a minimum of 50 marks in the interview for selection based on merit ranking. Document Verification: Verification of educational qualifications, experience certificates and other prescribed documents. Merit-Based Selection: Selection based on interview merit ranking, subject to the prescribed minimum of 50 marks. The document verification and interview schedule will be communicated later by AAI.

content_sections.text: The initial consultant engagement will be for one year. The contract may be extended for another year at a time, subject to the applicable conditions, with a maximum cumulative engagement period of five years. The assignment is full-time, and selected consultants cannot undertake another assignment during their consultancy period. They will be engaged as independent consultants rather than regular AAI employees.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a contractual, temporary basis for 11 months. Further extension, if any, may be granted subject to satisfactory performance and the requirement of the Institute. The appointment can be terminated at any time during the contract period with one month's notice from either side. The notice states that no right or claim to employment at IITH arises from this temporary engagement. Consolidated remuneration per month is subject to statutory deductions, as applicable. Working hours are 8 hours per day, 6 days a week. The appointee is required to work on weekends and holidays as and when informed by the Head of the Department/Faculty-in-Charge/Chairperson. Contractual employees are not eligible for campus residential accommodation. The Institute may consider allotment case to case, depending on the essentiality of services, availability of accommodation and payment of the licence fee at an appropriate rate. Medical facilities are limited to outpatient treatment (OPD) during medical emergencies, at Rs. 100/- for normal OPD and Rs. 200/- for Specialists (rates subject to change). No reimbursement of medical expenses is admissible. The selected candidate must hold a valid health insurance policy for the engagement period, obtained at their own expense, and submit a copy at the time of joining.

content_sections.text: The notice lists key responsibilities and the skills required for each post, as follows. Configure and manage workload schedulers such as Slurm. Monitor cluster performance, job queues, and resource utilisation. Troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues in HPC environments. Manage storage systems (NFS, Lustre, GPFS, or similar parallel file systems). Handle user account management, permissions, and access control. Ensure system security, patching, and compliance with policies. Automate routine tasks using scripting (E.g., Bash, Python). Support users in job submission, debugging, and optimisation. Maintain documentation for system architecture and procedures. Coordinate with vendors for hardware/software support and upgrades. Skills Required: Strong experience with Linux system administration. Hands-on experience with Slurm or other job schedulers (PBS, Torque, LSF). Experience with GPU computing environments (NVIDIA CUDA, drivers, etc.). Familiarity with storage technologies (RAID, SAN, NAS, parallel file systems). Knowledge of container technologies (Docker, Singularity/Apptainer). Knowledge of networking concepts (TCP/IP, InfiniBand, etc.). Experience with cluster provisioning and configuration tools. Scripting skills in Bash, Python, or similar. Understanding of security best practices in Linux environments. Exposure to configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef). Experience with monitoring tools (Nagios, Prometheus, Grafana). Familiarity with cloud-based HPC environments. Basic knowledge of MPI, OpenMP, and scientific workloads. Job Responsibilities (non-exhaustive, subject to change): Monitor and support the campus LAN, Wi-Fi, and fiber-optic network infrastructure. Troubleshoot and resolve L2-level network connectivity issues related to switches, Wi-Fi Access Points, VLANs, PoE, and network links. Analyse network faults and identify the root cause using network monitoring systems, switch logs, interface statistics, and troubleshooting tools. Perform basic configuration and troubleshooting of managed network switches. Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, access ports, trunk ports, PoE, port security, and basic Layer-2 network parameters. Monitor the health and availability of Wi-Fi Access Points and wireless network infrastructure through the respective network management platform. Troubleshoot Wi-Fi issues such as AP connectivity, uplink failure, PoE issues, high utilisation, intermittent connectivity, and client connectivity problems. Monitor and troubleshoot fiber-optic links, including link status, optical power, fiber connectivity, and interface errors. Coordinate with L1 technicians on LAN cabling, fiber, racks, APs, and other physical infrastructure issues. content_sections.heading: About NeGD
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the National e-Governance Division (NeGD) of Digital India Corporation (DIC) under the Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India. The Internship Programme is conducted twice a year, as a Summer Internship Programme and a Winter Internship Programme. This notice covers the Winter Programme 2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: NeGD has listed 12 intern positions in five interest areas: 5 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 1 = 12. Each area contains one or more roles, described under Job Description below.

rows.roles: 1. Policy, Documentation Support & Monitoring & Reporting; 2. Strategic Planning Activities; 3. Data Analytics; 4. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
5. Content Writing, Design & Visual Content Support; 6. Campaigns research, Events & Outreach Support
7. Training Programs support, Content & Curriculum Assistance; 8. Event Management & Logistics; 9. Data Privacy & Securities; 10. Internet of Things / New & Emerging Technologies / Cloud Computing

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The qualification below applies to the non-technical internship as a whole. The notice does not name a separate qualification for each interest area. Eligible applicants are students from recognised universities in India who meet any one of these conditions: They have secured at least 60% marks in the last held degree or certificate examination and have completed education under the 10+2+3 pattern, that is, 15 years of formal education; OR They are pursuing the pre-final or final year of Engineering in the 10+2+4 pattern of education; OR They are pursuing the pre-final or final year of a Diploma/Certificate course; OR They are pursuing the pre-final or final year of an integrated degree course or dual degree of the 10+2+5 pattern of education. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each role, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A token remuneration of Rs. 15,000/- per month is paid to an intern, subject to satisfactory performance duly certified by the Mentor. It is paid after the complete tenure of the internship, on submission of a Report duly accepted by NeGD. The notice prints no HRA or other allowance. The minimum duration of the internship is two months, extendable up to one month (total three months), depending on the candidate's performance, NeGD's requirements and the time the intern is willing to spend with NeGD. Every batch of interns or individual interns has a Mentor from NeGD, preferably the HOD of the Division/Project. NeGD issues certificates on completion of the internship and submission of the Report, duly countersigned and accepted by the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: NeGD Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties below are printed in the notice for each role. They are grouped by interest area. 1. Policy, Documentation Support & Monitoring & Reporting Assist in preparing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), BRDs, policy analysis documents / GAP analysis, and help in maintaining and updating project status trackers or documentation repositories. Track KPIs, milestones, or progress of projects. Support in drafting weekly / monthly status reports. Update dashboards or monitoring tools (Excel / Google Sheets). Prepare briefs / concept notes. 2. Strategic Planning Activities Contribute to research, background material, and benchmarking to support planning for new programmes. Summarize policies, case studies, and initiatives for internal references. Conduct research on similar digital transformation programmes across sectors or geographies. Compile learnings that could inform strategy or implementation. Assist in tracking programme-level compliance with timelines, budget reporting, or deliverables, and help prepare input for periodic reports or audits. 3. Data Analytics Assist in curating and organizing datasets, helping ensure data is clean, well-labelled, and ready for analysis. KPI defining, drafting case studies, data success stories, or visual summaries of findings for broader communication. Conducting secondary research on data use in governance, such as how other countries use analytics in public service delivery, and compiling best practices for internal learning. 4. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Automated KPI tracking and dashboard updates and pattern recognition to detect performance trends. Smart document search and tagging using Natural Learning Processing (NLP) for templates, reports, and past cases. To identify unusual delays or dropouts in activities. Use AI to review internal documents for clarity, redundancy, or outdated content. 5. Content Writing, Design & Visual Content Support Draft social media posts, captions, or threads for platforms like Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook. Write blogs, articles, and newsletters related to Digital India, government digital services, or success stories. Help prepare press releases, media briefs, or content for campaigns. Use tools like Canva, PowerPoint, or Photoshop to create posters & banners. 6. Campaigns research, Events & Outreach Support Research target audiences, channels, and key messaging strategies. Help brainstorm creative ideas for future campaigns or social media strategies. Support logistics and planning for outreach events, conferences, and exhibitions. Draft event invites, agendas, anchor scripts, and speaker notes. Help with registration, feedback collection, or post-event reporting. 7. Training Programs support, Content & Curriculum Assistance Help review or proofread training materials, presentations, or case studies. Organize or maintain learning content libraries (videos, PDFs, slide decks). Assist in structuring online courses on platforms like iGOT or LMS portals. 8

content_sections.text: For general guidelines, the notice refers applicants to the Internship Policy on NeGD's website, https://negd.gov.in/ . The notice names no documents to be attached.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Interns are shortlisted based on marks in the qualifying degree. They are selected for the internship through interviews, or based on the judgement of the internal selection committee, as per NeGD's requirements. Weightage is given to the top 100 colleges per year, as per the ranking of the National Institutional Ranking Framework by the Ministry of Education. The selection of the candidate is based on the prescribed weightage formula. The notice does not print the weightage formula or the interview mode.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely temporary. The term ordinarily does not exceed an initial 3 years and may be extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. Only a consolidated honorarium is paid; allowances such as DA, HRA, MA, GPF and NPS are not admissible. The pay rules and service terms are below. Need-based visits post: a total of max. 15 visits of medical or allied health professionals in a month, with at least 4 hours per visit. Medical Professionals with MBBS/PG receive Rs. 3750/- per visit; allied health professionals receive Rs. 3000/- per visit. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. An annual increment of 5% is based on completion of one year from the date of joining and a satisfactory performance report evaluated by the department. The incumbent has no right to claim regularization or extension/renewal of engagement in any circumstances. The competent authority can terminate the engagement at any time without assigning reasons by giving 30 days notice. A consultant who wishes to resign must give 30 days advance notice or remuneration in lieu.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts total 22: 15 at NIEPMD(D) Chennai and 7 at CRC Madurai. They cover Clinical Psychologist, Occupational Therapist, ASLP, Early Interventionist, Special Educator, Physiotherapist, Nurse, Trained Caregivers, Activity Teacher, need-based visits, Social Worker and Data Entry Operator.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is within 21 days from the date of publishing the advertisement in Employment News. The notice, dated 06-11-2026, does not print a calendar date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NIEPMD consultant posts?
faq.answer: It varies by post. For example, a Nurse needs a Diploma in Nursing and a Physiotherapist needs BPT, each with a minimum of 2 years' relevant post-qualification experience. A Data Entry Operator needs a graduate degree with knowledge of computer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years for all positions except Sl. No. 11, the need-based visits post, which has no age limit. Age is reckoned as on the closing date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.590/- (including GST), payable through RTGS/NEFT/IMPS. SC/ST/PWDs/Female/Transgender candidates are exempted from payment of the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of NIEPMD consultants?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is 60000 for Clinical Psychologist / Rehabilitation Psychologist, 50000 for therapist, educator and Physiotherapist posts, 42000 for Nurse, Activity Teacher and Social Worker, 30000 for Trained Caregivers and 25000 for Data Entry Operator. The need-based visits post is paid Rs. 3750 or Rs. 3000 per visit.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NIEPMD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only, using the link on https://niepmd.nic.in/notice-category/recruitments./ Pay the fee through RTGS/NEFT/IMPS unless exempted, and attach the requisite documents. Applications without them are summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post at NIEPMD?
faq.answer: Yes. A candidate who wishes to apply for more than one discipline or post must submit a separate online application form along with proof of requisite fees for each.

faq.question: Q9. Is the NIEPMD consultant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary on contract, ordinarily for an initial period not exceeding 3 years and extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. The incumbent has no right to claim regularization.

faq.question: Q10. Are HRA and other allowances paid with the NIEPMD remuneration?
faq.answer: No. Only a consolidated honorarium is paid; DA, HRA, MA, GPF, NPS and other allowances are not admissible.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is held in Conference Room No: 401, Directorate of Health Services (MI), Laitumkhrah, Shillong.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Medical Physicist-cum-Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) and 1 Medical Physicist.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Medical Physicist post?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Medical Physics/Radiological Physics or equivalent, or M.Sc. in Physics with a Post Graduate Diploma/Degree in Radiological/Medical Physics, plus a minimum 12 months internship in a recognised well equipped Radiation Therapy department and AERB e-LORA registration.

faq.question: Q5. What extra requirement does the Medical Physicist-cum-RSO post have?
faq.answer: Along with the M.Sc. qualification, the candidate needs an approval/certificate from the Competent Authority to function as Radiation Safety Officer (RSO) in Radiotherapy.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit, and who gets a relaxation?
faq.answer: The age limit for both posts is up to 32 years. The upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for ST/SC candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is ₹1,00,000/- per month for Medical Physicist-cum-RSO and ₹70,000/- per month for Medical Physicist.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring a filled Standard Form of Application, an updated CV, one passport-size photograph, and originals with self-attested photocopies of certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, ST/SC certificate, date-of-birth proof, identity proof and RSO approval or AERB e-LORA registration where applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is the DHS Meghalaya Medical Physicist job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis and gives no right or claim for regular appointment.

faq.question: Q10. Do local candidates get preference?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice states that preference will be given to Local Candidates.

content_sections.heading: About VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital
content_sections.text: V.M.M.C & Safdarjung Hospital is a Government of India medical college and hospital in New Delhi, with its recruitment handled through the Office of the Director. Its satellite centre, the Rural Health Training Centre (RHTC), Najafgarh, has 31 of the advertised posts. This recruitment is issued by the Nodal Officer (SR), Academic Section, VMMC & SJH.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: A total of 470 Senior Resident posts are advertised: 439 at VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital (including 86 backlog reserved vacancies, i.e. SC-24, ST-17 and OBC-45) and 31 at RHTC, Najafgarh. In addition, 29 posts (including 2 posts for RHTC) are reserved horizontally for Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) (Divyangjan), including backlog vacancies, as per DOPT, Govt. of India Rules. The combined department-wise table is below. The 31 posts at the Rural Health Training Centre (RHTC), Najafgarh are already included in the table above. Their break-up is:

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Each department has its own qualification. For all MBBS-based posts, the qualification must be recognized by NMC and the candidate must be registered with the Delhi Medical Council before joining. For the two Dental Surgery posts, the MDS must be recognized by DCI and the candidate must be registered with the Delhi Dental Council before joining. For Emergency Medicine, the PG Degree/Diploma/DNB may be in any of these disciplines, or a qualification recognized equivalent thereto in the discipline/subject: Medicine Emergency Medicine Geriatric Medicine Anaesthesiology Pulmonary Medicine General Surgery Trauma Surgery Priority will be given to Emergency Medicine recognized by NMC. The crucial date for eligibility with reference to age and educational qualification is the last date of submission of application (25 November 2026). The candidate must have passed the PG examination on or before the last date of submission of application. In case of DNB, the results of both theory and practical should be declared on or before the last date of submission of application. The PG tenure completion date should be on or before 31 December 2026. The upper age limit is counted on the last date of submission of application. The notice prints no experience requirement, though candidates fill in previous Senior Resident experience, if any, in the application form. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each department.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Rs. 67,700/- in Pay Level-11 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC, plus other allowances as admissible as per Govt. of India Rules. Tenure: three years, including any service rendered earlier as Senior Resident on adhoc/regular basis in any Govt. of India/State Government hospital/institution. Extension: the appointment will initially be for one year, which could be extended up to a total of three years on an annual basis, subject to a satisfactory work and conduct report from the concerned HOD. Rotation to RHTC: all Senior Residents recruited in Anaesthesia, Medicine, Obst & Gynae, Ophthalmology, Paediatrics, Psychiatry, SIC Ortho and Surgery will be posted at RHTC, Najafgarh on a brief rotational basis (as per requirement). Their teaching experience certificate will be issued by VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital. Other service conditions: as prescribed from time to time by the Govt. of India. Joining: the tentative date of joining is 10 days from the date of issue of the final result. Selected candidates collect the offer of appointment from the Academic Section; if acceptance is not received within the stipulated time, the offer stands cancelled and the post goes to the waiting list.

Candidates with any publication, presentation of paper in CME/conference, or distinction/awards/medals during MBBS and post-graduation must bring copies at the interview; these will be considered for award of marks by the selection board. content_sections.heading: About IICA
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs is an autonomous institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. The notice says it works in the field of Corporate Affairs through five Schools and eleven Centres, and acts as a Government think tank on corporate laws, policies and governance. Its campus at IMT Manesar, Gurugram district, has residential blocks, hostel facilities, a library and an auditorium.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The same eligibility applies to the single post. The cut-off for eligibility, qualifications, experience and age is the last date for submission of applications. Minimum 15 years of field experience in civil construction, electrical infrastructure, project execution, and campus estate maintenance. Under the Cadre / Rank Equivalence Clause, the candidate must have completed at least 2-3 years of service in any one of these equivalent grades or ranks: Central/State Government (CPWD/PWD): Executive Engineer (EE) / Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) in Pay Level-10 (7th CPC) / Grade Pay Rs. 5400/- (6th CPC) or above. Defence / Military Engineering Services (MES / BRO / Armed Forces): Commissioned Officers of the rank of Captain/Major (or equivalent in Navy/Air Force/Border Roads) with backgrounds in MES/Civil/Electrical engineering cadres. PSUs / Autonomous Bodies / Universities (IITs/IIMs/NITs): Executive Engineer / Senior Estate Officer / Assistant Executive Engineer at Level-10 pay scale or equivalent E-2/E-3 executive grade in PSUs. Private Sector: Equivalent managerial position managing integrated multi-acre facility/estate infrastructure. Thorough operational command over CPWD Delhi Schedule of Rates (DSR), CPWD Works Manual, Analysis of Rates, and e-Procurement/GeM portals. Proficiency in engineering tools (AutoCAD, MS Project/Primavera) and modern facility management software. Strategic estate planning, cross-disciplinary management (Civil + Electrical), strong written/oral communication, public relations, and statutory liaison skills. The age limit is up to 63 years as on the closing date of application, relaxable in exceptional cases. The applicant must be an Indian citizen. Candidates must be of sound health, and if selected must undergo such medical examination as may be required. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official notification.

Leave is granted as per the policy of the Institute. The notice does not mention the length of the contract.

content_sections.heading: IICA Senior Consultant (Estate Management) Job Description
content_sections.text: Integrated Estate Management: Direct supervision of all civil repairs, electrical substations, HVAC/AC systems, DG sets, street lighting, sewage treatment, and water supply networks across campus. BOQ & Project Execution: Preparation of Detailed Project Reports (DPRs), BOQs, tender documentation, and 5-year capital asset maintenance schedules aligned with CPWD manuals. Regulatory Liaison: Interface with CPWD, State PWD, local municipal bodies, fire safety departments, and environmental compliance agencies. Quality Control & Billing: Verification of Measurement Books (MB), processing contract bills, material testing per BIS standards, and handling contractual arbitration/disputes.

content_sections.heading: HLL Associate Manager (Biomedical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these tasks for the post: Conduct site visits and gap assessments across Government Hospitals, Medical Colleges and Institutes; prepare equipment inventories and room-wise requirements. Draft generic technical specifications and layouts; verify estimated costs using GeM, past orders and market rates. Support tender preparation, pre-bid replies, technical evaluation and comparative statements. Track tenders and purchase orders on GeM, CPPP and state e-procurement portals; maintain tender records. Follow up with suppliers on delivery, contract timelines, LD, performance security/BGs, insurance and import documents. Coordinate pre-dispatch and joint inspections, installation, testing and commissioning; check supplies against the PO. Prepare inspection checklists, punch lists, acceptance and handover documents. Verify bills against contract terms and maintain asset, warranty, CAMC and billing records, including applicable deductions. Coordinate with institute departments, stores, purchase, accounts, biomedical teams and suppliers for requirements, training and issue resolution. Maintain complete, audit-ready project records; follow site safety and infection-control rules and report progress and delays regularly. Perform any other duties assigned by management.

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: The National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi and issues this Terms of Reference on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare. The Senior Consultant (LSCM) will work with the Central TB Division (CTD) on the procurement and supply chain of drugs, lab consumables and other programme logistics.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.A / B.Sc. / B.Com. / BBA / B.Tech. from a recognized University with MBA or Post Graduate Diploma in Supply Chain Management. 5-7 years' experience in managing supply chain of drugs & other commodities. Working knowledge of computers. Preference will be given for experience in any public health Programme at National/ State Level. The age limit for the Senior Consultant (LSCM) post is upto 65 years, and the candidate must be ready to travel extensively. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates can refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The responsibilities of the Senior Consultant (LSCM), as printed in the Terms of Reference, are: To maintain and update the international/ national/ regional data base of manufacturers/ suppliers of drugs, lab consumables and other program logistics. To prepare documents for national level procurement including invitation for national/international competitive bids, Direct Shopping or Direct Purchase on a case to case basis. To assist Central TB Division in conducting pre and post procurement quality assessment. To prepare report on national procurement. To track and review the periodic procurement reports from the states/districts and provide feedback. Monitoring and evaluation of state/district level procurements based on the state/district annual action plans. Monitor the performance of manufacturers/suppliers in preventive maintenance of equipment under warranty and initiate statutory procedures on non-compliance. Monitor the states for timely engagement/ renewal of contracts of agencies for preventive maintenance of equipment. To ensure timely action by the states/districts to prevent expiries by monitoring stocks at each stocking point in collaboration with the SC manager. To train the state program managers and state nodal officers for PSM in collaboration with the SC manager. To conduct supervisory visits to state/district stores. To facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT & Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation & its use for public health action. Any other relevant job as and when assigned by CTD.

content_sections.heading: About IHM Lucknow
content_sections.text: The Institute of Hotel Management Catering Technology and Applied Nutrition, Lucknow is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India. Its address is Sector -G, Aliganj, Lucknow-226024, Uttar Pradesh. The notice says educational qualifications, experience, age limit, pay scale and other terms of service are as prescribed by the NCHMCT, Ministry of Tourism, GoI, and the Recruitment Rules of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from eligible Indian citizens for 2 posts in total.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The full-time degree or full-time three years diploma must be in Hotel Administration / Hospitality Management / Hotel Management / Hospitality Administration / Culinary Arts / Culinary Science, with minimum 55% marks in aggregate or its equivalent grade, from any one of: NCHMCT or an NCHMCT affiliated institute An institute approved by AICTE An institute approved by the State Board of Technical Education An institute affiliated to a university duly recognized by UGC A Central/State/Deemed to be University recognized by UGC An equivalent degree/diploma of a foreign university/institution recognized by AIU Essential experience (either one): At least 10 (Ten) years of experience in teaching and hotel industry together, including minimum 3 years teaching experience as Lecturer or equivalent in an institute affiliated to NCHMCT / AICTE / State Board of Technical Education / Recognized University; OR At least 10 years total experience (teaching and industry together) including hotel industry experience of minimum 3 years in supervisory capacity in a 3 star / Heritage or above category approved hotel, with 3 years experience in teaching and training. Desirable: Ph.D. Degree; research paper publication in reputed journals. Candidates also need working knowledge of office procedures, noting and drafting, record management, establishment matters and computer applications. The detailed eligibility for each post is in the official notification on the Institute's website.

content_sections.heading: HLL Operations Manager (Mechanical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Facility Development & Project Execution: Review designs, specifications, BOQs and P&IDs; supervise mechanical installation, testing and commissioning; coordinate with EPC contractors, consultants and vendors; monitor progress, quality, cost and timelines. HVAC & Cleanroom Engineering: Review and execute HVAC for classified areas, covering HEPA filtration, air changes, pressure cascades and environmental control; coordinate testing, commissioning and qualification. Process Utilities: Supervise installation, commissioning and maintenance of chillers, cooling towers, AHUs, steam and pure steam, WFI, purified water, compressed air and gases, boilers, ETP, exhaust systems and cold storage. Equipment Integration: Coordinate mechanical and utility requirements for bioreactors, fermenters, purification systems and filling lines; ensure hygienic design and maintainability; support qualification documentation. Maintenance & Facility Operations: Develop preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance programmes; ensure utility availability; maintain equipment records and asset plans; implement AMC/CAMC; coordinate calibration and statutory compliance; support deviations, change control and CAPA. GMP, Qualification & Compliance: Ensure compliance with WHO-GMP, Schedule M, biosafety and contamination control; support DQ, IQ, OQ and PQ; coordinate with QA, QC, Validation and Production; support inspections and audits. Tendering & Contract Management: Prepare specifications, BOQs, DPRs, estimates and tender documents; evaluate bids and vendors; monitor contractor performance and handover of completed facilities.

Extension of the contract and revision in remuneration shall be subject to the prescribed norms in the contract. Official travel needs prior approval of the competent authority. content_sections.heading: MoFPI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Support the NPMU in day-to-day project management and operational activities, including data collection, synthesis and analysis, preparation of reports, presentations, executive summaries and briefing materials. Provide technical and analytical inputs in areas such as Food Technology, Agribusiness, Rural Development, Data Analysis and Project Management. Assist in inter-institutional coordination, knowledge management and monitoring of project progress to ensure timely completion of activities. Undertake review and assessment of proposals relating to the establishment and operationalisation of Incubation Centres, Common facilities in food processing, etc. Undertake special tasks related to project implementation, as and when assigned by MoFPI. Perform any other work assigned by the competent authority. Analyse existing scheme data, generate insights and evaluate trends and projections to support evidence-based implementation of the Scheme and recommend corrective measures, wherever necessary. Conceptualise performance-monitoring parameters for scheme stakeholders and develop standardised reporting formats to track physical and financial progress under the Scheme. Undertake scrutiny, evaluation and assessment of Branding and Marketing proposals under the scheme. Establish tie-ups and linkages with e-commerce platforms to facilitate the onboarding and promotion of PMFME-supported food products. Undertake special tasks related to project implementation, as and when assigned by MoFPI. Perform any other work assigned by the competent authority. The Graphic Designer & Audio-Visual Creative Specialist shall be responsible for conceptualising, designing and producing high-quality visual communication materials for the PMFME Scheme across print, outdoor, digital and audio-visual media. The incumbent will support the Ministry in developing impactful branding assets for ministerial events, exhibitions, publicity initiatives and stakeholder outreach, while ensuring consistency with Government communication standards and the PMFME brand identity.

Official marks conversion formula, if the qualification uses grades. Any additional document required by WBPSC. content_sections.heading: WBPSC IDO Reservation and Certificate Rules
content_sections.text: SC, ST, OBC and EWS reservation benefits are governed by West Bengal Government rules and are generally available to eligible candidates belonging to the respective categories in West Bengal. Yes. Candidates from other states may apply if they meet the eligibility requirements. However, SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates from other states must apply as General candidates for the applicable unreserved vacancies, subject to the notification. OBC-NCL applicants claiming West Bengal reservation must possess the prescribed certificate from the competent authority and submit a renewed or revalidated certificate before interview and appointment. EWS candidates must possess a valid Income and Asset Certificate in the prescribed format. Renewal or revalidation is required at the later stages specified by the commission. Eligible candidates with benchmark disabilities and writing limitations may receive a scribe facility under the prescribed conditions. Where applicable, candidates must submit the required medical certificate in the format specified in Appendix-I. The notification provides 20 minutes of compensatory time per hour for eligible candidates with the required disability-related writing limitation and certification. Requests for engagement of a scribe must satisfy the conditions specified during application submission.

content_sections.heading: OIL Consultant (Electrical Engineering) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Consultant works at Rajasthan Fields (RF), Jodhpur. The notice calls this list indicative and not exhaustive. Technical Support: technical guidance and expertise to the Electrical Engineering Section for managing electrical installations, managing new projects and addressing technical issues. Coordination: liaise with local administration, DISCOM and BSF for timely support to installations in remote locations. Contract Management: oversee and manage services provided through contracts, ensuring required standards and objectives are met. Issue Resolution: work with the team to resolve electrical engineering operational issues, considering constraints of manpower and resources. Handholding and Training: assist new team members in understanding the complexities of managing RF installations. Documentation: maintain accurate records, reports and documentation on installations, technical issues and support provided. Compliance: ensure compliance with company policies, safety regulations and applicable industry standards. Continuous Improvement: identify areas for improvement in processes, procedures and resource utilisation and recommend changes. Stakeholder Engagement: collaborate with project managers, maintenance teams and other departments. Reporting: prepare periodic reports on the performance and activities of the Electrical Engineering Section. Other allied jobs as assigned by the concerned reporting Officer/HoD.

basic_details.job_title: CSL Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL), a Government of India enterprise under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, is filling 2 supervisory posts at CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU), Kolkata. The posts are one Assistant Engineer (Civil) and one Assistant Engineer (Mechanical), both in grade PS1 with the pay scale ₹ 28,000-3%-1,10,000. Applicants need a three-year Diploma in Civil or Mechanical Engineering and seven years of post-qualification experience, and must be within 45 years of age as on 27 November 2026. Indian citizens can apply online only, through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career

age_limit.details: For both posts, the upper age limit shall not exceed 45 years as on 27 November 2026. This means applicants should be born on or after 28 November 1981. Age relaxation for Ex-servicemen is as per Government of India guidelines, up to 50 years. | Ex-servicemen must submit their Discharge Certificate/ Book/ Pension Payment Order from the Armed Forces. With the online application, they must also submit an undertaking (as per Annexure–III) that they have not been re-employed in Government after availing the benefits for ex-servicemen. | Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for each discipline.

qualification.details: The qualification must be from a University/Institute/Examination Board recognised by AICTE, an appropriate statutory authority, or a State or Central Government. Applicants who do not have the prescribed qualification but hold higher qualifications such as B. Tech or M. Sc. shall not be considered. Applicants with an equivalent qualification must submit an Equivalency Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. Without it, the application will not be considered. Applicants must fill in the exact percentage of marks in the online application. Where the board gives grade points and does not define a conversion, the Aggregate Grade Points may be multiplied by 10 to get the percentage.

how_to_apply: Read the User Manual and FAQ published at www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) before you start.
Complete the One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal. You can reach the portal through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026.
Submit the application against the post. Submit only one application; once submitted, it is final.
Upload certificates in proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste etc. and a recent passport size colour photograph. Applications without these will be rejected.
Pay the application fee of ₹ 400/- online, unless you are SC/ST.
After you submit, log in to My Applications and check that the status shows "In process". Incomplete, withdrawn and draft-status applications are not considered.
Keep a soft copy or printout of the application with the unique registration number, and quote this number in any correspondence with CSL.

Applications sent directly or by any other mode will not be accepted. You do not need to post the printout, certificates or fee (DD/Challan/Cheque) to Cochin Shipyard Ltd/CKSRU. On the last date, no technical support by email or phone may be available after 1600 hrs.

Applicants in regular Government service or in Government-owned organisations should apply online directly. They must upload a declaration (as per Annexure–II) that they have informed their employer in writing. Their candidature will not be considered if the employer raises an objection.

The fee is paid only online (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking etc.) through the online application facility, from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026. No other mode of payment is accepted. For applicants who must pay, the application is considered only after the fee is received. Fees are not refunded after submission or withdrawal of an application.

content_sections.heading: About CSL
content_sections.text: Cochin Shipyard Limited describes itself in the notice as a listed premier Miniratna Schedule 'A' Company of the Government of India; its letterhead calls it a Government of India enterprise and a Miniratna company under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways. Both posts in this notification are with its ship repair unit in Kolkata, CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU). That unit works on dry docks, berths, ship docking and afloat repairs.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice has 2 vacancies, both in grade PS1 and both unreserved (UR). CSL reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies, not to fill the vacancy, or to cancel the recruitment process, as per its requirement. Government of India directives on reservation apply. The posts have not been identified as suitable for PwBDs. The notice gives the reason: the work calls for frequent visits to work sites, shops, docks and ships under construction and repair. It also involves climbing vertical ladders, moving through narrow passages and manholes, and working in confined spaces and at heights.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential experience: Seven years post qualification experience in supervisory capacity or above in works relating to civil, and to construction and maintenance of Infrastructure projects including housekeeping. This experience must be in a Shipyard, an Engineering company, a Large Civil construction company, or a Government / Semi-Government Company / Establishment. Desirable: Ability to speak in Hindi/ Bengali/ English. Knowledge of civil construction and maintenance practices related to marine/industrial infrastructure. Familiarity with dry dock and berth maintenance activities. Ability to supervise manpower and contractors effectively. Understanding of engineering drawings, estimates, and specifications. Good coordination, communication, and problem-solving skills. Awareness of industrial safety procedures and quality practices. Basic computer knowledge for reporting and documentation. Experience: Seven years post qualification experience in mechanical works in a Shipyard, a Dockyard, an Engineering Company or a Government Establishment. Out of the seven years, two years should be in supervising mechanical works and workmen. Desirable: Ability to speak in Hindi/ Bengali/ English. Experience of working in an ERP/ SAP/ computerised environment. The qualification must be from a University/Institute/Examination Board recognised by AICTE, an appropriate statutory authority, or a State or Central Government. Applicants who do not have the prescribed qualification but hold higher qualifications such as B. Tech or M. Sc. shall not be considered. Applicants with an equivalent qualification must submit an Equivalency Certificate issued by the Competent Authority. Without it, the application will not be considered. Applicants must fill in the exact percentage of marks in the online application. Where the board gives grade points and does not define a conversion, the Aggregate Grade Points may be multiplied by 10 to get the percentage. Only experience gained after passing the prescribed qualification counts. Post-qualification experience is reckoned as on 27 November 2026. Completed Apprenticeship Training in the relevant discipline/trade under the Apprentices Act, 1961 counts as experience, and so does any training with remuneration. Training does not count towards the two years of supervisory experience. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts are in grade PS1 with the pay scale ₹ 28,000-3%-1,10,000. The notice gives these monthly emoluments as on date: Other benefits listed in the notice, as admissible under CSL rules: New Pension Scheme, Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity, Accident Insurance coverage, Medical Assistance Scheme, Post-Retirement Medical Assistance Scheme, Earned Leave encashment and Performance related Payment. The selected candidate will be placed at the minimum of the pay scale. Pay protection will not be considered. Posting will be at CSL Kolkata Ship Repair Unit (CKSRU) Kolkata or any other CSL units/project sites as desired by CSL. The candidate is liable to be transferred to different units of CSL depending on project requirements. The appointment carries the obligation to serve in any department of CSL, on board ships, or in any unit, work site or project in any part of India or abroad. CSL will not bear any liability for salary, leave salary, gratuity or pension contribution related to a candidate's previous employment in Government or Public Sector Undertakings.

content_sections.heading: CSL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists job requirements for the Assistant Engineer (Civil) post only. Planning, organizing and coordinating civil engineering works for ship repair infrastructure, including dry docks, berths, workshops, buildings, roads, drainage systems and other allied facilities. Execution and timely completion of civil maintenance, construction and infrastructure development works related to ship repair projects. Supervising and monitoring civil works associated with ship docking, afloat repairs, estate management, housekeeping services, staging/scaffolding activities and vessel accommodation works. Coordinating with production, planning, mechanical, electrical and safety departments, clients, vendors and contractors. Supervising contractors and workforce and ensuring optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, equipment and materials. Ensuring civil works follow approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards, work schedules and statutory requirements. Conducting routine inspections of civil structures and maintaining records of work progress, site activities, measurements and material utilization. Assisting in the preparation of estimates, work orders, technical reports and project documentation. Ensuring strict compliance with Yard Quality Management System, HSE requirements, environmental regulations and safety standards. Participating in emergency repair works, breakdown maintenance and other urgent civil engineering activities as and when required. Being a good team player, being willing to travel at short notice, and working against set targets within the stipulated time frame. Performing any other duties assigned by the competent authority in the interest of the Company.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Read the User Manual and FAQ published at www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) before you start. Complete the One-time Registration in the SAP Online portal. You can reach the portal through www.cochinshipyard.in (Career page → CKSRU, Kolkata) from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026. Submit the application against the post. Submit only one application; once submitted, it is final. Upload certificates in proof of age, educational qualification, experience, caste etc. and a recent passport size colour photograph. Applications without these will be rejected. Pay the application fee of ₹ 400/- online, unless you are SC/ST. After you submit, log in to My Applications and check that the status shows "In process". Incomplete, withdrawn and draft-status applications are not considered. Keep a soft copy or printout of the application with the unique registration number, and quote this number in any correspondence with CSL. Applications sent directly or by any other mode will not be accepted. You do not need to post the printout, certificates or fee (DD/Challan/Cheque) to Cochin Shipyard Ltd/CKSRU. On the last date, no technical support by email or phone may be available after 1600 hrs. Applicants in regular Government service or in Government-owned organisations should apply online directly. They must upload a declaration (as per Annexure–II) that they have informed their employer in writing. Their candidature will not be considered if the employer raises an objection. The fee is paid only online (Debit card/Credit card/Internet Banking etc.) through the online application facility, from 05 November 2026 to 27 November 2026. No other mode of payment is accepted. For applicants who must pay, the application is considered only after the fee is received. Fees are not refunded after submission or withdrawal of an application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection for both posts has these stages: Phase I offline test (Objective Type – 40 Marks and Descriptive Type – 40 Marks), then Certificate Verification, then Phase II PowerPoint presentation on work experience (20 Marks). The process will be conducted at CKSRU, Kolkata, or through interview via electronic media. The objective test lasts 45 minutes. It has Part A (General) and Part B (Discipline related). Each question carries one mark, and there is no negative marking. The descriptive offline test is worth 40 marks and lasts 90 minutes, with discipline related questions. CSL will evaluate the descriptive answer sheets only of candidates who reach the minimum pass mark in the objective test and meet the eligibility requirements. The minimum pass mark for all categories (except PwBD) is 50% of the total marks of each test. The syllabus for both tests is in Annexure I, which the notice says is only indicative and not exhaustive. Tests will be held in West Bengal, as decided by CKSRU, depending on the number of applications. CSL alone decides the allocation of exam centres. Depending on the number of applications, CSL may also shortlist applicants by checking the certificates they uploaded. Qualified candidates are called for certificate verification in order of merit/reservation, at a minimum ratio of 6 candidates per post. Candidates must produce all certificates in original. Only those who clear verification attend Phase II, which may go ahead even with fewer than 1:6 candidates. Phase II is a presentation of not more than ten minutes on the candidate's work experience, worth 20 marks. It will be held at CSL-Kolkata Ship Repair Unit, Kolkata. The rank list is based on the total marks of Phase I and Phase II. Ties are broken first by the discipline marks in the objective test and then by seniority in age. Candidates attending the selection at CKSRU, Kolkata get single to-and-fro third AC rail fare by the shortest route from their mailing address, on proof. To claim it, they must submit a copy of the front page of their savings bank passbook with account number and IFSC code at certificate verification. This does not apply to selection through electronic media, or to candidates found ineligible at verification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is for one year from the date of joining and stands automatically terminated unless extended before the date of expiry. The engaged person receives ₹35,000 per month for the eligible working period, excluding the duly notified summer and winter vacation periods. No remuneration or other monetary benefit is payable during the notified vacation period; the person remains on vacation without pay. Either party can end the engagement with 15 days' prior notice or by depositing 15 days' remuneration in lieu; no reasons are communicated. One casual leave per month is allowed, subject to approval by the competent authority. Applicable taxes, including TDS, are deducted as per Income Tax Rules and other rules.

content_sections.heading: HPNLU Counsellor Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice states the following duties and obligations for the Counsellor: Devote whole time to the duties assigned by the University and not engage directly or indirectly in any trade, business or occupation on own account. Maintain appropriate records of students in physical and digital form, transfer them to the University administration from time to time, and hand over the data to the Registrar at the end of the engagement. Keep strict confidentiality of all records of students and employees disclosed in sessions. The notice says confidentiality may be broken if there is risk of harm to self or others, student or elder abuse, or genuine threats, with information shared in emergencies only with prior approval of the Competent Authority.

content_sections.heading: SAMEER Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection stages depend on the category of post. SAMEER may use academic screening, written examination, online interview, in-person interview or skill test as specified below. Where a written examination is prescribed, it may be conducted online as a computer-based test or in person. Candidates generally need at least 50% marks to qualify for the subsequent stage, subject to the prescribed shortlisting requirements. The written examination syllabus follows the general curriculum of Government-run universities and colleges for the relevant engineering, science, diploma, ITI or graduate qualification. Where no written examination is conducted, academic merit may be used for the next applicable stage. Final selection is based on in-person interview marks and/or skill test/interaction marks only , as applicable to the selected category. content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 281 Posts
content_sections.text: RITES Limited has announced 281 apprenticeship vacancies across engineering, non-engineering, diploma and ITI trades. Graduate Engineering accounts for 125 posts, while Graduate Non-Engineering has 43 posts. The Other Trades category includes trades such as Welder, Fitter, Turner, Plumber and Surveyor. Candidates must select the apprenticeship opportunity matching their recognized ITI qualification. The official notification provides reservation for SC, ST, OBC Non-Creamy Layer, EWS and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. However, the category-wise figures in the notified vacancy table contain an arithmetic discrepancy. The published grand-total row lists 32 SC, 12 ST, 68 OBC, 21 EWS and 144 UR vacancies, adding up to 277, whereas the notification advertises 281 total posts. Certain discipline-level category allocations also do not add up to their stated totals. Important: Candidates should follow the officially advertised 281-post recruitment total and consult any subsequent RITES corrigendum for clarification of the reservation breakup. PwBD reservation is horizontal and is included within the notified vacancies, not additional to them.

The qualification must be recognized by the applicable UGC, AICTE, NCVT or SCVT authority. Important: The 50% qualifying threshold applies to the notified reserved positions. Candidates applying against General or EWS positions must meet the applicable 60% requirement. Where the prescribed qualification specifies marks in the Honours subject, those marks will be used for eligibility. Otherwise, the aggregate marks of all subjects will be considered. Engineering and non-engineering graduates and diploma holders must have completed their qualifying course within the five-year period prescribed in the notification. No. Degree and diploma candidates whose final semester results were declared before 5 November 2021 are ineligible under this notification. This five-year passing-date restriction does not apply to ITI candidates. No. Candidates awaiting the result of their essential qualification as on 5 November 2026 are not eligible. The following candidates are not eligible: Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training. Candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates with one year or more of training after obtaining their essential qualification. Candidates with one year or more of post-qualification job experience. content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on percentage marks obtained in the essential qualification relevant to the selected apprenticeship trade . No written examination or interview will be conducted. NATS / NAPS Registration: Applicants complete the appropriate apprenticeship portal registration. Apprenticeship Application: Candidates apply for the RITES Limited opportunity through the relevant portal. RITES Document Submission: Applicants upload the prescribed supporting documents through the separate RITES form. Eligibility Verification: RITES reviews the submitted qualifications, category details and supporting certificates. Merit List: Eligible candidates are ranked using their qualifying examination percentage. Shortlisting: Candidates are selected according to the available apprenticeship vacancies. Joining and Original Document Verification: Shortlisted applicants must present original records when reporting. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates complete their NATS or NAPS contract formalities. Merit is calculated using the percentage marks obtained in the prescribed essential qualification. Where the prescribed qualification specifies marks in the Honours subject, those marks will be used; otherwise, the aggregate of all subjects will be considered. content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RITES Apprentices Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the NATS portal if you are an Engineering Graduate, Non-Engineering Graduate or Diploma candidate. ITI candidates should visit the NAPS Apprenticeship India portal . Complete student or candidate registration if not already registered. Log in and complete the apprenticeship profile. Verify personal details, category, educational qualifications and aggregate percentage. Search the available apprenticeship opportunities using the establishment name RITES Limited . Select the relevant apprenticeship opportunity matching your qualification or trade. Submit the application through the appropriate portal. Save the NATS or NAPS application details and registration number. Visit the official RITES Apprentice Application Form . Complete the form using the information requested by RITES. Prepare all required educational qualification certificates and identity documents. Include the applicable category certificate where reservation is claimed. Include the university or institution's CGPA conversion formula where required. Combine all prescribed documents into one PDF file not exceeding 10 MB . Upload the combined PDF through the RITES application form. Indicate the preferred posting location if the form provides that option. Review the submitted information and document file carefully. Complete the form in a single submission by 25 November 2026 . Retain your apprenticeship registration and application details for future communication. Important: RITES does not accept multiple submissions of the document form. Supporting documents submitted by email or hard copy will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: About LGBRIMH
content_sections.text: LGBRIMH is an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, located at Tezpur, Assam. The post is part of the multi-centric research project "HEADS – Human-in-the-loop Evaluation of Assisted Depression Screening", funded by the Wellcome Trust, United Kingdom. The project's participating institutions are NIMHANS, Bengaluru (lead institution), IIT Kharagpur and LGBRIMH, Tezpur. Its aim is to develop and evaluate a multilingual, human-in-the-loop, AI-based system for assisting depression assessment, using recorded clinical interviews, automatic speech recognition, machine translation and clinician-led diagnostic reasoning. LGBRIMH, Tezpur, is the implementing site for this notice.

Experience in psychiatric interviewing and clinical research. Experience in administering structured and semi-structured instruments such as QuickSCID-5 and PHQ-9.
