content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated emolument is ₹1,38,659/- per month, as per the approved project budget and the MoU. It is fixed under the approved project budget. No other allowance, benefit or pay-linked component is admissible over and above it, except as expressly provided in the project sanction. Tenure: initially for 1 (one) year, extendable up to 24 months or the project duration, whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance and availability of funds. Extension beyond the first year is subject to periodic performance review, project requirements and availability of funds from the funding agency. Nature of engagement: purely contractual, temporary and project-funded, and co-terminus with the project. It gives no right or claim to regular appointment, absorption or continuation in LGBRIMH or in any other project or post of the Institute. Full-time work: appointees work exclusively and full-time for the HEADS project and are not deputed to non-project duties of the Institute. Private practice of any kind is not permitted during the tenure. CPD: as mandated by the funding agency, 10 (ten) days per year are available to each appointee for approved Continuing Professional Development activities. Termination: either party may terminate by giving one month's notice or payment of one month's consolidated emoluments in lieu. The Institute reserves the right to terminate without notice in case of unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, or closure/curtailment of the project or its funding. Accommodation: residential accommodation on the campus may be provided subject to availability and on payment of charges as per Institute rules. It cannot be claimed as a matter of right. Leave: regulated as per the rules applicable to contractual/project staff of the Institute and the conditions of the project sanction.

content_sections.heading: LGBRIMH Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Senior Residents work under the supervision of the Site Principal Investigator at LGBRIMH and are required, inter alia, to: Conduct structured psychiatric assessments and clinical interviews of study participants using standardised tools, including QuickSCID-5 and PHQ-9, in accordance with the approved study protocol. Undertake audio-recording of clinical interviews and ensure the secure storage, handling, transfer and de-identification of all participant interview data, as per the project's data management plan. Carry out diagnostic and clinical reasoning annotation of recorded interviews, and perform quality control of Assamese/Bengali transcriptions and their translations. Participate in inter-rater reliability and harmonisation exercises, multi-centric research meetings (physical/virtual), and training programmes organised by the lead and partner institutions. Contribute clinical inputs to the multidisciplinary AI development and evaluation pipeline in collaboration with the teams at NIMHANS, Bengaluru and IIT Kharagpur. Maintain study records, case report forms and documentation, and perform any other project-related duties assigned by the Principal Investigator from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The Junior Faculty receives a consolidated remuneration of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) per month. Initial engagement is for a period of up to 06 months. The engagement may be extended, if required, for further periods of up to 06 months at a time through fresh engagement, subject to institutional requirements and approval of the competent authority. Performance and compliance with assigned responsibilities are reviewed periodically by the management, and the reviews are taken into consideration while assessing any requirement for re-engagement. Two Casual Leaves per month. Unutilized Casual Leave may be carried forward within the current engagement period of six months. Casual Leave not availed during the engagement period lapses. No Earned Leave or Leave Encashment is admissible. No entitlement towards HRA, House Allocation, LTC, Medical Reimbursement, or any other benefits not specifically mentioned in the notice. Temporary hostel/house accommodation may be provided, subject to availability and at the discretion of the Institute, on payment of prescribed charges. If allotted, it must be vacated within 15 days from the date of discontinuation of engagement. FDDI attendance rules and travel entitlements for official duties apply as per the norms of the Institute. Attendance is ordinarily required for five working days per week. The engaged person may be required to attend office on weekends or holidays due to operational exigencies. Compensatory Off, wherever admissible, is governed by the prevailing rules of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: FDDI Junior Faculty Job Description
content_sections.text: Perform duties and functions of the assigned role in accordance with institutional requirements and academic objectives. Assist the Head of Academics and/or Head of School in planning, coordination, implementation, monitoring and review of academic programmes and related activities. Liaise with faculty members, students and administrative departments for smooth conduct of academic programmes, examinations, workshops, seminars and institutional events. Undertake any additional responsibilities assigned by the Head of Academics, Head of School or competent authority from time to time. Adhere to all policies, rules, regulations and guidelines of FDDI as amended and notified from time to time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Purba Medinipur NHM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 67 vacancies across 10 posts. The largest are Pharmacist (17), Community Health Assistant (Urban) (12) and Multi Rehabilitation Worker under NPHCE (12).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of registration and fee payment is 25 November 2026. Full submission of the application form must be done by midnight of 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Medical Officer-AYUSH(MHT)?
faq.answer: A BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from an institution recognized by the respective Council is required, along with completed compulsory internship and council registration. Candidates holding an MD in Homeopathy/Ayurvedic/Unani get additional marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years as on 01.01.2026 for all posts. The minimum age is 18 years for Pharmacist and 21 years for Public Health Manager, Block Data Manager, Multi Rehabilitation Worker, STLS and STS. Relaxation is as per Govt. Norms for all posts except STLS and STS.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Monthly remuneration ranges from Rs.13,000.00 (CHA (U)) to Rs.35,000.00 (Public Health Manager). Medical Officer-AYUSH(MHT) gets Rs.32,000.00 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.100/- for General categories and Rs.50/- for Reserve categories. It is paid online only and is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online in the prescribed format on the Department's website between 4 November 2026 and midnight of 26 November 2026. Afterwards, download the print copy from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/Index.aspx under "Application Print" and keep it for document verification.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by marks under each post's Scale of Scoring, mainly proportionate academic marks. Public Health Manager, Block Data Manager, STLS and STS also have a computer test. Multi Rehabilitation Worker has 5 marks for interview.

faq.question: Q9. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely contractual, with an initial period up to 31.03.2027. The contract is likely to be extended on satisfactory performance and approval of Govt.

faq.answer: No. Only female candidates may apply for CHA (U). They must be permanent residents of Purba Medinipur, proficient in Bengali, and hold an ANM or GNM course registered with WBNC.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay for each post is the revised IDA scale shown in the vacancy table. For deputation, pay is as per standard terms and conditions. Deputy General Manager posts on post-superannuation basis carry a consolidated pay of ₹ 1,00,000 per month. Engagement is for a minimum of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years based on performance, subject to the organisation's standard terms and conditions. For IDA/CDA scale employees, the percentage of HRA may vary according to the place of posting, as per Government guidelines and company policy. Other benefits are paid as per Company Policy. Selected candidates get Group medical coverage and Group personal accident insurance coverage as per GMRCL policies. Selected candidates are likely to be posted at Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Surat or any other project of GMRC anywhere in Gujarat.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for GMRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Only online applications are accepted, through the "Careers" section of http://www.gujaratmetrorail.com . The online form can be edited before submission but not after it is submitted. Register on the portal with basic details such as name, DOB, category, mobile number and email ID. Log in with the credentials; the passcode is sent to the email ID given at registration. Select the position for which you are applying. Fill in the online application with relevant details, latest to earliest, and complete the form. Check the entered details with the "preview" option. Submit the form after verifying all the information, on or before 18 November 2026. Detailed curriculum vitae. Proof of age: Matriculation/Birth Certificate. Educational qualification: SSC marksheet, HSC marksheets, graduation all year/semester marksheets and degree/diploma certificates. Experience: experience/service certificates of past employments showing date of joining, date of relieving and department, along with pay details clearly mentioning payscale/CTC. Private-sector candidates: copy of the latest CTC break-up with the other documents at the time of online application. Without the CTC break-up the application will not be considered. Form-16 is used to arrive at the current CTC. Current organisation: appointment letter, proof of date of joining, latest payslip and Form-16 of the last three years.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection comprises Personal Interviews, followed by Document Verification and Medical Examination as per the category prescribed for the post. The process judges knowledge, skills, experience, expertise, aptitude and physical fitness. Call letters with time, date and venue are issued to shortlisted applicants through registered email. The venue, date and time of interview will be informed in advance; no interview date is printed in the notice. Document verification is done before the interview. Candidates must carry original certificates, otherwise they will not be allowed to attend the interview. Photocopies are to be submitted with the resume at the interview. Preference goes to candidates with experience in the same grade or the immediate lower grade with 2 years' experience in the grade. If enough suitable candidates are not available, candidates from a lower pay scale who meet the prescribed qualifications, total experience and age criteria may be considered. A request to change the date or venue of the interview will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is located at Plot no. 2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur – 441108. These posts are in the ICMR-funded multicentre trial "SMRITI: Stratified Multicentre RCT of Intravenous vs Traditional Inhalational Anaesthesia – A Biomarker-Stratified Multicentre RCT Evaluating Propofol TIVA vs Isoflurane for Postoperative Delirium Prevention in Geriatric Surgery". The Principal Investigator is Dr Omshubham Gangadhar Asai, Associate Professor, Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care, AIIMS Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists two posts with one vacancy each, a total of 2 posts. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: Three-year General Nursing and Midwifery course from a recognized institution. Desirable: Valid registration with the applicable State Nursing Council. Experience in perioperative nursing, critical care, geriatric nursing or clinical research. Familiarity with delirium assessment, cognitive screening, patient follow-up and clinical documentation. Good communication skills in Hindi, Marathi and English. Working knowledge of computers, spreadsheets and electronic data entry. Good Clinical Practice training or willingness to complete protocol-specific training before undertaking study duties. Essential: Three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject or field with three years of relevant post-qualification experience, OR a postgraduate degree in a relevant subject or field. For Engineering, Information Technology or Computer Science, a four-year graduate degree is eligible where relevant to the assigned project functions. All qualifications must be from a recognized university or institution. Relevant subjects: Medical Laboratory Technology, Medical Laboratory Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Life Sciences or Biomedical Sciences. Engineering / IT / Computer Science qualifications must be relevant to laboratory data systems or sample tracking. Desirable qualifications and skills: Hands-on experience in blood sample processing, serum or plasma separation, aliquoting, ELISA, pipetting, cold-chain management and sample inventory. Familiarity with laboratory quality control, biosafety, laboratory records and computer-based data entry. The notice states that desirable criteria are preferences and do not replace or add mandatory experience to an otherwise eligible qualification route. The notice gives the age limit as 30 years for each post. It does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Age relaxation, where applicable, will be as per prevailing ICMR and institute rules. Qualifications and relevant subject equivalence shall be governed by the applicable ICMR guidelines. Candidates with higher qualifications must also meet the prescribed essential eligibility criteria. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Both posts pay ₹24000 per month (₹20000 + 20% HRA). The stated remuneration includes HRA at the budgeted rate; other allowances, if any, will be governed by the sanction and applicable rules. This is a fixed-duration, purely temporary post under an ICMR-funded project. It is not a regular post of ICMR or AIIMS Nagpur and confers no claim to permanent employment. The initial tenure is nine months in Year 1. Renewal is subject to project requirements, fund availability, performance assessment and institutional approval. The engagement will end automatically upon expiry of its approved term unless renewed. Leave, notice, termination and other service conditions will follow the applicable ICMR guidelines and institute orders.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Screen potential participants and support recruitment, participant information and consent procedures under investigator supervision and documented delegation. Conduct protocol-specified postoperative delirium assessments using CAM or CAM ICU and delirium severity assessments using CAM S, after completing training and competency assessment. Perform scheduled cognitive, recovery and pain assessments, and coordinate participant follow-up. Maintain blinding to treatment allocation and follow the study procedures restricting access to intraoperative allocation information. Maintain accurate case report forms, assessment records, follow-up trackers and source documentation. Coordinate protocol-specified sample collection with the clinical and laboratory teams. Promptly report clinical concerns, adverse events and protocol deviations to the investigator. Undertake related project duties assigned by the Principal Investigator. Clinical diagnosis and treatment decisions remain the responsibility of the treating investigators. Process and aliquot study samples according to SOPs. Maintain sample identification, inventory, temperature and cold-chain records. Assist with ELISA assays and laboratory quality control under supervision. Prepare reagents and maintain equipment logs. Coordinate sample receipt and shipment. Enter laboratory data and assist with consumable stock records. Blood collection, if assigned, requires appropriate training and institutional authorization. The terms and conditions add that the appointee will carry out duties assigned by the PI, including multicentre coordination, trial documentation, data quality oversight and biomarker workflow support.

content_sections.text: Applications will be screened for eligibility, and shortlisted candidates will be notified through the AIIMS Nagpur website and/or email. Selection will be through a personal interview at AIIMS Nagpur. If more than 15 applications are received for a post, a written test may be conducted to shortlist candidates for interview. Date of interview: 21 November 2026 Reporting time: 8.00 AM Venue: Department of Anaesthesiology, 1st Floor IPD OT Complex, AIIMS Nagpur Candidates must produce original documents for verification. content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All three posts need the same qualification: MBBS with PG degree/ Diploma from any MCI recognized institution in related speciality . All posts carry the same pay rule: fixed remuneration as per Table A plus the top-up amount quoted by the candidate, with an upper ceiling of up to ₹4.00 lakh per month. The facilities, number of posts and specialities are subject to change as per requirement on the day of interview. The district-wise list of facilities is also uploaded on www.nhm.uk.gov.in . On selection, the candidate has to apply for registration with Uttarakhand Medical Council. Candidates should check the official notification for the speciality-specific eligibility of each post. The maximum age limit is 65 years for all posts. Relaxation in age up to 70 years may be given on a case to case basis, as per the decision of the selection committee and the approval of the Executive Committee. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. Specialists engaged under the YQWP model are paid on a consolidated basis, with an upper ceiling of up to ₹4.00 lakh per month, based on the quotation the candidate submits for a specific health facility. The pay has two parts: Fixed Remuneration: same as the existing NHM-approved structure for Specialists in Table A below. Top-up Amount: the additional amount over and above the fixed remuneration, quoted by the candidate in the Financial Proposal enclosed with the Proposal Format. If a YQWP Specialist Doctor takes long leave such as Paternity, Maternity or Child Care leave (other than Casual Leave and Privileged Leave), only the base fixed remuneration is paid and no top-up amount is paid, because the top-up is for providing services at a particular place.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The proposal is handed in on the day of interview in a closed and sealed envelope, in the prescribed format (uploaded on the website and enclosed in the notice), with all required documents and declarations. The notice names these: Proposal Format, filled in: post applied for, name, date of birth, mobile number, email, PG degree/diploma and specialization, permanent address, registration number and council, skills/training, total MBBS marks, working experience and two references (mandatory) Financial Proposal: post applied for, and the monthly top-up amount (INR, in figures and words) for up to three preferred facilities or places, signed with the declaration Detailed CV/ Resume Education documents (degree/ diploma) and mark sheets Document for registration Certificate for working experience Self-declaration for Medical Fitness Self-declaration in the enclosed prescribed format for being in clinical practice/ performing surgeries Affidavit on a non-judicial stamp paper of Rs 10/- for no litigation/ legal case pending in the court of law and of not being employed in Regular Cadre Service/ Bonded category service (format given in the notice) No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the concerned department/ competent authority, only if the candidate is employed in Regular Cadre Service/ Bonded Category Service

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates must be present physically at the venue by 09:30 AM. The interview is at 10:30 AM and registration for the interview closes at 11:30 AM. A candidate employed in Regular Cadre Service/ Bonded Category Service who does not submit the NOC will not be allowed to appear for the interview. Proposals are accepted only if they meet the prescribed eligibility criteria and are clear. The notice describes the selection as follows: Facility-wise and speciality-wise shortlisting as per selection criteria, including but not limited to qualifications, working experience and near past work done. The selection committee's decision is final. The lowest financial proposal/ quote from an eligible candidate is offered the quoted facility. When quoted amounts are similar, NHM Uttarakhand decides allocation in this descending order: a) Degree (preference over Diploma), b) Number of years of Experience, c) Experience of near past. If the lowest quoter cannot join the allotted facility, the facility goes to the next proposer (higher than lowest), and this continues until the position is filled or the proposals run out. A meritorious candidate even with a higher financial quote may also be selected by the committee, as quality of services is the prime concern. NHM-UK reserves the right to reject any lowest quoted proposal without assigning a reason, and selection cannot be treated as a matter of right.

faq.answer: Pay is a fixed remuneration from Table A (₹1,20,000 to ₹2,70,000 per month, by qualification, experience and region) plus a quoted top-up, with an upper ceiling of up to ₹4.00 lakh per month.

faq.answer: Bring the filled Proposal Format and Financial Proposal in a sealed envelope with CV, degree/diploma, mark sheets, registration document, experience certificate, medical fitness and clinical practice self-declarations, the Rs 10 stamp paper affidavit and, if employed in regular or bonded service, an NOC.

faq.question: Q8. How is the selection made?
faq.answer: After facility-wise and speciality-wise shortlisting, the lowest quote from an eligible candidate is offered the quoted facility, though a meritorious candidate with a higher quote may also be selected.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the posts are contractual with an 11-month agreement that may be extended by mutual consent, and no claim for regular appointment is admissible.

faq.question: Q10. Can a doctor in government regular service attend?
faq.answer: A candidate employed in Regular Cadre Service/ Bonded Category Service must submit an NOC from the concerned department; without it, the candidate will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IMU Mumbai Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for IMU Mumbai Recruitment 2026 are accepted only by email. The CV must be sent by 18:00 hrs on 30 November 2026 . Prepare a detailed CV containing complete details of your educational qualifications, work experience, special achievements, present address and expected salary. Fill in and sign the bio-data in the IMU-MPC format attached to the notice for your post. Attach all relevant documents to the email. Write the post applied for in the subject of the email. Send the email to [email protected] before 18:00 hrs on 30 November 2026. The bio-data formats attached to the notice, each in Hindi and English, are: Annexure 1: Faculty (Nautical Science) on Contract Annexure 2: Faculty (Marine Engineering) on Contract Annexure 3: Paramedic on Contract Basis Annexure 4: Workshop Instructor (Marine Engineering) on Contract Basis Annexure 5: Workshop Instructor (Electrical Engineering) on Contract Basis Annexure 6: Lab Assistant on Contract Basis The mode of selection is a physical interview. The date of the interview will be intimated to candidates by e-mail.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Detailed CV with educational qualifications, work experience, special achievements, present address and expected salary. All relevant documents. Signed bio-data in the IMU-MPC format for the post applied for. Faculty posts: the form includes a checklist of essential and desirable qualifications, details of sailing experience at management level, teaching / training experience in Maritime Training Institute(s) in India, and a sailing and shore experience sheet (CDC period, rank and days) in chronological order. Paramedic, Workshop Instructor and Lab Assistant posts: the form asks for Aadhar No. and PAN Card No., essential qualification details, experience with total duration, and academic qualifications from Class X onwards.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be admissible for the interview. Each application form carries a signed declaration: if a candidate is found to have concealed or suppressed any information or given false details, the candidature shall be liable to be summarily terminated without notice or compensation. The application forms ask candidates to state the notice period required to join (days / months). The Faculty forms ask whether the candidate meets each essential and desirable requirement (YES/NO) with remarks; the other forms ask whether the candidate meets the qualification, experience and age criteria for the post.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: All 31 Senior Technical Assistant posts are listed under VC No. CL/12/26 for posting in Andhra Pradesh, Telangana, Karnataka, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Puducherry & Lakshadweep. Selected candidates are also liable for posting anywhere in India as per Company requirements. The notice states that the number of vacancies may vary. Of these, 02 posts are reserved for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis: 01 for Cat-b and 01 for Cat-c. No posts are reserved for Cat-a or Cat-d & e.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: General/EWS candidates, and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts, need a minimum of 50% marks in the minimum educational qualification. Reserved category candidates (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD, as applicable) need at least 45% marks for consideration against reserved posts. The same applies to candidates with higher qualifications in the same discipline. Candidates with higher qualifications (Degree / PG Degree) in the same discipline are also eligible to apply. The diploma or degree must come from an institution recognised by BTE/AICTE respectively, a university incorporated by a Central or State Act, an institution established by an Act of Parliament, or a university deemed under Section 3 of the University Grants Commission Act, 1956. Sections A & B of the Institution of Engineers (India) examination are also accepted. If a mark sheet does not show the percentage, the candidate must provide the university's conversion formula. If the university has none, an undertaking signed by its authorised representative is required, and a minimum of 5 on a 10-point scale is treated as 50%. Training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship or PhD research experience is not counted as experience. The date of acquiring the qualification is the earliest of the following: the last day of the month of the final examination, the date of the result, the date of the final mark sheet, or the date of the degree. No relaxation is given on this point. The maximum age is 40 years as on the last date of application, i.e. 22.11.2026. Age, experience and all other eligibility criteria are reckoned as on that date. The PwBD relaxation applies whether or not the post is reserved, provided the post is identified as suitable for PwBDs. Only candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability get PWD benefits. The post is identified for locomotor disability (OA, OL) and hearing impairment (HI). Physical requirements include sitting, standing, bending, walking, seeing, manipulation by fingers, communication, and reading and writing. Persons with these disabilities may apply even where no vacancy is reserved for them; they are then considered by the general standard of merit. The relaxations are given subject to the required certificates. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.text: The RITES Senior Technical Assistant selection consists of a written test followed by document scrutiny. Appointment also depends on medical fitness. The tentative test centres are Chennai, Bangalore, Thiruvananthapuram and Secunderabad. RITES may allot a centre that the candidate did not choose. The exact date, time and venue will be communicated separately. Based on the written test result and the number of vacancies, RITES scrutinises the uploaded documents. A merit list is prepared only for candidates who meet the minimum marks and are shortlisted in the document scrutiny. Offers are then issued provisionally. Original documents are verified at joining, and the offer is cancelled if they cannot be verified. Depending on requirement, the written test, document verification or interview may be held at RITES' Regional Offices. Selected candidates must be found medically fit as per RITES Rules.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the competitive examination conducted by KEA , the compulsory Kannada language examination wherever applicable, and verification of eligibility and documents. Online Application: Candidates submit their applications through the KEA recruitment portal. Competitive Examination: KEA will conduct the prescribed objective examination for the notified technical posts. Compulsory Kannada Language Examination: Candidates who are not exempt under the notified rules must qualify in the Kannada language examination. Document Verification: KEA or the concerned department will verify educational qualifications, age, reservation and other eligibility certificates. Final Selection: Selection will be subject to examination performance, applicable reservation rules and verification of eligibility.

content_sections.heading: KEA Junior Engineer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The competitive examination will consist of two papers, each carrying 100 marks . The examination will be conducted in offline OMR format. Paper 1 covers subjects including current affairs, everyday science, geography, Indian Constitution, Indian history, Karnataka history, Karnataka administration, rural development, Panchayat Raj institutions and other general knowledge topics. Paper 2 will assess technical knowledge relevant to the prescribed educational qualifications and the selected post. Candidates should follow the detailed syllabus and further examination instructions issued by KEA. The notification prescribes a deduction of 0.25 marks for each incorrect answer in the competitive examination.

content_sections.heading: KEA Compulsory Kannada Language Test 2027
content_sections.text: The notification schedules the compulsory Kannada language examination for 8 January 2027, from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM . Eligible candidates who have already qualified in a recognized compulsory Kannada examination or meet the prescribed Kannada-medium educational criteria may be exempt, subject to the notification's conditions. The Kannada language test is qualifying and its marks are not added to competitive examination merit.

faq.question: Q1. Which post has the most vacancies?
faq.answer: Assistant Town Planner has the most, with 105 of the 187 posts. Among Junior Engineer (Civil) posts, the Greater Bengaluru Authority has the largest share with 46.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply if I am waiting for my final diploma result?
faq.answer: No. You must hold the prescribed qualification and certificate on 26 November 2026, and candidates awaiting results are not eligible.

faq.question: Q3. Can I pay the fee after the application closes?
faq.answer: Yes, by one day. Applications close on 26 November 2026, while the fee can be paid online until 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need AUTOCAD training for the Junior Engineer post?
faq.answer: It is not mandatory, but the Greater Bengaluru Authority gives preference to candidates trained in AUTOCAD. The notice prints no such preference for the other organisations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualifying mark in the competitive examination?
faq.answer: Candidates need at least 35% marks to qualify, and merit is prepared from those who reach it. In the Kannada Language Test, the qualifying score is 50 out of 150 unless the candidate is exempt.

faq.question: Q6. Will I lose marks for leaving a question blank?
faq.answer: Yes, if you do not shade the 5th option on the OMR sheet. An unshaded question costs 0.25 mark, the same as a wrong answer.

faq.question: Q7. Can I correct a mistake after submitting the application?
faq.answer: No, nothing can be edited once the application is submitted. The one exception is a wrongly claimed reservation, which can be deleted from the Candidate Verification Slip before mock allotment begins.

faq.question: Q8. Can I be selected under both KEA notifications?
faq.answer: No. A candidate can get only one post across this notice and notification No. ED/KEA/40/Ne.Vi/2026 (KK), decided by the options entered, eligibility, reservation and merit.

faq.question: Q9. Which ID should I carry to the examination?
faq.answer: Carry one original ID from the accepted list, such as a PAN card, Aadhaar card, passport or voter ID, along with your admit card.

faq.question: Q10. Does the National Pension System apply to every post?
faq.answer: No. It does not apply to the 12 Junior Engineer (Civil) posts at Karnataka Rural Infrastructure Development Limited, but it applies to the other organisations listed.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the recommendations of an Experts Committee constituted by the institute. Shortlisted applicants may be invited for a personal interaction or presentation at a specified place and date, if required. Original or provisional certificates showing that you meet the eligibility criteria must be produced during the personal interaction and at the time of joining. Selected candidates will receive engagement letters and must report for duty within the time stated in the offer, failing which the offer shall be treated as cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Tenure: The engagement is initially for 01 (one) year. It may be extended year to year as per requirement, satisfactory performance and administrative exigencies. Nature of engagement: It is purely temporary and contractual, and it shall not be considered a case of re-employment. The notice says it does not constitute a job and gives no assurance or claim for future employment, regularization or appointment to any post in the institute. Other work: Officers shall not take up any other assignment, consultancy or employment, paid or unpaid, without prior written approval of the competent authority. Working hours: Normal hours are 09:00 AM to 05.30 PM, and officers may be required to sit beyond these hours to complete time-bound works. Attendance is through the Biometric Attendance System. Leave: Leave is admissible at 08 days in a calendar year on a pro-rata basis, subject to prior approval of the Controlling Officer. Unused leave cannot be carried forward or encashed. Performance: The institute will define the scope of work, deliverables and performance indicators at the time of engagement. The Controlling Officer will review performance every quarter, and continuation depends on satisfactory performance and the institute's functional requirement. Termination: The institute may terminate the engagement at any time without assigning any reason. Secrecy: Data, information and deliverables, including Intellectual Property, remain the exclusive property of the institute. Any violation invites action under the Official Secrets Act, 1923, and relevant service rules under the DoPT guidelines. Disputes: Unresolved disputes go to the Director, IIIT Bhagalpur, whose decision is final and binding. Legal proceedings fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of the Courts at Bhagalpur/Patna only. The Competent Authority may modify, cancel or withdraw the engagement process, wholly or partly, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About NPCC
content_sections.text: National Projects Construction Corporation Limited is a Government of India enterprise and a Mini Ratna Category-I, Premier Schedule 'B' CPSU. It is a subsidiary of WAPCOS Limited and works in engineering, construction, planning, operation and project management consultancy. Its corporate office is at Plot No.148, Sector-44, Gurugram, and it has offices across India.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Posts
content_sections.text: General Manager (HR): Administration Department and Human Resource functions at the corporate office, including planning, organizing, staffing, development, coordination and periodical review of policies, systems and procedures. The post also handles Bi-partite/Tri-partite Settlements, adjudication, labour law cases and service matters. Manager (Finance): Institutional Finance, Budgetary Planning and Control, Central Treasury Management, Resources Generation, control of Accounts, Investment Planning, Auditing, Financial Analysis and Reporting, Taxation, Finance and Costing of Projects and MIS. The post also covers Income Tax and coordination with statutory/Govt. Auditors. Dy. Manager (Fin.): the same finance areas, from Institutional Finance through to Costing of Projects and MIS. Manager (HR): support, direction and advice to other division managers on HR procedure, policy, hiring, recruitment, training, compensation and promotion, plus IR matters, welfare, labour laws and related legal issues. Manager (IT): management and upkeep of information and communication systems, including software, hardware, networks and allied equipment. Manager (Raj Bhasha): compliance with the Official Languages Act and rules, including English-Hindi translation, preferably of technical and contractual documents. Dy. Manager (Law): managing all litigation filed by or against the company, managing related documents, drafting agreements and advising on compliance and regulatory issues.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through the payment gateway only; no other mode is accepted.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: NPCC will decide the selection procedure depending on the response received. Selection can be by Personal Interview or by any other appropriate way, and NPCC's decision is final. The Offer of Appointment follows the final selection, which is based on performance in the interview or the other method used. Meeting the criteria and applying does not give a right to be called for interview.

faq.question: Q1. Can private-sector employees apply for NPCC posts?
faq.answer: Yes, if they have drawn the CTC listed for the post for at least two years, such as Rs. 8.97 Lakh per annum for Dy. Manager, and meet the other criteria.

faq.question: Q2. Do I need to post a hard copy of the application?
faq.answer: No. Clause 23 of the general conditions says not to send any original documents, certificates or a hard copy of the application at this stage.

faq.question: Q3. Is the application fee refundable?
faq.answer: No. The fee will not be refunded under any circumstances, and it will not be held in reserve for a future selection.

faq.question: Q4. Are part-time or distance degrees accepted?
faq.answer: Yes. Qualifications may be full-time, part-time, regular or distance, from an institution recognised by UGC/AICTE or an Indian or foreign institution granted equivalence or recognition by AIU.

faq.question: Q5. From when is experience counted?
faq.answer: Experience counts from the date of declaration of the result or the date of issue of the final mark sheet, provisional certificate or degree, whichever is earliest, up to the cut-off date.

faq.question: Q6. I work in a PSU. Do I need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: You should apply through proper channel or furnish a No Objection Certificate at the interview. If that is difficult, you must produce a relieving order at joining, but you will not get service transfer benefits or pay protection.

faq.question: Q7. Does NPCC pay travel fare for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are paid to and fro rail fare from the nearest railway station of their declared residence, by the shortest route beyond 30 km, on producing the rail ticket. The entitlement is 2nd AC Sleeper for E-6 level and 3rd AC Sleeper for E-2 and E-1 levels.

faq.question: Q8. Where will corrections to this advertisement be published?
faq.answer: Any corrigendum, addendum or errata will appear only on www.npcc.gov.in, and no further press advertisement will be given.

faq.question: Q9. What can lead to rejection of a candidature?
faq.answer: Candidature can be rejected at any stage, even after recruitment, for false or fabricated information, suppressed facts or failure to meet the eligibility criteria. Canvassing, direct or indirect, also disqualifies a candidate.

faq.question: Q10. Which courts handle disputes about this recruitment?
faq.answer: Legal proceedings arising from the advertisement or applications are subject to the jurisdiction of the Courts at Delhi.

content_sections.text: CSIR-AMPRI has announced 14 vacancies across five post categories. The post-wise vacancies, reservation details, pay levels and upper age limits are provided below. content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for CSIR-AMPRI Recruitment 2026 must satisfy the nationality, educational qualification, experience and age requirements prescribed for their respective posts. Applicants must be citizens of India. Note: Candidates applying for Security Officer, Security Assistant and Technician posts should carefully check the detailed experience, trade and equivalent qualification requirements in the official notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive pay according to the applicable 7th CPC pay matrix level, along with admissible allowances under CSIR rules. Applicable benefits may include Dearness Allowance (DA), House Rent Allowance (HRA), Transport Allowance (TA) and other facilities according to CSIR rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Applicable application fees must be paid online through SBI Collect or the prescribed payment gateway. The fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying for more than one post code must follow the separate application and fee requirements.

content_sections.heading: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure depends on the post applied for and may include screening, trade tests, physical tests, skill assessments and competitive written examinations. Technical Officer: Screening, qualifying Trade Test and Competitive Written Examination comprising Paper I (Mental Ability), Paper II (General Awareness and English Language) and Paper III (Concerned Subject). Final merit is based on the prescribed written examination papers. Security Officer: Screening, physical standards and physical tests, followed by written examination covering mental ability, personality assessment and security-related subjects. Security Assistant: Screening, qualifying skill / physical and personality assessment tests, followed by a competitive written examination. Technician (1): Qualifying Trade Test followed by a competitive written examination covering mental ability, general awareness, English language and the relevant trade subject. Multi-Tasking Staff: Competitive written examination consisting of General Intelligence (25 questions, 75 marks), Quantitative Aptitude (25 questions, 75 marks), General Awareness (50 questions, 150 marks) and English Language (50 questions, 150 marks). The examination comprises 150 questions carrying 450 marks , with one negative mark for each incorrect answer.

content_sections.heading: About Zila Panchayat Korea
content_sections.text: Zila Panchayat Korea is the district panchayat office at Baikunthpur in Korea district, Chhattisgarh. Its District Mission Management Unit runs "Bihan", the State Rural Livelihood Mission, and is filling this post for the district/block offices of the mission in Manendragarh-Chirmiri-Bharatpur (MCB) district. The recruitment is approved by the Collector.

Zila Panchayat Korea Accountant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Minimum 21 years and maximum 35 years, counted as on 1 January 2026. Age relaxation applies as per the instructions of the General Administration Department issued from time to time for Chhattisgarh residents and various categories. Graduation in Commerce from a recognised university. One-year diploma in computer from a recognised institution/university. 2 years of relevant accounts work experience after graduation in Central/State Government, a local body or a Government-aided institution listed on the NITI Aayog website. Experience certificates are accepted only from government, semi-government or government-funded/aided non-government institutions. For experience in a non-government institution, certified pay-slips or bank statements for 3 continuous months must be attached. Candidates holding a Tally certificate will be given priority. The applicant must be a native of Chhattisgarh; a self-attested copy of the residence certificate is required. Only permanent caste and residence certificates issued by the competent authority are accepted. Anyone removed earlier from a post by Chhattisgarh Ajeevika Samvardhan Samiti or any government department for indiscipline, misconduct or irregularity is not eligible. A candidate who married before the minimum legal age, or who married a person with a living spouse (unless the government exempts), is not eligible. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on a merit of 100 marks. If many applications arrive, 10 applicants for the post are called for the interview/skill test in order of merit. The applicant with the highest combined marks is appointed. Marksheets showing only a grade get the average percentage of that grade (an A grade of 80 to 90 per cent counts as 85 per cent). On equal marks, the older candidate is selected first. The next 5 candidates are kept on a waiting list for one year to fill any future vacancy. The selection committee's decision on accepting experience documents is final.

It may be continued for another year on the basis of work ability, efficiency, Annual Performance Appraisal and conduct, with the consent of both sides. All conditions of General Administration Department memo No. F 9-1/2012/1-3 dated 31 December 2012 on contract appointments apply. Leave is under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules 2012; conduct under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules 1965. Either side can end the contract with one month's notice or one month's pay. No pension, gratuity or death benefit is given for contract service.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply for both AM-Mechanical-II and AM-Mechanical-III?
faq.answer: You can apply for any number of vacancies separately. However, the written test for CL/10/26 and CL/11/26 is held on the same date and at the same time, so check your eligibility and apply accordingly.

faq.question: Q2. Is there negative marking in the RITES written test?
faq.answer: No. No marks are deducted for an incorrect answer.

faq.question: Q3. How many candidates are called for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are called in the ratio of 1:6 to the number of vacancies.

faq.question: Q4. Does training or internship count as experience?
faq.answer: No. Training (except on the job training), internship, teaching, academic, fellowship and PhD research experience are not counted.

faq.question: Q5. Is an offer letter accepted as proof of experience?
faq.answer: No. You must submit a joining and relieving order or an experience certificate to claim that experience.

faq.question: Q6. Will SC, ST and PwD candidates get the fee back?
faq.answer: Their fee is refunded after they take part in the further selection process of written exam or interview, as applicable, and their category certificate is scrutinised. The refund goes to the source account or card used for payment, after deducting GST and bank charges as applicable.

faq.question: Q7. What if my mark sheet shows only CGPA?
faq.answer: You must provide the conversion formula used by your university or institution. If it has no formula, submit an undertaking to that effect signed by its authorised representative. A minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale will then be considered as 60%.

faq.question: Q8. Does RITES pay travel allowance for the test or interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no fares, TA or DA shall be payable.

faq.question: Q9. Does being placed on the panel guarantee a job?
faq.answer: No. Empanelment against a vacancy does not guarantee selection or a right to the job, and deployment depends entirely on project or company requirements.

content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a single-stage competitive MCQ examination conducted through CBRT or OMR mode, followed by document verification and preparation of the selection and waiting lists. Changes to the advertisement are posted only on the institute website. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification, and false information leads to cancellation at any stage.

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Nagpur
content_sections.text: IIIT Nagpur is one of the 20 Indian Institutes of Information Technology set up under the Ministry of Education's Public-Private Partnership Scheme. Under the IIIT (PPP) Act, 2017, it has been declared an Institution of National Importance. It offers undergraduate and PhD programmes in CSE, ECE, Basic Sciences, AI & ML, Data Science & Analytics, HCI & Gaming Technology and IoT. The campus is about 25 km from Nagpur city, at Survey No. 140,141/1, Behind Br. Sheshrao Wankhade Shetkari Sahkari Soot Girni, Village Waranga, PO Dongargaon (Butibori), District Nagpur – 441108 (Maharashtra).

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: Both officers assist the Registrar or the Faculty In-Charge (T&P), mainly with student placements and internships. The work covers compiling and analysing student data, dealing with industry, and handling pre-placement procedures, aptitude tests, group discussions, technical and HR interviews, and institute-industry interaction. They also carry out administrative tasks for other sections when required. Both report to the Registrar or as the Competent Authority advises. The counsellor counsels students, mostly aged 18 to 28, as well as adults over 28. The role includes building a counselling programme for the institute, working with volunteer agencies and hospitals, and running workshops, talks and group discussions. The counsellor keeps sessions confidential but must report any extreme case that needs the institution or the family to step in. They also keep a database on the mental well-being of students and employees. The counsellor reports to the Associate Dean (Student Welfare), the Registrar or as the Competent Authority advises. This officer looks after lab and equipment maintenance, IT, networking and email handling. The required knowledge covers system maintenance and troubleshooting, OS and driver installation, server maintenance, Wi-Fi and wired/wireless LAN, routing, and basic programming in Python, Java, C++ and C. The officer reports to the HoD or the Registrar. This officer handles lab work and equipment, IT, networking and email. The required knowledge covers circuit laws, AC fundamentals, sensors and transducers, SMPS and UPS electronics, analog and digital circuits, op amps, the 555 timer, signals and systems, control systems, DSO and PCB rework. It also covers tools such as PSpice, Cadence, MATLAB and network simulators, and newer technology such as antennas, SDR kits, cognitive radio and wireless communication. Candidates with experience in computer networking, LAN/WAN, and maintaining printers and routers will be given preference.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted first. The institute may set norms higher than the minimum, and meeting the qualifications alone does not guarantee an interview call. Depending on the number of applications, the institute may hold a written test, interviews or both. Interviews will be held offline. Eligible candidates will be told the dates. Original documents are verified at the interview. A candidate whose documents do not meet the criteria, or who does not bring originals, will not be allowed to take the interview. The institute may offer a lower post to a candidate it finds suitable. No TA/DA or lodging and boarding is paid for attending the interview. Paid guest-house accommodation is offered on a first-come basis, subject to availability. Details are on the institute website.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The positions are purely temporary and contractual, for 11 months. Extensions may follow under institute policy, depending on performance. Appointments are made through a third-party manpower supply service agency and give no right or preference to appointment on IIIT Nagpur's own rolls. The Student Counsellor attends the institute Monday to Saturday, 09:30 AM to 6 PM, or as the competent authority decides. The counsellor must be available for emergencies during holidays and odd hours, and must counsel online during a lockdown or curfew. The selected candidates will get joining details by email through the third party.

content_sections.text: Age limit: The maximum age for appointment by deputation is 56 years, counted on the closing date for receipt of applications. Who can apply: Officers of the drawing cadre under the Central Government, State Governments or Union Territories, statutory or autonomous organisations, public sector undertakings, universities or recognised research institutes who meet either condition below: (a) they hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their parent cadre or department; or (b) they have five years of regular service in a post in Level-6 of the pay matrix (Rs. 35400-Rs.112400), or an equivalent post, in their parent cadre or department. Essential qualification and experience: Diploma in Civil or Mechanical Engineering from a recognised university or institute. Three years' experience in the concerned field, gained in Central Government, State Government or Union Territory administrations, statutory or autonomous organisations, public sector undertakings, universities or recognised research institutes. The duties listed below describe what the concerned field covers. Desirable: Six months' experience with Auto-CAD software. Who is not eligible: Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion cannot be considered for deputation. In the same way, a deputationist cannot be considered for appointment by promotion. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions before you apply.

content_sections.heading: Duties of a Chief Draughtsman
content_sections.text: Administrative supervision of draftsmen of other categories, plus overall supervision, guidance and checking for accuracy. Drafting structural, fabrication, reinforcement and survey drawings with CADD software such as AutoCAD. Checking project estimates. Checking tender documents and construction schedules. Checking topographical contours, maps, GIS and hydrological data. Checking specifications for tenders, NITs and agreements. Checking rate analysis, including rates for non-scheduled items. Keeping drawings in digital form, including uploading and downloading them in the 'Digital Archival System for Engineering Drawings' maintained by CWC. Making sure new drawing staff are fully oriented. Keeping an account of scientific and mathematical instruments.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Selection Committee will assess the information in each candidate's CV, together with the supporting documents for essential qualification and work experience. The candidate's declaration in the proforma confirms this.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions

This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment, in the same or another Central Government organisation or department. Posting can be at CWC headquarters, any CWC field organisation or the encadred organisations listed above. Applicants can give three choices of organisation in the proforma. These choices are subject to administrative requirement. Other deputation terms follow the Government of India's orders and rules as issued from time to time. Once you apply, you cannot withdraw your candidature.

content_sections.heading: About DMIL
content_sections.text: Delhi Metro International Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC). It was set up to take on international metro rail projects and national projects in India. Its work covers operations and maintenance, consultancy, design, planning and project development in the metro and allied urban transport sectors. For this recruitment, DMIL is hiring staff for the O&M work of Chennai Metro Rail Limited Phase-II.

content_sections.text: The notice provides a 30% horizontal reservation for women candidates. Shortlisted candidates are placed on a panel, and the panel is used on a merit-cum-reservation basis, strictly according to the vacancies available. content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of engagement: Contractual, with no claim to regularisation in the future. Tenure: The initial engagement is for 03 years. It can be cut short or renewed depending on satisfactory service. Pay: The consolidated pay includes all other benefits, such as accommodation, transport, medical, LTA, canteen and insurance. Taxes are deducted from it. Any allowances above the fixed pay are paid under the Rules of the Corporation. PF: The minimum PF under the Code on Social Security, 2020 is deducted from salary, and DMIL pays a matching contribution. The amount built up is paid when the contract ends. Training cost bond: Staff must serve at least three years, not counting any leave without pay. Anyone who leaves within 03 years has to repay the training cost for that position on a pro-rata basis. DMIL will tell staff the amount later. Leave: 08 days of Casual Leave on a pro-rata basis and 18 days of Earned Leave (1.5 EL for each completed month). content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMIL Supervisor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check that you meet every eligibility condition before you report. Download the official notification and print the Bio-Data Form (Annexure-I, "DMIL Application Format"). Fill the form in CAPITAL LETTERS. Without these, your candidature will not be considered further. ID proof (Aadhaar, PAN, Passport, Driving Licence, Election Photo Identity Card etc.) A valid personal email ID and mobile number, kept active throughout the recruitment. content_sections.heading: THSTI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Laboratory Operations & Instrumentation: Contributes to the establishment and operationalization of the bioanalytical laboratory, including development and implementation of analytical workflows, laboratory processes, and documentation systems. Operate, troubleshoot, and maintain LC-MS/MS and HPLC systems to ensure reliable analytical performance. Support instrument qualification, calibration, preventive maintenance, and performance verification of laboratory equipment. Maintain accurate laboratory records and ensure adherence to laboratory safety and good documentation practices. Provide routine supervision and technical guidance to junior analysts and laboratory staff. Oversee the maintenance of reference standards, reagent inventory, logbooks and lab notebooks. Bioanalytical Method Development & Validation: Prepare method development, validation, and analytical protocols for new projects after required literature search. Develop, optimize, and validate LC-MS/MS and HPLC methods for quantification of metabolites in biological matrices (e.g., plasma, serum, tissues). Generate analytical summaries, concentration datasets, and bioanalytical study reports in compliance with laboratory quality systems. Familiarity with common laboratory techniques, including gel electrophoresis, molecular assays, and serological assays. Experience in handling small animals, histopathology. Experience in isolating PBMCs and working knowledge of FACS. Familiarity with common laboratory techniques, including gel electrophoresis, molecular assays (PCR, rt-PCR), and serological assays (ELISA, multiplex antibody detection assays), Gene cloning, protein expression. Candidates having work experience in a BSL-3 (Biosafety Level 3) laboratory environment will be preferred. Preparation of recombinant plasmids. Preparation and culturing of Mycobacterium tuberculosis strains in the BSL-3 laboratory. Setting up biochemical, immunological and cell-based assays. Conduct laboratory tests, experiments, and analyses in support of SiB program objectives. Collaborate with researchers and scientists to perform various technical tasks. Maintain accurate records of experiments, data, and results. Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards in the laboratory. Provide support in the development and implementation of research protocols. To assist in any other works like fields/site visits related to projects or other scientific/ technical activities. Conducting/ handling pre-clinical animal studies, expert in cell culture, performing immunological Assays, FACS, Cell sorting etc., data analysis and report writing. Hands-on Experience in conducting/ handling animal studies, cell culture, molecular biology, microbiology, FACS and report writing.

content_sections.heading: AUD Psychotherapist Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: M.A. in Psychology with at least 55% marks or an equivalent GPA from a recognized university. M.Phil in Clinical Psychology / M.Phil in Psychoanalytic Psychotherapy / M.Phil in Psychotherapy and Clinical Thinking, or post-master's training, degree or diploma with specialization in psychotherapy, clinical practice or counselling. At least two years of experience in clinical practice / psychotherapeutic work and/or counselling in the field of mental health, at public or private institutions, universities, hospitals, clinics or NGOs. Internships done as part of an academic programme do not count as valid work experience. You must hold the essential qualifications as on the closing date of application. Ph.D. in Clinical Psychology / PsyD (Doctor of Psychology) / Ph.D. with demonstrable interest in psychodynamic and psychoanalytical work. Experience in teaching and supervising trainee counsellors, psychotherapists or clinical psychologists. Evidence of research or publications in psychotherapy or clinical practice. Well-developed sensitivity, empathy, regard and in-depth understanding of the human psyche. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: Psychometric screening of first-year batches of all programmes to identify psychologically vulnerable students, through a Mentor-Mentee System, a Buddy System and other preventive mechanisms. Psychotherapy and clinical counselling for students. Clinical supervision, administrative and organisational work, and community mental health work. Intellectual and practice-based processes and activities. Adopting and implementing a uniform mental health policy, drawing on the UMMEED Draft Guidelines, the MANODARPAN initiative and the National Suicide Prevention Strategy. Consistent, informal and confidential support to students, especially during examinations and academic transitions. Protocols for immediate referral to mental health services, local hospitals and suicide prevention helplines. Training teaching and non-teaching staff in psychological first aid, spotting warning signs, responding to self-harm and making referrals. Training teaching, non-teaching and administrative staff to work with students from vulnerable and marginalised backgrounds in a sensitive, inclusive and non-discriminatory way. Confidential, accessible mechanisms for reporting, redressing and preventing sexual assault, harassment, ragging and bullying on the basis of caste, class, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion or ethnicity, and psycho-social support to victims. Sensitisation programmes (physical and/or online) for parents and guardians on student mental health. Adding mental health literacy, emotional regulation, life skills and awareness of support services to orientation programmes and co-curricular activities. Keeping anonymised records and preparing an annual report on wellness interventions, referrals, training sessions and mental health activities. Regular career counselling for students and parents that is inclusive and sensitive to socio-economic and psychological contexts, plus structured academic planning and mechanisms for monitoring and accountability. Any other duties assigned by the Competent Authority.

content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a visiting basis. It depends on the requirement of CPCR and on terms approved by the university. Applicants working in Government or Public Sector Undertakings (including Boards and Autonomous Bodies) must submit a No Objection Certificate on the prescribed proforma at the interview, if they did not upload it with the online application. If any information turns out to be false or concealed, the services will be terminated immediately. The university may also take action under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. Applications that are incomplete or do not meet the qualifications will be rejected summarily. The university may revise, reschedule, cancel, suspend or withdraw the recruitment in part or in full. Disputes fall under the territorial jurisdiction of the High Court of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: IoP Scientific Assistant-B (Electronics) Job Description
content_sections.text: The incumbent will be primarily associated with the Ion Beam Laboratory (IBL) and will provide electronics and instrumentation support for its accelerator and experimental facilities. Development, assembly, testing and maintenance of analog/digital electronics, instrumentation, power supplies and control systems. Development and integration of electronics for detectors, experimental setups, data-acquisition and computer-controlled instrumentation. FPGA/microcontroller programming and interfacing, wherever required. Troubleshooting, fault diagnosis, repair and preventive maintenance of electronic and instrumentation equipment. Operation, maintenance and upgrading of electronics and instrumentation associated with the Ion Beam Laboratory and other experimental facilities. Providing electronics/instrumentation support, including repair and maintenance, to other experimental laboratories of the Institute as required. Assisting faculty members, scientific/technical staff and students in the development, installation and operation of experimental systems. Maintaining appropriate technical documentation, equipment records, spares and inventory related to assigned systems. The post involves hands-on scientific and technical work. The selected candidate may be required to work in the Ion Beam Laboratory, other experimental laboratories and associated service areas and, depending upon operational requirements, beyond normal working hours/shifts. Any other scientific/technical duties assigned by the Competent Authority according to the requirements of the Institute.

content_sections.text: IIIT Pune is an Institute of National Importance set up by an Act of Parliament in the Public Private Partnership (PPP) model under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its permanent campus is at Talegaon (Maval), Dist. Pune, Maharashtra - 410507, in the foothills of the Western Ghats. These appointments are governed by the IIIT Act and statutes.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Junior Superintendent and Junior Engineer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: All three are Group B posts. The Institute reserves the right to change the number of vacancies.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Junior Superintendent and Junior Engineer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: 32 years for all three posts. Your age is checked against the date of birth on your 10th certificate or birth certificate. No other document is accepted. Nationality: Indian nationals can apply, including Persons of Indian Origin (PIOs) and Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs). Essential: First class Bachelor's degree with 6 years of experience in relevant area, OR Post Graduate with 4 years relevant experience. Desirable: Experience in Establishment Matters, Finance and Accounts, Audit, RTI, Stores and Purchase, Administration, Academic matters, Legal matters etc. in Central Government/State Government/Central Govt. Autonomous Bodies/Central University/CFTIs/IITs/NITs/IIITs etc. Essential: Degree in Engineering in relevant field with 02 years experience, OR Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. Desirable: Experience in civil engineering works in Central Government/State Government/Central Govt. Autonomous Bodies/Central University/CFTIs/IITs/NITs/IIITs etc. The notice lists building construction and maintenance, estimation and costing, BOQ and quantity surveying, site supervision, infrastructure development, water supply and sanitation, STP/drainage systems, preparation and interpretation of drawings, contract/work management, quality control, CPWD/PWD specifications, horticulture, basic plumbing and carpentry maintenance, and campus infrastructure maintenance. Essential: Degree in Engineering in relevant field with 02 years experience, OR Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. Desirable: Experience in the same types of government bodies listed above. The notice names electrical installation and maintenance, LT/HT distribution systems, transformers, substations, DG sets, UPS and power backup systems, electrical panels and cabling, lighting, earthing, fire alarm/ELV systems, central air-conditioning and HVAC systems, VRF/VRV systems, chillers, AHUs, FCUs, cooling towers, ventilation, ducting, pumps, thermostats and associated control systems, estimation and costing, electrical safety, statutory compliance, contract/work management, and campus electrical infrastructure maintenance. Your qualifications must come from a recognised Board, University or Institute. If you claim an equivalent qualification, you must show proof at document verification. If your university has no CGPA conversion formula or definition of First Class, 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA counts as First Class. Only full-time experience counts, and any single period shorter than six months is ignored. Experience certificates must be on official letterhead, signed by the Competent Authority, and must show your designation and pay level or pay. Qualifications and experience are counted as on the last date of online submission. SC, ST, OBC-NCL, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates get relaxation as per Government of India norms for reserved posts. Contractual and outsourced employees of IIIT Pune get relaxation equal to their continuous service in an equivalent post

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: You pay the fee on the portal, and it is not refunded. Regular employees of IIIT Pune do not pay a fee. If you apply for more than one post, you must send a separate application and fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee checks every application. If it asks you for more documents or clarifications, you get three working days to send them. The provisional shortlist is posted on the Institute website, and you then have three working days to raise any grievance by email. Admit cards are sent through the portal or to your registered email, usually at least 21 days before the exam. All tests are held at IIIT Pune, Talegaon, and no TA/DA is paid. Domain Knowledge covers the Constitution and government machinery, the Manual of Office Procedure, FRSR, reservation rules, CCS (Leave, CCA, Conduct, Pension) rules, pay fixation, TA and LTC rules, NPS, GPF, GFR 2017, GeM and CPPP, the RTI, RTE, GST, POSH and Arbitration Acts, NEP 2020, ranking frameworks, Sustainable Development Goals, and e-management systems (Samarth, e-Office, IT Act). The Civil syllabus covers building materials, concrete technology, building construction, estimating and valuation, contracts, surveying, geotechnical, transportation, environmental and structural engineering, RCC design and GFR (Works). The Electrical syllabus covers basic concepts, measuring instruments, electrical machines, generation, transmission and distribution, estimation and costing, contracts, utilisation of electrical energy, HVAC, solid waste management and GFR (Works). Every wrong answer in Stage-I loses 1/4 mark. Up to 8 times the number of advertised posts may be shortlisted for Stage-II. The Institute may shortlist more strictly, for example by higher qualifications, more relevant experience, or experience in government bodies. Ties are broken in this order: higher Domain Knowledge marks, then more relevant experience in a Govt. institution, then the older candidate, then alphabetical order of first name. A waitlist panel may be kept for one year.

rows.details: Part-A General Aptitude, 40 marks: Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, English, General Awareness, Basic Computer Knowledge. Part-B Domain Knowledge, 60 marks. Cut-off to reach Stage-II: 50% for GEN/OBC/EWS, 45% for SC/ST.
Qualifying only (minimum 50%). Tests documentation, drafting, data entry and other admin skills in MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, etc.
Merit is based on Stage-I marks only.
