rows.details: Civil: estimating and costing, surveying, material testing, contracts. Electrical: transformers, switchgears, HT/LT cables, internal wiring, UPS and DG kVA rating, contracts.
Stage-I and Stage-II marks are added together.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are on probation for one year and are made regular once they complete it satisfactorily. The probation may be extended. If you work in a government body, PSU or autonomous body, you must upload a No Objection Certificate (NOC) and vigilance clearance with your online form, or bring the NOC to the Written Test/JoPT. Without these, you will not be called for the test.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Pune Junior Superintendent and Junior Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the IIIT Pune E-Samarth recruitment portal and create a login ID and password. Fill in every field, upload your documents, and save your progress as you go. Pay the fee online and submit the form. Write down your E-Samarth Form No.; enquiries about lost numbers are not answered. Print the submitted form, the uploaded documents and the fee receipt. Number every page, sign and self-attest them, and arrange them in the Annexure-IV order: Cover Page/Index first, then the fee receipt, then the signed form, then your supporting documents. On the envelope, write "Application for the post of ______" and "E-Samarth Form No. ______". Send it to The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune, PO - Talegaon, Pune, Maharashtra - 410507, so it arrives by 09 December 2026, 05:30 PM. The Institute is not responsible for postal delays. Once submitted, the online form cannot be changed. Report portal problems to [email protected] . Your form must also give two references, preferably including your most recent employer if you are working. Cover Page/Index and fee receipt Application form, signed on every page, with a recent passport-size photograph Class X certificate showing your date of birth, and Class XII certificate with mark-sheet UG/PG degree or Ph.D. certificate, as applicable, and mark-sheets for every year or semester SC/ST certificate, or an OBC-NCL/EWS certificate in Central Government format valid for the current financial year NOC from your current employer, if applicable, and experience certificates Photo ID: Aadhaar, Passport, Driving Licence or Voter ID Documents cannot be added after the last date. At the Written Test/JoPT, bring all original documents and a signed PDF copy of your online form.

faq.question: Q1. Is a diploma holder eligible for the IIIT Pune Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes. You need a Diploma in Engineering with 05 years experience. With a Degree in Engineering in the relevant field, 02 years of experience is enough.

faq.question: Q2. How many Junior Superintendent vacancies are there for each category?
faq.answer: There are six: UR-3, OBC-NCL-2 and SC-1. The Junior Engineer (Civil) and Junior Engineer (Electrical) posts have one UR vacancy each.

faq.question: Q3. What counts as first class for the Junior Superintendent post?
faq.answer: If your university does not define First Class or give a conversion formula, 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA is treated as First Class.

faq.question: Q4. Do I have to send a hard copy after applying online?
faq.answer: Yes. The signed, self-attested set must reach the Registrar at PO - Talegaon, Pune - 410507, by 09 December 2026, 05:30 PM. Eligibility is decided on this hard copy.

faq.question: Q5. Is there negative marking in the written exam?
faq.answer: Yes. Every wrong answer loses 1/4 mark, for all three posts.

faq.question: Q6. Do JoPT marks count in the final merit?
faq.answer: For Junior Engineer posts, yes: Stage-I (50) and JoPT (50) are added to make 100. For Junior Superintendent, the JoPT is only qualifying at 50%, and merit is based on the 100-mark written exam.

faq.question: Q7. How much age relaxation do government employees get?
faq.answer: Up to 5 years, for regular employees with at least 3 years of continuous regular service in the same line or an allied cadre. Contractual or outsourced staff at IIIT Pune get relaxation equal to their service there, up to 10 years.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for both Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but each post needs its own application and fee. For example, a UR candidate pays ₹1,180 per post.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the probation period?
faq.answer: One year. It can be extended before you are made regular.

content_sections.heading: IIT Tirupati Job Description
content_sections.text: Communication and Analytics Manager Build and document data pipelines (ETL) that consolidate data from MIS, ERP, HR, academic and finance systems into an analytical layer. Integrate and maintain academic and administrative datasets of the Institute. Develop and maintain dashboards and periodic reports for institutional decision-making covering academic performance and programme outcomes. Prepare data submissions and analyses for statutory and ranking exercises (NIRF, AISHE, QS, THE, AICTE) and reporting. Design and execute exploratory and confirmatory analyses to answer specific questions. Any other relevant task assigned by the Advisor/ Dean (CDO) from time to time. Junior Multimedia Specialist Assist in the creation of multimedia content for the Institute, including posters, brochures, social-media creatives, event publicity materials, photography, videography, and basic video editing for official communication channels. Support the Communication and Analytics Manager in managing digital content archives, data collection, and assisting in the scheduling and dissemination of content across social media platforms.

content_sections.heading: About TNPDCL
content_sections.text: Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation Ltd is a power distribution company. Its Chief Engineer - Personnel works in Chennai. The Board of Apprenticeship Training, Southern Region (BOAT (SR)), Chennai, runs this apprenticeship programme with TNPDCL.

content_sections.heading: TNPDCL Diploma Apprentice Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Training lasts one year in every discipline. TNPDCL can increase or decrease the number of vacancies, whatever figure the notification gives. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/PwD follows the guidelines under the Apprentices Act. If you claim reservation, you must provide a certificate in the Government standard format. Without it, you will be treated as a 'General' category candidate. BC/MBC candidates who claim the OBC (Non-creamy layer) category must bring an OBC (NCL) certificate in the approved format from the certificate issuing authority. Up to 10% of the vacancies are reserved (horizontal reservation) for wards of regular (permanent) employees of TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO. Wards of contract, temporary, casual or retired employees cannot use this quota. Ward quota places that are not filled will go to other available candidates under the usual procedures.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: BOAT (SR) draws up a shortlist from the online application data. It is based on your percentage of marks in the basic qualification for your discipline. Intimation: Shortlisted candidates are told by email, at the email address they registered on the portal. Certificate verification: Shortlisted candidates must attend certificate verification at the TNPDCL office. The shortlist goes up on nats.education.gov.in . To find it, go to the bottom of the home page, then Regional Events, then BOAT (Southern Region), then Apprenticeship News. The notice asks students to check there every day.

content_sections.heading: Training Conditions
content_sections.text: Training lasts one year, as per the Apprenticeship (Amendment) Act 1973. When the apprenticeship ends, TNPDCL (TNEB LIMITED / TNPDCL / TNPGCL / TNGECL / TANTRANSCO) has no obligation to offer you a job. Finishing the apprenticeship does not give you a right to employment. No TA / DA is paid for attending certificate verification, and no boarding or lodging expenses are paid. Incomplete or wrong online applications, and applications received after the due date, will be rejected. No further communication about them will be entertained. Canvassing or putting pressure through any source will disqualify you. Your name will be removed from the records without notice. BOAT (SR) has not authorised any person or organisation to coordinate or liaise its work, so beware of touts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNPDCL Diploma Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The steps depend on whether you are already registered on a National Web Portal. Go to https://nats.education.gov.in , click Student, then Student login, then Forgot Password. Enter your registered email id. You will get an activation link to reset your password. Log in with your registered email id and new password, and complete the application form. You will get a unique 12-digit Enrolment Number. Under "Apply against advertised vacancies", search for "TAMIL NADU POWER DISTRIBUTION CORPORATION LIMITED (TNPDCL)" and click Apply. Your status will show as "applied". Log in with your email id and password. Under "Apply against advertised vacancies", search for "TAMIL NADU POWER DISTRIBUTION CORPORATION LIMITED (TNPDCL)" and click Apply. Your status will show as "applied". Go to https://nats.education.gov.in , click Student, then Student Register. Complete the application form. You will get a unique 12-digit Enrolment Number (ATN...). Log in with your email ID and password. Under "Apply against advertised vacancies", search for "TAMIL NADU POWER DISTRIBUTION CORPORATION LIMITED (TNPDCL)" and click Apply. Your status will show as "applied". Percentage of marks is mandatory: Enter your diploma percentage, as shown on your Diploma Provisional Certificate or Consolidated Mark Sheet, in the "% of marks" column on the NATS portal. content_sections.text: Eligible local candidates living within 16 km of Narora Atomic Power Station get first preference, subject to the reservation rules. If there are not enough eligible local candidates in a category, candidates from outside the area are considered on merit. The shortlist is based on the percentage of marks in the respective trade or discipline. If two candidates have the same percentage, the one born earlier ranks higher. content_sections.heading: Training Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of training: Narora Atomic Power Station, Narora, PO NAPS Township, Distt. Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh - 203389. Duration: a maximum of 12 months for all three types of apprentice. Each apprentice signs a contract of apprenticeship with NPCIL under the Apprentices Act, 1961 and the Apprenticeship Rules, 1992. The contract ends when the training period ends. Apprentices who stay away from training may have to refund the whole cost of their training, meaning the stipend received, as decided by the Central Apprenticeship Advisor. NAPS is a highly protected area, so apprentices are engaged only after they submit a Police Verification Certificate issued by the District Police Authorities. No hostel or transport is provided. NPCIL is not obliged to offer a job to anyone who completes the training, and apprentices are not obliged to accept one. Completing the apprenticeship gives no right to claim a job at NPCIL. Management may cancel or change the number of seats in any trade or discipline, or cancel the whole process, without giving reasons. Seats may stay unfilled if there are not enough suitable candidates.

content_sections.heading: About IIM Mumbai
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Mumbai is a management institute at Vihar Lake Rd, Powai, Mumbai - 400087. The Junior Sports Associates will support the sports and fitness activities of the Institute, including its intra-institute events, tournaments and competitions.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following under "Minimum Qualifications & Experience": Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institution. Diploma in Sports Management or related field will be desirable. Candidates with relevant experience in sports activities, event coordination or sports administration will be preferred. Participation/experience in organizing sports events, tournaments or competitions. Working knowledge of MS Office, Excel and other basic computer applications. Basic knowledge of social media and digital communication platforms. Preference will be given to persons with work experience in the relevant field. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Experience in any Government/ Semi-Government/ Autonomous/PSU/Private sector in the sporting domain shall be considered. Candidates who have participated in national and international level Olympic Sports Disciplines would be given preference. Knowledge of IT, software applications and social media. The age limit is "Upto 45 years (preferably)". The notice does not print an "as on" date for age. Notice condition 23 says the selection criteria may be relaxed for exceptionally deserving candidates. Candidates from the NC OBC, SC/ST and PwD categories must produce a valid Caste/Category certificate to support their reservation category. The applicable Central Government list as on the last date of application is binding. These candidates must upload valid documents signed by the competent authority. No request to change the category applied for will be entertained. See the official notification for the full eligibility requirements for the Junior Sports Associate post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments: ₹30,000 - ₹35,000 per month (consolidated). Out of Campus Allowance (OCA): ₹3,500 per month. Mobile reimbursement: ₹350 per month. Mode of engagement: fixed-term contract through an Institute contract or an Institute empaneled outsourcing agency. Selected candidates may be hired through an outsourcing agency empaneled by the Institute. Period: initially 01 year. The term can be extended as per the Institute requirement, subject to satisfactory performance and the needs of the Institute. Performance review: performance is reviewed every year and is also evaluated after three months of joining. Continuation in the role depends on meeting performance benchmarks. Nature of the post: purely contractual. Candidates will have no right to claim regularization or absorption in the Institute. Work schedule: six days per week (Saturday, Sunday and four weekdays). Sunday off in lieu: one day off in lieu of Sunday, taken on Tuesday, Wednesday or Thursday of the following week. Casual leave: 1.5 days per month. Working hours: 0600 HRs to 1200 Hrs / 1630 Hrs to 2230 Hrs (Shift Duty).

content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Junior Sports Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist in the day-to-day conduct of sports and fitness activities of the Institute. Assist in organizing intra-institute sports events, tournaments and competitions. Coordinate with students and participants regarding sports schedules, registrations and event requirements. Assist coaches and sports personnel in conducting training sessions and sports programmes. Assist in maintaining sports equipment, facilities and inventory records. Support arrangements for transportation, venues, equipment and other logistics for sports events. Maintain attendance, participation records and basic documentation related to sports activities. Assist in preparation of reports, schedules, notices and other sports-related documents. Assist in promoting sports activities through appropriate communication and social media platforms. Perform any other duties related to sports activities as assigned by the Institute.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Mumbai Junior Sports Associate
content_sections.text: Submit the application form online at https://iimmumbai.ac.in/careers on or before 16 November 2026 (5:00 pm). No other mode of application will be entertained. Incomplete applications, or applications without proper supporting documents, will be summarily rejected. Valid Caste/Category certificate signed by the competent authority, uploaded with the application (NC-OBC, SC, ST and PwD candidates only). Proper supporting documents for the application. A correct e-mail ID. All correspondence, including written test or interview call letters, is sent only to the e-mail ID the candidate gives.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Meeting the eligibility criteria does not guarantee that a candidate will be shortlisted for the interview. The Institute may limit the number of shortlisted candidates to a reasonable number based on higher qualifications and/or experience. Selection stages: selection will be through an interview or any other test/selection process that the Institute considers appropriate, for shortlisted candidates only. Depending on the number and quality of applications, the Institute may decide to hold a skill test and/or interview and/or any other test. Information for shortlisted candidates: shortlisted candidates will be told about the selection process separately. The interview date will be sent later to shortlisted candidates through email ONLY. Documents at the interview: bring all original Certificates, Degrees and other documents for your educational qualification, professional qualification, work experience, age etc. for verification, along with one set of photocopies of these documents.

content_sections.text: Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. The Institute can accept or reject any or all applications without giving a reason. The Institute can modify, withdraw or cancel the selection process at any stage, even after an appointment letter has been issued. No interim correspondence will be entertained. The decision of IIM Mumbai will be final and binding. Updates, amendments and corrigenda will be published only on the Institute website, www.iimmumbai.ac.in. For technical help, write to [email protected] . Any legal disputes will be restricted to the jurisdiction of Mumbai only.

Special Knowledge regarding Education, Culture, Agriculture, Industry, Trade, Living and Social Traditions of Uttar Pradesh. | General Hindi (Objective Type): (1) Opposites (10 words), (2) Sentences and Correction in framing (10 sentences), (3) One word for several words (10 words), (4) Same uses and same nature words (10 words), (5) A Noun as defined by an adjective and an adjective (10 words), (6) Synonymous words (10 words). | Paper-1, General Studies-I: | Indian History, Art and Culture: Indian Culture (art forms, literature and architecture from ancient to modern times); Modern Indian history (1757 to 1947): significant events and personalities; the Freedom Struggle; post-independence consolidation and reorganisation within the country (till 1965). Indian Society: Salient features of Indian society and culture; role of women, population and associated issues, urbanisation; liberalisation, privatisation and globalisation and their effects on social structure; social empowerment, social justice and inclusive growth. Geography of India: Physical, Economic and Human Geography of India; Geography of Uttar Pradesh (physical, human and economic aspects, and contemporary issues related to planning and development). Environment and Disaster Management: Environment concept, ecosystems, cycles and biosphere; man-environment relationship, pollution, degradation, conservation and Environment Protection Act; nature and types of disasters; disaster management cycle (Preparation, Rescue, Relief and Rebuilding), role of NDMA, NDRF and SDRF. Science and Technology: Developments and applications of science and technology in everyday life; India's science and technology policy; satellite communication, remote sensing, GPS, space technologies; IT industry, telecommunication; missile systems, UAVs, stealth technology, chemical and biological weapons; nanoscience and nanotechnology; robotics and artificial intelligence; nuclear power policy, nuclear energy applications, radiation, radioactive waste; biotechnology and microbiology, biopiracy, bioinformatics and ethical dimension in biotechnology. | Paper-2, General Studies-II: | Indian Polity and Constitution: Historical underpinnings, evolution, features, amendments, significant provisions and basic structure of the Constitution; role of the Supreme Court; functions and responsibilities of the Union and the States, federal structure, devolution of powers and finances up to local levels; role of the Finance Commission in Centre-State financial relations; Parliament and State legislatures. Governance: Structure, organisation and functioning of the Executive and the Judiciary; pressure groups; Public Interest Litigation (PIL); appointment to Constitutional posts; statutory, regulatory and quasi-judicial bodies including NITI Aayog; Government policies and interventions for development and Information Communication Technology (ICT). Economy and Agriculture: Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), manufacturing sector, energy scenario, means of transport; Government Budget and financial system, effects of liberalisation and globalisation, industrial policies, foreign trade; production of major crops, commercialisation of agriculture, manures, fertilizers, irrigation, storage, transportation and marketing of agricultural produce, e-technology for farmers; farm subsidies and minimum support prices, agricultural diversity, problems of agriculture in U.P., technology missions in agriculture. Ethics and Integrity: Ethics foundations and characteristics; ethical thoughts (Rit and Dharma, Purushartha, Yama, Niyama, Brahma-viharas, Utilitarianism, Deontological theory, Emotivism); attitude; aptitude and emotional intelligence. Current Affairs: Current affairs of regional, national and international importance including games and sports: Global, South Asia and SAARC, India, and Uttar Pradesh. | The Ethics and Integrity and Current Affairs topics appear under the label "Paper-IV" in the printed syllabus on page 8. how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online through the O.T.R. based system. Applications sent through any other medium are not accepted. The online application is completed in four stages.
It is mandatory to complete One Time Registration (O.T.R.) and obtain an O.T.R. number before applying.
Candidates without an O.T.R. number must obtain it from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before submitting the online application.
Only after obtaining the O.T.R. number can a candidate apply through https://uppsc.up.nic.in.

First Stage: On the Commission's website, click "ALL NOTIFICATIONS/ADVERTISEMENTS" and open the online advertisement (User Instructions, View Advertisement, Apply). Click "Apply" and then "Authenticate with O.T.R." and tick "Yes" or "No" for "Have You Completed Your O.T.R. Registration". If "Yes", enter the O.T.R. number, click "Proceed", and authenticate through the O.T.P. received on the registered mobile number/email ID or the O.T.R. password. Personal details from the O.T.R. are displayed automatically, and the candidate fills only the essential qualification required for the post. If "No", first obtain the O.T.R. number from the O.T.R. portal and then continue.

Second Stage: The Applicant Dashboard is displayed. Click "Submit Details" under "Application Part-2" against the applied post. The permanent and correspondence address and application form appear from the O.T.R., along with the preferential qualifications for the post. Choose Yes or No against each preferential qualification.

Third Stage: In the "Fee Confirmation Window", click "Yes" in front of "Proceed for fee payment". The SBI MOPS page opens with three modes of payment: Net Banking, Card Payments and Other Payment Modes. After payment, a "Payment Transaction Slip" is displayed and should be printed using the Printer Icon. If payment fails, log in through "Candidate Dashboard Login" with the O.T.R. number, authenticate, and click "Pending Payment" to pay the fee.

Fourth Stage: The application form is displayed on screen and its print should be taken and kept safely, as it must be produced in the Commission's office if any discrepancy arises. After applying, a candidate can modify the qualification details of the applied post only once through "Candidate Dashboard Login", until the last date for correction/modification.

On the final application page there is a Declaration. Clicking "I do not agree" drops the application. A Preview is available before final submission, and a successful submission report can be printed.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess all the requisite qualifications up to the last date for submitting applications. The Commission does not advise candidates about their eligibility. Candidates who are still appearing in the examination of the essential qualification are not eligible and need not apply. Qualification: Bachelor's degree, with specific requirements for some posts (see below). Age: 21 to 40 years on 01 July 2026, with relaxations. Marital status: Male candidates who are married and have more than one wife living, and female candidates who have married a person already having a wife, are not eligible unless the Hon'ble Governor has granted an exemption. Reservation and age relaxation: Candidates of reserved categories who are not permanent residents of U.P. are not given the benefit of reservation or age relaxation. Nationality: Not specified in the pages provided.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Qualification
content_sections.text: For the post of Samiksha Adhikari, candidates must have a Bachelor's degree from a University established by law in India, or a qualification recognised by the Government as equivalent, up to the last date for receipt of online applications. Some posts have specific educational qualifications, listed below. Candidates for posts with specific educational qualifications must give their options clearly. The notification gives three qualification entries for the Manager, Care-Taker and Receptionist (Swagati) posts of the U.P. Public Service Commission. The extracted text does not make clear which entry belongs to which post, so candidates should check the PDF (page 3). The entries are: Entry A: Bachelor's degree from a recognised University. Preferential qualifications: (a) one year's course in Cookery, Bakery, Table-laying, Flower-arrangements or an equivalent course; (b) knowledge of Horticulture; (c) knowledge of Accounts rules; (d) administrative experience such as supervision of Furrash, Mali, Chaukidar, Attenders and Sweepers. A note in Hindi lists diploma courses treated as equivalent to point (a), including a minimum one-year Diploma in Food Production, Bakery and Confectionery, Food and Beverage Service or House Keeping, as well as certain other courses. Entry B: Bachelor's degree from a University established by law in India or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Preferential qualifications: (a) three years Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering; (b) knowledge of Horticulture; (c) knowledge of Accounts rules; (d) administrative experience such as supervision of Furrash, Mali, Chaukidar, Peons, Attenders, Sweepers and Drivers. Entry C: (a) Bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a recognised University with History, Geography, English Literature, Anthropology or Architecture as one of the subjects at degree level. (b) Good knowledge of Hindi. For the posts of Samiksha Adhikari, Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari, Samiksha Adhikari (Account), Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari (Account), Care-Taker, Receptionist (Swagati), Manager and Store Keeper, a candidate who has served in the Territorial Army for a minimum of two years, or has obtained a 'B' certificate of the National Cadet Corps, shall, other things being equal, be given preference in direct recruitment. The notification refers to a Government Order dated 19-07-2023 (No. 03/2023/312/47-dk-2-312 LC/2022) on the equivalence of a graduate degree from a university established by law in India, and to Government Order No. 08/2022/2/47-dk-2-2022/02 LC/2022 dated 05.05.2022 for the equivalence of the "O" Level certificate awarded by the DOEACC Society. The Hindi text of the first order is reproduced in the PDF and candidates should read it there. The relevant service rules named in the notification are: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission Subordinate Service Regulations, 2006 (as amended) The Uttar Pradesh Secretariat Subordinate Service Rules, 1999 (as amended) The Uttar Prade

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must have attained 21 years and must not have crossed 40 years on 01 July 2026. They must not have been born earlier than 2nd July 1986 and not later than 01 July 2005. For PH candidates, the maximum age limit is 55 years, meaning they must not have been born before 02 July 1971. Conditions for Chief Minister Fellowship research scholars (as per the Uttar Pradesh Public Services (Relaxation of Age Limit and Weightage for Research Scholars of Chief Minister Fellowship for Competitive Examinations) Rules, 2026): Emergency Commissioned/Short Service Commissioned Officers whose Army service has been extended for rehabilitation may apply for age relaxation only if they obtain a certificate from the competent authority of the Army, Navy or Air Force that their service has been extended for rehabilitation and no disciplinary action is pending, and submit a written undertaking to get released immediately from the Army if selected. These facilities are not admissible if the officer gets a permanent commission in the Army, was released on tendering resignation, or was released on grounds of misconduct or physical disability or on his own request and gets gratuity. Reservation for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, Other Backward Class and Economically Weaker Section candidates of U.P. is admissible as per the relevant Government rules. Horizontal reservation is also admissible for Dependents of Freedom Fighters of U.P., Female candidates, Ex-Servicemen of U.P., P.H. of U.P. and Outstanding sports persons of U.P., on settlement of vacancies as per rules. Reservation for P.H. of U.P. is permissible only for the notified or identified posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UPPSC Samiksha Adhikari Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must apply online through the O.T.R. based system. Applications sent through any other medium are not accepted. The online application is completed in four stages. It is mandatory to complete One Time Registration (O.T.R.) and obtain an O.T.R. number before applying. Candidates without an O.T.R. number must obtain it from https://otr.pariksha.nic.in at least 72 hours before submitting the online application. A Preview is available before final submission, and a successful submission report can be printed.

A candidate who applies under the OBC category but cannot give valid proof at this stage will be rejected and will not be allowed to take the interview. content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the educational qualification and other eligibility requirements prescribed under the Recruitment Rules, 2019 for Non-Teaching Staff in National Institutes of Technology . Candidates applying for the 6 Junior Assistant vacancies must have passed Class 12 from a recognized Board. They must also have a minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute and proficiency in computer word processing and spreadsheet applications. Knowledge of additional computer applications and stenography is desirable but not listed as an essential qualification. Applicants must have passed Class 12 and possess a minimum typing speed of 35 WPM, along with proficiency in computer word processing and spreadsheets. Additional computer skills, stenography and a Bachelor's degree are desirable qualifications. The institute has advertised 4 Technical Assistant posts under Pay Level 6. First Class Engineering Diploma in the relevant field with excellent academic record. First Class Bachelor's Degree in Science. Master's Degree in Science with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade. Candidates must also satisfy the trade, field or specialization conditions specified in Annexure-II. The institute accepts the following alternative qualifications for Senior Technician and Technician posts: Class 12 with Science and at least 60% marks. Candidates with Class 12 Science may also qualify for certain Technician and Senior Technician positions, subject to the required marks and specialization. Yes. faq.question: Q1. When and where is the CSIR-IHBT walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are on 18 November 2026 (codes 18001 to 18005) and 19 November 2026 (codes 18006 to 18011) at 09.30 AM, at CSIR-IHBT, Palampur (H.P.). Candidates reporting after 10.00 AM will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there under Advertisement No. 18/2026?
faq.answer: There are 12 positions in 11 position codes: 2 for Project Associate PAT-I (18001) and 1 each for the other ten codes.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Assistant-I (PA-I)?
faq.answer: For Project Assistant-I (PA-I), codes 18002 and 18010, the essential qualification is SSC/10th plus ITI. Qualifications for the other posts differ and are given in the posts table.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is 35 years for Project Associate and Project Assistant posts and 40 years for Senior Research Fellow and Principal-PAT, counted as on 18.11.2026 (codes 18001 to 18005) or 19.11.2026 (codes 18006 to 18011). SC/ST/PwBD/Women get 5 years' relaxation and OBC get 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Rs. 18,000 per month for Project Assistant-I to Rs. 49,000 per month for Principal-PAT, consolidated. Project Associate PAT-I codes 18005 and 18006 get Rs. 31,000 or Rs. 25,000 depending on NET/GATE or equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice prints each amount as "per month" plus HRA: 10% HRA for most codes and 9% HRA for codes 18007, 18008 and 18010.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Bring the application on the prescribed format with a latest coloured passport size photo, self-attested photocopies of age, educational qualification and experience testimonials, and the original certificates. Candidates without originals will not be allowed to appear.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The Selection Committee may hold a direct interview, or an objective test based on Multiple Choice Questions followed by an interview on the same day. The number of selected candidates may differ from the advertised positions.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, or 06 years, whichever is earlier, and give no right or claim to regularisation at CSIR or CSIR-IHBT.

basic_details.short_information: Hindustan Copper Limited Apprentice Recruitment 2026: Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) has released Notification No. HCL/MCP/HR/Trade App./01/2026 dated 3 November 2026 for 171 Trade Apprentice seats across 19 trades at its Malanjkhand Copper Project in Balaghat, Madhya Pradesh. Candidates who have passed Class 10 or Class 10 with ITI in the relevant trade can apply, depending on the apprenticeship category. The age limit is 18 to 25 years as on 1 November 2026, with applicable relaxation. Selection will be based on Class 10 and ITI merit, and the training duration varies from one to three years

application_fee.details: The uploaded official notification does not specify an application fee or category-wise fee schedule. | Candidates should follow the official online application instructions and avoid making payments through unverified websites or intermediaries.

qualification.details: Applicants must have passed Class 10 or Matriculation under the 10+2 education system or an equivalent examination. For trades numbered 4 to 19, candidates must also possess an ITI qualification in the relevant trade from a recognized institute. | Important: The notice contains a minor inconsistency: the eligibility paragraph explicitly identifies Sl. Nos. 1 and 3 as 10th-pass entries, while the main vacancy table also shows no technical qualification for Sl. No. 2, Shotfirer/Blaster (Mines). The selection paragraph separately confirms that Blaster (Mines) is assessed on Class 10 marks alone. Candidates applying for these three trades should follow the trade-wise qualification table and verify the relevant application instructions. | The notification states that candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as a Diploma, B.E. or equivalent qualification will not be considered under this apprenticeship engagement. | Candidates with academic degrees such as B.A., B.Sc. or B.Com. will not receive additional weightage in the selection process. | Candidates who passed ITI in 2025 or earlier must upload an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper, sworn before a Magistrate or Notary Public. | The affidavit must declare that the candidate has neither undergone apprenticeship training previously nor taken employment anywhere. | The required affidavit must be uploaded as a PDF smaller than 1 MB.

salary_details.details: Selected Trade Apprentices will receive a stipend as admissible under the applicable apprenticeship rules. | The notification does not announce a specific monthly stipend for individual trades. Candidates should not assume a fixed amount without confirmation from the company.

selection_process: Qualification Example Marks Weightage Weighted Score

Selection will be based on a merit list prepared using Class 10 and ITI marks. The official notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview.

Online Registration: Candidates complete Government apprenticeship portal registration and HCL online application. Merit Calculation: Marks are evaluated using the prescribed Class 10 and ITI weightage. Shortlisting: The company prepares the shortlisted candidates list. Certificate Verification: Educational and eligibility certificates are verified. Medical Fitness: Candidates must satisfy Hindustan Copper Limited's medical standards. Apprenticeship Engagement: Selected candidates complete the applicable apprenticeship contract formalities.

content_sections.heading: HCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have passed Class 10 or Matriculation under the 10+2 education system or an equivalent examination . For trades numbered 4 to 19, candidates must also possess an ITI qualification in the relevant trade from a recognized institute. Important: The notice contains a minor inconsistency: the eligibility paragraph explicitly identifies Sl. Nos. 1 and 3 as 10th-pass entries, while the main vacancy table also shows no technical qualification for Sl. No. 2, Shotfirer/Blaster (Mines). The selection paragraph separately confirms that Blaster (Mines) is assessed on Class 10 marks alone. content_sections.heading: Hindustan Copper Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared using Class 10 and ITI marks . The official notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview. Online Registration: Candidates complete Government apprenticeship portal registration and HCL online application. Merit Calculation: Marks are evaluated using the prescribed Class 10 and ITI weightage. Shortlisting: The company prepares the shortlisted candidates list. Certificate Verification: Educational and eligibility certificates are verified. Medical Fitness: Candidates must satisfy Hindustan Copper Limited's medical standards. Apprenticeship Engagement: Selected candidates complete the applicable apprenticeship contract formalities. For ITI-based trades, the merit calculation gives 70% weightage to Class 10 marks and 30% weightage to ITI marks . Merit Percentage = (Class 10 Percentage x 0.70) + (ITI Percentage x 0.30) This is an illustrative calculation, not an actual cut-off. For trades where ITI is not required, the merit list is prepared using 100% weightage of Class 10 Board marks . The notification specifically identifies Mate Mines and Blaster (Mines) in its merit instructions. The main qualification table also lists Driver-cum-Mechanic (LMV) without an ITI requirement. If two or more candidates obtain the same merit marks, the older candidate will be given preference. Where Class 10 results are awarded in CGPA, the notification prescribes conversion into percentage by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5 . For example, a CGPA of 8.0 corresponds to 76% under this prescribed calculation.

content_sections.heading: RRC Central Railway Act Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 100 for candidates who are not covered by the notified exemptions. SC, ST, PwBD and women candidates are exempt. Payment Mode: Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, UPI or Wallet through the integrated online payment gateway. The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable payment transaction charges, if any, must be borne by the candidate. RRC Central Railway advises candidates to use the Verify Payment option if their payment is deducted but the application confirmation cannot be downloaded. Candidates should verify the original transaction before attempting another payment, since duplicate payments may not be refunded.

content_sections.heading: Central Railway Act Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a merit list calculated using the simple average of Class 10 and ITI percentage marks . The notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview. Online Application: Candidates apply through the RRC Central Railway website. Merit Calculation: Class 10 aggregate percentage and ITI percentage are given equal weightage. Merit List Preparation: Lists are prepared cluster-wise, unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must produce original educational and category certificates. Medical Fitness: Candidates must present the prescribed medical fitness certificate. Apprenticeship Engagement: Eligible candidates are engaged for training after completing the necessary formalities. Important: Although RRC Central Railway has issued a centralized notification, it will not prepare one centralized merit list for all 2,861 slots. Selection is organized according to the relevant cluster, unit, trade and community. The official merit formula is: Merit Percentage = (Class 10 Aggregate Percentage + ITI Percentage) / 2 This is an illustrative calculation, not an actual selection cut-off. Candidates must enter accurate percentages based on the aggregate Class 10 marks and the prescribed consolidated ITI marks. For boards that award letter grades rather than percentages, candidates must calculate the percentage using the midpoint of the marks range corresponding to the overall grade. If the education board does not issue an overall grade, the midpoints of individual subject-grade ranges must be averaged according to the notification's instructions. For example, if the overall grade corresponds to the range 80-89%, the midpoint is 84.5%. Candidates should use the conversion instructions given on pages 2 and 3 of the official PDF. Incorrect calculation may lead to rejection during verification. If two candidates obtain the same merit percentage, the older candidate will receive preference. If their dates of birth are also identical, the candidate who passed the Matriculation examination earlier will be placed higher.

content_sections.heading: Is There a Written Exam for Railway Apprentice 2026?
content_sections.text: No separate written examination is specified for this Central Railway Act Apprentice engagement. Candidates are shortlisted according to their Class 10 and ITI marks, followed by document verification and medical fitness assessment. Applicants should not confuse this apprenticeship selection with Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) CBT examinations conducted for regular railway posts.

content_sections.heading: Central Railway Apprentice Reservation Rules 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation applies to eligible SC, ST, OBC, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen categories according to the relevant notification provisions. SC and ST candidates claiming reservation must upload the appropriate caste certificate in the prescribed Central Government format. OBC candidates must submit a valid caste certificate and Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued on or after 1 April 2026 , in the prescribed Central Government format. Original certificates must be produced during document verification. PwBD eligibility is restricted to the disability categories and trade-specific fitness conditions stated in the notification. The applicable provisions include certain locomotor disabilities, cerebral palsy, hearing disabilities and low-vision categories. Candidates claiming PwBD reservation must possess a valid disability certificate from the competent medical authority. Not every disability category is suitable for every apprenticeship trade, and applicants must check the requirements applicable to their selected trade. Applicants claiming these benefits must upload the required discharge or serving certificate and produce the original supporting documents when called for verification.

content_sections.heading: Central Railway Apprentice 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Candidates can submit online applications through the official RRC Central Railway Apprentice 2026 recruitment portal. The application window is open from 3 November to 2 December 2026. Direct Apply Online: Central Railway Apprentice 2026 Application Portal Official Website: www.rrccr.com Notification Number: RRC/CR/AA/2026. Last Date: 2 December 2026, 5:00 PM. Applicants must select only one cluster and may give unit preferences within that cluster. Multiple applications are not permitted and may result in cancellation of all applications submitted by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Central Railway Apprentice 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official Railway Recruitment Cell, Central Railway website at www.rrccr.com . Locate Notification No. RRC/CR/AA/2026 for engagement of Act Apprentices. Download and read the complete notification before applying. Check the available ITI trades, cluster-wise vacancies, age criteria and educational requirements. Click the Apply Online link for the 2026 apprenticeship engagement. Complete the registration process using the information requested on the portal. Enter personal details, including name, parents' names, date of birth and contact information. Provide the required Aadhaar or other permitted identification details. Enter Class 10 qualification and aggregate percentage marks accurately. Enter the relevant ITI trade certificate and marks details. Select only one eligible cluster. Choose the available units within the selected cluster in order of preference. Enter the applicable community, reservation and other eligibility details. Upload the prescribed photograph, signature and supporting certificates. Review the completed application carefully before final submission. Pay the application fee of Rs. 100, unless exempt. Complete the application process before 2 December 2026 at 5:00 PM . Download and print the application form and retain the registration number and payment receipt. Important: Candidates should not submit multiple applications using different mobile numbers, email addresses or personal particulars. RRC Central Railway may reject all applications submitted by the same candidate.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Central Railway Apprentice 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload legible scanned copies of the required educational and supporting documents during the online application process. Class 10 or equivalent marksheet. Date-of-birth proof through Matriculation certificate, marksheet or accepted school leaving certificate. Consolidated ITI marksheet covering all semesters of the notified trade. National Trade Certificate issued by NCVT or accepted provisional certificate issued by NCVT/SCVT. SC/ST/OBC caste certificate, where applicable. Valid OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where applicable. Disability certificate for eligible PwBD applicants. Discharge certificate or Armed Forces serving certificate for applicable Ex-Servicemen reservation claims. Prescribed recent colour photograph. Scanned candidate signature. Aadhaar or other permitted identity document details. Original documents must be produced during document verification. Documents issued in languages other than Hindi or English must be accompanied by the required attested translation. Both images must follow the prescribed 100 DPI specification. The colour photograph must have been taken within three months before application and should show the candidate's face clearly without a cap or sunglasses. Applicants should retain two additional copies of the same photograph for document verification.

content_sections.heading: Aadhaar and Identity Requirements for RRC CR Apprentice 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants are generally required to enter their 12-digit Aadhaar number during registration. Those who have applied for Aadhaar but have not received the card may enter the 28-digit Aadhaar Enrolment ID. The notification provides special identification provisions for applicants from Jammu & Kashmir, Meghalaya and Assam. Eligible applicants from these locations may use a permitted Government identity document such as Voter ID, valid passport or driving licence. The original accepted identification document must be produced during document verification.

content_sections.heading: Central Railway Apprentice Document Verification 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted through the merit process will be called for document verification in the relevant division or unit according to their selected cluster. They must produce the original educational certificates, ITI marksheets, reservation certificates, identity documents and other applicable records. Shortlisted candidates must bring the prescribed medical fitness certificate in the format provided in Annexure VII of the official notification. The certificate must be signed by a Government-authorized Gazetted medical officer not below the rank of Assistant Surgeon in a Central or State Government hospital. Important: Candidates who fail to produce the required medical fitness certificate may not be permitted to undergo document verification and may have their candidature cancelled.

content_sections.heading: Common Reasons for Rejection of Railway Apprentice Applications
content_sections.text: Applicants should carefully review the following requirements because errors may lead to rejection: Not meeting the minimum Class 10 aggregate marks or prescribed ITI qualification. Selecting a unit where no training slots are available for the applicant's ITI trade. Submitting more than one application. Entering incorrect Class 10 or ITI percentages. Providing personal details that do not match the Matriculation certificate. Uploading unclear, corrupt or incorrect documents. Failing to produce the required original certificates during verification. Claiming reservation without the prescribed supporting certificates. Not meeting the applicable age limit. Failing to produce the required medical fitness certificate. Providing false or misleading information. Applicants should check the complete notification and all entered information before paying the fee and submitting the final application, as editing is not permitted after final submission.

content_sections.heading: Central Railway Act Apprentice 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: RRC Central Railway has announced 2,861 Act Apprentice training slots. The notification number is RRC/CR/AA/2026, dated 3 November 2026. Applications close on 2 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. Class 10 with at least 50% aggregate marks and the relevant ITI certificate are mandatory. The prescribed age limit is 15 to 24 years, with applicable relaxation. Engineering graduates and diploma holders are not eligible under this notification. Candidates already undergoing or having completed apprenticeship should not apply. Applicants must select only one cluster. The selected units must offer training slots for the applicant's ITI trade. Selection is based on the simple average of Class 10 and ITI marks. No separate written examination is prescribed. Merit lists are prepared cluster-wise, unit-wise, trade-wise and community-wise. SC/ST/PwBD and women candidates are exempt from the application fee. The notified monthly stipend is Rs. 9,600. The apprenticeship training duration is one year. Selected candidates must arrange their own accommodation. Original document verification and medical fitness are mandatory. No TA/DA will be paid for attending document verification. Apprenticeship completion does not guarantee regular railway employment. Candidates should regularly check the official RRC Central Railway website for updates.

content_sections.heading: About DMIL
content_sections.text: Delhi Metro International Limited is a wholly owned subsidiary of the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC). It was set up to take on international metro rail projects and national projects within India, covering operations and maintenance, consultancy, design, planning and project development in the metro and allied urban transport sectors. Under this notice, DMIL is hiring staff for the O&M work of Chennai Metro Rail Limited Phase-II.

content_sections.heading: DMIL Technician Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice provides 30% horizontal reservation for women candidates. Selected candidates may be deployed in any department, as the requirement and urgency of the work demand. DMIL may increase, decrease, cancel, restrict or modify the requirement at any time.

content_sections.heading: DMIL Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be 18 to 33 years old as on 1 October 2026. Reserved category candidates get the usual relaxation under the Tamil Nadu Government Rules. Your ITI aggregate must be at least 60%. Your ITI must be from a Government ITI or Govt aided ITI of Tamil Nadu. Candidates who passed from a private ITI will not be considered. Candidates who have had lasik surgery are not suitable for the post of Technician. For the trade-wise eligibility of each discipline, check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Matriculation / Class 12th pass and having ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in Electrician, Fitter and Ref. & AC Mechanic Trade from a Govt. ITI or Govt. aided ITI

Matriculation / Class 12th pass and having ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in Electronic Mechanic, Information communication Technology System Maintenance, Information Technology, Computer Hardware and Network Maintenance, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Power Electronics System from a Govt. ITI or Govt. aided ITI
Matriculation / Class 12th pass and having ITI (NCVT/SCVT) in Plumbers, Welders and Carpenters from a Govt. ITI or Govt. aided ITI

content_sections.heading: Pay and Benefits
content_sections.text: CTC of Rs. 28165/- (Rupees Twenty Eight Thousand, One Hundred Sixty Five only) per month, with no claim of regularisation in the future. The consolidated pay includes all other benefits, such as accommodation, transport, medical, LTA, canteen and insurance. Taxes are deducted from it. Any allowances over and above the fixed pay will be paid as per the Rules of the Corporation. Minimum PF under the Code on Social Security, 2020 will be deducted from your salary, and DMIL will make a matching contribution. The accumulated amount is paid when the contract ends. Leave: 08 days Casual Leave on a pro-rata basis and 18 days Earned Leave (1.5 EL for each completed month of service).

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is on a merit-cum-reservation basis. Document Verification and Screening, including a Tamil language Reading, Writing and Speaking Proficiency Test that is qualifying only. Candidates who studied Tamil as a subject in the 10th standard do not have to take this test. Candidates found suitable are put on a panel for 02 years from the date the Competent Authority approves it. The panel is used strictly as vacancies arise. Pre-engagement medical examination: empanelled candidates must meet the Corporation's medical standards, which are available on www.delhimetrorail.com . The Corporation pays for the first medical examination. If you ask for a re-medical, you pay for it yourself. Character and antecedents verification before engagement.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Engagement is contractual, initially for 03 (three) years. It can be cut short or renewed, depending on satisfactory service. Training cost bond: you must serve for at least three years, not counting leave without pay. If you leave within 03 years, the position-wise training cost is recovered on a pro-rata basis. You must give one month's notice before resigning. DMIL can end the engagement without giving reasons by giving 30 days' notice. If you resign, you must give 30 days' advance notice or pay in lieu of notice. Being selected, shortlisted or empanelled gives you no right to engagement. Your candidature stays provisional and can be cancelled at any stage if any information you gave turns out to be false.

content_sections.heading: Screening Schedule and Venues
content_sections.text: The schedule covers all trades: Electrician, Electronic Mechanic, Fitter, RAC, Information communication Technology System Maintenance, Information Technology, Computer Hardware and Network Maintenance, Mechanic Industrial Electronics, Power Electronics System, Plumbers, Welders and Carpenters.

basic_details.short_information: Candidates who have passed 10th class with at least 40% marks and hold a National Trade Certificate in the Lineman trade can apply for 7 seats of one-year Lineman apprenticeship training with the Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB), Construction Division, Dhulkote (Ambala), for session 2026-27, under the Apprenticeship Act 1961. Applications are accepted online only, through the NAPS portal (apprenticeshipindia.gov.in), from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026. Selection is on a merit list of 10th and ITI marks, with no written exam and no interview.

10th Mark sheet
ITI Certificate and Marksheets (the certificate must be issued by NCVT/SCVT)
Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC, if applicable)
Residence/Domicile certificate, if applicable
Aadhaar Card

Selection and deployment of apprentices depend on the detailed provisions of the Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments, if any. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives the following eligibility for ITI Trade Apprentices (Lineman): The candidate must have passed the 10th class examination with at least 40% marks from a recognised Board, and must also hold a National Trade Certificate in the notified trade, issued by the National Council for Vocational Training/State Council for Vocational Training in that trade. The candidate must have completed the relevant ITI course. The candidate must have an Aadhaar Card. It is compulsory and is needed for online registration. Age: as per the Apprenticeship Act 1961 and its amendments from time to time. Reservation: as per the Apprentice Act 1961 and its amendments from time to time. Candidates whose results for the qualifying examinations are still awaited on the last date for receipt of applications will not be considered. For the full eligibility for the Lineman trade, see the official notification and the BBMB website.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The seats are for a one-year apprenticeship training under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 for session 2026-27. The stipend amount is not specified in the notice. The notice says the stipend details are on the BBMB website (bbmb.gov.in). The contracts of the selected candidates will be registered under the NAPS Portal. The notice also says that contracts for the 7 Lineman Apprentice seats will be issued as and when a vacancy arises, on the basis of the merit list. That merit list is valid up to 28.02.2027.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBMB Lineman
content_sections.text: Applications must be received online by the concerned office from 5 November 2026 to 3 December 2026 through the National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) portal, https://apprenticeshipindia.gov.in. No other mode of application will be accepted. You need your Aadhaar Card to register online. Documents named in the notice (shortlisted candidates will be called to have them checked): 10th Mark sheet ITI Certificate and Marksheets (the certificate must be issued by NCVT/SCVT) Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC, if applicable) Residence/Domicile certificate, if applicable Aadhaar Card

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: There is no interview and no written exam. Eligible candidates will be selected from the database of the apprenticeship portal (NAPS/NATS). Selection is based on a merit list prepared for all applicants, using the percentage of marks in matriculation (10th) and the ITI course: 25% of the seats available for each trade will be given to candidates who hold a residency certificate of the concerned districts of the State where the Grid Sub Station is located. If any of these reserved seats remain unfilled, they will go to candidates who hold a residency certificate of the State where the Grid Sub Station is located. If seats still remain unfilled, they will be filled through open merit. If two candidates have the same marks, the older candidate gets preference. If the dates of birth are also the same, the candidate who passed matriculation earlier is considered first.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility varies slightly according to the Technician Grade II post and trade. Candidates must possess the required educational qualification, relevant vocational certificate and prescribed work experience. The required two years of experience must be relevant to the concerned trade and should be obtained after acquiring the prescribed qualification. The notification permits experience certificates from Government, Semi-Government, Limited, Private Limited, registered private companies or registered firms, as applicable. For direct recruitment to the advertised Group C posts, candidates must satisfy the eligibility conditions prescribed by the Uttarakhand Government. The notification states that applicable candidates should fulfil the required Uttarakhand employment registration, domicile/permanent residence or educational conditions prescribed for direct recruitment. Among the conditions mentioned in the notification are registration with an employment office located in Uttarakhand up to the last date of application, holding an Uttarakhand domicile/permanent residence certificate, or having passed the prescribed school-level examinations from recognized institutions situated in Uttarakhand, as applicable under the rules. Additional provisions are given for certain Government employees, employees of specified State bodies and their eligible family members. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact condition applicable to their case. The Technician Grade II posts are described as non-gazetted and permanent posts with EPF benefits.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Salary
content_sections.text: All three Technician Grade II categories carry the same notified Level-4 pay scale.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Application Fee
content_sections.text: The examination fee can be paid through the online payment options provided in the application system, including Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking or UPI, as available on the portal.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates should have completed 18 years of age and should not have completed 42 years as on 01 July 2026. The notification provides age relaxation according to Uttarakhand Government rules for eligible reserved categories. It mentions relaxation provisions for eligible SC, ST and OBC candidates, Persons with Disabilities, dependants of freedom fighters and eligible ex-servicemen, subject to the conditions prescribed in the notification.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for UKSSSC Technician Grade II Recruitment 2026 will be based primarily on an offline written competitive examination. Candidates who fail to obtain the prescribed minimum marks will not be treated as qualified in the written examination. The notification states that the examination will use an OMR answer sheet. Candidates should carefully follow all OMR instructions. Use of whitener or scratching/cutting of options is prohibited and may attract negative marking or other action as prescribed. The merit list will be prepared on the basis of marks obtained in the written competitive examination. Where two or more candidates obtain equal marks, preference will first be determined according to age, with the older candidate placed higher. Further tie-breaking will be carried out according to the rules stated in the notification.

Fill in educational qualification and other required information. Upload the photograph and signature in the required format. Pay the applicable examination fee through the available online payment mode. Submit the completed online application. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference. Registration and Personal Details Educational and Other Details Upload Photograph and Signature Make Payment Print Application Candidates should keep their registered mobile number and email address active and regularly check the UKSSSC website for examination schedules, admit cards, corrections and other recruitment notices.

content_sections.heading: UKSSSC Technician Grade II Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the prescribed educational qualification, trade certificate, experience and age criteria before applying. The required two-year experience must be post-qualification experience. Application must be submitted online within the prescribed dates. Candidates should enter reservation category and sub-category correctly in the online application. Reservation benefits will be available only to eligible candidates who produce valid certificates according to Uttarakhand Government rules. Candidates claiming Uttarakhand reservation benefits must meet the applicable State eligibility conditions. Applicants must ensure that the information entered in the online form matches their original certificates. Any false information or discrepancy may result in cancellation of candidature. After the last date, candidates will be given a specified correction period from 28 November to 30 November 2026. The Commission will publish admit cards online. Admit cards will not be sent by post. Candidates should regularly visit the UKSSSC website for examination information and other updates. Mobile phones, calculators, pagers, scanners or other prohibited electronic devices are not permitted inside the examination centre. Candidates must follow all examination-centre security and identification instructions. Physical fitness conditions prescribed for Government service will apply. Reservation, horizontal reservation and certificate requirements will be governed by the rules and Government Orders cited in the notification. The advertised number of vacancies and category-wise distribution may be changed according to departmental requirements and applicable Government rules.

content_sections.heading: About SPMCIL
content_sections.text: SPMCIL is a Schedule 'A' Mini-ratna Category-I Central Public Sector Enterprise wholly owned by the Government of India. It started functioning as a corporatized entity with effect from 13 January 2006. It designs and manufactures security papers and prints currency and bank notes, passports, non-judicial stamp papers and postage stamps, and it also mints coins. Its registered and corporate office is at 3rd Floor, Tower- G, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi- 110029. Its operational units are four Mints at Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad and Noida, four Currency / Security Presses at Nashik, Dewas and Hyderabad, and a Paper Manufacturing Mill at Narmadapuram.

content_sections.heading: About National Law University Delhi
content_sections.text: National Law University Delhi is a university of law established by Act No. 1 of 2008, located at Sector 14, Dwarka, New Delhi – 110078. This post supports the University's Institutional Repository, which is meant to be a central platform preserving the University's institutional memory and supporting dashboards and reports for the Vice-Chancellor's Office, Registrar's Office, IQAC, NAAC, NIRF, BCI, Annual Reports and other institutional requirements.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational qualification: B.Tech. in Computer Science / Information Technology or MCA from a recognised university or institution, or Degree in Computer Science / Management / Technology from a recognized University. Professional experience: minimum one year of relevant experience in database management, content management systems, digital information systems, data management or business intelligence in reputed institutions / organization. Database management: working knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL or equivalent, including SQL-based data management and retrieval. Data processing: proficiency in MS Excel, including data cleaning, validation, consolidation, Pivot Tables and Power Query. Content management: knowledge of content management systems (CMS), digital document management and systematic organisation of electronic records. Knowledge of Python or similar programming languages for data processing and automation. Knowledge of designing flyers, brochures, presentations, customized reports etc. Familiarity with APIs, data integration, workflow automation and automated report generation. Understanding of data warehousing, cloud-based platforms and modern institutional information management systems. Knowledge of metadata management, digital preservation, data security, backup and access-control mechanisms. Exposure to AI-assisted data extraction, document classification, information retrieval and data analytics. Experience in developing or maintaining dashboards, Management Information Systems (MIS) or institutional reporting platforms, preferably in universities, higher education institutions or research organisations. Candidates should read the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated remuneration is Rs.60,000/- per month. The notice says it shall be in the range of INR 60,000/- per month, and also describes it as fixed. TDS @10% shall be deducted from the monthly remuneration as applicable under law. Higher remuneration may be considered based on experience, competence and performance. The appointment is contractual for one year from the date of joining and is further extendable subject to satisfactory performance. It does not confer any right to regular appointment in the University.

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi Data Repository Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: Upload, organise and maintain institutional data and records received from various University departments and offices. Classify, catalogue, index and create appropriate metadata for digital records, including reports, minutes, photographs, publications and historical documents. Maintain structured institutional databases and ensure consistency, accuracy and easy retrieval of information. Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and customised reports for different institutional requirements. Consolidate and analyse departmental data to facilitate reporting for NAAC, NIRF, BCI, Annual Reports and other institutional purposes. Maintain digital records, version control, access permissions and appropriate preservation procedures. Coordinate with the IT Section for technical maintenance, data backups, system integration and troubleshooting. Provide technical assistance to departmental officers in relation to data formats, submission procedures and retrieval of information. Maintain records of repository activities and submit periodic progress reports to the designated authority. Assist the IT Department in their day-to-day activities as and when requested.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLU Delhi Data Repository Associate
content_sections.text: Use the online application form at https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in . Physical or email applications will not be considered. Submit two references/recommendations in the slot provided in the online application. One must be from the current employer (HOD). If you are not currently employed, both references may come from the academic institutions you attended, with at least one from the Head of the Institution/Department concerned. Pay the non-refundable application fee of Rs.1,000/- online. SC/ST and PwD candidates are exempted. Submit the application by 30 November 2026, 11:59 p.m.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The posts are under the Industrial Research & Development Unit of IIT Delhi, Hauz Khas, New Delhi-110016, and sit in the Centre for Biomedical Engineering. The ICMR-funded project, led by Principal Investigator Prof. Arnab Chanda, works on haptic interaction with realistic human tissue-mimicking phantoms for surgical training and robotic surgery. The project code is RM00064G and its duration is up to 15/03/2029.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi has advertised 4 posts in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. Each post has its own minimum and preferred qualification, printed below as the notice gives it. Minimum Qualification: 1. Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees; 2. For Engineering / IT / CS - Four Years Graduate Degree. Preferred Qualification: Ph.D. or equivalent qualification with hands-on experience in one of the following: 1) robotics, sensors, IOT, bioelectronics, haptics, 2) biomechanics, material development and characterization, 3D printing, CAD, FEM. content_sections.heading: About the Fellowship
content_sections.text: The NLUD Justice for Children Litigation Fellowship is described in the notice as a flagship program for young graduates committed to litigation practice on issues pertaining to POCSO and the JJ Act. It is supported by UNICEF. The fellowship aims at improving access to justice for children in need of care and protection and children in conflict with the law. It provides quality legal aid support to children and creates a cadre of well-trained and dedicated child-sensitive lawyers.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces 4 vacancies in total for the post of Litigation Fellow.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The qualification printed in the notice is Law Graduate (LL.B. or B.A.LL.B.). The notice also lists essential and desirable requirements. Updated knowledge of substantive and procedural child rights law, including POCSO and JJ Act Experience in child rights litigation Proficiency in drafting, pleading, and arguing child-centric cases before the child-centric forums in Rajasthan Proficiency in written and spoken English and Hindi An LLM or an equivalent Master's degree in Law Research experience and proficiency in legal writing Proficiency in the use of MS Word and PowerPoint Experience working as a support person, and/or in free legal aid, victims' compensation, and similar services

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is a contractual, part-time engagement for 12 months, starting 15 December 2026. The stipend is INR 30,000/- monthly, with an additional INR 2,000/- monthly payment towards filing and travel expenses.

content_sections.heading: NLUD Litigation Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The litigation fellows will be expected to: Service the cases pertaining to children in need of care and protection, and children in conflict with the law, that have been assigned to them by the Litigation Fellowship Supervisor. This includes end-to-end handling of the case: meeting the child and their family, making submissions in court and other forums, arguing the case, updating the child and family, etc. Attend the training and capacity building sessions organized by NLUD under the fellowship program. Submit weekly case reports in the format prescribed to the Litigation Fellowship Supervisor. Attend the online and offline monthly review sessions with the NLUD J4C Chair. Submit brief notes to the NLUD J4C Chair for publication in the Quarterly newsletter under the section on 'Notes from the Field', which highlights the experiences, successes and challenges of the litigation fellows.

content_sections.text: Open the application form at https://careers.nludelhi.ac.in . Submit the application there before the deadline of 30 November 2026. Do not submit any application materials by post or email. The notice names no documents to attach. For questions, the contact address given is [email protected] .

content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and will advance to the interview stage of the selection process. The notice does not give the interview date, mode or venue.
