content_sections.heading: About MRVC
content_sections.text: Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. (MRVC) is a public sector undertaking of the Government of India under the Ministry of Railways, with its office on the 2nd Floor, Churchgate Station Bldg., Mumbai. In its own words, MRVC is a vital project implementation organisation working in the sensitive Mumbai Suburban area with a very lean organisational structure.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The posts are open only to Civil Engineering officers/executives of Indian Railways/PSUs/Metros/RRTS who are regular/permanent employees. The three posts are advertised together; each grade has its own feeder-grade requirement, listed below. Applicants must hold the posts substantively. Additional General Manager (Civil) – Officers/Executives holding substantively: posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA), OR posts in Level-13 (CDA) with minimum 12 years' service in Group 'A', OR posts in IDA E-6 grade (Rs.90000-240000) for a period of 04 years with overall 16 years of managerial service. Joint General Manager (Civil) – Officers/Executives holding substantively: posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA), OR posts in Level 12 (CDA) with minimum 8 years' service in Group 'A', OR posts in IDA E-5 grade (Rs.80000-220000) for a period of 04 years with overall 14 years of managerial service. Deputy General Manager (Civil) – Officers/Executives holding substantively: posts in analogous grade (CDA/IDA), OR posts in Level 11 (CDA) with minimum 08 years of Gr. A/B service, OR posts in IDA E-4 grade (Rs.70000-200000) for a period of four years with overall 12 years of managerial service, OR posts in Level 10 (CDA) with minimum 12 years of Group B Service (for deputation only). At least 3 (three) years of work experience in Construction of Railway/Metro/High Speed/RRTS/DFCCIL Projects. 3 years' experience in execution of suburban Railway projects/works (preferable). Experience in dealing with Projects/Works funded by multinational banks/financial institutions like World Bank, ADB, NDB, AIIB etc. (preferable). The cut-off date for age and eligibility is the closing date of the Vacancy Notice; the application proforma asks for age as on 12.12.2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; candidates should check the official notification for the grade-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms

On deputation: Parent Pay plus Deputation (Duty) Allowance. On absorption: Scale of pay of the post in which absorbed. Terms of appointment: Deputation / Absorption. Duration: Maximum 5 years subject to exemption from the Rule of Immediate Absorption beyond 30-06-2027 (if selected on deputation). Officers selected for immediate absorption undertake to tender their technical resignation in their parent organisation (Annexure-IV). Place of posting: Mumbai.

content_sections.heading: MRVC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these duties and responsibilities for the posts: Planning, estimation, tendering, execution and contract management for Railway Projects/Works involving earthwork, bridges, stations for Mumbai Suburban, including ensuring quality and safety of the assigned work. Supervision and Contract Management. Dealing with arbitration/court cases related to construction works. Liaison with State/Local Authorities/Railway Officials. Any other works as assigned from time to time.

Candidates holding a higher qualification in Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution may also meet the educational qualification condition.

content_sections.heading: Can B.Tech Graduates Apply for PSSSB JE Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Yes, candidates with a higher qualification in the same engineering discipline can satisfy the educational qualification requirement. For example, a candidate holding a recognized B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering may meet the qualification requirement for Junior Engineer (Civil). Similarly, candidates with recognized higher qualifications in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering may meet the relevant discipline requirement. Applicants must also satisfy the applicable age, Punjabi-language and other recruitment conditions. A higher qualification in an unrelated discipline does not automatically establish eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Is Punjabi Language Compulsory for PSSSB Junior Engineer?
content_sections.text: Yes. Under the Punjab Civil Services (General and Common Conditions of Service) Rules, 1994, candidates must have passed Matriculation with Punjabi as a compulsory or elective subject, or an equivalent Punjabi-language examination recognized under the applicable Government rules. Applicants should verify their Punjabi-language qualification before proceeding with the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: PSSSB JE Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The PSSSB Junior Engineer selection process includes an objective-type written examination followed by counselling and document verification for candidates considered in accordance with the merit list and vacancy availability. Written Examination: Candidates will appear in an objective-type Multiple Choice Questions (MCQ) examination. Merit List: Merit will be prepared based on marks obtained in the written examination. Counselling and Verification: Candidates called for counselling must produce valid original documents supporting their eligibility. Departmental Recommendation: Eligible candidates may be recommended to the concerned departments according to the common merit list and available vacancies. Appearing in the examination or having a name in the merit list does not automatically guarantee appointment. Candidates must satisfy all required recruitment conditions.

content_sections.text: The revised examination schedule has been issued following the Punjab and Haryana High Court's order in CWP No. 32342 of 2026. Candidates are advised to visit the official website sssb.punjab.gov.in for further updates regarding the examination schedule and admit card.

content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit their online applications through the official PSSSB website during the reopened application period of 12 October to 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Do Candidates Who Applied Earlier Need to Apply Again?
content_sections.text: The reopened application window provides another opportunity for eligible candidates to submit applications. Previously applied candidates should continue monitoring the official website for examination and recruitment updates.

content_sections.text: Candidates should prepare the relevant documents specified in the application instructions before completing the form. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection consists of normalized GATE 2026 marks (out of 100) in the EC paper, Behavioural Assessment, Group Discussion and Personal Interview, followed by a Pre-Employment Medical Examination for appointment. Candidates are shortlisted for Behavioural Assessment, Group Discussion and Personal Interview based only on their normalized marks out of 100 in GATE 2026 (EC) and as per criteria decided by the Management. Status and interview call letters are available through the candidate login. Shortlisted candidates may have to undergo a Behavioural Assessment, whose results are used as an input during the interview. Candidates can take the GD/interview in Hindi or English. Group Discussion has no qualifying marks, but the Personal Interview must be qualified: Offers of appointment are issued in order of category-wise merit and based on requirement. Candidates with equal marks are empanelled by date of birth, the oldest first. Appointment is subject to medical fitness in the Pre-Employment Medical Examination as per POWERGRID Norms and Standards of Medical Fitness.

The position is primarily aligned with the Risk & Fraud function and may also support other strategic or operational initiatives of GeM as required. The role and responsibilities printed in the notice are: Identify and assess potential fraud-risk scenarios, operational gaps, and misuse patterns across platform processes and transaction workflows. Review transaction journeys, user activities, and process flow to support strengthening of platform integrity and control mechanisms. Analyze suspicious transactional trends, behavioural anomalies, and process deviations from a risk and fraud management perspective. Support implementation and enhancement of preventive and detective controls for mitigation of operational and transactional risks. Coordinate with internal stakeholders including business, operations, product, and technology teams for assessment and resolution of identified risk areas. Conduct structured reviews of digital workflows and system-driven processes to identify potential control gaps or misuse possibilities. Prepare investigation reports, observations, and recommendations for strengthening fraud prevention and monitoring mechanisms. Support review and analysis related to fraud investigations, transaction irregularities, or policy circumvention cases. Monitor emerging fraud trends, evolving misuse techniques, and risk patterns relevant to digital commerce and online platforms. Ensure all activities are carried out in accordance with organizational policies, governance standards, and confidentiality requirements.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-CIRCOT
content_sections.text: ICAR-Central Institute for Research on Cotton Technology is part of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research and is located at Adenwala Road, Matunga, Mumbai 400 019. The Young Professional-II will work on the portable cotton quality instrument project, which has a likely completion date of June 2028.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Graduate in B.E / B. Tech., or M.E / M. Tech., in Textile Technology / Electronics Engg. / Electrical Engg. / Instrumentation Engg. / Computer Science & Technology or Information Technology / Agricultural Engg. / Agricultural Structures and Process Engineering / Post Harvest Engineering and Technology / Farm Machinery and Power / Mechanical Engineering, OR any other relevant Engineering discipline. Candidates should possess 1st class or 60% marks or equivalent overall CGPA in graduate. Knowledge of design and development of instrument parts Operating 3D printer or any instrument Testing of electronic circuit boards Software development or coding skills Statistical Analysis Research paper/report writing The minimum age under the Young Professional category is 21 years and the maximum is 45 years. The application form asks for age as on the closing date of application. The notice does not mention any experience requirement. The notice states that the relaxation is permissible as per GOI rules. Candidates currently employed elsewhere must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their current employer; those without a valid NOC will not be considered for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A consolidated amount of Rs. 42,000/- (Rupees Forty Two Thousand Only) per month will be paid to the selected Young Professional-II. The appointment is purely temporary, contractual and co-terminus with the project and may be terminated at any time. The engagement is for one year, extendable for two more years (one year at a time), subject to requirement of the services and satisfactory performance after evaluation by the Director, ICAR-CIRCOT, Mumbai. The maximum duration is three years (1+1+1). Casual leave is 08 days in a calendar year on pro-rata basis, with 02 restricted holidays as per the rules of Govt. of India/ICAR. Un-availed leave is not carried forward to the next calendar year. Compensatory leave in lieu of duty on holidays may be allowed, but not more than 02 leaves can accrue in a month. It can be accumulated only up to 05 days at a time and may be availed within 03 months. Female Young Professionals are entitled to maternity leave under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act 2017. There is no paternity leave for male Young Professionals. No TA / DA will be paid for attending the interview or for joining the post if selected.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: Raman Research Institute, Bangalore, is funded by the Government of India and is described in the notice as a premier institute engaged in research in basic sciences. The posts are in the Soft Condensed Matter Group, for a Biophysics Project. More about the Institute is on www.rri.res.in .

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates with a background in experimental physics/engineering OR hands-on molecular and cell biology are encouraged to apply. The notice asks for motivated individuals with a good academic background, an aptitude to explore and master the functioning and use of scientific equipment, and eagerness to learn new techniques. M.Sc./M.Tech or B.E./B.Tech in any field with at least 1 year of academic research project or industrial work experience in biophysics field. The upper age limit is 45 years, as on the last date for closing of applications. Age relaxation applies as per Government of India rules for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/PWD categories. No minimum age is printed in the notice. Any ONE (or more) of the following: Experimental work experience in a research lab involving microfluidics, optics, biophysics, optical tweezers, AFM, optical microscopy, nanodevices, or electric and electronic measurements on biological samples (any one or more of the listed techniques) will be preferred. Familiarity with Arduino/Raspberry Pi programming languages, LabVIEW and/or Matlab is desired. Building electronics and/or optics for biosensors. Experimental work experience in a research lab in molecular biology, biochemistry, cell biology, cloning, recombinant protein expression and purification and microscopy imaging. Candidates with experience with chromatin assembly, DNA-protein complex assembly, CRISPR-Cas9 work, handling RNA work will be preferred. Hands-on experience with quantitative techniques like UV-vis absorption, white-light and/or fluorescence microscopy and density gradient fractionation will be preferred. The notice also expects the ability to work in a multidisciplinary lab environment, a detail and math oriented approach, excellent documentation skills and a quantitative approach in research. Candidates should be self-driven, motivated and have leadership skills to manage the personnel working with them. For the exact eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: RRI RESEARCH ASSISTANT (RA) Job Description

RA (with biology background) will be involved in chromatin assembly as well as protein purification for single molecule biophysics experiments. Extensive hands-on experience of molecular biology techniques handling DNA and protein is a must.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens and meet the prescribed educational, age, marital-status and medical requirements for their selected entry and branch. Candidates must have passed Mathematics and Physics at the 10+2 level and possess one of the following qualifications: Graduation of at least three years in any discipline from a recognized university. Four-year BE/B.Tech degree from a recognized university. Cleared Section A and B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India) or Aeronautical Society of India, as prescribed. Important: Mathematics and Physics at the 10+2 level are mandatory for the Flying Branch. Candidates must also satisfy the applicable age and medical standards. Aeronautical Engineer (Electronics) candidates must have passed Physics and Mathematics at the 10+2 level and possess a recognized eligible engineering/technology qualification or one of the alternative qualifications specifically accepted in the notification. Eligible degree disciplines include various Electronics, Electrical, Electronics and Communication, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, Instrumentation, Robotics and related engineering specializations. The detailed notification also provides an alternative route involving M.Sc. Electronics with B.Sc. Physics and specified professional engineering examinations. Candidates must check the exact accepted discipline in Paragraph 5.3.2.1 before applying. Aeronautical Engineer (Mechanical) applicants must have passed Physics and Mathematics at the 10+2 level and completed a recognized four-year engineering/technology qualification or the specified equivalent professional examination route. Accepted engineering disciplines include Mechanical, Aeronautical, Aerospace, Automobile, Production, Industrial, Manufacturing, Mechatronics, Metallurgical and related specializations listed in the notification. content_sections.heading: AFCAT 1 2027 AFSB Interview and Testing
content_sections.text: Candidates qualifying under the relevant entry route will be called for Air Force Selection Board (AFSB) testing. AFSB assessment involves Officer Intelligence Rating and psychological, group and interview assessments according to the prescribed testing stages. Flying Branch candidates may additionally be required to qualify in the Computerised Pilot Selection System (CPSS). Candidates who previously failed CPSS or were suspended from Flying Training at Air Force Academy are not eligible for the Flying Branch under the notification. Candidates recommended by AFSB must satisfy the prescribed Indian Air Force physical and medical standards. The requirements differ by Flying, Ground Duty Technical and Ground Duty Non-Technical branches. For Flying Branch training, the notification additionally requires a minimum nude body weight of 48 kg before commencing Stage-I fixed-wing flying training. Candidates should review the complete height, weight, vision and other medical standards contained in Appendix A of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT NCC Special Entry 2027
content_sections.text: NCC Special Entry provides eligible NCC Air Wing certificate holders an alternative route to Flying Branch selection. Applicants must possess an NCC Air Wing Senior Division 'C' Certificate acquired within the prescribed two-year period preceding the AFCAT registration date. Eligible NCC Special Entry candidates are exempt from the AFCAT written examination and are called directly for AFSB testing. They must still satisfy the educational, age, marital-status and medical requirements for Flying Branch.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT GATE Score Entry 2027
content_sections.text: GATE Score Entry is available for eligible Aeronautical Engineer (Electronics) and Aeronautical Engineer (Mechanical) candidates. Candidates must possess a completed BE/B.Tech qualification in one of the accepted engineering disciplines and qualify in the corresponding prescribed GATE subject. The GATE result declaration date must fall between 1 January 2024 and 31 December 2027 , as specified in the notification. Applicants must provide their GATE score details and supporting qualification records. The entry is subject to the applicable shortlisting and AFSB selection procedures.

content_sections.heading: AFCAT Permanent Commission and Short Service Commission
content_sections.text: The extension of Ground Duty SSC service is subject to vacancies, service requirements, willingness, merit and suitability. The notification also states that SSC officers are not entitled to pension under the applicable commission terms. Grant of Permanent Commission at a later date is not automatic.

basic_details.job_title: HOCL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Executive Director & Unit-in-Charge Posts
basic_details.short_information: Hindustan Organic Chemicals Limited (HOCL), a Government of India Enterprise, is filling one Unreserved (UR) post of Executive Director & Unit-in-Charge on a regular basis, in the scale of pay of Rs. 120000-280000 (Grade E8 as per Pay Revision w.e.f 01.01.2017) with allowances as admissible under the company's rules. Applicants need a B.E. / B.Tech in one of the listed engineering disciplines and minimum 25 years of post qualification experience as an Executive. Applications are accepted only online through www.hoclindia.com; the portal will be open from 12 November 2026 to 25 November 2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age is 55 years as on 1 November 2026. Relaxation of age applies to SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/Ex-servicemen as per rules, but the maximum upper age of applicants shall not exceed 56 years including all possible age relaxations. The prescribed age limit does not apply to internal candidates. The notice adds that relaxations and reservations are applicable as per Government Directives.

qualification.details: B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical / Petrochemical / Petroleum / Mechanical / Electrical / Civil / Instrumentation Engineering. Qualifications should be from a recognized university / institution.

selection_process: Assessment will be made through personal interview only. Shortlisting of candidates for the selection process is at the discretion of the Company
and its decision is final and binding. Meeting the minimum qualification
experience and job requirement does not give a candidate any right to be called for document verification or interview. Candidates attend the interview at their own risk
and travelling expenses for appearing in the interview will be provided as admissible under the rules of the Company.
how_to_apply: Only applications submitted online through the HOCL website, www.hoclindia.com, will be considered. The online application portal will be open from 12 November 2026 to 25 November 2026, and 25 November 2026 is the last date for submitting the online application.
Visit www.hoclindia.com, read the notification and instructions, and open the link for filling the Online Application.
Enter all required details, writing your full name as it appears in the matriculation / secondary examination certificate.
Upload a passport size photograph (plain background, both ears visible) and your signature when prompted; the application will not be registered without them.
Upload proof of age, qualification (from standard X onwards) and experience (where required); the application will not be registered without them.
Preview the application and check that the photograph is uploaded properly with the face clear and identifiable.
Pay the application fee through electronic fund transfer as instructed in the link, and keep a copy of the e-receipt.
After the prompt that the application has been submitted successfully, take a print-out of the submitted application and produce it as and when called for.

The application fee is non-refundable and is paid through electronic fund transfer. Any charges for effecting online payment are borne by the candidate. Exemption is subject to furnishing documents in proof of eligibility for exemption along with the application.
Passport size photograph and signature
Proof of age and qualification (from standard X onwards)
Experience proof (where required)
Certificates issued by the Competent Authority, for candidates claiming relaxation / reservation
Documents in proof of eligibility for fee exemption (internal, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates)
Supporting documents of the employer's CTC and turnover (private sector candidates)
NOC from the employer at the time of interview, for candidates working in Government / Semi-Government / PSUs who do not apply through proper channel
E-receipt of the fee and a print-out of the submitted application, when asked for
All documents submitted by the applicant must be self-certified.
important_instructions: Candidates presently working in Government / Semi-Government / PSUs should apply through proper channel or produce an NOC from their employer at the time of interview. Applications without photographs as specified are liable to be rejected at any stage; candidates with an unidentifiable or improper photo upload will not be permitted to participate in the selection process. Furnishing wrong or false information will lead to disqualification; if found at any stage, even after joining, the candidature or appointment will be cancelled. Canvassing in any form during any stage of the recruitment process will lead to cancellation of candidature. The decision of the HOCL Management on eligibility and acceptance or rejection of applications is final and binding. Any corrigendum or update to the notification will be published only on www.hoclindia.com. The court of jurisdiction for any dispute is at Kochi.

content_sections.heading: About HOCL
content_sections.text: Hindustan Organic Chemicals Limited (HOCL) describes itself in the notice as a Government of India Enterprise. The advertised post of Executive Director & Unit-in-Charge is posted at Kochi, where the court of jurisdiction for any dispute about this recruitment also lies. The notice is signed by the Chief Manager (HR) and dated 11 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical / Petrochemical / Petroleum / Mechanical / Electrical / Civil / Instrumentation Engineering. Qualifications should be from a recognized university / institution. Minimum 25 years of post qualification experience as an Executive in PSUs or reputed/leading organizations. At least 5 years' experience during the last 10 years at a Senior Management level in Technical / Operations / Maintenance / Administration in a large industry, preferably a Chemical/Petrochemical/Refinery plant. Indian Nationals only need to apply. Candidates should be in employment at the time of applying for the post. Candidates working in Govt. / Semi-Government / PSUs should have minimum two years of experience in the immediate lower scale of the advertised post. External candidates from the private sector must work in a company having a minimum annual CTC of around Rs. 35 Lakhs with average audited annual turnover for the last 3 years of around Rs. 300 Crores. Supporting documents have to be submitted. Preference will be given to candidates from listed companies. Internal candidates who fulfil the requirements and apply will be considered along with other candidates; an internal candidate must have a minimum of one year service left as on the selection date. The relevant date for determining all eligibility criteria, such as qualification, experience and age, is 1 November 2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. The maximum age is 55 years as on 1 November 2026. Relaxation of age applies to SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/Ex-servicemen as per rules, but the maximum upper age of applicants shall not exceed 56 years including all possible age relaxations. The prescribed age limit does not apply to internal candidates. The notice adds that relaxations and reservations are applicable as per Government Directives.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be entitled to Pay and Allowances in the scale of pay of Rs. 120000-280000 (Grade E8 as per Pay Revision w.e.f 01.01.2017), as admissible under the rules of the company. The notice does not list the individual allowances or mention the in-hand salary. Appointment is on a regular basis. Posting will be at Kochi; the company at its discretion may depute the officer to any of its Offices / Projects anywhere in India as per its requirement. The engagement of the selected candidate is subject to being declared medically fit by the approved Hospital and by the Medical Officer of the Company.

content_sections.heading: HOCL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Exercise overall supervision and control over the departments and divisions under his/her jurisdiction. Implement policies, decisions and directives issued by the CMD, Board of Directors and corporate management. Ensure effective manpower planning, deployment and utilisation. Monitor discipline, attendance, performance and conduct of employees. Ensure proper coordination between various departments and units. Review the performance of subordinate officers and employees. Ensure achievement of organisational targets, production targets and operational objectives. Monitor operational efficiency, productivity and quality standards. Review progress of projects and major activities. Identify operational bottlenecks and take corrective measures. Ensure optimum utilisation of manpower, machinery, materials and other resources. Promote efficiency, innovation and cost reduction. Ensure proper utilisation of budgetary allocations. Monitor expenditure and financial performance. Exercise financial powers in accordance with the Delegation of Powers (DoP). Ensure transparency, accountability and financial discipline. Monitor internal audit observations and ensure timely compliance. Prevent irregular expenditure and financial losses. Ensure compliance with applicable Central/State Government rules, regulations and guidelines. Ensure implementation of CVC guidelines, vigilance instructions and applicable procurement procedures. Monitor compliance with labour laws, environmental laws, safety regulations and other statutory requirements. Ensure timely settlement of audit observations and inspection reports. Promote transparency and accountability in official functioning. Submit periodic reports to the CMD and corporate management. Review performance indicators and organizational targets. Report major operational, financial and administrative issues. Take appropriate decisions within delegated authority. Ensure implementation of decisions taken by the Board and corporate management.

content_sections.heading: DMRL JRF Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: To be eligible for DMRL JRF Recruitment 2026, candidates must meet the following conditions given in the notification: Applicants must be Indian nationals. Candidates must hold the essential educational qualification for the fellowship code they are applying for (see the qualification section below). Only candidates who have been awarded a Degree or Provisional Certificate (applicable for B.Tech. or M.Tech., as the case may be) are eligible to apply. A valid GATE score is essential for candidates having B.E. / B.Tech. The upper age limit is 28 years as on the closing date of the interview (relaxations apply as described below). Those who were already in JRF positions in any of the DRDO laboratories / Centres earlier are not eligible to apply again. Candidates serving in Govt. or Govt. owned organizations must produce an NOC from their respective Department / Employer at the time of interview, failing which they will not be allowed to appear for the interview, or they should apply through proper channels.

content_sections.text: Selected JRFs will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- plus HRA as per DRDO Rules. The post is temporary and the maximum tenure is four years. Initially, the offer is for a period of two years, which may be extended for a further two years subject to Internal Screening Committee recommendations. faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is conducted by the Defence Metallurgical Research Laboratory (DRDO DMRL), located in Hyderabad, Telangana, for filling up various temporary research fellowship positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DRDO DMRL JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 18 vacancies available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post across different engineering and science disciplines such as Metallurgy, Mechanical, Chemical, and Physics.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for JRF positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech or M.E./M.Tech degree in the relevant engineering discipline with a valid GATE score, or an M.Sc in Physics with a first division and a valid NET qualification.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years. Age relaxations are provided for reserved categories such as SC, ST, and OBC candidates in accordance with government guidelines.

faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 37,000/- along with House Rent Allowance (HRA) as per DRDO rules.

faq.answer: The last date for receiving the completed applications via email is 22-11-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their documents well before the deadline.

faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly via Email. Candidates need to download the excel sheet application form, fill it out, scan all required documents into a single PDF, and send them to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these fellowships?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their valid NET or GATE scores and academic percentages, followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates conducted at Hyderabad.

faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for applying to the Junior Research Fellow positions at DRDO DMRL.

content_sections.heading: About RITES
content_sections.text: RITES Limited is a Navratna Enterprise of the Government of India with its Corporate Office at Shikhar, Plot No. 1, Sector-29, Gurugram and its Registered Office at SCOPE Minar, Laxmi Nagar, Delhi. RITES is providing consultancy services for supervision of construction of the Twin Tube Uni-directional Aizawl Bypass Tunnel in Mizoram, and this post serves that assignment.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The notice asks applicants to follow these steps: Register on the RITES website http://www.rites.com in the registration format under Tab "Career" – Expert Registration – registration for Consultant/Expert. Take a print out of the registration. Fill in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-A), which is attached to the notice. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below. Submit the registration print out, the proforma and the documents in hard copy to the undersigned within 07 days from the date of publication. The notice is signed by B.K. Nanda, General Manager/HR-II, RITES Ltd. (Shikhar) Gurgaon. The letterhead gives the Corporate Office address as Shikhar, Plot No. 1, Sector-29, Gurugram-122 001 (India). The notice does not mention a postal mode or what to write on the envelope. Detailed CVs may also be mailed at [email protected] with contact details. The Annexure-A proforma asks for the Vacancy Circular No., the position applied for (Re-employment as Expert (Technical/Professional)), name, date of birth, qualification required against the applicant's qualification (documents to be attached), details of employment (updated CV to be attached), the organisation retired from with last designation/grade pay, last basic pay and grade at retirement (CDA/IDA pay scale), field of specialization and years of experience against the required experience, additional information (on a separate sheet), and Discipline & Appeal cases and vigilance status for the last five years. The applicant signs that he is liable to be disqualified if any information is found incorrect, incomplete or false.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The single post is Team Leader Cum Senior Tunnel Expert, VC No. 85/26 (E), with 1 position, open to retired Govt/PSU employees. Minimum: Graduate in Civil/ Mining Engineering or equivalent from a recognized university. Preferential: Post Graduate or chartered engineer in Mining Engineering/ Geotechnical Engineering/ Structural Engineering/ Rock Mechanics or equivalent. Total professional experience of at least 20 years. (i) Professional experience of at least 15 years in handling major tunnelling projects. (ii) Involvement of at least 10 years in construction/construction supervision of major Road/ Rail/ Metro tunnel projects. (iii) At least 5 years' experience as Team Leader/Resident Engineer/Project Manager or similar capacity in supervision of transportation tunnel projects of length equal to or more than 1.5 km. (iv) Should have handled, as Team Leader or similar capacity, at least two projects in Construction Supervision of transportation tunnels equal to more than 1.5 Km length. Preferential: Project preparation/ design experience of transportation Tunnel projects. Mandatory Requirement: INFRACON CV required. The notice explains "similar capacity" as follows: On behalf of Consultant: Team Leader / Resident Engineer/Professional Engineer/Charted Engineer (Construction Supervision/IE/AE). On behalf of Contractor: Project Manager/ Professional Engineer/Charted Engineer (Construction/ Construction Supervision). In Government Organizations: Superintending Engineer (or equivalent) and above. Only those projects where the input of the personnel is at least one year will be considered for evaluation under items (ii), (iii) and (iv). Unless otherwise mentioned, tunnel projects of length 1.5 km or more are considered major tunnel projects. Maximum 63 years as on 30 November 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Negotiable remuneration to be decided as per policy of the company on approval of CV by client. The appointment shall be purely on contractual basis initially for a period of one year, extendable until completion of the assignment subject to mutual consent and satisfactory performance. The actual deployment will be subject to approval of client. The posting location is Mizoram. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Along with the registration print out and the Annexure-A proforma, the notice asks for self-attested copies of: 2 recent passport size colour photographs High School certificate for proof of Date of Birth Certificates of Academic & Professional qualifications Detailed CV Pension Payment Order Service Certificate, Last Pay-slip, indicating last grade and basic pay drawn issued by the last employer PF No with the last employer Proof of Identity & Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving License, Aadhaar Card etc) PAN Card Proof of different periods of experience as claimed in the Application Form (if applicable) Any other document in support of candidature

content_sections.text: Those who have been imposed any major/minor penalties during the last 5 years of service are not eligible to apply. The notice includes Annexure-B, a self declaration by retired government employees on vigilance status: no current vigilance or CBI case and no pending disciplinary or prosecution proceedings, no major penalty from vigilance/CBI action in the last 10 years of service, and no minor penalty from such action in the last 5 years of service. Under Annexure-B, any discrepancy found may result in termination of the engagement without prior notice, and if the applicant's name is found in any Agreed or Secret list, the engagement may be terminated forthwith. Remuneration is decided only on approval of the CV by the client.

content_sections.heading: About Indian Bank
content_sections.text: Indian Bank describes itself in the notice as a leading Public Sector Bank and a Government of India undertaking, with headquarters in Chennai and a geographical presence all over India and abroad. Its Corporate Office is at 254-260, Avvai Shanmugam Salai, Royapettah, Chennai – 600014. The posts in this notice are for the bank's Information System Security Department (ISSD), which will use AI/ML capabilities to protect the bank's assets from AI enabled cyber threats.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 5 vacancies across three posts. The number of vacancies and the number of reserved vacancies are provisional and may vary according to the actual requirement of the Bank. The notice's "Out of which" columns for PwBD categories (VI, HI, OC, ID) show no posts for any of the three posts. The notice adds that there is no reservation for Ex-servicemen in Officers' Cadre, and that EWS vacancies are tentative and subject to further directives of the Government of India and the outcome of any litigation.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens. The cut-off date for age, educational qualification, certifications and post-qualification work experience is 01.11.2026 . Mandatory: B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (CSE) / Information Technology (IT) / Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) OR M.E. / M. Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (CSE) / Information Technology (IT) / Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE). Qualifications must be from a University / Institution / Board recognised by Govt. of India or approved by Govt. Regulatory Bodies. No equivalent educational qualification will be considered for eligibility. The certifications in full, as printed: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) and Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH). All stipulated certificates must be valid as on the cut-off date and active on the date of submission of the application and of the interview. Vice President - AI Cybersecurity: ISACA AAISM (Advanced in AI Security Management) / EC-Council COASP (Certified Offensive AI Security Professional) / GIAC GMLE (Machine Learning Engineer). Assistant Vice President - AI Cybersecurity and Associate Manager - Senior Officer- AI Cybersecurity: ISACA AAISM / EC-Council COASP / GIAC GMLE / CompTIA SecAI+. All three posts (preferable/desirable experience): designing / implementing / tuning / operating AI/ML enabled security monitoring / detection / incident response capabilities. The maximum age specified applies to General and EWS category candidates. Relaxation in the upper age limit is as follows: For ex-servicemen and commissioned officers, the release must be on completion of assignment (including those whose assignment is due to be completed within one year from the last date of receipt of application), otherwise than by way of dismissal or discharge on account of misconduct or inefficiency or physical disability attributable to military service or invalidment. Certificates for age relaxation must be submitted at the interview and at any later stage. SC / ST / OBC / PwBD certificates must be issued by the competent authority in the Government of India format; the caste name must match letter by letter with the Central List for the candidate's State/UT. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate must be issued on or after 01st April, 2026; candidates who fail to produce it at the interview will not be considered. Creamy layer OBC candidates, or those whose caste is not in the Central List, should indicate their category as General. EWS candidates must produce an Income & Asset Certificate based on gross annual income for Financial Year 2025-26 and valid for Financial Year 2026-27, on the date of interview; failing which they will not be considered. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Period of engagement: Fixed Term Employment (FTE) on contractual basis for an initial period of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years, to be renewed yearly or at shorter intervals subject to performance review and the needs and requirements of the Bank. Remuneration and perquisites: negotiable and not a limiting factor for deserving candidate. The notice does not print an amount. Leave: 30 days per calendar year on pro-rata basis; leave balance is not carried forward and leave encashment is not permitted. Termination: three months' notice or three months' fixed component of the compensation in lieu thereof, from either party, at the sole discretion of the Bank. Place of work: Chennai or as decided by the Bank. The engagement is not to be construed as an offer of employment or a regular employment in the Bank, and ends automatically on completion of the contractual period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Indian Bank Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format given as Annexure - A of the notice, pasting a recent passport size colour photograph signed across, and signing at the bottom of all pages (signature in CAPITAL LETTERS is not accepted). Pay the fee (Rs. 175/- for SC/ST/PwBD; Rs. 1000/- for all other candidates) through Internet Banking / NEFT / RTGS / UPI to Account Name: Indian Bank Recruitment Fee Collection Account, Account Number 7422772966, Indian Bank, Royapettah (Current Account), IFSC IDIB000R021. Write the Reference number / UTR Number of the payment in the application form. Enclose self-attested photocopies of the documents listed below. Put the application in a closed envelope superscribed "Application for the post of AI - Cybersecurity Specialist Officers for Information System Security Department (ISSD) on Contractual Basis - 2026". Send it to: Chief General Manager (CDO & CLO), Indian Bank, Corporate Office, HRM Department, Recruitment Section, 254-260, Avvai Shanmugam Salai, Royapettah, Chennai, Pin - 600 014, Tamil Nadu, so that it reaches on or before 1 December 2026. Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected. Optionally, send an advance signed and scanned copy of the application with supporting documents to [email protected] . A separate application and a separate fee payment are required for each post. Bank transaction charges for the fee are borne by the candidate. The fee is non-refundable. Proof of Date of Birth (the form asks for a copy of the SSC / Birth Certificate). Mark sheet and passing certificate of all Educational, Technical / Professional qualifications / Certifications. Experience certificate(s) specifying designation / job profile, period of service (with specific dates), emoluments and activity profile of previous and present employers; the certificate must specifically state experience in the related field. Photo Identity proof and Address proof.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be by (1) scrutiny of applications by a Screening Committee and (2) interview of shortlisted candidates by a Selection Committee. If the number of applicants is substantially large, a Written Test / Group Discussion / Preliminary interview process or a combination of these may be adopted. Only eligible candidates will be called for interview and intimated by email, and the Bank may send interview call letters to the registered email ID. Original certificates for educational qualifications, certifications, experience, age and category must be produced at the interview; otherwise the candidate will not be allowed for interview. Candidates working in Govt. / quasi-Govt. organisations and public sector banks / undertakings must produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview, and a proper discharge certificate before appointment. Requests to change contact number, address, email ID, interview centre, interview date and time or mode of interview will not be entertained. If a written test is held, scribe and compensatory time rules for persons with benchmark disabilities apply as set out in the notice.

content_sections.text: Applications without a proper visible passport size photograph, signature or fee payment details will be rejected. The Bank takes no responsibility for delay in receipt or loss in postal transit. Candidates must keep a valid personal email ID and mobile number active during the process. faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Indian Bank Corporate Office in Chennai on or before 1 December 2026; applications received after that date will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: All three posts need a B.E. / B.Tech. or M.E. / M. faq.answer: The notice states that remuneration and perquisites are negotiable and not a limiting factor for a deserving candidate; no amount is printed.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The non-refundable fee is Rs. 175/- for SC/ST/PwBD candidates and Rs. 1000/- for all other candidates, inclusive of GST, paid by Internet Banking / NEFT / RTGS / UPI to account number 7422772966 (IFSC IDIB000R021).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Send the Annexure - A application with self-attested documents and fee details in a closed envelope to the Chief General Manager (CDO & CLO), Indian Bank, Corporate Office, HRM Department, Recruitment Section, 254-260, Avvai Shanmugam Salai, Royapettah, Chennai, Pin - 600 014, Tamil Nadu.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is by scrutiny of applications by a Screening Committee and interview of shortlisted candidates by a Selection Committee; a written test, group discussion or preliminary interview may be adopted if applicants are substantially large.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is Fixed Term Employment on contractual basis for an initial period of 3 years, extendable up to 5 years, and is not a regular employment in the Bank.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, if you meet the eligibility for each post, but you must submit a separate application and pay a separate fee for each post.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Goa is located at Cuncolim, South Goa District, Goa. The Principal Investigator of the project is Dr. Harikumar M, Assistant Professor, Department of Civil Engineering. The notice lists these project objectives: Development of a novel hybrid geosynthetic system comprising coir geotextile and synthetic geogrid layers. Characterization and comparative evaluation of the developed hybrid geosynthetic. Assessment of the performance of hybrid geosynthetics in weak pavement subgrades under static and cyclic loading conditions. Development of an Artificial Neural Network based prediction model for effective field implementation of hybrid geosynthetic systems. Validation of laboratory findings through field-scale pavement test sections and correlation of laboratory and field performance behaviour.

rows.pay: Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA with other allowances as per the Institute norms

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification for the JRF post is B.Tech/B.E. or M.Tech./M.E. in the relevant specialization of Civil Engineering with GATE qualification obtained at some point in time. The candidate needs at least 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale grading system or 60% marks in aggregate from a recognized technical institute or university in a full-time program. For SC/ST candidates, the minimum is 6.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale grading system or 55% marks, with GATE qualification obtained at some point in time. Strong knowledge of Geotechnical Engineering, Pavement Engineering and Geosynthetics. Experience in laboratory testing of soils, geotextiles, geogrids and pavement materials. Exposure to Artificial Neural Networks, Machine Learning or predictive modelling techniques is desirable. Proficiency in software/tools such as MATLAB, Python, PLAXIS, ABAQUS, GeoStudio or similar engineering analysis software will be preferred. Ability to conduct field investigations, instrumentation and monitoring of pavement test sections. Good technical writing, research publication and communication skills.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly salary is Rs. 37,000 + 20% HRA, with other allowances as per the Institute norms. The position will be offered for 1 year initially, which can be further extended based on the performance review. After 2 years, the JRF position will be converted into SRF based on the performance review. The applicant may get a chance to enroll into the PhD program at NIT Goa, as per the Institute norms. The appointment is for a time bound project, and the selected candidate must join immediately. All terms and conditions are as per the guidelines of NTTM, Ministry of Textiles, GoI.

content_sections.heading: NPC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The assignment involves development of Schedule of Rates (SOR)/cost-estimation models for opencast coal mining and allied operations. The scope broadly covers overburden removal and rehandling, silt removal, ripping/blast-free excavation, coal extraction, loading and transportation at different leads, crushing, coal and material handling, equipment deployment, lighting and pumping, and hiring of HEMM/vehicles. The work involves field studies at mining locations, review of existing SORs/NITs/contracts and operational records, time/cycle-time studies, equipment productivity and utilisation assessment, diesel/fuel consumption norms, manpower and machinery requirements, cost analysis, benchmarking, development of cost models and formulation/validation of SORs. Provide mining domain guidance for the field studies at the opencast mines. Validate HEMM productivity, cycle-time, utilisation and fuel norms. Review mining conditions, leads, gradients and strip ratios. Interact with mine officials on technical matters. Assist in formulating and validating SOR items and lead/price variation mechanisms. Review technical deliverables. Participate in technical discussions/presentations as required. Build cost models for each SOR item (owning and operating cost, fuel, manpower, repairs, overheads, profit). Convert time-study and productivity data into rates at different leads. Formulate lead variation and price variation clauses. Benchmark with SORs of CIL subsidiaries. Prepare working sheets and calculations that are traceable and auditable. Prepare technical deliverables. Participate in technical discussions/presentations as required.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application in the Annex-AF proforma. Self-attested copies of requisite documents, and a latest photograph. Details of experience in the prescribed APPENDIX-I. Self-attested copy of proof of date of birth. Self-attested copy of Aadhaar. For a retired person: date of retirement, name of the office where last working, and a copy of the PPO.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications are first screened by a Screening Committee. Only shortlisted candidates are called for online/physical interaction before the Selection Committee. The Screening Committee screens the applications received. Incomplete applications will not be considered. The Selection Committee assesses qualification, relevant experience, subject knowledge, computer skills and communication skills. Candidates securing more than 80% marks will be granted the maximum remuneration, and those securing 60% to 80% marks will be granted 90% of the maximum, as per AI No. 858/2026. The notice does not give a date or venue for the interaction.

Provide counseling, guidance, and continuous support to rare disease patients and their caregivers. content_sections.heading: About ABV-IIITM
content_sections.text: ABV-IIITM, Gwalior is described in the notice as an autonomous institute under MHRD, Government of India. Its address is NH-10, Morena Link Road, Gwalior – 474015 (M.P.), India. The project is supervised by Dr. Saswata Roy, Assistant Professor, Department of Information Technology. The ExAID project aims to develop an Explainable Multimodal Deepfake Detection framework for identifying AI-generated and manipulated content. It combines deep learning models with Explainable AI techniques and an artificial thresholding mechanism. The project will also build a multilingual audio-visual deepfake dataset covering regional languages and different demographic groups, including children, men, women and elderly individuals. It will develop real-time detection through browser extensions and social media integration, and a web-based dashboard.

content_sections.text: DGRE describes itself as one of the premier laboratories of the Defence R&D Organization (DRDO). It is located at Him Parisar, Sector 37-A, Chandigarh, and is an ISO 9001:2015 certified establishment. The notice invites Indian citizen students with an excellent academic record to this paid internship, which the notice also calls the DRDO Paid Internship Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications are to be sent by Speed Post, in the prescribed format, to: The Director, Defence Geoinformatics Research Establishment (DGRE), Defence R&D Organization, Sector-37A, Chandigarh 160036, Kind Attention: To HRD Division. On top of the envelope, write clearly "Application for Paid Internship: Starting 1st January 2027". Also write the "Branch Code" (CSE, CIE or RS) on the envelope, for ease in segregation of applications. The form to use is the "Format for Application for DRDO Paid Internship Scheme" printed on page 4 of the notice, with the latest passport size photo affixed. The application must reach DGRE by 06 December 2026. Incomplete or erroneous applications, and those received after the due date, will be rejected. The notice also prints the email [email protected] beside the address, and a telephone number on the letterhead, 0172-2699804.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 internship places in total across Category (a) and Category (b). The internship must be a part of the student's degree course. The duration of the internship or project work is 06 months for every row, at DGRE, Plot No. 01, Sector 37-A, Chandigarh. Category (a), CSE and CIE: students pursuing B.Tech Final Year. Category (b), RS: students pursuing IInd Year M.Sc/ M.Tech. Minimum education as printed: pursuing Graduate/Post Graduate in Engineering and Science, full time course in the respective discipline from a recognized Indian University/Institute. Good academic record with 75% and above marks (or 7.5 CGPA and above) from an AICTE/UGC approved college or university. Applicants must be Indian citizens. Below 28 Years, for all posts. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. The stipend of Rs 5,000/- is applicable only when the student is present at the Lab for a minimum of 15 working days per month. Payment is made in two instalments: the first after 03 months and the second after completion of 06 months of internship. The stipend is paid directly to the student's bank account. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each branch, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application format has a checklist of documents to tick and enclose: Referral letter from the Principal/HOD/TPO of the college or institute, mandatorily attached; it is to be printed on college letterhead and signed, in the request format on pages 5 and 6 of the notice. UG/PG marksheet reflecting CGPA/% of marks for all previous semesters/years. Copy of latest Aadhar Card. Copy of College Identity Card. Latest passport size photo affixed on the form; the form also asks for the average CGPA or percentage and any awards or professional membership. Bonafide Certificate from the college. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from college authorities, in original, on college letterhead, stating that the student will be relieved for the internship at DGRE. Police verification from hometown or place of residence. Undertaking for adherence to Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923, and to the IT Rules and Regulations applicable for Ministry of Defence. Bank details for transfer of stipend. Aadhar Card in original with college ID card for verification, and 03 passport size photographs. All B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc previous semesters mark sheets in original, or a letter from the college certifying that the originals are held with them. Originals are returned immediately after verification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice states that selection is based on CGPA or percentage of marks and an interview or interaction, as required. The Principal/HOD/TPO of the institution should send a request letter for highly deserving meritorious students only. Eligible students will be selected based on CGPA of all previous semesters/percentage of marks of all previous semesters/years and online/telephonic interview/interaction as required, subject to satisfactory verification of the documents. Selection is entirely on merit basis/suitability for the project/assignment, after going through the applications and shortlisting candidates as per the vacancies. In case of tie, the marks of the lower examination are the tie-breaker. Selected students are notified about joining procedures only through email to the email ID given in the application form. No communication is made with rejected students.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The internship is for 06 months. A progress report is due after 3 months and a project report after 6 months or completion; DGRE then issues a certificate. If a student leaves in between, no Certificate of Completion is issued and no payment is made. No boarding, lodging, transport, medical or any other allowance is provided; these are borne by the student. DGRE/DRDO has no obligation to offer employment, and an intern cannot claim a right to employment on completing the internship. The management reserves the right to change the vacancy positions or selection criteria at any point during selection without assigning any reason. Mere applying or fulfilling the criteria does not ascertain candidature; suppression of facts leads to disqualification, and canvassing leads to cancellation of candidature. Working hours are as per the lab/Estt time. No leave except sick leave, with a valid prescription, is given. DGRE/DRDO is not responsible for any injuries sustained during the internship period. Selected students must report at DGRE, Sector-37 A, Chandigarh, and give an undertaking on secrecy, IT rules and non-publication of data, and that they are not being paid for any other internship.

The position sits in a project to develop and optimize practical methods for generating high-quality Gottesman-Kitaev-Preskill (GKP) states in photonic quantum computing. The work accounts for realistic experimental imperfections, resource constraints and their impact on fault-tolerant quantum information processing. The supervisor is Prof. Sanjib Dey of BITS Pilani and the co-supervisor is Prof. Anil Prabhakar of IIT Madras. The notice is dated 07/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send your CV to Prof. Sanjib Dey at [email protected] by 21st Nov, 2026. Only candidates meeting the stated qualification should apply. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for online interviews, and the interview schedule will be sent to them by email. Queries about the position can be emailed to the same address. The notice does not print an email subject line.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: M.Sc. in Physics or an equivalent degree in Physics / Engineering Physics / M.Tech. / M.E. / B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering or other allied disciplines from a recognized university / Institute, with minimum 60% aggregate marks or equivalent CGPA. Desired skills: knowledge of quantum mechanics, quantum optics or quantum information theory, along with basic programming skills (preferably Python) and an interest in theoretical and numerical research. Age limit: 28 Yrs. The notice prints no cut-off date for age and no relaxation. Annual contingency: ₹ 20,000/-. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi Senior Project Associate
content_sections.text: The position is in the laboratory of the Department of Gastroenterology & Human Nutrition at the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029; the notice is signed by Dr. Vineet Ahuja, MD, DM, Professor of the department. According to the notice, the laboratory has established patient-derived 3D intestinal organoid (colonoid) models for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), including ulcerative colitis (UC). The current project centres on developing autologous organoid co-culture systems incorporating Lamina Propria Mononuclear Cells (LPMCs) and Fibroblasts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice accepts any one of these three options: Four years Bachelor's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / Master's degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / BVSc / B.Pharma or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent OR Master's degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent OR Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma / MD / Master of Surgery from a recognized University or equivalent The notice numbers the experience lines (i) to (iii) in the same way as the qualification options: (i) Four years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology organization and Scientific activities and service. (ii) Two years' experience in R&D Industrial and academic institutions or S&T organizations and scientific activities and services. (iii) Nil Practical experience in at least two of the areas listed under the job description below (organoid and cell culture, characterization and assessment, molecular and genomic analysis) will be considered an added advantage. The notice gives the age limit as 40. It does not print a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS New Delhi Senior Project Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key responsibilities and technical competencies: Adult stem cell-derived human intestinal organoid culture, maintenance, and optimization Primary cell culture: fibroblast and lamina propria mononuclear cell (LPMC) isolation and characterization Co-culture model development and optimization (organoid + primary cell integration) Flow cytometry (FACS) - cell sorting, gating, population analysis Immunofluorescence and immunocytochemistry (ICC) staining Live-cell imaging and confocal microscopy Functional cell-based assays RT-qPCR and Western blotting/Multiplex protein assay scRNA-seq sample preparation and library prep Transcriptomics data interpretation

content_sections.text: Engineering Projects (India) Ltd. describes itself in the notice as a 'Mini Ratna' Central Public Sector Enterprise operating under the Ministry of Heavy Industries, Government of India. It executes multifaceted projects on a turnkey basis across the Power, Steel, Industrial, Civil and Infrastructure sectors. This recruitment is for its Project Coordination Office (PCO) at Bhubaneswar, with the place of posting shown as Talcher, Odisha.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: EPI is filling one post of Senior Manager - Electrical (E-4), reserved as UR-01. The essential qualification is B.E. /B.Tech or AMIE or equivalent qualification in Electrical (min 55% marks) . The qualification must be recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education, University Grant Commission and/or any other Statutory Authority/Board. Min. 09 yrs. post qualification executive experience. The gross drawn remuneration should not be less than Rs.7,20,000/- per annum in the candidate's last/current organization. This gross drawn remuneration must be for one year. Required experience: experience in Plant/Coal Handling Plant (CHP) and also in design/detail engineering or handled HT/LT Switchgears, HT/LT Transformers, HT/LT Motors, development Infrastructural Projects consisting of UPS, Lighting, Cable Engineering, Earthing & Lightning Protection System etc. Teaching/training/consultancy/Freelancing experience shall not be treated as relevant experience. Post qualification experience is counted from the date of result/issuance of the mark sheet, which is treated as the date of acquiring the qualification; no relaxation is given on this account. Knowledge in the field of estimation of bill of quantities and basic cost estimation based on Central/State PWD/CPWD rates. Experience in the field of analysis of market rates and preparation of construction schedule. Experience in quality control/quality assurance. The upper age limit is 42 years. The cut-off date for the age limit and post qualification experience is the date of the walk-in interview, 17 November 2026. The notice states that upper age relaxation, as per Presidential Directives, is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC(NCL) and 10 years for PWD applicants for reserved posts. As this post is unreserved (UR-01), SC/ST/OBC(NCL) candidates may apply against it if they wish, but age relaxation will not be allowed to them against unreserved posts. Percentage must be stated without rounding off; only the percentage in the consolidated mark sheet is considered. Without a consolidated mark sheet, the average of all semesters/years is taken. Where the university gives no conversion formula, a minimum CGPA of 6 on a 10-point scale is treated as 60%; other scales are prorated. Where the university provides a conversion, the equivalent percentage as per its norms must be shown, and a certificate to this effect may be required at verification/interview. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

Provident Fund benefits as per the Employees Provident Fund Act, 1952. Medical: employees take a self-medical insurance on their own and are entitled to reimbursement of a maximum premium of Rs.3000/- per annum. Gratuity as admissible. An annual increment of 3% is admissible on completion of each year of service, subject to satisfactory performance. The contract is initially for one year and further extendable up to three years, subject to satisfactory performance and organizational requirements. Selected candidates will be required to serve anywhere in India as per the requirement and operational priority of the Company.

content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India. Age, essential qualification and experience are counted on the last date of submission of application. Or PhD in Chemistry with 2 years' experience. Or Masters/Integrated Masters in Chemical Engineering with 2 years' experience. Or Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering with 3 years' experience. application_fee.general_fee: Rs. 100 + applicable postal charges (paid by challan at a post office) or Rs. 100 + applicable service charges (online)

Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both. | Candidates must hold the qualification from a recognised university or institution. A certificate given by a college principal is not accepted in place of the marksheets and degree certificate. Where the university shows no percentage on the marksheet, the candidate must give the formula for calculating it. A degree or experience from a foreign university needs proof of its validity or equivalency in India, within the time limit.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by a preliminary test followed by an interview. Candidates are called for interview after scrutiny of applications, in order of preliminary test merit. The medium is Gujarati unless the Commission decides otherwise. The test is generally held at Gandhinagar/Ahmedabad, and candidates attend at their own expense. A candidate scoring less than 15% in the preliminary test is not eligible for the interview. A Consent Form and Consent Deposit may be taken for appearing in the exam, with detailed instructions published later. The syllabus is on gpsc.gujarat.gov.in and gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in. For 4 or more vacancies, the number of candidates called for interview is 3 times the number of vacancies or 20, whichever is higher. The interview carries 100 marks. Final selection is on 50% weight of the preliminary test marks (out of 300) and 50% weight of the interview marks (out of 100): preliminary marks x 50/300 plus interview marks x 50/100. The final result will be published within 10 working days after the interview is completed.

content_sections.heading: NEDFL Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager-Dairy Plant Job Description
content_sections.text: Monitor processing, quality, maintenance, and dispatch parameters to ensure quality output at minimum cost while adhering to food safety through SOPs. Process milk and milk products by monitoring FAT and SNF input and output to minimize solid loss. Review plant operations continuously and suggest measures for improved productivity. Ensure strict maintenance of product quality and adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Hygiene Practices (GHP). Maintain industrial relations, ensure preventive maintenance to minimize breakdowns, and manage pouch milk processing/packaging alongside products like Lassi, Butter Milk, Dahi, Paneer, and Sweets. Work with QA to release products according to specifications, oversee production, QC, and maintenance, and manage inventory of raw materials, packing materials, and finished goods. Facilitate ISO audits, ensure timely statutory requirements, plan and supervise subordinate staff, and monitor civil, mechanical, and electrical project works. Provide technical assistance to dairy infrastructure including BMC centers and arrange employee training.

content_sections.heading: About MSDMA
content_sections.text: The Meghalaya State Disaster Management Authority is part of the Government of Meghalaya and works under the Revenue and Disaster Management Department. Its office is at Lower Lachaumiere, Shillong. Both posts are in its Mitigation Project Management Division (MPMD), which deals with structural mitigation projects funded under NDMF/SDMF.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The form is titled "Application Form for Specialist/Assistant in the Meghalaya State Disaster Management Authority (MSDMA)". It asks for: the post applied for and a recent passport-size photograph; your name in capital letters, your father's, mother's or spouse's name, sex, date of birth and age; your date of retirement, and your designation and department at retirement (if applicable); your category (SC/ST/OBC/General/Any Other), contact addresses and present occupation; your education and experience, both in reverse chronological order. The experience part covers the period (From/To), nature of work and accomplishments; trainings, publications (if any) and any other information; references (name, designation, institution, address, e-mail and phone number); a signed and dated declaration. In it you confirm that your information is correct and that the Selection Committee will check your documents for Essential Qualification and Work Experience at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: No other allowances will be paid on top of the fixed monthly amount for either post. Both posts are based at SDMA, Shillong. Experience: at least 1 year in the field, with knowledge of AutoCAD. rows.pay: Fixed amount of Rs. 65,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: MSDMA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Provide technical expertise in the planning, design, and implementation of structural mitigation projects funded under NDMF/SDMF. Preparation of Project Pre-Feasibility Reports including cost estimates. Conducting technical assessments, including geotechnical and hazard-specific studies, and recommend safe, resilient design solutions. Design of appropriate mitigation measures. Prepare/review/vet DPRs, drawings, and technical specifications for compliance with BIS/NBC/NDMA standards. Support quality control and monitoring during project execution. Document best practices, case studies, and technical reports for resilient infrastructure. Provide technical inputs for capacity-building workshops on structural mitigation and resilient construction practices. Any other matters as required by SDMA. To assist the Structural/Infrastructure Mitigation Specialist as per the scope of work. Any other matters as required by SDMA.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed form at Annexure-I, with a recent passport-size photograph. Your resume. Self-attested copies of the relevant documents, including those for Essential Qualification and Work Experience.

content_sections.text: An Interview Committee makes the selection for both posts, and its decision is final and binding on all candidates. Your documents for Essential Qualification and Work Experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: SMC Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: SMC will prepare a waiting list of candidates who meet the prescribed qualification, to fill the currently vacant posts by direct recruitment. Considering the number of applications received, the Municipal Commissioner will decide whether written, practical or oral interview stages are held; his decision is final. The final selection list and waiting list are prepared on the decisions of the Staff Selection Committee under the recruitment rules for each cadre. Candidates attend any test at the place fixed by the Appointment Authority at their own cost; SMC pays no travel expense. If candidates have equal merit, the older candidate gets priority; if age is also equal, educational merit decides.

SC or ST candidates: caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Gujarat Government. SEBC candidates: Non-Creamy Layer certificate in the Gujarati format of Annexure-4, valid for the financial year and the next three, issued on or after 01-04-2024 and not after the last date. An English Annexure-A certificate is not accepted. EWS candidates: eligibility certificate in the Gujarati format (Annexure-G) issued by the Government of Gujarat, valid for three years and issued by the last date. PwD candidates: disability certificate and UDID (Unique Disability Identity Card). Married women: marriage registration certificate or Government Gazette copy to apply under the husband's name. Candidates in government, semi-government or company service: No Objection Certificate; training or service details; EPIC, PAN card and Aadhaar copies. Originals and one attested copy are submitted at document verification, not at the time of applying.
