content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The payment for services is a fixed monthly amount per post (shown in the vacancy table). The notice also states: Tentative project/work duration is 12 months for each post; the initial tenure of engagement is 12 months, extendable based on the performance of the individual and/or requirement of the project. The engagement may be extended by one year at a time, on the same project only, subject to a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on Key Performance Indicators. No extension is given beyond the age of 65 years. Where the contract is for more than one year, remuneration may be reviewed annually, based on the escalation received in the client's fee for the previous year. Payment is released within one week after completion of the month, based on attendance registered. There are no statutory benefits such as PF/ESI/Gratuity. Income Tax is deducted at source with TDS certificates issued; Goods and Service Tax, as applicable, is admissible to the consultant. Leave is 1.5 days per completed month, with no accumulation beyond a calendar year; absence up to one month may be considered without remuneration. Women consultants may be eligible for maternity leave under the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017. No TA/DA is admissible for joining the assignment or on its completion. The Individual Consultant has the legal status of an Independent Consultant and is not a staff member or official of RITES Limited; the appointment is of a temporary nature. RITES may terminate the contract at any time without notice or reason, but in the normal course gives one month's notice; the consultant must also give one month's notice to resign.

Knowledge of Government procurement procedures, General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, and contract management. Master's Degree in Civil Engineering/ Law/ Management from a recognized University/Institution. Prior working experience in Govt./Training Institute/Disaster Management. Fluency in written and spoken Hindi and English is required. The upper age limit is a maximum of 62 years; the notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full Terms of Reference.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration, allowances and leave entitlements are as per the provisions laid down in MoF, DoE OM No. 3-25/2020,E.III.A dated 09/12/2020. The notice adds that the remuneration may commensurate with the qualifications, experience and profile of the candidate. The consultancy is initially for 1 year and extendable up to a maximum of 5 years. The engagement is full-time, and the Sr. Consultant shall not take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy in NIDM. The Sr. Consultant reports to the Executive Director, NIDM, and shall complete the assigned tasks in a time-bound manner.

content_sections.heading: NIDM Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The Terms of Reference list these tasks for the post: Supervise, monitor and coordinate all works for construction, repair, maintenance and upkeep of the upcoming project of the DRR Museum building and café at NIDM, covering civil, electrical, plumbing and other infrastructure works, timely completion, quality control and regular maintenance of the building and its facilities. Oversee the maintenance and upkeep of the Institute's buildings, campus infrastructure and allied facilities. Supervise the operation and maintenance of electrical, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, fire safety, water supply, sewage and other utility systems. Monitor the execution of annual maintenance contracts (AMCs), comprehensive maintenance contracts (CMCs) and other maintenance works, ensuring compliance with contract terms and conditions. Inspect maintenance works regularly and ensure timely rectification of defects and breakdowns. Coordinate with CPWD, local authorities, service providers, contractors and other agencies for maintenance-related matters. Prepare estimates, technical specifications, maintenance schedules, work orders and inspection reports for routine and special maintenance works. Assist in procurement of maintenance-related materials, equipment and services in accordance with the General Financial Rules (GFR), 2017, and other applicable Government instructions. Maintain records relating to maintenance activities, assets, inspections, repairs, complaints, inventories and contract performance. Ensure compliance with safety standards, statutory requirements, environmental regulations, and fire and electrical safety norms applicable to the Institute. Monitor housekeeping, sanitation, landscaping, waste management and upkeep of common areas. Coordinate preventive and periodic maintenance of Institute assets to ensure uninterrupted functioning of essential services. Prepare periodic reports on maintenance activities, expenditure, pending works and the condition of Institute assets for submission to the Competent Authority. Attend to emergency maintenance requirements and coordinate prompt restoration of essential services. Any other task assigned by the Executive Director, NIDM/Reporting Officer. Promoting the vision of NIDM; advising, leading and supervising; formulating concepts and strategies; managing resources. Demonstrating and safeguarding ethics and integrity; displaying cultural, gender, religion and age sensitivity and adaptability. Ability to work in a team situation and engage diverse stakeholders; ability to plan, organize, implement and report on work. Inter-personal and communication skills; proactive engagement and dialogue; strategic advice and communication; excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proficiency with MS office suite and other software.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIDM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check the eligibility criteria in the Terms of Reference before applying. Apply online through the Google form link printed in the notice (see Important Links). Submit the application on or before 25 November 2026, up to 23:59:59 hrs. For queries, contact NIDM on Tel: 011-20873404 or email [email protected] . The notice names no documents to be uploaded or enclosed.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Depending on the number of applications received, NIDM may fix the shortlisting/selection criteria. Only shortlisted candidates may be informed, through email or telephone, and called for a written test or personal interaction. No TA/DA is paid for attending the written test or personal interaction. The notice gives no date or venue for these.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: NIDM reserves unfettered right to accept/reject any/all applications without assigning any reasons. The Sr. Consultant is governed under NIDM's procedure and guidelines for engagement of consultants. The engagement is temporary in nature, and NIDM can terminate it at any time without prior notice and without providing any reason. In the normal course it gives 45 days notice, and the consultant can also seek termination on giving 45 days notice to NIDM. All matters related to termination are handled by the Admin Section, irrespective of Division.

content_sections.heading: About the Office
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs & Trade Marks as an office under the Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry. It is responsible for the grant of patents and the registration of designs, trade marks, copyright, geographical indications and layout designs of integrated circuits. It also advises the Government on Intellectual Property Rights matters and runs training, capacity building and public outreach programmes. Its office is at Bouddhik Sampada Bhawan, Plot No. 32, Sector 14, Dwarka, New Delhi-110078.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: CGPDTM has advertised 5 positions in total. The notice marks each number with an asterisk and says the competent authority reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of vacancies. It prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: Master degree in Sciences, or LLM with Graduation in Sciences, or BE/BTech, from an institute of national importance or equivalent reputed Institution/University. Desirable: Ph.D. in Sciences/IPR Management, or MTech/MS. Experience: at least 15 years in handling IPR matters. Upper age: 65 years. Essential: Master degree in Sciences, or BE/B. Tech, or MBA, from an institute of national importance or equivalent reputed Institution/University. Desirable: (a) Ph.D. in Sciences/Law; or (b) professional working knowledge of IPR management, or MTech, M.Sc. with working knowledge in IPR and policy matters. Knowledge of MS Office, PowerPoint presentations with graphs, infographic displays, trend analysis and data governance and quality assessment software tools is preferred; or (c) LLB/LLM, or Degree/Diploma in IPR (full time, at least 1 year), or training and development experience from a reputed institution. Experience: at least 3 years in handling IPR matters. Upper age: 48 years. Essential: Graduation/Post-graduation in Law, or MBA in international business with domain knowledge in required areas, from an institute of national importance or equivalent reputed Institution/University. Desirable: Ph.D. in Law & IP field. Experience: at least 1-year Law & IP field research experience, preferably in IPR matters. The notice adds that the individual should have knowledge of handling legal work, drafting of rules, regulations and replies in court matters. Upper age: 35 years. Essential: MBA or PGDM (full time, 2 years course) in the discipline of Finance from an institute of national importance or equivalent reputed Institution. Desirable: higher qualification in the field of finance. Experience: at least one-year relevant experience, preferably in a government department/institution/office. Upper age: 35 years. Only post-qualification experience gained after completing the minimum essential qualification for the post applied is counted as effective experience. Experience also includes up to 3 years for Ph.D. holders, provided no other work experience is counted during those three years. Candidates who applied under the public notice dated 01.02.2026 or 05.05.2026 need not reapply, as they remain ineligible for the current recruitment year. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice lists the remuneration per month as ₹1,25,000 for the Consultant, ₹90,000 for each Research Associate and ₹70,000 for each Young Professional. An annual increment of 10% is granted subject to completion of the period with satisfactory performance. If a contract runs beyond one year, the remuneration may be reviewed annually on the recommendation of a Review Committee. The engagement is initially for one year and is extendable up to 03 years, one year at a time, subject to a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on Key Performance Indicators. No extension will be granted after three years. Payment is released within one week after the month ends, based on biometric attendance or on certification by the concerned Head of Office for staff placed at another location. Tax is deducted at source and a TDS Certificate is issued. GST, as applicable, is admissible to the contractual staff. Working hours are normally 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM on working days. Staff may be asked to sit late or attend on Saturdays, Sundays and other holidays. Paid leave is 1.5 days for each completed month. Accumulation beyond a year may not be allowed. Absence up to one month for a valid reason may be considered without remuneration. Women contractual staff may be considered for maternity leave of up to 26 weeks, without pay. For domestic tours approved by the competent authority, air travel in Economy class or rail in AC Two Tier is allowed. Hotel up to Rs. 2250 per day, taxi up to Rs. 338 per day for travel within the city, and food up to Rs. 900 per day are allowed as per Government of India Level-10 eligibility.

content_sections.text: Go to the website http://www.ipindia.gov.in . Only Indian nationals may apply. Submit the application online. Online applications open on 6 November 2026. Complete the online submission by 16 November 2026, the closing date. Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected. The notice does not describe the individual steps of the online form. For queries, the letterhead gives the telephone number +911125300205 and the email [email protected] . Qualification testimonials, which are verified before the interview on the same day. Experience certificate, verified in the same way.

content_sections.text: All four posts are filled through an interview. Eligible candidates whose online applications are scrutinised are called for it. Final selection is based on interview performance and verification of the documents submitted. If a selected candidate does not join within the given time or resigns after joining, the offer goes to the next candidate in the merit list. The final merit list is valid for 1 year. The same procedure is printed separately for the Consultant post and for the Research Associate and Young Professional posts. The interview will be held at the Office of Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks, Bouddhik Sampada Bhawan, Plot No. 32, Sector 14, Dwarka, New Delhi-110078. content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Vacancy 2026 - 41 Posts
content_sections.text: CPCL has advertised 41 vacancies across eight position codes . Chemical Engineering has the highest number of posts with 22 vacancies. The advertised total includes two backlog vacancies. *Reservation Note: ST and OBC totals for Engineer (Chemical) include one backlog vacancy each. PwBD reservation is horizontal and included within the advertised vacancies. The notification specifies certain carried-forward PwBD reservations for Chemical, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, while one Information Systems Officer position is earmarked for hearing disability.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria

The exact degree, minimum marks and experience requirements depend on the selected position. Important: The Manager and Senior Manager designations share one vacancy under CPCL08. The grade of appointment will be decided by CPCL based on the applicant's eligibility, experience, suitability and selection performance. The relaxed marks requirement is not available indiscriminately for every discipline. For example, the Civil Engineer vacancy permits 55% for eligible SC candidates against reserved positions, while the sole Instrumentation Engineer post has a 60% requirement without a separately notified reserved-category marks concession. Marks Calculation: CPCL calculates aggregate percentage using marks obtained in all subjects across all semesters or years. Fractions are ignored; 59.99% does not meet a 60% requirement. Candidates need a first-class Engineering or Technology degree in Chemical, Petroleum or Petrochemicals with at least 60% aggregate marks, subject to the notified concession for eligible reserved candidates. At least two years of post-qualification experience in relevant process units is mandatory, preferably in refining, chemical, petrochemical, fertilizer or hydrocarbon-processing industries. Exposure to commissioning, start-up, shutdown, troubleshooting, DCS, P&IDs, HAZOP and safety practices is advantageous. A first-class Mechanical Engineering/Technology degree and at least two years of post-qualification experience in a process industry are required. Experience with static and rotary mechanical equipment such as pumps, compressors, heaters, columns and exchangers is relevant. Maintenance planning, inspection and condition-monitoring knowledge are advantageous. Candidates need an Electrical or Electrical and Electronics Engineering/Technology degree with the prescribed minimum marks and two years of relevant post-qualification experience. Experience involving LT/HT motors, transformers, breakers, electrical control panels, switchgear and maintenance systems is relevant to the post. Applicants must possess a first-class Civil Engineering/Technology degree and at least two years of relevant post-qualification experience in process units, preferably in refining, petrochemicals, chemicals, fertilizers or hydrocarbon processing. Structural design, civil erection, project monitoring, rate analysis, tendering and contract management experience are advantageous. Candidates need an Engineering/Technology degree in Instrumentation, including Electronics and Instrumentation, with at least 60% aggregate marks. Two years of post-qualification experience in a relevant process industry, particularly maintenance of instrumentation, analysers and DCS/PLC control systems, is mandatory. content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Salary 2026

In addition to basic pay, eligible employees receive Industrial Dearness Allowance, HRA, cafeteria allowance, conveyance maintenance, performance-related pay, provident fund, gratuity, medical benefits, leave travel benefits and other applicable allowances under CPCL rules. No pay protection is admissible under the notified conditions.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 500 for General, EWS and OBC-NCL candidates . SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from payment. Payment Mode: SBI e-pay using Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI or Net Banking, as available through the application facility. Payment Deadline: 3 December 2026. The fee is non-refundable, except for applicable reversal of duplicate deductions caused by technical issues as described in the portal instructions. Additional bank charges, if any, must be borne by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process differs between Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07 and CPCL08. Applicants should prepare according to the assessment pattern applicable to their chosen position. Computer Based Test (CBT). Shortlisting based on CBT performance. Group Discussion / Group Task. Personal Interview. Document Verification. Pre-Employment Medical Examination. Computer Based Test (CBT). Skill Test. Personal Interview. Document Verification. Medical Examination. Manager/Senior Manager (Secretarial) candidates will be shortlisted based on qualification, experience and overall suitability, followed by Group Discussion/Group Task and Personal Interview. content_sections.text: The CBT for Post Codes CPCL01 to CPCL07 consists of 120 objective questions carrying 120 marks , with a duration of two hours. The General Aptitude section covers: Verbal Ability General Knowledge Reasoning and Logical Deduction Numerical Ability

content_sections.text: Visit the official CPCL website at www.cpcl.co.in . Open the Careers or Recruitment section. Find . Open the official Executive Recruitment application link. Read the instructions and accept the declaration checkbox. Click Continue . Select the eligible position from the Post Applying for dropdown. Enter the required basic personal information. content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the documents requested by the application portal and produce original supporting certificates during document verification. Educational degree certificates and all relevant marksheets. Class 10 or Higher Secondary certificate for age verification. Relevant post-qualification work experience certificates. Valid photo identity proof. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS certificate, where applicable. PwBD disability certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen certificate, where applicable. ICSI Associate Membership and examination records for CPCL08. Relevant degree specialization evidence, where required. Official CGPA-to-percentage conversion proof, where applicable. No Objection Certificate for eligible Government/PSU employees. Additional documents requested by CPCL for verification. The final upload requirements should be checked against the Executive Recruitment application instructions and the applicable fields before submission.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Reservation and Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: Reservation is available according to Government of India rules and the post-wise allocation in the notification. Candidates claiming OBC Non-Creamy Layer reservation must possess a valid Central Government format certificate issued by the competent authority on or after 1 April 2026 . OBC candidates belonging to the creamy layer are not eligible for OBC-NCL reservation benefits. Applicants claiming EWS reservation must provide the prescribed Income and Asset Certificate issued by the competent authority on or after 1 April 2026 . PwBD reservation applies only to identified functional disability categories suitable for each post. Eligible candidates must possess the prescribed disability certificate. As CPCL operates hazardous industrial facilities, the notification specifies post-wise functional requirements and identified disability categories. Applicants must check the relevant table on pages 3 and 4 before claiming suitability or reservation.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Executive Admit Card and CBT Examination 2026
content_sections.text: CPCL will make CBT admit cards available through its recruitment website. The tentative release period is approximately 10 days before the examination . Candidates will be required to download the call letter using the prescribed login credentials and follow the instructions regarding photograph, original photo ID and other documents. Admit cards will not be sent by post. The CBT is tentatively scheduled for December 2026 or January 2027, with Chennai as the proposed examination location.

content_sections.heading: About IPRCL
content_sections.text: Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Limited is a Joint Venture Company between 11 Major Ports under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, which hold 90% of the equity, and Rail Vikas Nigam Limited under the Ministry of Railways, which holds 10%. It was set up to provide efficient rail evacuation systems to Major Ports and to raise their capacity and throughput. It was registered on 10th July 2015 as a Public Limited Company under the Companies Act, 2013. Its Corporate Office is in Mazgaon, Mumbai, and its Registered Office is in Lodhi Road, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens. The crucial date for eligibility with reference to age, essential educational qualification and length of experience is 04.12.2026. Full time Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognized University. The educational qualification is not applicable for candidates applying on deputation. Required experience: Execution of Infrastructure Projects. Only experience gained after the minimum educational qualification counts towards eligibility. Preferred experience: working in Railway Electric Traction Projects, General Power Supply Projects, Air Conditioning, Building electrifications, Roads Lightings etc. Officers should be presently working on regular basis (on absorption) or on contract basis in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports, JV Companies under Govt. Control or a Private Company, subject to the following: CDA scale officers: working in PB-3 (15600-39100) + GP 6600/- (pre-revised 6th CPC), revised to matrix level 11 under 7th CPC; OR working in PB-2/3 + GP Rs. 4800/5400 (pre-revised 6th CPC), revised to matrix level 8/9 under 7th CPC, with minimum 04 years in Group 'A' or minimum 08 years of Group 'B' service in the grades. IDA scale officers: working in IDA scale Rs. 32900-58000 (pre-revised 2nd PRC), revised to 80000-220000 under 3rd PRC, with minimum 08 years of Managerial/Executive level service; OR working in IDA scale Rs. 29100-54500 (pre-revised 2nd PRC), revised to 70000-200000 under 3rd PRC, for a period of 02 years and with minimum 8 years of Managerial/Executive level service. Deputation, regular CDA officers: working in Senior Scale, i.e. PB-3/GP 6600 (pre-revised 6th CPC) revised to matrix level 11 (7th CPC), with 05 years of Group A service; or in Senior Scale with 8 years of Group B service; or GP 5400 with 11 years in Group B service. Private company officials: working at the level of JGM equivalent and above with a minimum gross salary of at least Rs.1.25 lacs per month; Managerial level service experience of at least 12 years; and working in a company engaged in Execution of Infrastructure Projects/Railway works whose Sales Turnover for the preceding year is at least Rs. 200 Crs. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: On Absorption: IDA Scale of pay Rs. 80000-220000/- + Applicable Allowances + PRP (for IDA as per Policy). On Deputation: Parent Pay & Allowances + Deputation Duty Allowance + Other Allowances applicable to deputationist as per Company Policy. Posting is tentatively at Mumbai or Bhubaneswar, but the officer can be posted anywhere in India.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IPRCL Joint General Manager (Electrical) - E5
content_sections.text: Fill the application in Annexure-II if applying on absorption, or Annexure-III if applying on deputation. Both forms are in the notice. Fill every column; an application form with a blank column may be rejected. Affix a recent passport size photograph on Annexure-II. Attach the self-attested enclosures listed in Para 20 (see the list below). Write on top of the envelope: "Application for the post of ________" (the post name). Send it by post or courier, or drop it personally, to: Chief General Manager (HR), Indian Port Rail & Ropeway Corporation Ltd (IPRCL), 4th Floor, Nirman Bhavan, Mumbai Port Trust Building, M.P. Road, Mazgaon (E), Mumbai- 400010. Candidates serving in Railways, other Govt. departments, Central PSUs, Ports or JV Companies under Govt. Control must send the application through proper channel only, with photocopies of their last 05 years APARs. Submit the application by 04.12.2026. IPRCL will not be responsible if an application is not submitted by the last date for any reason. Matriculation Certificate (for age proof). Certificates and mark-sheets in support of the required educational/professional qualifications. Experience certificates clearly showing the length and field of experience. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection involves a Personal Interview. Suitable candidates will be shortlisted on their eligibility/experience in the relevant field and may be called for interview. Where there are 05 or more eligible candidates for each vacancy, IPRCL reserves the right to shortlist in the ratio of 1:5. The interview may be held at the Corporate Office of IPRCL, through V.C., or at any other location at IPRCL's discretion. Interview intimation will be sent through e-mail/IPRCL website; candidates should keep checking the website rather than wait for e-mail. A candidate whose identity is in doubt, who cannot produce the documents, whose documents mismatch or who is found ineligible will not be allowed to appear in the interview, and the candidature will be cancelled. faq.question: What is the selection process for IPRCL Recruitment 2026?

faq.question: Can private company employees apply for IPRCL Manager (Electrical) posts?

faq.question: What is the tenure of the IPRCL deputation appointment?

content_sections.text: Applicants must possess a recognized Bachelor's degree in the prescribed engineering branch and must have qualified in the corresponding GATE 2025 paper. Qualifications must have been obtained from Indian universities or institutions recognized by UGC, AICTE or the appropriate statutory authority. Important: Degrees regarded as equivalent, or degrees combining branches other than those specifically notified, will not be accepted merely on the basis of claimed equivalence. The final aggregate percentage is calculated using the marks of all years, semesters or trimesters. Rounding up is not permitted; candidates must meet the exact prescribed percentage. SC/ST candidates applying against unreserved vacancies must satisfy the unreserved qualification standard without claiming the reserved-category marks relaxation. Yes. All applicants must have qualified in GATE 2025 in the paper corresponding to their notified engineering discipline. No. Candidates must have passed the prescribed qualification by 1 November 2026 . Applicants awaiting final results after that date are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for the Graduate Executive Trainee recruitment is 30 years for UR/EWS, 33 years for OBC-NCL and 35 years for SC/ST candidates as on 1 November 2026. In all applicable relaxation cases, the maximum age must not exceed 58 years as on the crucial date. Candidates must possess the prescribed category or disability certificates.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Graduate Executive Trainees will be inducted in E-2 Grade with a basic pay of Rs. 50,000 per month during their one-year training period. The approximate annual CTC is Rs. 14.50 lakh . After successfully completing the one-year training programme, GETs will be absorbed into E-3 Grade , with a pay scale of Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,80,000 and an initial basic pay of Rs. 60,000 per month. Other notified benefits include medical treatment for employees and eligible dependants, group insurance, applicable annual performance-related pay and residential accommodation at standard rent, subject to availability and company rules. Salary Clarification: The CTC is an approximate annual compensation figure, not monthly take-home pay. The advertised basic pay should not be presented as the final net salary after deductions.

rows.after_training: 30% of Basic Pay + DA, as Notified

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Service Agreement Bond 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Graduate Executive Trainees must execute a service agreement bond of Rs. 3,00,000 at joining. The three-year service obligation applies after completion of the one-year training period . Candidates should understand this commitment before accepting an appointment.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 854 for UR, EWS and OBC-NCL candidates and Rs. 354 for SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen candidates . Payment Mode: Online through the State Bank of India E-Collect facility as instructed on the NLCIL application portal. Fee Payment Deadline: 14 December 2026 at 11:45 PM. The fees are non-refundable. Applicable banking service charges, if any, are additional.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of GATE 2025 score evaluation carrying 80 marks and a Personal Interview carrying 20 marks , for a total of 100 marks. Eligible candidates will be shortlisted separately for each recruitment area based on their GATE 2025 marks, generally in a ratio of 1:6 or 1:10 against the notified vacancies, as applicable. The merit list for Area-1, Area-2, Area-3 and Area-4 will be prepared independently, ensuring the applicable reservation provisions. The final merit list will be prepared using the total marks obtained out of 100, combining the weighted GATE 2025 score and Personal Interview marks. If candidates obtain equal final scores at the cut-off, the older candidate will be placed higher. If the tie continues, the alphabetical order of the candidate's first name will be considered.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Recruitment 2026 Posting Locations
content_sections.text: Selected candidates may be posted at NLCIL units, mines, power stations, renewable energy projects or associated establishments within their selected area, subject to organizational requirements. Posting Restriction: Selected candidates cannot request transfer to another NLCIL plant, unit or office during the initial three years from their date of joining.

content_sections.text: The online application facility for NLC India Graduate Executive Trainee Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to open on 13 November 2026 at 10:00 AM . content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NLC India GET Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates must choose only one area. If applications are submitted for multiple areas, NLCIL will consider only the latest application and its selected area. Applicants cannot claim selection against vacancies in another area.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NLC India GET Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload self-attested copies of the prescribed documents and produce original certificates during document verification. The photograph must measure 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm , be taken after 1 March 2026 and be a high-quality studio photograph. The signature must be written in dark blue or black ink. Where multiple documents belong to the same upload field, candidates must arrange them chronologically in a single PDF. Uploading another file in that field may overwrite the earlier upload.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Reservation and Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: Reservation and age relaxation are governed by Government of India rules. Candidates claiming reservation must upload the appropriate certificates issued by the competent authority. OBC-NCL candidates must produce a valid Non-Creamy Layer certificate obtained on or after 1 April 2026 at document verification. EWS candidates must produce a valid Income and Asset Certificate obtained on or after 1 April 2026 . PwBD candidates must possess the applicable disability certificate or UDID card. Suitability depends on the engineering discipline and the identified disability categories listed in Annexure I. The notification identifies no PwBD suitability category for Mining Engineering.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Document Verification and Medical Fitness
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for document verification before the Personal Interview. They must produce original qualification certificates, GATE 2025 scorecard, category certificates and other applicable records. Candidates employed in Government, Central/State PSUs or qualifying organizations must submit the required No Objection Certificate. Finally selected candidates must undergo a pre-employment medical examination and be declared medically fit according to NLCIL standards before appointment.

content_sections.heading: NLC India GET Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: NLC India has announced 143 Graduate Executive Trainee vacancies. Recruitment is based on GATE 2025 scores. Only Mechanical, Electrical, Civil and Mining disciplines are notified. Online registration opens on 13 November 2026. The last date for registration is 14 December 2026. The fee payment deadline is 14 December 2026 at 11:45 PM. Eligible registered and paid candidates can complete final submission by 16 December 2026. Qualifications and reservation eligibility are assessed as on 1 November 2026. Minimum aggregate marks are 60% for UR/EWS/OBC-NCL and 50% for SC/ST, subject to the applicable vacancy conditions. The applicant must choose one recruitment area. GATE 2025 contributes 80 marks and the Personal Interview contributes 20 marks. Shortlisting is separate for each area. Training lasts one year in E-2 Grade. Successful trainees are absorbed into E-3 Grade as notified. A Rs. 3 lakh service bond applies for three years of service after training. Transfer requests are restricted during the first three years from joining. Application fees are non-refundable. Original documents and medical fitness are mandatory. NLCIL may increase, decrease or cancel vacancies according to its requirements.

The Director General is the Executive Head of the Agency. The vacancy notice is issued by the Department from Shram Shakti Bhavan, Rafi Marg, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The NWDA Director General post can be filled in two ways, and each route has its own eligibility. Both routes require the same educational qualification and experience. Officers under the departments of Central Government/State Governments who meet any one of these service conditions: Holding an analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre/department; or Having 3 years' regular service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on regular basis in Level-14 of the Pay Matrix (Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200) or equivalent in the parent cadre/department; or Officers with 25 years' regular service in Group 'A' posts, out of which at least one year regular service should be in Level-14 of the Pay Matrix or equivalent posts in the parent cadre/department; and possessing the following educational qualification and experience: Degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification from a recognized university/Institution. Having worked extensively in the field of Water Resources with at least 20 years of professional experience in surveys, investigations, planning and preparation of project reports, design and construction of major irrigation, hydro-electric, flood control and multipurpose projects, of which at least 10 years' experience should be in the senior management level. Candidates belonging to organisations other than those specified for deputation, possessing the following qualification and experience: Degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification from a recognized University/Institution. Having worked extensively in the field of Water Resources with at least 20 years of professional experience in surveys, investigations, planning and preparation of project reports, design and construction of major irrigation, hydro-electric, flood control and multipurpose projects, of which at least 10 years' experience should be in the senior management level. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

Period of deputation, including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation/department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed 5 years. The terms and conditions of the selected officer as Director General, NWDA, shall be governed by the DoP&T's Consolidated Guidelines dated 28.03.2024 on "Regulation of Terms & Conditions Governing Deputation/Foreign Service of Employees to/from Central Government", as amended from time to time. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises three stages: Shortlisting, Interview, and CTC Negotiation. Shortlisting: Fulfilling minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide shortlisting parameters to call an adequate number of candidates. Interview (100 Marks): The interview carries 100 marks. For the posts of GM & Chief AI officer, DGM (Risk and Operational Analytics), DGM (AI Governance and Compliance), and DGM (Data Engineering, Model Application Dev and AI Ops), shortlisted candidates must deliver a 10-minute presentation on their relevant job profile, projects undertaken, or milestones achieved. Qualifying marks in the interview are decided by the Bank. Intimation or call letters for the interview will be uploaded on the Bank's website or sent by email; no hard copy will be sent. CTC Negotiation: CTC negotiation is conducted one-by-one with candidates at the time of interview or separately after the interview process. Merit List: The final merit list is prepared in descending order based solely on scores obtained in the interview. In case of a tie in cut-off marks, candidates are ranked according to age in descending order. Travelling Allowance for Interview: Outstation candidates called for interview after shortlisting will be reimbursed the cost of travelling by Air fare (Economy Class) for the shortest route in India as follows: GM & Chief AI officer and all three DGM posts (Sl. No. 1 to 4): Reimbursement of actual Air Fare (Economy Class). AI Solution Architect and Enterprise AI Architect (Sl. No. 5 & 6): Reimbursement of Air Fare up to Rs. 15,000/- (Total for both sides) or actual fare, whichever is lower. Note: In case a candidate called for interview is found not satisfying the eligibility criteria (Age, Educational Qualification, Experience, etc.), he/she will neither be allowed to appear for the interview nor be entitled to reimbursement of any travelling expenses.

content_sections.heading: About APGENCO
content_sections.text: APGENCO was incorporated under the Indian Companies Act, 1956 as a wholly owned State Government Company and is engaged in power generation in Andhra Pradesh. According to the notification, its installed capacity is 8789 MW, made up of 6610 MW Thermal, 1773.6 MW Hydro and 405.4 MW Solar power stations. Besides operating and maintaining its power plants, it is executing new projects under its capacity addition programme and renovating older power stations. Andhra Pradesh Power Development Corporation Limited (APPDCL) and APSPCL are its subsidiaries.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's degree in Engineering i.e., BE/B.Tech (Electrical/ Mechanical/ Mining) from a recognized University/ Institute /equivalent Degree in the subject directly relevant to the position. Post Graduate in Engineering in the same discipline/MBA of 2 years duration/ Ph.D., from a recognised University/institution. At least 25 years of professional experience in the Coal/Thermal sector with Central/State Government/Public Sector undertakings. Of these 25 years, at least 15 years of experience in Construction, Designing, Development, Operation & Maintenance of Thermal Power Plants/Coal mines. Of these 15 years, at least 3 years of cumulative service at senior level positions of General Manager/Superintending Engineer and Chief Engineer/Chief General Manager/Executive Director, or an equivalent rank, in the Central/State Government/Public Sector Undertakings of the Coal/Thermal sector, as on the date of Notification. OR Officers of Organized Group 'A' Services (such as IRTS/IRMS etc.) of the Central Government/State Government working at the appropriate level are exempted from the educational qualifications above. They should have at least 5 years of cumulative experience at a senior level during the last ten years in Coal Procurement/Coal Linkage Management, Coal Mining, Railway Freight and Rake Management, Port Operations, Transportation and Logistics, Fuel Supply Agreements, Coal Quality Management, Materials/Supply Chain Management, and/or associated Commercial and Contract Management functions. They have to work on deputation as per the terms and conditions of deputation of their parent department. The maximum age for the APGENCO Director (Coal & Logistics) post is 65 years, as on the date of Notification (2 November 2026). The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The candidate should have sound health. In the application's declaration, the applicant certifies that he or she has not been disqualified to act as a Director under Section 274 or any other relevant section of the Indian Companies Act, 1956. The applicant also certifies that he or she is not facing any charge of, nor has ever been convicted for, any act of moral turpitude or economic offence. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Tenure: Initially for a term of two years. The tenure may be extended for one year at a time, up to a maximum of two extensions. Extension decisions: Made after approval of the competent authority, on the recommendation of the Selection Committee, based on the Director's yearly assessment report. Only candidates with an outstanding assessment should be considered for re-appointment. Government servants: A person selected who is already a Government servant will have to seek retirement and retire before appointment. Group 'A' Service officers: Work on deputation as per the terms and conditions of deputation of their parent department. Place of work: APGENCO Corporate Office, Vidyut Soudha, Vijayawada.

content_sections.heading: About IOL
content_sections.text: India Optel Limited is a Schedule B Central Public Sector Enterprise under the administrative jurisdiction of the Department of Defence Production, Ministry of Defence, with its registered office at OFILDD Campus, Raipur, Dehradun-248008. It has 3 production units: Ordnance Factory Chandigarh, Ordnance Factory Dehradun and Opto-Electronics Factory Dehradun. Its products include sights for T-90S (BHISHMA), Tank T-72 M1 (AJEYA) and ICV BMP-II (SARATH), along with artillery and surveillance sights, assault rifle and small arms sights, cables, the Commander Thermal Imager and periscopes. As on 31 March 2026, its authorized and paid up capital stood at Rs. 6500 Crores and Rs. 5958.64 Crores, with 04 regular employees at Board of Director level and 2275 employees on deemed deputation.

content_sections.heading: IOL Chairman & Managing Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The vacancy arose on 1 June 2026.

content_sections.heading: Job Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Chairman & Managing Director is the Chief Executive of the company, accountable to the Board of Directors and the Government of India, and responsible for its efficient functioning and for meeting its corporate objectives and performance parameters. Liaise with important customers and Central Government Authorities, particularly the Department of Defence Production and the Defence Research & Development Organization. Maintain close liaison with the three Service Headquarters on ongoing Defence projects, and develop further business in night vision and laser sighting devices. Liaise with State Government Authorities, heads of other Public Sector Undertakings, customers, collaborators, and commercial and financial institutions. Provide overall leadership on indigenization and import substitution, exports, business development and marketing, defence production, modernization, R&D and innovation.

content_sections.heading: IOL Chairman & Managing Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age is counted on the date of occurrence of vacancy, and the age of superannuation is 60 years. The same limits apply to internal candidates and others. The applicant should be an Engineering Graduate/ Chartered Accountant/ Cost Accountant/ Post Graduate/Graduate with MBA/ PGDIM from a leading institute. The applicant should meet one of these two requirements: Cumulative experience/exposure for at least 5 years during the last 10 years in Finance, Business Development, Production, Operations, Marketing, Project Management or Research & Development in an Industry of repute. Cumulative 5 years of experience in HR/IR/Personnel Management, along with at least 3 years experience during the last 10 years in any of the above core areas. Applicants with experience in the Electronics/Opto-Electronics/Instrumentation/Communication Industry will be preferred. On both the date of application and the date of interview, the applicant must be employed in a regular capacity, not a contractual or ad-hoc one, in one of the following: A Central Public Sector Enterprise, including as a full-time functional Director on its Board. Central Government Group 'A' service, including the Armed Forces of the Union and All India Services, or a Public Sector bank, Financial Institution or Autonomous Body. A State Public Sector Enterprise with annual turnover of Rs 750 Crore or more. A Private Sector Company, Joint Venture or National or State Level Cooperative Federation with annual turnover of Rs. 750 crore or more. The minimum service required in the eligible scale is one year for internal candidates and two years for others as on the date of vacancy. Eligible officers of the Indian Ordnance Factories Services are treated as internal candidates. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

faq.answer: No. The applicant must be employed in a regular capacity on both the date of application and the date of interview, and contractual or ad-hoc employment does not qualify.

faq.question: Q2. Who counts as an internal candidate?
faq.answer: Eligible officers of the Indian Ordnance Factories Services are considered internal candidates. They need one year of service in the eligible scale, against two years for others.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum company turnover for private sector applicants?
faq.answer: The company must have an annual turnover of Rs. 750 crore or more, and the applicant must be working at Board level. The same turnover limit applies to State Public Sector Enterprises.

faq.question: Q4. How many years of experience are needed?
faq.answer: At least 5 years during the last 10 years in a core area such as Finance, Production, Marketing or Research & Development. Those with 5 years in HR/IR/Personnel Management also need at least 3 years in a core area during the last 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It runs for 5 years from joining, unless superannuation or further orders end it earlier.

faq.question: Q6. What happens if a selected candidate refuses to join?
faq.answer: A candidate who conveys unwillingness after the interview, or after the offer of appointment, is debarred for two years from being considered for a Board level post in any CPSE. content_sections.heading: About DA&FW Senior Agricultural Engineer
content_sections.text: The Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare functions under the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare from Krishi Bhawan, New Delhi. The Senior Agricultural Engineer posts are at its Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institutes: the Central Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institute at Budni (Madhya Pradesh) and the Northern Region, Southern Region and North Eastern Region institutes at Hisar (Haryana), Anantapur (Andhra Pradesh) and Biswanath Chariali (Assam).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be routed through proper channel and sent directly to this address: Under Secretary (M&T), Room No. 12A, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Krishi Bhawan, Dr. Rajendra Prasad Road, New Delhi -110001 The notice does not mention a postal mode or any text to write on the envelope. Advance copies of applications, applications received after the closing date and applications not accompanied by the required certificates/documents are liable to be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There are two posts of Senior Agricultural Engineer, classified as General Central Service, Group 'A' Gazetted, Non-Ministerial, in Pay Level - 11 (Rs. 67700-208700) in pay matrix. The number of vacancies is tentative and may be decreased or increased at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Officers under the Central Government or State Governments or Union Territory administrations or public sector undertakings or agricultural universities or recognised research institutions or councils or semi-government or autonomous bodies or statutory organisations who are: (i) holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or (ii) with five years' service in the level rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in posts in Level -10 (Rs. 56100-177500) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; or (iii) with seven years' service in the level rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in posts in Level -7 (Rs. 44900-142400) in the pay matrix or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; and who possess the educational qualification and experience below. Degree in Agricultural Engineering or Mechanical Engineering from a recognised University or Institute; and Five years' experience in operation and maintenance of tractors, agricultural machinery and allied equipment's including teaching experience in any Government or private listed organisation; or five years' experience in handling independently testing and evaluation of farm machinery and agricultural implements in any Government or private listed organisation. Post Graduate Degree in Agricultural Engineering from a recognised University or Institute. The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short term contract) shall not be exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Departmental Officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion will not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Curriculum vitae (in triplicate) in the Annexure-II proforma. Attested photocopies of Annual Performance Appraisal Reports for the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary (Annexure-III also allows the CR Dossier in original). Vigilance Clearance/Integrity Certificate/Cadre Clearance Certificate. Statement giving details of major or minor penalties imposed on the officer, if any, during the last 10 years (Annexure-III). Declaration by Applicant (Annexure-IV). Latest salary slip showing basic pay, Dearness Pay/Interim relief/other allowances and total emoluments, when the applicant's organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales. A separate sheet, authenticated by signature, if the space for employment details or additional information is insufficient.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Deputation
content_sections.text: The deputation will be initially for a period of one year, but is extendable as per DoPT's guidelines. The period of deputation will include deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department in the Central Government. The appointment will not give the appointee on deputation any claim for regular appointment. The deputation is subject to DoP&T circulars, especially the terms in DoP&T's OM No. 6/8/2009 Estt. (Pay II) dated 17.06.2010 and its subsequent amendments. Place of posting can be the Farm Machinery Training and Testing Institute at Budni (Madhya Pradesh) or Hisar (Haryana) or Anantapur (Andhra Pradesh) or Biswanath Chariali (Assam) or the Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (Hqrs).

content_sections.heading: MHI Consultant Grade-II Job Description
content_sections.text: Oversee and manage all activities related to the implementation of the Electrical Equipment Quality Control Order (QCO) for Low Voltage Switchgears and Controlgears. Coordinate with industry stakeholders, BIS, testing labs, departments/ministries and other agencies to ensure effective implementation of regulations and policies. Participate, examine and prepare inputs/proposals for BIS Sectoral Committees for electrical equipment standardization. Prepare comprehensive procedures for clarifying QCO product classifications with customs. Examine and prepare proposals or suggest initiatives to address and mitigate the impacts of supply chain constraints. Develop concept notes for initiatives aimed at enhancing the electrical equipment sector. Formulate and evaluate public policy for the electrical equipment industry, including examining draft cabinet notes, policies, schemes, FDI proposals and the registration of bidders under GFR 144(XI). Examine and prepare inputs/proposals related to Technical Barriers to Trade or Non-Tariff Measures for Free Trade Agreements (FTA), Preferential Trade Agreements (PTA) and WTO TBT negotiations for the Department of Commerce (DoC) and DPIIT. Technical examination of Cabinet Notes/EFC/PIB/DIB of all matters except clean technology. Technical examination of Concept Note/Feasibility Report/Bills/Acts/MoU, etc. of all matters except clean technology.

content_sections.text: Bharat Coking Coal Limited is a Mini Ratna company and a subsidiary of Coal India Limited, with its office at Koylanagar, Dhanbad, Jharkhand. This notification has been issued by the EE Department, Office of the General Manager, and is signed by the Dy. General Manager (HR/EE), BCCL.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open only to retired E-8/E9 grade executives of the Excavation discipline from CIL/Subsidiary Companies or an equivalent Public Sector Undertaking/autonomous organisation of the Central/State Government. VRS optees will not be considered. The cut-off date for eligibility is 30 September 2026. Engineering graduate in Mining Machinery/Mechanical Engineering/Electrical Engineering (BE/B.Tech). Retired E8/E9 Grade executive of Excavation Discipline with experience in the following works/jobs: Extensive work experience in HEMM maintenance and management for at least 25 years in Opencast Mining Projects. Leadership roles in policy-making at corporate level/Head Quarters of CIL/its subsidiaries/any PSU in the capacity of Head of the department (Excavation/Mechanical) for a period of minimum 1 year, with the experience of HEMM procurement and review of HEMM management. Knowledge: Sound knowledge of DGMS regulations, CIL/BCCL policies, HEMM management and relevant statutory guidelines. Desirable: Proven experience in integrating technical mining expertise with excavation planning, HEMM management and productivity improvement. The maximum age limit for eligibility is not more than 65 years during the contract period. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Full-time Advisor (Excavation) is engaged on fixed tenure basis for two years, which may be extended. The consolidated monthly compensation/honorarium depends on the grade at retirement: Other benefits printed in the notice: Conveyance: The company shall provide conveyance as per availability; where it is not provided, the Advisor is eligible for 5% of consolidated pay per month as conveyance charges. Accommodation: Suitable company accommodation shall be provided on availability; if not available, HRA will be provided as per the applicable CIL HRA rules for X, Y and Z class of cities based on the DoE OM dated 07.07.2017. Mobile telephone: Reimbursement based on actual bills or ₹1000/- per month, whichever is less. Medical: CIL executives covered under the Post Retiral Medical Benefits Scheme continue under that scheme; appointees not on the roll of CIL get the same coverage if they are not covered under any Post Retiral Medical Scheme. Leave: Paid leave of 15 days in every six months in addition to paid holidays, regulated as per EL provisions under CIL Executive Leave Rules; not encashable, and accumulated leave lapses at the expiry of each period of engagement. TA/DA on official tour: As per entitlement on retirement, restricted to air travel by Economy class only. On joining: If travel from out-station is required to join, the cost of one ticket (for self) as per the entitlement above; one ticket (for self) also on expiry of contract. Hotel accommodation: As per entitlement at the time of retirement/superannuation, limited to a single room and to the maximum entitlement of E9 grade executives; DA as admissible at retirement (limited to E9 level) when boarding and lodging is not provided by the company. Tax: Where payment of GST is required, it shall be reimbursed on production of proof of payment.

content_sections.heading: BCCL Full-time Advisor (Excavation) Job Description
content_sections.text: The broad scope of work includes: Advise on excavation planning and optimum deployment of HEMM. Assist in assessment of HEMM fleet requirements, capacity and replacement needs. Advise on fleet optimization, mechanization and equipment standardization. Review availability, utilization and productivity of major HEMM. Identify critical issues affecting equipment performance and suggest corrective measures. Advise on measures for improving equipment productivity and utilization. Provide expert inputs on procurement/replacement of major HEMM. Review technical specifications, equipment capacity and suitability wherever required. Advise on life-cycle considerations and optimum utilization of capital equipment. Assist in resolving critical excavation and HEMM-related issues in coordination with Areas/Projects, CMPDI, CIL, manufacturers and other stakeholders. Provide inputs during review of major excavation projects and equipment deployment. Provide advisory inputs to CMD/Functional Directors/Project Review Committees on critical excavation and HEMM-related matters. Assist Management in policy-level decisions relating to HEMM planning, procurement, deployment and replacement. Undertake any other excavation-related advisory work assigned by Management from time to time.

Nine months in Year 1, extendable subject to project duration, funding, performance and institutional approval

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Nagpur and the SMRITI Project
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur is a medical institute located at Plot no. 2, Sector-20, MIHAN, Nagpur – 441108. The post sits in the ICMR-funded SMRITI trial, a biomarker-stratified multicentre randomised controlled trial evaluating Propofol TIVA against Isoflurane for preventing postoperative delirium in geriatric surgery. The Principal Investigator is Dr Omshubham Gangadhar Asai, Associate Professor, Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care, AIIMS Nagpur.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Postgraduate degree, including integrated PG degree, in a relevant subject (for example life sciences, biochemistry, biotechnology, clinical research or public health) from a recognized university; OR a four-year graduate degree in Engineering / IT / Computer Science relevant to the project. 1–2 years' clinical-research experience, preferably multicentre RCT/ICMR project. Experience in trial coordination, IEC/regulatory documentation, participant recruitment/follow-up, EDC/database management, GCP, statistical software, project reporting and scientific writing. Multicentre trial and peer-reviewed publication experience preferred. Qualifications and relevant subject equivalence are subject to applicable ICMR guidelines, and candidates with higher qualifications may apply. The age limit for the post is 35 years. This is a fixed-duration, purely temporary post under an ICMR-funded project. It is not a regular post of ICMR or AIIMS Nagpur and confers no claim to permanent employment. The initial tenure is nine months in Year 1. Renewal is subject to project requirements, fund availability, performance assessment and institutional approval. The engagement will end automatically upon expiry of its approved term unless renewed. Leave, notice, termination and other service conditions will follow the applicable ICMR guidelines and institute orders.

application_fee.details: The CWC application fee is Rs. 850 plus intimation charges of Rs. 500 (Rs. 1,350 in total) for UR, EWS and OBC candidates. SC, ST, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and women candidates are exempt from the application fee but must pay intimation charges of Rs. 500. The amount is inclusive of GST, and the payment gateway charges are borne by the candidate. | The fee is non-refundable and is paid through the online payment gateway only. Payment by DD, cheque or postal order is not accepted. Payment can be made by debit card (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), credit card, internet banking, UPI, IMPS, cash cards or mobile wallets. A candidate applying for more than one post must apply and pay the fee separately for each post. On successful payment, an e-receipt is generated. If no e-receipt is generated, the payment has failed, and the candidate should log in again with the Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the payment.

age_limit.details: The CWC age limit is a maximum of 28 years as on 15.11.2026 for all the posts. Candidates should not have been born earlier than 16.11.1998 and later than 15.11.2008, both days inclusive. The maximum age in Table-A is applicable to UR candidates, and the following relaxation is given on top of it. | With cumulative age relaxation, the maximum age limit cannot exceed 55 years as on 15.11.2026. For Ex-Servicemen (post codes 07 and 08), the period of actual military service is deducted from the actual age, and the resultant age should not exceed the maximum age limit by more than 3 years (8 years for SC/ST and 6 years for OBC candidates). The relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with any one of the other categories listed above, except SC/ST/OBC themselves. Departmental candidates (regular CWC employees) get age relaxation only if they have at least 5 years of service left on the last date of receipt of applications. Age concession is not admissible to sons, daughters and dependents of Ex-Servicemen. SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates applying against unreserved posts get no age or qualifying-marks relaxation.

how_to_apply: Candidates can apply online only from 17.10.2026 to 15.11.2026. No other mode of application is accepted. A candidate can apply for one or more posts according to the qualification and eligibility, but must apply and pay the fee separately for each post. Not more than one application should be submitted for a particular post.
Keep ready a scanned photograph, signature, left thumb impression and a hand-written declaration, a valid personal e-mail ID and mobile number, and the details for online payment.
Go to www.cewacor.nic.in, click the link "Career @CWC (Direct Recruitment)-2026" and then "Click here to apply online for Advertisement No. 2026/01".
Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter the name, contact details and e-mail ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password are generated and also sent by e-mail and SMS.

Fill in the application form. The "Save and Next" option can be used to save the data and verify it. The name of the candidate and the father/husband must be spelt as in the Class 10 certificate/mark sheet.
Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration, and capture the live photograph by webcam or mobile phone.
Preview the form, click "Complete Registration" after verifying, then use the "Payment" tab to pay the fee and click "Submit".
Take a printout of the application form and the e-receipt. Do not send them to CWC.

The text of the declaration is: "I, (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." Visually impaired candidates or others who cannot write may get the text typed and put their left thumb impression below it. The online application is not registered unless the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and hand-written declaration are uploaded as specified.

faq.answer: GEN/EWS/OBC (NCL) candidates pay Rs 1000/- + GST, i.e. Rs. 1180/-, online through SBI e-Pay Lite. SC/ST/PwBD/ESM candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.answer: Candidates need a B.E / B.Tech / B.Sc (4 Years) Engineering degree in the listed Electronics disciplines or in Mechanical. content_sections.heading: About NIBMG Recruitment 2026

These posts are "Project Linked Person" positions for extramural projects carried out by the institute. The posts serve the IndiaCAN-Twin project. Its Principal Investigators are Prof. Nidhan K. Biswas and Prof. Analabha Basu, and its Co-Principal Investigator is Dr. Dilip Kumar. The project studies gingivo-buccal oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC), the leading cancer among Indian males. It uses multi-omics profiling, longitudinal cohorts and computational genomics pipelines at NIBMG, together with artificial intelligence and digital pathology. The aim is to build predictive Bio-AI frameworks and to find diagnostic and prognostic biomarkers for Indian oral cancer patients.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of work: MoEFCC, HQ at New Delhi. Tenure: Upto three years (1+1+1), subject to performance and the professional's presence being highly useful to the Division. Continuation for upto two more years will be considered case by case with the approval of the Competent Authority. Nature of appointment: Temporary (non-official), purely contractual and full time, with no other assignment permitted during the consultancy. No request for promotion shall be entertained. Termination: The Ministry can cancel the appointment at any time without assigning any reason. Absence for a continuous period of 8 days without information or valid reason leads to automatic termination. Reporting: Consultants report to the Director/Dy. Secretary under the overall supervision of the Joint Secretary or equivalent. Working hours: Same as regular Government employees in the Ministry, with attendance marked in the Biometric system. Monthly remuneration may be deducted for coming late. No extra remuneration is allowed for working beyond office hours or on holidays, and compensatory leave is at the Divisional Head's discretion. Leave: Paid leave accrues at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. No remuneration is drawn for absence beyond 18 days in a year (pro-rata). Unused leave cannot be carried forward to the next 1-year tenure. Female consultants are eligible for maternity leave under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 and the Maternity Leave Rules based on it. Official travel: TA, DA and hotel accommodation for official work are allowed under SR 190 and MoEFCC guidelines Admin-43012/1/2022 – P-II [E-176223] dated 15 April 2025. No TA/DA is admissible for joining the assignment or on its completion. Confidentiality: Consultants are subject to the Indian Official Secret Act, 1923. Internal reports and data cannot be used for research papers or books, and publishing or broadcasting information gathered on the assignment needs the Ministry's previous sanction. Conduct: Engagement is liable to be discontinued without any reason being assigned if services are found unsatisfactory or in conflict with Government interests.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Chief Executive Officer
content_sections.text: Secure Government funding, beginning with the MSME cluster development scheme and the technology upgradation scheme. Build the Centre into a self-sustaining institution that draws on the University's campus, laboratories and talent. Build the core organisation, structure and processes in line with the Foundation's purpose and vision. Establish the innovation and entrepreneurial ecosystem. Manage incubation, infrastructure and facilities, legal and compliance work, finance, administration, procurement, and IT and lab infrastructure. Raise and manage funds from Government schemes, industry, incubator funds and CSR. Attract grants (for example NITI Aayog, DST, NSTEDB, BIRAC, MeitY, MSME), pitch to angel investors and venture capitalists, and build revenue-generating services. Handle budgeting, reporting, audit and compliance with statutory rules and regulations. Curate programmes, events, engagement activities and marketing campaigns that promote entrepreneurship and the Foundation's visibility. Work with MMMUT faculty and students to incubate startups, steering technologies and IP towards commercialisation through mentoring and venture set-up. Frame and execute the long-term roadmap, business models and annual action plans in alignment with the Board. Send timely reports to the Board, funding agencies and stakeholders. Handle duties assigned by the Chairman, Member Secretary and Directors, and stay current with global developments in the incubator and startup ecosystem.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Incubation Manager
content_sections.text: Manage the daily operations of the MMMUT Foundation and its incubation facilities. Implement the annual action plan and operational instructions approved by the CEO and competent authority. Maintain records of startups, incubatees, applications, mentoring sessions, programmes, events and facility utilisation. Coordinate the use of office space, laboratories, equipment, meeting rooms and prototyping facilities. Ensure timely execution of assigned activities and maintain operational discipline. Identify promising entrepreneurs, student innovators, faculty innovators and technology-based startup teams.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The mode of selection for both posts is direct, in three stages: Screening: A committee constituted by the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor, Chairman, Board of Directors, MMMUT Foundation, checks all applications against the advertised criteria. Only candidates who meet the stated qualifications pass this stage. Shortlisting: A committee nominated by the Chairman shortlists candidates in a 1:3 ratio on merit. This committee sets the shortlisting criteria. Presentation: Shortlisted candidates make a presentation before the Board of Directors, MMMUT Foundation, which takes the final decision on appointment.

content_sections.heading: Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Cloud Engineer will design, implement and manage scalable cloud infrastructure, keeping systems secure, reliable and optimized for performance while supporting application deployment and operations. The notice lists these duties: Design and implement scalable, secure, high-availability technical solutions inspired by large digital platforms. Translate business and functional requirements into end-to-end technical architectures and solution designs. Support onboarding and integration of partner applications and services into the platform ecosystem. Architect and manage cloud infrastructure for AI, data and application workloads. Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code and automation using tools like Terraform, CloudFormation and Ansible. Implement cloud operations best practices, including autoscaling, configuration management and cost optimization. Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for platform and application deployments. Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize cloud and application environments for performance and reliability. Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams and solution blueprints for internal teams and partners. Work with internal teams to identify gaps, improve processes and enhance solution delivery. Deliver customer service in a client-facing role, using strong communication, analytical and problem-solving skills.

DIBD-DIC reserves the right not to select any candidate, and to fill all, some or none of the positions, without assigning any reason. A candidate selected in this interview could also be considered for other vacant positions at DIBD-DIC that require similar skills, at an appropriate level.

faq.question: Q1. Which discipline has the most Skill Instructor vacancies?
faq.answer: CSE/IT has the most, with 10 posts under Advt. No. T-42/2026. Agriculture and Medical Lab. Technology follow with 03 each.

faq.question: Q2. Can a diploma holder apply for SVSU Skill Instructor posts?
faq.answer: Yes, in some disciplines. Civil, Electrical, Electronics and Mechanical (RAC), for example, accept a first class three-year Engineering Diploma with six years' experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is a National Trade Certificate accepted?
faq.answer: Yes, for Civil, Electrical, Electronics, Hospitality, Mechanical (RAC) and Printing & Technology. These need eight years' experience, including the training period.

faq.question: Q4. Can candidates from outside Haryana apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but a reserved-category applicant from another state is considered only against General posts and pays Rs. 1000/-.

faq.answer: Yes. Each post needs its own application and its own fee.

content_sections.heading: About OHPC
content_sections.text: Odisha Hydro Power Corporation Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 as a hydro power generation company of Odisha and functions under the state's Energy Department. Its installed capacity has grown from 1273.53 MW to 2099.8 MW, with 6 projects within the state and one interstate project in operation. This Gold rated State PSU also promotes renewable energy investment through its wholly owned subsidiary GEDCOL and is taking up new hydro projects, including Pumped Storage Projects and Small Hydro Projects.

content_sections.heading: OHPC Managing Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The pay follows a Cost to Company pattern. Over and above the CTC, the post carries an official vehicle, Company accommodation or HRA, Medical Facilities, and other allowances and perks as per the rules of the Corporation. Pay protection will be allowed only to Officers from the Central or State Governments, CPSEs, State PSUs or any other Government Organization. The Managing Director is the Chief Executive of the Company and is accountable to the Chairman, Board of Directors, Government of Odisha. Smooth operation and maintenance, renovation and modernisation of hydro power plants. Interaction with the authorities of GoI, Govt. of Odisha and stakeholders. Planning and execution of new hydro projects and Pumped Storage Projects. Efficient functioning of the Corporation for achieving its vision and objectives, and driving it to a new trajectory of growth with dynamic leadership.

rows.pay: CTC of Rs.35 lakhs to Rs.70 lakhs per annum
