content_sections.text: Nature and tenure: Full time contract for 5 years or up to the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier, subject to the terms and conditions of appointment. Probation: 1 year, included in the tenure. Appointment shall be confirmed after satisfactory completion of probation and approval of the Energy Department. Extension: May be allowed in exceptional cases, to candidates with residual service, up to 65 years, subject to performance assessment by PESB or the Energy Department. There will not be any extension beyond two terms and 65 years of age. Deputation: Interested candidates from Government, CPSUs, SPSUs, or State or Central Govt. may be considered on deputation for a period of not less than 3 years. Lien: Eligible selected candidates, other than internal candidates, serving in Government, CPSUs, SPSUs or other Government organisations may retain a lien in their parent organisation, subject to its rules. They must furnish a valid Lien Certificate from the competent authority at the time of joining, and may join back on completion or cessation of the tenure, subject to the lien terms and the parent organisation's rules. Minimum service with lien: 3 years, unless the appointment is terminated earlier in accordance with its terms and conditions. Internal candidates: If selected, the candidate should resign or take Voluntary Retirement and join as Managing Director on contractual appointment.

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: This consultant will provide specialised technical and analytical support on medical devices. The role focuses on regulatory compliance, market analysis, quality standards, manufacturing competitiveness and policy inputs. The duties include: Supporting research on global and domestic policies, industry trends, manufacturing promotion and access to medical devices Assisting with background notes, talking points, briefs, presentations and minutes for meetings, events and conferences Supporting coordination with industry associations and related Departments of the Government of India Providing comprehensive secretarial support, including drafting proposals, handling correspondence, file processing and record-keeping Carrying out other duties entrusted from time to time This consultant will provide technical, regulatory and analytical support for initiatives in the Indian pharmaceutical sector, including policy development, industry competitiveness, trade facilitation, quality compliance and market access. The role requires strong knowledge of India's pharma ecosystem, regulatory frameworks and global pharmaceutical trends. The duties include: Assisting with background notes, briefs and presentations for bilateral and multilateral meetings, trade negotiations and other international engagements Helping to collect and analyse data, especially trade data, and preparing summary notes Supporting research and analytical reports on country profiles related to pharmaceuticals and medical devices, international trade matters, regulations and market access issues Providing comprehensive secretarial support, including drafting proposals, handling correspondence, file processing and record-keeping Carrying out other duties entrusted from time to time

content_sections.heading: NIH Junior Research Fellow Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates before appearing for the walk-in-interview shall ensure that they are eligible (in the required field) for the position they intend to apply. The selected candidate shall be allowed TA/DA for their travel inside the country in connection with the official work. The selected candidates will not be permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of consultancy with NIH. The selected candidates shall not be entitled to allowances such as Dearness Allowance, Residential Telephone, Transport facility, Personal Staff etc. Selected candidates may be provided transit accommodation as per prevailing rules of the Institute subject to payment of applicable licence fee, which must be vacated on termination or expiry of the tenure, whichever is earlier. content_sections.heading: About CSIR-NEERI
content_sections.text: CSIR-National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-NEERI) is a research institute on Nehru Marg, Nagpur. This engagement is for R&D project staff under the project "Urban Biodiversity Studies include city Biodiversity Index Assessment for 3 urban areas Ara - Buxar, Bhagalpur and Biharsharif – Pawapuri – Nalanda - Rajgir Cluster in Bihar - (GNP-3072)", tenable at CSIR-NEERI Nagpur or its Zonal Centres. content_sections.text: The notice states that the anticipated vacancy may be 2, depending on the availability of funds, and that the second candidate will be selected from the waiting list. The higher rate of Rs. 35,000 plus HRA applies to candidates who have qualified CSIR-UGC / ICAR / ICMR NET lectureship / Assistant professorship or GATE, or national-level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent and/or their Agencies/Institutions. All others get Rs. 28,000 plus HRA. HRA is admissible as per applicable rules, but project staff must arrange their own accommodation.

content_sections.heading: CSIR-NEERI Project Associate-II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 35 years, reckoned as on the last date of receipt of applications. Any one of the following: B.E./ B. Tech in Civil / Computer Science/ Environmental Engineering from a recognized University AND 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. M.Sc. in Environmental Science/ Botany from a recognized University AND 2 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Scientific activities and services. M.E./ M. Tech in Civil/ Environmental Engg/ Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering from a recognized University. Application of ArcGIS, QGIS software Web design and GIS map hosting services Floral (Vascular, Invasive, Medicinal etc) study Only candidates whose result for the essential qualification has been declared (at least a provisional certificate) are eligible. Result-awaited, final-semester-appeared or Ph.D-submitted candidates are not eligible where the minimum essential qualification is mandatory, and final-semester and result-awaited candidates may not appear for the interview. Experience is counted from the date after acquiring the minimum educational qualification. Dissertation or thesis work done during the academic period does not count. Time spent acquiring a higher qualification is not counted as experience over the essential qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact discipline-wise eligibility of the post.

content_sections.text: Candidates are not required to pay any application fee.

content_sections.text: The gate will be closed by 11:00 am, so candidates arriving later will not be let in.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be done on the basis of a walk-in interview at CSIR-NEERI, Nagpur. Meeting the minimum qualification does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. If a large number of applications is received, preference will be given to candidates under the criteria adopted by the Screening Committee. The notice's general conditions also say that shortlisted candidates will be invited for an online interview, with the information uploaded on the website/portal. No TA will be paid for attending the interview in the case of offline interviews.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Place of posting: CSIR-NEERI, Nagpur. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, and it gives no right to regularization against any CSIR/CSIR-NEERI post. Total tenure as project staff in CSIR-NEERI or other CSIR laboratories cannot exceed six or seven years, as per clause 1.6/1.7 of CSIR OM No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024. In the application form, candidates must declare that they have not completed the maximum tenure of 6 years. The offer letter will first be issued for the period for which funds are available. A review committee will assess performance and may recommend extension, subject to funds. The engagement may be extended or curtailed depending on the project duration, the level of performance or the conduct of the incumbent. Either side may end the engagement with one month's notice. A candidate who leaves may instead pay one month's remuneration. Selected candidates must sign a confidentiality undertaking covering project findings and intellectual property. Joining follows pre-appointment formalities such as medical examination and character verification. No upgradation is allowed in the same or a new project. CSIR-NEERI may cancel the offer if any discrepancy is found in a candidate's details at any stage.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal is in Saket Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. Its letterhead describes it as an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of India. These posts are in its Department of Microbiology. They serve the PM-ABHIM funded research project "Establishing a One Health Sentinel Surveillance System in High Human-Animal Interaction Settings among Selected Zoos in India". The notice's heading calls it an ICMR funded zoonotic research project.

content_sections.heading: About the Zoonotic Research Project
content_sections.text: The project will set up a One Health surveillance system to detect and monitor zoonotic diseases early, where humans, animals and the environment meet in selected Indian zoos. The work covers: human syndromic surveillance animal pathogen screening environmental monitoring vector surveillance molecular diagnostics serology metagenomics genomic epidemiology The aim is to assess and reduce the risk of zoonotic disease. The engagement is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

ICMR recruitment: The post continues only as long as the vacancy is not filled through ICMR's central recruitment examination. Posting: Staff can be posted anywhere the project needs them, including rural areas and field sites. Leave: Leave follows ICMR's leave policy for extramural research projects. Accommodation: The Institute does not provide a hostel or any other accommodation. Private practice: Private practice of any kind is not allowed. Conduct: Staff must follow the Institute's rules of conduct and discipline.

content_sections.heading: About TPGL
content_sections.text: Tripura Power Generation Limited is a Government of Tripura enterprise that runs power generating stations and generation projects in the state. Its Corporate Office is at Bidyut Bhavan (Old Building), North Banamalipur, Agartala, and this is where applications for this post go.

content_sections.heading: TPGL General Manager (Technical) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice states that the number of posts may increase or decrease, and that the Corporation may choose not to fill the vacancy if the circumstances call for it. For in-service candidates on deputation and direct recruits below 60 years of age, pay is fixed at level 20 of the pay matrix under the "Tripura State Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2018". This corresponds to Pay Band Scale Rs. 37400-67000 (HAG + Scale). The minimum basic pay is Rs. 118500, and these allowances are paid on top of it: Retired candidates and those above 60 years get Rs. 1,00,000 (Rupees one lakh only) a month on a consolidated basis. This amount is not linked to any pension from earlier service. All pay is subject to revision by the Government or the Corporation. Other facilities: Leave under the Tripura State Government's Leave Rules Medical bill reimbursement under Tripura State Government Rules TA bills for official tours under Tripura State Government Rules A vehicle and a mobile phone as per Company Policy

content_sections.heading: TPGL General Manager (Technical) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 65 (sixty five) years, counted on the last date for receipt of applications. The notice states that this limit may be relaxed for a deserving candidate. You need a consistently good academic record with at least 55% marks in B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical / Mechanical Engineering from a University or Institution recognised by UGC / AICTE. Where a grading system is used, an equivalent grade on a point scale is accepted. You need at least 20 (twenty) years of working experience at managerial level in any Public or Private Sector Power Utility. This must include adequate exposure to installing and commissioning new power projects, and to the operation and maintenance of Generation Systems, including Commercial and System Operation, Tariff and Material Management. For a deserving candidate, the 20-year requirement may be reduced. These job specifications are the minimum. Meeting them does not guarantee a call for interview. The selection committee may relax any of the terms for selection and appointment. For the exact eligibility wording, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The General Manager (Technical) works as a Line Manager and reports to the Director (Technical). The managerial duties are: Setting tasks and targets in line with the Corporation's goals and assigning work to Line Managers Running technical and organisational functions with proper systems and controls Building a positive work culture and motivating staff Carrying out programmes of the Central Government and the Government of Tripura Running random checks of offices and project work, collecting feedback and taking corrective action The technical duties are: Keeping power generation uninterrupted and reliable through proper operation and maintenance of generating stations, including all types of transformers, with protection at every level Coordinating Generation, Transmission and Distribution, with proper relay coordination Material management, inventory, disposal of scrap material, and asset creation through TPGL projects Preparing DPRs, finishing tendering on time, and monitoring construction quality under generation projects and schemes Reducing transformer failure rates and working towards zero accidents through safety awareness Any other assignment given by the Director (Technical) or the Managing Director

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on an interview only, and only shortlisted candidates are called. If shortlisting is needed, it may be done through a written test, academic records, higher educational qualifications and experience. The decision of the Screening Committee and the Appointing Authority on shortlisting is binding. The Corporation does not pay T.A. / D.A. for attending the interview. Original documents must be shown at the interview, or at any other time the Corporation decides.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is on contract for 3 (three) years. The appointing authority may extend it if both sides agree. No pension is paid by the Government of Tripura or TPGL. EPF benefits are available if you want them and if they apply. Either side can end the contract with 30 days' notice or by paying 1 (one) month's salary. Other service conditions are the same as for Tripura State Civil Service Officers of the equivalent grade. A Government of Tripura officer appointed on deputation stays under the service conditions of their original employment. In-service candidates may apply directly. If selected, they must bring a 'Release Order' or 'Deputation Order' from their present employer when joining. Without it, they cannot join.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TPGL General Manager (Technical) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and fill in the bio-data form printed on pages 5 and 6. Fill in your personal details, your qualifications from Matriculation/Madhyamik onwards, your memberships of professional bodies, every post you have held, the training you have done in India and abroad, any honours, and how soon you can join. Paste one recent passport-size photograph on the form, then sign the declaration with the date and place. Attach self-attested copies of your mark-sheets, certificates and other testimonials as proof of age, education, experience and state of domicile. Do not send originals. Write "Application for the post of General Manager (Technical) in TPGL" on the envelope. Post it to: The Managing Director, Tripura Power Generation Limited, Corporate Office, Bidyut Bhavan (Old Building), North Banamalipur, Pin – 799001, so that it arrives by the last date. Applications that arrive late or are incomplete will not be considered. Papers sent after the closing date will also be ignored. content_sections.heading: About IIT Gandhinagar
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar is a technical institute in Gandhinagar, Gujarat. This position is advertised by its Research & Development Office for the project "Center for Creative Learning." The project is run by the institute's Center for Creative Learning department, and Prof Manish Jain is the Principal Investigator.

rows.pay: Rs 50,000 to 90,000 per month (consolidated), depending on qualification and experience

content_sections.heading: IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate II (Chemistry) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility follows Institute norms, not funding agency norms. M.Sc. in Chemistry or B.Tech./B.E. in a Chemistry-related engineering/technical field, with at least 02 years of post-qualification experience, OR B.Sc. with Chemistry as a subject, with at least 06 years of post-qualification experience. Marks: at least 60% or an equivalent grade from graduation onwards, and at least 55% or an equivalent grade in Class 10th and 12th. The institute wants a self-driven, creative chemistry educator with a strong interest in school STEM education through hands-on and inquiry-based learning. The following are preferred but not required: Experience teaching chemistry to students in grades 8-12 (for example as a TGT or PGT, or under CBSE, IB, IGCSE, ICSE and state boards). Good communication and facilitation skills, professional fluency in spoken and written English and in spoken Hindi, and good digital documentation skills. Experience designing and conducting physical experiments and hands-on activities, and using lab instruments. 1 year of experience writing textbook chapters or making learning modules for grades 8-12 in ed-tech. Check the official notification for the full eligibility details for this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The main responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Creating high-quality, rigorous hands-on chemistry modules for grades 6-12, and updating and organising the resource repository. Adapting, making, testing and optimising activities, models and prototypes. Documenting the work as manuals, chapters, worksheets, presentations, videos and articles. Turning suitable activities into models that schools can use, with product specifications. Coordinating and running the testing of content in schools.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting or appointment, and a higher cut-off may be used. The institute may choose not to call an applicant for a selection test. It may also decide not to fill the position in this round, without giving a reason.

Apply for the Project Associate II (Chemistry) position under the Center for Creative Learning project. Submit the application by the last date. content_sections.text: The Islamic University of Science & Technology (IUST) is a university in Kashmir. This notice lists its departments and centres for languages, sciences, engineering, management, planning, geomatics, AYUSH Sciences and molecular medicine, along with the Kalam Academy of Skill Development & Training (KAST). Legal disputes about this recruitment can be heard only in the courts at Srinagar.

content_sections.heading: IUST Assistant Professor Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The two Mathematical Sciences posts marked * need a Master's degree in Data Sciences, Actuarial Sciences, Statistics or Applied Statistics. Reservation follows the rules of the Government of the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir. Persons with disabilities get a 4% horizontal reservation across all vertical categories, and this depends on suitable candidates being available. Vacancies reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities are included within these numbers; the official notice gives the break-up. EWS posts are only for EWS candidates. EWS vacancies are not carried forward, though, so a post with no suitable EWS candidate goes to the Unreserved (UR) category. UR candidates may apply for EWS posts at their own risk and will be considered only if no suitable EWS candidate is found. The University may increase or decrease the number of posts.

Kalam Academy of Skill Development & Training (KAST)

content_sections.heading: IUST Assistant Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: English Language & Literature, Urdu Language & Literature, Journalism & Mass Communication, Education, Zoology, Physics, Chemistry: A Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the subject (50% for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer) or an equivalent grade on a point scale from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Mathematical Sciences: A Master's degree with at least 55% marks in Mathematics/Applied Mathematics. For the posts marked *, a Master's degree with at least 55% marks in Data Sciences/Actuarial Sciences/Statistics/Applied Statistics. Food Technology, Civil Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, Mechanical Engineering: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S., or Integrated M.Tech., in the concerned/relevant/allied branch, with first class or equivalent in either degree. Management Studies: A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline and a Master's Degree in Business Administration/PGDM/C.A./ICWA/M.Com. with First Class or equivalent. Computer Science: A Master's degree with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer) or an equivalent grade in Computer Science/Information Technology/Computer Applications/Computer Engineering from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. AYUSH Sciences: An MD/MS Degree in the AYUSH System of Medicine with at least 55% or an equivalent grade at the Master's level in the concerned subject, recognised under Schedule II of the CCIM Act, 1970 / NCISM Act 2020. Planning: A Bachelor's Degree in Architecture/Planning/Technology/Engineering and a Master's Degree in Planning, with at least 60% marks in aggregate or equivalent in either degree. Alternatively, a Master's Degree in Economics/Geography/Sociology and a Master's Degree in Planning, with at least 60% marks in aggregate in either of the two Master's degrees. Geomatics: A Master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in Geo-informatics/Geomatics/Remote Sensing/GIS/Geospatial Technology from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university. Molecular Medicines: A Master's degree with at least 55% marks (50% for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer) or an equivalent grade in Molecular Medicine, Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Clinical Biochemistry, Microbiology, Genetics, Genetic Engineering, Human Genetics, Biophysics, Structural Biology, Cell Biology, Bioinformatics, Immunology, Computational Biology or another relevant/allied subject. Skill Development & Training (KAST): A Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in all preceding degrees, a consistently very good academic record and evidence of ability to do independent high-quality research. The preceding degrees must be in Computer Science/Computer Science & Engineering (Software Engineering), Electrical Engineering (Solar PV), Food Technology (Food Technology), Mechanical Engineering (Mechanical Engineering) or Elect

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application processing fee is Rs. 1000/- (Rupees One Thousand only). It is non-refundable and is paid online by debit card, credit card or net banking. Candidates in the PwD category do not pay the fee.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected by shortlisting followed by an interview. If a post gets a large number of applications, the University shortlists candidates for interview using the score card below. Ordinarily, 20 candidates are called for one post and 5 more for every additional post. The University also decides the cut-off score after screening the applications. You will be told the date and place of the interview through the University website or by e-mail. Each paper in a journal indexed in Scopus or the Web of Science (SCIE/SSCI/AHCI) earns 2 marks. A single author, or an author who is both first and corresponding author, gets full marks. A first or corresponding author gets 70%, and other joint authors get 30%. For the language departments, journals on the UGC-CARE list also count, under UGC Order No. F. No.:1-1/2018(CARE/JOURNAL) Dated: 16-07-2025. If your experience is less than one year, the marks are reduced in proportion. If you have a B.Tech./B.E./FYUG degree and a direct Ph.D., your undergraduate score is scaled to 40 points in place of the Master's score: above 90% earns 40 points, above 80% and up to 90% earns 37, and above 75% and up to 80% earns 35.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Appointees are bound by the Statutes, Ordinances, Regulations and Rules of the University and its code of professional ethics. Where the University has no service rules of its own, the rules of the Government of the UT apply. Selected candidates are covered by the New Pension Scheme (NPS). Each appointment depends on verification of reserved-category certificates and other claims, and on the outcome of any court case pending before a competent court.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IUST Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.iust.ac.in , open the recruitment/application portal and read the detailed instructions. Register with a valid Email ID and Mobile Number. Keep your Username and Password safe. Enter your personal details, educational qualifications, experience and other particulars. Information you leave out of the relevant columns will not be considered. Preview the form and submit it. You cannot edit it after submission. Pay the fee online, unless you are a PwD candidate. Print the submitted form and attach self-attested copies of all relevant documents, certificates and testimonials. Arrange them in the same order as the serial numbers generated for each entry. Deliver the hard copy to the office of the Registrar, IUST, by 4:00 PM on 7 December 2026. If you send it by post, make sure it arrives by that time. If the hard copy is late, your online application can be rejected. If you are already employed, forward your application through your employer. A detailed CV covering your qualifications, experience and published work. For each publication, give the journal/book title, paper title, volume number, page numbers, year, ISSN/ISBN, authorship (sole or joint), whether it is refereed and indexed, and whether it is local, national or international. A valid category certificate from the Competent Authority. EWS candidates need an EWS certificate in the prescribed format under UT of J&K rules. Experience certificates issued by the competent authority of each institution. Ph.D. holders: the Annexure certificate (page 9 of the notice), signed by the Registrar, Dean Academic Affairs or Dean Research, confirming that the degree complies with the UGC 2009 Regulation. Without it, your Ph.D. will not be considered. Foreign degree holders: an equivalence certificate from the concerned regulatory authority. Original documents, to be shown at the interview. Applications that arrive late or are incomplete will not be considered. Fake documents or hiding material information can lead to debarment, termination and criminal action. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification, and no TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. All updates, addenda and corrigenda will appear only on www.iust.ac.in .

faq.answer: There are 48 posts. KAST has the most, with 7, and English, Education, Mathematical Sciences, Physics, Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering and Management Studies have 3 each.

faq.answer: Yes. Send a print-out of the submitted form with self-attested documents to the Registrar's office by 4:00 PM on 7 December 2026, or your online application can be rejected.

faq.answer: NET/SET/SLET is required unless you have a Ph.D. that complies with the UGC 2009 Regulations, or a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500 of QS, THE or ARWU.

faq.answer: All seven KAST posts need a Ph.D. with first class or equivalent in every preceding degree. The branches are Software Engineering, Solar PV, Food Technology, Mechanical Engineering and E&CE.

faq.answer: Candidates in the PwD category. Everyone else pays the non-refundable fee online by debit card, credit card or net banking.

faq.answer: Yes, at their own risk. They are considered only if no suitable EWS candidate is available, because EWS vacancies are not carried forward.

faq.question: Q7. How many candidates will be called for interview?
faq.answer: Ordinarily, 20 candidates for one post and 5 more for each additional post. They are ranked on a 100-mark score: 80 for academic record, 10 for research publications and 10 for teaching experience.

faq.question: Q8. Which Ph.D. certificate must I attach?
faq.answer: The Annexure on page 9 of the notice, on your university's letterhead and signed by the Registrar, Dean Academic Affairs or Dean Research. It has one version for Ph.D. registrations before 11 July 2009 and one for registrations on or after that date.

faq.question: Q9. What pension scheme covers selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates are covered by the New Pension Scheme (NPS). They are also bound by IUST's Statutes, Ordinances, Regulations and Rules.

This circular was issued by its General Administration Department, Administration Office Building, Post Box No. 50, Gandhidham (Kutch), Gujarat. The letter is addressed to the Secretaries of all Major Port Authorities, because the post is open only to their officers.

content_sections.text: The Recruitment Rule in Annexure I gives the number of posts as 2 in its "No. of posts" column. Undertaking. It also says this experience requirement does not apply to absorption. faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the Deendayal Port Deputy Chief Engineer post?
faq.answer: Only eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities can apply. They must hold an analogous post or a Superintending Engineer or equivalent post in the Civil Engineering Department, with the service set out in the Recruitment Rule.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 2,20,000. The pre-revised scale was Rs. 16,000 to Rs. 20,800.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an age limit for absorption?
faq.answer: No. The upper age limit of 42 years applies only to direct recruitment. The Recruitment Rule says it does not apply to absorption.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: You need a degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized university/institution. This requirement also applies to absorption.

faq.question: Q5. How much service do I need as Superintending Engineer?
faq.answer: You need three years in the Rs. 13000-18250 grade in a Major Port Trust. Two years in that grade also qualifies if you have a combined seven years in the Rs. 10750-16750 and Rs. 13000-18250 scales.

faq.question: Q6. What ACR grading is required?
faq.answer: Your overall ACR grading must be at least "very good". You must send APARs/ACRs for the last 5 years, with each page attested by an officer not below Dy. HoD rank.

faq.question: Q7. Where do I send the hard copy?
faq.answer: Send it to The Secretary, Deendayal Port Authority, Administrative Office Building, Gandhidham – Kutch, Gujarat - 370201. It must reach there by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Which annexures must go with the application?
faq.answer: Annexure II is the Head of Office certificate. Annexure III is the vigilance clearance proforma, with Part A signed by the HoD and Part B by the CVO.

faq.question: Q9. What happens if I withdraw after selection?
faq.answer: You can be barred from selection to any post in Deendayal Port Authority for two (02) years.

faq.question: Q10. Who approves the final appointment?
faq.answer: The DPC may be held at port level. Its recommendations go to the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways for approval before the appointment order is issued.

content_sections.heading: CUH Technical Assistant (Computer) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 32 years. Age is counted on the closing date of applications, 27 November 2026. Bachelor's Degree in Engineering/ Technology in Computer Science and Technology/ Information Technology from any recognized University or Institute, OR Master's Degree in Computer Science/ Technology/MCA from any recognized University/Institute. At least 02 years of experience in a relevant field in a University/Research establishment/ Central/State Govt./PSU and other autonomous bodies, or a private organisation of repute with an annual turnover of at least Rs. 200/- Crores or more. You must hold the minimum qualification on the closing date of applications. Indian nationals only can apply. SC/ST/OBC/PWD and other reserved categories: relaxation in age, experience and qualifying marks for reserved posts, as per UGC / Govt. of India guidelines. You must attach a certificate from the competent authority. Regular employees of Central Govt./State Govt./Central Universities/UGC-maintained deemed universities/other Central or State autonomous bodies: as per Government of India Rules. Ex-Servicemen: as per Government of India Rules. Group 'C' and erstwhile Group 'D' departmental candidates with three years of continuous regular service in the university: up to 40 years for General candidates and up to 45 years for SC/ST candidates. These people cannot apply: anyone convicted by a court, or facing pending criminal proceedings anyone of unsound mind or questionable conduct, or medically unfit for the duties anyone who has married a person with a living spouse, unless the competent authority grants an exemption anyone who is not a citizen of India For the full eligibility rules for this post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The written test or skill test will follow University norms. There will be no interview, because this is a Group 'C' post (MHRD, now MoE, Letter No. 19-50/2015-Desk-U dated 22.12.2015). Bring all original certificates of age, qualifications and experience to the test. Without them, you may not be allowed to sit the test. The University may keep a waiting list. If a selected candidate does not join within six months, or resigns or dies within one year of joining, the offer goes to the next candidate on merit. An SC/ST/OBC candidate who is selected on the general standard is counted as a merit candidate against an unreserved point. Outstation SC/ST candidates get to-and-fro sleeper-class rail fare by the shortest route. Where there is no rail link, they get ordinary bus fare on showing the ticket. This does not apply to those already in government, PSU or local-body employment. All other candidates attend at their own cost.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Probation follows University norms. You may be posted anywhere within the University's jurisdiction. The New Pension Scheme of the Govt. of India applies, as extended by the UGC. The University's Act, Statutes, Ordinances and Rules apply, along with the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964 and the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965. Before joining, you must give a medical fitness certificate from a Govt. hospital or a Govt./CGHS empanelled hospital, countersigned by the civil surgeon or the Medical Superintendent/Director. The appointment stays provisional until your character and antecedents are verified.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUH Technical Assistant (Computer) Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the CUH Samarth recruitment portal and register or log in. Fill in the application form in full. Your eligibility is judged only on what you enter, and no changes are allowed later. Incomplete forms are rejected. Reserved-category candidates must attach self-attested caste/class certificates. PwBD candidates must attach a disability certificate in the Government of India format. Without these, the application is rejected. Also attach the certificate for any relaxation you claim. Pay the fee if your category has to pay. Submit the form by 05:00 PM on 27.11.2026. Use a separate form for each post. If you are already in service, apply through proper channel with a vigilance clearance certificate. You may send an advance copy. If your employer does not forward the application, bring a No Objection Certificate and the Vigilance Clearance Certificate in a sealed cover to the test. Test call letters and all other messages go only to the email address on your form. Any corrigendum will appear only on the University website. Canvassing of any kind disqualifies you. Disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the Punjab and Haryana High Court.

content_sections.heading: About PFI Analyst - Research
content_sections.text: Power Foundation of India (PFI) is a not-for-profit organisation promoted by leading power sector CPSUs to undertake policy advocacy, capacity building, research, knowledge dissemination, and sectoral development initiatives for the Indian power sector. The organisation functions from its registered office situated at B-28, Qutub Institutional Area, New Delhi 110016.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Analyst – Research position must fulfill the following criteria: Educational Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, preferably in Electrical/Power from a recognized university, and an MBA in Power/Energy/Finance or an M.Tech in an Energy related field. Experience: 2 years of relevant post-qualification professional experience in the power sector, with demonstrated experience in policy research, regulatory analysis, tariff assessment, power markets, or related areas. Applicants must possess experience in analysing power sector policies, regulations, tariff petitions, regulatory orders, and legal judgments, with an understanding of the Indian electricity sector and its regulatory framework. Experience in conducting quantitative and sectoral analysis, preparing research papers, policy notes, reports, and presentations, and providing analytical inputs for policy advocacy and stakeholder consultations is also required. Added Advantage: Exposure to international power sector developments, regulatory practices, and emerging areas such as energy transition, market reforms, and competition will be considered an added advantage. Age Limit: Maximum 28 years as on the closing date of application (30 November 2026). Candidates should refer to the official notification for complete discipline-specific eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be appointed on a regular, full-time basis, subject to satisfactory verification of credentials and fulfillment of the organisation's applicable service rules. The CTC of the selected candidate shall be protected, and an additional increase of 10% to 30% over the existing CTC may be offered as per PFI policy, depending upon qualifications, relevant experience, competencies, and overall suitability. Candidates will also be entitled to PF, gratuity, medical/insurance coverage, and other applicable benefits in accordance with the rules and policies of PFI.

content_sections.heading: PFI Analyst - Research Job Description
content_sections.text: The appointed Analyst – Research will report to the Head- Regulatory and Research. Key responsibilities and performance areas include: Conducting research on key power sector policy and regulatory issues, including power markets, retail competition, parallel licensing, contracts for difference, and emerging areas. Preparing policy notes, research papers, analytical reports, briefing notes, and presentations based on detailed research and analysis. Monitoring and analysing policies, regulations, guidelines, and orders issued by MoP, CERC, CEA, SERCs, and other relevant authorities. Examining tariff petitions and regulatory filings of GENCOs, TRANSCOs, and DISCOMs, including assessment of tariff structures, cost components, and financial implications. Tracking and analysing judgments and orders of the Supreme Court, High Courts, and APTEL to assess their implications for the power sector and stakeholders. Compiling, analysing, and interpreting regulatory, tariff, financial, and sectoral data to support evidence-based policy research and decision-making. Undertaking comparative research on international practices and regulatory frameworks and assessing their applicability to the Indian power sector. Supporting stakeholder consultations, workshops, expert discussions, and industry interactions on power sector and regulatory matters. Contributing to policy advocacy and preparing comments, submissions, and recommendations on key regulatory and policy issues. Developing and maintaining a strong understanding of the technical, regulatory, commercial, financial, and energy-transition dimensions of the power sector. Supporting the preparation of PFI presentations, reports, knowledge products, and other research outputs for internal and external stakeholders. Providing research, analytical, and cross-functional support to the Regulatory & Research Division and undertaking other assignments as required.

content_sections.heading: About IARI
content_sections.text: ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (IARI) is located at Pusa, New Delhi-110012. Its Division of Agricultural Engineering is filling this post under the project "Development of an AI-based robotic precision transplanter for onion crop". The project is funded by DST, Ministry of Science and Technology, GOI.

content_sections.heading: IARI Junior Research Fellow Vacancy Details 2026
IARI Junior Research Fellow Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be at least 18 and at most 35 years old. The application form asks for age as on the date of the interview. Under Govt. of India/ICAR Rules, the upper age limit is relaxed as follows: M.Tech./M.E. (Agricultural Engineering/Mechanical/Electronics Engineering/Manufacturing Engineering) with a 4/5 years Bachelor's degree. Candidates should also have qualified NET (ICAR/UGC/CSIR) or GATE, with two years of research experience. Expertise in agro-machine fabrication CAD for mechanical/electronic circuit development Computer programming: C, Python and Android Application programming Only candidates with the essential qualifications will be interviewed. Candidates who cannot show their essential degree completion certificate by the date of the interview cannot attend. For the full eligibility details, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by interview. The notice says eligible candidates may attend an offline interview on 23 November 2026 at 10:00 AM in the Conference Room, Division of Agricultural Engineering, IARI, Pusa, New Delhi. The institute will also tell applicants the mode of interview in advance by email or SMS, so applicants must have a working email address and mobile number. If candidates are given online slots, they must be available in their slot. Candidates who do not respond after repeated calls may not ordinarily be considered. The decision of the Joint Director (Research), ICAR-IARI, New Delhi will be final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis. It ends with the project. It is offered initially for one year, or until the project tenure ends or the project is terminated, whichever is earlier. It can be extended for the rest of the project if performance is satisfactory. Selected candidates cannot claim a regular appointment or absorption in IARI or ICAR. Indiscipline or failure to carry out assigned duties can lead to termination under ICAR rules. The JRF gets no regular leave. CL and RH are allowed up to (8+2) = 10 days a year. The JRF is a full-time worker and must follow the administrative, financial and disciplinary rules of ICAR-IARI. Attendance is recorded in an attendance register.

content_sections.heading: About NTTM
content_sections.text: The National Technical Textiles Mission is run under the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, and has its own Mission Directorate. The Ministry's office named in the notice is at GPOA-3, Netaji Nagar, New Delhi. Both posts are with the Mission and are filled from officers on deputation.

content_sections.heading: NTTM Joint Mission Director and Deputy Mission Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: For Joint Mission Director, Level 13 applies to officers drawing the Level 12 pay scale in their parent cadre. Level 13A applies to those drawing Level 13. The pay of officers selected on deputation will be regulated by the relevant instructions of the Department of Personnel & Training, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: NTTM Joint Mission Director and Deputy Mission Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: For both posts, the maximum age for appointment by deputation or absorption must not exceed 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Who can apply: Officers of the Central Government who hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their cadre or department, or who are in Level 13 or equivalent, or who are in Level 12 with three years' regular service in the grade (or equivalent) in their parent cadre or department. Qualifying (mandatory): a Masters Degree in Science/Technology, or a B Tech/BE in Textile with at least 5 years' experience in Technical Textiles. Desirable: a Ph.D in the relevant subject, and at least 3 years' experience in any Scientific/Technology Mission. Who can apply: Officers of the Central Government, Autonomous Bodies or Statutory Bodies who hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their cadre, department or organisation, or who have three years' regular service in the grade at Level 10 or equivalent in their parent cadre, department or organisation. Required: relevant experience in implementing Government Schemes. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for each post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Appointment is on deputation. The deputation period, including any time on deputation in another ex-cadre post held just before this appointment in the same or another Central Government organisation or department, lasts up to 31 March 2028. The posting is with the National Technical Textiles Mission under the Ministry of Textiles. Once an officer applies, they cannot withdraw their candidature. When forwarding the application, the forwarding authority must confirm that the officer will be relieved of their duties to join the Ministry of Textiles if selected.

faq.answer: Applications are due within 60 days of the O.M.'s issue date. Counted from the O.M. dated 27 October 2026, that is 26 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About RECPDCL
content_sections.text: REC Power Development and Consultancy Limited, formerly REC Power Distribution Company Limited, is a wholly owned subsidiary of REC Ltd., a "Maharatna CPSE" under the Ministry of Power, Government of India. It provides consultancy across the power sector. Its work includes project management consultancy, smart metering, smart grid, solar projects, third-party quality inspection, energy audit, DPRs and power transmission projects. It also works with Government of India schemes such as R-APDRP, IPDS, PMDP, RFMS and NFMS.

content_sections.heading: NIELIT Director General Job Description
content_sections.text: Shall be responsible for planning, management and running of NIELIT under the overall guidance of the Governing Council; Shall be required to lead a group of professionally qualified team of IECT & management personnel at NIELIT Centres and Managers of all Institutes accredited for ‘O’, ‘A’, ‘B’ & ‘C’ level courses; Will interact with leading IT Education and Training Experts / Officers from Academia, Industry and Government; Shall be responsible for preparation of five Year Plans, Annual Plans, budget etc., of the Society and its Centres, apart from developing new education and training programmes in the emerging areas of IECT for implementation in the non-formal sector. Shall exercise such administrative and financial powers as contained in the NIELIT’s Memorandum of Association, Rules & Regulations, or as delegated to him by the Governing Council from time to time. Shall be the Member Secretary of the Governing Council.

basic_details.short_information: New Mangalore Port Authority (NMPA) Marine Department has invited applications for engagement to the post of Assistant Manager (VTS) on a contract basis at Panambur, Mangalore. Eligible candidates possessing the required qualifications and experience must submit their applications in the prescribed format along with copies of self-attested documents to the Deputy Conservator, New Mangalore Port Authority, Panambur, Mangalore – 575 010. The last date for receipt of applications is on or before 20-11-2026.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for the position is 35 years. The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience, age etc. shall be as on first day for the month in which applications were invited.

qualification.details: Degree in Electrical and Electronics or Electronics and Communications Engineering from a recognized University. | Minimum 2 years work experience in Electrical / Electronic Works. | Candidates having experience in electrical installation, operation & maintenance of Marine communication equipment like VHF, Radar, AIS, DSC, MF/HF Radios etc. Proficient in M.S Office (Word, Excel and Power point). Candidates having work experience in Port sector. | The maximum age limit for the position is 35 years. The crucial date for determining eligibility criteria, educational qualification, experience, age etc. shall be as on first day for the month in which applications were invited.

salary_details.details: The consolidated pay for Assistant Manager (VTS) on contract basis is ₹50,000/-. An increment of 5% on consolidated monthly of remuneration would be considered for every completed year of service, subject to satisfactory performance. The tenure of the engagement shall be for a period of 03 years from the date of joining the duty/service, extendable by 02 years on mutual consent. Your engagement is purely on contract basis and shall not confer you any right to lay claim for permanent absorption in the port service, against any post whatsoever.

selection_process: The candidates possessing requisite qualification and relevant experience will be called for interview. Eligible candidates will be called for interview through e-mail only. The date
time and venue of interview will be informed accordingly. NMPA reserves the right to fix the minimum standard / qualifying marks for selection of position.
important_instructions: The selected candidate shall execute a security bond, before joining to the post, on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹200/-. An amount of ₹5,000/- (Rupees Five thousand only) per month will be retained from your salary, subject to a maximum of ₹50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) and will be refunded after completion of the contract period without any interest. The duration of working hours will be as per office hours with weekly off on Saturday & Sunday. In exigencies, he/she may require to work beyond officer hours/holidays for which no extra remuneration will be paid. The selected candidate will be permitted to avail 15 days of Casual Leave in a calendar year with the prior permission of the competent authority. No provision exists for the encashment of the non-availed portion of the Casual Leave or for carrying forward the said leave to the next calendar year. In case of absence in excess of 15 days, payment will be subject to proportionate reduction of salary. Entitled to avail free medical facility at Srinivas Port Hospital, Panambur, Mangalore for self with dependent spouse and children to the extent of the In-house facilities available in the hospital. Port accommodation will be provided subject to availability at rent as per NMPA policy, which will be deducted from the consolidated pay. In addition, allied charges such as water charges & Electricity charges shall have to be borne by occupant. For joining the post, no Travelling Allowance will be paid. However, the TA/DA will be paid for official tour during the contract period, as applicable to the regular officers of the equal rank in the port with the same basic pay. No office vehicle will be provided for attending duty at headquarters. Hence, you should make your own arrangement of transportation for attending duty headquarters at Panambur, Mangalore. - NMPA reserves the right to terminate your contract appointment at any point of time by giving one month’s notice without any liability. In the event of misconduct, the contract appointment can be terminated by the port without any notice and without assigning any reason. In case the selected candidate wish to leave the contract appointment at NMPA, he/she shall be required to give one month advance notice in writing. The candidates shall have good health condition, and the original documents should be submitted at the time of interview for verification.

basic_details.short_information: BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB), Thiruvananthapuram, has 8 technical posts to fill: 2 Technical Officer posts, 3 Technical Assistant Group II posts and 3 Technical Assistant Group I posts. Indian citizens up to 35 years of age can apply, as long as they have at least one year of documented work experience in a government research institution, PSU, autonomous body or university. You can apply only online, there is no application fee, and the portal closes at 17.00 hrs on 14 December 2026. Selection is through a three-tier examination held only in Thiruvananthapuram.

content_sections.heading: About RGCB
content_sections.text: BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology is a biotechnology research institute at Thycaud Post, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. According to the notice, RGCB has sophisticated scientific equipment that supports research across several divisions, along with technology development units and core facilities. These technical posts provide the hands-on support behind that work.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: The Technical Officer provides hands-on engineering support to research laboratories, technology development units and institutional facilities. The post needs practical expertise in biomedical instrumentation, electronics, embedded systems and field-level engineering work. The duties include, but are not limited to: installing, operating, maintaining, calibrating and troubleshooting biomedical, electronic and laboratory instruments hardware prototyping, PCB design, circuit debugging, sensor integration and embedded system development for research and translational projects calibration, reliability testing and quality checks of scientific equipment supporting field deployments, mobile laboratory operations and outreach programmes, including installation, testing and user training preparing technical documentation, equipment specifications and procurement notes for engineering components coordinating installation, AMC and compliance of procured systems supporting IT-enabled systems, communication interfaces and sensor-based monitoring platforms training students, researchers and project staff on instrument handling, safety procedures and good operating practice reporting equipment status, updates and replacements in real time, and maintaining all equipment on site The job description also asks for excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical problems and propose solutions. This post provides day-to-day laboratory and research support across RGCB's scientific divisions. The duties include: routine laboratory procedures, preparing reagents and buffers, and handling biological and chemical samples assisting scientists with experimental workflows and recording observations accurately operating and maintaining centrifuges, spectrophotometers, incubators, electrophoresis units, microscopes and PCR systems keeping equipment calibrated and clean, and documenting its use sample processing, biochemical and molecular assays, and maintaining cell culture materials where required managing laboratory inventories and stocks, and following safety protocols and biomedical waste disposal norms giving technical help to students and project staff, and coordinating sample submissions with core facilities This post helps with routine work in scientific, clinical and molecular laboratories. The duties include: supporting the Laboratory-in-Charge in day-to-day work keeping the designated laboratory sections running smoothly maintaining laboratory records ensuring safety, hygiene, autoclave and waste disposal compliance general administrative and support work: keeping work logs, processing orders, indents or invoices, and simple clerical and accounting tasks tasks given by the Competent Authority

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: There is no application fee for any of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: First, an Institutional Screening Committee checks every application against the minimum qualifications. Applications that do not meet them are rejected without further correspondence. Meeting the requirements does not on its own guarantee a place in the selection process. Shortlisted candidates take a three-tier examination, held only in Thiruvananthapuram. Candidates are shortlisted for Tier III based on their combined Tier I and Tier II score (maximum 300 marks). The designated authority decides the cut-off. The list for Tier III is published on the RGCB website and on the notice board at the Main Campus, and no individual messages are sent. Tier III is a qualifying Pass/Fail practical test based on the job description. If you have applied for more than one post, you take a separate skills test for each one. The final merit list ranks candidates who passed Tier III by their total Tier I and Tier II score. Results are published on the Institute's website, and successful candidates are informed by email. At every tier you must bring the RGCB Admit Card and one valid Government of India identity card: Aadhaar Card, Passport, PAN Card, Voter ID or Driving Licence. If you cannot show both, you will be disqualified on the spot.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates can be posted to any office or branch of the Institute anywhere in India, as administrative needs require. Appointment orders are issued following the procedures used in Autonomous Institutes of the Government of India. The Institute may withdraw any or all advertised posts at any time without giving a reason. Any canvassing leads to automatic disqualification.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply with a Plus Two qualification?
faq.answer: Yes. You can apply for Technical Assistant Group I (Pay Level 2) if you passed Plus Two / Higher Secondary / VHSE or equivalent with First Class and have one year of documented work experience.

faq.question: Q2. Which degrees are accepted for the Technical Officer post?
faq.answer: A First Class B.E./B.Tech. in Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering or Electronics & Communication Engineering, or a First Class M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Physics or Chemistry. You also need two years of experience.

faq.question: Q3. Does private-sector experience count?
faq.answer: No. The experience must be documented work in the relevant field at Central or State Government research institutions, PSUs, Autonomous Bodies or Universities.

faq.question: Q4. Is there negative marking in the exam?
faq.answer: Yes, in Tier I only. Each wrong answer costs 0.50 marks, and each correct answer earns 2 marks.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the exams be held?
faq.answer: All three tiers, for every post, are held only in Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, but you must submit a separate application for each post. If shortlisted, you take a separate Tier III skills test for each.

faq.question: Q7. Which posts have OBC and EWS vacancies?
faq.answer: Technical Assistant Group II has 1 OBC and 1 EWS post. Technical Assistant Group I has 1 OBC post. Both Technical Officer posts are UR.

faq.question: Q8. How will I know if I am shortlisted for Tier III?
faq.answer: The list is published on the RGCB website and on the notice board at the Main Campus. No individual emails are sent at that stage.

faq.question: Q9. I am a government employee. What extra do I need?
faq.answer: Apply online, and send the hard copy through proper channel. Otherwise, bring an NOC from your employer to the selection process. You cannot attend without it.

content_sections.heading: About IRCON
content_sections.text: IRCON International Limited calls itself a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways. It builds turnkey infrastructure projects in Railways, Highways, Buildings, the Power sector and other areas, in India and abroad. Its registered office is at C-4, District Centre, Saket, New Delhi – 110 017. These posts are for its Northeast Frontier Railway (NFR) Projects under the Lumding and Tinsukia Divisions.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The only post is Manager/Electrical – on contract. It has 37 vacancies, and the notice divides them by category as shown below. The notice says the number of posts may change after a further assessment of requirement. Full Time Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering with not less than 60% marks or equivalent grade from recognized University/ Institute approved by AICTE/UGC, as on 01.10.2026. The percentage is taken from the consolidated mark sheet issued by the University/Institution. If the university or institute does not issue a consolidated mark sheet, the final percentage is the average of all semesters/years. Candidates must write their percentage without rounding it off. If the mark sheets show CGPA/OGPA/DGPA: If the university/institute has no rule for converting CGPA/OGPA/CPI/DGPA or a letter grade into a percentage, a minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale is treated as 60%. A score on any other scale is prorated. If the university/institute does provide a conversion, the candidate gives the equivalent percentage using that institution's norms. A certificate to this effect may be obtained from the university/institute, and it must be produced at the time of verification. Candidates need at least five years of experience after their qualification, as on 01.10.2026. The experience must be in Electrical construction, Procurement, Installation, Testing and commissioning/TRD Maintenance in Railways, Metro Rail or Power Transmission/Distribution utilities. Experience in Railway OHE/Power Supply/SCADA, E&M or Electrical utility Diversion will be preferred. Teaching, training, consultancy or freelancing experience does not count as relevant experience. The maximum age is 50 years as on 01.10.2026. Age relaxations follow the Government of India's guidelines, as long as the candidate has the required qualification and experience. Candidates should be in sound health and free from colour blindness. No relaxation in health standards will be allowed. Candidates can apply whether or not they are working on the cut-off date, as long as they have the essential qualification and post-qualification experience. Ex-contract employees of IRCON whose services ended because their projects closed can also apply if they meet these requirements. They must send a copy of their termination letter with the application, and the new appointment will be a fresh appointment with no link to their earlier employment in IRCON. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Contract Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: a fixed consolidated pay of Rs. 60,000/- per month, plus an annual increment of 5% on the fixed consolidated pay after each completed year of service. There are no allowances on top of the fixed pay. Contract period: initially 18 months, subject to satisfactory performance. The contract may be extended for another year if the candidate's services are satisfactory and the Project requires it. The posts are only for the NFR Projects under the Lumding and Tinsukia Divisions and not for IRCON's regular establishment. The appointment is co-terminus with the Project and gives no right to claim absorption into the regular establishment or appointment in other projects of the company. Medical cover: contract employees must take a Medical Health Insurance Policy of Rs Three Lakhs for themselves, covering Covid-19 and other diseases, with a premium ceiling of Rs 4000/- per annum. The premium is reimbursed when the employee submits a copy of the policy and the original premium receipt. PF: the minimum PF prescribed under the EPF & MP Act 1952 is deducted from the salary, and IRCON makes a matching contribution. The accumulated amount is paid when the contract ends. Leave: one leave for each calendar month of service. Leave can be carried forward and accumulated, but unused leave is not encashed during the contract or on resignation or termination. No other type of leave is admissible. Employees get one weekly off and the public holidays on which the project office is closed. Working hours, working days and offs are the same as for the Project. TA/DA is admissible if the employee is deputed on outstation duty. No other perks or benefits are admissible.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must bring the originals and one set of photocopies of the following: The application, typed on A-4 size paper in the format attached to the notice. The format asks for personal and contact details, community, whether any relative works or has worked in IRCON, last/present organisation, academic and professional qualifications with marks, and work experience as on 01-10-2026. It also needs a self-attested passport-size photograph and the signed declaration. Experience certificates in chronological order. Candidates in a current job must also bring the last two months' salary slips from their present employer, because an offer letter alone is not accepted as proof of experience. Date of birth/Class X passing certificate as proof of date of birth. Caste certificate/EWS certificate/age relaxation certificate, in the format prescribed by the Government of India's guidelines. Qualification degree/diploma and the mark sheets of all semesters/years, so that the percentage in the qualifying degree can be calculated. For ex-contract employees of IRCON: a copy of the termination letter. OBC candidates need a caste certificate issued by the competent authority for appointment to services under the Government of India, in the Annexure-A format attached to the notice. Only an OBC certificate issued in the current financial year will be accepted as proof of not belonging to the "creamy layer".

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Registration opens at 09:30 am at the venue for that date. Candidates can register up to 1:00 pm only. Interviews start at 10:00 AM. Only candidates who meet the eligibility criteria will be interviewed. Candidates must bring the original certificates proving their age, community, educational qualifications and experience. Without them, the interview will not be held. Depending on how many candidates register, the process may take more than one day, so candidates should plan their travel with this in mind. Requests to change the date, time or location will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About INFLIBNET Centre
content_sections.text: The notice describes the INFLIBNET Centre as an Autonomous Inter University Centre of the University Grants Commission, with its headquarters at Gandhinagar, Gujarat. The Centre runs programmes to modernise libraries and information centres in universities, colleges, institutes of higher learning and R & D institutes in India using computer and communication technology. Its major programmes include ONOS, Infistats, INFED, Shodhgangotri, Shodh-Chakra, Vidwan, Vidya-Mitra, IRINS, NIRF and SOUL, along with several other national-level projects.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Centre reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of posts and to fill or not fill some or all of them.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals may apply. Qualifications must be from a recognised university, board or institution. Experience and qualification are counted as on the last date for submitting the online application (as amended, if any, on the INFLIBNET website). Essential: A Bachelor's degree of a recognized university with at least second class with five years experience in the field of Purchase & Stores/Accounts/Establishment in a Univ./Govt./Autonomous Body/reputed private Firm. Desirable: (1) B.Com/M.Com; (2) Knowledge of Tally accounting software, PFMS, TDS/GST, Audit procedure/rules, Financial Statements. Where a post requires experience, only relevant experience gained after the prescribed qualification is counted. Relaxation or concession is as per Govt. of India rules/Bye-laws of the Centre, if any. A candidate with a foreign university's degree must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU) with the application. A candidate whose degree comes from a university that uses a grading system must give the equivalency criteria, or the formula or method, for converting the score into a percentage and Class/Division. A candidate whose degree, diploma or certificate is from an institution declared fake or de-recognised by the University Grants Commission, AICTE or another competent authority is not eligible for any post. A person dismissed by the Union Government, a State Government, a Local Authority, or a Government Corporation owned or controlled by the Central or a State Government is ineligible for appointment. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official INFLIBNET notification.

basic_details.short_information: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC), Prayagraj has released two notifications on 23 October 2026 to fill Principal (Pradhanacharya) and Headmaster (Pradhanadhyapak) posts in aided non-government schools under the Secondary Education Department, Uttar Pradesh. Advertisement No. 08/2026 covers 1,475 Principal vacancies and Advertisement No. 09/2026 covers 1,172 Headmaster vacancies, making 2,647 posts in total. Online applications for both posts started on 23 October 2026 on the official website www.upessc.up.gov.in.

application_fee.details: The fee can be paid by credit card, debit card or net banking through the online payment gateway on the portal, right after registration. When paying by card or net banking, the payment is valid only after the bank confirms it. Keep the fee receipt safe after payment. A candidate who does not complete the application by the last date after One Time Registration and payment will not have the application accepted. Once the fee is paid, it will not be refunded in any situation and it will not be adjusted against another application.

age_limit.details: Applications without a date of birth, or from candidates who are over 62 years of age on 1 July 2026, will not be accepted. Only the date of birth recorded in the High School or equivalent certificate is valid. No other document is accepted as proof of date of birth. The notification does not give any age relaxation for any category.

A candidate who applies with less than the required qualification is solely responsible for the consequences. The Commission's decision on a candidate's eligibility or ineligibility is final. | A postgraduate (Master's) degree with at least 50% marks from a university, deemed university or institution established by law in India or recognised by the Government. A Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) degree from a course recognised by NCTE. At least 4 years of teaching experience as Lecturer or Assistant Teacher in higher classes (Class 9 to 12) of an institution recognised by the Central or State Government, or at least 4 years of experience as Headmaster in a High School, issued by the competent authority. | A postgraduate (Master's) degree with at least 50% marks from a university, deemed university or institution established by law in India or recognised by the Government. A Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) or B.P.Ed. degree from a course recognised by NCTE. At least 4 years of teaching experience as Lecturer or Assistant Teacher in higher classes (Class 9 to 12) of an institution recognised by the Central or State Government, or at least 4 years of experience as Headmaster in a Junior High School, issued by the competent authority. | For experience certificates, "competent authority" means a certificate issued by the district-level officer and countersigned by the divisional officer. For Kendriya Vidyalayas, the competent authority is the Regional Officer. The issued experience certificates will be maintained by the concerned office. | The format of the experience certificate is given in Appendix-2 of the notification. | The Commission does not give separate advice on eligibility. Candidates should read the notification carefully and apply only after they are satisfied that they meet the conditions. Candidates must have a health condition and physical fitness that allow them to perform their duties efficiently. Before final selection, the Commission will ask for a health certificate from a government hospital or primary health centre, issued by a medical officer as per rules. No male candidate is eligible for appointment as Principal in a girls' institution. Both notifications carry this clause with the wording "Principal" (Pradhanacharya). Female candidates are eligible for both boys' and girls' schools, but must choose only one category (boys' or girls') while filling the application. A candidate who is married and has more than one living spouse, or who has married a person who already has a living spouse, is not eligible unless the Governor has exempted the candidate from this restriction. Candidates must state clearly whether any case is pending against them in a court of law, and whether they have been punished or not. If information is hidden or wrongly given and this later comes to the Commission's notice, the candidature or selection will be cancelled. Candidates working in a job must obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer, to be produced when the Commission asks for it at the time of interview.
