selection_process: Stage Details Marks
Written examination 120 objective-type (multiple choice) questions, duration 2 hours 360
Interview For candidates shortlisted on the basis of written exam marks 40
Total 400

Selection for both posts is based on a total of 400 marks: a written examination of 360 marks and an interview of 40 marks. The final merit list is prepared from the marks obtained out of these 400 marks.
Every question has four options
of which only one is the most suitable answer. The answer bubble must be darkened with a black ball point pen on the OMR sheet. The question paper will be in Hindi and English
except for language subjects. Each correct answer carries 3 marks. For every wrong or multiple answer

1 mark is deducted (negative marking). The cut-off and marks obtained by candidates will be displayed on the Commission's website after the selection process is complete. The syllabus for the written examination is available on www.upessc.up.gov.in.
If more than one candidate has equal merit
marks are compared in this order:
Marks in the written examination. If still equal
marks obtained in the interview. If still equal
the highest percentage in the postgraduate degree. If still equal
marks in B.Ed. (Principal) or B.Ed./B.P.Ed. (Headmaster). If the written exam
interview
postgraduate and B.Ed. (or B.Ed./B.P.Ed.) percentages are all equal
the older candidate is placed higher.

Exam centres will be fixed as required at district headquarters. A candidate can be allotted any centre. The district of the exam centre will be shown on the website 10 days before the exam date. The admit card with centre details can be downloaded through the link on the Commission's website 3 days before the exam. Candidates will be informed by SMS
e-mail

newspaper and website or portal. The admit card can be downloaded from www.upessc.up.gov.in using the "Admit Card Download" button with registration number or mobile number and date of birth. Candidates must appear only at the centre allotted to them. Change of exam centre is not allowed. If a candidate takes the exam at a centre other than the one printed on the admit card
the answer sheet will not be evaluated and the candidature will be cancelled.
Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date
time and place by SMS

newspaper and the Commission's website at least 10 days in advance. The interview letter can be downloaded from www.upessc.up.gov.in. Candidates declared successful for the interview must be present. They must submit an affidavit in the format given in Appendix-3 on the interview date. The interview date cannot be changed. If the Commission changes it due to unavoidable circumstances
candidates will be informed by SMS
portal or website. No daily allowance or travel allowance is payable for the written exam or the interview.
Shortlisted candidates must bring two separate sets of self-attested photocopies of the following
along with the originals for verification in order. If the originals are not brought
the interview will not be held and the candidate is fully responsible.

Two self-attested copies of the online application form. High School marksheet and certificate (two self-attested copies each). Intermediate marksheet and certificate (two self-attested copies each). Graduation first
second and third year marksheets and degree (two self-attested copies each). B.Ed. marksheet and degree (Principal); B.Ed./B.P.Ed. marksheet and degree (Headmaster)

two self-attested copies each. Postgraduate first and second year marksheets and degree (two self-attested copies each). Original and self-attested copy of the experience certificate issued by the competent authority (Appendix-2). Original and self-attested copy of the No Objection Certificate. Two self-attested copies of the disability certificate (Appendix-1)

if applicable. Two copies of the affidavit (Appendix-3). Two self-attested copies of the character certificate from the last educational institution. Two self-attested copies of character certificates given by two respectable persons. An affidavit stating whether any case is pending in the Hon'ble Court
and whether the candidate has been punished or not
in case of any pending case.
Documents not related to the candidate need not be attached. The formats for Appendix-1

how_to_apply: The notification gives the following application process. Only online applications through the Commission's OTR-based system are accepted. Applications sent by any other means will not be accepted.
Visit the official website www.upessc.up.gov.in.
Complete One Time Registration (OTR). Registration is compulsory before applying.
Read the User Manual (Hindi and English) and watch the tutorial videos available on the website before applying.
Fill the registration and application form in English only.
Upload your scanned signature on a white background and a passport-size photograph, both in JPG or JPEG format with a file size between 10 KB and 100 KB.
Upload certificates and documents in PDF format, with a file size between 20 KB and 200 KB.
Pay the application fee online as per your post (₹2,000 for Principal, ₹1,500 for Headmaster).
Submit the application. Take three printouts for future use and keep the fee receipt safe.
The notification does not give a direct application link or screen-by-screen steps. Candidates should use the official website and the User Manual.
After the application is finally submitted, no change is allowed in category, sub-category, date of birth, gender and similar details. Fill in all details correctly while registering and submitting.
A chance to correct errors will be given until the date fixed by the Commission (25 November 2026). Fees paid for an erroneous application will not be refunded.
If a candidate submits more than one application for the same post, only the last application is accepted and all others are treated as cancelled.
An application will be rejected if the photograph or signature is not uploaded in the prescribed size, or if the declaration is not accepted.

If the declaration made in the application is found to be false, the candidate's candidature will be cancelled. The candidate may be debarred from this and all other selections/examinations and face other penal action.

If at any stage it comes to light that a candidate has hidden information or filled it wrongly, the candidature will be cancelled and the candidate may be debarred from future examinations/selections.
Candidates must keep three copies of the submitted application. Two copies must be submitted to the Commission office at the time of interview, with two separate sets of the documents.
A candidate who tries to cheat, shows indiscipline or misbehaves in the exam hall can have candidature cancelled and may be barred from future examinations.

Bring a black ball point pen to the exam hall. Use only black ball point pen to fill the boxes and bubbles on the OMR sheet. Blue or other colour ball pens, fountain pens, gel pens, sketch pens, H.B. pencils and whitener are prohibited.
Once a bubble is darkened, no change is accepted. If more than one bubble is darkened for a question, it will not be evaluated and no marks are given.
Use of eraser, nail, blade or whitener on the OMR sheet is prohibited. An OMR sheet damaged in any way will be cancelled and not evaluated.

Fill the required information on the OMR sheet correctly and darken only the related bubbles. Do not make any other mark such as dots or ink marks. If the OMR sheet is not evaluated because of a mistake, the candidate is solely responsible.
Candidates can download the OMR answer sheet format from the Commission's website and practise before the exam.

Candidates with disabilities will be given a scribe as per the Government Orders dated 4 December 2019 and 8 September 2022. The scribe must be brought by the candidate. Such candidates must get the written exam scribe details registered at the Commission office at least one week before the exam. An additional 20 minutes per hour is allowed. No travel allowance is paid to the scribe.

content_sections.heading: UPESSC Principal Headmaster Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for both posts is based on a total of 400 marks: a written examination of 360 marks and an interview of 40 marks. The final merit list is prepared from the marks obtained out of these 400 marks. Every question has four options, of which only one is the most suitable answer. The answer bubble must be darkened with a black ball point pen on the OMR sheet. The question paper will be in Hindi and English, except for language subjects. Each correct answer carries 3 marks. For every wrong or multiple answer, 1 mark is deducted (negative marking). The cut-off and marks obtained by candidates will be displayed on the Commission's website after the selection process is complete. The syllabus for the written examination is available on www.upessc.up.gov.in. If more than one candidate has equal merit, marks are compared in this order: Marks in the written examination. If still equal, marks obtained in the interview. If still equal, the highest percentage in the postgraduate degree. If still equal, marks in B.Ed. (Principal) or B.Ed./B.P.Ed. (Headmaster). If the written exam, interview, postgraduate and B.Ed. (or B.Ed./B.P.Ed.) percentages are all equal, the older candidate is placed higher. Exam centres will be fixed as required at district headquarters. A candidate can be allotted any centre. The district of the exam centre will be shown on the website 10 days before the exam date. The admit card with centre details can be downloaded through the link on the Commission's website 3 days before the exam. Candidates will be informed by SMS, e-mail, newspaper and website or portal. The admit card can be downloaded from www.upessc.up.gov.in using the "Admit Card Download" button with registration number or mobile number and date of birth. Candidates must appear only at the centre allotted to them. Change of exam centre is not allowed. If a candidate takes the exam at a centre other than the one printed on the admit card, the answer sheet will not be evaluated and the candidature will be cancelled. Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the interview date, time and place by SMS, e-mail, newspaper and the Commission's website at least 10 days in advance. The interview letter can be downloaded from www.upessc.up.gov.in. Candidates declared successful for the interview must be present. They must submit an affidavit in the format given in Appendix-3 on the interview date. The interview date cannot be changed. If the Commission changes it due to unavoidable circumstances, candidates will be informed by SMS, e-mail, portal or website. No daily allowance or travel allowance is payable for the written exam or the interview. Shortlisted candidates must bring two separate sets of self-attested photocopies of the following, along with the originals for verification in order. If the originals are not brought, the interview will not be held and the candidate is fully responsible. Two self-attested copies of the online application form. High School marksheet and

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UPESSC Principal Headmaster Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification gives the following application process. Only online applications through the Commission's OTR-based system are accepted. Applications sent by any other means will not be accepted. Visit the official website www.upessc.up.gov.in. Complete One Time Registration (OTR). Registration is compulsory before applying. Read the User Manual (Hindi and English) and watch the tutorial videos available on the website before applying. Fill the registration and application form in English only. Upload your scanned signature on a white background and a passport-size photograph, both in JPG or JPEG format with a file size between 10 KB and 100 KB. Upload certificates and documents in PDF format, with a file size between 20 KB and 200 KB. Pay the application fee online as per your post (₹2,000 for Principal, ₹1,500 for Headmaster). Submit the application. Take three printouts for future use and keep the fee receipt safe. The notification does not give a direct application link or screen-by-screen steps. Candidates should use the official website and the User Manual. After the application is finally submitted, no change is allowed in category, sub-category, date of birth, gender and similar details. Fill in all details correctly while registering and submitting. A chance to correct errors will be given until the date fixed by the Commission (25 November 2026). Fees paid for an erroneous application will not be refunded. If a candidate submits more than one application for the same post, only the last application is accepted and all others are treated as cancelled. An application will be rejected if the photograph or signature is not uploaded in the prescribed size, or if the declaration is not accepted. If the declaration made in the application is found to be false, the candidate's candidature will be cancelled. The candidate may be debarred from this and all other selections/examinations and face other penal action. If at any stage it comes to light that a candidate has hidden information or filled it wrongly, the candidature will be cancelled and the candidate may be debarred from future examinations/selections. Candidates must keep three copies of the submitted application. Two copies must be submitted to the Commission office at the time of interview, with two separate sets of the documents. A candidate who tries to cheat, shows indiscipline or misbehaves in the exam hall can have candidature cancelled and may be barred from future examinations. Bring a black ball point pen to the exam hall. Use only black ball point pen to fill the boxes and bubbles on the OMR sheet. Blue or other colour ball pens, fountain pens, gel pens, sketch pens, H.B. pencils and whitener are prohibited. Once a bubble is darkened, no change is accepted. If more than one bubble is darkened for a question, it will not be evaluated and no marks are given. Use of eraser, nail, blade or whitener on the OMR sheet is prohibited. An OMR sheet damaged in any way will be cancelle

content_sections.text: Allotment of schools to selected candidates is done by the authorised officer, the Director, Secondary Education, U.P., Prayagraj. The Commission will conduct the written exam and interview for the Principal and Headmaster posts in aided non-government schools (boys/girls). Appearing in the written exam or even succeeding in it does not make a candidate finally eligible for selection as Principal or Headmaster. Candidates must confirm for themselves that they meet the minimum qualifications. The Commission will provisionally allow candidates into the written exam on the basis of the information given, but if it is found later that the candidate is not eligible or the application should not have been accepted at the initial stage, the candidature will be cancelled. If a recommendation has already been made for appointment, it will be withdrawn. In a dispute, the candidate must first make a representation to the Commission.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: This research project operates under the Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering at the Indian Institute of Technology, Roorkee, with sponsorship from the Armament Research Board, DRDO, Delhi. The appointed Junior Research Fellow will support systematic experimental investigations into the structural behaviour of unaged and aged sandwich composites for armament applications. Selected candidates will get an opportunity to pursue a PhD once the project is over (PhD candidate will be given MHRD fellowship as per Institute Policy).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow position must meet the following educational qualifications: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engg./Production Engg./Aerospace Engg./Equivalent. ME/M.Tech in Machine Design/Applied Mechanics/Aerospace Engg./Equivalent. GATE qualified candidates will be preferred. Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The project aims at a systematic investigation of the structural behaviour of unaged and aged sandwich composites for armament applications. A systematic experimental approach will be employed to characterize Nomex, PMI foam, and PVC foam core sandwich composites. Hygroscopically aged specimens will be evaluated to verify moisture resistance and its detrimental effect on the mechanical properties. Delamination behavior will be examined under Mode-I and Mode-II loading for both aged and unaged samples. The fatigue performance of various aged sandwich composite samples will be assessed and benchmarked against unaged Nomex, PMI and PVC core-based sandwich composites.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Roorkee Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Candidates should submit their applications with the following documents to the office of Principal Investigator through email as a Single PDF file in the following order: Application in a plain paper with detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained. Experience including research, industrial field and others. Attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate. Submit the application via email to the Principal Investigator (Prof. Indra Vir Singh) at [email protected] or [email protected] by November 15, 2026, by 5 PM.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates before appearing for the interview shall ensure that they are eligible for the position. Only the shortlisted candidates will be notified through email for interview. The interview will be held online through Webex or Google Meet.

content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens pursuing Graduate or Post Graduate courses and must have a good academic record with 75% & above marks (or ≥ 7.5 CGPA) from AICTE/UGC approved Colleges/Universities. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The internship will run for a minimum duration of 06 months, starting from 01st January, 2027 onwards. A fixed stipend of Rs. 5,000/- per month will be paid for the entire duration in two equal installments: Rs. 15,000/- after completion of 03 months, and Rs. 15,000/- after completion of 06 months of internship. faq.question: Are allowances like HRA provided on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, dearness allowance, transport allowance, and house rent allowance (if campus accommodation is not available) are provided as applicable to Central Government Employees.

faq.question: Who is eligible for age relaxations and category certificates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS, and PwD categories receive age relaxations and reservation benefits as per Government of India norms, subject to submitting valid prescribed certificates.

faq.question: How are candidates shortlisted for the interview?
faq.answer: The Institute conducts scrutiny, shortlisting based on cumulative essential credit points, written tests, presentations of teaching and research seminars, and personal interviews before a duly constituted selection committee.

faq.question: Can candidates apply for more than one faculty position?
faq.answer: Yes, separate applications must be submitted if an applicant is applying for more than one faculty position.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | deputy director (engineering): Officers under the Central Government or State Government or Union Territory Administrations or Major Ports or public sector undertakings, or autonomous bodies or universities or recognized research organizations possessing: (a)(i) holding analogous post on regular basis in parent cadre or department; or (ii) with 5 years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in Level-10 (Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500) in the pay matrix or equivalent in parent cadre or department; and (b) possessing Bachelor's degree in Civil/Mechanical Engineering from a recognized University or Institute; and (c) 5 years experience in the field of: (i) Design, construction and maintenance of Civil Engineering works including Harbour Engineering; or (ii) Maintenance and operation of different types of cranes, diesel locos, marine engines, winches and auxiliary machinery in a mechanical or marine workshop or organisation.

how_to_apply: Download the vacancy circular and application format from the official website at https://shipmin.gov.in/.
Fill out the Bio-data / Curriculum Vitae form accurately in all respects.
Ensure the application is duly signed by the applicant and certified by the Head of Office or Employer.
Gather two copies of the signed Bio-data along with complete and up-to-date ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years attested by an officer not below the level of Under Secretary.

Enclose vigilance clearance certificate, cadre clearance, certificate of immediate relieving upon selection, certificate of no major/minor penalties during the last 10 years, and integrity certificate.

Send the complete application "Through proper channel" to the designated address: Under Secretary (Admn.), Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Room No. 439, Transport Bhawan, 1- Parliament Street, New Delhi-110001.
Ensure the application reaches the specified address within 60 days from the date of publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.
important_instructions: Candidates applying for the post will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently. Incomplete applications, applications received after the closing date, or applications not received through proper channel will be summarily rejected. The cut-off date for determining eligibility will be the last date for receipt of nominations in the Ministry (60th day from the publication date in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar). Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation consideration, and deputationists are not eligible for promotion. Officers already on deputation must have their applications forwarded by their parent cadre/department along with required clearances.

content_sections.text: Remuneration for Individual Consultants is decided within the corresponding band, based on years of post-qualification relevant experience. Final remuneration for a selected candidate depends on expectations, experience, and expertise, and the decision of IPL is final and binding. Consultants will also be allowed to undertake tours as required by their duties, for which TA/DA and Hotel Accommodation shall be paid or reimbursed as per Company policy.

content_sections.heading: IPL Recruitment 2026 Selection Procedure
content_sections.text: Selection is done by way of Interview. Merely satisfying the eligibility norms does not entitle an applicant to be called for interview. IPL reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates for interview after preliminary screening/shortlisting, with reference to qualifications, experience, suitability, city preference, and business requirement. IPL will call only those candidates who match the requirements for the specific grade, position, and IC Code indicated in the application form. Applying for a higher grade does not automatically make the applicant eligible for a lower grade. Applicants must apply separately for each IC Code and Grade Code. Shortlisted applicants will be required to attend an interview in Delhi or in online mode, as decided by IPL in its absolute discretion. IPL will not reimburse any expenditure incurred by an applicant for appearing at the interview. IPL reserves the right to appoint none, one, or more Individual Consultants against any IC Code.

content_sections.heading: Period and Nature of Engagement
content_sections.text: Individual Consultants will be engaged for a fixed period of two years, which may be extended by one year at a time, up to a maximum tenure of five years (2+1+1+1 years), for providing services on specific projects as per requirement. Continuation beyond the first and subsequent years is contingent on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review based on defined Key Performance Indicators. Engagement is on a Contractual and Full-Time basis, during which the selected candidate is not allowed to take up appointment/engagement/assignment anywhere else.

content_sections.heading: MSSDS Program Associate – Accounts Job Description
content_sections.text: Job purpose as printed: the Program Associate (Accounts) will independently handle day-to-day operational accounting, voucher maintenance, digital filing, and statutory compliance support. Record daily financial transactions by preparing and posting accurate Journal Entries in accordance with standard accounting principles. Maintain and update General Ledgers, Sub-ledgers, and verify Trial Balance figures periodically. Prepare monthly Receipts and Payment along with Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS) for all project and institutional bank accounts. Execute hands-on accounting entries in Tally ERP / Tally Prime (Mandatory). Create and manage chart of accounts, ledgers, vendor accounts, and project-specific heads in Tally. Maintain strict voucher management workflows within the software environment. Prepare data files and assist in the timely filing of GST returns. Process TDS (Tax Deducted at Source) deductions on vendor invoices, generate payment challans, and assist in periodic TDS return uploads. Maintain statutory registers, tax deduction records, and compliance documentation for internal and external verification. Verify, code, and process Payment Vouchers, Receipt Vouchers, and Journal Vouchers with complete supporting documentation (invoices, receipts, approval notes). Organize systematic physical and digital filing systems to ensure audit-ready financial records. Perform day-to-day transaction processing on the PFMS portal (Mandatory), including vendor mapping, payment generation (EAT module/PFMS workflows), and fund tracking. Assist in generating PFMS-based expenditure reports and Utilisation Certificate (UC) schedules. Process finance-related files in alignment with Government Financial Rules (GFR) and organizational financial guidelines. Utilize eOffice / eFile systems for digital file movement, record tracking, and official correspondence processing. Liaise with government departments, financial institutions, and partner agencies for routine operational coordination.

selection_process: Positions will be filled based on merit cum first cum first receipt basis. Applications received and found complete in all respects will be considered for selection periodically for the remaining available vacancies. The Department of Revenue reserves the right to post suitable applicants in any bench out of the three preferences given by the applicant
subject to the availability of vacancy in the posts applied for.
how_to_apply: Open the online application portal at https://gstn.org.in/gstat-application. The link will be active from 15 November 2026. The vacancy circular, proforma and application link are also hosted at dor.gov.in/gstat-recruitment.
Fill in the application in the proforma given in Annexure 2 and Annexure 3, with the requisite attachments.
Choose three bench preferences in the "Location applying for" field.
Submit the application through the online portal within 30 days from 15 November 2026, i.e. before 15 December 2026.
Send a copy of your application to your Cadre Controlling Authority.

The Cadre Controlling Authority forwards the application in the Annexure 3 proforma, with photocopies of APARs/ACRs of the last five years attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India, to the Under Secretary, Ad.1C Branch, Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Kartavya Bhawan-1, New Delhi-110001 (also at [email protected]). This must be done within 15 days from the date it receives the application.
Officers already on deputation must have their application forwarded by the parent cadre or department, along with Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and an integrity certificate.
A photograph and three bench preferences, chosen from a drop-down list.
The date of entry into government service and the date of retirement as per parent cadre rules.
A clear statement on whether you meet the requisite essential qualification and work experience.
Employment details in chronological order (office, post held, from, to, scale of pay, nature of appointment). Attach a separate sheet if needed.

The nature of present employment (ad-hoc, temporary, quasi-permanent or permanent), deputation or contract details where applicable, any past deputation with the date of return, and whether you work under the Central Government, a State Government or another employer.
A signed declaration that the information is correct and that no material fact has been suppressed.
Photograph on the application form.
Photocopies of APARs/ACRs of the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India (sent by the Cadre Controlling Authority).
Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and integrity certificate (for officers already on deputation).
important_instructions: Candidates once selected will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently on any ground. All fields in the application proforma/checklist are mandatory. An incomplete application will not be considered and will be rejected without any intimation. Deputation period, Sl. No. 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 (Joint Registrar, Assistant Registrar, Senior Private Secretary, Senior Accounts Officer, Court Officer, Private Secretary, Accountant, Stenographer Grade I and Assistant): ordinarily not exceeding three years. Deputation period, Sl. No. 3 and 4 (Deputy Registrar and Principal Private Secretary): ordinarily not exceeding four years. Deputation period, Sl. No. 1 and 13 (Financial Advisor and Upper Division Clerk): ordinarily not exceeding five years. Each deputation period includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment. It may be curtailed depending on the officer's performance and organisational requirement, and may be extended or curtailed in case of administrative exigencies. Pay-band and grade pay granted under ACP/MACP are personal to the officer and should not be mentioned as the pay of the post. Only the pay of the post held on regular basis is to be given; ACP/MACP details go in the separate space on the form. For officers holding a post on deputation outside the cadre while keeping a lien in the parent cadre, the deputation details (parent office and substantive post and pay) must be given in all cases. The vacancy circular invites fresh applications in continuation of the department's vacancy circulars dated 14.09.2024 and 14.08.2025.

content_sections.text: The notice does not mention allowances or the in-hand salary. Other service conditions will be governed by the Recruitment Rules notified or to be notified.

content_sections.heading: GSTAT Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Positions will be filled based on merit cum first cum first receipt basis. Applications received and found complete in all respects will be considered for selection periodically for the remaining available vacancies. The Department of Revenue reserves the right to post suitable applicants in any bench out of the three preferences given by the applicant, subject to the availability of vacancy in the posts applied for.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for GSTAT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application portal at https://gstn.org.in/gstat-application . The link will be active from 15 November 2026. The vacancy circular, proforma and application link are also hosted at dor.gov.in/gstat-recruitment. Fill in the application in the proforma given in Annexure 2 and Annexure 3, with the requisite attachments. Choose three bench preferences in the "Location applying for" field. Submit the application through the online portal within 30 days from 15 November 2026, i.e. before 15 December 2026. Send a copy of your application to your Cadre Controlling Authority. The Cadre Controlling Authority forwards the application in the Annexure 3 proforma, with photocopies of APARs/ACRs of the last five years attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India, to the Under Secretary, Ad.1C Branch, Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, Kartavya Bhawan-1, New Delhi-110001 (also at [email protected] ). This must be done within 15 days from the date it receives the application. Officers already on deputation must have their application forwarded by the parent cadre or department, along with Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and an integrity certificate. A photograph and three bench preferences, chosen from a drop-down list. The date of entry into government service and the date of retirement as per parent cadre rules. A clear statement on whether you meet the requisite essential qualification and work experience. Employment details in chronological order (office, post held, from, to, scale of pay, nature of appointment). Attach a separate sheet if needed. The nature of present employment (ad-hoc, temporary, quasi-permanent or permanent), deputation or contract details where applicable, any past deputation with the date of return, and whether you work under the Central Government, a State Government or another employer. A signed declaration that the information is correct and that no material fact has been suppressed. Photograph on the application form. Photocopies of APARs/ACRs of the last five years, attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India (sent by the Cadre Controlling Authority). Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and integrity certificate (for officers already on deputation).

content_sections.heading: GSTAT Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates once selected will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently on any ground. All fields in the application proforma/checklist are mandatory. An incomplete application will not be considered and will be rejected without any intimation. Deputation period, Sl. No. 2, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 and 12 (Joint Registrar, Assistant Registrar, Senior Private Secretary, Senior Accounts Officer, Court Officer, Private Secretary, Accountant, Stenographer Grade I and Assistant): ordinarily not exceeding three years. Deputation period, Sl. No. 3 and 4 (Deputy Registrar and Principal Private Secretary): ordinarily not exceeding four years. Deputation period, Sl. No. 1 and 13 (Financial Advisor and Upper Division Clerk): ordinarily not exceeding five years. Each deputation period includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment. It may be curtailed depending on the officer's performance and organisational requirement, and may be extended or curtailed in case of administrative exigencies. Pay-band and grade pay granted under ACP/MACP are personal to the officer and should not be mentioned as the pay of the post. Only the pay of the post held on regular basis is to be given; ACP/MACP details go in the separate space on the form. For officers holding a post on deputation outside the cadre while keeping a lien in the parent cadre, the deputation details (parent office and substantive post and pay) must be given in all cases. The vacancy circular invites fresh applications in continuation of the department's vacancy circulars dated 14.09.2024 and 14.08.2025.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 237 posts across 13 grades, the largest being Stenographer Grade I (59) and Court Officer (56). All counts are tentative and subject to variation dependent on workload.

faq.question: Q2. When does the GSTAT 2026 online application start?
faq.answer: The online application link at gstn.org.in/gstat-application will be active from 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted within 30 days from 15 November 2026, i.e. before 15 December 2026. The cut-off date for eligibility is 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for GSTAT deputation posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age is fifty-six years for posts at Sl. No. 1 to 12 and fifty-eight years for Upper Division Clerk, as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is required for GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Most posts need a Bachelor's degree with experience; for example, Court Officer needs a Bachelors Degree and two years experience in administration or establishment or Court matters. Senior Private Secretary, Private Secretary, Stenographer Grade I and Upper Division Clerk have only service conditions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for GSTAT posts?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Level-4 (Rs.25500 - 81100) for Upper Division Clerk to Level-13 (Rs.123100 - 215900) for Financial Advisor. Court Officer and Senior Private Secretary are at Level-8 (Rs.47600 - 151100).

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for GSTAT 2026?
faq.answer: Positions will be filled based on merit cum first cum first receipt basis. Complete applications are considered periodically for the remaining available vacancies.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for GSTAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only serving officers and officials of the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories or Tribunals can apply, along with other bodies listed for some posts. Each applicant must hold an analogous post or have the prescribed regular service in a lower pay level.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation period in GSTAT?
faq.answer: The deputation period is ordinarily not more than three years for most posts, four years for Deputy Registrar and Principal Private Secretary, and five years for Financial Advisor and Upper Division Clerk. It may be curtailed, or extended or curtailed in administrative exigencies.

faq.question: Q10. Can a selected candidate withdraw from GSTAT deputation?
faq.answer: No. Candidates once selected will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature subsequently on any ground.

how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format (Annexure I) from the official notification.
Fill in all required particulars, including personal information, contact address, educational qualifications from Class X onwards, and professional experience.
Affix an attested passport-size photograph on the form and sign the declaration.
Prepare clear scanned copies of the filled form along with self-attested copies of Class X onwards certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, and No Objection Certificate (NOC) if employed.
If any near or distant relative works in ICAR/IARI, fill and sign the relative declaration form.
Send the application along with all scanned documents as an email attachment to [email protected] on or before 20 November 2026.
important_instructions: The engagement is strictly contractual and does not confer any right to regular appointment or absorption in ICAR-IARI or ICAR. Failure to maintain discipline or to perform assigned duties may result in termination of the engagement in accordance with applicable ICAR rules. Candidates must produce all original documents for verification at the interview; any false claim will result in immediate rejection. Candidates currently employed must bring a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer at the time of the interview. Candidates whose near or distant relatives are employed by ICAR/IARI must submit the prescribed declaration by post or email on or before 20 November 2026. Candidates who do not have any near or distant relatives working at ICAR/IARI must submit the declaration at the time of the interview. Working hours will be the same as those applicable to regular employees. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates for attending the interview. Selected candidates must submit a signed Declaration of Secrecy and Non-Disclosure Agreement prior to joining. Selected candidates must provide a Medical Fitness Certificate issued by an MBBS doctor at their own expense and complete police verification within 15 days of joining. Leave entitlement is 8 days of casual leave and 2 restricted holidays per calendar year. Female candidates are entitled to maternity leave as per applicable rules. Unauthorized absence for 8 consecutive days may lead to termination of the contract. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. Any dispute arising in connection with this engagement will be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts in New Delhi.

basic_details.short_information: Odisha Livelihoods Mission, Department of Mission Shakti (OLM), Bhubaneswar, has invited applications for 1115 posts in 57 roles. The posts include State Project Manager (Human Resources & Training), State Project Manager (Farm Livelihoods), State Project Manager (Non-Farm Livelihoods), State Project Manager (Value Addition, Market Linkage (Farm & Non-Farm)) and 53 more. The online application is open from 6 November 2026 to 5 December 2026.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 16,560 to Rs. 72,450, depending on the post

exam_pattern.details: Computer Based Test in English language only. Four options per question; one mark for a correct answer. Negative marking of 0.33 mark for each wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no deduction. Normalized score is calculated up to seven places after decimal. Provisional answer key is published and objections are allowed within the prescribed period.

how_to_apply: Read the whole advertisement, including the eligibility criteria and the Syllabus Appendix, before filling in the online application form.
Apply online only through www.missionshakti.odisha.gov.in; applications received through any other mode are rejected.
Follow the detailed instructions on the website for registration, document upload and fee payment.
Pay the application fee of Rs. 500/- online at the time of registration; SC, ST and PwD candidates pay nil.
Submit the application between 06 Nov 2026 and 05 Dec 2026 (11:55 PM).
Apply once per position; if more than one form is submitted for the same post, only the latest correct form is considered.
Attempt the mock test link that will be placed on the website before the CBT.
Download the e-Admit Card from the website ahead of the examination; none is sent separately.
Apply on or before 5 December 2026.
important_instructions: Application fee is refunded to all candidates who appear in the examination. Exact CBT date, shift and venue will be notified on the e-admit card on the website. Candidates must report with a printed e-Admit Card and a valid original Government photo ID. OLM may change the number of vacancies without notice and may cancel the recruitment process fully or partially. Grievances about the CBT must be e-mailed to [email protected] within 3 days of the candidate's examination.

content_sections.text: Candidates debarred, terminated or removed from service by OLM and Mission Shakti Department on disciplinary grounds. Candidates whose age is outside the limit; overage relaxation is not allowed to PwD candidates with less than 40% disability.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contract is initially for 1 year, which may be renewed based on satisfactory performance and continued as per project requirement. Contractual engagement gives no right to regularisation, permanent absorption or continuation beyond the contractual period. No TA/DA is paid for the examination, document verification or first joining of OLM.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online at the time of registration.

content_sections.heading: How Will OLM Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Computer Based Test (CBT) Publication of provisional merit list Document Verification (three times the vacancy for each position) Final merit list from normalized CBT marks along with document verification Single CBT paper; no group discussion or personal interview. Three times the vacancy for each position are called for document verification. Final merit list is drawn from normalized CBT marks along with document verification. Tie in marks: senior in age first, then alphabetical order of names.

content_sections.heading: OLM Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Computer Based Test in English language only. Four options per question; one mark for a correct answer. Negative marking of 0.33 mark for each wrong answer; unattempted questions carry no deduction. Normalized score is calculated up to seven places after decimal. Provisional answer key is published and objections are allowed within the prescribed period.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: H.S.C. or equivalent certificate for age, issued by the Board/Council Master's/Post Graduation/Bachelor's degree certificate from the University Certificate of any other higher qualification Caste certificate by birth for SC/ST/SEBC claims Experience certificate from the competent authority Ex-servicemen: Discharge Certificate and affidavit of not availing the quota in a civil post Permanent Disability Certificate (40% or more) and Sports Certificate, where applicable

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Application fee is refunded to all candidates who appear in the examination. Exact CBT date, shift and venue will be notified on the e-admit card on the website. Candidates must report with a printed e-Admit Card and a valid original Government photo ID. OLM may change the number of vacancies without notice and may cancel the recruitment process fully or partially. Grievances about the CBT must be e-mailed to [email protected] within 3 days of the candidate's examination.

content_sections.text: Himachal Pradesh Rajya Chayan Aayog has released for 2,423 teaching vacancies in Government CBSE-affiliated schools. content_sections.heading: HPRCA Teacher Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the post-specific educational qualifications by 5 December 2026 . Most subjects require a relevant Master's degree, B.Ed. and Teacher Eligibility Test (TET), while some specialized teaching posts have alternative qualification pathways. English and Mathematics Teacher candidates must meet the specific graduation, postgraduate and teacher-training requirements prescribed in the notification. The applicable relaxation in minimum marks for eligible Himachal Pradesh reserved categories must be checked against the detailed qualification conditions. The Computer Teacher post provides multiple educational qualification pathways, including: B.E. or B.Tech. in Computer Science or Information Technology with the prescribed marks. B.E. or B.Tech. in any stream with a recognized postgraduate diploma in Computer Science, Technology or Applications. M.Sc. Computer Science or MCA with the prescribed marks. Postgraduate degree in Mathematics or Physics with a postgraduate diploma in Computer Science or Computer Applications. DOEACC 'B' or 'C' Level qualification from the recognized authority, meeting the notified marks requirements. Candidates must also meet the prescribed proficiency requirement for teaching in Hindi and English. The Physical Education Teacher post accepts specified professional qualifications recognized under the relevant NCTE regulations, including the applicable B.P.Ed., integrated Physical Education degree and other notified training routes. Applicants should carefully compare their qualification, course duration and minimum marks with the detailed notification. Applicants may qualify through a recognized Master's degree in Fine Arts or Visual Arts, including Painting and Sculpture, with the prescribed minimum marks. The notification provides up to 5% relaxation in minimum educational marks for eligible SC, ST, OBC and PwD candidates of Himachal Pradesh, where specified against the qualification. Applicants should not assume that the same minimum marks or relaxation applies identically to every educational route.

content_sections.heading: About AIC STPI Bengaluru
content_sections.text: AIC STPI Bengaluru is an incubation centre in Bengaluru, Karnataka. It works under STPI and STPINEXT Initiatives, whose logos appear on the notice. It runs incubation programmes and Open Challenge Programs (OCPs) for startups, gives marketing assistance to the startups it incubates, and manages AIM/STPI grants.

content_sections.heading: AIC STPI Bengaluru Administrative Executive and Marketing & Project Coordinator Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: STPI reserves the right to fill all, some or none of the advertised positions without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: AIC STPI Bengaluru Administrative Executive and Marketing & Project Coordinator Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: below 35 years for both posts. Age is counted as on the last date for receiving applications. The notice says relaxation is permissible for deserving candidates. Experience in the relevant field counts only from the date you obtained the minimum essential qualification. The Administrative Executive role needs strong financial expertise, Tally/ERP accounting, and good Excel, data management and MIS reporting skills. The Marketing & Project Coordinator role needs business development, startup ecosystem engagement, digital marketing, social media management and AI-enabled communication skills. Read the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_and_experience: B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance) or equivalent; 2-3 years of experience
MBA – Marketing / Business Development / Communications or equivalent; 2-3 years of experience

content_sections.heading: Duties of Each Post
content_sections.text: This post handles the centre's administration, finance and grant management from start to finish. Finance and accounts: vouchers, ledgers, bank reconciliation, vendor payments, bills, invoices and reimbursements; Income & Expenditure and Receipts & Payments statements; MIS reports; budget-head-wise expenditure tracking. Grant and government finance: AIM/STPI grant use and balance tracking; Utilization Certificates (UCs); PFMS-related processes and grant releases; financial reporting for AIM, STPI, PMG, the Governing Board and audits. Statutory compliance: GST, TDS, PF and ESI; coordination with the Chartered Accountant, the auditor and statutory consultants; keeping audit records up to date. Administration and procurement: day-to-day administration of the Incubation Centre; vendor records, quotations, work orders and contracts; procurement under government/STPI procedures; asset and inventory records. e-Office: e-Office/Parichay file creation, movement and tracking; notes for internal approvals; following up on pending approvals. This post supports the centre's startup outreach, partnerships, marketing, digital presence and programmes. Startup outreach and OCP: outreach for Open Challenge Programs and incubation programmes; startup databases; coordination with universities, incubators, accelerators and startup communities; application campaigns and screening. Business development: partnerships with corporates, GCCs, industry, academia, investors, hospitals, technology companies and CSR organisations; proposals and MoUs; CSR support, sponsorships and investor roundtables. Marketing and digital presence: LinkedIn and other social media channels, website content and newsletters; startup and founder stories; press releases; content calendars and engagement analytics; working with photography, video and agency vendors. Digital marketing: tools such as Canva for communication material, and analytics tools to measure campaigns. Programmes and events: OCPs, workshops, Demo Days, hackathons and investor engagements; an annual/quarterly events calendar; post-event reporting. Startup marketing assistance: putting marketing assistance in place for incubated startups and tracking its use and results.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee checks the applications received by the last date. It looks at qualifications, age, academic record and relevant experience. Candidates who meet the advertised qualifications and experience may be screened in. Screened-in candidates are called for a personal interview before a Selection Committee on the scheduled date and time. The Selection Committee recommends a candidate or a panel of candidates, in order of merit, for appointment. Applying does not by itself mean you will be called for a test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The contract runs for 3 years or until the end of AIC STPI Bengaluru, whichever is earlier. It may be renewed based on performance, subject to the project tenure being extended. Both posts report to the CEO or the STPI Jurisdictional Director, as the STPI Jurisdictional Director decides. The job is based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The work location can change by mutual agreement. If a candidate is found ineligible on any ground after appointment, their services may be terminated without a reason being given. Any litigation is subject to the jurisdiction of Delhi courts.

content_sections.heading: About the Institute
content_sections.text: Srinivasa Ramanujan Institute for Basic Sciences (SRIBS) is a constituent of the Kerala State Council for Science, Technology and Environment (KSCSTE). It fosters fundamental research across disciplines including chemistry, biology, physics, mathematics and computer science. The institute is at Pi Hills, 8th Mile, Velloor P.O., Kottayam – 686501. The K-STAR project envisages the establishment and operationalisation of a Supercomputing Centre at SRIBS. Implementation involves administrative coordination, documentation, procurement-related activities, institutional correspondence and IT support. Because SRIBS is primarily a theoretical research institution, personnel are required to support scientific-administrative activities and the associated academic and institutional operations.

Experience related to administrative/financial/purchase in industrial/Academic/Government Institutions and Scientific Activities and Services. 5 years of work experience in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations. Teaching experience in academic/educational institutions is considered desirable. Proficiency in Government office software and office applications, along with skills in report preparation and official correspondence. A good typing speed and fluency in computer use. The maximum age limit is 40 yrs as on the closing date prescribed for receipt of application. The notice does not print a minimum age. Assistance in maintaining academic, scientific and institutional records and providing other administrative support assigned by SRIBS.

content_sections.heading: About DPA
content_sections.text: Deendayal Port Authority, formerly Deendayal Port Trust, is a Major Port Authority with its Administration Office Building at Post Box No.50, Gandhidham (Kutch), Gujarat. This recruitment is issued by its General Administration Department under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways framework, and the notice is addressed to the Secretaries of all Major Port Authorities.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The post is open only to officers of Major Port Authorities who satisfy the Recruitment Rule enclosed as Annexure-I. The crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date of online submission, 12 December 2026. A degree from a recognized university. The Recruitment Rule states that the educational qualification prescribed for direct recruits will apply in case of promotion/absorption/deputation. The following officers are eligible: Officers holding analogous posts, or the post of Dy. Traffic Manager and equivalent posts in the respective discipline of Traffic Deptt., in the scale of pay of Rs.13000-18250 with three years' service in the grade in a Major Port Trust; or Deputy Traffic Manager and equivalent post in the respective discipline of Traffic Department with two years' service in the grade and a combined service of seven years in the scales of pay of Rs. 10750-16750 and Rs. 13000-18250 in the respective discipline of Traffic Department in a Major Port Trust. The twelve years' experience in shipping/cargo operations/railway transportation in executive cadre in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking is prescribed for direct recruitment; the Recruitment Rule states that this experience will not apply in case of promotion/absorption/deputation. The Recruitment Rule prescribes an upper age limit of 42 years for direct recruitment and states that this age limit will not apply in case of promotion/absorption/deputation. The Recruitment Rule provides for recruitment by absorption through composite method, failing which by deputation from other Govt. organisations, and failing both by direct recruitment. For deputation, officers holding analogous posts or the post of Dy. Traffic Manager and equivalent post in the respective discipline of Traffic Department in the scale of pay of Rs. 13000-18250 in Govt./Semi-Govt./PSUs or Autonomous Bodies with three years' service in the grade are eligible. The present notice invites applications by absorption from officers of Major Port Authorities. The period of probation is shown as NA. Candidates should check the full Recruitment Rule in Annexure-I of the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

Reserved-category applicants must attach a permanent caste certificate issued by the competent authority. A candidate who married before the minimum marriageable age is not eligible. If selected, she must submit an affidavit notarised on Rs. 50 stamp paper. A candidate married to a person who already has a living spouse is not eligible. The Government may decide otherwise if satisfied that there is sufficient reason. Employees of government or semi-government bodies must submit the application with an employer's No Objection Certificate, or the application will not be considered. selection_process: The Case Worker is selected by the District Level Steering Committee. The committee prepares a merit list from the applications on a points system
then invites applicants to a walk-in interview or skill test
and sends the final recommendation to the District Collector. The District Collector is the appointing authority and issues the appointment order.
Maximum 60 marks
by giving a weightage of 100 to the percentage obtained in the minimum required educational qualification. 2 marks for each additional year of experience beyond the minimum experience
maximum 10 marks. 2 marks per year as bonus for experience with a State women helpline or Sakhi One Stop Centre
up to a maximum of 10 marks.
The walk-in interview or skill test carries 20 marks. Knowledge of the local language or dialect is required and is also a criterion during the walk-in interview. From the merit list
applicants are called in the ratio 1:5 or 1:10 for each post
as the selection committee thinks fit. No travel allowance or other allowance is payable to candidates who attend.
If candidates have equal marks in the merit list
the older candidate is preferred. Former Sakhi One Stop Centre service providers whose services have ended or are under process
and who apply
get priority for their experience during the walk-in interview.
important_instructions: Appointment is for a first term of up to 2 years on the consolidated service fee. The District Collector may extend it for 1 year each time based on work ability, conduct and the controlling officer's recommendation; if not extended, the appointment ends automatically. The appointment is fully temporary and may be ended without giving a reason. Either side may end it with one month's notice, or one month's pay instead. The posts last only as long as the scheme runs under the Government of India. After that, the department has no responsibility for the service providers. The service fee is as per limits set by the Government of India. If the Government of India raises it in future, the fee will be raised accordingly. Only the consolidated service fee is payable; no other pay, allowances or ex-gratia grants are given. Service providers are governed by the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1965, and must follow them. Maternity leave benefit applies. Travel allowance is paid as per rules if sent on tour or training. A selected candidate must pass a medical examination and submit a fitness certificate within 1 month of selection; if found unfit, service is ended. Police verification of background is mandatory before appointment, and the certificate must be given to the office when taking charge. After joining, the selected candidate must keep all case and victim data confidential and submit an affidavit to that effect; a breach leads to action to end service. Incomplete, unclear and faulty applications are rejected without separate information. An applicant found ineligible at any stage can be rejected. The District Collector's decision on selection is final.

From the merit list, applicants are called in the ratio 1:5 or 1:10 for each post, as the selection committee thinks fit. No travel allowance or other allowance is payable to candidates who attend. If candidates have equal marks in the merit list, the older candidate is preferred. Former Sakhi One Stop Centre service providers whose services have ended or are under process, and who apply, get priority for their experience during the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Appointment is for a first term of up to 2 years on the consolidated service fee. The District Collector may extend it for 1 year each time based on work ability, conduct and the controlling officer's recommendation; if not extended, the appointment ends automatically. The appointment is fully temporary and may be ended without giving a reason. Either side may end it with one month's notice, or one month's pay instead. The posts last only as long as the scheme runs under the Government of India. After that, the department has no responsibility for the service providers. The service fee is as per limits set by the Government of India. If the Government of India raises it in future, the fee will be raised accordingly. Only the consolidated service fee is payable; no other pay, allowances or ex-gratia grants are given. Service providers are governed by the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1965, and must follow them. Maternity leave benefit applies. Travel allowance is paid as per rules if sent on tour or training. A selected candidate must pass a medical examination and submit a fitness certificate within 1 month of selection; if found unfit, service is ended. Police verification of background is mandatory before appointment, and the certificate must be given to the office when taking charge. After joining, the selected candidate must keep all case and victim data confidential and submit an affidavit to that effect; a breach leads to action to end service. Incomplete, unclear and faulty applications are rejected without separate information. An applicant found ineligible at any stage can be rejected. The District Collector's decision on selection is final.

content_sections.heading: About Jayashankar Bhupalpally District Court Typist
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District and Sessions Court, Jayashankar Bhupalpally, in Telangana. The Typist will work in the Fast Track Special Court for Expeditious Trial and Disposal of Rape and POCSO Act Cases, Jayashankar Bhupalpally, set up as per G.O.Ms.No.104, Finance (HRM - II) Department, dated 30.12.2019. A copy of the notification has been submitted to the Registrar General, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the format printed with the notification (page 4, "Application for the Post of Typist"), with a recent photograph affixed in the box provided. The form asks for full name, father's / husband's name, date of birth, age as on 01.11.2026, caste / category, sex, nationality, religion, educational qualifications (academic, technical, other), previous experience if any, local / non-local status, permanent address, address for correspondence and mobile number, followed by a signed declaration with station and date. Fill in the application form given with the notification and affix a recent photograph. Attach attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures below, including a self-addressed registered post cover. Put the application in a sealed cover addressed to: The Honourable Prl. District and Sessions Judge, Jayashankar Bhupalpally. Send the cover by Speed Post or courier. Application forms will not be entertained either directly or in person. Make sure it reaches the office by 5.00 PM on 28 November 2026; applications received after that time will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The pay is on a contract basis; the notice states that remuneration shall be paid as fixed by the Government from time to time. Educational qualification (as per TJMSS Rules, 2018): Must have passed a Bachelor's Degree of any recognized University in India established or incorporated by or under a Central Act, State Act or Provincial Act, or an Institution recognized by the University Grants Commission, or any equivalent qualification. Must have passed the Telangana Government Technical Examination in English Typewriting by Higher Grade (45 WPM) or its equivalent examination. If a Higher Grade English Typewriting candidate is not available, English Typewriting Lower (30 WPM) will be considered. Must have knowledge or qualification in computer operation. Age limit: as on 01/11/2026, a candidate must have completed the age of 18 years and must not have completed the age of 34 years. Age relaxation (on the maximum age limit): SCs / STs / BCs / EWS: 5 years Physically Disabled candidates: 10 years Other eligibility conditions: Only eligible candidates of Jayashankar Bhupalpally District may apply. Only persons of sound health and active habits will be considered. Only persons with a proven record of ability, good performance and integrity will be considered. Persons who have been awarded any punishment for misconduct in disciplinary proceedings while in service are not eligible for consideration. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility wording for the Typist post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of the following documents must be enclosed with the application: Certificates of academic qualifications such as marks lists, pass certificate, provisional certificate, testimonials, and other certificates to prove technical efficiency, if any Date of Birth Certificate Community Certificate in the case of SCs/STs/BCs, issued by the competent authority Employment Registration Card Certificate in respect of Local / Non-Local candidature in terms of the Presidential Order, 1975 A self-addressed registered post cover with acknowledgement worth Rs.70/-, or as fixed by the Postal Department for RPAD

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for the Typist post is in two stages: Typewriting test: a test in typewriting with regard to technical efficiency for the post of Typist. Oral interview: candidates who qualify in the typewriting test will be called for an oral interview. The notice does not mention the date or venue of the typewriting test or interview. No TA and DA will be paid for the journey performed in connection with the appointment.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: The candidate will be appointed only on a contract basis as per Rule 9 of the Telangana State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, for a period of ONE YEAR. A Deed of agreement must be executed at the time of appointment. Selected persons have to produce a physical fitness certificate and enter into an agreement / contract with the District Court, Jayashankar Bhupalpally on such terms and conditions as the appointing authority deems fit. The contract appointment automatically ceases to be in operation unless a fresh proposal is made and a fresh contract is entered into. In the case of retired employees, the provisions of the Telangana Civil Service (Conduct) Rules, 1964 and the Telangana Pension Code shall be applicable mutatis mutandis. No other service rules shall be applicable other than those above.

rows.details: NALSAR University of Law, Hyderabad (Animal Law Centre)
A Scoping Report on Broiler Chicken Welfare in India

Remote (the candidate can be based anywhere in India); the role requires travel across six states in India

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: NALSAR University of Law is an institution that aims to provide quality legal education with a focus on social justice for marginalised communities. It is partnering with ALPN Research Foundation, Bengaluru, which the notice describes as a not-for-profit independent think-tank working to improve animal welfare across India. The study assesses the current conditions and challenges to the welfare of broiler chickens in India. It evaluates the broiler chicken industry end to end, from farming systems and supply chains to market demand, regulatory context and the wider stakeholder ecosystem. It is meant to inform targeted intervention pathways in India.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists these qualification conditions for the Research Associate post: A Bachelor's degree in any field. Candidates with backgrounds in life sciences, social sciences, agriculture or veterinary studies would be preferred. No prior expertise in poultry or animal welfare is required. Training on poultry behaviour and welfare indicators will be provided. Proficiency in Hindi and other regional languages is strongly preferred, given the multi-state fieldwork. Willingness to travel extensively across multiple states for field research is listed as a requirement. The notice says preference will be given to candidates with the following: Willingness and ability to travel extensively across multiple Indian states for field research (approximately three months of fieldwork). Prior experience in field research, surveys or fieldwork-based data collection, which would be an advantage. Strong interpersonal skills, with comfort in conducting informal or semi-formal interviews and building quick rapport with farmers and other stakeholders. Interest in animal welfare or willingness to learn poultry-specific observation skills. Good written communication skills for clear, organised field notes, and familiarity with note-taking and transcription. Basic organisational and project support skills, with the ability to manage tasks and timelines.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is ₹60,000-₹70,000 per month, depending on qualifications and experience. The engagement duration is four months, with the joining date given as 07 December 2026. All fieldwork costs will be covered by the organisation. The role is remote, so the candidate can be based anywhere in India, but it requires travel across six states.

content_sections.heading: NALSAR Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The Research Associate will support field research across approximately 60 farm visits in six states, plus slaughterhouses and meat shops. The post works closely with the Project Lead on on-ground observation, interviews and note-taking. The key responsibilities are: Support the project team in conducting field visits across approximately 60 farms in six states, plus slaughterhouses and meat retail points. Observe and accurately document farm conditions, farming practices and poultry behaviour using training and frameworks provided by the project team. Conduct interviews with farmers, workers and other on-ground stakeholders, adapting communication style and language to the local context. Take detailed, organised field notes and assist in structuring raw field data for analysis. Help coordinate field logistics: scheduling visits, travel planning and liaising with local contacts. Assist in transcription, translation or summarisation of interviews and field notes, particularly from regional languages into English.

basic_details.job_title: DIO iDEAL Internship Program Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The iDEX Defence Exploration and Learning (iDEAL) Internship Program at DIO pays a monthly stipend of INR 30,000 for a 6-month internship and INR 20,000 for a 3-month internship, with work in person at the DIO office in New Delhi. Final-year undergraduates, graduates and postgraduate students of science and engineering/technology degree programmes, aged not above 26 years as on 30-11-2026, can apply online at idex.gov.in until 30 November 2026; the internship is tentatively set to begin on 4 January 2027.

how_to_apply: Apply only in online mode through the application form at https://idex.gov.in/d/s/form/ideal_internship_November_2026. Applications received through any other mode will not be considered.
Students should obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC), where applicable, from their college or institution in the format of Annexure 1.
Submit the application on or before 30 November 2026.

No Objection Certificate (Annexure 1, applicable to students): given on letterhead and signed by the HOD/Principal. It certifies that the applicant is a bonafide student, that the institution has no objection to the applicant joining the program from January 2027 for 3 or 6 months, that the student is not registered for any course requiring class attendance in that period, and that the student's conduct has been found satisfactory.
important_instructions: The internship is in-person; all interns must be physically present at the designated DIO office during the internship period. Office timings are 09:30 AM to 06:00 PM, Monday to Friday, and interns are expected to follow them. Regular attendance is mandatory, and interns must maintain punctuality and professionalism. Besides official holidays as per the organization's calendar, interns are entitled to six days of leave for a 6-month internship and three days for a 3-month internship.

content_sections.heading: About the iDEAL Internship
content_sections.text: iDEX Defence Exploration and Learning (iDEAL) is a stipend-based 3-month and 6-month internship program. It aims to give students exposure and practical experience in managing projects focused on niche technology development in Defence and Aerospace. The notice describes the internship as neither a job nor an assurance of a job with the Authority.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The program at DIO is generally open to Indian citizens with the specified educational qualification from a recognized University. Undergraduate students in their final year, or those who have graduated from a degree program for science and engineering/technology in the year of application. Postgraduate students, pursuing or graduated in the year of application, with the bachelor's qualification applicable as in the point above. Age: should not exceed 26 years as on 30-11-2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates who have undergone or are undergoing Apprenticeship Training under NATS or NAPS in any other establishment or organization are not eligible. Suppression of facts and furnishing false information lead to disqualification or rejection of candidature, and canvassing in any form results in disqualification. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The maximum duration of the internship can be extended on need basis. Interns who complete the program are eligible for an experience certificate issued by iDEX/MoD. Interns would receive defence-related technology project management experience through diverse responsibilities and regular evaluations and feedback. Interns who demonstrate exceptional skills, dedication and a strong fit in the iDEX ecosystem may be offered relaxation(s) in the recruitment process of iDEX-DIO as deemed suitable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DIO iDEAL Internship Program
content_sections.text: Apply only in online mode through the application form at https://idex.gov.in/d/s/form/ideal_internship_November_2026 . Applications received through any other mode will not be considered. Students should obtain a No Objection Certificate (NOC), where applicable, from their college or institution in the format of Annexure 1. Submit the application on or before 30 November 2026. No Objection Certificate (Annexure 1, applicable to students): given on letterhead and signed by the HOD/Principal. It certifies that the applicant is a bonafide student, that the institution has no objection to the applicant joining the program from January 2027 for 3 or 6 months, that the student is not registered for any course requiring class attendance in that period, and that the student's conduct has been found satisfactory.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The internship is in-person; all interns must be physically present at the designated DIO office during the internship period. Office timings are 09:30 AM to 06:00 PM, Monday to Friday, and interns are expected to follow them. Regular attendance is mandatory, and interns must maintain punctuality and professionalism. Besides official holidays as per the organization's calendar, interns are entitled to six days of leave for a 6-month internship and three days for a 3-month internship.
