content_sections.heading: About the Division
content_sections.text: Hassanur Forest Division is part of the Sathyamangalam Tiger Reserve in Erode District, Tamil Nadu. Its office is headed by the Deputy Director and District Forest Officer, Hassanur Forest Division, Hassanur. The JRF post is under the Comprehensive Human-Wildlife Conflict Mitigation Scheme and is open to eligible and motivated Indian candidates.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The applicant should preferably be a resident of Tamil Nadu. The notice calls the post purely contractual and temporary. Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of 55% marks in Wildlife Science, Wildlife Biology, Forestry, Ecology, Environmental Science, Zoology, Life Sciences, or Allied Disciplines from a recognized University/Institute. Minimum 1 year experience in ArcGIS Software or related GIS applications. Proficiency in Tamil and English (written and spoken), described as essential to liaise with frontline staff and village communities. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be appointed on a contractual basis for an initial tenure of one year. The tenure is extendable based on project requirements and satisfactory performance. The consolidated monthly remuneration is Rs. 25,000/- (Including HRA and Travel), so HRA and travel are part of this amount and are not paid on top of it.

content_sections.heading: Hassanur Forest Division Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Field monitoring of wildlife movements. Conflict vulnerability hotspot mapping. Assessing linear infrastructure and elephant-proof barriers (solar fences, trenches, railway barricades). Gathering camera-trap and spatial data. Coordinating with Anti-Depredation Squads and local community stakeholders across Hassanur, Thalavadi, Germalam and Jeeragahalli ranges, and any other tasks.

faq.answer: The notice lists 17 items. Items 3 to 17 each have 01 post, which makes 15 posts. Items 1 and 2 (Senior Research Fellow, NICRA) do not state a number of posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Establishment Section, ICAR-IIHR, Bengaluru, by 25 November 2026, 05:30 PM. Late applications will not be entertained, even when the delay is due to postal delays.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Young Professional II?
faq.answer: Each Young Professional II item requires an M.Sc. in a specified subject, for example M. Sc. Floriculture for Item 11. Item 10 accepts M Tech/MSc Bioinformatics Or MSc (Agri) Plant Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: For Senior Research Fellow, the age limit is 35 years for men and 40 years for women. For Young Professional I, Young Professional II and Field Assistant, it is 21 to 45 years.

faq.answer: Young Professional II gets Rs. 42,000/- PM (Consolidated) and Young Professional I gets Rs.30,000/- PM (Consolidated). Senior Research Fellow gets Rs. 37,000/- PM + HRA, except Item 9 (Rs. 42,000/- PM + 27% HRA) and Item 14 (Rs. 42,000/- PM + HRA from the 3rd year).

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: HRA is paid on top of the pay for the Senior Research Fellow items and for the Field Assistant (Rs.20,000/- PM + 30% HRA). Young Professional I and II are paid a consolidated amount.

Write the Item No. and Name of the Post on both the application and the envelope. Email applications will not be accepted.

faq.answer: After screening, shortlisted candidates for Items 01 to 09 will be interviewed on 15 December 2026, and those for Items 10 to 17 on 16 December 2026 (tentative). Candidates must report at the ICAR-IIHR campus by 8:30 AM.

faq.answer: Yes. A separate application must be submitted for each post, and no two applications should be tied together.

faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the project, and ICAR/IIHR has no liability for absorbing the selected candidates.

content_sections.text: Masters' / Bachelors' degree in any subject. MBA or Bachelor of Commerce is preferred. Post-Graduates: administrative experience of one year. content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Admin. Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The role is administrative and commercial in nature, connected with training and consulting projects, and includes organising and coordinating all administrative activities of these programmes. The administrative functions listed in the notice are: Create schedules as per plan for training or consulting programmes and liaise with faculty and participants. Be the point of contact for programme coordinators and teaching faculty to create and implement the class schedule. Collect, enter or update course outlines and other descriptions of courses and programmes in the database or LMS as required. Create class links on online platforms like WebEx, Zoom, Teams etc. as per schedule, and monitor and support classes if required. Be the point of contact for participants and programme coordinators to organise and conduct the programme. Coordinate with the programme office or departments including IT, infrastructure, security, housekeeping and other support services, so that arrangements for classes, faculty travel and hospitality of faculty/participants are done without fail. Coordinate the operational aspects of the programme with client representatives. Assist in preparing budgets and budget variance notes, and create noting for administrative approvals. Coordinate with vendors: collect and compare vendor quotes, create purchase orders, and coordinate and monitor receipt of items, payments and stock.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bibinagar
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar is a medical institute in the Hyderabad Metropolitan Region of Telangana. This post is in the institute's Department of Orthopaedics, under the ADIDOC project led by Dr. Y. Ranjith Kumar, Principal Investigator and Associate Professor, Department of Orthopaedics. The project works on an advanced carbon fiber foot prosthesis under the Make in India Initiative.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives two alternative routes (either one is enough): Three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject/field (Biomedical / Mechanical / Computer Science / Information Technology / Computer Applications) from a recognized University + two years' experience in relevant subject/field. OR 12th (Science) + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) + 5 years' experience in relevant subject/field. Candidates must possess the required essential qualifications and experience on or before the last date of application. All educational qualifications/certificates must be from a recognized Board/University. Experience shall be preferably from Government organizations and is counted after the date of completion of the minimum essential qualification; experience from reputed National/International organizations will also be considered, and experience in the relevant field/area, as required for the project, will be considered. Experience in data entry, documentation and MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with Google Workspace and Canva. Experience in research/clinical data collection, participant follow-up, record keeping and file management. Experience in procurement documentation and administrative work in a government/research setting. Basic knowledge of statistics, and basic understanding of AI and automation tools. Good communication and interpersonal skills; ability to communicate effectively in English, Telugu and Hindi will be preferred. The upper age limit is 35 years as on the date of the interview. The notice's vacancy table heads this column "as on 11th December 2026", which is the tentative interview date. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates who are already employed in a regular position under the Central/State Government, Government institutions, or other Government organizations are not eligible to apply for the post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a monthly remuneration of Rs. 20,000/- + HRA, As Admissible, described in the notice as a consolidated fixed salary. The appointment is for the sanctioned period of 18 months, purely on contractual and temporary basis, and is co-terminus with the project. It will automatically come to an end with the completion/termination of the project or expiry of the sanctioned period, whichever is earlier. Any extension will be subject to satisfactory performance, project requirements, continuation of the project, availability of funds, and approval of the competent authority. The appointee will have no claim for regular appointment, permanent employment, or absorption in AIIMS Bibinagar or any other Government organization. These are tenure vacancies under a funded project and are not employment on AIIMS Bibinagar payroll. Leave is admissible as per AIIMS Bibinagar rules for project staff, on a pro-rata basis where applicable; it is not carried forward beyond the contract and unavailed leave is not encashed, unless the applicable rules provide otherwise. The appointment may be terminated by either side by giving one month's notice or one month's remuneration in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Should support ongoing projects by performing data entry and documentation, conducting data analysis and reporting, and providing overall technical and operational assistance. To maintain project records, files and registers, and to assist in procurement documentation and administrative work of the project. To assist in data analysis, progress reports, utilization-related documentation and other reporting to the funding agency. To undertake any other project-related duties assigned by the Principal Investigator. The selected candidate may also be required to perform field visits, participant follow-up and other activities, as required by the study protocol and directed by the Principal Investigator.

This recruitment fills Probationary Officer posts from among domiciles of the UT of J&K, and the online examinations will be conducted by IBPS. Selected candidates must stay posted within the Branch/Office(s) of the Zone first allotted to them for at least five years.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Probationary Officer Category-wise Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice gives reservation as percentages, not as the number of posts in each category. Reservation follows the Union territory of Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Rules, 2005, as amended from time to time, and S.O. 176 dated March 15, 2024, issued by the Social Welfare Department, Civil Secretariat, J&K. Under section 34 of the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, the 4% reservation is divided as follows: Multiple disabilities from amongst the above, including deaf-blindness, are also covered. Only persons with benchmark disability (not less than 40% of a specified disability) are eligible for reservation, and they must submit a disability certificate issued by a Competent Authority. PwBD candidates whose certificate shows the condition as "likely to improve" under the temporary disability category are not eligible for reservation; conditions marked "Progressive, non-progressive or not likely to improve" are treated as eligible. A reserved category candidate who figures in the general list on own merit will not be adjusted against a reserved post; the original category stays unchanged. Unfilled EWS vacancies will be filled as per the reservation rules of the UT of J&K. A valid reserved category certificate must be held on the date of online registration. The EWS certificate should be valid for the year 2026-2027.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Probationary Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Domicile: only domiciles of the UT of J&K are eligible; selected candidates must submit the domicile certificate issued by the competent authority. The candidate must hold a valid marks sheet/degree certificate showing graduation as on the last date of registration (26 November 2026). The percentage of marks in Graduation, calculated to the nearest two decimals, must be entered while registering online. Where CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it must be converted into percentage, backed by a certificate from the appropriate authority on the University's conversion norms. Percentage is total marks in all subjects of all semesters/years divided by aggregate maximum marks (including honours/optional/additional optional subjects) multiplied by 100. Fractions are ignored: 59.99% is treated as less than 60%. A self-declaration of character and antecedents in a prescribed format is required. Candidature or appointment may be cancelled for material misrepresentation or conviction in a criminal offence involving moral turpitude. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Probationary Officer post.

rows.qualification_required: Graduate in any discipline from a university recognized by Government of India or any other equivalent qualification recognized by the Central Government/UGC, as on the last date of registration.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Probationary Officer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is minimum 20 years and maximum 30 years as on 01-01-2026, that is, a candidate must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996 and not later than 01.01.2006 (both dates inclusive). The maximum age limit applies to General and EWS candidates. The upper age relaxation for SC/ST/Socially and Educationally Backward candidates is allowed on a cumulative basis with the relaxation for Persons with Disabilities.

rows.category: Socially and Educationally Backward Classes (OBC, ALC/IB, Residents of Backward Areas)

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Probationary Officer Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The fee (Application Fees/Intimation Charges) is paid online from 07.11.2026 to 26.11.2026, both dates inclusive, through Debit Cards (RuPay/Visa/MasterCard/Maestro), Credit Cards, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards/Mobile Wallets. Bank transaction charges are borne by the candidate. Registration is complete only when the fee is successfully deposited. If no e-Receipt is generated, the payment has failed and the candidate must log in again with the Provisional Registration Number and Password and repeat the payment.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Probationary Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Online Preliminary Examination Online Mains Examination (Objective & Descriptive) Interview Candidates must qualify in each of the three tests by securing cut-off marks decided by IBPS in concurrence with J&K Bank. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category candidates, subject to overall merit. Candidates numbering 10 times the vacancies in each category are shortlisted for the Mains. Each candidate needs a minimum score in each test and a minimum total score. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category, subject to overall merit. Only Mains marks count for shortlisting, and candidates numbering 3 times the vacancies in each category are called for interview. Mains scores are not shared before the interview process is completed. The interview carries 100 marks, with minimum qualifying marks of 40% (35% for reserved category). The centre, venue, time and date will be given in the interview call letter, downloaded from https://jkb.bank.in/ . The final merit score combines the Mains and the interview in the ratio 80:20, and candidates must qualify in both. Provisional selection is by category-wise merit against the vacancies in each category and will be notified on the Bank's website.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Probationary Officer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The medium of examination is English, and each test is separately timed. The Descriptive Paper may be broadly based on economic and social issues, emerging trends in banking and technology, current events and ethics. Negative marking: one fourth of the marks of a question is deducted for each wrong answer in the objective tests of both the Preliminary and Mains. No penalty for a blank question. Scores from different sessions are normalized using the equi-percentile method, taken up to two decimal points. J&K Bank reserves the right to modify the structure of the examination, which will be intimated through its website. Candidates must choose six centres, of which at least three must be outside J&K-UT. Any other centre may also be allotted.

rows.test: General/ Economy/ Banking Awareness/ Digital/ Financial Awareness, including RBI Circulars

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for J&K Bank Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted online only from 07.11.2026 to 26.11.2026; no other mode is accepted. Before starting, keep scanned copies of the photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm, 20kb–50kb, 200 x 230 pixels preferred), signature in black ink (not in capital letters), left thumb impression on white paper, and the hand-written declaration in English, plus an active personal email ID and mobile number. Go to https://jkb.bank.in/ , open the relevant notification under the "Careers" tab and click "APPLY ONLINE". Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details and Email-id; note the Provisional Registration Number and Password sent by Email and SMS. Validate the details and save with "Save & Next"; the form can be completed in more than one sitting. Upload the photograph and signature as per specifications, and capture a live photograph by webcam or mobile phone. Fill the other details of the application form, then preview the whole form. Click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" after checking everything; no change is possible after this. Click the "Payment" tab, pay the fee online and click "Submit". Print the e-Receipt and the online Application Form containing fee details. The hand-written declaration text is: "I, _______ (Name of the candidate), hereby declare that all the information submitted by me in the application form is correct, true and valid. I will present the supporting documents as and when required." A declaration written by anyone else or in another language makes the application invalid. Visually Impaired candidates who cannot write may type it and put their left thumb impression below.

content_sections.heading: J&K Bank Probationary Officer Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must remain posted within the Zone first allotted for at least 5 years; no transfer outside that Zone is permitted on any ground before then. No change of category is permitted after registration, and requests to be considered under another category will not be entertained. Names of the candidate and father/husband must match the certificates, mark sheets and identity proof. Entry to the Preliminary and Mains needs the call letter and original photo identity proof with a photocopy; Mains candidates must also bring the stamped Preliminary call letter and stamped ID copy. Accepted ID proofs include PAN Card, Passport, Permanent Driving Licence, Voter's Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, college/university ID, Aadhaar/E-Aadhaar with photograph or Employee ID; Ration Card and Learner's Driving Licence are not accepted. Bring one additional photograph with the Preliminary call letter; keeping about 8 copies of the uploaded photograph is advised for later stages. Late reporting after the time on the call letter bars entry; biometric data is captured at the Mains, document verification and joining. Original documents (category, domicile, age, qualification) with photocopies are produced at document verification; candidature is cancelled without them at the interview. Scribe users need the Appendix I certificate (uploaded with the application) and Appendix II undertaking; eligible candidates get 20 minutes compensatory time per hour if registered for it while applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the Junior Grade Typist / Data Entry Operator post has four stages: Preliminary Examination, Language Test, Computer Application Test and Main Written Examination (Typewriting Test in English). Document verification is held before the Main Written Examination. The first three stages are qualifying; the final merit list is based only on the Typewriting Test marks. There is negative marking of 0.5 (half) mark for each wrong answer. Candidates securing not less than 33% (SC/ST) or 40% (other categories) are called for the Language Test. The Court may fix the cut-off mark considering the number of vacancies and of qualified candidates. Marks: essay in English of 300 words (30), precis writing (20), translation English to Odia (20), translation Odia to English (20) and English Grammar (10). At least 33% (SC/ST) or 45% (other categories) is needed to reach the Computer Application Test. Candidates securing 50% or more are called for the Main Written Examination (Typewriting Test in English). Candidates type about 400 words from printed matter in 10 minutes. 0.25 mark is deducted for each mistake; omission, substitution, addition and repetition of words count as mistakes. A script with more than 20 mistakes is disqualified. If marks are equal, the older candidate is placed higher. The Chief Justice may reduce the qualifying marks if sufficient candidates are not available.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Research scientist 1 (non-medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: Coordinate day to day project activities in consultation with the Principal Investigator. Coordinate screening, recruitment, enrolment and follow-up of stroke survivors and caregivers. Assist in obtaining informed consent and maintaining participant documentation. Coordinate formative research activities, including interviews, focus group discussions and stakeholder consultations. Facilitate co-design workshops with healthcare professionals, stroke survivors and caregivers. Coordinate the development, refinement and pilot testing of the telerehabilitation package. Facilitate coordination between participants, caregivers and the multidisciplinary rehabilitation team. Support patient and caregiver onboarding to the digital telerehabilitation platform. Monitor participant engagement, session attendance, adherence and caregiver participation. Coordinate baseline and follow-up assessments and data collection. Maintain research databases and ensure data completeness, accuracy and confidentiality. Monitor intervention implementation fidelity and document indicators. Assist in quantitative and qualitative data management, analysis and interpretation. Assist the Principal Investigator in overall project fund management, including budget monitoring, expenditure tracking, and preparation of financial statements and utilisation reports in coordination with the relevant institutional sections.

basic_details.job_title: ITPO Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Senior Security Consultant, Security Consultant Posts
basic_details.short_information: India Trade Promotion Organisation (ITPO), under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, invites applications from willing and eligible retired Government employees and the Private Sector for 4 contractual posts at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi: 1 Sr. Security Consultant and 3 Security Consultant. Applications must be emailed to [email protected] within three weeks of the Circular's publication on the ITPO website, which is about 2 December 2026 (3 weeks from 11 November 2026).

qualification.details: The pay is a consolidated monthly remuneration, subject to statutory deductions. Retired Government employees who draw pension get a fixed monthly remuneration equal to the last pay drawn minus the basic pension, plus Transport Allowance, as per Department of Expenditure O.M. No 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. There is no annual increment or percentage increase during the contract period. | The notice requires that the health of applicants supports their candidature, with a medical fitness certificate at the time of application and at joining (in case of selection), and a Police Clearance Certificate. It prints no age relaxation. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

selection_process: All applications received will be scrutinized by a Scrutiny Committee

and the eligibility data of candidates will be tabulated. The scrutinized/shortlisted applicants will be called for a personal interview before a Selection Committee. ITPO reserves the right to accept or reject in part or in full or all the responses without assigning any reasons whatsoever.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely contractual: initially for 1 year, extendable up to 3 years, one year at a time depending on requirement within the organisation. Place of posting: India Trade Promotion Organisation, New Delhi. Leave of 8 days a year is allowed on pro-rata basis; absence beyond 8 days in a year means no remuneration, and absence for a continuous 8 days without information or valid reason leads to automatic termination. Working hours are the same as regular Government employees working in ITPO. Attendance is marked in the Biometric Attendance System. No extra remuneration is allowed for work beyond office hours or on Saturdays, Sundays or Gazetted holidays. No TA/DA is admissible for joining or on completion, or for attending interviews or written test. A fixed Transport Allowance for commuting is allowed, not exceeding the rate applicable at the time of retirement. No other facilities such as DA, accommodation, residential phone, conveyance, foreign travel, personal staff, medical reimbursement or CGHS are admissible. TDS is deducted from the monthly remuneration. Selected candidates give integrity certificates from 2 references and a self-declaration of no criminal record or pending criminal case. The consultant is not entitled to absorption or regularization of service. To resign, a consultant gives at least one month's notice or remuneration in lieu, which the Competent Authority may waive in deserving cases. ITPO may terminate any or all consultants at any time without assigning any reason. Consultants are subject to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923 and sign the non-disclosure undertaking; an Annual Performance Report is used for appraisal.

content_sections.text: India Trade Promotion Organisation is registered under section 25 of the Company Act, 1956 (now Section 8 of the Companies Act 2013). The notice is issued from its Administration Division, E-I Section, Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.

content_sections.text: Send the duly filled application in the prescribed format at Annexure-III, together with the Non-Disclosure Undertaking at Annexure-IV, by e-mail to [email protected] . The notice gives no subject line for the email. Applications received after the closing date, by hand or by post will not be accepted under any circumstances. Fill in the application form at Annexure-III, which carries a recent coloured passport size photograph, PAN and Aadhaar details with copies, education, experience and two references. Fill in and sign the Non-Disclosure Undertaking at Annexure-IV, addressed to GM (BM-Coord.) & HoD (Administration). Email both to [email protected] within three weeks of the Circular's publication on the ITPO website. Queries may be sent to the same address, [email protected] . The detailed guidelines of engagement are available on ITPO's career page at https://www.itpo.gov.in/career-at-itpo .

content_sections.heading: ITPO Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of job responsibilities, which applies to both posts: Monitor security activities at Bharat Mandapam premises including parking areas. Ensure safety of vehicles, visitors, and staff. Conduct regular patrols and site inspections of Bharat Mandapam. Manage access control and entry/exit procedures of Bharat Mandapam. Respond to security incidents and emergencies. Coordinate with security guards and parking teams for smooth day top day operations. Operation and maintenance of CCTV system, CCTV footage and report suspicious activities. Maintain security attendance records, daily situational reports and deployment records. Ensure compliance with safety and security procedures. Ensure safety and security arrangements during events/fairs. Liaison with local agencies for security operations. Recommend improvements for parking security and operations.

content_sections.heading: SECL FULL TIME ADVISOR at DCC Job Description
content_sections.text: The Advisor's role is to expedite mutation of DCC land acquired through 09 Nos. of notifications under the West Bengal Land Requisition and Acquisition Act, 1948. The work will broadly include: Supervising the job of mutation/updating of RoR/updating the nature of the acquired land of DCC in favour of the project. Pursuing with the State Govt of West Bengal regarding expediting mutation of land of DCC acquired in 09 Nos. of notifications. Liaising with the Govt of West Bengal for arranging necessary documents for the job. Any other jobs assigned as per the requirement of DCC and SECL. The selected Advisor would be stationed at DCC or as per the requirement of the Company, must maintain the integrity and secrecy of the Company's business, must not engage in any other business during the tenure, and must devote whole time to the company.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The scales for Professor and Associate Professor are under the 7th Pay Commission w.e.f. 1 January 2016. The pay carries allowances such as DA (currently 60% of basic), Leased Accommodation/HRA (20% of basic), LTC, Medical Allowance, Term Insurance, Children Education Allowance, NPS, Reimbursement of Telephone Bills, Incentive for Research Publications, Faculty Development Fund for attending National and International Conferences, Membership of Professional Bodies etc. as per IIM Jammu Rules. Faculty members are permitted to pursue MDPs and Management Consulting as per IIM Jammu Rules. For regular appointment, there would be a probation period of 2 years. For contractual appointment, depending on the academic credentials of the candidate, the Institute may consider an offer on a contractual basis of one/two years. A higher start in the pay scale may be considered for exceptionally deserving candidates. Appointed initially for one/two years, renewable every year for a maximum period of up to 5 years based on performance. The retirement age will be 65 years. Selected candidates will get Consolidated Compensation, Accommodation, Medical Allowance, Term Insurance, Reimbursement of Telephone Bills, Incentive for Research Publications, Faculty Development Fund for attending National Conferences, Membership of Professional Bodies etc. as per IIM Jammu Rules. Faculty members are permitted to pursue MDPs and Management Consulting after meeting the minimum teaching requirements as per IIM Jammu Rules. The appointment may be for an initial period of one/two years, which may be extended as per the requirement of the Institute subject to satisfactory performance. Accommodation on campus is provided subject to availability, or a fixed HRA of Rs. 15000/-. Actual telephone reimbursement up to Rs. 1500/- pm and medical allowances as per IIM Jammu Rules. Incentives for research publications, training and consulting as per IIM Jammu Rules. All other terms and conditions apply as per IIM Jammu Rules for contract employees.

content_sections.heading: IIM Jammu Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Faculty members are expected to carry out research, design and teach courses, engage in institution development, conduct training programmes and undertake consultancy. Senior academicians and professionals are required at IIM Jammu for assignments as consultant in developing the academic and research programs, academic administration, taking classes at degree awarding programs, organising senior level management development programs (MDPs) and conducting consulting assignments. The job profile is: Senior Consultant will be given responsibility to head a 'Centre of Excellence' or any major activity of the Institute and may be designated as Head of the Centre or the Activity. He/she will teach a minimum two courses in UG/PG programs, conduct at least one MDP and organise one international conference per year on contemporary issues relevant to the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be invited for interview before the Faculty Selection Committee. Papers published only in the journal categories listed above are considered for shortlisting of applications for regular/contractual positions. Mere fulfilment of the qualifications and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. The Institute will prepare an area-wise merit list, valid for one year, and the appointment letter will be issued as per the requirement of the Institute. Candidates called for interview to fill a vacancy may be considered for a lower post if otherwise found suitable. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Jammu Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the IIM Jammu website, www.iimj.ac.in , and open Faculty Positions under Jobs@IIMJ. Use the "Online Application for Faculty Recruitment" link for Advt. No. IIMJ/Advt./Faculty-Rect./2026/02. Submit the online application so that it is received by 10 December 2026, 5:00 PM. Queries about the application go to [email protected] or phone 0191-2741400. The notice names no documents to be uploaded or enclosed.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications in any respect will not be entertained by the Institute. Candidates who applied in the last one year need not apply again unless there is a substantial addition in research publications as per IIM Jammu rules. The Institute reserves the right to consider and to fill or not to fill positions in any of the above and/or any other specialization(s). Relaxation in qualification and experience, or a higher start in the time scale, may be considered for exceptionally bright candidates. Reservation Policy will apply as per the Government of India Rules. No correspondence or queries will be entertained regarding e-mail delays, conduct and result of interview, and reasons for not being called for the research seminar and interview. Amendments and corrigendum, if any, will be placed on the Institute website ( www.iimj.ac.in ) only.

content_sections.text: The Meghalaya State Rural Livelihoods Society is the nodal agency of the Government of Meghalaya for implementing NRLM under the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. Its office is at Montfort Building, 2nd Floor, Dhanketi, Shillong-793001. This recruitment fills posts at its State Mission Management Unit (SMMU) and its District Mission Management Units (DMMUs).

content_sections.text: MSRLS has advertised 5 posts, one vacancy for each post. Two posts are at the State Mission Management Unit and three at the District Mission Management Units. The annexures give the place of each post: PM-NFM (1 Post – Shillong), PM-SVEP (1 Post – Shillong), DFS-FI (1 post – Ri Bhoi), DFS-NFLP (1 post – Ri Bhoi) and DFS-SISD (1 post – Garo Region).

Experience in: (i) strategic marketing planning and promotion of products of SHGs, producer groups or micro-enterprises; (ii) developing market linkages, branding, packaging and retail/institutional buyer tie-ups; (iii) online and offline campaign development, including social media, e-commerce platforms and content marketing. Proficiency in MS Office/ Canva/ Adobe and internet applications. Working knowledge of English and at least one local language (Khasi/Garo/Pnar). Within 35 years of age. Exposure to working with Community Based Organization (SHGs, Village Organizations, Cluster Level Federations), and to trade fairs, exhibitions and sales outlets such as Saras. Experience with GeM, ONDC or other e-commerce platforms. Certification or formal training in rural marketing, entrepreneurship development, value chain management, or digital marketing from a recognized institution (Mandatory). content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The two Project Manager posts pay ₹46,800/- per month. The three District Functional Specialist posts pay ₹39,000/- per month. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of this pay. The appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis. No claim whatsoever can be made for any permanent position with the Government or any organization under it. All posts are transferable. The job requires extensive tours and night stays in remote rural areas of the state. It also involves staying at villages for about 15 days in a month. Only candidates willing to undertake such travels and stays may apply.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MSRLS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the MSRLS website (msrls.nic.in) and go to Notice Board -> Recruitment, where the application link is provided. Submit the online application between 10:00 am on 12 November 2026 and 5:00 pm on 26 November 2026. Fill in a correct and active e-mail address and contact number. MSRLS will use them for correspondence and takes no responsibility if a mail bounces. Upload self-attested copies of the documents listed below, in PDF format only, with a maximum document size of up to 10MB. Do not pay any fee. No application fee is required with the application. Documents named in the notice: Certificate for the Highest Educational Qualification only. A Marksheet, Provisional Certificate or Completion Certificate of the latest qualification may be uploaded as proof. Working Experience Certificate / No Objection Certificate only (Internship Certificate not allowed). Curriculum Vitae (CV). Proof of Date of Birth as per the Birth Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births & Deaths or as entered in Matriculation. Any address proof duly Certified/Issued by the Government (e.g. Valid Indian Passport/EPIC/Driving License/Aadhar Card). Candidates working in any private or public sector organisation may furnish a No Objection Certificate from their controlling authority at the final stage of selection. For queries, candidates can email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail. They will then go through a multi-modal selection process. The process will include a preliminary examination, followed by a group discussion, a skill test and/or any other tests MSRLS may decide. Preliminary examination: tests the verbal, quantitative and analytical abilities of the candidates. It will be held at Shillong. Group discussion, skill test and/or other tests: as MSRLS may decide. Candidates will be screened at every stage of the examination. Candidates appearing for the examination will not be paid any TA/DA. The notice does not give the examination date. Call letters will be sent by email, and recruitment updates will appear on the MSRLS website.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications in any respect, and ineligible applicants, will be summarily rejected. No further correspondence will be entertained. A candidate furnishing incorrect information, making false declarations about eligibility or suppressing material information is liable to be debarred from any recruitment stage. The candidature will also be summarily rejected. Any attempt to breach the process, or any action that violates or is likely to violate fair practices, is sufficient ground for debarment from this recruitment. Impersonation, procuring impersonation or other irregular or improper means makes a candidate liable to debarment from this recruitment and to criminal prosecution. Canvassing directly or indirectly for the posts will disqualify a candidate. The decision of MSRLS is final and binding. Candidates should regularly check their email for call letters and the MSRLS website for updates. MSRLS office contacts as printed: [email protected] , phone 0364-2502130.

content_sections.heading: About GeM
content_sections.text: Government eMarketplace is a Government Company registered under Section 8 of the Companies Act, under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India. It is a single digital platform that government departments, organisations and PSUs use to buy goods and services from sellers across India. It covers the whole process, from vendor registration and item selection to delivery and payment.

content_sections.heading: GeM Manager (Buyer Management- MoD and MHA) Vacancy Details 2026
GeM Manager (Buyer Management- MoD and MHA) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility is judged as on the last date for receiving applications, which is 15 November 2026. GeM's selection committee may relax or extend the eligibility criteria and educational qualifications. Essential: Graduate Degree in any discipline from a recognized University Desirable: Post Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university Essential: At least 11 years of experience in business development, key account management or a similar role. Preferable: A strong understanding of Government procurement processes. Preferable: Knowledge of GFR, DoE procurement guidelines and the GeM procurement framework. Preferable: Ability to analyse procurement cases and provide practical solutions. Strong people management, relationship management and leadership skills Capability to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment Result oriented, with a high bias for action and sharp business acumen Empathetic, positive attitude and a desire to help clients progress towards their goals Ability to influence decision making for win-win results High on ownership and self-motivation Knowledge of MS Office (PowerPoint and Excel) Ability to perform data analytics and generate reports using a BI Tool Proficient in handling confidential and restricted communications Ability to analyze tenders and prepare detailed reports Strong verbal and written communication skills Before applying, check the full eligibility for the post in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The Manager is the single point of contact (SPoC) for Defence (MoD) and MHA organisations and their buyers and consignees on GeM. The duties are listed under these heads: Buyer Management: help these organisations get onboarded, build their capacity and use GeM well. Track procurement trends and GeM adoption, and work with the relevant GeM verticals to resolve systemic issues. Procurement and Policy Advisory: examine cases against GFR, GeM GTC, DoE Manuals, DPM and other applicable Government rules. Advise on procurement modes such as Category, Bid, RA, Custom Bid/BOQ and PAC/STE/LTE, and recommend Defence-specific clarifications. Integration and Stakeholder Management: coordinate with MoD and MHA organisations, engage with senior officials, and prepare briefs, presentations, notes, ATRs and inputs for leadership. Procurement Case Examination: handle complex cases involving technical or financial evaluation, RA/L1, MSE/MII, post-bid changes, price matching, quantity distribution, contract amendments or cancellation, and EPBG/performance security. Recommendations must be documented and defensible. Monitoring and Performance Management: track GMV, orders, buyer participation, savings and other KPIs, ministry by ministry. Prepare dashboards, MIS and briefs, and monitor high-value procurements. Policy, Process and System Improvement: work with the Product, Technology, Policy, Category, Legal and other verticals. Support Defence-relevant GeM functions and collect structured feedback from users. Capacity Building and Outreach: run buyer workshops, training programmes, buyer meets and awareness sessions. Write advisories, FAQs and guidance notes, and support Defence-specific campaigns. Issue Resolution and Escalation: act as the escalation point for critical buyer issues, keep records of decisions, and escalate systemic or policy matters with clear recommendations. Key Shared Accountabilities: work with the tech and customer experience teams to communicate MoD and MHA buyer needs, for example integrated payment systems and value-added services.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process

content_sections.heading: APCOB Chief Business Development Officer (CBDO) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the roles and responsibilities under ten heads: Business Strategy, Planning and Growth: formulate business development strategies and plans for APCOB and DCCBs, drive growth in deposits, advances and fee-based income, monitor performance against targets, build models using the DCCB–PACS network as a last-mile channel, and develop annual/quarterly business KRAs. Deposit, CASA, Credit and Institutional Business Development: strengthen low-cost deposits and CASA, find branches below potential, identify Government Departments, Corporations, educational institutions, temples and local bodies for deposit business, and expand asset business. Product Development, Digital Business and Customer Proposition: facilitate deposit, loan and other products, develop distinctive customer value propositions ("WOW" factors), and promote digital banking and alternate delivery channels. Customer Segmentation and Rural Market Development: segment customers by occupation, livelihood, cropping patterns, income and banking behaviour, and target farmers, agricultural labourers, tenant farmers, SHGs, JLGs, FPOs, rural artisans, rural youth and pensioners. DCCB and Branch Business Transformation: assess DCCB potential, study branches with low business/viability, and replicate successful practices across branches and DCCBs. Marketing, Customer Acquisition and Business Partnerships: marketing and branding strategies, customer acquisition and retention, and institutional tie-ups and partnerships. Market Intelligence, Benchmarking and Business Analytics: benchmark against leading commercial banks and analyse business data and market trends for Management. Field Engagement, Capacity Building and Implementation Support: field visits to APCOB branches, DCCBs and DCCB branches across the State, workshops and training, and mentoring of branches. Profitable Growth, Risk Alignment and Performance Governance: keep growth aligned with asset quality, regulatory requirements, approved policies and risk appetite, and submit periodic reports to Senior Management. Other Responsibilities: other business development functions assigned by the Senior Management/Board of Management from time to time.

Products are sourced directly from entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs and local producers rather than external traders. The listed duties are: Retail Market Development: identify and establish new retail outlets, franchise opportunities and distribution channels. Sales & Revenue Growth: achieve sales targets through marketing campaigns, upselling and cross-selling. Customer Relationship Management: build and maintain strong relationships with retail partners, distributors and customers. Marketing Strategy Execution: plan and implement promotional campaigns, merchandising activities and brand-building initiatives. Market Research & Competitor Analysis: monitor competitor activities, pricing strategies and consumer trends. Operational Coordination: collaborate with supply chain, logistics and marketing teams. Reporting & Documentation: prepare periodic sales reports, marketing performance reviews and business development documentation. Retail Staff Training: guide and train retail staff on product knowledge, sales techniques and customer engagement. Strategic Partnerships: explore collaborations with retail chains, e-commerce platforms and vendors. Travel Flexibility: be available for travel to retail outlets, promotional events and partner meetings. Entrepreneur Product Sourcing: ensure retail outlets stock products developed or supplied by registered entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs and cooperatives. Market Linkages: facilitate direct connections between entrepreneurs and retail outlets, eliminating middlemen. Quality Assurance: monitor and maintain product standards to build consumer trust in entrepreneur-driven goods. Brand Promotion: highlight "Made by Local Entrepreneurs" branding in retail marketing campaigns. Sales Growth: position entrepreneur products as authentic, organic and regionally unique. Documentation & Reporting: maintain records of entrepreneur participation, product categories and sales performance.

content_sections.text: Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar University is a Central University located at Vidya Vihar, Rae Bareli Road, Lucknow-226025. These posts are in its Department of Food and Nutrition, School of Home Science, under the research project "Learning Initiative for Vitamin A and D Fortification Programming", run in collaboration with PGIMER, Chandigarh; BBAU, Lucknow; ICMR-NIN, Hyderabad; FSSAI, New Delhi; and SJRI, Bengaluru, for the session 2026-27. The notice is issued by Prof. Neetu Singh, Co-PI.

content_sections.text: The notice offers 2 project positions in total. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the two posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable qualification: Undergraduate Diploma in Computer Applications / Diploma in Financial Accounting. Prior experience in data entry. Experience in handling the GeM Portal. Knowledge of GFR and CCS (CCA) Rules. Experience in office administration or project documentation. Working knowledge of English and Hindi. Essential qualification: (i) Master's degree in Remote Sensing & GIS, Geoinformatics, Geography, Environmental Science, or an allied field from a recognized university/institution, with a minimum of one (01) year of relevant experience. OR (ii) Graduate degree in Geography, Environmental Science, Remote Sensing & GIS, Geoinformatics or an allied field from a recognized university/institution, along with a Postgraduate Diploma in GIS and Remote Sensing, and a minimum of one (01) year of relevant experience. Desirable qualification/skills: Experience in community-based/household surveys. Experience in GPS/GNSS and mobile-based data collection. Familiarity with ArcGIS/QGIS and GIS mapping/geotagging. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian Nationals may apply. The single vacancy is unreserved (UR). Minimum 8 years of relevant supervisory experience in an academic institution, preferably in a Business School or CFTI. Applicants should have experience in academic administration and government-related matters and a flair for serving an academic institution. Only relevant experience gained after the minimum qualifying degree is considered. Internships or Traineeships are not counted as work experience. The experience requirement is relaxable at the discretion of the Institute. Not exceeding the age of 50 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen candidates is as per Government of India rules. Candidates should have sound health and good moral character. They should not be involved in or related to any criminal case or any offence or act involving moral turpitude. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.minimum_qualification: Post Graduation or equivalent from a recognized university/institute with 55% marks or its equivalent

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A consolidated salary equivalent to Pay Level 10 (Gross) is paid every month during the contract term. The appointee is entitled to Group Medical Insurance as per the Institute's policy. If a retired senior official from the Central/State Government, CFTIs, Public Sector Undertakings or Defence Forces is selected, the consolidated salary is fixed as per Govt. of India guidelines. The initial contract period is 2 (two) years. The contract may be extended for a further period of up to 2 (two) years on a 1+1 year basis, subject to performance review and the requirement of the Institute. A contractual appointment does not create any right to a claim for future appointment in any contractual or regular position.

content_sections.heading: IIM Ranchi Manager (Academics) Job Description
content_sections.text: Handling activities of Academic Programmes and other academic and non-academic assignments. Supervising overall management and handling of activities related to admissions and academic administration of the Academic Programmes. Liaison with Visiting/Guest faculty with respect to programme and sessions. Preparation of the Academic calendar and Area teaching plans under the guidance of respective Programme Chairpersons. Interaction with candidates/participants of different programmes. Scheduling of classes, conduct of exams and preparation of grade sheets. Maintaining fellowship/contingency funds and liaising for accommodation and mess facilities for participants attending Programmes.

content_sections.text: Apply online through the Institute website https://www.iimranchi.ac.in/ as per the prescribed procedure, along with relevant documents. Submit the print out when called for interview; it is required at document verification/interview. Do not send a hard copy of the application to the Institute. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received are scrutinised and only shortlisted candidates are called for interview. Meeting the advertised requirements does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called. Selection is made on the basis of the candidate's previous records and performance in the interview. The Institute may set higher criteria for shortlisting and decide the criteria or procedure for it. The selection committee may decide its own method of evaluating interview performance. The Institute may hold a written test and/or interview for selection, as required. The interview schedule and the copies of certificates to be submitted are e-mailed to the registered e-mail address; no separate letter is sent by post. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

how_to_apply: Open the Apply Online link given in the advertisement; detailed instructions are on the Bihar Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya website, https://vidhansabha.bihar.gov.in.
Register and fill the online form between 7 November 2026 (11:00 AM) and 27 November 2026, using your own working mobile number and email ID.
Tick the box beside each post you are applying for.
Upload scanned copies of your educational and reservation certificates, a recent photograph and your signature, and check that the images are clear.
Pay the fee by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card; bank charges are added to the fee. Print and keep the bank receipt.
After final submission, log in again and download the filled form from the "Download Filled Application Section" on the dashboard; print two copies.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Within these 50 posts, horizontal reservation is also given to candidates with disabilities: 1 post for the blind and low vision category and 1 post for the deaf and hard of hearing category. One post is reserved under the 2% horizontal reservation for grandsons and granddaughters (children of a son or daughter) of former freedom fighters of Bihar.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India. For both posts – Assistant Section Officer and Assistant Caretaker – the candidate must hold a graduate or equivalent degree from a university recognised by the State Government or the Central Government by the last date for filling the online application. A candidate with the required qualification may apply for more than one post. A separate application for each post is not needed: ticking the box beside the posts shown in the registration form makes the candidate an applicant for each ticked post, and only one fee is payable. If two candidates are in contention for one post, the desirable qualification fixed for that post decides. The post-wise desirable qualification is given in the Schedule attached to the Bihar Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya (Recruitment and Service Conditions) Rules, 2018. Candidates should check the official notification for the eligibility of each post. The minimum age is 21 years on 01-08-2023. Age is counted from the date of birth recorded in the matriculation or equivalent certificate. The maximum age limit is: Reservation benefit is only for candidates whose permanent residence is in Bihar; residents of other states do not get reservation. Reservation must be claimed in the column of the online form; the permanent address given in the online form alone is accepted for reservation. Reservation for EWS is 10%, for persons with disabilities 4% (horizontal) and for women 35% (horizontal), subject to vacancies and rules. The reservation category cannot be corrected or changed during the appointment process. Claims are valid only if all certificates are produced by the date fixed by the Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya.

content_sections.text: Printed, typed or handwritten applications outside the online form are not accepted. Candidates who already applied in the 2024 windows need not apply again. The notice does not give a separate last date for fee payment in the new window. The fee is not refundable. SC/ST candidates who pay the SC/ST fee but later fail to produce the certificate, or whose certificate is doubted, may be disqualified; they may voluntarily pay the fee for general candidates to keep their candidature safe. SC and ST: caste certificate and permanent residence (domicile) certificate. BC and EBC: caste certificate, permanent residence certificate and non-creamy layer certificate. Unmarried or married women: caste and non-creamy layer certificates issued from the father's permanent address. Caste and residence certificates must be issued by the Circle Officer (Anchaladhikari) of the permanent residence circle notified by the State Government. EWS: income and asset certificate in Annexure-1 (Form-1) of the government notification, issued by the competent authority. Grandchildren of freedom fighters: certificate signed by the District Magistrate of the home district or an officer authorised by him, and an identity card. Persons with disabilities: certificate of at least 40% disability in the prescribed form from the Medical Board.

rows.category: Men of EBC, BC, EWS and Unreserved categories who are original residents of Bihar; candidates from outside Bihar of any category (women and men)
SC, ST and PwD (40% or more) candidates who are original residents of Bihar; women of all categories who are original residents of Bihar

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is in two stages: a Preliminary Examination (objective, multiple choice, OMR answer sheet) and a descriptive Main Examination. A post-wise merit list is prepared on the basis of the Main Examination. Each question carries 4 marks; 1 mark is deducted for each wrong answer. The medium is Hindi/English; if the Hindi and English papers differ, the English version is valid. Minimum qualifying marks: General 40%, Backward Class 36.5%, Extremely Backward Class 34%, SC/ST, women and candidates with disabilities 32%. If many applications are received, the preliminary may be held in more than one phase, and results will be prepared through normalisation. Syllabus: General Studies covers current events, India and its neighbouring countries, history, culture, geography, economy, polity and Constitution, Panchayati Raj and Bihar's role in the freedom movement; General Science (Physics, Chemistry, Biology) and Mathematics are broadly of matriculation level; Mental Ability covers verbal and non-verbal reasoning, number series, coding and decoding.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The examination programme will be published separately on the Bihar Vidhan Sabha website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Bihar Vidhan Sabha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 54 posts under Advertisement No. 01/2024: 50 Assistant Section Officer and 4 Assistant Caretaker. The number of posts may decrease or increase.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 27 November 2026; applications open on 7 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Do I need to apply again if I applied in 2024?
faq.answer: No. Candidates who have already applied for these posts need not apply again.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant Section Officer and Assistant Caretaker?
faq.answer: A graduate or equivalent degree from a university recognised by the State or Central Government, held by the last date of the online application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 21 years on 01-08-2023; the maximum is 37 years for Unreserved men, 40 years for Unreserved women and BC/EBC candidates, and 42 years for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Assistant Section Officer gets Pay Level 7 (Rs. 44,900-1,42,400) and Assistant Caretaker Pay Level 4 (Rs. 25,500-81,100), plus other admissible allowances as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs. 600 for Bihar-domicile EBC, BC, EWS and Unreserved men and for all candidates from outside Bihar; Rs. 150 for Bihar-domicile SC, ST, PwD (40% or more) and all Bihar-domicile women.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: An objective Preliminary Examination of 100 questions and 400 marks with 1 mark negative marking, followed by a descriptive Main Examination; the merit list is based on the Main Examination.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for both posts with one fee?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible candidates tick both posts in the registration form; only one application and one fee are needed.

basic_details.job_title: IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering at the Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune) has invited applications from Indian nationals for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in an ISRO-sponsored project under the RESPOND Programme. The fellowship is ₹37,000 per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms) for a project of two years. Applications go by email to [email protected] or through a Google Form, and the last date is 25 November 2026 (tentative). The interview is tentatively on 7 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Prepare a single PDF file containing the documents listed below.
Email the PDF to [email protected] with the subject "Application for JRF Position – ISRO RESPOND Project".
Alternatively, fill and upload the completed application form and all supporting documents through the Google Form: https://forms.gle/18NDdn1m6TyAcRUUA
The application form is placed at the end of the advertisement.
Documents named in the notice:
Duly filled Application Form.
Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV).
Self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets.
GATE/CSIR-UGC NET score card.
Experience certificates (if any).
List of publications along with copies of the first page of each publication (if any).
Any other supporting documents relevant to the project.
Undertaking (Annexure I).
For queries, the Project Investigator Dr. Dheeraj Dubey can be reached at [email protected] or 8840677530.
important_instructions: Meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee shortlisting for the interview. IIIT Pune reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview based on academic performance and relevant experience. The Institute reserves the right not to fill the advertised position if suitable candidates are not found. The selected candidate shall not claim any regular appointment in IIIT Pune by virtue of this fellowship. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. Original documents have to be produced for verification at the time of interview/joining. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will not be considered. Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification. The decision of IIIT Pune regarding selection is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow (JRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune
High Data Rate Channel Codec Architecture for Free Space Classical RF and Optical Communication
Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO), under the RESPOND Programme
Project duration two (02) years; initial appointment of six months
₹37,000/- per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms)
Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune
Email in a single PDF file, or the Google Form

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian nationals may apply. The essential qualification is a Postgraduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate/Postgraduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through a process described in either of these: (a) Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests such as CSIR-UGC NET (including Lectureship/Assistant Professorship), or GATE. (b) Selection through National Level Examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies/Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE (formerly MHRD), ICAR, ICMR, IITs, IISc, IISER, etc. Preference will be given to candidates having one or more of the following desirable qualifications: Strong background in Digital Communication, Wireless Communication, Information Theory, Channel Coding and Error Control Coding. Knowledge of Optical Communication and Free Space Optical (FSO) Communication. Experience with MATLAB, Python, or similar simulation/programming tools. Knowledge of communication system design and performance analysis. Good programming, analytical and technical writing skills. Research publications in relevant areas will be an added advantage. The notice does not mention a minimum experience. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is ₹37,000/- per month + 30% HRA (as per ISRO norms). The JRF will be appointed for an initial period of six months. Based on satisfactory performance, the appointment will be extended for the remaining duration of the project (up to two years), subject to the availability of project funds and institute/ISRO guidelines. The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct research related to high-speed channel coding for classical RF and Free Space Optical communication systems. Design, simulate and evaluate communication algorithms. Develop software models and validate system performance. Assist in preparation of project reports, technical documents and research publications. Participate in meetings and other project-related activities assigned by the PI.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Pune Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: Documents named in the notice: Duly filled Application Form. Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV). Self-attested copies of all educational certificates and mark sheets. GATE/CSIR-UGC NET score card. Experience certificates (if any). List of publications along with copies of the first page of each publication (if any). Any other supporting documents relevant to the project. Undertaking (Annexure I). For queries, the Project Investigator Dr. Dheeraj Dubey can be reached at [email protected] or 8840677530.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are first screened on eligibility and suitability for the project. Only shortlisted candidates are invited for the interview, and they are informed by email about the schedule. The interview may be conducted offline at IIIT Pune or online, depending on administrative requirements. Final selection is based on the candidate's academic credentials, research aptitude, technical competence and interview performance.

content_sections.heading: About ISM
content_sections.text: India Semiconductor Mission was established by MeitY as an independent business division within M/s Digital India Corporation, with administrative and financial autonomy, to drive India's strategies for developing the semiconductor and display manufacturing ecosystem. It is the nodal agency for implementing semiconductor and display schemes and is located at Electronics Niketan, 6, CGO Complex Lodhi Road, New Delhi – 110003.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration/ Management/ Public Administration/ any relevant discipline from a recognized university. Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Business Administration/ Management / Public Administration / any relevant discipline from a recognized university. Professional Certification or Training in office management/secretarial practices etc. Minimum 4 years of experience (post EQ) for bachelor's degree OR 02 years of experience (post EQ) for master's degree. Ph.D experience may be considered as relevant work experience, depending on the field of study and its relevance to the role. Relaxation in the prescribed experience may be considered for candidates from top-ranking Colleges/Universities (Bachelor's/Master's/Ph.D.) in the relevant discipline, as per NIRF 2025 Ranking or the latest available ranking. Relevant experience in executive assistance, secretarial support, or office management, preferably supporting senior leadership in Government / PSU / Autonomous Bodies / Corporate organizations. Excellent drafting and communication skills. Strong organizational and coordination abilities. Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Ability to manage multiple assignments and work under strict timelines. High level of professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality. Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills. The age of the applicant as on the last date of receipt of the applications will be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: ISM Executive Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Executive Assistant will give administrative and operational support to senior leadership, including managing schedules, coordinating meetings, handling confidential documents, facilitating communication and ensuring smooth day-to-day functioning of the executive office. The post reports to Advisor (Technology) / CFO. Key responsibilities as printed: Provide comprehensive administrative support to senior management. Manage calendars, appointments, and travel arrangements. Prepare correspondence, reports, presentations, and official documents. Organize meetings, prepare agendas, and record minutes of meetings. Coordinate with internal departments and external stakeholders. Follow up on action points and ensure timely completion. Draft official communications, letters, and emails. Maintain confidential records, files, and documentation. Manage information flow between executives and other departments. Assist in organizing official events, meetings, and conferences. Monitor deadlines and ensure timely submission of reports. Support administrative and operational activities of the office. Handle sensitive information with the highest level of confidentiality. Maintain professional communication with senior officials and stakeholders.

content_sections.text: *Age relaxable by 3 years for OBC. The notice also states that OBC, SC, ST and women candidates are encouraged to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Professionals with Post-Graduation in Anthropology/ Social Work/ Sociology / Public Health/ Social Welfare and Rural Management/Rural Development or any other subject of life sciences. Experience: a minimum of two (02) years of post-qualification experience exclusively in community-based health research with publications. Age: maximum 35 years. Essential qualification: MA/MSc in Anthropology/ Social Work/MPH/ Social Welfare and Rural Management/Rural Development other social sciences, or life sciences, with experience in community-based health research.
