content_sections.heading: About PSB
content_sections.text: Punjab & Sind Bank describes itself as a Govt. of India Undertaking, with its Head Office HRD Department at NBCC Building Block 3, Kidwai Nagar, New Delhi - 110023. The Chief Risk Officer will oversee risk management across the Bank, including at group level covering Domestic Operations, Domestic Subsidiaries and Branches.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal or Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 intending to settle permanently, or a person of Indian origin who migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Uganda, the United Republic of Tanzania, Zambia, Malawi, Zaire, Ethiopia or Vietnam intending to settle permanently. The last four groups need a certificate of eligibility issued by the Govt. of India. Graduate Degree from a university/institution recognised by the Government of India or its regulatory bodies. At least five years' experience in Corporate Credit and Risk Management at the level of Assistant General Manager or above in one or more Public Sector Banks; or in an equivalent senior position, with similar roles and responsibilities, in one or more regulated lending entities, as may be determined by the Bank and the CRO Selection Committee, with minimum experience of one year in Corporate Credit and one year in Risk Management. Along with any one of: (a) professional certification in financial risk management from the Global Association of Risk Professionals; (b) Professional Risk Management Certification from the PRMIA Institute; or at least two years' experience as Chief Risk Officer in a regulated lending entity where the CRO must be appointed with Board approval under a regulatory requirement. Preference may be given to candidates with one or more of the following: Chartered Financial Analyst charter from the CFA Institute. Chartered Accountant qualification from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India or an equivalent qualification obtained abroad. Cost and Management Accountant qualification from the Institute of Cost Accountants of India or an equivalent qualification obtained abroad. Postgraduate degree in Finance, Economics, Banking, Risk Management, Business Administration or a related field. Certification or specialised qualification in treasury risk, credit risk, operational risk, cyber risk, climate risk, data analytics or model-risk management. Desirable experience: good understanding of market risk and/or liquidity management and/or operational risk, with exposure to analytics an added advantage. Minimum 40 years of age and less than 55 years of age (as on 01.11.2026). The notice prints no age relaxation. Date of birth as per the Secondary School Certificate (SSC)/School leaving certificate must confirm age eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: the compensation and terms and conditions will be negotiated/finalised depending upon the suitability of the candidate. Tenure: the CRO may initially be engaged for a fixed contractual tenure of three years, extendable by one year at a time, up to a maximum of five years, subject to annual performance review by the Board/Risk Management Committee of the Board. The engagement is purely contractual and gives no right to claim regular employment or absorption in the Bank. Working hours and weekly off/holidays are as applicable to the Bank's serving employees. Leave: 30 days' paid leave per calendar year, not more than 05 days at a time. Absence beyond 30 days in a contract year leads to a proportionate deduction from the consolidated payment, and unavailed leave lapses at the end of the contract year. PF, Gratuity, Pension etc. do not apply, and no other allowance, payment, benefit or facility is payable beyond what the notice mentions. Location: preferably Head Office/Corporate Office; the Bank reserves the right to post the candidate to any office in India depending on administrative requirements.

content_sections.heading: PSB CHIEF RISK OFFICER Job Description
content_sections.text: The CRO oversees the entire risk management process of the Bank, including at group level, reviews risk models, and develops policies, procedures and pricing models. The role is grouped under credit risk, market risk, operational risk, and liquidity and interest rate risk management, and also includes RBI guidelines applicable from time to time. Annexure I of the notice lists these duties: Act as risk assessor and overall in charge of the Bank's Risk Management function, and advise top management. Implement and maintain an enterprise-wide integrated risk management and governance framework covering credit, investment, operational, market and compliance risk. Report the Bank's risk profile periodically to Risk Committees, top management and the Board, and implement BASEL guidelines as per RBI directives. Oversee the Fraud Risk Management Department (FRMD) and strengthen frameworks including EIRMS, policy and cyber risk governance. Credit risk: bank-wide credit risk management, risk limits and risk appetite, stress testing, preparation of the Annual ICAAP document, monitoring of large exposures, and validation of Credit Risk Assessment (CRA)/scoring models. Market risk: turn the Board's framework into policies and procedures, and guide the market risk team on interest rate risk, equity price risk, derivatives, country limits, counterparty bank limits and stress testing. Operational risk: supervise the ORM Cell, review operational risk policies, conduct the Product and Process Approval Committee, Credit Policy Committee, ALCO and ORMC meetings, oversee AML/CFT controls and IT security risk, and ensure Board RMC meetings are held as scheduled. Liquidity and interest rate risk: oversee the liquidity position of all PSB Zones and departments, supervise the ALM Cell and review the Asset Liability Management Policy. The notice adds that any other roles and responsibilities may be assigned by the authorities/Bank.

content_sections.text: Log on to the Bank's website https://punjabandsind.bank.in/ and, on the Home Page under the link "Recruitment", click the relevant Notification. No other mode of application is accepted. Before registering, keep a valid personal email ID and mobile number active until the appointment process ends. Call letters are sent to the registered email ID. Spell your name and your father's/husband's name exactly as in your certificates, mark sheets and identity proof. Any change found may disqualify the candidature. Pay the application fee online only. Cash, Demand Drafts, Cheques, Money Orders and Postal Stamps are not accepted. Submit the application by 17.11.2026. Applications received after the stipulated date and incomplete applications are rejected. The fee is Rs. 1000/- + GST as applicable. The table prints Rs. 1180/- (including CGST and SGST) for New Delhi and Rs. 1180/- (including IGST) for out of New Delhi. Transaction charges are borne by the candidate. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be held in reserve for any other selection. An application cannot be withdrawn once made.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process may broadly comprise preliminary scrutiny of applications, shortlisting, a personal interaction/interview before the Selection Committee, and verification of credentials. Final selection is on marks obtained in the interview, by merit ranking. Scrutiny: applications are checked against age, qualifications, experience and other eligibility conditions. Shortlisting: based on relevant experience, seniority, professional credentials and suitability, and on academic track record. Only shortlisted candidates are called. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: consolidated Rs. 57,700/- per month. Contract: the initial period is six months. It can be extended on the basis of performance and work, or till the regular appointment is made, whichever is earlier. The University may re-engage the Skill Assistant Professor if further staff is required, based on performance and the work and conduct report. This cannot be claimed as of right. No claim of regularization or extension will be entertained. The University may terminate the contract without assigning any reason. Allowances, provision and gratuity admissible to regular teachers are not given. Medical Reimbursement and LTC are not admissible. Casual leave is one day per month, up to a maximum of 5 days in the six-month contract. Medical/sick leave is one per calendar month, up to a maximum of 5 days. Maternity leave is as admissible under the Maternity Benefit Act, 1961. No contract amount is payable for absence from duty. Continuous unapproved absence of more than 5 days ends the service automatically. The engagement can be ended on one month's notice or one month's salary in lieu of notice, on either side. TA/DA is payable for official tours at par with other employees, as per University policy. No TA/DA is payable for attending any test or interview. No No Objection Certificate is issued for Ph.D. enrolment. Registration in a Ph.D. in this University or outside ends the engagement automatically.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes a written test, scrutiny of those who qualify, shortlisting on academic score, and a final selection on a composite score that includes a PPT presentation and an interview. All applicants are first allowed to appear in the written test without checking eligibility. Securing minimum 40% marks is mandatory (38% for DSC/OSC/BC/PwBD). Only applicants who qualify are scrutinised for eligibility. The structure and syllabus of the test will be uploaded on the University website in due course. Only eligible and test-qualified applicants are considered for shortlisting on an academic score out of 100: academic record 80, research publications 10, teaching experience 10. Shortlisted candidates are called for interview in a ratio of 1:15 for the first post, and the University decides the number called. Graduation: 80% and above = 15; 60% to less than 80% = 13; 55% to less than 60% = 10; 45% to less than 55% = 05. Post-graduation: 80% and above = 25; 60% to less than 80% = 23; 55% (50% for SC/ST/OBC non-creamy layer/PWD) to less than 60% = 20. M.Phil.: 60% and above = 07; 55% to less than 60% = 05. Ph.D. = 30. M.Phil. plus Ph.D. maximum 30. NET with JRF = 07; NET = 05; SLET/SET = 03. JRF/NET/SET maximum 07. Research publications: 2 marks for each paper in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals, maximum 10. Teaching/post-doctoral experience: 2 marks for each year, maximum 10, reduced proportionately for less than a year. Awards: national/international level 03; state level 02; maximum 03 in the awards category. A candidate who fails to secure at least 50% composite marks (47.5% for DSC/OSC/BC/PwBD) is not considered suitable. A tie in composite score goes to the older applicant, and if the date of birth is the same, to the candidate who acquired the essential degree earlier.

basic_details.short_information: The Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agricultural University (CCS HAU), Hisar, has one Young Professional-II (YP-II) post on a contractual basis under scheme 3828-C(g)-PB-124-OA. The post pays ₹42000/- p.m. fixed and runs up to 31 March 2027, which the notice says is likely to be extended. The essential qualification is an M.Sc. in Genetics and Plant Breeding or a graduate degree in Agricultural Sciences. Applications on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) must be received by 20 November 2026, and the interview is on 21 November 2026 at 3:30 pm.

how_to_apply: Candidates apply offline on the prescribed proforma (Annexure A) printed with the notice. The complete application must be received in the office of the Professor & Head, Department of Genetics and Plant Breeding, CCS Haryana Agril. University, Hisar - 125004, by 20 November 2026. No application received after that date will be entertained for any reason. The notice does not specify the mode of sending.
The Annexure A form asks for:
Full name in block letters, father's name, date of birth, age as on the interview date, sex and marital status
Permanent address with PIN code, mobile number and e-mail address
Category (SC/ST/OBC/General)
Educational qualifications from Matriculation to Ph.D., with board or university, year of passing, marks and percentage
NET status, computer knowledge, work experience and publications
A brief note on how the candidate can contribute to the present project, and a signed self-declaration
Attested passport size photograph, fixed on the form
No objection certificate from the present employer, if applicable
Original certificates at the interview
Certified true copies or original certificates, to be submitted to the University
NOC from the Dean PGS, for Ph.D. students, at the interview

The selected candidate can leave after one month's notice or by paying one month's emoluments. When the project ends, the candidate will be relieved. An agreement on non-judicial stamped paper of Rs. 15/- must be signed before joining. The candidate must report within 15 days of the appointment order. The Park runs the DAY-NRLM Incubator Programme, Odisha, with the Odisha Livelihoods Mission (OLM), to support growth-oriented micro-enterprises. The notice describes the positions as purely temporary/project-based and co-terminus with the programme, subject to the availability of funds and continuation of the project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian Nationals may apply. For both posts the essential qualification is Post-Graduation in Business Management, Development Studies, Rural Management, Accounts, Economics or related fields, or a professional qualification such as CA/ICWA or equivalent. Age, qualification and experience are reckoned as on the last date of submission of applications. The notice prints no age limit. Experience: minimum 12–15 years of relevant experience in setting up and/or managing a manufacturing/business enterprise, preferably in food processing, handicrafts or related sectors, with experience in a leadership position. Demonstrated expertise in overall business operations, particularly sales, business development, accounts and enterprise management. Desirable: experience of working with government programmes, development institutions, entrepreneurship/incubation programmes or rural enterprises. Preferred: candidates with extensive industry/business networks and stakeholder-management experience. Experience: minimum three (03) years of experience in enterprise promotion/management in a functional area such as production, sales, procurement, business development or related functions. Preference may be given to candidates having experience in sales/business development. Candidates from premier institutions such as IRMA, IIMs, IITs, NITs and other institutions of similar repute may be preferred. Candidates must be willing to travel extensively within Odisha and provide hands-on mentoring and support to approximately 60–75 enterprises. Higher relevant qualifications and experience may be considered. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is consolidated and stated per annum: up to ₹10,00,000 for the Project Lead and up to ₹12,00,000 for each Business Manager. It is subject to the applicable DAY-NRLM project norms, actuals-based reimbursement provisions and approval of the competent authority. The initial engagement is ordinarily for 12 months, extendable annually up to a maximum of three years, subject to satisfactory performance, achievement of approved KPIs, availability of funds and continuation of the programme. Selected personnel are engaged in accordance with the qualification and experience requirements of the DAY-NRLM Incubator Guidelines and are subject to approval by OLM before formal onboarding.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhubaneswar Research and Entrepreneurship Park Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice calls these responsibilities indicative and says they are not limited to the points below. Provide overall direction and guidance to the incubation team. Coordinate and supervise the work of Business Managers, Mentors and other project personnel. Interface with OLM, government officials, industry experts, financial institutions and other key stakeholders. Guide Business Managers in providing hands-on mentoring and support to incubated enterprises. Facilitate enterprise growth through business development, technology access, market linkages, standardisation, finance and other appropriate interventions. Review enterprise-level business and governance KPIs and ensure systematic monitoring of programme outcomes. Guide preparation and implementation of enterprise growth plans. Oversee the project MIS, reporting, documentation and knowledge products. Coordinate challenge fund-related activities and other programme activities as required. Participate in review meetings with OLM and other programme stakeholders. Ensure timely implementation of programme activities and achievement of approved project targets. Provide hands-on mentoring and handholding support to growth-oriented SHG enterprises. Assist enterprises in preparing and implementing business growth plans. Support enterprises in improving sales, production, procurement, financial management and business processes. Facilitate access to markets, finance, technology, registrations, certifications and other business-development services. Monitor enterprise performance against approved monthly, quarterly and annual KPIs. Identify enterprise-level gaps and facilitate appropriate technical/functional support. Coordinate with Mentors, functional experts and the Project Lead. Maintain enterprise-level records and contribute to project MIS and reporting. Undertake extensive field visits and provide regular enterprise-level support.

content_sections.text: Indian Bank has announced 1,500 apprenticeship seats across 30 States and Union Territories . Uttar Pradesh has the highest number of seats with 285, followed by Tamil Nadu with 270 and West Bengal with 145. District-Wise Vacancies: Annexure III of the official notification provides the district-wise distribution of apprenticeship training locations. content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000 in Metro/Urban branches or Rs. 12,300 in Rural/Semi-Urban branches during the 12-month training period. Stipend Clarification: The stipend is not a regular bank employee salary. Apprentices are not eligible for additional allowances or regular employee benefits under this engagement.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship duration is 12 months of on-the-job training under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Apprentices are entitled to bank holidays and one casual leave after completing each month of training. A maximum of four casual leaves may be taken at one time. The notification requires more than 338 paid days during the 12-month period to become eligible for the Certificate of Proficiency, subject to the prescribed assessment and completion conditions. After successful training and assessment, the Board of Apprenticeship Training (Southern Region) will issue a digital Certificate of Proficiency through NATS 2.0. No. Apprenticeship is a fixed-duration training arrangement. Indian Bank has no obligation to provide regular or contractual employment after completion of training, and apprentices do not have a right to claim employment with the bank.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 800 plus GST for General, OBC and EWS candidates . SC, ST and PwBD candidates must pay Rs. 175 plus GST. Fee Payment Period: 5 November to 25 November 2026. Payment Mode: Online through Debit Card, Credit Card or Internet Banking using the available payment gateway. The application fee is non-refundable. Applicable bank transaction charges are additional.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection procedure includes an online objective examination and a Local Language Proficiency Test (LLPT) . Indian Bank may also conduct an interview at its discretion. NATS Registration: Eligible candidates complete their apprenticeship registration and profile. Online Application: Candidates submit the application and pay the applicable fee. Online Written Test: Candidates appear in the 100-mark objective examination. Local Language Proficiency Test: Qualified candidates must demonstrate proficiency in the selected State/UT language unless exempt. Interview, If Conducted: The bank may include or dispense with an interview. Merit List: Candidates are ranked according to the applicable State/UT and category-wise merit rules. Document Verification: Eligibility and supporting certificates are verified. Medical Fitness: Engagement is subject to the bank's prescribed medical fitness requirements. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates receive their digital engagement through NATS 2.0.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The online examination consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 100 marks , with a composite duration of 60 minutes. Indian Bank will determine the minimum qualifying marks on the aggregate examination score. There are no separate minimum qualifying marks for individual sections. SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates receive a 5% relaxation in the prescribed aggregate qualifying percentage. The bank will prepare merit lists State/UT-wise and category-wise according to online examination performance. Candidates will be ranked in descending order of aggregate marks. If candidates have identical marks at the cut-off, the older candidate will receive preference. Where examinations are conducted in multiple sessions, scores will be normalized using the equi-percentile method. A State/UT-wise and category-wise waiting list may also be prepared to fill unoccupied apprenticeship seats.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Local Language Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be able to read, write, speak and understand one of the specified local languages of their selected State or Union Territory. The Local Language Proficiency Test will be conducted after the online examination. Candidates who fail to qualify will not be engaged as apprentices. Candidates who provide Class 8, Class 10 or Class 12 marksheets or certificates proving they studied their selected local language are exempt from appearing in the Local Language Proficiency Test. Important: Candidates without the prescribed language-study evidence must qualify in the LLPT. The test will be held at a centre decided by the bank in the relevant State/UT, and candidates must bear their own travel expenses.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice State and District Preference 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants can apply for only one State or Union Territory . During registration, candidates may choose three preferred districts within the selected State/UT. The bank gives the applicant's resident district the first preference in the applicable merit arrangement, while candidates may select two additional neighbouring districts. Important: District preferences do not guarantee posting in a particular branch or district. Indian Bank may allot candidates to any district within their selected State/UT according to availability and operational requirements.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Indian Bank Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following documents and records available for registration, application and subsequent verification, as applicable. Graduation degree certificate and marksheets. Proof showing the graduation result was declared on or before 1 November 2026. Date-of-birth proof. Valid identity proof. NATS 2.0 Enrolment ID. Recent passport-size colour photograph. Scanned signature. Left thumb impression. Handwritten declaration. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS category certificate, if applicable. PwBD disability certificate or UDID card, where applicable. Class 8, 10 or 12 certificate showing study of the selected local language, if claiming LLPT exemption. Other applicable documents requested by the bank during verification. Documents must be uploaded in the prescribed JPG/JPEG format. Candidates must also capture a live photograph through a webcam or mobile phone using the application portal's facility. The handwritten declaration must be written in English on white paper using black ink. It must be written in the candidate's own handwriting and must not be written entirely in capital letters. The official declaration is: Candidates should reproduce the declaration exactly as prescribed in Annexure II of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Exam Centres 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can indicate their preferred examination centre while applying, subject to the options provided by the application form. However, Indian Bank may allot a different centre according to availability. Requests for examination centre changes will not be entertained. Candidates must bear their own examination-related travel expenses.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: Indian Bank will issue examination call letters through its official website or other recruitment-related portals identified in the notification. Candidates must download their call letters using the registration number or roll number and the required login credentials. Call letters will not be sent by post. Applicants should regularly check their registered email and the official bank recruitment website for examination updates.

content_sections.heading: Indian Bank Apprentice Certificate and Contract Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a digital apprenticeship engagement offer through NATS 2.0. The apprenticeship contract is normally for 12 months and terminates automatically after completion of the prescribed training period. Candidates must report at the allotted bank branch or training venue on the specified joining date. Failure to report may lead to termination of the apprenticeship contract. A candidate who voluntarily leaves the training before completing the contract may be required to pay an amount equivalent to one month's stipend, under the notified conditions. Separate provisions apply to termination after securing gainful employment or due to medical grounds. Candidates should read the full contractual conditions before accepting the apprenticeship.

Essential: Ph.D in Bioinformatics/ Life Science/ Biotechnology/ Agricultural Statistics/ Statistics/ Computer Science/ Computer Application/ Agricultural Science/ Biostatistics or equivalent. OR Master's in the same fields or equivalent, with 4 years or 5 years of Bachelor's degree having 1st Division or 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average, with at least 03 years of research experience as evidenced from fellowship/ associateship/ training/ other engagements as circulated vide F.No. 2-9/2012-HRD dated 25.04.2014, and one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/NAAS rated (>=4.0) journal as per OM SR/S9/Z-09/2018 of DST dated 30.01.2019. Desirable: knowledge of Statistical and Computational Genomics/ Bioinformatics; knowledge of programming, LINUX/ R/ Perl/ Java/ PHP/ JSP and use of various software and tools; knowledge in DBMS. Age: not more than 35 years; 5 years relaxation for SC/ST/women candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates. Essential: Bachelor Degree with at least 60% marks in Bioinformatics/ Biotechnology/ Computer science/ Computer Engineering/ BCA/ Allied Sciences or equivalent from any recognized university, with one-year experience in relevant field. OR Master in Bioinformatics/ Biotechnology/ Computer science/ Computer Engineering/ MCA/ Allied Sciences or equivalent from any recognized university. Desirable: experience in web-site and portal development and management, and content management system with Joomla framework using Linux, Apache, MySQL, etc. based application development; experience in Java/ C++/ PHP/ PERL/ Python etc. based application development on Linux, Apache and MySQL/ Oracle; familiarity with fundamentals of Statistics/Ag.Statistics and model development, fundamentals of Bioinformatics and computational biology, the concept of GWAS/GS, and basic understanding of AI/ML model development; knowledge of programming languages (R/Python) and LINUX. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a competitive examination of two papers, held online (CBT) or in Offline-OMR mode. Candidates who are not exempt must also qualify in the compulsory Kannada Language Examination. Paper-1 covers the following topics: Current events, general science, geography and social science. History of Indian society and its development; history of India and Karnataka; the Indian Constitution and public administration. Practical knowledge and mental ability (SSLC level). Social and cultural history of Karnataka, and land reforms and social change in Karnataka after independence. Karnataka's economy, its strengths and weaknesses; rural development, Panchayat Raj institutions and rural co-operative institutions. The role of science and technology in effective governance in Karnataka; environmental problems and development of Karnataka; mental ability. Rules for the competitive examination: A minimum of 35 percent marks in the competitive examination is compulsory to qualify. Each question has 4 options. 0.25 mark is deducted for each wrong answer. The OMR sheet has a 5th option for unanswered questions. Five extra minutes are given after the final bell to shade it. If no option is shaded for a question, 0.25 mark is deducted. The Kannada Language Examination is a multiple-choice paper of 150 marks, set to the standard of SSLC first-language Kannada. The minimum qualifying mark is 50. Candidates who are absent or score less than 50 are not eligible for selection. The marks are not counted for selection or seniority. The following candidates are exempt from this examination: Those who studied Kannada as a first or second language in the SSLC examination of the Karnataka Secondary Education Examination Board, or in an equivalent or higher examination. Those who passed such examinations in the Kannada medium. Those who passed the compulsory Kannada examination held earlier by the Commission or another selection authority. Sports achievers will be given weightage marks as specified in Government Notification No. ಸಿಆಸುಇ 295 ಸೇನೆನಿ 2023.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled biodata in the application format Annexure-I and Annexure-II, with a photograph affixed on it and signed. The notice says a duly filled application form is compulsory. Self-attested scanned copies (PDF/JPEG) of the relevant documents, as printed in the notice. Original testimonials (date of birth, degree certificate, experience certificate, etc., if any), to be shown, plus a set of attested copies of all certificates for verification at registration and again before joining, if selected. Complete bio data and duly self-attested certificates and mark sheets from class 10th onwards, and experience certificates. A no objection certificate from the current employer, for candidates who are employed. Documentary proof of prior experience, which the Annexure-I form says is mandatory. Annexure-I asks for name in block letters, parent or spouse name, date of birth and age, present and permanent postal address, mobile number, Aadhar number, email, educational qualifications (Matriculation/SSC to Doctorate/Ph.D.), prior experience, additional information, and whether the candidate belongs to SC/ST/OBC/OC/PH/Ex-servicemen. It also asks whether the candidate is willing to be considered for a lower post if the application for the applied post is ineligible or not shortlisted for further scrutiny (Yes/No), and ends with a self declaration. Annexure-II is a declaration that no near or distant relative is an employee of ICAR-IIMR, or, alternatively, a statement of the name, designation and relationship of relatives working in ICAR.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Report at the venue by 10:15 AM; the 15-minute grace period is the only extra time allowed. Submit the filled Annexure-I and Annexure-II and show the originals at registration, along with a set of attested copies. Only candidates having the essential qualifications will be allowed to attend the interview, which starts at 10:30 AM. The notice does not describe marks, shortlisting or the way the interview decides the selection. It says the decision of the Director, ICAR-IIMR is final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.text: The initial basic pay ranges from Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 44,900 under the 7th Central Pay Commission, depending on the post and pay level. Applicable allowances and deductions will be governed by Railway rules and the employee's posting and service conditions.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The examination fee is Rs. 500 for most candidates and Rs. 250 for the eligible concession categories . Fee Payment Last Date: 6 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Payment Mode: Internet Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card or UPI. Applicable transaction charges are additional. Candidates who appear for the Computer Based Test are eligible for a partial or applicable fee refund after deduction of bank charges. The refund will be credited through the prescribed Aadhaar-seeded bank account mechanism. Candidates who do not appear for the CBT or whose applications are rejected are not entitled to the applicable refund. Economically Backward Class (EBC) candidates may qualify for examination fee concession where their annual family income is below Rs. 50,000 and they satisfy the documentary requirements. Economically Weaker Section (EWS) is a separate category used for reservation under applicable Government rules. Claiming EBC fee concession does not automatically provide EWS reservation or an OBC benefit.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment involves a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) , followed by a Translation Test for Junior Translator candidates, where applicable, and subsequent Document Verification and Medical Examination. Computer Based Test: Eligible candidates appear for the prescribed objective examination. Translation Test: Junior Translator (Hindi) candidates shortlisted from CBT must qualify in the translation test. Document Verification: Candidates are shortlisted according to merit, vacancy availability and applicable reservation rules. Medical Examination: Candidates must meet the medical standards applicable to their selected post. Final Empanelment: Subject to merit, qualifications, medical fitness and successful verification. RRBs reserve the right to conduct additional recruitment stages where necessary under the notification.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category CBT Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The standard CBT consists of 100 objective questions carrying 100 marks , with a duration of 90 minutes. Eligible candidates using a scribe receive 120 minutes. The notified subject-wise distribution is indicative and may vary slightly in the actual question paper. These are minimum eligibility percentages, not guaranteed selection cut-offs. A relaxation of two marks may be allowed for PwBD candidates where a shortage exists against reserved PwBD vacancies, as prescribed.

content_sections.heading: RRB Junior Translator Hindi Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Junior Translator (Hindi) candidates will appear for a specialized CBT followed by a qualifying Translation Test. The CBT is designed to assess knowledge of both Hindi and English. At least 50% of the questions will assess language proficiency, including approximately 20% English and 30% Hindi. Remaining questions cover General Knowledge, General Intelligence, Simple Arithmetic and basic computer knowledge. Important: Translation Test marks are not added to the final merit score. Candidates who fail to obtain 60% in the Translation Test will not be considered for further selection even if they performed well in CBT.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The CBT includes common subjects and post-specific Professional Ability questions. Detailed professional syllabi are provided in Annexures IX to XV of CEN 09/2026. Mathematics: Number system, percentages, ratio and proportion, algebra, geometry, mensuration, profit and loss, time and work, time and distance, interest and elementary statistics. Reasoning: Analogies, number series, coding-decoding, syllogism, relationships, Venn diagrams, decision-making, classification, data interpretation and analytical reasoning. General Awareness: Current affairs, Indian history, geography, Constitution, economy, sports, environment and scientific developments. General Science: Physics, Chemistry and Life Sciences up to Class 10 CBSE level. Professional Ability: Questions related to the academic or professional qualification prescribed for the selected post. Candidates should study the relevant syllabus annexure rather than relying on a generic Railway examination syllabus.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Medical Standards 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the medical fitness standards prescribed for their post. Failure to meet the required standard may result in rejection without an alternative appointment. Important: The medical standards include prescribed visual acuity and fitness requirements. Candidates who have undergone LASIK or other refractive surgery should check Annexure VII and the applicable medical conditions before applying.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply for CEN 09/2026 through the official Railway Recruitment Board application portal from 5 November to 4 December 2026 . Apply Online: RRB Recruitment Application Portal Notification Number: CEN 09/2026. Application Last Date: 4 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Fee Payment Last Date: 6 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Important: Candidates can choose only one RRB. Once selected, the RRB cannot be changed during the application process or modification window.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit www.rrbapply.gov.in . Find the application facility for CEN 09/2026 - Isolated Categories . If you already created an RRB account for a previous CEN in 2024, 2025 or 2026, log in using the existing account credentials. New applicants should select Create an Account. Enter personal details exactly as recorded in the Class 10 certificate or equivalent record. Provide an active personal email address and mobile number. Complete account creation and the required verification steps. Log in and select CEN 09/2026. Choose one RRB and review the vacancies available under it. Enter the educational qualifications and professional experience required for the selected posts. Provide the applicable community, reservation and relaxation details. Choose the preferred examination language. Enter the order of preference for eligible posts and Railway Zones or Production Units. Complete Aadhaar/DigiLocker verification where available and applicable. Capture a live photograph through the application portal. Upload the scanned signature according to the prescribed specifications. Upload other mandatory documents, including the applicable SC/ST certificate when requesting a free railway travel pass. Preview the application carefully. Submit the application by 4 December 2026 . Pay the prescribed application fee by 6 December 2026 . Save or print the submitted application and payment acknowledgement. Important: Only one application is permitted for CEN 09/2026. Submitting multiple applications to different or the same RRB can lead to rejection of all applications and debarment from future Railway recruitment examinations.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Photograph and Signature Requirements
content_sections.text: The application system captures a live photograph. Candidates are not required to upload an existing passport-size photograph during registration. Use a computer webcam or mobile front camera. Choose a plain white background. Wear non-white clothing, preferably a plain dark colour. Ensure the entire face is visible and centered. Do not wear spectacles, caps or masks while capturing the photograph. Follow the portal's positioning and lighting instructions. Do not photograph a printed or digital copy of an existing photograph. Important: Blurred, incomplete, incorrectly formatted or non-standard signatures may lead to application rejection. Eligible SC/ST candidates requesting a free railway travel pass must upload their valid category certificate in PDF format, with a file size below 400 KB .

rows.specification: Running Handwriting, Not Capital or Block Letters

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: The application modification window is scheduled from 7 to 16 December 2026 . The modification facility is available only for permitted application fields. Candidates should verify their permanent account information and RRB choice before submitting the original application.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must keep the relevant documents ready for online application and original document verification. Class 10 certificate or equivalent proof of name and date of birth. Class 12 Science certificate and marksheet, where applicable. Degree and postgraduate qualification certificates, where required. Professional diploma or certificate relevant to the selected post. Advocate practice or professional experience certificates, where applicable. Valid photo identification. Scanned signature meeting RRB specifications. SC/ST certificate, where applicable. OBC-NCL certificate in the prescribed Central Government format, where applicable. EWS Income and Asset Certificate, where applicable. EBC income or other prescribed certificate for fee concession, where applicable. PwBD certificate and scribe-related records, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen service documents, where applicable. Minority declaration, where required for fee concession. No Objection Certificate from the current employer, where applicable. Application confirmation and fee payment acknowledgement.

content_sections.heading: RRB Isolated Category Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: RRB CEN 09/2026 announces 191 isolated-category vacancies. Applications are open from 5 November to 4 December 2026. The application fee payment deadline is 6 December 2026. The modification window is 7 to 16 December 2026. Candidates may select only one RRB. Multiple applications can result in rejection and debarment. Educational qualifications must be completed by the application closing date. Candidates awaiting final results are ineligible. Age is calculated as on 1 January 2027. Post-specific medical standards are mandatory. The standard CBT contains 100 questions for 100 marks. Negative marking is one-third of the marks for each wrong answer. Junior Translator candidates must qualify in the additional Translation Test. Exam fee refunds depend on CBT attendance and the notified conditions. Live photo capture is mandatory during application. The scanned signature must meet the prescribed specifications. Official communication will be published through the RRB websites and registered email/mobile channels. All vacancies are provisional and may change.

content_sections.heading: MbPA Principal Advisor (Port) Job Description
content_sections.text: Annexure-A says the Principal Advisor shall: Advise the Chairperson on strategic matters relating to Port Management and Operations. Review organizational systems and recommend administrative reforms for improving efficiency and governance. Assist in implementation of Government policies, Board decisions and Ministry directives. Monitor important operational initiatives, modernization projects and institutional reforms. Facilitate coordination amongst various departments for timely execution of strategic assignments. Advise on operational optimization, productivity enhancement and business process improvements. Provide strategic guidance in policy formulation, administrative restructuring and change management. Liaise with the Ministry of Ports, Shipping & Waterways, Major Port Authorities, Government Departments and other external agencies whenever required. Mentor senior officers and assist in capacity building of management personnel. Undertake any other strategic assignment entrusted by the Chairperson/ Dy. Chairperson. Function under the direct supervision and administrative control of the Chairperson/ Dy. Chairperson.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of documents and certificates relating to age and qualification; the form also asks for self-attested proof of date of birth and self-attested qualification certificates. A "No Objection Certificate" from the employer, for candidates serving in Government/ Semi Government, Public Sector Undertakings/ Autonomous Bodies, at the time of application. Without it, the candidature may not be considered. Necessary documents for any outstanding achievement recognized by a higher authority, if claimed. Details of two reference persons with contact details (email and mobile number). Passport size photograph affixed on the form. Original certificates must be produced for verification at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says that, depending on the response, the Administration reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for a written examination and/or interview. The notice does not describe the syllabus, marks or dates of either stage. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in a written examination or interview, if called. Decisions on eligibility, shortlisting and engagement are final, and no representation will be entertained.

rows.event: Last date for receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: Contract Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is initially for one year, extendable at the discretion of MbPA with the Chairperson's approval, subject to satisfactory performance review. MbPA will not provide regularization or permanency. Leave: 20 days Casual Leave in a year and Public Holidays. For other absence, pro-rata deduction is made from the consolidated remuneration. Duty hours: 10.00 A.M. to 6.00 P.M. or as decided by the Administration, with a weekly off on Sunday normally. Work beyond normal hours carries no other compensation. Accommodation: MbPA quarters subject to availability. If availed, rent is 10% of consolidated remuneration plus licence fees, with electricity and water charges on actual consumption. Medical: emergency treatment in case of accident on duty at MbPA hospital/dispensary; no other medical facilities for the person or family. Termination: either side can end the contract with one month's written notice. If the person leaves without notice, the pay due is forfeited to the extent of the notice period.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must submit a discharge/relieving letter from their employer at joining; without it they will not be allowed to join. Engagement is subject to medical fitness, service and contract rules of MbPA, and police verification of antecedents. The selected person may not take up any other assignment during the engagement and is governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923. Records of the assignment must be handed over before the contract expires and before final payment. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidate. MbPA may change the number of vacancies or any clause, or cancel the recruitment at any stage, without assigning reasons. Updates and corrigenda appear only on www.mumbaiport.gov.in ; no separate communication is sent to applicants. Legal disputes fall under Mumbai courts only.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 200 Seats
content_sections.text: National Insurance Company Limited has announced 200 apprenticeship training seats across 14 states . Assam has the highest allocation with 30 seats, followed by Gujarat with 22 seats. Vacancy Clarification: The 200 seats are provisional and may increase or decrease according to NICL's requirements. The notification provides state-wise totals but does not announce separate district-wise or category-wise numerical allocations. No. Candidates can apply for apprenticeship engagement in only one state . NICL reserves the right to allot selected candidates to any district within their chosen state based on administrative requirements. Applicants should therefore select their state carefully before submitting the application.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed a regular, full-time graduation degree in any discipline from a university or institution recognized by AICTE, DOTE or UGC. They must have passed their qualifying examination and possessed their degree certificate by 1 April 2026. The notification includes graduation qualifications such as B.E., B.Tech., B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., BBA and BCA in its NATS application instructions. Candidates must satisfy the recognition, completion and other eligibility conditions. The official notification specifically excludes the following candidates: Candidates holding a postgraduate degree. Candidates who have completed an integrated postgraduate course. Candidates who graduated from an institution not approved by AICTE, DOTE or UGC, as applicable. Candidates who have previously undergone apprenticeship training with NICL or another organization. Candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates whose previous apprenticeship training was terminated midway. Candidates with one year or more of work experience in a Government, public-sector or private organization as on 1 April 2026. Candidates without a fully completed NATS profile. Candidates who do not meet the prescribed age or graduation completion requirements. No. Candidates who already possess a postgraduate degree or have completed an integrated postgraduate course are expressly excluded under this notification, even if they also hold an eligible Bachelor's degree. Yes. Candidates who completed regular, full-time graduation by 1 April 2026 and meet the other eligibility conditions can apply without prior employment experience. Candidates with one year or more of work experience as on 1 April 2026 are not eligible. Those with less than one year of experience are not excluded by this particular condition but must satisfy all other prescribed requirements.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit is 21 to 30 years as on 1 April 2026 , with applicable upper-age relaxation for eligible reserved categories. Both dates in the notified General/EWS date-of-birth range are inclusive. The applicable relaxation is subject to Government of India guidelines and submission of valid supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a fixed monthly stipend of Rs. 15,000 during the 12-month apprenticeship period. The Government component will be credited directly to the apprentice's bank account through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT), in accordance with applicable guidelines. Stipend Clarification: The Rs. 15,000 is an apprenticeship stipend, not a permanent employee salary. Apprentices are not entitled to other NICL employee allowances or benefits.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship period is 12 months . Selected candidates will receive practical training at the NICL office allotted within their selected state. Apprentices are entitled to one day of leave for each month of training, credited at the beginning of the following month and subject to prior approval. Unused eligible leave may be carried forward. A maximum of four days of leave may be taken at one time. Unused accumulated leave expires when the contract ends. Approved leave does not result in stipend deduction. Other absences may result in proportionate stipend deductions. No. NICL clearly states that it has no obligation to offer regular employment during or after apprenticeship training. The contract ends after 12 months, and apprentices cannot claim permanent absorption on the basis of completing the programme.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The official six-page notification does not specify an application or examination fee. Candidates should complete their application through the official NATS portal and follow the instructions displayed there. They should not make payments to unverified recruitment agents or intermediaries.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: NATS Registration: Candidates register and complete their NATS student profile. Online Application: Eligible candidates apply for the National Insurance Company Limited apprenticeship opportunity. Merit-Based Shortlisting: BOPT (Eastern Region) shortlists candidates using graduation percentage marks. Email Intimation: Shortlisted candidates receive instructions through their registered email address. Document Verification: Candidates appear in person at the designated NICL office with original certificates and self-attested copies. Final Engagement: Selection is subject to eligibility verification, state-wise seat availability and approval of the apprenticeship contract in NATS. NICL will use the percentage of marks obtained in the qualifying graduation examination, calculated up to two decimal places . Where the university awards CGPA, OGPA or GPA, the candidate must convert the score into a percentage using the official conversion formula prescribed by that university. Important: Candidates must enter their graduation percentage in the prescribed NATS profile field. Applications without the percentage information will not be considered. If two or more candidates obtain the same graduation percentage, the older candidate will receive preference in the merit list. No written examination is mentioned in the notification. Shortlisting is based on graduation marks, followed by physical verification of original documents.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentices Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit online applications for the 200 NICL Graduate Apprentice seats through the NATS portal from 4 November to 18 November 2026. Apply Online: NATS Apprenticeship Portal Establishment Name: NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LTD NATS Enrollment / Establishment ID: EWBPNC096867 Last Date: 18 November 2026. Candidates must apply specifically against the NICL advertised vacancy. Creating a NATS student account alone is not sufficient.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: The application procedure differs slightly for candidates who already have a NATS account and candidates registering for the first time. Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in . Click Student . Select Regular Student . Choose Student Registration . Complete the registration form with accurate personal, contact and educational details. Complete the NATS enrolment process. Save the generated 12-digit Enrollment Number . Log in and complete all required student profile sections. Ensure the NATS profile reaches 100% completion . Log in to the NATS portal using the registered email ID and password. Open Apply against advertised vacancies . Search for NATIONAL INSURANCE COMPANY LTD . Verify the available apprenticeship opportunity and establishment details. Select the applicable opportunity. Choose the eligible state for apprenticeship engagement. Check that your graduation details and percentage marks are entered correctly. Ensure the required certificates and supporting documents are uploaded in the NATS profile. Click Apply . Confirm that the application status displays Applied . Complete the application before 18 November 2026 . Retain the NATS Enrollment Number and application details. Important: Candidates already registered on NATS do not need to create another student account. They can log in with their existing credentials, complete their profile and apply to the NICL opportunity.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for NICL Graduate Apprentices Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload the relevant documents clearly in their NATS student profiles. The notification identifies the following records. Applicants must ensure their name, parents' names, Aadhaar number and educational details match their certificates and identity records. The company specifically requires candidates to enter the graduation percentage in the % of marks / CGPAx10 field in the NATS portal. Candidates with CGPA-based results must use their university's prescribed percentage conversion formula. Applications without the graduation percentage will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Document Verification 2026
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates must attend document verification in person at the NICL office assigned to them. The date and location will be communicated through their registered email address. Applicants must carry original certificates and self-attested photocopies supporting their age, educational qualification, identity and other eligibility claims. Travel and Accommodation: NICL will not pay TA/DA for document verification. Boarding and lodging expenses are also not admissible. Being called for document verification does not guarantee final engagement. The company will verify the details entered in NATS against the original records before approving the apprenticeship contract.

content_sections.heading: NICL Graduate Apprentice Reservation Rules 2026
content_sections.text: NICL will follow the applicable reservation guidelines under the Apprentices Act for SC, ST, OBC and PwBD candidates. OBC candidates claiming reservation must possess the prescribed Government of India Non-Creamy Layer certificate. The notification specifies that the certificate must be issued during the period from 1 April 2026 up to the date of engagement , if selected. OBC candidates belonging to the creamy layer are not entitled to OBC reservation benefits and should apply as General or General-PwBD, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: NICL Apprentice Contract and Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates must enter into a formal apprenticeship contract with NICL, approved through the NATS portal. Apprentices are trainees and will not be treated as regular employees of NICL. Employee benefits such as PF, ESI and bonus do not apply to this apprenticeship engagement as stated in the notification. The contract normally terminates automatically after 12 months. Misconduct, false information, failure to meet eligibility conditions or prolonged unauthorized absence may lead to earlier termination. If an apprentice remains absent without authorization for more than 15 consecutive business days, NICL may issue a three-day notice by email. If no satisfactory explanation is received, the company may terminate the apprenticeship contract under the notified conditions.

content_sections.heading: About ABV-IIITM Gwalior
content_sections.text: Atal Bihari Vajpayee-Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management Gwalior is an Institute of national importance established by an act of Parliament under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Its address is Morena Link Road, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India - 474015. Only candidates of Indian nationality may apply, and the notice also encourages candidates from overseas to apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: First class means at least a 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale or 60% marks at the Bachelor's and Master's level, from a recognized Technical Institute/University. CGPA/percentage relaxation is as per GOI norms. Candidates whose PhD thesis has been submitted may also apply. If selected, they must produce the certificate of award of the PhD before joining the PDF program. At least one degree from graduation onward, or work experience on a regular pay scale/guest faculty, should be from CFTIs (preferably IISc/IITs/IIITs/NITs/IIMs/ISI/IISERs) or a foreign university with QS rank 500 or better (QS rank 500 or below in number). At least 3 publications in SCI/SSCI/SCIE, of which at least one must be indexed in the Q1 journal list as per the latest JCR. Age: at most 35 years at the time of submission of the application form, and the application must be made within 5 years from the date of award of the PhD (defense date). A PhD holder from ABV-IIITM Gwalior can apply for IPDF after 1 year of completion of the PhD defense viva-voce approval date. The notice prints no separate qualification, age limit or pay for EFPDF; the guidelines of the sponsoring agency apply to a candidate admitted under the EFPDF category. The general requirement of a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline with first class in the preceding degrees applies to all candidates. CGPA/CPI to percentage conversion (or the reverse) by the individual Institute/University is allowed for determining eligibility. If the CGPA/CPI is on a scale other than 10 points, a certificate from the authorized signatory (not the Mentor/Supervisor/Head of the Department) of the Institute/University showing first class must be attached, or the CGPA/CPI may be converted to a 10-point scale. Qualifications, experience and age limit are determined on the closing date, that is the last date of submission of the application form. Experience on a part-time or daily-wage basis is not counted for shortlisting.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship table below is printed under the Fellowship and Leave rules of the IPDF notice. A contingency grant of Rs. 30,000/- per annum for consumables, attending conferences, meeting publication charges, etc. is made available on the mentor's recommendation. Any unused amount is carried forward to the next year. Institute accommodation is provided against a license fee and other due charges as per institute norms, subject to availability. As per GOI norms, HRA is provided if accommodation is unavailable. Leave rules follow the PhD rules and regulations of the Institute. The IPDF appointment is purely temporary and full-time for 2 years. The offer is initially made for one year and is extendable up to a maximum of two years based on performance evaluation.

rows.post_phd_experience: 1 year or more but less than 2 years

content_sections.heading: ABV-IIITM Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Academic responsibilities of at most 8 hours per week, including tutorial classes, laboratory work, conducting seminars and symposia. Carry out quality research work and assist the mentor(s) in writing externally funded project proposals. Eligible to co-guide B.Tech./M.Tech. students in BTP and MTP along with the mentor, with the approval of the DoAA on recommendations from the mentor, HOD and DoRC. Targets: at least 1 manuscript submitted in SCI/SSCI/SCIE indexed Q1 journals in the 1st year along with the mentor. In the 2nd year, 1 paper must be accepted in SCI/SSCI/SCIE indexed Q1 journals and another submitted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ABV-IIITM Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare the application form with full details of teaching, research and industrial experience, achievements, etc. Sign each page of the application form and appendices, and put your signature and photo on the form. Enclose self-attested photocopies of only the relevant documents issued by the competent authority. Email the completed application form to Dean of Faculty Affairs at [email protected] on or before 14 December 2026 (05:00 PM). Send a separate application for each department if applying for a position in more than one department. The notice also says self-attested photocopies of relevant documents should be produced for verification at the time of interview, and that fresh enclosures after the last date will not be entertained. OBC and EWS certificates, where applicable, must have been issued on or after 01 April 2026. An incomplete form is rejected. Anyone serving in Govt./Semi-Govt./PSU/other Govt. aided autonomous bodies should apply through proper channel or furnish a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the start of the selection process; an advance copy marked "Advance Copy" on the application form may be sent before the last date, but the candidature is not considered if the NOC is not produced at the start of the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A Screening Committee short-lists applicants on set criteria; these norms may not be uniform across departments and bind all applicants. Selection is based on a personal/technical interview before the Selection Committee, with a technical presentation. Meeting the minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called. The Institute reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit, based on qualifications, area of expertise, research outputs and experience higher than those prescribed. An interview invitation only indicates suitability and gives no assurance of selection. The date and time of the interview are informed only through the institute website or email. The Institute holds web interviews for overseas candidates. Originals of all documents and a valid photo ID (Passport/Voter-ID/PAN Card/Aadhar Card/any Government issued ID) with a photocopy must be produced at the technical presentation and interview; without ID proof the candidate is not allowed to attend. Appointment of selected candidates is subject to being found physically fit by a medical examination by the Institute's medical Board/Senior Medical Officer/Medical Officer.

content_sections.text: Family Court, Devbhumi Dwarka is preparing a panel of Counsellors for the Family Courts in Devbhumi Dwarka district, located at Khambhaliya, Okha-Mandal and Kalyanpur. The empanelment is made under the Gujarat Family Court (Amendment) Rules, 2023. The Family Court functions from the New District Court Building, Salaya Road, Khambhaliya.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: An applicant must possess the following qualifications as on the last date of application: Degree of a recognized University, preferably with Social Science or psychology as one of the subjects. Minimum experience of 02 (Two) years in Social Work, Child Psychiatry or Family Counselling. Impeccable integrity. The application form asks for educational qualifications from the Bachelor's degree onwards, with certificates attached, and for experience in the field of social and family welfare with certification as required under Rule 5(B) of the Gujarat Family Court (Amendment) Rules, 2023. Where other things are equal, preference in appointment shall be given to a woman candidate having the requisite qualification. Preference shall also be given to a candidate who has been a Judge or has experience of counselling in family matters. The length of the term is not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Devbhumi Dwarka Family Court Counsellors Job Description
content_sections.text: The Counsellor works in association with the Family Court to promote conciliation and secure speedy settlement of disputes relating to marriage and family affairs and connected matters. The Counsellor shall not act or plead for a party to a case or proceeding, but shall generally assist the Court in reaching a peaceful and amicable settlement of the dispute. A Counsellor entrusted with any petition shall: attend the Court as and when required by the Judge of the Family Court; aid and advise the parties regarding settlement of the subject-matter of dispute or any other part thereof; help the parties in reconciliation; submit a report or interim report, as required by the Court to which he or she is attached; perform such other functions as may be assigned by the Family Court to which he or she is attached, from time to time.

content_sections.text: The Senior Relationship Manager (Deputy Manager) position accounts for 791 of the 837 advertised vacancies. Candidates must be graduates with the prescribed certification and at least three years of relevant post-qualification experience. Candidates must have at least three years of post-qualification experience as a Relationship Manager in Wealth Management, Investment Advisory or Portfolio Management. The experience may be with eligible organizations such as: Public Sector Banks. Private Sector Banks. Foreign Banks. Broking Firms. Securities Firms. Asset Management Companies. Certified Financial Planner (CFP). Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or equivalent qualification. NISM XIII and NISM Series XXI-A certifications. Qualification Clarification: An MBA is preferred, not mandatory, for the Senior Relationship Manager position. However, graduation alone is insufficient because the prescribed professional certification and work experience are mandatory. Selected candidates will manage customer relationships, support wealth management business growth and provide appropriate investment solutions to clients. Acquire and manage affluent, High Net Worth Individual (HNI) and other wealth management customers. Build and maintain long-term client relationships. Increase Assets Under Management (AUM) and investment product business. Understand customer financial goals and investment requirements. Promote suitable mutual fund, insurance, portfolio management and other investment products. Conduct customer portfolio reviews and financial planning discussions. Support business development and customer retention. Maintain customer service, documentation and regulatory compliance standards.

content_sections.heading: About NaBFID
content_sections.text: The National Bank for Financing Infrastructure and Development (NaBFID) has been set up under an Act of Parliament, the NaBFID Act, 2021, as the principal entity for infrastructure financing in the country. It is regulated and supervised as an All-India Financial Institution (AIFI) by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI). According to the notice, NaBFID supports infrastructure funding by developing innovative financing instruments, bond and derivatives markets, and data-driven risk management.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: NaBFID accepts applications for this post only by email. The notice states that no other mode of application will be accepted and hard copies are not to be sent. Visit the link given against the job position for the detailed role description. Prepare your CV, including a passport sized photograph. Send the CV by email to [email protected] . Write the subject line strictly as "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF <Job Code>". The job code printed for this post is NABFID/EVP/16. Make sure the email is received on or before 24 November 2026 by 06:00 pm IST. Candidates should have a valid email ID and keep it active till the declaration of result, as call letters and interview advice will be sent by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Graduate /Postgraduate in any discipline from a recognized University / Institution or a Chartered Account. Preferred: Certification in Financial Risk Management from Global Association of Risk Professionals (GARP) OR Professional Risk Management Certification from PRIMA Institute. Minimum 20 years of experience in financial sector. Of these, 5 years should be in risk management function (in RBI regulated entity). Of these 5 years, 2 years should be at senior management level. Experience in the infrastructure domain will be preferred. The notice invites applications from Indian Citizens. Remuneration will be offered based on qualifications, experience, suitability, last drawn salary and market benchmark, and shall not be a limiting factor for suitable candidates. No fixed amount is printed in the notice. Contractual engagement will be for a period of 5 years, which may be renewed for additional terms at the discretion of the Bank. Location of position: Mumbai. Selected candidates may be posted in the Bank's establishment in Mumbai/New Delhi/Anywhere in India, as per the Bank's discretion and requirement. Engagement of the selected candidate is subject to being declared medically fit as per the requirement of the Bank. Candidates should check the detailed role description linked in the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: NaBFID Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Responsible for developing and implementing NaBFID's enterprise-wide risk framework. Ensuring that the Bank's portfolio is built within the defined risk parameters. Building appropriate mechanisms to measure risk. Providing advice and structuring risk mitigation into the business operations at NaBFID. A detailed role description is available as a separate document on the NaBFID website, linked from the notice.

content_sections.text: CV including a passport sized photograph (with the email application). Details of criminal case(s) pending, if any, at the time of interview. Proper relieving letters from the employer at the time of taking up the appointment, in case of selection.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened and shortlisted on the basis of eligibility and relevant experience, and the requisite number of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.
