content_sections.heading: About WCD Raigarh Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Government of India has started "Mission Shakti", an umbrella scheme for the safety, protection and empowerment of women under the integrated women empowerment programme. Under it, a State Hub for Empowerment of Women (SHEW) has been set up in the state and a District Hub for Empowerment of Women (DHEW) in every district. The two contract posts in Raigarh are for running this Hub for Empowerment of Women, and the eligibility table is given for the district-level hub (DHEW).

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, District Raigarh (C.G.), PIN 496001 Postal mode: only registered post, speed post or courier. Applications sent any other way are not accepted. Deadline: the application must reach the office by 30.11.2026, till 05:30 office time. Applications received after this date will not be considered. One post, one application: a separate application is required for each post. On the envelope and in the form: write the name of the post applied for; otherwise the application may be rejected. Also on the envelope and in the form: the sender's name and full correspondence address, including email address and mobile number. Enclose a blank self-addressed envelope with a Rs. 10 stamp. Paste a self-attested photograph on the form; certificates and mark sheets must be attested by a gazetted officer or self-attested. The office email printed on the letterhead is [email protected] ; the notice does not ask for applications by email.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: For both posts the notice requires good knowledge of computer and MS Office and the ability to work in computer typing, and a minimum of 03 years' work experience. There will be no relaxation in the essential educational qualification; the minimum experience may be relaxed only in special cases, with the Collector's permission, when suitable applicants are not found. Educational qualification: Graduate degree in Social Work / other social fields. Essential skill: good knowledge of computer and MS Office and ability to work in computer typing. Experience: at least 03 years of gender-related work in government / semi-government institutions, and at least 03 years' experience of women's issues. Desirable: postgraduate degree holders will be preferred; experience of working on computer in English language. Age: not less than 21 years and not more than 45 years as on 01.01.2026. Local residents of Chhattisgarh get age relaxation as per State Government instructions, but the maximum age including all relaxations will not exceed 50 years. Residence: being a resident of Chhattisgarh is not mandatory, but Chhattisgarh residents get preference through 02 bonus marks in the merit. Category: 01 post, Unreserved (UR). Educational qualification: Graduate degree in Computer / IT field. Essential skill: good knowledge of computer and MS Office and ability to work in computer typing. Experience: at least 03 years of work in data management / process documentation, web-based and web-based reporting formats in government / semi-government institutions. Desirable: experience of working on computer in English / Hindi language. Age: not less than 21 years and not more than 35 years as on 01.01.2026. Age relaxation as per State Government instructions applies, but the maximum age including all relaxations will not exceed 45 years. Residence: the candidate must be a native (mool niwasi) of Chhattisgarh; only a residence certificate issued by the competent authority is accepted. Category: 01 post, Scheduled Tribe (ST). Reserved category candidates must attach a permanent caste certificate issued by the competent authority. Only experience certificates issued by government / semi-government institutions are accepted. A full-time experience certificate issued by the employer and certified / verified by a gazetted officer must be attached, along with the appointment letter. No voluntary service certificate of any kind is accepted as experience. The appointing authority's (District Collector's) decision on accepting the experience is final. Age is verified from the birth certificate or the class 8th / 10th mark sheet showing the date of birth; the original and a self-attested copy must be brought at document verification. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The application form lists these mandatory enclosures: The form also asks for the caste certificate and the Chhattisgarh residence certificate issued by the competent authority, the employment exchange live registration number and date, and the employment exchange name, with self-attested photocopies of all other certificates relating to eligibility. Employees of government / semi-government institutions must apply with their employer's No Objection Certificate; otherwise the application will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: A merit list is prepared on a marking system, and selection is made through walk-in interview / written and skill test (if necessary). The marks are distributed as follows: If many applications are received, 10 candidates per post will be called for the skill test, according to the merit list based on the marks for essential qualification, experience and Chhattisgarh domicile. If candidates have equal marks in the merit list, the older candidate gets preference. No travel allowance or other allowance is paid for attending the skill / written test / walk-in interview.

rows.component: Percentage in the required minimum educational qualification (weightage of 100 marks)

Bonus for native residents of Chhattisgarh

content_sections.heading: Terms of Appointment
content_sections.text: Selection is initially on contract / consolidated pay for a maximum of 02 years. After that, the District Collector may extend the contract by 1 year each time, based on work ability, performance, conduct, the department's need and the controlling officer's recommendation; otherwise the appointment ends automatically. The appointment is fully temporary and may be ended without giving a reason; during the contract either side can end it with one month's notice or one month's pay instead. The posts last only as long as the Government of India runs the scheme; the department has no responsibility for the staff after the posts end. Staff are governed by the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Conduct) Rules, 1965. Leave is as admissible to contract staff under the Chhattisgarh Civil Services (Contract Appointment) Rules, 2012, as amended. Travel allowance as for an equivalent post is payable, after approval, when sent on tour or training. Selected candidates must submit a fitness certificate from the District Medical Board, Raigarh within 1 month; anyone found unfit for government service will have their services terminated.

faq.answer: There are 2 contract posts: 1 Gender Specialist (UR) and 1 IT Assistant (ST).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for WCD Raigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application must reach the District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, Raigarh by 30 November 2026, till 05:30 office time; late applications will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Gender Specialist and IT Assistant posts?
faq.answer: Gender Specialist needs a graduate degree in Social Work / other social fields, and IT Assistant a graduate degree in Computer / IT field, each with at least 3 years' experience and good computer, MS Office and typing skills.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: As on 01.01.2026, Gender Specialist: 21 to 45 years (up to 50 with all relaxations for Chhattisgarh residents); IT Assistant: 21 to 35 years (up to 45 with all relaxations).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated / contract monthly pay is Rs. 25780 for Gender Specialist (Pay Matrix Level 8) and Rs. 20900 for IT Assistant (Pay Matrix Level 7).

faq.answer: Fill the prescribed form and send it only by registered post, speed post or courier to District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, District Raigarh (C.G.), PIN 496001, with the post name written on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: A merit list on 80 marks (60 for qualification, up to 18 for extra experience, 2 bonus for Chhattisgarh natives) is followed by a 20-mark skill / written test, with selection through walk-in interview / written and skill test if necessary.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from outside Chhattisgarh apply?
faq.answer: Yes for Gender Specialist, where Chhattisgarh residence is not mandatory but residents get 2 bonus marks; no for IT Assistant, which requires the candidate to be a native of Chhattisgarh.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are contractual and fully temporary, initially for a maximum of 2 years, extendable by 1 year at a time by the District Collector, and limited to the duration of the scheme.

content_sections.heading: About Lakshadweep Directorate of Education
content_sections.text: The Directorate of Education of the Lakshadweep Administration is based at Kavaratti. This panel serves three groups of institutions under the Department of Education: the Government College of Arts & Science, the Government College of Education and the Government Polytechnic College.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates are invited to the interview, which is held in person or online as the Department decides. A merit/rank list is then published, and selected candidates must submit their willingness to accept the post immediately after its publication. One point is awarded for every 12 months of relevant experience, up to a maximum of five points. Experience certificates without valid and verifiable details of the issuing authority are rejected. The venue for the physical interview is the Directorate of Education, Kavaratti, Union Territory of Lakshadweep. Online candidates get the interview link at the e-mail ID given in their application, and must stay in the session until the Interview Board permits them to leave. The Department is not responsible for a delayed link or for poor connectivity or technical issues at the candidate's end. Candidates attend in the mode opted for in the application and approved by the Department. Failing to attend at the scheduled time and in the prescribed mode means no further opportunity.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual and subject to the requirements of the Department. The nature, duration and place of engagement are decided at the discretion of the Department. Duties include teaching, academic administration, hostel-related responsibilities and any other duties assigned by the Department of Education. Faculty teach core subjects as well as supplementary and interdisciplinary subjects included under the National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. Services may be deployed at any Higher Educational Institution in the Union Territory of Lakshadweep. Remuneration and other terms stipulated in the contract agreement apply. The engagement order is cancelled if a selected candidate fails to report for duty within the time stipulated by the Department. The Department may cancel the notification or modify any of its provisions, in accordance with the applicable rules.

faq.question: Q1. Can I apply without UGC NET if I have a Ph.D?
faq.answer: Yes, a Ph.D holder may be exempted from UGC-NET if the degree was obtained before the UGC cut-off date and all other mandatory UGC conditions are met. You must also submit a certificate from the University or regulatory authority confirming the degree follows UGC norms.

faq.question: Q2. What happens if I do not have the prescribed UGC qualifications?
faq.answer: Your application may be considered for a separate panel if a sufficient number of eligible and qualified candidates are not available. Pay for candidates on that panel is 10% lower than the prescribed remuneration.

faq.question: Q3. Can I change my interview mode after applying?
faq.answer: No. The option given in the application form is final, although the Department decides whether the interview is held online or in person.

faq.question: Q4. How early should I reach the physical interview?
faq.answer: Report to the Directorate of Education, Kavaratti, at least two hours before the scheduled interview time, with all relevant documents.

faq.question: Q5. Will I get travelling allowance for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is paid to candidates for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Are distance mode degrees accepted?
faq.answer: They are considered if you submit a certificate or supporting document from the UGC or the concerned University showing that the qualification is recognized and valid under UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q7. Can I send more documents after submitting the application?
faq.answer: No. The information in the online application is final, and no additional information or documents are accepted through supplementary applications, requests or representations.

faq.question: Q8. How much does a Ph.D add to the score for Assistant Professor and Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: A Ph.D carries 5% within the 10% weightage for Desirable Qualification. The other 5% is for experience.

faq.question: Q9. Whom can I contact about the interview process?
faq.answer: For an emergency or urgent clarification, contact the Higher Education Cell on 9497286658 or at [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About VOC Port Authority
content_sections.text: V.O.Chidambaranar Port Authority is a Major Port Authority under the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, Government of India, with its Administrative Office at Harbour Estate, Tuticorin, Tamilnadu. The Senior Deputy Secretary post belongs to the General Administration Department (main administration) of the Port, as shown in the Recruitment Rules enclosed with the circular. The circular is signed by S.P. Mohan Kumar, Secretary, and is addressed to the Chairperson of all Major Port Authorities.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be sent through proper channel. The applicant's own Port forwards it. Applications sent directly by candidates are not described in the circular. Form: the prescribed Proforma at Annexure-II, "Application for the post of Senior Deputy Secretary in V.O.Chidambaranar Port Authority by absorption through composite method". Envelope superscription: "Application for the post of Senior Deputy Secretary in V.O.Chidambaranar Port Authority". Address: The Secretary, V.O.Chidambaranar Port Authority, Administrative Office, Harbour Estate, Tuticorin – 628 004, Tamilnadu. Deadline: the application must reach on or before 02/12/2026. Applications received after the due date will not be considered. Contact details on the letterhead: Fax 91-461-2352232, Email [email protected] , Website www.vocport.gov.in. The email address is printed for contact only. The circular asks for the application by post through proper channel. The Annexure-II Proforma asks for the following details: Name, Father's/Husband's Name, and Date of Birth and present age. Whether the applicant belongs to SC/ST/OBC/UR. Address for communication, with telephone or mobile number. Academic and professional qualifications: exam or degree, year of passing, institution, and marks or percentage. Employment history: organisation, designation, pay scale, whether the post is held on a regular or ad-hoc basis, the period with dates, and the nature of work. Any appreciation or outstanding work recognised by higher authority. A list of enclosures and a signed declaration that the candidature will not be withdrawn if selected. A passport size photograph affixed to the form.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post of Senior Deputy Secretary. It is a Class I post filled by selection by merit. The pay scale is Rs. 80000-220000 (pre-revised Rs.32900-58000) (pre-pre-revised 16000-400-20800). The Recruitment Rules state that the qualifications prescribed for direct recruits also apply to absorption. These are: Essential (I): A degree from a recognized University. Essential (II): Twelve years experience in Executive cadre in the field of General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations, etc., in an Industrial/ Commercial/Government Undertakings. Desirable: Post graduate degree/diploma in Personnel Management/ Industrial Relations / Social Work/Labour Welfare or allied subjects or degree in Law from a recognized University/Institution. Under the Recruitment Rules, two groups of officers are eligible. The first group covers officers holding the post of Senior Deputy Secretary or Deputy Secretary. It also covers officers in the respective discipline of General Administration Department, such as Chief Public Relation Officer, Deputy Estate Manager, Deputy Chief Law Officer or Personnel Officer. These officers must be in the scale of Rs. 60000-180000 and have 3 years regular service in the grade in a Major Port Authority. The second group (the "OR" option) covers Deputy Secretary and Senior Deputy Secretary in the respective discipline of General Administration Department. These officers need 2 years regular service in the grade. They also need a combined regular service of 7 years in the scales of Rs. 50000-160000 (pre revised Rs.20600-46500) and Rs. 60000-180000 (pre-revised Rs.24900-50500) in the respective discipline of General Administration Department in a Major Port Authority. The Recruitment Rules give an upper age limit of 42 years for direct recruitment. The same Rules say the age limit prescribed for direct recruits does not apply to absorption ("Age: No"). The circular fixes 02/12/2026 as the crucial date for determining eligibility with regard to qualification, experience, age, etc. The period of probation is shown as "Not applicable" in the Recruitment Rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The following documents must go in the envelope with the Annexure-II Proforma: Copies of APARs for the last 5 years (2020-2021 to 2024-2025), attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Dy. HoD. If the APAR for a particular year is not available, the last available APAR may be furnished with a non-availability certificate. A statement showing the year-wise availability of APARs and grading, duly signed by the HoD or Secretary. Attested photocopies of all certificates and proof of educational qualification, and of present and past work experience in the respective post, pay-scale wise. These must be duly verified by the Port while forwarding the application. A No objection certificate from the respective Port. Vigilance and Administrative Clearance of the concerned Port. A certificate from the Head of the Office in the Annexure III proforma. This certificate confirms that the particulars and eligibility are correct and that the qualification and caste certificates have been verified. It also confirms that no disciplinary or vigilance case is pending or contemplated, that the officer's integrity is certified and that no Major/Minor penalty has been imposed in the last 10 years. APAR copies for 2020-21 to 2024-2025 are enclosed with this certificate. A vigilance report in the format prescribed by Ministry of Shipping's letter No.C-31018/5/2020-Vigilance dated 15/02/2022 (Annexure IV), furnished and signed by the CVO or HOD. It covers the positions held in the ten preceding years and whether the officer is on the "Agreed List" or the "List of officers of Doubtful Integrity". It also covers any misconduct allegations, punishments and pending proceedings, actions contemplated, and the annual immovable property return under Rule 18 of the CCS (Conduct) Rules, 1964. An undertaking by the applicant that the candidature will not be withdrawn, if selected. Certification that the veracity of the qualification certificates and the recognition of the degree have been ensured. Two passport size photographs.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is by merit. Overall grading in the APARs must not be below "Very Good". The Recruitment Rules name the following Departmental Promotion Committee: Chairperson – Chairman Deputy Chairperson – Member Head of Department in charge of the Department in which the vacancy occurs – Member Head of the Department in charge of the Personnel – Member Representative of Scheduled Caste/Scheduled Tribes & Other Backward Class nominated by the Chairperson – Member Ministry's letter No. A-29018/4/2018-PE-I dated 30.05.2022 and 01.06.2022 covers all Dy. HoD level posts. Under that letter, the Appointing Authority and the Disciplinary Authority is the Central Government, i.e. Secretary (PSW). The recommendations of the Service Selection Committee are therefore conveyed to the Ministry for approval before the appointment order is issued.

rows.details: Institute of Rural Management Anand (IRMA), “Tribhuvan” Sahkari University

content_sections.heading: About IRMA
content_sections.text: The Institute of Rural Management Anand (IRMA) describes itself as a premier national institute for postgraduate, doctoral-level and mid-career/in-service education, research and consulting in rural management. Founded in 1979, it aims to promote sustainable rural development through professional management. It now functions under “Tribhuvan” Sahkari University, an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India. The Field Investigator / Field Enumerator will work on IRMA's project on sustainable dairy farming and value chain development through Primary Dairy Cooperatives, which studies livelihood diversification strategies for small and marginal dairy farmers in rural Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan. This recruitment is for field work in Bihar and Madhya Pradesh.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following selection criteria for the Field Investigator / Field Enumerator post: Education (preferred): A candidate with a post-graduate degree in Social Sciences, Rural Management, Agriculture, Dairy Management, Development Studies or allied disciplines will be preferred. Experience (preferred): Relevant field experience, particularly in household surveys, rural fieldwork or working with dairy farmers/cooperatives, will be preferred. Language: The candidate should be fluent in Hindi and English. Skills (desirable): Good communication, coordination and fieldwork skills are desirable. Travel: Candidates should be willing to travel extensively within the assigned districts of Bihar and Madhya Pradesh. The educational qualification and experience are written as preferences, not as compulsory conditions. The notice also says that the Institute reserves the right to relax the prescribed selection criteria in case a suitable candidate is found. The candidate's age should preferably be below 40 years. The notice prints no cut-off date for counting age and lists no category-wise age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Field Investigator / Field Enumerator will receive a consolidated remuneration of ₹20,000/- per month (inclusive of all). No separate payment towards any additional allowance shall be admissible unless specifically approved under the project norms. The contract is purely on a temporary basis for two (2) months. No claims can be made about permanent employment, as the post will not turn into a permanent role under any circumstances. The notice states that the contract may be extended based on performance, availability of project funds and requirements, and also states that the contract will automatically conclude upon completion of the two-month period and will not be extended further.

content_sections.heading: IRMA Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The key duties and responsibilities printed in the notice are: Conduct midline surveys of dairy farming households using structured survey tools. Undertake primary data collection through household surveys, interviews and Focus Group Discussions (FGDs), as required. Coordinate and assist in training and capacity-building programmes conducted under the project. Coordinate with dairy farmers, Primary Dairy Cooperative Societies (PDCS) and other relevant local stakeholders for field activities. Assist in field-level activities and ensure timely and accurate collection of project data. Assist in data verification, documentation and preparation of field reports. Support the research team in other project-related field activities as assigned.

The notice does not give an interview date or mode.

content_sections.heading: About DUK
content_sections.text: Kerala University of Digital Sciences, Innovation and Technology is the university issuing this notification, and it refers to itself as DUK in the job descriptions. KSAAC is its project for cybersecurity auditing, with services covering audit, consultancy, training and compliance.

content_sections.heading: Job Duties
content_sections.text: Lead and manage KSAAC's cybersecurity auditing engagements, and plan and supervise audits including web and mobile application, IT infrastructure, VAPT and Secure Code Review work. Define audit scope, objectives, methodology, timelines, resources and deliverables, then allocate work and guide the audit team. Review and validate findings, evidence and risk ratings, and oversee draft and final audit reports, executive summaries and risk registers. Maintain liaison with CERT-In, track its notifications and regulatory developments, and recommend updates to audit practices. Develop audit methodologies, procedures, checklists, templates and quality assurance processes. Mentor security auditors and analysts, coordinate with client organisations and support proposals, Statements of Work and project estimates. Identify delivery risks, resolve technical issues and escalate matters needing management intervention. Design secure architectures and solutions for applications, networks, IT infrastructure, cloud environments and enterprise systems. Analyse client requirements and develop technical approaches and implementation roadmaps. Support delivery of services such as VAPT, security audits, secure code review, digital forensics, governance, risk assessment and compliance. Prepare technical proposals, techno-commercial bids, project estimates, service descriptions and consultancy reports. Support business development for KSAAC and DUK, and build relationships with Government departments, PSUs, universities and industries. Take part in client meetings, presentations, negotiations and proposal follow-ups. Track emerging technologies and market requirements, and help develop service catalogues, pricing models and delivery frameworks. Assist senior forensic professionals in investigations involving computers, storage media, mobile devices, logs and other digital sources. Help identify, preserve, acquire and examine digital evidence, and maintain chain-of-custody records. Perform forensic disk imaging, hash verification, file-system analysis, metadata examination and deleted-file recovery under supervision. Assist in analysing system artefacts, browser history, application artefacts and event logs. Assist in preparing examination notes, evidence inventories and draft forensic reports. Support incident response, cybercrime investigations and malware-related examinations where required. Help maintain forensic laboratory equipment, software, evidence storage systems and case documentation, and take part in internal training. Each post also carries any other related duties assigned by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a test and/or interview, held in Thiruvananthapuram district only. The schedule reaches candidates through their registered email only. Any selection or appointment is provisional and subject to physical verification of documents.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Each appointment is on contract basis for one year. The term may be extended further based on the performance and project requirements. The job location for all posts is Thiruvananthapuram. If suppression of material facts or incorrect information is detected even after appointment, the service is liable to be terminated.

content_sections.heading: About Maharashtra State Commission for Right to Public Services
content_sections.text: The Commission was established by the Government of Maharashtra under the Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015, and has its headquarters in Greater Mumbai. It comprises the State Chief Commissioner and six State Commissioners for Right to Public Services. One State Commissioner is provided for each Revenue Division, excluding the areas of Mumbai City and Mumbai Suburban Districts.

content_sections.heading: Maharashtra Right to Public Services Commissioner Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The applicant must be at least 45 years of age and must not exceed 62 years of age, counted as on the last date of submission of the application. The applicant must be a graduate in any discipline. The applicant must be an eminent person in public life with wide knowledge and experience in administration in the Government or a public authority, as stipulated under Section 13(5) of the Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015. A minimum of 20 years of experience in the functioning of the Government or a public authority is required. Knowledge of relevant laws Understanding of quasi-judicial procedures Transparency Administrative leadership and decision-making ability An affidavit must accompany the application. It must state that no criminal offence has been registered against the applicant and that no criminal case is pending. Persons in Government or semi-Government service must also state that no disciplinary proceedings are pending or proposed against them. See the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of each post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 1,000/- (Rupees One Thousand only), and it can be paid in either of these ways: In cash or through a Demand Draft at the Cash Branch of the General Administration Department, Mantralaya, Mumbai, in favour of the Section Officer, Cash Branch, General Administration Department, Mantralaya, Mumbai. Deposited in the Treasury under Head of Account "0070 - Other Administrative Services, 60 - Other Services, 119 - Fines and Penalties under Right to Public Services, (01) Maharashtra Right to Public Services Act, 2015 - Fines and Fees (0070086901)." The original fee receipt or the Demand Draft must be attached to the application.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications received up to the last date are scrutinised by the Secretary-level Scrutiny Committee constituted under Government Circular No. RTS-1120/CR-55/18 (RWK), dated 23 October 2020. The shortlist prepared by this committee is submitted to the Committee constituted under Section 13(3) of the Act, chaired by the Hon'ble Chief Minister, for the final selection process.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: A State Commissioner holds office for five years from the date of assuming office, or until attaining the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier (Section 14(1) of the Act). A State Commissioner is not eligible for reappointment. Where a Commissioner receives pension or retirement benefits, these are adjusted in accordance with the applicable provisions (Section 14(4) of the Act).

The approximate gross figure includes Basic pay, VDA (55.7%), Perks (34%) and HRA (30% for class A cities and applicable rates for other cities). HRA will be as per the rules of the company. Initial pay will be fixed at the lowest of the pay in the grade, and no protection of pay is admissible to candidates joining from other PSUs, Central Government or State Government. Ensuring compliance with regulations laid down by PESO, and managing and coordinating the transportation of Ammonium Nitrate (Melt.) Monitoring statutory and regulatory compliance as per PESO guidelines Ensuring accuracy and completeness of all compliance-related documentation Liaison with regulatory authorities for smooth operations Ensuring adherence to prescribed safety standards and transportation norms

content_sections.heading: RCF Assistant Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 46 years for the Unreserved category as on 01 August 2026. This cut-off date also applies to the minimum educational qualification and will remain unchanged. Three years Regular and Fulltime Graduate in any discipline from a university recognized by UGC/AICTE. Candidates should have secured minimum 55% in Final Year / aggregate of Last Two Semesters of the graduation degree. Where a CGPA/OGPA grade is awarded, the candidate must obtain the equivalent percentage from the University/Institute and mention it in the application. If no conversion norms exist, the grade will be presumed to be on a 10 points scale. Conversion norms, or proof that there are none, must be produced at the Skill Test. Candidates must have minimum 15 years' relevant post-qualification experience as on 01 August 2026. Training, internship and apprenticeship periods are not counted. Preference will be given to candidates having experience in explosive industry and Ammonium Nitrate compliance. Children/family members of the victims of 1984 riots get an additional concession of 5 years. Reservation and relaxation for SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwBD candidates are as per DPE guidelines. Reserved category candidates applying for a post with no vacancy in their category will be treated as General candidates, and no relaxation in any criteria will apply. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: For E0 Grade, the selection process comprises a Skill Test, which will be conducted on a suitable earliest date. All eligible candidates will be provisionally called, and documents will be verified before the test. Call letters are intimated by SMS and/or email. A candidate has to secure minimum 60 marks out of 100 to qualify. The test is of qualifying nature (Suitable or Unsuitable for the post). Qualifying alone does not mean selection, because the number of candidates empanelled is limited to the number of vacancies and the waitlist. If candidates secure equal marks, merit is decided in this order: Percentage of marks in the qualifying examination Highest percentage in the SSC examination Date of birth, with the candidate born earlier considered senior A waitlist shall be prepared in the ratio of 1:2, meaning 2 candidates for each selected post. It will be valid for one year. Selection is subject to being declared Medically Fit by the RCF Ltd designated Physician. The examination comprises physical examination, audiometry, electrocardiogram, vision and eye tests, blood and urine pathology, chest X-ray P.A. view, lung function test, height and weight, body mass index and any further examination the RCF Medical Officer recommends. Original documents may be required at this stage for final verification. Outstation candidates will be reimbursed to and fro III tier AC Train or Bus fare (restricted to III tier AC Rail fare) from the nearest railway station of their correspondence address, by the shortest route, on production of receipts. The amount is transferred to a bank account. Candidates declared ineligible or without complete original documents will not be allowed to attend and will not get TA.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Posting may be at the Trombay or Thal units, Area Offices or All India Marketing Offices of the company throughout India, or at any project site decided by the Management. The job requires working in rotating shifts including night shift, and a high level of physical fitness. Candidates may be posted in any plant or location subject to exigencies of work. Candidates possessing a higher qualification will get no consequential benefits for it later in service. No NOC will be provided to a candidate pursuing a higher qualification at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RCF Assistant Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Log on to the RCF website and go to the HR-Recruitment section. Fill in your age, date of birth, qualification, division and percentage of marks, year of passing, School/College/University and work experience. Use your full name as it appears on the matriculation school certificate. Upload your photograph, signature and scanned supporting documents. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Check the details, correct any errors and press the "Submit Form" button. No changes are possible after this. Note the Unique Application Number and print the application form. Keep a photocopy for future reference. Keep valid bank details ready as well: Account Number, IFSC code, MICR code and PAN number, which are needed for reimbursement of Travelling Allowance. There is no later chance to upload, change or correct documents, and applications without the required documents will be rejected. Call letter, with the original and a photocopy of a valid photo identity bearing exactly the same name. Ration Card and Learner's Driving License are not valid. Acknowledgement or receipt of online payment Printout of the online application forwarded through Proper Channel, or a No Objection Certificate, for candidates employed in government bodies or Public Sector Undertakings Caste certificate and Caste Validity certificate, wherever applicable Canvassing in any form is a disqualification for employment. Using unfair means or carrying a mobile phone into the skill test hall can lead to disqualification, debarment from future RCF recruitment or termination of service.

faq.answer: Yes, a three-year regular and fulltime graduate in any discipline can apply, provided the marks are at least 55% and the 15-year experience requirement is met.

faq.answer: No. Training, internship and apprenticeship periods are not counted in the experience required as on 01 August 2026.

how_to_apply: Get Annexure-I (Parts I, II and III) from the circular, the IFS website or the MoEFCC IFS page.

Fill in Part I and sign it. It asks for the level sought, three stations in order of preference, batch, cadre, date of birth, present pay scale and post, educational qualifications, postings of the last 10 years, all deputation postings, wildlife experience and date of return to cadre.

Get Part II completed by the State or UT Government. It covers vigilance status, pending disciplinary proceedings, any reprimand, penalty or debarment, attested ACRs of the last eight years, and the Central and State Deputation Reserve figures.
Get the vigilance particulars and vigilance profile furnished by the CVO or HOD.
Check the application against the Annexure-III checklist, then email the complete set to [email protected] by 1 December 2026.
Application in the Annexure-I format, signed by the officer

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Nominations are used to prepare the Offer List for vacancy year 2027. Selection will be based on actual vacancy positions available as per the administrative and technical requirement. Actual appointments will be subject to the availability and suitability of officers for the post at a particular station.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Appointment is on tenure deputation basis to posts in various Ministries and organisations of the Government of India. Officers may give three station preferences, but a posting at a preferred station is not assured. If selected, the State or UT certifies in Part II of the form that the officer's services shall be placed at the disposal of the Central Government.

faq.question: Q1. Can a fresh candidate apply for these MoEFCC posts?
faq.answer: No. Nominations are invited from eligible and willing Indian Forest Service officers, with State Forest Service officers considered only in the exceptional cases the circular describes.

faq.question: Q2. Which station has the most vacancies?
faq.answer: New Delhi has the most, with 11 at AIGF level, 8 at DIGF level, 2 at ADGF level and 1 at IGF level. Dehradun follows with 10 DIGF and 9 AIGF vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. How many stations can an officer choose?
faq.answer: Three, listed in order of priority in column 3 of Annexure-I.

faq.question: Q4. What happens if a selected officer does not join?
faq.answer: An officer who fails to take up the central deputation assignment after the appointment is approved attracts debarment of five years from central deputation.

faq.question: Q5. Does the applicant need State Government consent?
faq.answer: Yes. An application without the consent of the concerned State or UT Government will not be entertained, and an officer already on deputation must also send the concurrence of the concerned Administrative Ministry.

faq.question: Q6. Who must complete the cooling off period?
faq.answer: Any officer who has previously been on deputation. Such an officer is considered again only after completing the mandatory cooling off period.

faq.question: Q7. Which NTCA stations have extra requirements?
faq.answer: Delhi, Nagpur, Bangalore and Guwahati. Annexure-IV sets the additional criteria for AIGF, DIGF and IGF posts at the NTCA.

faq.question: Q8. How much wildlife experience does an IGF (NTCA) post need?
faq.answer: At least 8 years in wildlife conservation, including five years in tiger reserves, the National Tiger Conservation Authority or the Project Tiger Division of the Ministry.

faq.question: Q9. How many years of ACRs does Part II ask about?
faq.answer: Part II asks the State or UT whether original or attested copies of the officer's ACRs for the last eight years are enclosed.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Research Scientist and Project Technical Support Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age is counted as on the last date of application, which is 15 November 2026. Essential: Postgraduate degree in Public Health / Biostatistics & Demography / Population Studies / Geography or a relevant discipline from a recognized university, with five years of research experience in a relevant field. Desirable publications: Five original research publications in MEDLINE/PubMed-indexed journals in the relevant area. The journals should be listed in the Science Citation Index (SCI). Desirable experience: Prior experience in community-based studies. Research skills: Advanced data analysis, scientific report writing, manuscript preparation and publication, team management, and field-level data collection, monitoring and supervision. Candidates should be able to coordinate and carry out research activities independently. Leadership skills: Ability to work in a diverse interdisciplinary environment and to guide other team members. Essential: Three-year graduate degree in Public Health / Medical Social Workers (MSWs) / Sociology / Computer Application / Biostatistics or other relevant disciplines from a recognized university. Experience: Three years of post-qualification experience, or a PG in the relevant subject or field. Mandatory: Willingness and ability to travel extensively for field tasks on a regular basis. Desirable: Experience in field data collection related to Health/Population. Experience is counted from the date of completing the minimum essential educational qualification. Candidates already working against regular or permanent posts in Government departments or organisations are not eligible. Candidates employed in Government settings must submit a No Objection Certificate at the interview. Without it, they may not be allowed to appear. Age relaxation is given as per ICMR/Government of India guidelines. SC/ST/OBC relaxation applies only to posts reserved for that category, not to unreserved posts. Relaxation for Ex-servicemen and departmental candidates, including project staff, follows Government of India/ICMR norms. Check the official notification for the full post-wise eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Document verification: Only candidates found eligible here may take the interview. Written examination: This may be held before the interview if many eligible candidates turn up. Walk-in interview: Held on 16 November 2026 at 9:00 AM at the Department of Community & Family Medicine, Academic Block (MNC building), AIIMS, Gorakhpur. If there are many eligible candidates, the appointing authority may use higher criteria to shortlist candidates for the interview, written test or personal discussion. Meeting the essential qualification does not guarantee shortlisting. The decision of the Screening Committee, Interview Committee or competent authority is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Both positions are purely temporary and contractual and end with the project. They give no right to a regular post, absorption or transfer at AIIMS Gorakhpur, ICMR or any Government body. The first engagement runs up to 31 March 2027. It may be extended until the project ends, depending on funds, performance and approval. The engagement may be ended at any time, without notice, if performance is not satisfactory. Staff will normally work at the study or project site but may be deputed to other sites. Provident Fund, LTC, medical claims and other regular service benefits are not provided. Leave follows ICMR or project rules. Selected candidates must join within 15 days of the result or offer letter. They must also sign the declaration, code of conduct and confidentiality undertaking. The engagement follows the ICMR Extramural Research Grant guidelines.

content_sections.heading: About THSTI
content_sections.text: BRIC-Translational Health Science and Technology Institute is an institute of the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council, Department of Biotechnology, Ministry of Science & Technology, Govt. of India. It is part of the NCR Biotech Science Cluster in Faridabad, and its mission is to conduct translational research that turns concepts into products to improve human health. These posts are at THSTI's Clinical Development Services Agency (CDSA). CDSA supports not-for-profit preclinical and clinical product development and clinical research carried out by public agencies.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Data Manager and Project Research Scientist-I Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Both posts are under the project "Sepsis related mortality in neonates in India: A multi-disciplinary, multi-institutional research program for context specific solutions". The notice says the number of vacancies may change, depending on actual requirements at the time of the written test, skill test or interview.

content_sections.heading: THSTI Data Manager and Project Research Scientist-I Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for both posts is up to 35 years. The notice states that age, essential qualification and experience are judged as on the closing date of application, which it calls the crucial date. Essential qualification and experience (either one): Master's degree in any field, preferably in science, with 6 years of experience in clinical data management/clinical research/operations/MIS/data analysis/IT/computer science/healthcare field Graduation degree in any field, preferably in science, with 8 years of experience in clinical data management/clinical research/operations/MIS/data analysis/IT/computer science/healthcare field Desirable: Diploma in Clinical research and clinical data management; familiarity with industry-standard CDMS and some programming skills; preparation of Clinical Study Data Management documents. Skills listed: management and leadership skills; IT literacy (Microsoft applications, data visualization and other CDMS applications); experience in handling databases and query management, which the notice lists as a must; an understanding of clinical trials and clinical data management functions, also listed as a must; good communication, negotiation and organisational skills; time management; and the ability to work independently. Essential qualification: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees. Desirable: Postgraduate degree in Clinical Research, Clinical Trials, Epidemiology, Public Health or a related discipline from a recognised university Additional qualification or prior training in Medical Laboratory Technology or a related laboratory discipline Experience in clinical research, preferably involving the collection, processing, storage and transport of biological samples, and the related documentation Experience in preparing SOPs and study workplans, and in coordinating study activities Good Clinical Practice (GCP) certification Skills listed: computer skills in Excel, Word, PowerPoint and Access; documentation, communication and organisational skills; managing several tasks at once; and working both independently and in a team. All qualifications must be from a recognised Board/University. Experience counts only if it was gained after obtaining the minimum educational qualification for the post. THSTI will not answer queries about eligibility. Candidates must check for themselves that they meet the criteria. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

content_sections.text: The Delhi State Legal Services Authority was set up under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, an Act of Parliament, and works under the administrative control of the High Court of Delhi. content_sections.text: Analytical study and research for future planning, so that the schemes of NALSA and DSLSA are implemented better. Support and assistance to victims in matters under the Delhi Victim Compensation Scheme in the District Legal Services Authorities. Legal assistance to victims of human trafficking, and looking after their welfare and rehabilitation together with NGOs working in the field. content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Nature of engagement: a full-time job, but purely contractual and temporary. You cannot take up any other profession, service or engagement while you work for DSLSA. Period: the first engagement is for three months. It may be extended from time to time, up to a maximum of one year. Extensions depend on your work assessment, performance and conduct, and on what the Authority needs. No claim to a regular post: the engagement gives no right to a regular appointment or to continue in service at DSLSA. The Authority may end the engagement at any time without giving reasons. Leave: 12 days a year, with no more than 3 days in a calendar month. Leave above these limits is deducted pro rata from your pay. Leave you do not use cannot be carried forward to an extended period or encashed. Notice period: you must give one month's notice before leaving. Otherwise, one month's pay is deducted or recovered. Working hours: you may have to work beyond office hours, and no overtime is paid.

faq.question: What is the salary of a DSLSA Law Clerk-cum-Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The pay is a fixed consolidated Rs. 50,000 per month. Leave taken above 12 days a year or 3 days a month is deducted pro rata from this amount.

faq.question: What presentation do I need to attach?
faq.answer: You need a PowerPoint presentation of at least 15 slides on one listed topic, such as Victimology, Victim Compensation, Rights of Children or Rights of under Trial Prisoners.

faq.question: Can I apply by email or post?
faq.answer: No. You can apply only through the web link on www.dslsa.org. Hard-copy and e-mail applications will be rejected.

faq.question: How long does the engagement last?
faq.answer: It starts with three months and may be extended up to a maximum of one year, depending on your performance and the Authority's needs.

faq.question: How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by interview only. Candidates called for interview are not paid any TA/DA.

faq.question: Can I do other work alongside this job?
faq.answer: No. This is a full-time assignment, and you cannot join any other profession, service or engagement while you work with DSLSA.

faq.question: What will a Law Clerk-cum-Research Assistant do?
faq.answer: The work includes research for NALSA and DSLSA schemes and help to victims under the Delhi Victim Compensation Scheme. It also covers legal help to victims of human trafficking and preparing material for legal literacy programmes.

content_sections.heading: About CRCS
content_sections.text: The Office of the Central Registrar of Cooperative Societies is a Government of India office under the Ministry of Cooperation. It is on the 9th Floor, Tower-E, World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110 029. This contract post will be based at that office.

content_sections.text: The remuneration stays the same for the whole contract. There is no annual increment or percentage increase.

rows.pay: Monthly remuneration fixed by the formula "last basic pay minus pension"

content_sections.heading: CRCS Consultant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must not be older than 62 years at the time of applying. You must have retired, or be about to retire, from a post of at least Assistant Section Officer in the CSS or a Non-CSS cadre. Good experience of handling Court Cases, VIP Matters, Establishment, Budget & Account, Parliament, RTI and other work of Central Ministries or Departments. Good knowledge of the Central Government rules and regulations for this work. Good working knowledge of computers, including MS-Word, MS-Excel, PowerPoint and e-Office. Good knowledge of independent noting and drafting on computer or e-Office, as Central Government Ministries require. Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university. The notice says the candidate should preferably live in Delhi NCR. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Consultant
content_sections.text: The Consultant will deal with Court Cases, VIP Matters and Finance. The Consultant will also help run the office's day-to-day work across its areas of activity, in line with its mandate.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be called for an interview. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or for joining the post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The terms follow Department of Expenditure Office Memorandum No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020. The engagement is purely on contract. It does not count as re-employment. The first term is one year. It may be extended after review, at the sole discretion of the Office or Ministry. The post is full-time. During the contract you may not take any other assignment in a public or private organisation. The place of work is the CRCS office at World Trade Centre, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi. There is no accommodation and no allowance, including Dearness Allowance, transport, residential accommodation, personal staff, CGHS and medical reimbursement. There is no Provident Fund, pension, insurance or gratuity. Leave is 1.5 days for each completed month. Leave cannot be carried beyond a calendar year, unused leave is not paid for, and no single spell of leave may be longer than three days. The Department can end the engagement at any time without notice or reason. The Consultant can resign by giving 15 days' notice or paying the consultancy fee instead. The Consultant must keep the Department's information confidential, avoid conflicts of interest and keep absolute integrity. The Department may review the Consultant's work at any time. If any information you give turns out to be false, or you hide a material fact, you can be removed from the engagement. The Department is not responsible for any loss, accidental damage or injury that happens during the work, including travel.

content_sections.heading: ISTM Joint Director and Deputy Director Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The Joint Director post falls vacant from 17 March 2027. The Deputy Director post has been vacant since 1 May 2020. Both posts are classified as General Central Service Group 'A' Gazetted, Non-Ministerial. The selected officer can draw either the pay of the deputation post, or the basic pay drawn in the parent department or cadre plus a training allowance on it. The Government of India sets the training allowance rate from time to time. At present it is 12% of basic pay. Schedule, organise and direct training programmes for supervisory and operating level officers of the Central and State Governments, autonomous bodies and similar organisations. Produce training materials, case studies, practical experiences and similar material. Assist the Director of the Institute in administrative and training matters.

content_sections.heading: ISTM Joint Director and Deputy Director Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Age limit: For both posts, applicants must not be over fifty-six (56) years of age on the closing date for receipt of applications. Who can apply: Officers under the Central Government who either: hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their parent cadre or department; or have five years' regular service in the grade at Level 11 (Rs. 67700-208700) in the pay matrix, or an equivalent post, in their parent cadre or department. Essential: Bachelor's degree from a recognised University or institute; and Five years' experience in Administrative or Establishment or Financial Matters in ministerial posts of the Government of India. Desirable: Master's degree in Public Administration or Economics from a recognised University or institute. DoPT Certified Master Trainer, or Recognised Trainer, or trained in Direct Trainer Skills (DTS) or Design of Training (DoT) under the Trainers Development Programme (TDP). Experience in one or more of these areas: one year in matters related to training; or one year in an Integrated Finance Division or in Administrative Vigilance at pay level 10 (Rs. 56100-177500) or above; or one year in developing online training modules, instruction design or curriculum design. Who can apply: Officers under the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, Universities, recognised research institutes, public sector undertakings, or autonomous or statutory organisations, who either: hold an analogous post on a regular basis in their parent cadre or department; or have five years' regular service in the grade at Level-10 in the pay matrix, or an equivalent post, in their parent cadre or department. Essential: Desirable: Master's degree in Economics or Business Administration (Finance) from a recognised University or institute. Two years' teaching or training experience in Economic Policy, Financial Management or Planning. DoPT Certified Master Trainer, or recognised Trainer, or trained in Direct Trainer Skills (DTS) or Design of Training (DoT) under the Trainers Development Programme (TDP). Experience in one or more of these areas: one year in training-related matters; two years in Administrative, Establishment or Financial matters at pay level 10 or above; one year in an Integrated Finance Division or in Administrative Vigilance at pay level 10 or above; or one year in developing online training modules, instruction design or curriculum design. content_sections.heading: About MBMC
content_sections.text: Mira Bhayandar Municipal Corporation is the civic body for Mira Bhayandar in Thane district, Maharashtra. Its Public Health Department works from Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bhavan, Nagar Bhavan, Mandli Talav, Bhayandar (W). The person appointed will work at the corporation's Bharatratna Indira Gandhi Hospital in Mira Road.

content_sections.heading: MBMC Mammography Technician Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The honorarium is paid according to biometric attendance. Extra work beyond normal hours is not paid for.

content_sections.heading: MBMC Mammography Technician Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A degree in the science faculty from a recognised university, with Radiology as a subject. 3 years' experience as a Mammography Technician in a government-recognised hospital. Knowledge of Marathi is required. The application form also has a section for computer qualifications (MSCIT or an equivalent recognised course). Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: MBMC will check the applications it receives and prepare a draft merit list of eligible candidates. Appointments will be made from this list in order of merit, based on MBMC's needs and the notice's terms and conditions. Selected candidates must report for appointment with their original eligibility and experience documents, a passport-size photograph and one set of self-attested photocopies. MBMC will not write to candidates who are found ineligible.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The first appointment order will be for six months, on an honorary, purely temporary basis. The selected candidate must join within 3 days of receiving the appointment order. The job requires at least eight hours of duty a day, depending on the hospital's needs. The head of department sets the working hours. Because this is an essential service, extra work may be needed when required. The post is entirely honorary and on contract. It gives no right to claim a permanent post, absorption into MBMC service or the benefits of permanent staff. Candidates also cannot take this claim to court. MBMC may end the appointment without notice. It does not have to give one month's notice. To resign, you must give at least 15 days' written notice. If you do not, that month's honorarium will not be paid. Service can be ended without notice for doubtful integrity, misconduct or improper behaviour, misleading seniors, absence or disobeying orders. It can also be ended at any stage if your work is not satisfactory. The Medical Health Officer or head of department decides what the work involves. The Commissioner may change the number of posts or other details, change the process, or cancel the recruitment at any stage without giving a reason. Your candidature will be cancelled automatically if you are found ineligible or if you use misconduct or pressure at any stage. If you have already been appointed, the appointment will be ended.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MBMC Mammography Technician Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the MBMC website . The notice says applications not made on this form within the deadline will not be accepted. Paste a passport-size photograph in the box on the form and sign below it. Fill in your full name in Marathi and in English capital letters. Then add your permanent and current addresses, phone number, email, date of birth, age, sex, nationality, whether you are domiciled in Maharashtra, marital status and the languages you know. List your educational qualifications from Class 10 upwards, giving percentages only. Do not give grades, SGPA or CGPA. Then add any additional qualifications and your computer qualification. Give details of your experience: the institution, whether it is government, semi-government or private, the period, the total time and why you left. Answer the question on court, criminal or disciplinary cases, list the copies you are attaching, and sign the declaration. Complete and sign the undertaking (हमीपत्र) stating that no criminal case is registered against you. Submit the application by 5.00 pm on 10 November 2026 at: Public Health Department, Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Bhavan, Nagar Bhavan, Mandli Talav, Ground Floor, Bhayandar (W), Tal. Dist. Thane - 401101. Attach self-attested true copies of your mark sheets and certificates as proof of age, educational qualification, marks and experience. Applications will be rejected if candidates are not eligible, if the form is incomplete or wrongly filled, or if these copies are missing. The Public Health Department can be contacted at [email protected] or by phone on 022-28192828 / 28193028.

content_sections.heading: About NMPA
content_sections.text: New Mangalore Port Authority is a port under the Govt. of India (Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways), located at Panambur, Mangalore - 575010. Its letterhead calls it "Fully Solar Powered" and "An ISO 9001:2015, 14001:2015, 45001:2018 & ISPS Compliant Port", and it carries the Sagarmala logo. The office phone numbers printed on the notice are 0824 - 2407341 and 2887399.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The vacancy is open to eligible and willing officers of Major Port Authorities who have the qualifications and experience set out in the Recruitment Rule (RR) in Annexure I. The RR was published in the Gazette of India: Extraordinary. It classes the post as Class-I and as a selection post, with a scale of pay of 10750-300-16750 (pre-revised). The crucial date for deciding eligibility is 20 November 2026 . Under the RR, absorption/deputation will be of officers holding analogous posts, or the post of Asst. Secretary Gr-I in the scale of pay of Rs.9100-15100 with 5 years regular service in the grade, in a Major Port Trust. The RR lists the following qualifications for direct recruitment: Essential (i): A degree from a recognised university. Essential (ii): Five years experience in executive cadre in the field of General Administration, Personnel, Industrial Relations etc. in an Industrial/Commercial/Govt. Undertaking. Desirable: Post Graduate degree/diploma in Personnel Management/Industrial Relations/Social Work/Labour Welfare or allied subjects or degree in Law from a recognised university/institution. According to the RR, the educational qualifications for direct recruits will apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation, but the experience for direct recruits will not. The RR prints an upper age limit of 35 years for direct recruitment. It also states that this age limit does not apply in the case of promotion/absorption/deputation. The RR fills the post by promotion. If that fails, the post is filled by absorption/deputation, and if both fail, by direct recruitment. The feeder posts for promotion are Asst. Secretary Gr.I or Hindi Officer in the pay scale of Rs. 9100-15100. The RR gives a period of probation of 2 years. Candidates should check the official notification (Annexure I) for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is in the scale of pay of Rs.50,000-1,60,000 (Pre to pre revised Rs.10750-16750). Annexure VI sets out the following terms and conditions of deputation at New Mangalore Port Authority: Period of deputation: 3 years, extendable to 4 years. In exceptional circumstances it can be extended to 5 years. The Central Government decides this for a post whose holder is regarded as the Head of Department, and the Chairman decides it for any post below the level of Head of Department. Pay: The employee may choose to have pay fixed in the deputation post under the normal rules. Or the employee may draw the pay of the post held in the parent department plus a deputation allowance, under the conditions as modified from time to time. Dearness allowance: Paid under the rules of the parent department or of NMPA, depending on whether the employee keeps the parent department's scale of pay or draws pay in the Port's scale. Local allowance: If the deputationist chooses the parent department's pay, H.R.A. is payable as per the parent department's rules at the rates applicable to NMPA employees. Joining time pay and transfer T.A.: T.A. and joining time are given both when joining the deputation post and when returning to the parent department, under the Port's rules. The Port bears this cost. Travelling allowance: Travelling allowance for journeys on duty during deputation is regulated under the rules of NMPA. Leave and pension: The leave and pension rules of the parent organisation continue to apply. Provident fund: The employee keeps subscribing to the Provident Fund of the parent organisation. If the deputationist is governed by the Contributory Provident Fund Rules, the Port pays the employer's contribution for the period of deputation. Medical facilities: As available to employees under the rules of the New Mangalore Port. Residential accommodation: If the Port allots accommodation, rent is recovered as per the Rules/Regulations of the New Mangalore Port. Residuary matters: Service conditions not covered above are governed by the rules and orders of the parent Department/Organisation.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 3 Deputy Secretary, 1 Deputy Legal Adviser, 1 Under Secretary and 3 Section Officer. All of them are filled by deputation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 30 days from the date the advertisement is published in the Employment News.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the NCH Deputy Legal Adviser post?
faq.answer: The notice requires a bachelor's degree in law with eight years of experience of handling legal and legislative matters, or a Master's degree in law with five years of such experience. It lists this together with condition (a): an analogous post, or five years of regular service in Level 11 with experience of legal and legislative matters.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Deputy Secretary, Under Secretary and Section Officer posts?
faq.answer: Each of these posts asks for a bachelor's degree from a recognised university or institute and five years of experience in Accounts or administration or establishment work in a Government Office, Public Sector Undertaking or Statutory Body. Each also has its own condition (a): an analogous post, or regular service in the feeder level (five years in Level 11, six years in Level 8 or eight years in Level 7 respectively).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is not more than 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NCH Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Deputy Secretary and Deputy Legal Adviser are at Level 12 (Rs.78800-209200/-). Under Secretary is at Level 11 (Rs.67700-208700/-), and Section Officer is at Level 08 (Rs.47600-151100/-).

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send your biodata in the prescribed proforma from the NCH website, with an SOP of no more than 250 words, a passport photograph and copies of your qualification and experience certificates. The address is: Dr. Sanjay Gupta, Secretary, National Commission for Homoeopathy(NCH), No. 61-65, Institutional Area, Opp. D Block, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the deputation period at NCH?
faq.answer: The period of deputation shall ordinarily not exceed three years. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Can feeder-category officers of NCH apply on deputation?
faq.answer: No. Department officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment by deputation, and deputationists are not eligible for appointment by promotion.

basic_details.job_title: ORGI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 26 Assistant Registrar General, Research Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Serving officers of the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, recognized universities, recognized research institutions, public sector undertakings and statutory or autonomous bodies can apply for 26 posts on deputation (including short term contract) in the Office of the Registrar General, India (ORGI), Ministry of Home Affairs, New Delhi. The posts are 1 Assistant Registrar General (Map), 12 Research Officer (Map), 3 Research Officer (Drawing), 1 Research Officer (Language)/Linguist and 9 Map Analyst, with pay from Level-8 to Level-12 and an initial term of

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short-term contract) is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation (including short term contract). Deputationists are not eligible for appointment by promotion. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check Annexure-I of the official notification.

how_to_apply: Get the Bio-data/Curriculum Vitae proforma (Annexure-II) from the circular. The circular says it is available on the website www.censusindia.gov.in.

Write the post you are applying for at the top. Fill in all items, including the eligibility and qualifications of the post set against what you hold (items 5(A) and 5(B)), your employment history and your present pay. Then sign it.
Attach self-attested certificates and documents supporting the qualification and experience you claim, and the certificates listed below.
Have the application certified by your Controlling Officer, and have the Employer/Head of Office/Forwarding Authority/Cadre Controlling Authority complete the certificate at the end of the proforma.

Have the application, in duplicate, forwarded through proper channel to: The Under Secretary, Admin-III Section, Office of the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, Ministry of Home Affairs, Janganana Bhawan, 3rd Floor, 2-A Mansingh Road, New Delhi-110011.
Make sure the application reaches within 60 days from the date the circular is published in Rozgar Samachar/Employment News.
Bio-data in duplicate as per the proforma in Annexure-II.
Supporting self-attested certificates/documents in support of the qualification and experience claimed, including supporting documents for items 5(A) and 5(B) of the proforma.
Cadre clearance certificate.
Statement giving the details of major or minor penalties imposed on the officer, if any, during the last ten (10) years.
Vigilance clearance/Integrity Certificate.
Photocopies of APARs for the past five years (2020-21 to 2024-25), attested on each page by an officer not below the level of Under Secretary or equivalent, or the CR Dossiers in original.

The certificate by the Employer/Head of Office/Forwarding Authority/Cadre Controlling Authority. It confirms that the details are correct and that the officer will be relieved immediately if selected. It also certifies that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated, certifies the officer's integrity, and states whether any major or minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years.
As the proforma's note puts it, documents related to eligibility conditions "such as Bachelor's Degree, Experience Certificate (duly attested) and APARs for the period 2020-21 to 2024-25".

If your organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales: the latest salary slip, showing basic pay with the scale of pay and rate of increment, dearness pay/interim relief/other allowances with break-up, and total emoluments.
Officers already on deputation: the application must be forwarded by the parent cadre/Department along with cadre clearance, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate.
important_instructions: Applications that are incomplete, received after the closing date, or not certified by the forwarding authority will not be entertained. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later. Only officers who can be spared immediately if selected should be forwarded. Applications must be forwarded strictly in line with the circular and its annexures. Pay Band and Grade Pay granted under ACP/MACP are personal to the officer and must not be shown as the pay of the post. Show only the pay of the post held on regular basis, and give ACP/MACP details in the separate table in the proforma. The information in the bio-data and the documents for essential qualification and work experience will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection. Lending departments must give their specific comments confirming the essential qualification and work experience of the candidate for the post applied for. The circular is signed by Sunil Kumar Mishra, Under Secretary to the Govt. of India (E-mail ID: [email protected]).

content_sections.heading: About ORGI
content_sections.text: The Office of the Registrar General, India (ORGI) is an office of the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India. It is located at Janganana Bhawan, Tower-A, 2/A, Man Singh Road, New Delhi-110011. Its head is the Registrar General & Census Commissioner, India, and its offices named in the circular include the Map Division, the Language Division and the Directorates of Census Operations.
