content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three posts carry a salary of basic Rs 80,000/-. DGM (IT) and DGM (Project & Ventures): Rs. 80,000/- per month plus allowances as approved by the Management. All three posts are on contractual basis. DGM (IT): initial contract will be for one year, extendable on annual basis on discretion of the Management. DGM (Project & Ventures): the job would require regular travel across Punjab & neighbouring states, and the officer will report to the Managing Director. DGM (IT): the officer will report directly to the Managing Director, PESCO and General Manager (Admin).

content_sections.heading: PESCO Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: PESCO intends to hire an IT Officer who will be overall in charge of the entire IT setup at PESCO, i.e. existing software in use, legacy database, cyber security and network, and ERP implementation to ensure seamless business operation. The DGM IT will be the Chief Technology Officer of PESCO, responsible for ensuring: Digital transformation of PESCO from manual to a fully automated, paperless, ERP-based system. Single Point of Contact (SPOC) between PESCO and Software Development Agency. Technical skills listed for DGM (IT): Hands-on experience with major ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics 365, Ramco etc. Proficiency in database management and query language like SQL. Knowledge of coding / scripting language (Java, Python, XML). Experience connecting ERP modules with their parts applications, AIPS, cloud infrastructure etc. Ability to run system diagnostics, troubleshoot errors, data migration, backup etc. Framework knowledge of Project Management. Data Centre / Network Administrator. Network Security and Cyber Security aspects. Tableau / Data Visualisation / report generation tools. Suggest AI Tools to be incorporated in ERP / Software used. DGM (Project & Ventures) is a strategic leadership position focused on bridging the gap between the workforce of ex-servicemen (ESM)/Dependents and the evolving industrial landscape of Punjab. Job purpose: to identify, evaluate and secure new avenues for the employment and self-employment of Ex-Servicemen, Widows and Dependents, and to act as primary liaison between PESCO and the private sector, industrial bodies and skill-building agencies. Key responsibilities (Business Development & Opportunity scouting): Market Intelligence: Conduct regular market research to identify emerging sectors in Punjab/Chandigarh that can absorb ESM manpower. Tender & Project Management: Scout for government and private tenders where PESCO can provide specialized manpower or security services. Skill Gap Analysis & Liaison. Industry Mapping: Visit industrial hubs to understand specific technical and soft skill requirements. Training Partnerships: Connect with Punjab Skill Development Mission (PSDM), National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and private "skilling agencies" to design customized bridge courses for retiring ESM/Dependents. Curriculum Integration: Ensure that military training is mapped to civilian job roles to facilitate easier transition. Entrepreneurship Support: Identify small-scale venture opportunities for ESM. Any other responsibility given by the Management.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PESCO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: There is no online form. Applicants send their bio-data in the format printed in the notice, by 24 November 2026, in either of these ways: Prepare the bio-data with these columns: Ser No, Rank & Name, Address, Contact No & E-mail ID, DOB & Age, Med Cat, Domicile, Education (Civil and Cmptr), Matric with Punjabi (year), Experience. Attach a copy of the Record of Service, the PPO and a photograph. Email the bio-data and attachments to [email protected] , or Send them by post or deliver them physically at PESCO Head Office, SCO 89-90, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh - 160022. Documents named in the notice: Bio-data as per the prescribed format Copy of Record of Service PPO Photograph For queries, the notice gives the contact number 0172-2620423 and the website www.pesco.punjab.gov.in .

content_sections.heading: About MGUG
content_sections.text: Mahayogi Gorakhnath University Gorakhpur describes itself as a multidisciplinary university expanding across a 200+ acre campus at Balapar, Gorakhpur. Its fields include Medicine, Ayurveda, Pharmacy, Nursing, Agriculture, Health & Life Science, Engineering & Technology, Allied & Healthcare and Management & Commerce. The campus is also home to an upcoming 1,800-bed multi-specialty hospital. Two functional multispecialty hospitals in Gorakhpur are Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (650+ beds) and Mahayogi Gorakhnath Chikitsalaya (300+ beds).

basic_details.short_information: AIIMS Rishikesh has invited applications for one Research Assistant post under the extramural funded research project “Evaluation of the efficacy and safety of Suprabrain® in children with autism spectrum disorder”, purely on a temporary basis, at a consolidated fixed salary of Rs 25,000 per month. The essential qualification is a Master's Degree in any subject related to medical science (like psychology or psychiatry) or life science from a recognized university or equivalent, and the maximum age limit is 35 years. Applications are received from 5 November 2026 to 15 November 2026 (5:00 PM) b

how_to_apply: Prepare the filled application form together with all necessary documents supporting the qualification and other information.
Combine the form and the documents into a single merged PDF.
Email the PDF to [email protected].
Send it so that it is received by 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Incomplete applications and applications received after the last date and time will not be considered.
Applications are received from 5 November 2026.
The notice does not print a subject line for the email or a format for the application form.
important_instructions: At the time of document verification/interview, candidates must bring a duly completed hard copy of the application form, all original certificates/documents, and one set of self-attested photocopies. No TA/DA is paid for attending the written test, document verification or interview. The selected candidate must join within five days of issue of the offer letter, failing which the offer may be cancelled and offered to the next eligible candidate. The selected candidate may be required to work at AIIMS Rishikesh or at any project-related site, as per project requirements. The post gives no right to regular appointment or absorption in AIIMS Rishikesh. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. Private practice of any kind is not permitted during the tenure. The appointee may resign by giving one month's notice or salary in lieu thereof, subject to acceptance by the Competent Authority and completion of handover formalities. The appointment may be terminated by the Competent Authority, on the recommendation of the Principal Investigator, if performance or conduct is found unsatisfactory, as per applicable rules. content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Rishikesh Project
content_sections.text: The post sits in an extramural funded research project at AIIMS Rishikesh that evaluates the efficacy and safety of Suprabrain® in children with autism spectrum disorder. The notice is issued by the Principal Investigator, AIIMS Rishikesh, and the interview venue is the Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS, Rishikesh.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists one post, Research Assistant (Vacancy-1). Age: the notice gives the maximum age limit as 35 years, counted as on the last date of application. Age relaxation, wherever applicable, is admissible in accordance with prevailing Central Government/ICMR and AIIMS Rishikesh rules. The notice does not list the relaxation by category. Experience is counted only after the minimum essential qualification prescribed for the post has been obtained. Candidates must make sure they meet the qualification, experience and age requirements. False or incorrect information found at any stage leads to cancellation of candidature or appointment and may invite appropriate action. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: A Master's Degree in any subject related to medical science (like psychology or psychiatry) or life science from a recognized university or equivalent

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated fixed salary is Rs 25,000/- per month. No allowances or facilities other than the approved consolidated emoluments and admissible HRA, if any, are payable. The post is purely temporary, contractual and co-terminus with the project. The initial appointment is for three months. It may be extended, based on satisfactory performance, project requirements and availability of funds, up to one year or until completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Any extension is subject to a satisfactory performance evaluation by the Principal Investigator and approval of the Competent Authority. Leave is admissible as per the rules applicable to project staff/contractual employees of AIIMS Rishikesh.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Prepare the filled application form together with all necessary documents supporting the qualification and other information. Combine the form and the documents into a single merged PDF. Email the PDF to [email protected] . Send it so that it is received by 15 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Incomplete applications and applications received after the last date and time will not be considered. Applications are received from 5 November 2026. The notice does not print a subject line for the email or a format for the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates may be shortlisted on the basis of the information in the application form, qualifications and relevant experience. Only shortlisted candidates may be called for the selection process. The method of selection may include a written test, an interview, or both, as decided by the Selection Committee. If required, a written test may be held before the interview. The Selection Committee is constituted with the approval of the Competent Authority, AIIMS Rishikesh, and its decision is final. The interview is held at the Department of Pediatrics, AIIMS, Rishikesh, and the date will be communicated on the AIIMS, Rishikesh website. The interview is conducted only after physical verification of original documents. Requests for an online interview are not entertained. Permission to appear in the selection process does not mean a candidate fulfils the eligibility criteria. Eligibility is finally determined after verification of original documents.

rows.date: Will be communicated on the AIIMS, Rishikesh website

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: At the time of document verification/interview, candidates must bring a duly completed hard copy of the application form, all original certificates/documents, and one set of self-attested photocopies. No TA/DA is paid for attending the written test, document verification or interview. The selected candidate must join within five days of issue of the offer letter, failing which the offer may be cancelled and offered to the next eligible candidate. The selected candidate may be required to work at AIIMS Rishikesh or at any project-related site, as per project requirements. The post gives no right to regular appointment or absorption in AIIMS Rishikesh. Canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. Private practice of any kind is not permitted during the tenure. The appointee may resign by giving one month's notice or salary in lieu thereof, subject to acceptance by the Competent Authority and completion of handover formalities. The appointment may be terminated by the Competent Authority, on the recommendation of the Principal Investigator, if performance or conduct is found unsatisfactory, as per applicable rules. AIIMS Rishikesh reserves the right not to fill the post, to cancel the recruitment process, or to modify the number of posts, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the enclosed format Annexure-I (proforma) and Annexure-II (declaration), with a photograph affixed on it and signed. The notice says the duly filled application form is compulsory. Self-attested copies of the relevant educational and experience documents. All relevant original testimonials (date of birth, degree certificate, experience certificate, etc., if any) to be shown, and a set of attested copies of all the certificates for verification at the time of registration. No objection and experience certificate from the employer, in case the candidate is employed (the notice also lists no objection certificates from the current employer at the appointment time). Documentary proof of prior experience, which the application form calls mandatory for any experience claimed. Annexure-I asks for the post applied for, the project, name in block letters, parent/spouse name, date of birth and age as on date of interview, present and permanent postal address, mobile number, Aadhar number and email. It has a table for educational qualifications from Matriculation/SSC to Doctorate/Ph.D. (year of passing, board/university, major subjects, marks), and a table for prior experience (organisation, post, from, to, drawn salary). It also asks for additional qualifications, trainings, research publications, awards, professional affiliations, category (SC/ST/OBC/OC/PH/Ex-servicemen as per GoI norms), and whether the candidate is willing to be considered for any lower post. Annexure-II is a declaration that none of the candidate's near or distant relatives is an employee of ICAR-IIMR, or, as the alternative, the name, designation and relationship of relative(s) working in ICAR.

Only candidates having the essential qualifications will be allowed to attend the interview, which begins at 10:30 AM onwards. The selected candidate may have to join immediately, and certificates will be verified again before joining.

content_sections.heading: About ICMR
content_sections.text: The Indian Council of Medical Research, headquartered at V. Ramalingaswami Bhavan, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029, deals with biomedical and health research in various areas in collaboration with national and international agencies. According to the notice, ICMR works through its Headquarters at New Delhi and 28 Institutes/ Centres and a large number of field stations across the country. The Director posts in this circular head five of these institutes.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Research Areas
content_sections.text: The vacancy circular lists five Director posts. All five share the same pay, qualification and age limit; the area in which the Research & Development experience must have been gained differs from post to post. *The posts of Director, ICMR-NIMR, Dwarka, New Delhi and Director, ICMR-NITM, Belagavi are against lien vacancies and are subject to reversion of the lien holder.

Director-National Institute of Traditional Medicine (NITM), Belagavi*

rows.required_r_d_experience_area: Research & Development related to Communicable Diseases, or Non-Communicable Diseases, or Reproductive Health, or Child Health, or Nutrition

rows.required_r_d_experience_area: Research & Development related to Communicable Diseases, or Non-Communicable Diseases, or Reproductive Health, or Child Health, or Nutrition

rows.required_r_d_experience_area: Research & Development related to Communicable Diseases, or Non-Communicable Diseases, or Reproductive Health, or Child Health, or Nutrition

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian Citizens. The same essential qualification and experience apply to all five Director posts. MD/MS or equivalent degree recognised by MCI/NMC OR MBBS or equivalent degree recognised by MCI/NMC with MPH from a recognised University OR Master's Degree in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences or MBBS or equivalent degree, recognised by MCI/NMC, with Ph.D. from a recognised University in a subject related to Biomedical Sciences 15 years, which must include: 05 Years in a managerial position and has handled R&D projects independently (viz. PI or Co-PI of Scientific studies, Head of Research Groups/ Centres/ Institutes/ Laboratories), AND 02 Years regular service in the pay matrix level-13-A or 07 Years regular service in the pay matrix level-13, or equivalent as amended from time to time Experience in Research & Development related to Biomedical Sciences in Govt./ Public sector/ Private Institutions will be admissible, in the area set for each post in the table above. Ph.D. will be considered as 4 years' experience (irrespective of the duration taken to complete the degree). MD/MS or equivalent to be considered as 3 years' experience. MVSc will be considered as 2 years' experience. MPH/M.Tech/ME will not be considered as any experience. The period spent on obtaining the minimum essential educational qualification shall not count towards experience. For applicants from the private sector or laboratories/ institutions abroad, the Screening Committee shall decide the equivalency of Pay Scale. The qualifications and experience may be relaxed in the case of exceptionally meritorious candidates, with the approval of the President, Governing Council, ICMR, for reasons to be recorded in writing. Scientists from the Central Government or State Government or recognised autonomous organisations of the Central Government or State Government or Research Institutes or Universities who are: Holding an analogous post on regular basis; or Possessing the same essential qualifications and experience prescribed for direct recruits. ICMR Scientists shall not be eligible for appointment on deputation; they shall apply under Direct Recruitment. The age limit for the Director posts is not exceeding 58 years . For appointment by deputation, the maximum age limit shall not exceed 58 years as on the last date of applications. Age relaxation applies as per the existing Government of India instructions. In addition, the age limit may be relaxed for exceptionally meritorious candidates, based on their CVs/experience, with the approval of the President, Governing Council, ICMR, for reasons to be recorded in writing. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: All five Director posts are in Level-14 of Pay Matrix (Rs.1,44,200-2,18,200) (7th CPC), with usual allowances as admissible to ICMR employees. The posts are filled on regular basis, with all India transfer liability under the Council. 5 years, extendable by maximum 5 years, or till superannuation, whichever is earlier. During the tenure as Director, ICMR Scientists shall hold lien on their substantive post at ICMR. ICMR Scientists, on completion of the tenure (including extension, if any) as Director, shall be given the position of Scientist 'G' in any of the Institutes/Centres/HQ of ICMR, till superannuation; pay and allowances shall be protected in accordance with rules. A Non-ICMR Scientist holding the tenure post of Director can be considered for absorption in ICMR as Director's Grade Scientist, i.e., Scientist 'G', subject to availability of vacancy in the scientific cadre, on completion of minimum 5 years of continuous regular service as Director. The tenure of deputation shall be 5 years (extendable maximum by 5 years, only if the incumbent is absorbed in ICMR). The period of deputation, including deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment in the same or other organisation/Department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed 5 years. The Director on deputation can be considered for absorption in ICMR as Director's Grade Scientist, i.e., Scientist G/Head, subject to availability of vacancy in the scientific cadre, on completion of minimum 5 years of continuous regular service as Director. The fee is paid through the online link given in the application form.

content_sections.text: The notice describes selection through shortlisting followed by interview: Initial shortlisting: all candidates who fulfil minimum eligibility in respect of age, essential qualifications and essential experience (wherever required) shall be short-listed. Further shortlisting: if the number of shortlisted candidates is high and it is not possible to call all of them for interview, ICMR shall further shortlist on suitable criteria fixed by the Competent Authority, ICMR. ICMR generally prefers to call candidates with higher experience in the relevant fields or with higher educational qualification, as decided by the Appointing Authority. Interview / personal discussion: shortlisted candidates are called for interview; government and PSU employees must bring the NOC with an undertaking that "the applicant will be relieved within one month of his/her receipt of appointment order".

content_sections.text: Application should be submitted along with the online application fees. Incomplete applications or applications without supportive documents are liable to be rejected. Any outside influence (political or otherwise) brought in by a candidate shall disqualify him/her. Any further detail/ communication shall be displayed on the ICMR website only. ICMR retains the liberty to either modify or cancel or publish afresh this vacancy circular; matters with no specific instruction shall be decided by ICMR. content_sections.heading: About IICA
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs is an autonomous institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. Its 14-acre campus is at Plot No.6, 7 & 8, Sector-5, IMT Manesar, District-Gurugram, Haryana. It provides knowledge and professional training through five Schools and eleven Centres, and also serves as a Government think tank on corporate laws, policies and governance.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Posts
content_sections.text: Conduct general research connected to CSR and sustainability Organize research on needs and impact assessment, baseline studies and SROI, including proposals, literature reviews, questionnaires, field surveys and data collection Collect, record, analyse and evaluate data and facts Support, facilitate and maintain CSR data Do any other duty entrusted by the Competent Authority Collaborate with the WNS Research team, Finance and Administration stakeholders and experts to ensure smooth project execution Assist in opportunity reviews to identify key tenders and relevant studies in CSR and sustainability Support research administration, including record-keeping and documentation Handle the Centre's office files, coordinate with other units, schools and centres of IICA, and arrange logistics Maintain records, prepare data sheets and update content modules Follow up on invoices and settlement of advances for ongoing and upcoming projects Handle or coordinate the Learning Management System

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: All applications received by the due date are screened against the minimum educational qualifications and experience prescribed. The duly constituted Selection Committee shortlists candidates. The Institute reserves the right to devise its own shortlisting criteria. Shortlisted candidates are called for a presentation and/or interview at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference, on a date and time communicated separately. Holding the minimum qualifications does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called. IICA communicates only with shortlisted candidates and does not entertain interim correspondence or personal enquiries. No TA/DA is permissible for attending the interview. Final results will be published on the IICA website once the process concludes. Selected candidates may have to undergo a medical examination, if required.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is for one year at first, and may be extended or curtailed depending on performance and requirement. WNS Project positions can be extended up to the duration of the Project, as they are co-terminus with it. The assignment is full time. The person must attend office on all working days, and on holidays if required. Selected candidates must sign a contract with IICA and join the duties immediately. Either side can end the contract with two months' notice, or two months' consolidated emoluments in lieu. A consultant cannot apply for any position inside or outside IICA while the contract is valid, or before 02 years of joining the position (where the contract provides for extension after one year), whichever is later. To apply internally for another position, the consultant must terminate the present contract. Leave and increments are as per the policy of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Verbal and Communication Trainer
content_sections.text: Train students in verbal and communication skills, covering vocabulary-building, grammar, syllogisms, critical reasoning and comprehension. Encourage and motivate students to communicate fluently and confidently. Prepare students for higher-study exams such as CAT and GRE, and train them in special skills like public speaking and debate. Conduct exams regularly and give immediate feedback, so students can rate their progress and identify weak areas. Give training based on industry requirements, so students can face placement tests. Be ready to imbibe new technology-based training. Identify students who lack communication skills and give them special training to overcome their limitations. Provide career counselling and guidance, and record the data in the required formats. Actively participate and contribute in the special training drives organised by CIR for Amrita students. Stay updated on university accreditation requirements under CIR's learning and development activities. Contribute to periodic curriculum revisions in verbal and communication skills, in line with current industry requirements. Keep students' knowledge current by sharing the latest question papers, vocabulary-building techniques and newly coined words through the Amrita University Management System (AUMS) software.

content_sections.heading: About Jamia Hamdard
content_sections.text: Jamia Hamdard is a Deemed to be University at Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi, declared by the Government of India, Ministry of Education, through a Gazette Notification dated 10 May 1989. The notice describes it as a research oriented organization, accredited by NAAC in the 'A+' Category. It also says the university is ranked among the top 50 Universities in India and 1st in the Pharmacy category in NIRF-2025.

content_sections.heading: Jamia Hamdard Registrar Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A Master's degree with at least 55% of the marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed. Candidates also need one of the following: At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the Academic Level 11 and above. Eight years of service in Academic Level 12 and above including as Associate Professor, along with experience in educational administration. Comparable experience in research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education. 15 years of administrative experience, of which 8 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post. The minimum qualification, pay and other benefits shall be as per the UGC/Statutory bodies/Jamia Hamdard norms. The official notification has the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.text: The appointment is on Tenure/Deputation basis. The age of retirement for the post is 62 years. The post is based at Jamia Hamdard, Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening: only candidates who fulfil all the essential qualifications and qualify the screening by a duly constituted screening committee will be short-listed. Selection: short-listed candidates will be selected through a process comprising a written test and/or interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary, and the appointment is initially for one year and coterminous with the project. Extension beyond one year depends on obtaining the prescribed grading in the yearly progress evaluation by the Program Monitoring Committee (PMC). The evaluation will be strictly based on achievements against the milestones set at the beginning of the program. If progress is not satisfactory, no further extension will be granted. Selection does not entitle the candidate to any claim for future positions at IAV, permanent or otherwise. The selected candidate will be required to work at any of the collaborating institutions as per the directions of the PI. Selected candidates are required to join within 15 days from the date of the appointment order.

The 11-page prospectus contains the department-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limits, remuneration provisions, selection methodology, application fees, online registration procedure and document verification requirements. content_sections.heading: BCECEB Senior Resident Tutor Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the relevant postgraduate medical qualification in the concerned speciality, subject to the eligibility and faculty qualification rules applicable to Bihar government medical institutions. The prospectus specifies that DNB and DNB Super Speciality qualifications are to be considered according to the Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulations, 2025 issued by the National Medical Commission. Important: Applicants holding postgraduate qualifications in more than one speciality may apply for eligible subjects separately, following the department-wise application requirements. Candidates must satisfy the prescribed qualification and speciality requirements. Applicants must possess valid medical registration and supporting certificates. Candidates already having completed a three-year Senior Resident/Tutor tenure in the same subject are not eligible for another tenure in that subject. Candidates who have completed three years in one subject may be considered for another eligible subject under the prescribed rules. Applicants must disclose previous employment, teaching experience and Senior Resident/Tutor appointments accurately. The prospectus provides special provisions for eligible Bihar Health Service doctors and applicants with related higher qualifications.

faq.question: Q1. Is there an interview for these posts?
faq.answer: No. The interview provision has been removed, and every candidate receives a uniform 6 marks under that head.

faq.question: Q2. What score do I need to qualify?
faq.answer: The minimum qualifying score for appointment is 16 marks.

faq.question: Q3. Can a diploma holder apply?
faq.answer: A diploma is accepted only when suitable candidates are short. Diploma holders get 10 marks like PG degree holders, but are placed below them in the merit list.

faq.question: Q4. Is a DNB accepted?
faq.answer: Yes. DNB / DNB Super Speciality is treated as a valid qualification under the Medical Institutions (Qualification of Faculty) Regulation, 2025.

faq.question: Q5. I have already done a Senior Residency. Can I apply?
faq.answer: Not in the same subject if you completed the three-year tenure. You can apply in a different subject, and your earlier work in Bihar's government or semi-government colleges earns experience marks.

faq.question: Q6. I have PG degrees in two subjects. How should I apply?
faq.answer: Submit a separate application for each department and mention this in the online form. Once selected in one subject, you cannot be selected in another.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from outside Bihar apply?
faq.answer: Yes, 20% of the posts are for doctors with a PG degree from recognised institutions outside the state. However, applicants who are not natives of Bihar get no reservation benefit.

faq.question: Q8. Can I change my details after submitting the form?
faq.answer: You can correct entries only during the editing period ending at 11.59 PM on 24 November 2026, and only if you paid on time. Your verified mobile number and email cannot be changed.

content_sections.heading: VMRF ERP Implementation Coordinator Vacancy Details 2026
Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: The University describes the role as critical to the successful deployment, adoption and use of its ERP system. The coordinator works with the ERP vendor and with internal stakeholders across all constituent institutions and faculties. The duties listed in the notice are: Act as the primary point of contact between the University and the ERP vendor. Coordinate and plan ERP implementation activities, timelines and deliverables. Understand University processes and work with the vendor to configure and customise the ERP system. Facilitate requirement gathering, documentation and process mapping from various departments and institutions. Coordinate data migration for the Academic, Student, HR, Finance and other modules. Organise and coordinate user training, awareness programmes and change management activities. Monitor project progress, track issues and make sure the vendor resolves them on time. Conduct testing and user acceptance, and ensure quality assurance. Support go-live, stabilisation after implementation, and user support. Prepare regular reports, dashboards and presentations for the University leadership. Work with the IT team on system integration, security, data backup and compliance. Promote best practices for ERP usage and continuous improvement.

content_sections.heading: About Lakshadweep Department of Planning, Statistics & Taxation
content_sections.text: The Department of Planning, Statistics & Taxation of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep works from the Secretariat, Kavaratti - 682555. This post is part of the State Support Mission of NITI Aayog. The Mission aims to strengthen the UT's planning system with multidisciplinary technical support for evidence-based policymaking, sustainable development, governance reforms and national development goals.

content_sections.heading: Lakshadweep Transport Sector Expert Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: One of the following: Master's Degree in Shipping Management, Maritime Studies, Port and Shipping Management, Maritime Transport, or Logistics and Supply Chain Management, or MBA/Post Graduate Diploma in Management with specialisation in Shipping, Maritime Management or Logistics. Candidates also need considerable field experience in the shipping and maritime transport sector, gained after obtaining their highest qualification. Preference will be given to candidates with an advanced diploma or degree in Shipping, Maritime Management, Port Operations, Maritime Transport, Logistics or a related field, and to those with published research papers or publications in the relevant field. Minimum 5 (five) years of experience relevant to the job description (mandatory). Demonstrated experience in leading teams, managing projects and conducting stakeholder engagement. Experience from internships or training will not be counted. Preferred: work experience in the transport sector and in implementing programmes. Experience in stakeholder management Experience in carrying out research and preparing policy briefs Experience in drafting reports and reviewing detailed project reports Knowledge of and experience in National/State planning Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Desirable: prior experience with the Government, UN agencies and other international organisations Excellent spoken and written English, skills in the State-specific language, and a proven ability to communicate well in a multi-cultural environment. For the full eligibility conditions for this post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Duties and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Maintain coordination among the UT Planning Department, LKI and NITI Aayog. Assist the State Institution for Transformation (SIT) in achieving its objectives in collaboration with NITI Aayog and LKI. Evaluate existing strategies, methodologies and systems to improve the socio-economic conditions of the UT. Prepare development strategies, sectoral targets, socio-economic goals and the UT Vision@2047, with a roadmap for achieving them. Draft policy briefs, presentations and other relevant documents. Coordinate with development partners and the technical agencies concerned. Support ways to strengthen horizontal and vertical coordination within the Government. Work with UT officials to prepare project proposals for the UT Government to implement. Assist the UT in strengthening its innovation ecosystem and its monitoring and evaluation ecosystem. Create and facilitate cross-learning platforms, and document the SIT's activities and good practices. Support the preparation of UT-level, regional and sectoral reports on a regular basis. Support regular updates on the UT's progress through the dashboard/portal maintained by NITI Aayog. Support the organisation of workshops and other SIT events, including preparing the relevant inputs. Perform any other tasks assigned by the supervisor (Team Leader) in the interest of the Mission.

content_sections.text: Nature of engagement: purely contractual Contract period: an initial period of two years Place of posting: Kavaratti, Lakshadweep Leave: 18 days in the whole year, plus the holidays listed by the UT of Lakshadweep government Reporting: to the supervisor (Team Leader)

The university may also have its own doctor check the certificate. A good-conduct certificate from the head of the institution last attended or served is required, unless the candidate is an employee of this university. A No Court Case Certificate from the competent authority must be submitted at the time of joining.

content_sections.heading: CUS Associate Professor and Professor Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must meet the eligibility criteria on or before the last date for receipt of applications. A: An eminent scholar with a PhD degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline and published work of high quality. You must be actively engaged in research, with at least 10 research publications in peer-reviewed/UGC-listed journals and a total Academic/Research Score of 120 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Regulations, 2018. At least ten years of teaching experience in a university/college as Assistant Professor/Associate Professor/Professor, and/or research experience at an equivalent level at a University/National Level Institution, with evidence of having successfully guided doctoral candidates. B: An outstanding professional with a PhD degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline, from any academic institution (not included in A) or from industry. You must have made significant contributions to knowledge in the discipline, supported by documentary evidence, and have ten years' experience. A good academic record, with a PhD degree in the concerned/allied/relevant discipline. A Master's Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale, wherever the grading system is followed). At least eight years of teaching and/or research experience in an academic/research position equivalent to Assistant Professor in a University, College or Accredited Research Institution/industry. At least seven (07) publications in peer-reviewed/UGC-listed journals and a total academic/research score of 75 as per Appendix II, Table 2 of the UGC Regulations, 2018. For both posts, publications will be judged in light of UGC Public Notice F. No. 1-1/2018(CARE/JOURNAL) dated 16.07.2025. Papers in predatory or dubious journals, and presentations at predatory or dubious conferences, earn no academic credit. PhD holders who obtained their Master's Degree before 19 September 1991 may get a 5% relaxation, from 55% to 50%. On the UGC seven-point scale, grade "B" counts as equal to 55%: If your postgraduate degree or PhD is from a foreign university, you must enclose an Equivalence Certificate from the Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi. Without it, the application will be rejected. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee can be paid only through the payment-gateway link on the university website. It is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applicants will be screened using the shortlisting criteria in the UGC Regulations 2018/University norms. Screening is based on what you enter in the online form. If any information turns out to be false or wrong at any stage, your candidature will be rejected. Each Academic/Research (API) score must be backed by documentary evidence in the Performance Based Appraisal System (PBAS) Proforma. Claims without evidence will not be counted. Shortlisted candidates attend an interview and must produce original documents on age, qualifications, experience, fitness and any other claims. No TA/DA is paid for attending.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be on probation for the period set by UGC norms. Terms of appointment follow the Srinagar and Jammu Cluster Universities Act, 2016, its Statutes and Regulations, and the rules of the UGC and the Government of Jammu and Kashmir, where applicable. Where the university has no service rules of its own, the rules of the Government of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir apply. The university may verify your character, antecedents and documents at any time, including during service. Services will be terminated at once if documents are found to be fake or a background has been hidden.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUS Associate Professor and Professor Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Documents and other rules: Self-attest every enclosure and attach them in the order of the serial numbers generated in the form. Mark page numbers on all supporting documents, matching the application form. Fill the PBAS proforma with each publication's details: title, journal/book, volume, page numbers, year, ISSN/ISBN, authorship, refereed/indexed status and local/national/international status. Back each entry with evidence such as copies of publications, project sanction letters, utilisation and completion certificates, patent letters and students' Ph.D. award letters. If you claim a reserved category, include a valid category certificate from the Competent Authority. Include an AIU Equivalence Certificate if your degree is from a foreign university. Include a Relation certificate if any relative works in the university, giving their name, designation and department. Write your name exactly as it appears on your Matriculation/Higher Secondary certificate. If you are already employed, apply through proper channel. You should still send an advance copy with documents. The forwarded form must reach the university at least ten days before the interview, or you will not be called. To apply in more than one category, submit a separate application for each. Late or incomplete applications will not be accepted. Canvassing in any form disqualifies you.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Every application is screened for qualification and completeness. Complete applications are sorted, and suitable candidates are shortlisted for interview. Not every applicant may be called. The concerned Evaluation Committee holds the interviews and selects candidates based on criteria, performance and a qualitative assessment. Selected candidates are placed on a panel that stays valid for two years from the date it is created. OEA sends offers of engagement in order of merit, as and when it needs people.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is purely a contractual engagement for specific requirements or projects. It is full-time, and you may not take up any other assignment during the period. The initial period is 03 years, renewed every year based on a performance appraisal. It can be extended by up to 2 more years with the competent authority's approval. Place of posting: OEA, DPIIT, GPOA-3, Netaji Nagar, Bhikaji Cama Place, New Delhi - 110023. Working hours are normally 9 AM to 5.30 PM. When work demands, you may be asked to stay longer or to come in on Saturdays, Sundays and gazetted holidays. Paid leave builds up at 1.5 days for each completed month (18 days in a year) and cannot be carried forward. Female Junior Consultants and Consultants may be granted maternity leave of up to 26 weeks. For official tours, TA/DA and hotel accommodation are given as admissible to Central Government employees drawing grade pay of Rs. 5400/- (Junior Consultant) or Rs. 6600/- (Consultant). Either side can end the engagement with 30 days' notice or pay in lieu of notice. Police verification is required. If you are engaged urgently, you must submit the report within 02 months. You will be bound by the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923, and you need prior sanction before publishing or broadcasting anything on your assigned work. You will be an independent consultant, not a staff member of DPIIT. The engagement gives no right to a permanent or regular job.

content_sections.heading: About MZU
content_sections.text: Mizoram University is based in Aizawl, Mizoram. DRDO has signed an MoU with Mizoram University to set up the DRDO - Industry Academia Centre of Excellence, Mizoram University (DIA-CoE, MZU) for directed research. The centre works with academic researchers and faculty, start-ups, industries and other institutes in the country to support and advance technology research. It carries out multidisciplinary directed applied research in four areas: Agro Bio Resources for Soldier Survival, Harnessing Environment for Soldier Survival, Defence Waste Management and Human Cognition Studies.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Master's Degree in Engineering, Technology or Science from a recognized University 25 years of experience in technology domains/ defence (technical domain), but not limited to the above-mentioned technology areas PhD degree in Engineering, Technology or Science from a recognized University Wide-ranging experience and exposure to collaborative projects, setting up of large research facilities, strategic research planning and technology transfer Exposure to multi-mode projects across Labs/ Organizations/ Academia/ Industry interactions, with awareness of global developments in relevant areas for overall exposure Experience in the defence domain in research/ coordination and technology development/ deployment towards useful outcomes. Alternatively, a strong record of publications and patents, laboratory/ course development and/or other recognized relevant professional activities leading to defence or related technology development in the country. Exposure to Academic and Industry oriented research/ coordination towards realization of technology/ systems Applicants must be below 62 years of age as on the closing date of receipt of applications, which is 26 November 2026. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Accommodation: Mizoram University may provide accommodation if MZU Quarters are available on the Mizoram University Campus. Medical: The Health Centre at Mizoram University will provide medical facilities. Nature of appointment: This is a full-time contract position. The initial appointment is for 3 years. Extension: The competent authority can extend the period by 2 more years, subject to a performance review. Early exit: Either side may end the position before 3 years by giving 3 months' notice, without giving a reason. Joining: The selected candidate must submit a declaration to join the post within 30 days of the appointment letter being issued.

basic_details.short_information: The National Institute of Hydrology (NIH), Roorkee will hold a walk-in interview for Project Associate-I on 16 November 2026 at 11:00 AM at NIH, Roorkee. The notice is Advertisement No. Advt.67/10/2026-NIH(Admn.), dated 23 October 2026. There is 1 post under the ANRF PM ECRG project. The pay is Rs.37,000/- p.m. + HRA for candidates selected through NET or GATE, or through a national-level examination, and Rs.30,000/- + HRA for others.

age_limit.details: The maximum age for Project Associate-I is 30 years as on the date of interview (16 November 2026).

qualification.details: The Project Associate-I post serves the ANRF PM ECRG project titled "Geochemical and isotopic fingerprinting of hydrological, hydro meteorological and hydrogeological processes sustaining Yamuna river". The place of posting is NIH, Roorkee. The notice advertises 1 post. It also says the number of posts may increase or decrease depending on the project. | The essential qualification is printed as: "Bachelor's Degree or Master's Degree in Geology/Applied Geology/Geochemistry/Earth Sciences or its allied subjects". The notice says professionals with the required qualifications and experience will be eligible for appointment. Before the walk-in interview, candidates must make sure they are eligible in the required field. For the full eligibility of the post, see the official notification. | The maximum age for Project Associate-I is 30 years as on the date of interview (16 November 2026). | HRA is paid on top of the pay. The selected candidate will not get any allowance such as Dearness Allowance, Residential Telephone, Transport facility or Personal Staff. Transit accommodation may be given under the institute's rules, and the licence fee for it will be charged. The accommodation must be vacated when the appointment ends or the tenure expires, whichever is earlier.

important_instructions: The appointment is for one year and is likely to be extended until the project closes in June 2029. Selected candidates will be engaged for a fixed period to provide high-quality services to the institute for specific, time-bound jobs. The appointment is full-time. The appointee may not take up any other assignment during the consultancy with NIH. The appointment is purely temporary and co-terminus. It gives no claim, implicit or explicit, to any NIH post, and the institute can cancel it at any time without giving a reason. No TA/DA will be paid for joining the appointment, which is on a contract basis. The selected candidate will get TA/DA for official travel within India.

content_sections.heading: DIAT Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are required to perform specific roles according to their departments and specializations: Post Code 01 (Professor - School of Quantum Technology): Expertise in developing methods and devices for high sensitivity quantum sensing of magnetic fields, rotation, and gravity; design and development of advanced experimental platforms for quantum optics and quantum technologies, and advanced training based on them; expertise in quantum sensing and metrology with atomic vapours and laser-cooled atoms; quantum sensing with non-invasive quantum measurements and weak measurements; experience in precision optical and interferometric measurements. Post Code 02 (Assistant Professor - Aerospace Engineering & Autonomous Systems): UAV Design / Aircraft Design / Missile Design : UAV/Drone Design and Development, Aircraft Conceptual and preliminary Design, Missile configuration and System Design, Multidisciplinary Design Optimization. Post Code 03 (Assistant Professor - Electronics Engineering): VLSI & Embedded System / Semiconductor IC Design/Hardware Security. Post Code 04 (Assistant Professor - Joint appointment, Electronics Engineering jointly with School of Defence Technology & Management): Communication (Digital / Wireless / Mobile / Satellite) Electronic Warfare/ Advanced Modulation and Coding. Post Code 05 (Assistant Professor - Joint appointment, School of Defence Technology & Management jointly with Aerospace Engineering & Autonomous Systems): Advanced UAV design & integration, counter UAV technologies, simulation & autonomous navigation, Proficiency in software-in-the-Loop and Hardware-in-the-Loop simulation, Autonomous flight control algorithms, Prognostics and Health management for UAVs. Post Code 06 (Professor of Practice - Aerospace Engineering and Autonomous Systems): Area of Specialization: Missile Guidance and Control, Aircraft Control and Control of Robotic Systems. Essential Expertise: Working and research experience in the areas of missile, aircraft and robotic control. Post Code 07 (Professor of Practice - Electronics Engineering): Area of Specialization: SONAR system design, Radar systems, SONAR / Radar signal processing, Underwater acoustic communication, Array signal processing, Communication systems, EMI/EMC, Hardware security & cryptology, VLSI & Embedded systems, Semiconductor IC design, Electronic warfare, Detection and estimation theory. Essential Expertise: Working, research and hands-on experience in any of the above areas.

content_sections.heading: DFCCIL Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Planning and monitoring enroute examination of IR stock and maintenance of DFC owned rolling stock in co-ordination with IR. Co-ordinate for safe & trouble-free working of crew on DFC network in co-ordination with IR. Develop and implement strategies for locomotive troubleshooting. Co-ordination with IR for restoration work in case of accidents, derailments or liquidation of IR stock marked sick on DFC network. Develop emergency response team/equipment for early restoration of traffic in case of rolling stock defect enroute. Planning and deployment of wayside equipment/diagnostic technologies, preferably AI driven technologies for rolling stock. Data analytics captured through DFIS, FMM, FOIS, SLAM, CMS to formulate and implement strategies to minimise failures and detentions of rolling stock on DFC network. Maintenance and calibration of EFWMBs wherever applicable.

content_sections.heading: AFMS SSC Medical Officer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection involves NEET PG-based shortlisting, interview, medical examination and preparation of separate male and female final merit lists . Online application and eligibility scrutiny. Shortlisting using calculated NEET PG marks. Viva-voce / Personal Interview. Special Medical Examination Board. Final merit list preparation. Joining instructions for medically fit candidates selected against available vacancies. AFMS converts the candidate's NEET PG percentile into a score out of 200 for interview shortlisting. Calculated NEET PG Marks = NEET PG Percentile × 2 The above values are illustrative applications of the official calculation formula, not actual selection cut-offs. If the original NEET PG result was declared using an absolute score, AFMS will first determine the percentile based on the candidate's merit position and then calculate the equivalent marks out of 200. Separate shortlisting lists are prepared for male and female candidates. The interview carries a maximum of 50 marks , including weightage for the highest applicable NCC certificate. Only the highest eligible NCC certificate is considered. Candidates cannot add the marks for A, B and C certificates together. Candidates must obtain at least 50% of the interview marks , equivalent to 25 out of 50, to qualify for further consideration. Qualifying in the interview does not automatically guarantee selection or commissioning. The final merit list combines the calculated NEET PG marks out of 200 and interview marks out of 50, giving a maximum combined score of 250. Separate male and female merit lists are prepared. Joining instructions are issued to selected candidates who are declared medically fit, according to the available vacancies.

content_sections.heading: About NDC
content_sections.text: The National Defence College is located at 6 - Tees January Marg, New Delhi and functions under the Ministry of Defence, Government of India. The Consultant (SME) will support the NDC course, and according to the Terms of Reference the Consultant engaged at NDC would be working as Senior Directing Staff for all practical purposes.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Qualification: NDC course or equivalent, with expertise in National Security & Strategies. Profile: The candidate must be a practitioner-scholar with preferably a PhD degree, an outstanding professional record within national security establishments, and a distinguished academic and publishing record. Additional qualifying requirements: Necessary teaching and research assignments in India and/or abroad. Knowledge and ability: Candidates would need to demonstrate a sound knowledge of the national security system and possess the ability to suitably mentor operational practitioners undergoing the NDC course. Age limit: Age of the candidate should not be more than 65 years as on 31 December 2027. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The maximum monthly remuneration of the Consultant (SME), depending upon pay level, is Rs 65,000/- (Rupees Sixty-Five Thousand only) to Rs. 80,000/- (Rupees Eighty Thousand only). TDS as admissible will be deducted from the monthly remuneration, and the concerned Drawing and Disbursing Officer will issue a TDS certificate on demand.

content_sections.heading: NDC Consultant (SME) Job Description
content_sections.text: Under the Terms of Reference (Annexure-II), the Consultant (SME) would be expected to carry out the following minimum tasks: Conduct Integrated Analysis Group (IAG) meetings. Conduct one of the modules as assigned by the College. Guide the Course Members (up to a maximum of 18 members) assigned to him/her in selection of topics, completion of thesis and their internal evaluation/assessment, including viva voce. Attend selected lectures, panel discussions and presentations conducted as part of training activity and promulgated in the weekly training programme of NDC. Assess all written assignments submitted by the assigned Course Members, including recommendation for publication in NDC Journal. Supervise presentations given by the assigned Course Members. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications completed in all respects will be screened by a Screening-cum-Selection Committee of three members: the Commandant, NDC (Chairman), the Senior most Senior Directing Staff, NDC (Member) and the Secretary, NDC (Member). content_sections.text: Tenure is 01 (One) year or attainment of 70 years of age, whichever is earlier, from the date of joining. Yearly extension is possible up to another 02 (Two) years on the same terms and pay, on satisfactory performance, willingness, conduct and the Institution's requirement. The selected candidate must apply for extension every year. Absence beyond 07 (Seven) days without proper permission amounts to voluntary abandonment and automatic termination. Teaching faculty must mark attendance manually and on the Aadhaar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily. Monthly pay is paid as per AEBAS attendance. Either side may terminate the engagement with one month's prior notice without assigning reason. On spot resignation, one month's salary is to be deposited to the ESIC Account through Challan. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining. No claim to PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance/Benefits, Seniority, Promotion etc. is admissible. Leave of 2.5 (Two and a Half) days may be availed for each completed month of work, with pre-approval of the Competent Authority. faq.question: Q1. What is MGUVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: MGUVV Recruitment 2026 is an official recruitment drive conducted by Mahatma Gandhi Udyanikee Evam Vanikee Vishwavidyalaya, Durg, Chhattisgarh, to hire eligible candidates for 50 vacant posts of Dean, Assistant Professor, and Assistant Librarian.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in MGUVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 50 vacancies are available, comprising 2 posts for Dean, 40 posts for Assistant Professor across various disciplines, and 8 posts for Assistant Librarian.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for MGUVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 14 November 2026 up to 17:30 hrs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates require a Master's Degree in the concerned discipline with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) with a good academic record, along with passing the NET examination conducted by ICAR/UGC/CSIR (or holding a Ph.D. as per UGC regulations).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Assistant Professor and Assistant Librarian posts?
faq.answer: The applicant's age shall not be more than 35 years for the post of Assistant Professor/Assistant Librarian, with age relaxations applicable for bonafide residents of Chhattisgarh belonging to SC, ST, OBC, women, and Divyang categories as per C.G. Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Dean post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment to the post of Dean shall be 62 years as on the last date for submission of application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for UR and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for UR and OBC candidates, while it is Rs. 500/- for SC and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for MGUVV Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official university website at mguvv.ac.in by filling out the application form, uploading necessary certificates and documents, and paying the required fee online.

faq.question: Q9. Is the post of Dean permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment to the post of Dean is on a tenure basis for a period up to 05 years or till attaining the age of superannuation (62 years), whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. What are the selection criteria and scorecard weightage for Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a scorecard system totaling 100 marks, which includes educational qualifications and examinations passed (55 marks), academic excellence (10 marks), performance in co-curricular activities (02 marks), publications/research excellence (08 marks), experience (05 marks), knowledge of agro-ecological/climatic conditions of Chhattisgarh (05 marks), and personal interview by the selection committee (15 marks).

The rules and regulations of National Law University Delhi apply to the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi IPR Chair Professor Job Description
content_sections.text: Promote teaching, research and capacity-building in Intellectual Property (IP) at the University. Develop and strengthen IP curricula across academic programmes, foster high-quality research, and contribute to building an IP knowledge base, including through engagement with global best practices. Facilitate collaborations with academic institutions, industry and other stakeholders. Support policy-oriented research and inputs on IP-related issues. Undertake outreach and awareness activities, mentor students and researchers, and publish regularly on relevant platforms.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted based on an evaluation of their application contents. Shortlisting does not guarantee an interview or final selection. Only shortlisted candidates are contacted for an interview, and the details will be communicated separately. A 3-member Committee of eminent persons, constituted by the Vice-Chancellor, reviews the applications and submits its recommendation to DPIIT. The University may also decide shortlisting on other criteria. Its decision on eligibility, shortlisting and selection is final and binding, and no correspondence will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The qualifications for Principal (other than Education, Physical Education and Medical Colleges) follow the UGC regulations and their subsequent amendments as adopted by the University of Delhi. An applicant must have: Ph.D. Degree. Professor/Associate Professor with a total service/experience of at least fifteen years of teaching/research in universities, Colleges and other institutions of higher education. A minimum of 10 research publications in UGC Care List and SCOPUS Publications. A minimum of 110 Research Score as per Annexure V.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay: Academic Pay Level 14 of the 7th Central Pay Commission Pay Matrix. A College Principal is appointed for a period of five years, extendable for another term of five years on the basis of performance assessment by a committee appointed by the University. The assessment committee for the second term consists of a nominee of the Vice-Chancellor and a nominee of the Chairman, UGC, chosen from Principals of Colleges with Excellence, Colleges with Potential for Excellence, Autonomous Colleges or NAAC 'A' accredited Colleges. After completing the term, the incumbent joins back her/his parent organisation with the designation of Professor and in the grade of Professor. The College reserves the right to offer the post at a level lower than that advertised/applied, or on contract basis, depending upon qualifications, experience and performance, wherever applicable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DCAC Principal
content_sections.text: Applications with incomplete information or without the requisite fee are rejected. Fees once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Screening: a Screening Committee chaired by the Chairperson, Governing Body scrutinises all applications, lists the candidates who meet the minimum eligibility and awards points on the criteria notified by the University. At least three members form the quorum. Shortlisting: applications are screened under the screening guidelines; the minimum points for shortlisting are given in those guidelines. Interview by the College Selection Committee: the committee (with Governing Body members, Vice-Chancellor's nominees, Higher Education experts and subject experts; five members including two experts form the quorum) prepares the list of selected and waitlisted candidates in order of merit on the day of the meeting. University Selection Committee: the Vice Chancellor, Pro-Vice-Chancellor, a Nominee of the Visitor, the Chairman of the Governing Body and two Executive Council members consider the list. If none of the applicants is considered suitable, the post shall be re-advertised. Appointment by the Governing Body as per Ordinance XVII of the University. The score is based on evidence such as copies of publications, project sanction letters, utilisation and completion certificates, patent letters and students' Ph.D. award letters. Selected items as printed: Publications 'under submission' or submitted to referees are not counted, and every item claimed must strictly follow the screening guidelines. All testimonials/certificates in original along with photo ID. One set of photocopies of certificates/testimonials on the qualifications and experience given in the online form, self-certified by the applicant. No Objection Certificate from the employer for applicants serving in Government/Public Sector Undertakings (including Boards/Autonomous Bodies), if not uploaded with the online application.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post of Professor carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 3,05,000/- per month. The post of Associate Professor carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 2,55,000/- per month. The post of Assistant Professor carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,95,000/- per month. The emoluments for the post of Specialist Grade - III will be as per revised pay rules Level 11 (Pay Rs. 67,700/- plus admissible allowances per month) and as per rules approved by the Governing Council of JSSH. Specialist Grade - I posts carry a Pay Scale of Rs. 15600-39100 + Grade Pay 6600/- plus allowances as per Contractual engagement terms and conditions of Delhi Government. The appointment of teaching faculty shall be on contract basis for an initial period of 03 years, extendable further for another 02 years, with extension based on annual performance appraisal report up to the age of superannuation in the Government of Delhi. The appointment of Specialist Gr. III and Specialist Grade - I shall be initially on contract for a period of five years with a notice period of three month from either side for severance of contract.

how_to_apply: Candidates must complete the online application and ensure that the signed printed application with supporting documents reaches the DTU Recruitment Cell before the separate hard-copy deadline.
Visit the official Delhi Technological University website at www.dtu.ac.in.
Locate Advertisement No. 05/2026 for Professor and Associate Professor recruitment.
Read the advertisement and applicable discipline-specific Recruitment Rules.
Prepare Annexure-II and calculate the required Academic/Research Score.
Open the online application facility and complete the required application details.
Select the appropriate post, discipline and reservation category.
Enter the prescribed educational qualifications, experience, publications and research achievements.
Upload the required photograph, signature and supporting documents.
Complete online payment of the applicable application fee.
Review all entries carefully and submit the online application by 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
Download and print the completed application form and Annexure-II.
Sign each page of the printed application and Annexure-II.
Attach self-attested copies of the relevant certificates, research evidence and fee receipt.
Place all required documents in a single sealed envelope.
Send or deliver the envelope to the DTU Recruitment Cell so that it reaches by 21 December 2026 at 5:00 PM.
Multiple Disciplines: Candidates applying for more than one discipline must submit separate online applications and pay the prescribed fee for each discipline.
Application Correction Warning: Once an online application has been submitted, changes or corrections, including category changes, are not permitted.
important_instructions: Only eligible experience and research achievements supported by the required documents will be considered.

Eligible teaching experience includes regular faculty service or qualifying contract/ad hoc faculty service at the equivalent level in recognized higher education institutions, subject to the prescribed minimum commitment.
Industrial experience must be in an equivalent management-level position in an eligible organization.

Experience is counted from the date the applicant becomes eligible under the Recruitment Rules. The notification specifies a minimum commitment of 11 months per year and does not count individual employment periods shorter than six months.

Eligible research experience in R&D organizations or institutions is considered under the notified scoring criteria. The duration of a full-time PhD programme is excluded from the prescribed research-experience calculation.
Only publications already published online or offline by 7 December 2026 will be considered.
Research papers submitted, under peer review or accepted but not published by the closing date will not receive assessment points.
OBC candidates from outside Delhi who do not satisfy the notified Delhi OBC eligibility conditions and candidates belonging to the creamy layer must apply under the Unreserved category.
The required OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate must be issued on or after 1 April 2026 and no later than 7 December 2026.

EWS applicants must possess the required Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2026-27, based on income for financial year 2025-26, according to the prescribed Government of Delhi conditions.
PwBD reservation operates horizontally across the applicable vertical categories. Candidates must meet the identified disability suitability requirements for the selected discipline.
Only candidates possessing the required valid benchmark disability certificates will be considered for the applicable PwBD reservation benefits.

Candidates must be Indian citizens. Applications must be submitted online before 7 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. The printed application and supporting documents must reach DTU by 21 December 2026 at 5:00 PM. No corrections are allowed after online application submission. Separate applications and fees are required for separate disciplines. Only eligible experience, qualifications and research achievements supported by documents will be assessed. All recruitment stages involving verification, presentation and interview require personal attendance. Online document verification, presentation or interview is not permitted. Photographs must be recent, clear, in colour and taken against a plain white or off-white background. Applicants serving in Government departments, autonomous bodies or universities must apply through the proper channel. No travelling or daily allowance will be provided for document verification, presentation or interview. Updates and selection-related communication will be published on the DTU website or sent to the registered email address.

content_sections.heading: DTU Research Score Requirements 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the minimum research score specified for their post and provide evidence supporting all claimed research achievements. The notification identifies the following activities for calculating academic and research scores. Research papers published in eligible indexed or approved journals. Books authored and eligible translation works. Innovative teaching pedagogy, curricula, MOOCs and electronic content. Research guidance and completed or ongoing research projects. Consultancy activities. Patents, policy documents, awards and fellowships. Invited lectures, seminars, conferences and eligible conference publications. The detailed score must be calculated according to Annexure-II and the criteria referenced from the UGC Notification dated 18 July 2018.

content_sections.heading: DTU Academic and Research Screening Score 2026
content_sections.text: The university evaluates candidates using Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance scores for shortlisting. The academic record is initially assessed using a 50-point schedule and scaled down to 20 points. Experience and research performance are initially assessed using a separate 50-point schedule and scaled down to 40 points. Important: The detailed marks awarded for publications, patents, research projects and related achievements depend on authorship, publication category, project value and other criteria in the notification. Candidates must calculate the score using the prescribed table rather than claiming the maximum points automatically.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: DTU will select candidates through eligibility screening, academic and research evaluation, document and point verification, teaching presentation and interview. Online application and submission of the required printed documents. Initial scrutiny under the discipline-specific Recruitment Rules. Publication of provisional eligibility lists. Consideration of candidates' representations, where applicable. Shortlisting based on Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance scores. Original Document and Point Mark Verification. Presentation assessing teaching aptitude and ability. Interview evaluating domain knowledge and interview performance. Final selection according to the prescribed assessment criteria. The university normally calls 10 candidates for the first vacancy and five candidates for each subsequent vacancy for interview, subject to recruitment requirements. Shortlisting for document verification is based on the combined 60-point score for Academic Record and Experience and Research Performance. Candidates tied at the shortlisting cut-off may also be included in the provisional shortlist according to the notification. Candidates shortlisted for verification must produce original certificates and relevant supporting evidence for the academic and research points claimed. If a candidate has not uploaded or attached evidence for a claimed assessment component, the university will award zero points for that component. Candidates unable to produce the required original documents will not be permitted to participate in the presentation and interview stages. Candidates successfully completing document and point verification must attend: Presentation: Assessment of teaching aptitude and ability. Interview: Assessment of domain knowledge and interview performance. Final selection takes account of academic record, experience, research performance, teaching aptitude, domain knowledge and interview performance.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Experience and Publication Assessment Rules
content_sections.text: Only eligible experience and research achievements supported by the required documents will be considered. Eligible teaching experience includes regular faculty service or qualifying contract/ad hoc faculty service at the equivalent level in recognized higher education institutions, subject to the prescribed minimum commitment. Industrial experience must be in an equivalent management-level position in an eligible organization. Experience is counted from the date the applicant becomes eligible under the Recruitment Rules. The notification specifies a minimum commitment of 11 months per year and does not count individual employment periods shorter than six months. Eligible research experience in R&D organizations or institutions is considered under the notified scoring criteria. The duration of a full-time PhD programme is excluded from the prescribed research-experience calculation. Only publications already published online or offline by 7 December 2026 will be considered. Research papers submitted, under peer review or accepted but not published by the closing date will not receive assessment points.
