content_sections.text: Candidates must complete the online application and ensure that the signed printed application with supporting documents reaches the DTU Recruitment Cell before the separate hard-copy deadline. Multiple Disciplines: Candidates applying for more than one discipline must submit separate online applications and pay the prescribed fee for each discipline. Application Correction Warning: Once an online application has been submitted, changes or corrections, including category changes, are not permitted.

content_sections.text: The completed printed application, Annexure-II and prescribed documents must be sent to: The Recruitment Cell Room No. 818, 8th Floor, AB-3 Block, Delhi Technological University, Shahbad Daulatpur, Bawana Road, Delhi - 110042. Last Date for Receipt: 21 December 2026, up to 5:00 PM. content_sections.heading: Documents Required for DTU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Printed online application form, signed on each page. Completed Annexure-II, signed on each page. Self-attested educational qualification certificates and marksheets. Relevant teaching, research or industrial experience certificates. SC/ST/OBC/EWS category certificate, if applicable. PwBD certificate, if applicable. Front page of PhD thesis. Front pages of research publications. Documents supporting research-score and academic-score claims. Research project sanction letters and completion certificates, where applicable. Evidence supporting patents, awards, research guidance and other claimed achievements. Online application fee receipt or proof of payment. Equivalent qualification recognition certificate, where applicable. Other documents specified under the selected discipline's eligibility conditions. Candidates should retain the original documents for in-person document and point verification.

content_sections.heading: DTU Recruitment 2026 Reservation Rules
content_sections.text: OBC candidates from outside Delhi who do not satisfy the notified Delhi OBC eligibility conditions and candidates belonging to the creamy layer must apply under the Unreserved category. The required OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate must be issued on or after 1 April 2026 and no later than 7 December 2026. EWS applicants must possess the required Income and Asset Certificate for financial year 2026-27, based on income for financial year 2025-26, according to the prescribed Government of Delhi conditions. PwBD reservation operates horizontally across the applicable vertical categories. Candidates must meet the identified disability suitability requirements for the selected discipline. Only candidates possessing the required valid benchmark disability certificates will be considered for the applicable PwBD reservation benefits.

content_sections.heading: About JMI Faculty of Dentistry
content_sections.text: The Faculty of Dentistry is a faculty of Jamia Millia Islamia, a university in New Delhi (PIN 110025). This notice offers the one-year BDS internship there to students from other dental institutions. The internship is run under the Ordinances of Jamia Millia Islamia.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application form attached to the notice and submit it with the required documents to this address: Office of the Dean, Faculty of Dentistry, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi-110025. The deadline is 16 November 2026, 04:00 PM. The notice says the Institute will not be responsible for any delay in postal delivery or in delivery through any other agency, so the application has to reach the office by that time. The notice does not say what to write on the envelope. The application form has these parts: Personal details: name of the student, father's name, date of birth, nationality, religion, marital status, whether you belong to OBC/SC/ST, address for correspondence, email ID and mobile number. Academic details: the name and full address of the institution where you are doing the BDS Programme, the name and address of the affiliated university, the date you joined the BDS Programme and the date you passed the final BDS Examination. Reason and documents: your reason for seeking internship at Jamia, and a list of the documents and certificates you have attached (you may add extra sheets). Detail of BDS Examination Passed: for each year (I, II, III and Final) and each paper (Paper No. I to VIII), give the subject name, the number of extra attempts, the percentage of marks in the subject and any distinction or medal in the subject. Then give the overall percentage. Photo and undertaking: paste a self-attested photograph on the form, then sign the undertaking and write your name in block letters. In the undertaking you declare that your statements are true. If facts are found to be hidden or misrepresented at any stage, your candidature for internship may be cancelled without any liability on Jamia Millia Islamia.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The JMI internship has 11 vacant seats for external candidates for the academic session 2026–2027. Eligibility and terms, as printed in the notice: Educational qualification: passed the final BDS Examination on or before 15.11.2026. Recognition of the parent institution: your parent institution must certify that it is recognised by the National Dental Commission (formerly DCI). It must also certify that it was not de-recognised by the National Dental Commission at any time from your admission until you passed out. University permission: you need permission from the university your college is affiliated to. Stipend: the prescribed stipend of ₹3000/- only per month. Training fee: ₹1,75,000/- (Rs. One Lakh and seventy five thousand only), paid only if you are selected. Pay it by Demand Draft in favour of "Registrar, JMI", payable at New Delhi, before the internship starts. The fee will be non-refundable after the training period starts. Duration: one year, as per the NDC guideline. Part internship is not permissible, and selected candidates undertake not to ask for an extension of the internship period. Rules: the internship is governed by the provisions of the Ordinances of Jamia Millia Islamia. For the full eligibility conditions, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attach these documents to the application. They come from the notice and its checklist of documents: An application giving your reasons for wanting to do the internship at the Faculty of Dentistry, JMI, with documentary proof. Self-attested photocopies of the marksheets of all BDS Annual Examinations (each part/year). An attempt certificate issued by the University/College, showing the number of attempts and the percentage of marks in each part/year. A No Objection Certificate from your parent institution, covering its recognition as described above. Permission from the university your college is affiliated to, allowing you to do the internship at the Faculty of Dentistry, JMI, subject to selection. A certificate of good character and conduct from your parent institution. Documentary evidence of any distinction or medal awarded in any subject in a University Examination. An undertaking with three parts: (a) you are prepared to do the internship on the stipend of ₹3000/- per month and will deposit ₹1,75,000/- as the fee if selected; (b) you will follow the rules and regulations of the Faculty of Dentistry, JMI's internship program and will not ask for an extension; (c) you will maintain good conduct, discipline and decorum, and you accept that the University authorities have the right to expel you for misconduct, indiscipline or unsatisfactory work without any liability on the University. Two photographs: one self-attested, pasted on the application form, and one without attestation. The checklist page has a "Mark √ or X" column for each document.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under SVNIT Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 tentative vacancies for the post of Professor, distributed as 01 for UR, 01 for SC, and 03 for ST across 12 departments.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for SVNIT Professor?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 2 December 2026 up to 5:00 p.m., and the hard copy must reach the institute by 9 December 2026 (5:00 p.m.).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for SVNIT Professor?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline with first class (or at least 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale / 60% marks) in all preceding degrees from Bachelor's onwards.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SVNIT Professor posts?
faq.answer: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged, except for candidates with exceptional research and ongoing or approved externally funded research projects.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay scale for SVNIT Professor?
faq.answer: The post is placed in Pay Level 14A of the Pay Matrix, with basic pay ranging between ₹159,100 and ₹220,200 per month along with admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Who is exempted from paying the SVNIT Professor application fee?
faq.answer: SC, ST, PwD, female candidates, and faculty members of SVNIT Surat are completely exempted from paying the application processing fee.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for SVNIT Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises scrutiny of applications and shortlisting, followed by a departmental presentation/seminar and a personal interview before the selection committee.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply as a new entrant under the inbreeding rule?
faq.answer: Candidates who obtained their Ph.D. from SVNIT Surat must have a minimum gap of three years between Ph.D. notification and the application deadline, unless they are already faculty members at SVNIT Surat.

faq.question: Q9. Which documents must be dispatched with the printed application form?
faq.answer: Applicants must send the signed application form, credit point summary sheet, educational marksheets and degree certificates, experience certificates, caste/disability proof, credit point proofs, and fee receipt.

All appointments in Pay Level 12 are made on probation for a period of one year.

content_sections.heading: About C.R. College of Education Rohtak
content_sections.text: Chhotu Ram College of Education, Rohtak describes itself as recognised by the NCTE, Haryana Government aided and affiliated to M.D. University, Rohtak. The college is run and managed by Jat Education Society (Regd.), Rohtak-124001 (Haryana), whose President, Gulab Singh, is the President of the college's Governing Body. The Director General Higher Education (DGHE), Haryana granted approval to fill the vacant post of Principal (General) through Memo No. 8/27-2026 C(IV) (1) dated 06/10/2026.

faq.answer: The advertisement is for the single vacant post of Principal (General) at Chhotu Ram College of Education, Rohtak.

All degrees acquired by the applicant must be from an Institute / University recognized by the UGC/AICTE/AIU/GOI. All applicants shall have a Ph.D. in the relevant or equivalent discipline and First Class in the preceding degrees (Bachelor's Degree onwards). In case First Class is not mentioned in the preceding degrees by the University/Institution, candidates should have passed and secured at least 6.5 CGPA (on a 10-point scale) or 60% marks in aggregate. Conversion from CGPA to percentage or vice versa given by an individual Institute/University will not be considered or allowed for determination of eligibility. | Other Essential Requirements: None. Additional Desirable Requirements: 01 or more patents; supervising two or more students for Ph.D.; strong liaison with industry; offering courses through application of ICT. | For Engineering: B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent and M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in the relevant discipline. Candidates possessing a Ph.D. directly after B.Tech./B.E. from reputed institutions are also considered provided they have First Class at the Bachelor's level. For Mathematics: First Class at both UG and PG levels (60% marks or 6.5/10 CGPA) with Ph.D. in the relevant discipline. Countable Experience: Only experience rendered on a regular basis in applicable pay scales as per UGC, AICTE, Government of India, or PSUs is counted. Experience rendered on part-time, ad-hoc, daily wage, visiting, guest faculty, fixed remuneration, contractual, or temporary basis will not be considered. Equal Treatment: There shall be no distinction between external and internal candidates with regard to the requirements of qualification and experience. Age Limit: Fresh appointment beyond the age of 60 years is discouraged except in the case of faculty with an exceptionally brilliant research career and with an ongoing or approved externally funded research project. The crucial date for determining eligibility and preferred age limit is 21 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Sonepat Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Information Technology Sonepat is an Institute of National Importance established in 2014 under the provisions of the Indian Institute of Information Technology PPP- Act, 2017. The institute has its permanent campus at Kilohrad, Sonepat, and operates from its office at IIT Delhi Sonepat Campus, I-Tech Technopark Plot No 4 Rajiv Gandhi Education City, Rai, Sonipat, Haryana. The institute is dedicated to imparting high-quality technical education and cultivating a rigorous culture of innovation and research in Information Technology and its allied disciplines.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies for the post of Assistant Professor are advertised across Pay Levels 10, 11, and 12 without a predetermined number earmarked for any specific Pay Level. Candidates fulfilling the prescribed criteria may submit separate applications for each Pay Level. The institute also follows horizontal reservation in case of PwD candidates. Computer Science and Engineering / IT / CSE (DSA) / CSE (AI): Full Stack Development, Enterprise Java, Blockchain, High-Performance Computing, Industrial Internet of Things, Machine Learning, Advanced Data Structure and Algorithm, Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision, Data Analytics, Quantum Computing, Web Technologies, Generative AI. Electronics and Communication Engineering: VLSI, IoT, Embedded System, Quantum Computing, Semiconductor Devices, Visible Light Communication, 5G/6G & Wireless, RF Systems. Mathematics: Mathematics for Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Scientific Computing, Optimization Techniques, Computational Complexity, Numerical Linear Algebra.

content_sections.text: IIM Ranchi describes itself as an autonomous institution founded by the Ministry of Education, Government of India, in December 2009. For designation-wise shortlisting criteria for experience, the notice refers to the Ministry of Human Resources Development circular F.No.23-1/2008-TS.II dated August 18, 2009, September 16, 2009 and September 22, 2009. The research/teaching/industry experience is expected to be in a relevant area. All qualifications must be from a UGC recognized University/Deemed university or an AICTE approved autonomous institution (wherever applicable); courses from autonomous institutions should be equivalent to the relevant course approved/recognized by the Association of Indian Universities (AIU). content_sections.heading: BEEI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of duties and responsibilities for all the teacher posts: Set annual goals before the end of June every year and prepare an annual programme of work. Be present in the school 15 minutes before the commencement bell, attend the morning prayer and assist in maintaining discipline during it. Leave 15 minutes after the closure bell, after reporting to the HOI or Administrative Officer. Draw up daily lesson plans, study books relevant to the subject and use relevant teaching aids. Update computer skills and customised online teaching. Identify learning disabilities through diagnostic tests, chalk out a bridge course, and prepare an action plan and individual education plan (IEP) for remedial teaching. Engage classes as per the time table, with a lesson plan, so that students achieve the prescribed learning outcomes. Prepare a resourceful activity bank, use electronic media and facilitate participatory learning. Give meaningful homework, correct mistakes, guide needy students and report habitual defaulters to the HOI. Conduct periodical tests and examinations, evaluate performance, make entries in the marks card / SATS software, communicate with parents and help students who lag behind. Assist students to overcome mental blocks or other deficiencies by counselling or persuasive means, without resorting to punishment. Develop students' talents through programmes like elocution, essay writing, quiz, painting and sports meet, consulting the HOI / Administrative Officer. Be responsible for the overall academic and co-curricular performance of the class, completion of lessons, maintenance of registers and achievement of prescribed learning outcomes. Maintain the work done diary and documents pertaining to Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation. Attend meetings of the institution unless exempted by the Head of the Institution, and assist the HOI in carrying out the HOI's duties. Participate in all functions, programmes and developmental activities organised by the school. Resolve genuine grievances of students and parents. Conduct extra classes even on holidays if the prescribed syllabus is not taught within the stipulated period. Engage extra classes in the absence of teachers on leave or OOD, and special classes for remedial teaching when entrusted by the HOI. Do not skip practical classes in the respective subjects; maintain a logbook of practicals. Complete any other work entrusted by the Management Committee, Administrative Officer and HOI, working in team spirit. Co-operate with colleagues, subordinates, superiors, students and parents for the smooth completion of curriculum activities. Discharge any additional work entrusted by the HOI, higher ups or Management within the time frame.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Written Test for shortlisted candidates, followed by an Interview only for those who qualify in the Written Test. The written test carries 70% of the marks and the interview 30%. The venue for the written test and interview will be intimated through e-mail. Candidates who pass the written test will be called for interview in a 1:5 ratio. The names of candidates shortlisted for the written test or interview, and the final selections, will be notified on the BEEI website. Short listing is carried out purely on the information declared in the application form. Merely meeting the minimum qualification and experience gives no right to be called for the interview.

content_sections.heading: About NLSIU
content_sections.text: As per the notifications, the National Law School of India University (NLSIU) was established in 1987 to be a pioneer in legal education. Over the last three decades, the University has evolved as an innovative leader in law, social sciences, humanities, and public policy education and research in India. It has also been ranked first among the law universities in the National Institute Ranking Framework (NIRF) for the last eight years. The University invites applications from exceptionally well-qualified individuals dedicated to academic teaching, scholarship, and institutional service.

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 Notification-wise Details
content_sections.text: The HAL Defence Public Sector Chair was established in 2012 through an endowment corpus from Hindustan Aeronautics Limited. The key objective of the Chair is to expand teaching and research on relevant areas of business laws, which include contracts management, defence sector procurement, dispute settlement, and environmental compliance among other areas. The Chair further seeks to strengthen academic learning and pedagogy, contribute to policy dialogue and reform, foster a community of world class researchers and academics, facilitate training programmes, hold national and regional convenings, and produce high-impact legal research. The Chair will be part of a dedicated team of faculty members working to advance learning and scholarship in the areas of contract law, property law, and other areas of business law intersecting with the defence sector. The responsibilities include: Teaching Deliver undergraduate and postgraduate courses; Supervise student assignments, submissions, and thesis (as required); Evaluate students through examinations, presentations, and assignments as required. Research Contribute to designing and expanding the research agenda of the Chair; Publish in academic journals, books, and media platforms; Develop research proposals and grant applications; Organise guest lectures, public talks, and panel discussions on subject areas of the Chair as required; Develop training programmes in the areas of contracts, dispute resolution, negotiations etc. with special reference to defence sector; Conceptualize and organize an annual conference on defence sector laws; Participate in stakeholder meetings and contribute to policy and reform dialogues as required. Administrative Serve on university committees and provide other institutional services as required. The notification adds that serving under the Chair provides an excellent opportunity for emerging scholars to advance their research, demonstrate thought leadership in their field, and make meaningful contributions to evidence-based policy discussions and reform initiatives. As per the notification, NLSIU along with the Department of Revenue, Government of India, has established the Department of Revenue (DOR) to recognize scholars and teachers in the field of taxation law, anti-corruption, and foreign exchange regulation. The stated aim is to produce high quality research, strengthen pedagogy, engage in public policy dialogue and attract world class researchers and academicians to the University. The DOR Chair Assistant Professor is expected to perform the following functions: Contribute to teaching, research, and scholarship in taxation laws at the University; Conduct training and capacity building programmes including for DOR officials as required; Provide legal opinion and analysis on related laws to DOR officials as required; Render active support in all related topics as mutually agreed to with the primary objective of enhancing the knowledge and professional skills of DoR exe

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is defined through Appendix A of each notification, titled “Minimum Qualifications for Recruitment to Regular Posts of Teachers in the University (per UGC Regulations, 2018)”. All six notifications require the Essential Qualifications in Section I. The two permanent-post notifications (Nos. 20/2026 and 21/2026) additionally refer to Section II.1. The notifications also state that the prescribed essential qualifications/experience are the bare minimum, and that merely possessing them will not entitle a candidate to be called for an interview. The qualification should have been obtained from recognized Universities/Institutions.

rows.notification: 23/2026 – Assistant Professor (Humanities & Social Sciences), 5 Year Contract
24/2026 – HAL Defence Public Sector Chair, 5 Year Contract
25/2026 – Department of Revenue Chair, 5 Year Contract

content_sections.heading: NLSIU Assistant Professor Qualification
content_sections.text: A Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale, wherever the grading system is followed). A relaxation of 5% may be provided at the graduate and master’s level for the Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe and Differently abled categories for the purpose of eligibility and for assessing good academic record during direct recruitment to teaching positions. A relaxation of 5% may be provided to the Ph.D Degree holders who obtained their Master’s Degree prior to 19 September 1991. The eligibility marks of 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale prescribed by these regulations and the relaxation of 5% to the categories mentioned above are permissible, based on only the qualifying marks without including any grace mark procedures. Section II.1 is titled “Assistant Professor (Law)” in Notification No. 20/2026 and “Assistant Professor (Humanities & Social Sciences)” in Notification No. 21/2026. The conditions are the same in both and are given below as per the notifications. Option A: The candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET, subject to the following exemptions: OR Option B: The Ph.D degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among the top 500 in the World University Ranking (at any time) by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS), (ii) the Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) the Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai). Notification Nos. 22/2026, 23/2026, 24/2026 and 25/2026 refer only to Section I of Appendix A. Section II.1 (NET/Ph.D. conditions) is not referenced in these four notifications. Section II.1 does not form part of the Appendix A attached to them.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The pay structure is as per the 7th CPC. HRA is not admissible if accommodation is provided within the campus. The posts carry allowances such as D.A., H.R.A and Transport Allowance as per GoI rules, corresponding at present to those admissible to Central Government employees stationed at Indore. LTC, Children Education Allowance and contribution towards the New Pension Scheme (NPS) are permissible as per GoI rules. The position of Assistant Professor Grade II will be on contract basis; the notice prints no contract length. Cumulative Professional Development Allowance (CPDA): Rs. 3 lakh for every block period of 3 years, which may be made available on a reimbursable basis for conference papers, professional body fees and academic/research contingency expenditure. Relocation Allowance: up to Rs. 1,00,000 for faculty joining from abroad (air fare for self and spouse and transport of goods), and up to Rs. 75,000 for self, family and goods for those joining from within India. Tickets must be booked through IRCTC or authorised agents (M/s Balmer Lawrie & Company Limited, M/s Ashok Travels & Tours). Medical Facility: cashless OPD and IPD in leading hospitals in Indore and the Institute Health Centre, for employees and dependent family members. Children Education Allowance: for the two eldest school-going children, classes nursery to twelfth, at Rs. 2,812.5 per month per child as per GoI norms. Communication charges are reimbursed under Institute/GoI rules. Accommodation: on-campus accommodation may be provided in lieu of HRA, subject to availability. For the initial 21 days after joining, a Guest House/HoR stay may be provided, with a token Rs. 2500 paid by the occupant or deducted from HRA. Research grants: Young Faculty International Dream Lab Research Experience Grant up to Rs. 5 lakh; grant up to Rs. 5 lakh for research and innovation with undergraduate students; Research Seed Grant of Rs. 2 lakh for the 5 best technologies. The notice also mentions R&D facilities in all departments, a library, and campus facilities including a bank, post office, shopping centre, Kendriya Vidyalaya school, health centre and sports facilities.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes shortlisting followed by interview. The Institute reserves the right to call for interview only those candidates shortlisted on qualification, experience, research, publication records and the requirements of the individual academic school. It may set different as well as higher norms while shortlisting. Meeting the minimum qualifications does not guarantee shortlisting or an interview call. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted by email at the address given in the application form. Applicants called for interview in person must carry original certificates and self-attested copies, failing which the candidature would be disqualified. Applicants from abroad will, generally, be interviewed through video conferencing. Those from abroad who are in India at the time of the Selection committee meeting must attend in person if called.

Give full details of educational qualifications, including the year of obtaining Ph.D. and the date of defense certificate. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The remuneration is consolidated and covers NPA@20% (wherever applicable and admissible), DA@63%, HRA@20% and TA@7200+DA thereon. It may change as per Headquarters instructions. It is revised automatically when the Dearness Allowance rate is revised, effective from the date of notification of Government orders. Arrears are not admissible for any rate revision with retrospective effect. The tenure is 01 year, or joining of a regular incumbent, or attainment of 70 years of age, whichever is earlier. The institute intends to engage faculty for 01 year, extendable up to 3 years on satisfactory performance and functional requirement. Either side may end the engagement with one month's prior notice without assigning a reason. On spot resignation, one month's salary is to be deposited to the ESI Account through Challan. No claim to PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority or Promotion is admissible. Absence beyond 07 days without permission amounts to voluntary abandonment and automatic termination. Faculty and Senior Residents mark attendance manually and on the Aadhaar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily. Leave of 2.5 days is credited for each completed month, and no other leave is allowed. Sunday and holiday duty is by rotation. Selected candidates deposit Rs. 20,000/- as security deposit. It is forfeited if the candidate resigns or leaves within six months of joining, or is terminated by the institute. Candidates in patient care must hold a professional indemnity policy covering the contract period. The minimum sum assured per annum is Rs. 30 lakhs for Anaesthesiology, ENT, Eye, Medicine, Obstetrics & Gynaecology, Orthopaedics, Paediatrics, Surgery, Accident & Emergency, ICU, Cardiology, Medical Oncology, Nephrology, Gastroenterology, Neurology, Surgical Oncology, Urology, Rheumatology, Haematology and Anaesthesiology with Surgical Super Speciality. It is Rs. 20 lakhs for Chest and Rs. 10 lakhs for Biochemistry, Pathology, Microbiology, Dermatology, Radiology, Psychiatry and Dental. A copy of the policy and premium receipt must be submitted within 07 days of engagement, or service will be terminated. The contract is signed on a Non judicial stamp paper of Rs. 500/- or as applicable under the Stamp Act. The selected candidate brings the blank paper before joining, purchased between the date of issue of the result and the date of reporting.

faq.answer: No. You need a separate complete application and fee for each post or department. A single form covering more than one department is summarily rejected.

faq.question: Where do I send the hard copy?
faq.answer: Send it to The Registrar, Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune, PO – Talegaon, Pune, Maharashtra – 410507. It must arrive by 9 December 2026, 05:30 PM.

faq.question: I did my Ph.D. at IIIT Pune. Can I apply?
faq.answer: Only if you have 3 years of experience outside IIIT Pune after your Ph.D. This is the notice's in-breeding restriction.

faq.question: Will travel expenses be paid for the test or interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid for the written test, the presentation-cum-interview or any other stage at the Talegaon campus.

qualification.details: Eligibility follows the NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualifications (TEQ) guidelines 2025 and their latest amendments (National Medical Commission, Notification F.No.N-P051(12)/18/2024-PGMEB-MNC). The upper age limit for both posts is up to 70 years, as on 20 November 2026. Retired faculty and doctors from private medical colleges, Institutes of National Importance and other Government medical colleges within the country may apply as per the eligibility for each post. | (a)(i) Associate Professor in the subject for three years in a recognised medical institution; or (ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least three years of experience as Associate Professor in the relevant speciality in a teaching hospital of the Armed Forces; and (b)(i) at least two research publications after becoming Associate Professor, among the first three authors; (ii) Basic Course in Biomedical Research from a recognised medical institution completed; and (iii) Basic Course in Medical Education required, provided the broad specialty subject is covered under undergraduate training. Note 1: For Aviation Medicine and Marine Medicine, two years as Flying Squadron (Aviation) and two years in a Diving and Escape Training School (Marine Medicine) are considered equivalent to one year of teaching experience as Associate Professor. Note 2: A Senior Consultant with three years of experience as post graduate teacher of broad specialty or super specialty subject in a National Board of Examination in Medical Sciences recognised Government medical institute is eligible to become Professor in the concerned specialty. Total years as post graduate teacher in such an institute count as experience as Professor. | (a)(i) Assistant Professor in the subject for four years in a recognised medical institution, or five years for those appointed directly as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; or (ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least five years of clinical experience in the relevant specialty after the recognised Postgraduate qualification, of which at least three years as Assistant Professor in a teaching hospital of the Armed Forces; and (b)(i) at least two research publications after becoming Assistant Professor, among the first three authors; (ii) Basic Course in Biomedical Research from a recognised medical institution designated by the Commission; and (iii) Basic Course in Medical Education required, provided the broad specialty subject is covered under undergraduate training. Note: A non-teaching Consultant, Specialist or Medical Officer with a postgraduate medical degree and ten years of experience in at least a 220 bedded Government hospital is eligible to become Associate Professor of that broad specialty. On such appointment, the Basic Course in Medical Education and the Basic Course in Biomedical Research must be completed within two years. | Candidates must hold updated NMC/State Medical Council registration covering all post-MBBS/MD/MS qualifications. Without it, they must produce "Applied for document(s)" at the interview; otherwise they may not be interviewed or their result may be withheld. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

salary_details.pay_scale: Professor Rs. 3,20,000; Associate Professor Rs. 2,60,000 (monthly fixed remuneration, without any added allowance)

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted by email only. Eligible candidates who wish to attend the interview must submit the scanned application form (Annexure-I) with supporting documents to [email protected] by 05:00 PM on 20 November 2026.
Fill in the application form given as Annexure-I in the notice and affix a self-photograph.
Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below.
Combine the form and all documents into one single PDF. Multiple submissions will not be considered.
Email the PDF to [email protected] with the subject line: Application for the Position of Professor and Associate Professor at Shillong Medical College, Shillong.
Send it so that it reaches by 05:00 PM on 20 November 2026.
Submit a separate application for each post, in the prescribed format only; other formats or incomplete applications will be summarily rejected.

Applicants already employed in Central/State Government, autonomous institutions, statutory organisations or PSUs under Central/State Governments should route applications through proper channel. If that is not immediately available, a copy of "Applied for NOC" is to be submitted at the interview. The application form asks for post and department applied for, personal details, educational qualifications, medical council registration, present designation, academic records, previous teaching experience, number of publications, and completion of the Medical Education and Biomedical Research courses.

Selection is on the basis of academic credentials and performance in the interview before the Selection Board. The interview mode is offline. Candidates will be told by email of any additional documents needed and of the interview date at least 7 days before the scheduled date. Dates of interview for later cut-off applicants under the rolling advertisement will be notified in due course. Screening, communication, interviews and recruitment will be conducted in phases, depending on availability of experts, receipt of complete documents and the requirements of the position. Results will be displayed on https://shillongmedicalcollege.co.in and https://meghealth.gov.in, and the offer of appointment will be sent by email.

content_sections.text: Eligibility follows the NMC Teachers Eligibility Qualifications (TEQ) guidelines 2025 and their latest amendments (National Medical Commission, Notification F.No.N-P051(12)/18/2024-PGMEB-MNC). The upper age limit for both posts is up to 70 years, as on 20 November 2026. Retired faculty and doctors from private medical colleges, Institutes of National Importance and other Government medical colleges within the country may apply as per the eligibility for each post. (a)(i) Associate Professor in the subject for three years in a recognised medical institution; or (ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least three years of experience as Associate Professor in the relevant speciality in a teaching hospital of the Armed Forces; and (b)(i) at least two research publications after becoming Associate Professor, among the first three authors; (ii) Basic Course in Biomedical Research from a recognised medical institution completed; and (iii) Basic Course in Medical Education required, provided the broad specialty subject is covered under undergraduate training. Note 1: For Aviation Medicine and Marine Medicine, two years as Flying Squadron (Aviation) and two years in a Diving and Escape Training School (Marine Medicine) are considered equivalent to one year of teaching experience as Associate Professor. Note 2: A Senior Consultant with three years of experience as post graduate teacher of broad specialty or super specialty subject in a National Board of Examination in Medical Sciences recognised Government medical institute is eligible to become Professor in the concerned specialty. Total years as post graduate teacher in such an institute count as experience as Professor. (a)(i) Assistant Professor in the subject for four years in a recognised medical institution, or five years for those appointed directly as Assistant Professor in a Government medical institution; or (ii) Specialist Medical Officer of the Armed Forces with at least five years of clinical experience in the relevant specialty after the recognised Postgraduate qualification, of which at least three years as Assistant Professor in a teaching hospital of the Armed Forces; and (b)(i) at least two research publications after becoming Assistant Professor, among the first three authors; (ii) Basic Course in Biomedical Research from a recognised medical institution designated by the Commission; and (iii) Basic Course in Medical Education required, provided the broad specialty subject is covered under undergraduate training. Note: A non-teaching Consultant, Specialist or Medical Officer with a postgraduate medical degree and ten years of experience in at least a 220 bedded Government hospital is eligible to become Associate Professor of that broad specialty. On such appointment, the Basic Course in Medical Education and the Basic Course in Biomedical Research must be completed within two years. Candidates must hold updated NMC/State Medical Council registration covering all post

Assistant Professor – Grade I needs three years after Ph.D. or six years teaching and research experience.

faq.question: What is the pay for the posts?
faq.answer: Associate Professor is at Pay Level 13A2 (AGP Rs.9500) and Assistant Professor – Grade I at Pay Level 12 (AGP Rs.8000) in the 7th CPC.

faq.question: What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1000/- (non-refundable) for UR/OBC/EWS, paid online. SC/ST/PWD categories and Female candidates are exempted.

faq.question: How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the online application at nitpyrec.samarth.edu.in along with the necessary enclosures before 12 December 2026.

faq.question: Can I apply for both posts?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application with the application fee must be submitted for each post, or the application will be rejected.

faq.question: How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is in two phases: a technical seminar in the area of specialization for shortlisted candidates, then an interview by the Selection Board.

faq.question: Can an NIT Puducherry Ph.D. holder apply?
faq.answer: Not unless there is three years of outside experience after leaving the Institute. Candidates who obtained their Ph.D. from NIT Puducherry are otherwise not considered.

faq.question: Will TA/DA be paid for the selection process?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending any stage of the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists vacancies speciality by speciality with the category of each post. Added together, they come to 112 posts. The vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease as per the actual requirement for teaching and patient care. SR3 is the Senior Resident (3 Year) post under the residency scheme and SR1 is the Senior Resident (1 Year) post against GDMO. UR stands for Unreserved, SC for Scheduled Caste, ST for Scheduled Tribe, EWS for Economically Weaker Section and OBC for Other Backward Class. Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines issued from time to time, and reservation for Persons with Disability (Divyangjan) will be maintained as per Government of India norms. The Dean reserves the right to vary these vacancies, including increase, decrease or cancellation of any or all posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice states that holders of MSc, PhD, MBBS, Diploma & DNB [Alternate routes], MD, MS, MCH & DM can apply as per the latest NMC Regulations. All candidates must fulfil the prescribed educational qualifications, teaching experience and other eligibility criteria as per the prevailing National Medical Commission (NMC) Regulations and applicable ESIC recruitment policies. The qualifying degree and experience are counted as on the last date of application submission. A candidate eligible for a higher post (Professor) may be interviewed against a lower post (Associate Professor). If such a candidate is selected, placement is with the pay of the lower post, as per eligibility and the recommendation of the selection board. Any up-gradation of the post is at the sole discretion of the Competent Authority, is temporary and lasts only for the tenure of the teaching faculty or until a regular incumbent joins the lower post. Age relaxation is as per the prevailing norms of the Government of India (GOI) and the discretion of the competent Authority. The notice does not mention a separate age limit for the Tutor post. For the speciality-wise eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification and the NMC regulations it cites.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Teaching faculty: initially three (03) years on a contractual basis, extendable up to a maximum cumulative period of five (05) years, subject to satisfactory performance, annual performance appraisal and renewal/approval by the Competent Authority. Faculty contracts are renewed yearly and end on completion of the tenure, on attainment of 70 years of age or on the joining of a regular incumbent, whichever is earlier. Senior Residents: one year at a time, extendable subject to satisfactory performance and applicable NMC regulations, for a maximum tenure of three (03) years under the Senior Residency Scheme. A draft of Rs. 1,00,000/- must be deposited as security deposit at the time of joining; it will be forfeited if the candidate resigns within six months of joining. The engagement may be terminated or discontinued from either side with one month's prior notice; on resignation by the selected candidate, one month's salary is to be deposited to the ESI Account through challan. Faculty will be entitled to 2.5 leaves per month. No claim for service benefits such as PF, pension, gratuity, medical allowance, medical benefits, seniority or promotion will be admissible. Absence beyond 07 (seven) days without proper permission amounts to voluntary abandonment of the engagement and automatic termination. Teaching faculty must mark attendance manually as well as on the Aadhar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily on scheduled working days. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining. The contractual appointment confers no right to regularisation, permanent absorption or a regular appointment in ESIC.

faq.answer: The vacancy table adds up to 112 posts: 14 Professor, 22 Associate Professor, 16 Assistant Professor, 45 Senior Resident (3 Year), 8 Senior Resident (1 Year) and 7 Tutor. The vacancies are provisional and may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to email the application is 19 November 2026. Under the rolling advertisement, the last date is the 19th of each month until the posts are filled.

faq.question: Q3. When and where is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 23 November 2026 (Monday), with reporting from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM at the 2nd Floor, Dean's Office, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Ludhiana – 141001, Punjab.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Education and experience are as per the latest NMC norms for all advertised posts. The notice says MSc, PhD, MBBS, Diploma & DNB [Alternate routes], MD, MS, MCH & DM holders can apply as per the latest NMC Regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Faculty must not exceed 69 years and Senior Residents must not exceed 45 years, both as on the date of interview. Age relaxation is as per GOI norms and the discretion of the competent Authority.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at ESIC Ludhiana?
faq.answer: Both Senior Resident posts carry a fixed basic pay of Rs. 67,700 (Level 11) plus allowances, with a gross salary of about Rs. 1.45 lakh. Rs. 1350 per month is deducted for diploma holders and Rs. 2250 per month if no Degree/Diploma is held.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500 for all other categories and Nil for SC/ST, ESIC regular employees, female candidates, defence ex-servicemen and PH candidates. It is paid by Demand Draft in favour of ESI Fund A/c No. 1, payable at Ludhiana.

faq.question: Q8. What should be written in the email subject line?
faq.answer: The subject line must read: NAME OF CANDIDATE – POST APPLIED FOR – DEPARTMENT. The form, documents and demand draft must be sent as one single PDF to [email protected].

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is on the basis of performance in an interview out of 100 marks before the Selection Board, after scrutiny of applications. The minimum marks are 50 for UR/EWS, 45 for OBC and 40 for SC/ST/PwBD.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are contractual: faculty for three years extendable up to five, and Senior Residents for one year at a time up to three years, with no right to regularisation. A security deposit of Rs. 1,00,000 is required at joining.

It states that reservation for SC, ST, OBC and EWS categories will be provided as per Government of India norms, depending upon availability of candidates, and therefore requests candidates of all categories to apply. Reservation will apply strictly in accordance with Government of India rules and UGC guidelines. The University reserves the right to alter the number of vacancies or not to fill any or all positions.

rows.department: Department of Commerce, Main Campus, Lucknow

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Indian citizens. Candidates with higher academic credentials, research publications, teaching experience and desirable specialization relevant to the department may be given due weightage during selection. Qualification, experience, publications and other eligibility conditions will be reckoned as on the last date for submission of applications (17 November 2026). Superannuated teachers may also be considered, subject to a maximum age limit of 70 years. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification and the UGC Regulations, 2018 it names.

rows.qualification: As prescribed under the UGC (Minimum Qualifications for Appointment of Teachers and Other Academic Staff in Universities and Colleges) Regulations, 2018, as amended from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Selected Contractual Faculty will be paid a fixed consolidated remuneration of Rs. 57,700/- (Rupees Fifty-Seven Thousand Seven Hundred only) per month, equivalent to the initial Basic Pay of an Assistant Professor at Academic Level-10, without any allowances. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual. It does not confer any right to regular appointment or create any claim for absorption, continuation or seniority in the University. The appointment is initially for one Academic Session or until further order of the University, whichever is earlier. It may be extended for a further Academic Session, subject to satisfactory performance, teaching effectiveness, conduct, availability of workload, continued requirement of the Department and approval of the Competent Authority. An extension does not confer any right to regular appointment, absorption or continuation beyond the approved tenure. Contractual Faculty will not get allowances, pension, gratuity, leave and similar benefits admissible to regular teachers. Contractual Faculty will not be treated like regular teachers for voting rights or for membership of the university's statutory bodies.

content_sections.heading: BBAU Contractual Faculty Job Description
content_sections.text: Teaching, practical/laboratory work, student mentoring, evaluation, examination duties and academic administration. Other responsibilities as may be assigned by the Head of the Department and the University. Teaching, examination, evaluation and other academic duties may be assigned at par with regular faculty; duties involving statutory, financial or disciplinary powers will not be assigned. Workload and duties will ordinarily follow the applicable UGC norms and University regulations.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through short-listing followed by an interaction (the notice also calls it an interview). Meeting the minimum qualifications does not entitle an applicant to be called for interaction or selection. The University reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates called for interaction by adopting appropriate short-listing criteria. Shortlisted candidates will be told the date, time and venue of the interaction through the registered e-mail only; no communication will be sent by post. Employed candidates must produce an NOC from the employer at the time of interview, failing which they may not be interviewed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BBAU Contractual Faculty
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed "Application Form for Contractual Faculty" from the University website www.bbau.ac.in (the form is also attached to the notice). Fill in the form: department, personal details, educational qualifications, Ph.D. and NET/SLET/SET details, experience, publications of the last five years, academic distinctions, present position, the signed declaration and three references, and paste a passport size photograph. Combine the filled form and self-attested scanned copies of all requisite supporting documents into a single PDF file. Email the PDF to [email protected] between 10-11-2026 (10:00 A.M.) and 17-11-2026 (11:59 P.M.). Submit a separate application for each Department and/or discipline. Applications sent by any other mode, including by hand, post, courier or any other electronic medium, will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected, as will applications received after the closing date and time or found incomplete, unsigned or without the requisite documents.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Duly filled prescribed application form with a passport size photograph. Self-attested scanned copies of all requisite supporting documents (in the same single PDF). Copies of reprints of publications (the form asks for these for teaching posts). At the interaction: all original certificates, testimonials and caste/EWS/etc. certificates. At the interaction: one complete set of self-attested photocopies. At the interview, for candidates already in employment: NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the employer.

content_sections.heading: About SBI Risk Specialist Recruitment
content_sections.text: The Central Recruitment & Promotion Department of the State Bank of India, located at the Corporate Centre in Mumbai, conducts regular recruitment for specialist cadre officers. This recruitment cycle invites applications for the Risk Specialist position under Middle Management Grade Scale-II (MMGS-II) to handle expected credit loss modelling, macroeconomic overlays, and model risk management.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment offers a total of 3 regular vacancies for the Risk Specialist post under the Unreserved (UR) category (with PwBD-VI horizontal reservation of 1 vacancy). The post-wise and category-wise break-up is detailed below.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the mandatory educational qualification, age limits, and post-qualification experience requirements as on 31.10.2026. Age Limit: Minimum 25 years and Maximum 35 years as on 31.10.2026. Upper age limit is for unreserved category candidates. Relaxation in upper age limit is available to reserved category candidates as per Govt. of India guidelines (wherever applicable). Essential Qualification: Mandatory: (i) CA or (ii) CFA or (iii) MBA / PGDM or equivalent degree in Finance / Data Analytics / Business Analytics from a recognized institute. Preferred Qualification / Certification: Financial Risk Manager (FRM) by GARP OR Professional Risk Managers by PRMIA (valid as on 31.10.2026). Work Experience: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification work experience in dealing with Expected Credit Loss (ECL) related modelling in Risk Management Department of any Bank / Financial Institution / Rating Agency / Brokerage firm or Risk Advisory in Consulting Firm as on 31.10.2026. Training & teaching experience will not be counted for eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates are appointed in Middle Management Grade Scale-II (MMGS-II) on a regular basis with a basic pay scale of 64820-2340/1-67160-2680/10-93960. The official will be eligible for DA, HRA, CCA, Provident Fund, Contributory Pension Fund i.e. NPS, Leave Fare Concession (LFC), Medical Facility, other perquisites etc. as per Bank’s salary structure.

content_sections.heading: SBI Risk Specialist Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be assigned roles and Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs) that include: Development of Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD) and Exposure at Default (EAD) models for various loan portfolio and investments on which ECL is applicable. Development of Macroeconomic Overlays models required as per regulatory guidelines. Implementation of PD, LGD and EAD Models in OFSAA. Period Monitoring, Maintenance and validation of above models. Preparation of Framework for Determination of Stage under ECL. Identification of Significant Increase in Credit Risk (SICR) triggers along with setting qualitative and quantitative triggers for various portfolio. Coordinate with Auditors & Regulator, BUs & other stakeholders throughout model lifecycle. Maintain proper Model documents and database required for audit & regulatory supervision. Develop models required for ECL computation using industry best practices and using statistical and machine learning techniques.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of two stages: Shortlisting: Mere fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience will not vest any right to candidate for being called for interview. The shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank will decide the shortlisting parameters and thereafter, adequate number of candidates, as decided by the Bank, will be shortlisted for interaction. Interview: Interview will carry 100 marks. The qualifying marks in interview will be decided by the Bank. Merit list for selection will be prepared in descending order on the basis of scores obtained in interview only.

content_sections.heading: SBI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will support the development and delivery of customized solutions to clients. The candidate must also ensure that product offerings stay aligned with evolving market dynamics and regulatory expectations. The job profile includes: Conducting research followed by development of new derivative products in line with the prevailing market. Evaluating the performance of the product on an ongoing basis. Assisting marketing of derivative products to the clients. Providing periodic updates to the Top Management. Key Responsibility Areas (KRAs): Lead product conceptualization and development of new derivative instruments. Conduct advanced macroeconomic and interest rate research to support product suitability. Prepare product notes, risk disclosures and documentation for approval committees. Evaluate product performance and recommend product positioning strategies. Coordinate with internal departments such as risk, legal, IAD and ITTSS for timely approvals and clearances within the regulatory and internal compliance framework. Coordinate closely with CTMU/RTMUs to drive derivative penetration across the bank's corporate and retail clients. Handle the end-to-end process of product development and approval. Assist in automation and integration of compliance workflows. Mentor AVP-level team members and contribute to strategic product planning. Any other related work as assigned. Design tailored products based on the client's need and market dynamics, and keep up with developments in derivative products and regulatory frameworks. Conduct Fundamental and Technical research across Equities, Forex and Debt Markets. Analyse macroeconomic trends, central bank policies and geopolitical developments, and assess their market impact. Generate and maintain financial models and prepare valuation reports. Monitor the markets and assess the client's requirements. Provide necessary support in product development. Liaise with various departments involved in designing and developing new products. Provide regular updates to the stakeholders and Top Management. Track and analyse corporate earnings, bond yield movements and currency fluctuations. Prepare and present research notes, market outlook and sectoral reports. Collaborate with the trading desk to align strategies with research insights. For the Manager post, the KRAs may be finalized after selection. The notice states that the job profiles and KRAs for both posts are illustrative, and the bank may assign other roles from time to time.

content_sections.heading: About Bank of Baroda
content_sections.text: Bank of Baroda is a public sector bank. Its letterhead calls it "India's International Bank" and marks its 119th Foundation Year. The notice was issued from Mumbai on 28 October 2026 by the Chief General Manager (HRM & Marketing).

content_sections.heading: Salary and Pay Scale
content_sections.text: The pay scales are MMG/S-II (basic pay Rs. 64,820 to Rs. 93,960), MMG/S-III (Rs. 85,920 to Rs. 1,05,280) and SMG/S-IV (Rs. 1,02,300 to Rs. 1,20,940). Salary and other pay follow the industry-level bipartite settlement and the Joint Note for officers in the banking sector. On top of basic pay, officers may get bank-specific allowances, perquisites and other facilities under the bank's policies.

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Project Finance – Infrastructure & ESG: credit policy and pricing, using ESG and sustainability factors to assess credit proposals, independent credit risk evaluation of loan proposals, and sector analysis. MSME Credit Risk Management: risk-return evaluation of the loan portfolio, stress testing and scenario analysis for capital adequacy, and monitoring credit risk capital. Enterprise and Operational Risk Management: the bank-wide risk framework, risk appetite and limits, CRAR and economic capital, the ICAAP exercise and Pillar III disclosures. Fraud Incidence and Root Cause Analysis: root cause analysis of frauds, including digital risks, and loss data and incident management in line with RBI guidelines on Operational Risk. Manager - Digital Fraud: fraud tools and rules for Debit cards, Internet and Mobile Banking, IMPS and UPI, plus dashboards. Uses SAS/SQL and credit data from sources such as CIBIL and Equifax. MSME Relationship: finding MSME business, meeting revenue targets, cross-selling, recovering long-outstanding debts and checking financial statements. Business Finance: performance MIS, Funds Transfer Pricing, cost management, capital budgeting and balance sheet and accounting policy advice. Chief Manager - Internal Controls: the Internal Controls Framework, ICOFR, reconciliation of office accounts, GL review under IRAC norms, and work with Statutory Auditors on IFC audits.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection may include application scrutiny, an online test, a psychometric test or any other suitable test, followed by Group Discussion and/or Interview or several rounds of interviews. Shortlisting may be based on online test scores, qualifications, work experience, domain expertise, skill set and suitability. The bank does not share its shortlisting criteria. If an online test is held, you need a minimum score in each section and overall. Candidates tied at the cut-off mark are ranked by age, oldest first. The minimum qualifying mark in the Personal Interview is 60% for General and EWS candidates and 55% for reserved categories. The bank may change these marks. The final merit list combines the online test and/or interview scores. The bank may consider you for a different position if you meet that position's eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Probation: 12 months (1 year) of active service from the date of joining. Service bond: serve at least 3 years, or pay the bank three months' gross salary (capped at Rs. 3 Lakhs) if you leave earlier. Posting: any branch or office of the Bank anywhere in India. Only candidates willing to serve anywhere in India should apply. Selected candidates sign an employment contract. Serving government, PSU and bank employees must produce a No Objection Certificate at the interview and a relieving letter on joining.

content_sections.heading: About DDSCBL
content_sections.text: The Daman & Diu State Co-operative Bank Ltd. is a state co-operative bank licensed by the RBI (Licence No. Dos. RO (AH). REG/LIC.S-2187/04.36.000/2023-24 dated 07 March 2024). Its Head Office is in Dilip Nagar, Nani Daman, and its Administration Department issued this notice. You can reach that department on 0260 2255984 and 2255985, or by email at [email protected] . The internship is part of NABARD's scheme for engaging Cooperative Interns to strengthen cooperatives. The National Cooperative Development Corporation (NCDC) runs the scheme, NABARD monitors it and state co-operative banks carry it out.

content_sections.heading: DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The bank pays TA/DA from its own funds. The Rs.25,000 remuneration is reimbursed from the Cooperative Education Fund of the Ministry of Cooperation through NCDC.

content_sections.heading: DDSCBL Cooperative Intern Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: You must be at least 21 years old and no older than 30. MBA or equivalent in Marketing Management / Cooperative Management / Agri Business Management / Rural Development Management. Essential: proficiency in computer. The bank asks candidates to read the full eligibility criteria and essential requirements in NABARD's circular dated 15.03.2024, which comes with the official notification, before applying.

content_sections.heading: Duties of the Cooperative Intern
content_sections.text: Work with PACS and other primary cooperatives and guide them in carrying out the initiatives of the Ministry of Cooperation, Government of India. Solve day-to-day problems PACS face with computerisation, business plans, projects, financing and various approvals. Prepare and share a weekly status report on these initiatives, in coordination with the DCCB/StCB. The scheme aims to take the cooperative movement down to the grassroots. It also lets professional graduates learn how cooperatives work in practice and builds a pool of experienced cooperative professionals.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is purely an internship programme for one year only. NCDC funds it, and the bank carries no liability. It is not an appointment or employment and does not promise one. No intern has any right or claim to a job with the bank because of this internship. The internship is full-time. The intern must keep the bank's working hours. The bank may post or transfer interns according to its functional needs. Interns get 10 days of Casual Leave for the year and no other leave. Any other leave is treated as "Leave without remuneration". The bank's holidays may apply to interns. The internship may end at any time, with no financial benefit, if performance is not satisfactory or the intern is absent without the bank's permission. The bank may also end it at any time without giving a reason. Interns must keep all documents, reports and information confidential. Breaking this rule has legal consequences. Interns may not deal with or represent the bank to print, electronic or social media. They may not post their work on social media without express permission from the competent authority. Interns must follow the rules and regulations of the bank and behave professionally with the bank and the public.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay is Pay Level 10 (56100 – 177500) of the 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable). The appointment is purely temporary and initially for 1 year. It gives no right to regular appointment or permanent absorption in the Institute. The contract expires automatically after 1 year (1 term) unless renewed for another term, up to a maximum of 3 terms, on the recommendation of the concerned HoD and if the service is required by the Institute. The Institute can terminate the appointment at any time without assigning any reason. The employee can leave by giving 01 (one) month notice or salary in lieu thereof. A candidate cannot resign or leave within 03 months from the date of joining. The initial place of posting is the temporary campus of AIIMS Madurai, i.e. Government Medical College, Madurai, Tamil Nadu. It will be shifted to the permanent campus based on the progress of construction. The appointment is full-time and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Leave entitlement follows the Institute's leave rules as amended from time to time. No travelling or other allowances are paid for joining the post. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits of regular Government servants. The posts are regulated under the Central Residency Scheme and governed by CCS (Temporary Service) Rules.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Madurai
content_sections.text: AIIMS Madurai is described in the notice as an Institute of National Importance, one of the new AIIMS being established by the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY). JIPMER, Puducherry is its mentor institute. The initial place of posting is the Government Medical College, Madurai, which serves as the temporary campus.

content_sections.text: The notice lists 46 vacancies across 19 departments. The vacancies are provisional, and the Executive Director reserves the right to vary them, including the reserved vacancies. If no application is received under EWS, the post may be filled under UR. The notice states that 4% reservation for PwBD candidates on a horizontal basis applies as per Government Rules. The vacancy table does not show a separate PwBD column.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice prints the following essential qualifications. For every Medical route, MCI / NMC / State Medical Council registration is mandatory before joining, if selected. The notice does not print an experience requirement for the posts. Each of the Medical degrees above must be from a recognized University / Institute. Applicants holding DNB in broad specialties or Dr NB in super specialties must provide documentary evidence of equivalence with MD / MS / DM / M.Ch, issued by the competent authority as per the NMC New Delhi notification dated 30.06.2025. They qualify if they meet either of these conditions: DNB / Dr NB training was done in a medical institution with an attached hospital, or in a hospital with 500 or more beds, recognized by the National Board of Examinations. The candidate has done one year of senior residency in a medical college or institution recognized by NMC as a teaching institution for that specialty / super specialty after passing DNB / Dr NB, in all cases where training was in a hospital with fewer than 500 beds. Only Indian Nationals are invited to apply. OCI cardholders under section 7(a) of the Citizenship Act, 1955 are also eligible to apply for teaching posts as per the Ministry of Home Affairs order quoted in the notice, but are not exempted from personal appearance for a written exam or interview. Only candidates declared successful in the qualifying degree exam and completing their tenure for it on or before the closing date are eligible. If the result is declared after the closing date, candidature stands cancelled. Applicants should not have completed 3 years of Senior Residency under the Residency Scheme in any Govt. medical institution, whether on regular or ad-hoc / Contract basis. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. The upper age limit is 45 years as on the closing date of online application (03.12.2026). content_sections.text: The fee is remitted through SBI Collect only. Cheque, MO, IPO, CRF, cash, demand draft, Money Order, Bankers Cheque, Postal Orders, Treasury Challans and similar modes are not accepted, and such applications are treated as without fee and summarily rejected. Fees once paid are not refunded or adjusted under any circumstances. Applications without the prescribed fee are rejected.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the pay. The terms printed in the notice are: The post is governed by the Central Residency Scheme and CCS (Temporary Service) Rules. It is a tenure post with a total Residency period of 3 years; the initial appointment is for one year and is extendable based on satisfactory performance and the Institute's requirement. If the candidate has worked as a Senior Resident in any Govt. medical institution, on regular, ad-hoc or Contract basis, the duration already done is reduced from the 3 years offered. The appointment can be terminated at any time, by either side, with one month's notice or by paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason. If an appointee applies elsewhere or resigns within the first three months of joining, no NOC, Relieving Letter or Experience Certificate is issued. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits available to regular Government Servants. No extra allowances are admissible for additional duty assigned. Leave follows Institute Policy. The appointment is whole-time. Private practice of any kind and any other assignment, paid or otherwise, are prohibited. The initial posting is at the Government Medical College, Madurai (temporary campus of AIIMS Madurai), to be shifted based on progress of the permanent campus. The appointee works in shifts and may be posted on rotation to casualty, ward, OPD or camps. Appointment is provisional, subject to verification of credentials and to the candidate being declared medically fit by a competent Medical Board.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes shortlisting followed by an interview. It does not print a marks scheme. Shortlisting: for further process or interview, on the basis of educational qualification, relevant experience, caste/category etc., or as per criteria decided by the Executive Director, AIIMS Madurai. If many applications are received for a post, a screening test, or a written test, may be conducted. Possessing the minimum qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called. Interview: held at AIIMS Madurai or at any other place and mode decided by the Executive Director. Candidates called must produce all relevant original documents for verification before the interview.

Select the category "GOVT / PSU / COURTS", search "ALL INDIA INSTITUTE OF MEDICAL SCIENCES, MADURAI", and select "Recruitment Cell - Application Fee" from the drop-down menu. Fill the columns marked "*" and continue to pay by SBI Net Banking, other Banks Net Banking, Credit Card, Debit Card or other payment modes. Transaction charges are borne by the applicant. Take a print out of the payment receipt to attach with the application form, and enter the transaction ID / reference number, date of payment and amount in the space provided in the application. If you claim fee exemption, write "Fee Exempted" in the fee details space of the respective page of the application form. Do not send a hard copy of the application at this stage. Shortlisted candidates submit the application form with self-attested copies of certificates at certificate verification / interview. If an applicant submits more than one application, only the latest is considered; earlier ones are not considered for scrutiny or further processing. After submission, no change is allowed in Name, Date of Birth, Subject applied or Category (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/UR/PwBD/EWS).

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates called for interview bring these originals with a duly filled application form and one set of self-attested photocopies, arranged in this order: Print out of the online Application form. Proof of Age: Birth Certificate, or Matriculation / 10th Standard certificate (or equivalent) from a Central/State Board showing date of birth. Educational Certificates from 10th or equivalent to Post Graduate / Ph.D. A provisional certificate is enclosed if the degree certificate is not awarded by the Institute; a Date of Completion certificate for Ph.D, if applicable. Mark Sheets / Mark Cards of UG and PG degree. Medical Council Registration Certificate(s), UG and PG, with renewal up to date and the latest PG registration. DNB equivalence certificate, if applicable; a DNB teacher certificate for candidates working in DNB Institutes. Experience Certificates. Certificate for claiming reservation (SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwBD). No Objection Certificate (NOC) for candidates working on a regular basis in Central/State Government, Autonomous Institutions, Statutory Organizations or PSUs, if applicable. Self-declaration of the number of terms under the Residency Scheme so far.

faq.question: Q1. How many Senior Resident (Non-Academic) vacancies are there at AIIMS Madurai?
faq.answer: There are 46 vacancies across 19 departments (UR 20, OBC-NCL 12, SC 07, ST 02, EWS 05). The notice calls them provisional and subject to variation.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Madurai Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The last date is 03.12.2026 till 05.00 PM. Online applications opened on 13.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for AIIMS Madurai Senior Resident?
faq.answer: A post graduate Medical Degree (M.D./M.S.) in the concerned specialty from a recognized University / Institute, with NMC / State Medical Council registration before joining. Anatomy, Biochemistry, Microbiology and Pharmacology also have a Non-Medical route: M.Sc. plus Ph.D. in the medical subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?

faq.answer: UR / OBC / EWS candidates pay ₹ 500 plus applicable transaction charges. SC / ST / PwBD / Women candidates are exempted from the fee.
