faq.answer: Fill the Google form given in the notice and pay the fee through SBI Collect if applicable. Do not send a hard copy now; shortlisted candidates submit the form and self-attested documents at verification or interview.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted on qualification, experience and category, a screening or written test may be held if applications are many, and an interview follows. Dates will be intimated later.

faq.question: Q8. Is the Senior Resident post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a tenure post of 3 years under the Residency Scheme. The initial appointment is one year, extendable on satisfactory performance, and no Pension, Provident Fund or Gratuity is admissible.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply with more than one application?
faq.answer: Multiple applications are allowed to be submitted, but only the latest one is considered for scrutiny and selection. Earlier ones are not considered.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA / DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA / DA is paid for attending the written test or interview. Candidates arrange their own stay, food and travel.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The SMaRT Trial is a multi-centric study, with St John's Research Institute, M. S. Ramaiah Medical College Hospitals and CSIR-CFTRI, Mysore as the centres. It evaluates a structured progressive resistance exercise and nutritional intervention on muscle health and functional outcomes among women receiving treatment for breast and gynaecological cancers. The study will assess changes in muscle strength, muscle mass, physical function, fatigue, quality of life and treatment-related outcomes, along with relevant biochemical/biomarker assessments. The post reports to the Ramaiah Site Investigators: Dr V Sundar Kumar, Additional Professor, Physiotherapy, and Dr Santhosh K Devadass, Professor and Head, Medical Oncology.

Experience in the conduct of intervention research. The preferred languages are English, Kannada, Telugu, Tamil and Hindi. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India. PWD candidates must hold a disability certificate issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Govt. Hospital/Institutions.

basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III (General Medicine) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Project Nurse III post is open in the Department of General Medicine, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Jodhpur, under the project "Implementation of AMSP in various tertiary care centres across India", funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The post is purely temporary, with tenure as per project requirement and monthly salary as per ICMR norms. The essential qualification is a four-year B.Sc. Nursing course, and candidates send their CV with the filled application form to [email protected] by 16 November 2026 before 5:00 PM.

important_dates.interview_date: To be informed to shortlisted/selected candidates

how_to_apply: Fill the "Format for Application" printed with the notice (page 3). It asks for the name of the post, Advertisement File No. and date, name, father's name, date of birth, age, permanent and correspondence addresses, email, phone numbers, qualifications from High School onwards and post-qualification experience, with a passport size photo and signature.
Attach all essential qualification and experience certificates with the application form. Without them the application will be considered incomplete.
Combine the CV and the duly filled application form together in one single PDF file.
Email the PDF to [email protected] by 16 November 2026 before 5:00 PM.
Applications received without the duly filled application form in the prescribed format will be summarily rejected and the candidate will be disqualified.
important_instructions: No enquiries shall be entertained after the due date. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jodhpur Project Nurse III
content_sections.text: The Project Nurse III post is part of an Extramural Research project at AIIMS Jodhpur, run under the Principal Investigator Dr. Deepak Kumar, Additional Professor, Department of General Medicine. The project, "Implementation of AMSP in various tertiary care centres across India", is funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR). The project office is at the Department of General Medicine, Medicine OPD, Room No. 119, 1st Floor, B Block OPD Building, AIIMS Jodhpur.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: Four-year B.Sc. Nursing course from a recognized university/institute. Desirable: Experience in clinical research/AMSP/Infection Control Computer proficiency Good communication skills Age concession: Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case to case basis (only applicable for ICMR Project). Other conditions printed in the notice: All educational, professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Any experience counted should be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification required for the post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Project Nurse III post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly salary is as per ICMR norms. The notice states that the salary is a consolidated sum without any other benefits, and that it is based on the experience, qualifications, skill set, etc. of the candidate. No fixed amount is printed. The tenure is as per project requirement. The post is filled purely on a temporary basis, co-terminus with the project, and the position will be on a temporary/contractual basis for the specified period of time and based on the project. The selected candidate will have no right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation of services in any other project, and the contract service will not confer any right for further assignment or regular appointment in the institute.

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: The National Health Systems Resource Centre has been set up under the National Health Mission as an autonomous registered society to channelise technical assistance and capacity building support to the states for strengthening the public health system. It is also mandated to contribute towards national strategic health planning and programme design. Its work is organised around seven divisions: Community Processes & Comprehensive Primary Care (CP-CPHC), Quality & Patient Safety, Public Health Planning, Public Health Administration, Healthcare Financing & Healthcare Technology, and Human Resources for Health. This post serves the Free Drugs Service Initiative, through which the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare (MoHFW) supports states in improving access to free and affordable drugs. That support covers procurement systems, the IT-backed Drug & Vaccine Distribution and Management System (DVDMS), warehousing, quality assurance, prescription audits, grievance redressal and IEC. The Consultant is expected to coordinate and facilitate implementation of the initiative in the states, handhold states during roll-out, manage operational issues and coordinate with MoHFW, the software development organisation, states and other stakeholders.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only regular degrees are accepted. The essential requirements for the Consultant (Drugs and Logistics) post are: Full-time B. Pharma degree from a recognized institute with Master's Degree in Pharmacy or Pharm D or a full-time MBA/PGDM in Pharmaceutical Management/Supply Chain Management/Healthcare Management/Hospital Management/Master's in Public Health. Minimum 2 years post qualification experience in drug procurement and supply chain management/inventory management/Warehouse management/field level experience in Free Drugs Service implementation. Sound knowledge of drugs and pharmaceuticals, storage practices, pharmacopoeias, the Drugs & Cosmetics Act, the NDPS Act, the National Formulary of India (NFI), the National List of Essential Medicines (NLEM), GFR and other relevant regulatory frameworks. Sound knowledge of IPHS and National Health Programmes. Strong IT skills with hands-on experience in Logistics Management Information Systems (LMIS), including DVDMS (central dashboard and state implementations such as e-Aushadhi). Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience in data analysis, quantification, demand forecasting and use of AI-driven forecasting models/tools for drug procurement and supply planning. Experience in vendor management/rate contracts/framework agreements, and performance monitoring. Experience in inventory optimization techniques (ABC–VEN analysis, FSN, HML, safety stock calculation, lead-time analysis). Field experience in implementation support, capacity building or state handholding for supply chain strengthening initiatives. Proficiency in MS Office, especially Excel (data analysis, dashboards, reporting) and PowerPoint. The age limit is 45 Years and below. The notice does not mention a cut-off date for counting age or any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration range is between Rs. 60,000/- and Rs. 1,20,000/- per month. The fee offered within this band will be commensurate with the candidate's qualification and experience. In addition to the remuneration, NHSRC Consultants are entitled to: Free accidental insurance and subsidized medical insurance Mobile bills reimbursement and laptop reimbursement (as per NHSRC Policy) 30 days consolidated leave Fully paid maternity leave for female Consultants, as per Government of India policy Performance linked increments TA/DA and per diem for on-duty visits NHSRC intends to fill the post purely on a short-term basis. The contract runs till 31 March 2028, with further extensions of similar duration subject to satisfactory performance. The work location is New Delhi, and travel to states and districts will be involved.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the role as multi-dimensional. The duties are: Review, update, rationalize and map State Essential Medicines Lists (EMLs) in line with the revised IPHS, NLEM and programme-specific requirements for various levels of public health facilities. Support categorization of medicines as Essential and Desirable, and ensure regulatory compliance under the Drugs & Cosmetics Act, NDPS Act and other applicable frameworks. Review and assess procurement, logistics and supply chain management systems across States/UTs and recommend evidence-based improvements. Conduct situational analysis, field visits and gap assessments to strengthen drug procurement, warehousing, distribution and last-mile availability under the Free Drugs Service Initiative (FDSI). Assist States/UTs and MoHFW in adopting, customizing, strengthening and using IT-based LMIS such as DVDMS (Central Dashboard) and e-Aushadhi. Analyse supply chain data from DVDMS and other LMIS platforms for drug availability, stock status, expiry management, lead times and performance indicators. Support scientific quantification and demand forecasting, including AI-driven forecasting models and data-based procurement planning tools. Undertake financial analysis of State proposals under Programme Implementation Plans (PIPs), review approvals under Record of Proceedings (RoP) and assess budget utilization efficiency for drug procurement and logistics. Support the development of guidelines, SOPs, guidance documents and training modules. Collect, compile, validate and analyse data from States/UTs and prepare analytical reports, dashboards and policy briefs for MoHFW. Coordinate with State Health Departments, Procurement Corporations, CDAC/HMIS/Statistics division teams and relevant Programme Divisions. Support capacity building through review meetings, workshops and technical trainings for state officials and supply chain personnel. Track and review the periodic data uploaded by states on DVDMS developed by MoHFW. Any other function as allotted by the Advisor – Quality & Patient Safety.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue for the SRHC walk-in?
faq.answer: Registration is from 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM in the conference room (Room No. 103) of Satyawadi Raja Harishchandra Hospital, Plot No. 30, Sec-7A, Narela, Delhi-110040.

faq.question: Q3. How many Senior Resident vacancies are there at SRHC?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: Anesthesia 02, Radiology 03, Medicine 01, Dermatology 01, Obs & Gynae 02 and Surgery 01; the notice says the number may vary.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for SRHC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: MBBS with a Post Graduate degree/Diploma from a Recognized University and registration with Delhi Medical Council. For Medicine and Obs & Gynae, MBBS with two year experience (minimum one year in the concerned/equivalent department from a recognized Government Hospital/Institution) may be considered if no PG candidate is available.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SRHC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years as on the date of interview, with age relaxation for reserved category candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of SRHC Senior Resident?
faq.answer: Pay is in the Pay Matrix of Level-11 (Rs. 67,700 - 2,08,700/-) plus other admissible allowances as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. How are SRHC Senior Residents selected?
faq.answer: Through the walk-in interview; the posts are filled on a first come first serve basis and strictly on merit basis, with fresh candidates given preference over relaxed-norm candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is the SRHC Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely ad-hoc for 89 days or till a regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier, extendable up to a maximum of 03 years if service is found satisfactory.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any fee or TA/DA for the SRHC interview?
faq.answer: No fee is charged for appearing in the interview, and no TA/DA is paid for appearing in it.

faq.question: Q10. How soon must a selected candidate join SRHC?
faq.answer: Immediately or within 07 days from the date of issue of the offer letter; otherwise the offer stands automatically cancelled.

The engagement is regulated by the Company's rules and administrative orders enforced from time to time. The engaged candidate has no claim to regular employment in NHPC, nor to any relaxation in recruitment for regular posts. Candidates are placed at the posting location in the vacancy table, but are liable to be posted or transferred anywhere within the Company, including joint ventures and subsidiary companies, in India or abroad. Engagement is subject to medical fitness as per NHPC's prescribed standards. Third AC rail fare or bus fare (as per actual, shortest route, both ways) is reimbursed on production of ticket for appearing in the Personal Interview, provided the distance travelled is not less than 30 km.

faq.question: Which qualifications are desirable for this post?

faq.question: What are the duties of the Resident Medical Doctor at IIT Gandhinagar?
faq.answer: Duties include medical care at the Institute's Medical Centre, consultation, diagnosis and treatment for students, faculty and staff, outreach and community health initiatives, and attending emergency cases on a call basis beyond stipulated duty hours.

Level 10 of Pay Matrix, entry pay Rs.56,100/- plus NPA and other allowances as admissible under rules

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 14 vacancies for Junior Resident Doctors. One post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities in the non surgical departments as per Government of India policy. The notice does not give a department-wise break-up; it gives the reservation-wise table below. The Persons with Benchmark Disabilities reservation is one percent each for persons with benchmark disabilities under clauses (a), (b) and (c), and one percent for those under clauses (d) and (e): (a) Blindness and low vision (b) Deaf and hard of hearing (c) Locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy (d) Autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness (e) Multiple disabilities from amongst persons under clauses (a) to (d) including deaf-blindness, in the posts identified for each disability EWS posts are not carried forward or treated as backlog vacancy if unfilled. Candidates of other categories may therefore apply provisionally, and are considered as UR candidates only if the EWS seat is otherwise not filled.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Persons possessing qualifications included in Part II of the 3rd Schedule must also fulfil the conditions specified in section 13(B) of the Act. The notice does not print an experience requirement. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility. The age limit is 30 years, counted as on 18 November 2026, the last date for submitting applications (the notice uses this date to determine age, educational qualification and experience). Age is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC (Non-creamy layer) candidates, in respect of vacancies reserved for them. Age relaxation for physically handicapped candidates is as per Govt. of India norms.

rows.qualification: Medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of the 3rd Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956; satisfactory completion of the compulsory internship; registration with the Central/State Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Level 10 of Pay Matrix with entry pay of Rs.56,100/- plus NPA and other allowances as admissible under rules. Accommodation: subject to availability, Resident Doctors are provided accommodation in the RMO Hostel. HRA: if no accommodation can be provided, HRA admissible as per rules is paid. Reservation and age relaxation are provided as per Govt. of India norms; EWS reservation follows the Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-(Estt (Res) dated 19 January 2019 and 31 January 2019.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NEIGRIHMS Junior Resident Doctors
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email. Eligible candidates submit the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I, together with scanned copies of the self attested certificates listed below, to [email protected] by 18 November 2026, up to 5:30 p.m. Fill the prescribed proforma at Annexure-I. Add scanned copies of the self attested certificates named in the notice. EWS candidates attach the certificate issued by the competent authority in the form prescribed at Annexure-II. OBC (NCL) candidates produce the latest OBC (NCL) certificate issued by the Competent Authority during the current financial year, 1.4.2026 to 31.3.2027. Email the application to [email protected] so that it is sent by 18 November 2026, 5:30 p.m. The documents submitted are screened before the interview, and only eligible candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria are allowed to appear in the interview. The date of the interview will be published on the Institute's website. Candidates bring the original documents to the Institute at the time of interview. Candidates with disabilities produce the original physically handicapped certificate, with degree of disability, issued by the Competent Authority (a Medical Board duly constituted by the Central or State Govt.). For queries, contact [email protected] or Phone Nos 0364-2538020 or 0364-2539-215/216.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Two recent passport size photos Certificate of Date of Birth (10th certificate) Certificate of EWS/SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) from the competent authority, if applicable MBBS passed certificate MBBS marksheets MBBS attempt certificate MBBS internship completion certificate Medical registration certificate for MBBS NOC from the present employer (if employed) MCI/NMC eligibility certificate for candidates passing from foreign medical institutions Result of the screening test for Indian nationals with foreign medical qualifications, issued by the National Board of Examinations All certificates are scanned copies that are self attested.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Resident Doctors vacancies are there at NEIGRIHMS?
faq.answer: There are 14 vacancies: UR 07, EWS 02, OBC 01, SC 03 and ST 01. One post is reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities in the non surgical departments.

faq.answer: A medical qualification included in Schedule I & II of the 3rd Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act 1956, satisfactory completion of the compulsory internship, and registration with the Central/State Medical Council.

faq.answer: Submitted documents are screened before the interview, and only eligible candidates are allowed to appear in the interview. The interview date will be published on the Institute's website.

faq.answer: Subject to availability, Resident Doctors get accommodation in the RMO Hostel. If no accommodation can be provided, HRA admissible as per rules is paid.

faq.answer: Candidates who completed the 1 (one) year tenure as Junior Resident (house job) in State or Central Govt. or PSU/Autonomous bodies, and employed applicants without an NOC, will not be allowed to appear.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential requirements also include willingness to work in shifts, including night duties, to ensure 24 × 7 study coverage. Desirable: Clinical research experience or experience in a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU), preferably for at least 6 months. Proficiency in Tamil and English. The notice says the consolidated salary may vary from time to time and that no other allowance or facilities beyond the consolidated salary will be extended. The likely duration is 33 months. The position is only for the duration of the project and depends on external funding. The engagement may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Nurse-III Job Description
content_sections.text: Screening eligible very preterm infants for participation in the SAFE-FEED trial. Assisting with participant enrolment and obtaining written informed parental consent in accordance with the approved protocol and delegated responsibilities. Performing study-related assessments and recording baseline maternal, antenatal and neonatal information. Supporting implementation of protocol-based feeding procedures in coordination with the treating clinical team. Applying sensors and performing NIRS monitoring according to the study protocol. Recording the study parameters/clinical data at specified monitoring time points. Monitoring study participants for protocol-defined outcomes and promptly communicating relevant clinical findings to the treating team. Maintaining accurate and timely case record forms, screening logs, enrolment logs, monitoring records and other study documentation. Ensuring adherence to the approved study protocol, standard operating procedures, infection prevention measures and participant confidentiality requirements. Coordinating with the study investigators and clinical team to ensure completion of scheduled study procedures and assessments. Working in shifts, including night duties, to provide 24 × 7 study coverage. Performing other duties related to the project as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.text: Fill in the application form attached to the notice (Application for the post of Project Nurse-III, SAFE-FEED Trial). Print it on A4 paper and fill it in block letters with a blue pen. Affix a recent passport size photo in the space on the form, without stapling. Attach the CV and the supporting documents, and scan the form, CV and documents together as one PDF. Name the PDF as "Candidate name_Post-name_year_application", for example "James_PN-III_2026_application". Email the PDF to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for PN-III – SAFE-FEED Trial". Send the email so that complete applications reach by 25 November 2026, up to 5:00 PM. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be processed or accepted. A candidate applying for two or more different posts must fill in a separate form for each post and send each in a separate email. A valid email ID and mobile number are compulsory. Documents named in the notice (all certificates self-attested and attached in this order): Proof of identity (copy of Aadhaar card, Voter ID, Passport or Driving License). Certificate in support of age (Tenth equivalent or High School Certificate). Degrees/Diplomas. Experience certificates. Any others, if relevant (specify). Proof of prior research experience, if any. The form also asks for educational qualifications from SSLC/Matriculation onwards (self-attested photocopies enclosed), details of previous employment with PDFs of proof of work, a description of previous work experience in up to 500 words, and contact details of previous employers. It carries a declaration signed by the applicant.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants are shortlisted on the details in the application, CV and documentary proof. The list of eligible candidates will also be displayed on the JIPMER website. Final selection is based on CV, application, written test and in-person interview. After the application form is evaluated, the recruitment process is a written test followed by an interview. The written test topics are neonatal nursing care, care of preterm and growth-restricted infants, enteral feeding practices and feeding protocol implementation, infection prevention and control, patient monitoring and documentation, research-related nursing responsibilities, and recognition and reporting of adverse events. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for a written test and/or interview. If the number of applications is very large, more stringent criteria than those specified may be used to determine eligibility. The interview may be conducted in person or by videoconferencing at the discretion of the Principal Investigator. For a videoconference, the candidate must arrange a device (computer, laptop or mobile) with audio and camera and an adequate internet connection. The date and time of interview will be notified one week in advance.

content_sections.text: The appointee is entitled to remuneration as per pay-scale. The notice does not name HRA separately; it states NPA and "other usual Allowances, as applicable". The appointee has to work in shifts and can be posted at any place or Centre attached to the Institute at the discretion of the MS/Dean/Executive Director. No extra allowance is admissible for such assignment. Senior Residents may be assigned to one or more departments and will need to work in emergency on rotation as needed. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits available to regularly appointed Government servants. Either side may end the appointment at any time by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason. A candidate who joins and leaves, resigns or is terminated before the tenure ends may do so with one month's prior notice, or by depositing pay and allowance in lieu for the shortfall. Earlier engagement as Senior Resident is counted along with this engagement against the prescribed period for SR ship. content_sections.heading: About DMFT Chatra Medical Officer
content_sections.text: The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Chatra, Jharkhand issued this recruitment notice for the District Mineral Foundation Trust (DMFT), Chatra. The DMFT will engage Medical Officers on a contractual basis at various health facilities under DMFT Chatra. According to the notice, the DMFT is floating these vacancies to strengthen the health sector of the district. The notice is signed by the Deputy Commissioner-cum-Chairperson, DMFT, Chatra.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice has 15 Medical Officer posts. The table below shows how these posts are divided by category. The notice defines these categories as per the Government of Jharkhand, and the Government of Jharkhand's reservation policy applies. Jharkhand candidates who claim reservation in their category (ST, SC, BC-I, BC-II) must submit the latest caste certificate in the prescribed format. This certificate must be issued by the competent authority of Jharkhand State. EWS candidates must attach the latest income certificate issued by the Govt. of Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Candidates must have valid medical registration with the National Medical Commission (NMC) / State Medical Council. The candidate should not have been convicted by any court of law. Candidates who are currently employed must enclose a "No Objection Certificate" from the employer, if applicable, as listed on the application form. The age limit is not specified in the notice. For the full eligibility conditions of the Medical Officer post, see the official notification.

rows.qualification: MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) with valid registration
rows.experience: Experience not mandatory

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: A Medical Officer receives ₹ 75000/ Month (Consolidated, full-time). The notice does not name any other allowance. TDS will apply as per Government rules. Salary and choice of posting are non-negotiable and rest purely with the selection committee, Chatra. The service is purely contractual for a period of one year and is a full-time role. Successful candidates must execute the one-year contractual agreement. The contract may be renewed subject to satisfactory performance. No claim for regularisation of the position will be entertained. Performance will be reviewed after completion of three months of service. Continuation depends on satisfactory performance during the probation period. If performance is unsatisfactory, the probation period may be extended by one to three months, as the competent authority deems appropriate. Either party may terminate the contract by giving one-month prior notice. Services may also be terminated if performance is not satisfactory. Leave is availed according to the provisions of the State Government. Selected doctors must serve full-time in the posted health institution. They will be posted as per requirement in any block or health institution of Chatra district. If the Government of Jharkhand or the Department of Health, Medical Education & Family Welfare, Jharkhand deploys Medical Doctors in Chatra district in the near future, the post will be dissolved and the contract terminated.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DMFT Chatra Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the recruitment section of the official website https://chatra.nic.in/ or from the Office of the DMFT, Chatra. The form is also printed on pages 5 and 6 of the notice. Fill in the form and paste a self-attested photograph. Then sign the declaration. Attach self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Write "Application for the Post of Medical Officer under DMFT, Chatra" clearly on the envelope. Submit the application by hand or send it by Registered Post/Speed Post to: The Deputy Commissioner-cum-Chairperson, 2nd Floor, District Mineral Foundation Trust (DMFT), Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Chatra, Jharkhand – 825401. The application must reach the office by 18/11/2026, till 05:00 PM. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered. The hiring process is a personal interview, and marks obtained in the interview are the criteria for selection. The interview date will be notified on the official website of Chatra district, https://chatra.nic.in/ . Candidates must bring the printout of the application form, all original documents/certificates and one set of self-attested copies to the interview. Candidates who do not bring these will not be allowed to appear in the interview. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.text: Selection is through an interview, and an MCQ examination may be conducted before the interview for shortlisting. content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: JIPMER, at Dhanvantari Nagar, Puducherry, was declared an Institution of National Importance by an Act of Parliament in 2008 and runs a hospital with more than 2000 beds. Its second campus, JIPMER Karaikal, was established in 2016 and trains students at the 506-bedded Government General Hospital, Karaikal. JIPMER has also set up a Multi-specialty Consulting Unit at Yanam to provide health care in selected specialties.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: JIPMER has advertised 9 Senior Resident posts in six departments. The department-wise and category-wise break-up is as follows. All Senior Residents recruited at JIPMER, Puducherry shall be posted to work at the JIPMER Karaikal Campus on rotation basis. Senior Residents recruited in the Department of Radiodiagnosis will be deputed to the Yanam Campus regularly and will make periodic visits to the Karaikal campus on rotation basis. Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) is 4%, provided on a horizontal basis. The minimum degree of disability is 40%, assessed by the JIPMER Medical Board, whose decision will be final. The acceptable disabilities for each department are given in JIPMER O.M No.Admin-I/DR/PwD/2021, dated 18-03-2023. Applicants of any category may be considered for a reserved seat only when no applicant of that reserved category is available; candidates of other categories, including Unreserved, will then be considered for appointment not exceeding beyond 40 days, which may be extended further by the competent authority if required. The vacancy position may be revised or changed as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: JIPMER invites applications from eligible Indian candidates. The essential qualification for each department is as follows. The crucial date for eligibility with regard to age and educational qualification is 16.11.2026. Candidates must complete all requirements for the qualifying degree, such as passing the examination and completing the mandatory period of Junior Residency, if any, by 16.11.2026. Those who do not fulfil these conditions need not apply. Appearing in the written exam or interview does not imply that a candidate is finally eligible. The full name in the application must match both the Govt. Photo ID card (Aadhaar, PAN, identity card, driving licence etc.) and the undergraduate degree certificate, in the same spelling and order. The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the crucial date, 16.11.2026. Age relaxation beyond the upper age limit is permitted as follows. OBC: a valid OBC certificate for posts under the Central Government, stating that the candidate does not belong to the Creamy Layer, issued in the current financial year, in the Annexure-I format. It must not be older than one year before 16.11.2026. EWS: persons not covered by SC, ST or OBC reservation whose family has a gross annual income below ₹ 8 lakh from all sources for the financial year before the year of application. A valid EWS certificate in the Annexure-III format is required, failing which the candidature will be rejected. SC/ST: a valid certificate in the Annexure-II format. SC, ST, OBC (NCL) and EWS certificates should be issued by a Tahsildar or higher authority. A certificate in a regional language must be uploaded with an English version attested by a Gazetted Officer. Disability: a certificate from a duly constituted Medical Board of a State or Central Govt. hospital or institution, countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital, in the Annexure-V format. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.answer: There are 9 Senior Resident posts: 2 in Neurology, 1 in Neurosurgery, 2 in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, 1 in Pathology, 2 in Radiodiagnosis and 1 in Transfusion Medicine (UR 6, OBC 2, SC 1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to register for the JIPMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Online registration through the Google Form closes on 16 November 2026 at 04.30 PM. It opened on 2 November 2026 at 11.00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JIPMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: An NMC/MCI-recognized MD/MS/DNB in the respective discipline is required. Neurosurgery needs MS/DNB in Surgery, and Neurology needs MD/DNB in Medicine/Paediatric, with MCh/DrNB or DM/DrNB holders also allowed to apply. The degree and Junior Residency must be complete by 16.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for JIPMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 45 years as on 16.11.2026. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10, 13 and 15 years for PwBD candidates of UR/EWS, OBC and SC/ST respectively.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a JIPMER Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.1,28,359/- per month consolidated, with no enhancement during the contract period.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the JIPMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.500 for General (UR), OBC (NCL) and EWS candidates and Rs.250 for SC/ST candidates; Persons with Disabilities are exempted. It is paid only online through SBI Collect and is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register through the Google Form linked on the www.jipmer.edu.in home page, upload the photograph, signature and certificates, pay the fee through SBI Collect, and upload the payment copy in the Google Form by 16.11.2026, 04.30 PM.

faq.question: Q8. How are JIPMER Senior Residents selected?
faq.answer: After certificate verification on 18.11.2026, candidates whose certificates are in order appear for an in-person interview. The interview carries 100% weightage, and candidates may be shortlisted if many applications are received.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the JIPMER Senior Residents be posted?
faq.answer: Senior Residents recruited at JIPMER, Puducherry will work at the JIPMER Karaikal Campus on rotation basis. Radiodiagnosis Senior Residents will be deputed to the Yanam Campus regularly, with periodic visits to Karaikal.

faq.question: Q10. Is the JIPMER Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract appointment advertised for 11 months. The terms state 12 months at a time, continued up to 3 years on the HOD's recommendation and the Competent Authority's discretion.

content_sections.heading: AMCH Technical Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: Act as a focal point for Rare Disease Clinic as the CoEs. Provide technical and strategic support for planning, coordination and implementation of rare disease-related activities. Coordinate with clinical departments for diagnosis, investigations and formulation of treatment plans. Facilitate documentation, application review and approval process for patient support. Liaise with MoHFW, State Governments, and other stakeholders for fund disbursement and compliance. Coordinating with the spokes in matters of proposal for equipment and consumables procurement, demand for funds, submission of utilization certificates etc. Track drug procurement and ensure timely availability and logistics for therapy. Guide and monitor ABHA ID generation and digital health record maintenance. Ensure timely and accurate data reporting and analytics for MoHFW and interval reviews. Organize capacity-building sessions, trainings and awareness program at the CoE. Develop and disseminate IEC materials and media content for public and stakeholder awareness. Support development of treatment guidelines, SOPs, and other technical documentation. Manage patient data and regularly update the Rare Disease Registry and associated digital platforms. Assist in preparation of reports, summaries, and digital dashboards. Maintain proper patient records in both digital and physical formats, ensuring confidentiality. Provide counselling, guidance, and continuous support to rare disease patients and their caregivers.

content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian Nationals who satisfy all eligibility conditions. Eligibility will be considered as on the date of Interview.

content_sections.text: A Postgraduate Medical Degree, viz. MD/MS/DNB/MDS, in the respective discipline, recognized by NMC/DCI/NDC or an Institute of National Importance. Valid registration with NMC/State Medical Council/Dental Council of India (DCI). Only candidates declared passed in their qualifying degree exam on or before the date of Interview can apply. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Senior Resident Salary
content_sections.text: The pay scale is Rs. 67,700/- (Level-11, Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) plus usual allowances including NPA, as admissible under rules.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Senior Resident Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for one (01) year, extendable up to three (03) years. The total duration cannot go beyond three years under the Residency Scheme in any circumstances, including Residency services already rendered by the applicant. Candidates who have already completed 3 years of Senior Residency will not be considered. If a candidate has served as Senior Resident in any Institute/Hospital of Govt./Public Sector Undertaking/Autonomous Bodies, only the balance period will be considered, so that the total does not exceed 03 years. For posts at Sl. No. 27 to 40 (Annexure-IV), the appointment is for a maximum of 6 months, which may be further extended to a maximum of 6 months. If candidates are not available in the reservation category in which a seat was advertised, candidates from other categories including Unreserved will be considered for interview and appointment not exceeding 44 days.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Senior Resident Reservation
content_sections.text: Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS and PwBD candidates is as per Central Govt. rules/policy. Candidates claiming reservation must attach a copy of a valid category certificate issued by the appropriate authority. SC/ST: Category certificate as per the format in Annexure-I. OBC: Certificate from the competent authority as per Annexure-II for Central Government jobs, along with a certificate that the candidate does not belong to the Creamy Layer. The non-creamy layer certificate should be valid for the financial year 2026-2027; certificates issued from 1st April 2026 to the date of interview are considered valid. EWS: Reservation as per Govt. of India policy (Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) DoPT dated 19th January 2019 and 31st January 2019). EWS persons not covered under SC, ST and OBC reservation get 10% reservation. The certificate must be in the form prescribed in Annexure-III, valid for the financial year 2026-2027; certificates issued from 1st April 2026 to the date of interview are considered valid. PwBD: 4% of total vacancies is horizontally reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, as per Government of India guidelines. The disability certificate should be issued by a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of the State or Central Govt. Hospitals/Institutions, conforming to Ministry of Social Welfare and Empowerment guidelines, and countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution as the case may be. Annexures I, II and III (certificate formats) were not included in the documents provided, so their contents are not reproduced here.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhopal Senior Resident Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification mentions that a written test/interview will be conducted at AIIMS Bhopal-462020 (MP). Date, time and venue details will be uploaded on the Institute website in due course. The exact stages and any marks distribution are not specified in the provided notification. Tie cases (more than one candidate with the same marks in the interview) are resolved on date of birth. The older candidate is ranked above the younger candidate. Selected candidates will undergo a medical examination/test to ascertain medical fitness. If not found fit, the offer of appointment will be treated as withdrawn. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the selection process.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required at the Time of Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates should bring original documents and one set of self-attested copies, along with the print-out of the online filled/offline filled application form. Candidates who do not produce the original documents at the time of interview will not be considered/allowed for the recruitment/selection process. Demand Draft of requisite fee in favour of Executive Director, AIIMS, Bhopal. Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.). Address Proof. Five recent passport size photographs. Certificate showing Date of Birth (10th Certificate/Birth Certificate). UG/PG Marksheets & Certificates/Degree. Internship Completion Certificate and Attempt Certificate. Registration with National Medical Commission/State Medical Council/Respective Council. FMGE certificate issued by NBE (for foreign graduates). No Objection Certificate from present employer. Category Certificate (OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PwBD). Publications, if any. Experience Certificate. Any other relevant information/documents.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is under the Government of India's Residency Scheme, and engagement is regulated as per the CCS (Temporary Service Rules). Either side can end the appointment by giving one month's notice or paying one month's salary, without assigning any reason. The appointment can also be terminated for failure to complete the period of three months to the satisfaction of the competent authority. Appointees may work in shifts and can be posted at any place in the Institute, at the discretion of the Medical Superintendent, Dean or Director. Additional duties may be assigned, with no extra allowance. Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion and other benefits of regular Government servants are not available. Leave follows Institute rules and Government of India instructions. No NOC will be given within one month of joining, and no experience certificate will be given to those resigning within 1 month after joining. Selected candidates must be declared medically fit by the competent Medical Board. Selected candidates get 14 days to join. An extension may be granted in exceptional situations, and if a candidate does not join, the offer stands cancelled and the post goes to a waitlisted candidate, if any. Candidates must not have been convicted by any Court of Law, and any pending disciplinary proceedings must be reported in writing at document verification. Canvassing leads to disqualification, and incomplete applications are rejected. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the High Court, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a walk-in interview at AIIMS Mangalagiri?
faq.answer: No. The notice states "No Walk-in Interview", so candidates must first apply through the Google Form.

faq.question: Q2. Can M.Sc candidates apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Yes, in Anatomy and Pharmacology, if they also hold a Ph.D as specified for that department. Their pay is Rs. 56,100 in Level-10 plus other allowances.

faq.question: Q3. Do I pay again if I apply to two departments?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate fee is required for each department, so a General candidate applying to two departments pays Rs. 1500/- for each.

faq.question: Q4. How long does the appointment last?
faq.answer: It is a whole-time appointment for 12 months at a time and can continue up to 3 years. Continuation depends on the HOD's recommendation and the Competent Authority's discretion.

faq.question: Q5. Will there be a written test?
faq.answer: Only if the number of applicants is high. In that case, an MCQ screening test in the subject concerned comes before the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply if my postgraduate result is still awaited?
faq.answer: Only candidates declared successful in the qualifying degree examination, who will complete its tenure on or before 21 November 2026, are eligible.

faq.question: Q7. I work in a government institute. What do I need?
faq.answer: You must apply through proper channel and produce an original No Objection Certificate from your employer at the interview. It must clearly state that you will be permitted to join AIIMS Mangalagiri if selected.

faq.question: Q8. Can a Senior Resident do private practice?
faq.answer: No. Private practice of any kind is prohibited, and appointees cannot accept any other assignment, paid or otherwise, during the contract.

faq.question: Q9. Can UR candidates be selected against EWS posts?
faq.answer: Yes, they may be considered if suitable EWS candidates are not found. There are 5 EWS posts in this advertisement.

Either side can end the engagement with one month's notice. Poor performance or absence without permission can lead to termination. The company can also terminate forthwith for prolonged medical unfitness, moral turpitude, conviction, insolvency, loss of licence to practise, misconduct or financial irregularity. The engagement is purely contractual and gives no right to regular appointment in Salem Steel Plant. All company assets must be used properly and returned at the end of the contract.

faq.answer: The single GDMO post is reserved for OBC, so candidates should carry their caste certificate for document screening.

faq.answer: MBBS from a University/institute recognized by MCI, with MCI/NMC/SMC registration or a valid practitioner licence and enrolment in the State or National Register.

faq.answer: Candidates can be up to 69 years old as on the date of advertisement, 30 October 2026.

content_sections.text: Download the official notification and print the Annexure-I application form, "Application for the post of Radiologist (Purely Temporary on Part time Contractual basis)". Fill in your name in block letters, your father's or husband's name, date of birth and age, sex, and your permanent and correspondence addresses with PIN codes. Also give your telephone or mobile number and your email ID. Enter the percentage of marks you got in Madhyamik or equivalent, HS/10+2 or equivalent, MBBS and MD or equivalent. Also enter your West Bengal Medical Council registration number and your experience. Paste a self-attested, passport-size colour photograph in the box on the form. Sign the declaration and add the place and date. Send the application to: Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Pearson Memorial Hospital, Visva-Bharati, Santiniketan, Birbhum, PIN-731235. It must reach the office before 5:00 p.m. on 20 November 2026. Documents to attach (self-attested): Aadhaar card, as proof of your name and your father's or husband's name Proof of date of birth and age, preferably a Birth Registration Certificate Educational certificates: Madhyamik, HS/10+2, MBBS and MD or equivalent West Bengal Medical Council registration certificate Proof of experience Under the declaration on the form, your candidature or engagement may be cancelled or ended without notice if any information is found to be false or incorrect, or if you are found ineligible at any stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many Radiologist posts are vacant at Pearson Memorial Hospital?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) Radiologist post, filled on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly pay for the Radiologist?
faq.answer: It is a consolidated remuneration or consultation fee of Rs. 75,000/- per month. No DA, HRA, TA or other allowances are paid on top of it.

faq.question: Q3. Is this a full-time job?
faq.answer: No. The Radiologist works part-time, in one session of 3 hours a day, 6 days a week.

faq.question: Q4. Where do I send the application?
faq.answer: Send it to the Office of the Chief Medical Officer, Pearson Memorial Hospital, Visva-Bharati, Santiniketan, Birbhum, PIN-731235. It must reach the office before 5:00 p.m. on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Which medical registration do I need?
faq.answer: You need permanent registration with the West Bengal Medical Council. Attach a self-attested copy of it to the application.

faq.question: Q6. Is experience required?
faq.answer: Experience is not mandatory. One year of experience after passing the MD or equivalent examination is listed as desirable.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The first contract is for six months from the date of joining, or until a regular candidate joins, whichever is earlier. It may be extended if the Authority is satisfied with your service and the post has not been filled permanently.

faq.question: Q8. How will I know if I am called for the interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview through the email ID they give in item 8 of the application form.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside West Bengal apply?
faq.answer: Any Indian citizen can apply. The notice says those living in West Bengal are preferred, and permanent registration with the West Bengal Medical Council is mandatory.

content_sections.heading: About CMO Raebareli
content_sections.text: The Office of the Chief Medical Officer is the district health office for Raebareli in Uttar Pradesh. Under the National Health Mission, U.P., it runs several programmes in the district, including NP-NCD, District Hospital Strengthening, the blood bank, telemedicine and the urban Ayushman Arogya Mandirs. This revised walk-in notice follows the Mission Director, NHM U.P., Lucknow letter no. 179/एस0पी0एम0यू0/एन0एच0एम0/डिस्ट्रिक वॉक-इन/2023-24/4150, dated 18.08.2023.

Blood Bank: Preferably DCP, or one year of experience in a blood bank during regular service, plus adequate knowledge and experience of blood group serology, blood group methodology and the medical principles of procuring blood and/or preparing its components. content_sections.text: The posts are purely contractual, with a fixed honorarium. A selected doctor cannot claim a permanent post. The appointment is valid for one financial year, up to 31.03.2027. It may be extended after approval from the Government of India. The number of posts and the honorarium may change at any stage of the recruitment. If any adverse fact comes to light, the interview or the contract of a selected candidate can be cancelled. No travel allowance or daily allowance is paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: AVNL Consultant – Business Development (Naval Domain) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Consultant for Business Development (Naval Domain) will perform the following job description: Establish strategic engagement with Naval Headquarters, Naval Commands, Dockyards, Coast Guard Headquarters, Shipyards and Maritime Defence Organizations. Identify opportunities for AVNL to diversify into naval logistics and shore-based military mobility systems. Advise AVNL Management on Indian Navy operational requirements, platform modernization, emerging doctrines, and long-term diversification strategy. Conduct market research on international naval support equipment and recommend products suitable for indigenous development. Submit strategic market intelligence reports, competitor analysis technology assessments and annual business development plans to AVNL management. Co-ordinate with DRDO laboratories, MDL, GRSE, CSL, GSL, HSL, BEL, BDL and private shipyards for collaborative product development. Monitor modernization plans, AoN, RFI, RFP and procurement programmes related to Navy. Identify opportunities for AVNL participation in future naval infrastructure and maritime security projects. Promote AVNL products during naval exhibitions, maritime security forums and defence industry events. Identify export opportunities for logistics, security and support vehicles. Prepare long-term business diversification plans covering maritime logistics, coastal security, disaster response and defence infrastructure support.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhopal
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal is a medical institute at Saket Nagar, Bhopal – 462020, Madhya Pradesh. This walk-in is conducted under the Dean (Academics), AIIMS Bhopal. Candidates selected will work as Junior Residents (Non-Academic) within the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice advertises one post, Junior Resident (Non-Academic), with 20 vacancies. Eligibility is judged as on the date of interview, 19 November 2026. The 20 vacancies are split by category as shown below. The 20 posts include 01 post for PwBD candidates. PwBD reservation follows Government of India norms, with 4% of the total vacancies horizontally reserved for candidates with benchmark disabilities. A Medical Degree viz. MBBS in respective disciplines recognized by NMC/Institute of National Importance. Internship completed within 5 years of the date of interview. Valid registration with NMC/State Medical Council. Only candidates who have been declared passed in their qualifying degree exam and will complete their course tenure on or before the date of interview are eligible. Foreign medical graduates must produce an FMGE certificate conducted by NBE. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. The upper age limit is 33 years as on the last date of submission of application, which is the date of interview (19 November 2026). The upper age limit is relaxed as follows: A Junior Resident (Non-Academic) gets Rs. 56,100/- (Level-10, Cell No. 01 as per 7th CPC) plus usual allowances including NPA as admissible under rule(s). The appointment is for 6 months and can be extended for another six months. In selected cases, the Institute can give an extension beyond two terms. The appointment is purely contractual and need-based. Applicants whose services were terminated on any disciplinary ground cannot be considered for the Junior Resident (NA) post, even if they otherwise qualify. Reservation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS and PwBD candidates follows Central Govt. rules/policy. Candidates claiming reservation must attach a copy of a valid category certificate issued by the appropriate authority: SC/ST: category certificate in the format at Annexure-I. OBC: certificate from the competent authority in the format at Annexure-II for Central Government jobs, along with a non-creamy layer certificate valid for the financial year 2026-2027. Certificates issued from 1 April 2026 to the date of the walk-in interview are valid. EWS: certificate from the competent authority in the form at Annexure-III, valid for the financial year 2026-2027. Certificates issued from 1 April 2026 to the date of the walk-in interview are valid. EWS reservation follows DoPT Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res) dated 19 January 2019 and 31 January 2019. It gives 10% reservation to EWS persons not covered by the SC, ST and OBC reservation scheme. PwBD: a disability certificate from a duly constituted and authorized Medical Board of a State or Central Govt. hospital or institution. It must be countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital/Institution, as the case may be. The Medical Board must follow the guidelines of the Ministry of Social Welfare and Empowerment, Govt. of India. The fee is paid only by Demand Dr

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: There is no online application. Candidates bring the duly filled application form in the prescribed format, which is available on the AIIMS Bhopal website, www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in. Along with the form, bring the following originals and one set of self-attested copies: Proof of fee deposited (Demand Draft), if applicable Certificate showing Date of Birth (10th Certificate/Birth Certificate) Photo Identity Proof (PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhar Card etc.) Address proof UG all Mark Sheets and Degree/Certificate Internship Completion Certificate Registration with National Medical Commission/State Medical Council/Respective Council Category Certificate (OBC/SC/ST/EWS/PwBD) issued by the competent authority, if applicable Attempt Certificates FMGE certificate conducted by NBE (for foreign graduates) NOC, if applicable Photographs – 5 Nos. Copies of any other relevant documents Candidates who do not produce these original documents at the interview will not be considered or allowed into the selection process.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The notice says selection will be by a written test, an interview or both, as decided by the Institute authority. Written test: This is held if there are more than 20 candidates for any particular post. The top 15 merit candidates for each post are shortlisted for the interview. Written test marks only decide who qualifies for the interview. Interview: Selection is based on interview performance alone. Ties: If two or more candidates have the same interview marks, the older candidate (earlier date of birth) is ranked higher.

During the two-year engagement, either side can end the services with one month's notice in writing. content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: M.A./M.Sc. in Psychology/Clinical Psychology (Completed) with a minimum of one year of experience in providing counselling to students at educational institutes, hospitals, or mental health clinics. Desirable Qualifications: Experience in counselling adolescents aged 18 to 30 years, preferably in a residential institution, counselling centre, or psychiatric clinic. Ability to administer and interpret psychometric tests. Membership of professional societies is desirable. Age Limit: Up to 35 years. Candidates with higher desirable experience will be preferred. The closing date for submission of applications is considered as the cut-off date for age.

content_sections.heading: SVNIT Counselling Psychologist Job Description
content_sections.text: Individual Counselling & Psychological Support: Provide confidential, professional, one-to-one counselling services to students experiencing psychological, emotional, academic, social, behavioural, interpersonal, or personal concerns. Support students in managing stress, anxiety, depression, examination pressure, homesickness, adjustment difficulties, relationship concerns, grief, trauma, low self-esteem, loneliness, and other psychosocial challenges. Conduct psychological screening and assessments, develop individualized support plans, and provide follow-up and continuity of support. Crisis Intervention & Emergency Psychological Response: Provide timely psychological first-line support and crisis intervention in cases of acute emotional distress, suicidal ideation, self-harm risk, substance-use concerns, violence, harassment, trauma, or severe behavioural concerns. Undertake risk identification, safety planning, and intervention. Coordinate with Institute authorities, medical personnel, hostel administration, wardens, and emergency services while maintaining confidentiality. Mental Health Promotion, Awareness & Preventive Program: Design and conduct a structured calendar of mental health awareness, preventive, and wellness programs. Organize workshops, awareness campaigns, and interactive sessions. Conduct sensitization programs for students, faculty, staff, and other stakeholders to improve awareness and early identification of mental health concerns.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in the prescribed format. Duly attested copies of all certificates and mark-sheets. Appropriate conversion formula to percentage or CGPA/GPA calculator (in case of CGPA/GPA). All supporting documents, which must be self-attested.

content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting followed by a personal interview. Shortlisting: The Institute will decide shortlisting parameters, and adequate numbers of shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Fulfilling minimum qualifications and experience does not vest any right in a candidate for being called for an interview. Interview: Final selection is based on the performance of the candidate during a personal interview held at SVNIT Surat. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the interview.

content_sections.text: The Government of Assam has announced 256 Chief Minister's Fellow positions to support entrepreneurship development and implementation of the CMAAA programme across the state.

content_sections.heading: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must hold an MBA, MBA-equivalent qualification or Master's degree in Social Sciences, Public Policy or Development Studies from a reputed university or institution, with a meritorious academic record and at least 60% marks or equivalent CGPA in the qualifying postgraduate qualification. Important Marks Clarification: The 60% minimum applies only to the qualifying postgraduate degree or MBA-equivalent qualification. Candidates are not separately required to have 60% marks in Class 10, Class 12 or graduation. Where CGPA is awarded, candidates must calculate the equivalent percentage according to the conversion formula prescribed by their university or institution. The notification gives preference to candidates from premier institutions such as: Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs). Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs). Institute of Rural Management Anand (IRMA). Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS). National Institute of Rural Development (NIRD). Professionals working in multinational companies or international organisations who wish to take a sabbatical and contribute to the social sector are also welcome to apply, provided they meet the prescribed eligibility requirements. Applicants should be prepared to work closely with government departments, entrepreneurship beneficiaries and other programme stakeholders across Assam.

content_sections.text: The fellowship duration is 24 months . Selected candidates are expected to join in December 2026 and undergo orientation, exposure visits and on-the-job training. Performance will be evaluated every six months against mutually agreed Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Continuation of the fellowship depends on the outcome of these evaluations.

content_sections.heading: Assam Chief Minister's Fellow Job Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Fellows will help CMAAA beneficiaries develop viable business ideas and support entrepreneurship development across Assam. Mentor beneficiaries in developing their business ideas into viable enterprises. Support project planning, enterprise development and entrepreneurship activities. Work with the Office of the Chief Executive Officer, CMAAA Society. Coordinate with District Industries and Commerce Centres. Collaborate with District Commissioners and other government departments. Help beneficiaries connect with banks and financial institutions. Work with universities, research stations, NABARD and NEDFi. Coordinate with progressive farmers, local entrepreneurs and start-ups. Support programme implementation and stakeholder coordination. Contribute to performance monitoring and achievement of agreed programme objectives. Selected Fellows will be placed across Assam according to programme requirements. Their assignments may involve working with CMAAA Society, District Industries and Commerce Centres, District Commissioners and other relevant departments.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be Advocates enrolled under a Bar Council as per the Advocates Act, 1961. In the case of a law firm, the application must be submitted through an Advocate enrolled under a Bar Council as per the Advocates Act, 1961. The qualifying experience is reckoned from the date of enrolment mentioned on the Certificate of Enrolment issued by the Bar Council for High Courts or Subordinate Courts/Tribunals. Cumulative experience is counted, but at the date of application, the applicant must be actively practising in the forum for which empanelment is sought. For empanelment before the Supreme Court of India, Advocates who are regularly practicing in the Supreme Court (including Advocates-on-Record) will be considered. Designation as an Advocate-on-Record in the Supreme Court of India, Orders or Judgments of the Supreme Court noting appearance, or a Certificate of Practice serves as valid proof of 10 years of practice. Applicants must possess excellent communication skills, drafting skills, and court craft, and maintain a fully functional working office with adequate infrastructure. Due weightage will be given to Advocates having experience in handling cases of Central Public Sector Enterprises and Government Departments. Applicants should also be familiar with relevant branches of law, including Mining Laws (Coal Mines), Land Acquisition Law, Competition Law, Constitutional Law, Company Law (including SEBI Guidelines), Forest and Environmental Law, Service Law, Labour Law, Law of Contract, Commercial Law, Property Laws, and Taxation, and be well conversant with practice rules in Supreme Court, High Courts, Subordinate Courts, and Tribunals.

content_sections.text: The initial empanelment will be for a period of five years from the date of receipt of acceptance of empanelment. content_sections.heading: CMPDI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities apply to all empanelled advocates and law firms across all designated forums: Represent Central Mine Planning & Design Institute Limited (CMPDI) and its officers/officials before the Supreme Court of India, High Court of Delhi, High Court of Jharkhand, and other Courts and Tribunals within the jurisdiction of Delhi High Court and Jharkhand High Court at Ranchi. Provide CMPDI with legal advice and legal opinions as and when requested.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMPDI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the designated online application portal at aeap.cmpdi.co.in. Fill in the online application in the prescribed proforma. Select and mention the forum or forums (Courts) where empanelment is sought (applicants applying exclusively for tax matters must select the relevant option). Upload self-attested scanned copies of your bio-data and relevant supporting documents, ensuring seals, stamps, signatures, names, authorities, and dates are clearly visible. Submit the completed online application on or before 15 November 2026. Applications submitted through email or in hard copy will not be entertained. Advocates and law firms already empanelled with CMPDI or who have previously applied must submit a fresh application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received will be scrutinized by CMPDI, and suitability will be adjudged based on the following parameters: Length of practice and specialization in the area of law relevant to the company. Proper and adequate infrastructure, such as office premises, number of junior advocates, assistants, clerks, fax, mobile phone, fixed phone, and internet connection. Annual income-tax return filed with the Tax Authorities for the last three years. Current and past empanelment by other organizations, establishments, regulators, and especially by Public Sector Enterprises and Government Departments. Notable achievements. The decision reached by CMPDI will be final and binding, and no communication will be entertained in this regard.

The official notice specifies the contact phone number as 011-23435241 and official email as [email protected] for administrative reference. Incomplete, unsigned, and the application received not on prescribed proforma and after the last date of receipt of applications shall be rejected summarily, without any notice to the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Vacancies & Place of Posting: 02 posts (01 - Chennai, 01 - Bhopal). Educational Qualification: Officers possessing Bachelors degree in Law from a recognised university and holding; (a) analogous post on regular basis in Central Government or State Government or courts or tribunals; OR (b) post in Central Government or State Government or courts or tribunals, with five years regular service in pay band -3, Rs. 15600-39100/- with grade pay of Rs. 6600/- i.e. Level-11 in the Pay Matrix, as per 7th CPC. Vacancies & Place of Posting: 01 post at Pune. Educational Qualification: Officers possessing a Bachelors degree in Law from a recognized university and holding: (a) Analogous post on regular basis in Central Government or State Government or courts or tribunals; OR (b) Post in Central Government or State Government or courts or tribunals with five years regular service in pay band-2, Rs. 9300-34800/- with grade pay of Rs. 5400/- i.e, Level 9 in the pay matrix; OR Six years regular service in grade pay of Rs. 4800/- i.e, Level 8 in the pay matrix; OR Seven years regular service in grade pay of Rs. 4600/- i.e, Level 7 in the pay matrix; OR Ten years regular service in grade pay of Rs. 4200/- i.e, Level 6 in the pay matrix. Age Limit: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation shall not be exceeding fifty-six years as on the closing date of receipt of application. Period of Deputation: Period of deputation including the period of deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately preceding this appointment in the same or some other organisation or department of the Central Government shall ordinarily be three years. Feeder Category Restriction: The departmental officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment on deputation. Similarly, deputationists shall not be eligible for consideration for appointment by promotion. Pre-2006 Service Calculation: For the purpose of appointment on deputation basis, the service rendered on a regular basis by an officer prior to 1st January, 2006 or the date from which the revised pay structure based on the recommendation of the Sixth Central Pay Commission has been extended, shall be deemed to be the services rendered on the corresponding grade pay or pay scale extended based on the recommendation of the said Pay Commission except where there has been merger of more than one pre-revised scale of pay into grade with a common grade pay or pay scale, and where this benefit will extend only for the post, for which that grade pay or pay scale is the normal replacement grade without any upgradation. Rules Reference: Please refer to NGT Recruitment Rules, 2011 and G.S.R.1362 (E) dated 02.11.2017 of MoEF&CC, Govt. of India notification which is available in the NGT website (https://greentribunal.gov.in).

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The following documents must be attached with the application form and forwarded through the proper channel: Application form in the prescribed proforma. Relevant documents towards educational qualification. Experience documents. Copies of ACRs of the last five years. Vigilance clearance. Integrity certificate. Certified that the particulars furnished by the candidate have been verified from service record and found correct, and no vigilance case is pending or contemplated against the officer. Undertaking that if the officer is selected, he / she shall be relieved within 15 days of receipt of appointment letter.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: The Competent Authority reserves the right either to fill up the posts or not to proceed for appointment without assigning any reason thereof. (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time shall be made applicable as notified by the DoPT, Govt. of India. basic_details.job_title: BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow (Chemical Engineering) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus has one Junior Research Fellow vacancy on the project "Rational design of broad-spectrum antifungal peptides and peptide-based enzyme mimics for neutralization of mycotoxins", run from the Chemical Engineering and Chemistry departments. The fellowship is ₹48,100 per month including HRA @30% for 24 months. Applicants need an M.E./M.Tech., M. Pharm. or M.Sc. in the listed disciplines with at least 60% marks and must fill the Google form by 16 November 2026. The tentative online interview date is 23 November 2026.

qualification.details: A valid GATE/NET/any other National examination will be preferred. In Vitro Microbiology and Enzymology skills: antifungal assays, cytotoxicity assays, hemolysis assays, and functional assays for mycotoxin degradation, e.g. quantification via HPLC/ELISA. Experience in handling animal models for safety, pharmacokinetics and efficacy studies will be preferred.

how_to_apply: Open the Google form given in the notice: https://forms.gle/2HkVknX2J3LQJEBF6.
Fill the form before the last day to apply, 16 November 2026.
Keep your email inbox ready, because shortlisted candidates are notified by email.

The notice names no documents to attach and does not describe the form fields. Enquiries can be addressed to Prof. Debirupa Mitra, Chemical Engineering Department, BITS Pilani Hyderabad Campus, [email protected].
