content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post: Training Officer (Senior Professional) – Training Business Development & Programme Management, post code HRM-01, number of persons required 1. MBA in any discipline from a recognized institution. Specialization in Marketing or Human Resource Management is preferred. Minimum two years of relevant professional experience in marketing, business development, client relationship management, training coordination, event management or a related field. Experience in marketing training programmes, corporate learning and development, private-sector client acquisition or hospitality coordination is desirable. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Strong interpersonal, networking and follow-up skills. Proficiency in MS Office, social media and digital communication tools. Ability to independently coordinate training programmes and willingness to travel as required. The age limit is not specified in the notice. The application form asks for the date of birth with a self-attested proof. Remuneration: consolidated remuneration up to ₹50,000 per month, in accordance with the applicable Administrative Instructions of NPC and the marks/recommendations given by the selection committee. Annual increments and other entitlements: as per the applicable Administrative Instructions of NPC. Type of engagement: full-time contractual. Contract period: one year, extendable on a need basis up to a maximum total period of three years, subject to satisfactory performance and approval of the competent authority. Travel: official travel and admissible expenses shall be governed by applicable NPC rules and instructions. Place of deployment: HRM Group, NPC Headquarters, New Delhi. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: NPC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the work responsibilities of the Training Officer (Senior Professional) under six heads. Publicize HRM training programmes through email campaigns, follow-ups and participant mobilisation. Identify Government, PSU and private-sector clients; maintain a database of prospective participants and organisations. Generate leads, prepare/follow up proposals, and develop customized residential, in-company and online programmes, including webinars. Identify opportunities for pre-promotion and other specialized/customised training programmes. Identify potential consultancy requirements related to HRM while performing the above activities. Coordinate residential, in-company and online programmes, including participant communication, faculty and client liaison, venue/hotel arrangements and on-site management; travel as required. Welcome and assist participants, represent NPC in routine programme coordination, and coordinate conduct of training, participant departure and programme closure. Coordinate attendance, feedback, bills, supporting documents, participants' fee and internal invoicing follow-up, and programme completion reports. Maintain records and periodically report on nominations, occupancy, proposals, new client leads, consultancy leads and hotel empanelment to the Group Head (HRM). Coordinate the annual preparation of NPC's Training Calendar by collecting programme details from all Groups and Regional Directorates (RDs). Compile and standardise the information, and follow up with the concerned units for timely submission and revisions. Coordinate its publication on the NPC website after obtaining the approval of the competent authority. Coordinate hotel empanelment across India for NPC Groups and RDs. Maintain an updated location-wise database of hotels, facilities, tariffs, validity and service quality. Follow up renewals, address non-availability or withdrawal issues related to hotels, and identify suitable alternatives at key locations. Undertake any other duties and responsibilities as may be assigned by the Group Head (HRM) from time to time, based on the functional requirements and needs of the office.

content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 30 September 2026. Age, qualification and experience are all reckoned on this date. 3 years full-time bachelor's degree in law (L.L.B) or 5 years full-time integrated law course (B.A. L.L.B/ B.Sc. L.L.B), recognized by the Bar Council of India (BCI), from a recognized Indian university/institute. 60% or more marks in the qualifying degree examinations. If the university or institute awards letter grades or a point scale, a certificate from it linking the grade or point scale to percentage of marks must be submitted. Minimum 05 years' post-qualification experience in a reputed organisation. The candidate should be well conversant with the Contract Act, Labour Arbitration, in particular general laws, and proficient in drafting agreements/conveyance deeds and other service regulation in government services. Only full-time work experience counts, from the date of registration with the Bar Council and/or the date of joining employment, as applicable. Internships during the LLB programme are not considered experience. Preference will be accorded to incumbents from Govt./CPSEs/Autonomous bodies. Only Indian nationals are eligible to apply. Computer proficiency is essential for the post. Reserved-category candidates who meet the criteria may apply for this UR post as per Govt. rules. content_sections.heading: About Unnao District Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Chairman, Selection Committee / District Judge, Unnao, for the District Court (Janpad Nyayalaya) Unnao. The re-employment of retired employees is being done in compliance with the Hon'ble High Court Allahabad's C.L. No. 14/Admin. (D) Section dated 15.10.2022. Two separate notices were issued on 05.11.2026: one for retired Class III employees (Junior Assistant) and one for retired Class IV / Sweeper employees.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be made in the prescribed format attached to the notice and submitted at the Administrative Office, District Court, Unnao by 17 November 2026, 5:00 PM. The notice does not print a full postal address with PIN code and does not mention sending the application by post or email. Use the prescribed application form attached to the notice ("Application for employment on a vacant post to be filled through re-employment of retired employees in District Court Unnao"). Write the name of the post applied for at the top of the form. Fill in the details asked: name, father's / husband's name, date of birth, date of retirement, last post held and the name of the district court from where you retired, photo identity card details (ID card / Aadhaar card / other valid ID), permanent address, temporary address, mobile number, email ID and educational qualification. Attach a copy of the last drawn pay and the pension order – the form says this is mandatory. Sign the undertaking printed on the form, with the date and place (Unnao). Submit the application at the Administrative Office, District Court, Unnao before 5:00 PM on 17 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: For each post, the pay is the last drawn pay the applicant received on the related post, from which the pension amount is deducted; the balance is paid as honorarium. The notice does not print a fixed amount. The applicant should be physically and mentally fit. The applicant's character roll for the previous 5 years should be correct (clean). No criminal or civil case should be pending and registered against the applicant. The form asks for the educational qualification, but the notice does not specify a minimum educational qualification. The notice does not prescribe an age limit for applying; the tenure ends on completion of 65 years of age at the latest (see Important Instructions). Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility for each post.

content_sections.heading: About Unnao District Court
content_sections.text: District Court Unnao is the district judiciary of Unnao in Uttar Pradesh, under the High Court of Judicature at Allahabad. This re-employment drive is conducted by the Selection Committee chaired by the District Judge, Unnao, in compliance with the Allahabad High Court's C.L. No. 14/Admin. (D) Section dated 15.10.2022.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must fill in the prescribed application format attached to the notice and submit it at the Administrative Office (Prashasnik Karyalaya), District Court, Unnao by 5:00 PM on 17 November 2026. The notice does not mention submission by post or email. The application form, titled "Application for employment on vacant posts to be filled through re-employment of retired employees in District Court Unnao", asks for: Name of the post applied for Applicant's name, father's / husband's name and date of birth Date of retirement, and the last post held and the District Court from which the applicant retired Photo identity card details (identity card / Aadhaar card / other valid ID) Permanent address and temporary address Mobile number and email ID Educational qualification The form ends with an undertaking, signed by the applicant with the date and the place (Unnao).

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Retired Class III employees of the District Court (Janpad Nyayalaya), for re-employment. The applicant should be physically and mentally fit. The applicant's character roll for the past 5 years should be correct. No criminal or civil case should be pending and registered against the applicant. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification; the form only asks applicants to state theirs. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for the post. The pay for the post is the last drawn pay the applicant received on the post concerned, from which the pension amount is deducted; the balance is paid as an honorarium. The tenure runs for 1 year from the date of joining, or until the post is filled by direct recruitment or promotion, or until the employee completes 65 years of age, whichever is earlier. The appointment will be fully temporary and may be terminated without any prior notice if service is not found satisfactory.

rows.pay: Last drawn pay minus pension amount, as honorarium

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: A copy of the last pay drawn and the pension order (mandatory with the application form). The undertaking printed on the form, signed by the applicant. In the undertaking, the applicant declares that he or she is physically fit and capable of working on the post in District Court Unnao; that, to his or her knowledge, no penalty or entry has been given during service that would bar re-employment; that no criminal proceedings are pending against him or her; that no criminal or civil suit against or relating to him or her is pending in District Court Unnao; and that all information given is true, accepting full responsibility and any action if it is found false.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The applicant's past record and ACR will be the basis of appointment. The notice also requires the applicant's character roll for the last 5 years to be correct.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications received after 5:00 PM on 17 November 2026 will not be considered. Report between 10.00 a.m. and 10.30 a.m. Carry the following documents: Recent CV Passport size photograph Original and xerox copies of educational qualification certificates Original and xerox copies of work experience certificates Aadhaar Card as ID proof (original and xerox)

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the ACTREC walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on Tuesday, 17 November 2026, at Meeting Room I, Khanolkar Shodhika, 3rd Floor, ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai - 410210. Reporting is from 10.00 a.m. to 10.30 a.m.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary for Project Technical Support III?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 36,400 per month, made up of Rs. 28,000 plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification and experience are required?
faq.answer: An M.Sc. (Life Sciences) or equivalent with at least 60% marks, and at least 1 year of wet lab experience with direct experience with murine cancer models.

faq.question: Q4. Is a one-year M.Sc. accepted?
faq.answer: No. An M.Sc. degree of one-year duration will not be considered.

faq.question: Q5. Can candidates awaiting their final result apply?
faq.answer: No. The selected candidate has to join at the earliest, so result-awaited candidates are not eligible.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 years.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the engagement?
faq.answer: Six months, extendable. The candidate's work progress will be monitored, and an extension may be given after six months.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring?
faq.answer: A recent CV, a passport size photograph, and original and xerox copies of educational and work experience certificates, plus the Aadhaar Card as ID proof.

faq.question: Q9. Which project is the post attached to?
faq.answer: The project studies the mechanisms behind the failure of immune checkpoint blockade immunotherapies in oral cancer and alternatives for Indian patients. The Principal Investigator is Dr. Subir Biswas.

basic_details.short_information: The Centre for Applied Research in Electronics (CARE) at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi needs one Sr. Project Scientist for the project "A Unified IOT Architecture and Development Framework for 5G/6G Applications", funded by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology and running up to 14 March 2027. The consolidated pay-slab is Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 per month plus HRA @ 27%, and applicants need a 1st class M.Tech/MS(R) in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline with a valid GATE score. Indian nationals

Fill in the form with complete information on educational qualifications, indicating the percentage of marks/division, and details of work experience.
Write the advertisement number (IITD/IRD/312/2026) on the subject line of the e-mail.
Send the duly filled form by e-mail to Prof. Monika Aggarwal at [email protected].
Make sure the e-mail is sent by 17 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.
Documents named in the notice:
Duly filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 with educational qualifications (percentage of marks/division) and work experience details.
important_instructions: The post may be downgraded at the discretion of the Selection Committee if none of the candidates is found suitable for the post. Updates on short-listing and the online interview appear only at ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted; candidates not short-listed are not informed.

Card payments are unavailable between 23:30 and 00:30 IST.

or the GPA is multiplied by 10. In all other cases

Enter a valid email ID and keep it active for at least one year, as BHEL will send important information by email.
Download the application form from the website, fill it in, sign it and paste a photograph on it.
Attach the required documents and the printout of the State Bank Collect e-receipt, if applicable.
Write "Application for the post of FTA Grade III Official Language Translator (Hindi Translator)" clearly on the envelope.
Send it by post or courier to: Additional General Manager (HR), BHEL, Power Sector Southern Region, BHEL Integrated Office Complex, TNEB Road, Pallikaranai, Chennai – 600100.
Incomplete applications and those not in the format prescribed on the website will not be accepted. BHEL is not responsible for postal loss or delay.
Send self-attested copies of the following:
Aadhaar card, Class 10 certificate, passport or date of birth certificate
Category certificate, meaning a valid PwBD certificate or ex-servicemen discharge certificate, if applicable
Final consolidated, semester-wise or year-wise mark sheets
Proof of the university or institute's conversion norms, where the degree or diploma shows CGPA, OGPA, DGPA or a letter grade
Graduation and post-graduation certificates
Jammu and Kashmir certificate, if claiming that age relaxation
For PwBD candidates, a duly stamped medical certificate from a medical board of a government hospital or one attached to a special employment exchange

Experience proof: joining and relieving letters from the employer; or an experience or service certificate showing joining and relieving dates for each organisation; or a salary certificate with ITR or Form-16

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: if eligible applications exceed the set ratio of 1:25, candidates are shortlisted in that ratio on their marks in the relevant graduation degree, where applicable. Personal interview: eligible candidates are called for the interview. All candidates with the same cut-off marks in the relevant category are also called. Total marks are worked out from all subjects shown in all semester mark sheets. For a 10-point scale, equivalent marks follow the university or institute's stated calculation, or the GPA is multiplied by 10. In all other cases, the GPA is converted to a 10-point scale and multiplied by 10.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is fully temporary, for a maximum of 2 years or until the assignments are completed, whichever is earlier. The post is not against a permanent vacancy. It gives no right to future regular or permanent employment in BHEL.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BHEL Hindi Translator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Pay the fee through SB Collect, if it applies to you, and note the SB Collect reference number. Fill in the online application on the BHEL careers website with the fee details. PwBD, Jammu and Kashmir and ex-servicemen candidates must enter their category carefully, because it cannot be changed later. Enter a valid email ID and keep it active for at least one year, as BHEL will send important information by email. Download the application form from the website, fill it in, sign it and paste a photograph on it. Attach the required documents and the printout of the State Bank Collect e-receipt, if applicable. Write "Application for the post of FTA Grade III Official Language Translator (Hindi Translator)" clearly on the envelope. Send it by post or courier to: Additional General Manager (HR), BHEL, Power Sector Southern Region, BHEL Integrated Office Complex, TNEB Road, Pallikaranai, Chennai – 600100. Incomplete applications and those not in the format prescribed on the website will not be accepted. BHEL is not responsible for postal loss or delay. Send self-attested copies of the following: Aadhaar card, Class 10 certificate, passport or date of birth certificate Category certificate, meaning a valid PwBD certificate or ex-servicemen discharge certificate, if applicable Final consolidated, semester-wise or year-wise mark sheets Proof of the university or institute's conversion norms, where the degree or diploma shows CGPA, OGPA, DGPA or a letter grade Graduation and post-graduation certificates Jammu and Kashmir certificate, if claiming that age relaxation For PwBD candidates, a duly stamped medical certificate from a medical board of a government hospital or one attached to a special employment exchange Experience proof: joining and relieving letters from the employer; or an experience or service certificate showing joining and relieving dates for each organisation; or a salary certificate with ITR or Form-16 All these documents must be produced in original at the interview. Candidates who do not produce them will not be allowed to attend and will not get travel fare reimbursement.

faq.answer: Yes. SC, ST, ESM and PwBD candidates pay no processing fee, but sending the application form to the Pallikaranai address is still mandatory for them.

faq.question: Q3. Does apprenticeship count towards the 2 years of experience?
faq.answer: No. Any training or apprenticeship period is left out of the 2 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. Can a graduate apply without a Master's degree?
faq.answer: Yes, if the Bachelor's degree from a recognised university has Hindi and English as main subjects and the translation experience requirement is met.

faq.question: Q5. Will BHEL pay for travel to the interview?
faq.answer: Yes. On proof of travel, BHEL reimburses the actual to-and-fro fare up to second-class rail fare by the shortest route. The fare is counted from the starting station or the postal address, whichever is nearer to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q6. Can I change my category after submitting the online form?
faq.answer: No. PwBD, Jammu and Kashmir and ex-servicemen candidates will not be allowed to change the category later.

faq.question: Q7. Can this job become permanent?
faq.answer: The appointment gives no right to any regular or permanent job in BHEL, and the post is not against a permanent vacancy.

faq.question: Q8. What happens if false information is found after appointment?
faq.answer: BHEL may end the candidature or service without notice if a candidate gave false information, hid a relevant fact or did not meet the eligibility criteria. Any attempt at recommendation or undue influence is also a disqualification.

faq.answer: Any corrigendum or extension will be published only on the BHEL careers website. BHEL may cancel, limit, extend or reopen the process without notice or reasons. The notification is issued in Hindi and English, and the English version prevails if the two differ.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the essential academic qualifications and experience norms prescribed by the institute. M.Sc. in Life Science/ Bio Science/Biological Science with minimum 02 years of post-qualification experience. Good communication and facilitation skills; professional fluency in spoken-written English and spoken Hindi; good digital documentation skills. Experience in designing/conducting physical experiments, hands-on activities, use of lab instruments. 1 year experience in writing textbook chapters, or making learning modules for grades 8-12 in ed-tech.

Adapt-make-test-optimise the activities/ models/prototypes. Documentations of manuals, chapters, worksheets, presentations, videos, articles. Convert relevant activity for models ready to use in schools with product specifications. Coordinate and conduct the testing of content in schools.

content_sections.heading: About Navsari Collector Office

The panel is being formed because the Home Department of Gujarat issued instructions in circular no. HD/MIS/e-file/8/2026/3525/I-1, dated 17/07/2026. The panel will be prepared under Section 18(4) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and the Prosecuting Officer (Appointment and Conditions of Service) and Conduct of Government Legal Business Rules-2025. The notice is signed by Manish Gurwani, District Magistrate, Navsari.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the office website, https://navsari.nic.in/forms/ . The same form is also printed with the notice. Fill in every detail and attach the documents listed under Enclosures. Send the form by Speed Post only to this postal address: Office of the Collector and District Magistrate, Magistrate Branch, Jilla Seva Sadan, 1st Floor, Kaliyawadi, Navsari-396427. The form must reach the office by 19 November 2026 at the latest. The notice does not mention what to write on the envelope. The office phone number is 02637-246099 and its e-mail is [email protected] . The e-mail address is a contact address only; applications go by Speed Post. The form is addressed to the District Magistrate, with the subject "Appointment of Additional Public Prosecutor". It asks for the following details: Paste a recent passport-size photograph on the form and sign across it. Sign the form, and write the date and place at the end.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The Woman Public Prosecutor post is for the Special POCSO Court. The notice names it as a post for a woman public prosecutor. The notice gives the following conditions for applicants to both posts: Applications are invited from law graduates. The applicant must have been active as an advocate for at least seven years. The applicant must have been an income tax payer for at least 3 years before the appointment. The applicant must be not less than 30 years and not more than 55 years old. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age, and it lists no age relaxation. An appointed prosecutor may serve up to a maximum age of 60 years. Attested proof of any other qualification. A recent passport-size photograph, pasted on the form and signed. The form ends with a list of enclosures, with ten numbered rows. Write the details of each attested copy you attach in that list.

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: JIPMER is a medical education and research institute at Dhanwantri Nagar, Puducherry. This vacancy is for a contract post in a research project funded by an external agency, ICMR. The project principal investigator is Dr. Saranya B Gomathy of the Department of Neurology.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: Graduate degree in Occupational Therapy/ Physiotherapy (BOT/BPT) or Nursing (BSc Nursing), Sociology, Public Health or equivalent degree with three years of post-qualification experience or postgraduation in relevant field. Age: Not exceeding 35 years, as on the last date of receipt of applications. The notice does not list any age relaxation. Desirable: Experience in clinical research, stroke rehabilitation or telehealth related projects. Knowledge of telehealth and telerehabilitation guidelines and methods. Computer skills in MS Office, Excel, email and video-conferencing tools. Experience in using digital health platforms, mobile based applications and telehealth tools. Ability to converse in Tamil fluently. Proficiency in SPSS/STATA/R and data management software (Epicollect/REDCap). Qualification and experience should be in a relevant discipline/field and in a reputed institution/organization. The experience should have been gained after acquiring the essential qualification. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

The consolidated salary may vary from time to time, and no other allowance or facilities beyond it will be extended. The likely duration is one year, extended up to three years based on satisfactory performance of the candidate. The engagement may be extended or curtailed at the discretion of the Project Investigator.

content_sections.heading: JIPMER Project Technical Support – III Job Description
content_sections.text: Assist the Project Research Scientist in coordinating day to day project activities. Support screening, recruitment and enrolment of stroke survivors and caregivers. Assist in obtaining informed consent and maintaining participant records. Coordinate telerehabilitation sessions and follow-up visits. Assist in conducting baseline assessments and follow up. Support caregiver training and coordination with the multidisciplinary team. Monitor participant follow-ups and intervention activities. Assist in data entry, data management and preparation of project reports. Maintain bills, vouchers and other financial records and support project fund utilization. Perform other project related duties assigned by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: About APEDA
content_sections.text: APEDA is an autonomous organisation under the Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. The notice says it is mandated with the promotion of agricultural and processed food products from India and works to improve market access for Indian agricultural products at the international level. Its work includes addressing Sanitary and Phyto-Sanitary (SPS) and Technical Barriers to Trade (TBT) issues. The post is in APEDA Head Office, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go by email to [email protected] . The notice makes it mandatory to mention the position applied for. It does not print a subject line. The application must be typed and signed, in the prescribed format attached to the notice (pages 5 and 6). The notice states that the application should be submitted strictly in the prescribed format only. The form is addressed to: The Secretary, APEDA, 3rd Floor, 3 Siri Institutional Area August Kranti Marg, Hauz Khas, New Delhi - 110 016. The notice states 18 November 2026 by 1700 hrs as the last date of submission of application. It does not say whether this is for receipt or dispatch. A candidate shall submit only one application. Submitting more than one may lead to rejection. Along with the application, send the scan CV and self-attested copies of the relevant documents.

The notice prints an upper age limit of 50 years for the position of Associate. It does not print a minimum age, an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. The remuneration is inclusive of all applicable taxes, and no other facility or allowance will be allowed. While on tour, TA/DA is admissible to officials at Pay Level 10 of the Central Government. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail of the post.

content_sections.text: Signed and typed application in the prescribed format. Scan CV. Self-attested copies of the relevant documents. Self-attested copy of proof of age (as marked on the form). Self-attested copy of the essential educational qualification (as marked on the form). Self-attested copy of the experience certificate (as marked on the form). Recent passport size photograph, pasted on the form. The form asks for name in block letters, father's or husband's name, permanent and correspondence addresses, contact number and email ID, date of birth, nationality, educational and professional qualifications, post-qualification work experience, languages known and any other relevant information. It ends with the candidate's signature, date and place.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice says only shortlisted candidates will be contacted via email for the interview. Mere submission of an application does not give any right to be called for interview. The notice does not describe the shortlisting method or how the interview is conducted.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: The engagement is at the level of Associate and is purely on a contractual basis. The engagement is initially for one year, including a probation period of three weeks. It may be extended year-to-year depending on performance evaluation. After three years no further extension is permissible under any circumstances. The period of engagement commences from the date of joining at APEDA. It confers no claim or right to subsequent engagement or employment with APEDA or any other Government Department. Working hours are normally 9.00 AM to 5.30 PM on working days, including a half-hour lunch break. In exigencies of work the Associate may be required to sit late and to work on Saturday, Sunday and other holidays. The Associate is eligible for 20 days of leave in a year on pro-rata basis, with prior written approval of the controlling officer. Un-availed leave cannot be carried forward. Leave up to one month without remuneration can be considered with prior approval. A female Associate may be eligible for maternity leave as per the Maternity Benefit (Amendment) Act, 2017. The engagement can be terminated at any time by APEDA with 30 days' notice or pay in lieu. The Associate may also resign after giving similar notice.

content_sections.text: The competent authority may cancel any application or candidature at its discretion, and no correspondence will be entertained. APEDA may require a Statement of Good Health from a recognised physician before work starts. Before engagement, the Associate must submit a police verification report from the concerned police station and a medical-cum-fitness certificate from an authorised Medical Practitioner. The Associate will be governed by the Official Secrets Act, 1923, and must not use APEDA's name, emblem or official seal without prior written permission. In case of death, injury or illness while serving APEDA, the Associate or next of kin is not entitled to any compensation or appointment. content_sections.heading: BBAU Project Associate-I/JRF Eligibility 2026

content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview.

content_sections.text: The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The appointment is initially for one year. It is extendable for two (1+1) more years or till completion of the project (whichever is later), based on satisfactory performance. The position is prone to termination upon unsatisfactory performance, on one month of prior notice.

The university's website will carry any update or modification, so check it regularly before the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Which M.Sc. subjects are accepted for the BBAU JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice accepts an M.Sc. in any of four subjects: Geology, Earth Science, Environmental Science or Life Sciences.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets Rs. 37,000/- instead of Rs. 30,000/-?
faq.answer: Scholars selected through CSIR-UGC NET, including lectureship, or through a national level examination conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions get Rs. 37,000/- + HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your plain-paper application with your personal, educational and experience details, along with self-attested copies of all mark-sheets and certificates.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: It starts with one year and can be extended by two (1+1) more years or till completion of the project, whichever is later.

faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA shall be paid for the interview.

faq.answer: The ANRF-sponsored project covers hydrological mapping of Arsenic and Fluoride in the Ganga - Gomti Doab, including their co-occurrence, environmental dynamism and sustainable mitigation methods.

The fellowship pays ₹1,08,393 a month for up to one year. The hard copy of the application must reach the Department of Electronics and Communication by 18 November 2026, and a copy must also be sent by email.

content_sections.heading: About UoA
content_sections.text: The University of Allahabad describes itself on its letterhead as a Central University. It is in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh. The fellowship is based in the Department of Electronics and Communication, Science Faculty, and is offered under the Visvesvaraya Ph.D. Scheme of Digital India Corporation, MietY, Government of India (Implementation Order No.: PhD-02/PDF-2026/97).

content_sections.heading: UoA Postdoctoral Fellowship Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 40 years on the date the application is submitted. Reservation follows Government of India norms. A Ph.D. degree with research focused on Electronics System Design & Manufacturing (ESDM) or Information Technology/IT Enabled Services (IT/ITES). The Ph.D. must be from a recognised institution, with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) at every earlier level and a good academic record throughout. The Ph.D. must have been completed within the past 5 years, counted on the last date for applications. Candidates who earned their Ph.D. from the University of Allahabad are not eligible. Applicants must be Indian citizens. The fellowship goes to researchers with a proven academic record, including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions. Applicants in regular employment will not be considered. Scientists or researchers in temporary academic or research posts may apply, but they must give up those posts if selected. Anyone who has already received this fellowship under the scheme is not eligible. The research proposal must set out clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. Preference will go to applicants who have active links with industry and whose research proposal addresses industry-specific problems. See the official notification for the full discipline-specific eligibility for this post.

faq.answer: On top of ₹1,08,393 a month, there is a contingency grant of ₹1,00,000 a year and travel support of up to 2,10,000 a year as per norms.

faq.answer: No. The notice says candidates who completed their Ph.D. at the University of Allahabad are not eligible.

faq.answer: You must have completed it within the past 5 years, counted on the last date for applications, 18 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About KVIC Marketing Expert
content_sections.text: The Khadi and Village Industries Commission works under the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Govt. of India, and uses the brand name Khadi India. This notice comes from the Commission's State Office, Telangana, at Block - A, NI-MSME Campus, Yousufguda, Hyderabad - 500045. The Director signed it at Hyderabad on 25 October 2026. The Marketing Expert will be posted at this State Office, and the remuneration follows the "timely PMEGP / KVIC guidelines".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice accepts either of these two combinations: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or any other discipline with 5 years' experience in the relevant field, preferably in Small-Scale and Village Industries, Handicrafts, etc. OR MBA (Marketing) with 2 years' experience in the relevant field, preferably in Small-Scale and Village Industries, Handicrafts, etc. Experience in Small-Scale and Village Industries, Handicrafts and similar areas is "preferably" required: it is a preference, not a condition. Under "Experience", the notice lists: Previous experience in sales, marketing, advertising and brand management. Excellent analytical and data analysis skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Extensive knowledge of current and relevant markets in rural India for Village or Cottage Industries. Should be well-versed in Telugu. The maximum age is 40 years. The application format asks for the candidate's age as on the last date of application. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates who state SC/ST/OBC in the form must attach documentary proof. For the exact eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: a lump-sum consolidated amount of Rs. 50,000/- per month (as per timely PMEGP / KVIC guidelines). Allowances: no other allowance or benefit is admissible except as specifically provided by KVIC. Nature of engagement: purely contractual and temporary. The engagement does not confer any right to regular appointment in KVIC. Period of engagement: up to 31 March 2027. It may be extended for a further period, subject to KVIC's requirement and the selected candidate's satisfactory performance. Travel: the selected candidate(s) may be required to travel as part of official duties, as applicable to the post, including field visits from the Hyderabad State Office.

content_sections.heading: KVIC Marketing Expert Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these key responsibilities of the Marketing Expert: Develop, implement and track marketing programmes such as email, social media or digital campaigns, and events. Collaborate with other internal teams to develop and monitor strategic marketing initiatives. Analyse and report on the performance and efficiency of campaigns. Conduct market research and analyse trends to identify new marketing opportunities. Develop and create marketing materials, such as sales and product collateral, and ensure that guidelines are met. Write, proofread and edit creative and technical content across different mediums. Work with external agencies and vendors to execute marketing programmes. Demonstrate excellent time management skills and the ability to balance multiple projects simultaneously. Ability to travel as necessary.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized institution or university , have two years of qualifying work experience and meet the prescribed typing and computer requirements. Candidates need to satisfy either the English or Hindi typing speed requirement, not both. The required two-year experience must be as a Junior Assistant or in an equivalent position in one of the following organizations: Universities or research establishments. Central or State Government organizations. Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). Autonomous bodies. Reputed private companies or corporate banks offering an equivalent pay package, with minimum annual turnover of Rs. 200 crore. The prescribed qualification and experience must be possessed by the applicable application closing date.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Age relaxation is available to eligible SC, ST, OBC, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen and other categories under applicable Central Government orders adopted by Delhi University. Applicants with at least three years of regular service in the same or allied field in eligible government, university, autonomous or PSU organizations may receive relaxation up to five years or the number of completed years of qualifying service, whichever is less. The notification also provides specific age exemptions for eligible departmental candidates and certain contractual, daily-wage or ad hoc employees directly appointed by Delhi University or its affiliated/constituent colleges. Important: The special contractual-employee exemption does not apply to outsourced employees or project-based contractual assignments.

content_sections.text: The Assistant post carries Pay Level 4 under the 7th Central Pay Commission , with allowances admissible under University rules.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of a Preliminary Test, Main Examination and qualifying Skill Test . The Preliminary Test is used for shortlisting, while the Main Examination determines merit, subject to qualification in the Skill Test. Preliminary Test - Objective MCQ examination. Main Examination - Descriptive examination. Skill Test - Computer proficiency, office procedures, noting, drafting and typing. Document Verification - Verification of qualification, experience and other eligibility claims. Final Merit - Based on Main Examination marks, subject to applicable selection rules.

content_sections.heading: Delhi University Assistant Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Preliminary Test consists of 100 multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks , with a duration of two hours and 30 minutes. Important: The Preliminary Test is only for shortlisting and does not carry weightage in final merit. The qualifying cut-off is determined using 50% of the average score of the top 5% of candidates appearing in the test, subject to the special calculation provisions in the notification. The notification provides a five-percentage-point relaxation for SC/ST candidates and a ten-percentage-point relaxation for PwBD candidates in the prescribed cut-off. For shortlisting to the Main Examination, the University prescribes 30 candidates for one vacancy and 15 additional candidates for each further vacancy, subject to merit and ties at the cut-off. The Main Examination is descriptive in nature and carries 200 marks, with a duration of two hours. The Main Examination assesses knowledge of higher education administration, financial rules, university procedures, procurement, pension rules, grievance handling and administrative management. The Skill Test carries 100 marks and is qualifying in nature. Candidates must obtain at least 50 marks to qualify. The Skill Test covers the Manual of Office Procedures, noting and drafting, computer operations and typing proficiency.

Monitor progress and prepare regular status updates and reports for clients and internal stakeholders. Liaise with experts: work with subject-matter experts, urban planning professors and industry professionals. Manage internal and external communications, including social media, press releases and outreach efforts. Manage recruitment, onboarding and employee relations to build a strong team. If there are not enough candidates with the prescribed 2 years of experience, candidates with 1 year of relevant experience may be considered. A 5-year integrated dual degree in Law (B.A. LL.B./B.B.A. LL.B./B.Com. LL.B. or equivalent) is also considered. Experience in either or both capacities may be counted, provided the periods do not overlap. Only post-qualification experience as on 01.11.2026 is considered. The educational qualification must be approved or recognised by UGC, AIU or the Bar Council of India. Candidates with qualifications from foreign universities must produce the order or letter under which AIU approved or recognised it. The qualification must be from a full time regular course. Candidates who studied part time or through correspondence, distance, private study or off campus courses are not eligible to apply. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Candidates offered engagement with two years' experience are paid a consolidated Rs.32,890 per month. Candidates appointed with one to less than two years' experience are paid a consolidated Rs.31,930 per month. Both get an increase of 3% on successful completion of each year. Leave, ESI, Provident Fund, and TA & DA for duty travel apply based on eligibility, as per the Rules of the Company. The engagement is for two years, renewable for a maximum period of 2 spells of one year each, at the discretion of the Management, subject to requirement, performance and assessment. content_sections.heading: About ICAR-NIAP
content_sections.text: ICAR - National Institute of Agricultural Economics and Policy Research (NIAP) is an Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) institute at Dev Prakash Shastri Marg, Pusa, New Delhi – 110 012. The Young Professional-II post serves the project "Demand driven extension and advisory service provision in agriculture: A Policy Roadmap", which runs under the Central Corpus Fund-Indian Council of Agricultural Research (CCF-ICAR) - National Priority Project (NPP).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The walk-in is for 01 (One) Young Professional-II post. The notice calls this vacancy tentative. The essential qualification is a Master's Degree in Agricultural Economics , and the post carries a pay of Rs. 42000/- (Consolidated) per month. Experience in collating and handling primary data Good communication skills Proficient in handling datasets and using standard software employed in qualitative and quantitative research, such as STATA, R, and NVivo The minimum age is 21 years and the maximum age is 45 years, counted as on the date of interview. The notice gives relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per government rules: Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed proforma, giving a full Curriculum Vitae. The application form is attached to the notice and must be brought duly filled at the time of the interview. One set of self-attested photocopies of testimonials and certificates Original age-proof One self-attested passport size photograph Original certificates/degrees, which will be verified before the walk-in interview Experience certificate(s) from the previous employer(s) The attached application form asks for: General information: the post applied for, full name, father's/husband's name, gender, date of birth (DD/MM/YYYY), age as on the date of interview (years, months, days), marital status, contact number, e-mail address, correspondence and permanent addresses, and whether General/SC/ST/OBC/PH Academic qualifications: the name of the degree, subjects/specialisation, board/university, year of passing, duration of the course, maximum marks, marks obtained and percentage/OGPA Experience: a chronological list with designation, name of the employer, period (from and to dates), number of years/months and the nature of work done Additional information, if any A signed and dated declaration that the information is true, and whether any near or distant relative is an employee of ICAR (with name, post, institute name and type of relation)

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Candidates report at the Auditorium at least an hour before the 10:00 AM interview time. Original certificates/degrees are verified before the walk-in interview. The walk-in interview selects the candidate for the post. A panel will be made with the approval of the Competent Authority. Any future vacancy in this project, or in any other project with similar eligibility conditions, may be filled from this panel. The panel will be maintained as per rule. The selected candidates will be medically examined for fitness before the appointment.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Tenure: the initial appointment may be made up to 31 March 2027. It may be extended further, subject to satisfactory performance and the continuing requirement of the project. The appointment is on a purely contractual basis for the period mentioned, co-terminus with the project/plan scheme. It may be extended or shortened based on performance and requirement. The engagement is purely time-bound and non-regular. The services end when the sanctioned period expires, or even earlier if the work is not found satisfactory. The Competent Authority also reserves the right to terminate the appointment at any time without assigning any reason. The engagement is not against any sanctioned vacancy, cadre-strength, post or position, so the service provisions for regular posts, including reservations, will not apply. The incumbent shall not have any claim for a regular appointment under ICAR. The selected candidate(s) shall have no legal right to claim regularisation by absorption or otherwise, against any regular post, or to any further continued engagement. The terms and conditions for Young Professionals will follow ICAR OM No. Ag. Edn. 1-06/2020-A&P dated 04.12.2020 and other orders issued by ICAR/Govt. of India from time to time. The engagement will also be regulated by the ICAR guidelines issued from time to time. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview. The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease. The posts are purely tentative and subject to change or withdrawal in the future. The decision of the Director, ICAR-NIAP, New Delhi will be final and binding in all respects.

content_sections.heading: ZSI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Conduct novel research on long term ecological monitoring of arthropods in the LTEO sites across India in terrestrial and freshwater ecosystems using integrated approaches. Work on community ecology, stream ecology, GIS and use of remotely sensed data, molecular studies, and responses to environmental stresses in the context of global change. Location of work: (1) Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve (2) Central India (3) Gujarat (4) Western Himalaya (5) Eastern Himalaya (6) Andaman Islands. Maintain, curate and analyse data collected from LTEO sites using relevant statistical techniques and GIS. Prepare scientific and technical reports and manuscripts. Location of work: Chennai.

content_sections.heading: CSIR CFTRI Technician Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the prescribed educational and trade requirements as on 18 November 2026. The minimum qualification is Class 10 or equivalent with Science subjects and at least 55% marks, along with one of the accepted trade qualifications or experience routes. Applicants must meet the Class 10 Science and 55% marks requirement and satisfy any one of the following conditions in the relevant trade: ITI certificate or National/State Trade Certificate in the concerned trade. Two years of full-time apprenticeship training in the concerned trade from a recognized institution. Three years of work experience in the concerned trade in an eligible Central or State Government department, public sector undertaking or autonomous organization, as specified in the notification. The required ITI certificate or experience must correspond to the trade selected in the application. Candidates should check the exact trade name and supporting-document conditions in the official notification. The minimum age for CSIR CFTRI Technician Recruitment 2026 is 18 years and the maximum age is 28 years as on 18 November 2026. Relaxation in the upper age limit is available to eligible candidates under Government of India rules. Additional relaxation provisions apply to eligible widows, divorced women and women judicially separated from their husbands who have not remarried. Candidates seeking relaxation must provide the prescribed supporting certificates.

content_sections.heading: SAI Deputy Director Job Description
content_sections.text: Functions as a Section Head, assisting and reporting to the Divisional Head in matters relating to sports administration, policy implementation, and programme management. Exercises overall supervision, coordination, and management of assigned divisions or centres, ensuring effective implementation of SAI schemes and Government of India guidelines. Maintains and monitors data related to athletes, personnel, and schemes. Oversees administrative and financial matters and ensures compliance with applicable rules and procedures. Conducts inspections of offices, training centres, and field units to ensure smooth functioning of operations and optimal execution of training programmes. Handles inter-divisional coordination, communication with stakeholders, and supports decision-making processes at higher levels to achieve organizational objectives.

content_sections.heading: About NIFT
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT) was set up in 1986 under the Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India. It is a statutory institute governed by the NIFT Act 2006 and has 20 campuses across the country. Its head office is at NIFT Campus, Hauz Khas, New Delhi. NIFT describes itself as an institute of fashion education that also works as a knowledge service provider to the Union and State governments in design development and in the positioning of handlooms and handicrafts.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the application, with self-attested copies of documents in support of qualification, experience, age and so on, to this address: The Registrar, NIFT Campus, Hauz Khas, Near Gulmohar Park, New Delhi- 110016. It must reach that address on or before 20 November 2026 by 05:00 PM. Every letter from NIFT, including any interview/interaction letter, will be sent only to the email address you give in the application form. Item 11 of the form asks for the full postal address with PIN code of your forwarding authority, along with that authority's name, telephone number and email address. Item 13 is for your three campus preferences if you are applying for Campus Director.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All four posts are at the same pay: Level – 13 (7th CPC) / PB – 4 [Rs. 37400 – 67000/- + Grade Pay Rs. 8700/- (6th CPC)]. The pay of a candidate selected on deputation will be regulated under the DoP&T O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. The 16 Campus Director locations are Bengaluru, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Chennai, Gandhinagar, Hyderabad, Jodhpur, Kangra, Kolkata, Kannur, Mumbai, New Delhi, Patna, Raebareli, Shillong and Srinagar. Officers of the Central Govt. / State Govt./ UT/ Autonomous Organization / PSUs who hold an analogous post on regular basis and have experience in administration / establishment / academic matters. Officers of the Central Govt. / State Govt./ UT/ Autonomous Organization / PSUs who hold an analogous post on regular basis and have relevant experience in administration / establishment / admissions / academic matters. Officers of the Central Govt. / State Govt./ UT/ Autonomous Organization / PSUs who hold an analogous post on regular basis and have relevant experience in dealing with financial, accounting and audit matters. Officers of the Central Govt. / State Govt./ UT/ Autonomous Organization / PSUs who hold analogous posts on regular basis, with at least 2 years' experience on a post at the level of Director of Govt. of India or equivalent, and with relevant experience in administrative / establishment / admissions/ Academic matters. You must give 3 choices of campus in order of preference. The posts are transferable across all NIFT campuses. The Competent Authority is free to transfer a Campus Director to any NIFT campus. NIFT reserves the right to post the selected candidate to a campus outside the choices given. Age limit: the maximum age for appointment shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. Period of deputation: three years. The tenure shall not be extended further. Educational qualification: the official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Nationality: you must be a citizen of India. No reservation exists for these deputation posts, as per Clause C (2.) of DOPT OM No.36011/1/2022-Estt(Res-I) dated 28 March, 2024. Officers already on deputation are not eligible to apply. The upper age limit, qualifications and experience are all judged as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Adhoc, contract, part-time, consultant or similar employment that is not permanent (not holding a substantive post/lien) is treated as temporary and will not count as experience. Check the official notification for the eligibility of each post in its own discipline.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed proforma of application (Annexure-I), with the Statement of Purpose Integrity Certificate (in original) (Annexure – II), signed by an officer of the rank of Deputy Secretary or above List of major / minor penalties imposed on the official, if any, during the last 10 years. If no penalty has been imposed, a "NIL" certificate must be enclosed (in original) (Annexure – III). Vigilance Clearance Certificate (in original) (Annexure – IV) Cadre Clearance Certificate (in original) (Annexure – V) Attested photocopies of the APARs (Annexure – VI) for the last five years (2020-21 to 2024-25). The application will not be considered without them. Matriculation Certificate (as proof of age) Self-attested copies of your educational qualification, experience and caste/ category certificates (wherever applicable) Each page should be attested by an officer not below the rank of an Under Secretary to the Govt. of India. If your parent department keeps APARs in Grade Points (year-wise), submit them as Grades (year-wise): Outstanding, Very Good, Good, Average, Below Average, Poor and Fail only. If an APAR for any year is under process or cannot be submitted for an administrative reason, the APAR for the year before will be accepted. Any document in a language other than Hindi or English needs a Hindi or English transcript attested by the candidate. The Statement of Purpose (not more than 1000 words; a separate sheet may be used) must cover: Why do you wish to join NIFT? Why do you think you are suitable for the job? How will you bring value to NIFT? What has been a significant defining experience in your professional life? When forwarding the application, the forwarding Ministry, Department or Organisation must certify that the applicant will be relieved within one month of receiving the offer of appointment if selected. It must also record vigilance clearance.

content_sections.heading: About AP State Food Commission Member (ST)
content_sections.text: The Andhra Pradesh State Food Commission has been set up by the Government of Andhra Pradesh under the provisions of the National Food Security Act, 2013 (NFSA). Its Members perform the duties and functions and exercise the powers prescribed under the NFSA read with the Andhra Pradesh Food Security Rules, 2017, issued vide G.O.Ms.No.8 of the CA,F&CS Department, dated 18-04-2017. The recruitment is handled by the Consumer Affairs, Food & Civil Supplies Department at the A.P. Secretariat, Velagapudi, Amaravati.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The single post is for the ST category (ST-General), and the application form asks for a caste certificate pertaining to ST. Men and women may both apply, as the post is advertised without restricting the gender. The Member shall be appointed from amongst persons: Who are citizens of India; Who are not beyond 65 years of age; and Who meet any one of the three conditions below. Who are or have been members of All India Services, or any other Civil Services of the Union or State, or holding a Civil post under the Union or State, having knowledge and experience in matters relating to food security, policy making and administration in the field of agriculture, civil supplies, nutrition, health or any allied field; OR Of eminence in public life with wide knowledge and experience in agriculture, law, human rights, social service, management, health, food policy, public administration; OR Who have a proven record of work relating to the improvement of the food and nutrition rights of the poor. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The application form does ask for details of each examination or degree passed, and certificates of educational qualifications must be enclosed. Applicants must be not beyond 65 years of age. The closing date of submitting the application (20 November 2026) is the date for determining the eligibility of age in every respect. No person shall hold office as Member after attaining the age of sixty-five years. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification and the provisions it names (NFSA, 2013 and the AP Food Security Rules, 2017) for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Pay, allowances and other terms and conditions of service of the Members are as stipulated by the Government vide G.O.Ms. No.6, CAF & CS Deptt., dated 12-04-2017 read with G.O.Ms.No.8, CAF & CS Deptt., dated 18-04-2017, and as amended subsequently. The salaries, allowances and other conditions of service of a member shall not be varied to their disadvantage after appointment. A Member holds office for a term not exceeding five (5) years from the date on which he or she enters the office and is eligible for reappointment. The State Government may remove any member from office for the reasons indicated in the National Food Security Act, 2013.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Computer Proficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted after the Main Examination must qualify in the Computer Proficiency Test (CPT). Important: The CPT is qualifying in nature. Final recruitment merit is based on the Main Examination, subject to the candidate qualifying in CPT and meeting all other selection conditions.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Minimum Qualifying Marks 2026
content_sections.text: These are the minimum qualifying percentages stated for selection in the notification. The Commission may separately fix Screening Test shortlisting standards. Obtaining the minimum qualifying marks does not guarantee selection. Final selection depends on examination merit, eligibility, reservation and the number of available vacancies.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Local Reservation Rules 2026
content_sections.text: The notification provides 95% local reservation for designated zonal and district-cadre positions under the applicable Andhra Pradesh Presidential Order, 2025. For zonal-cadre posts, Andhra Pradesh is divided into six zones. Local candidature is determined using the study or residence conditions specified in the notification, generally involving the relevant four-year or seven-year period ending with Class VII. Important: Candidates who studied in educational institutions must ordinarily provide study certificates. Residence certificates are not accepted as replacements where the notification requires study certificates.

rows.cadre_local_reservation: State Cadre - No Separate Local Reservation Under the Notified Provisions

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Reservation 2026
content_sections.text: Reservation is provided according to Andhra Pradesh Government rules for SC, ST, BC, EWS and applicable horizontal reservation categories. Women: 33 1/3% horizontal reservation, as applicable. Meritorious Sportspersons: 3% horizontal reservation under the notified rules. Ex-Servicemen: 2% horizontal reservation for notified Non-Executive categories. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities: Reservation according to the post-specific suitability rules. SC/ST/BC/EWS: Applicable vertical reservation according to Government rules. The notification specifies that candidates belonging to reserved categories of other states are not entitled to Andhra Pradesh's state-specific community reservation benefits. BC Non-Creamy Layer certificates must satisfy the specified issue-date conditions. EWS applicants must possess the prescribed digitally issued Income and Asset Certificate based on financial year 2025–26.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for 720 APPSC Group-II Services vacancies through the official APPSC application portal. Apply Online: APPSC Official Recruitment Portal Notification: 37/2026. Application Start Date: 10 November 2026. Application Last Date: 11 December 2026, 11:59 PM. Important: Creating an OTPR profile does not mean the candidate has applied for Notification No. 37/2026. A separate recruitment-specific application and successful payment are required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website psc.ap.gov.in . Read APPSC Group-II Services Notification No. 37/2026. If you are a new applicant, complete One Time Profile Registration (OTPR). Enter the required personal details, educational qualifications, contact information and other profile data. Save the generated OTPR ID and login credentials. Existing applicants should log in using their registered OTPR ID and password. Verify all profile information before applying. Open the Online Application Submission section. Find Notification No. 37/2026 and select the Fill Application option. Enter the required local/non-local status information. Provide category, reservation and applicable fee-concession details. Enter educational qualifications and select eligible post preferences. Choose the prescribed examination-centre preferences. Check the application preview carefully. Click Save & Submit to generate the payment link. Pay the applicable examination and processing fees through the online payment gateway. Confirm successful submission. Download the completed application PDF. Retain the payment reference number and application copy. Complete the entire process before 11 December 2026 at 11:59 PM . Important: Selecting only Save does not submit the application. Candidates must select Save & Submit and complete payment for the application to be treated as submitted.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Application Correction 2026
content_sections.text: The Commission provides a limited online correction facility for eligible application fields after the application closing date. Candidates should carefully check their application before final submission. The notification does not permit unrestricted changes after the deadline, and subsequent changes made only in the OTPR profile do not automatically update the already submitted recruitment application.

rows.details: Up to 7 Days After Application Closing Date

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep the following records ready for application and certificate verification, as applicable: Recognized Bachelor's degree certificate. Degree marksheets and other prescribed academic records. SSC / Class 10 certificate or accepted date-of-birth proof. OTPR registration details. Active mobile number and email address. Photo identity proof. Study certificates covering the relevant Class I to VII period. Residence certificate where specifically permitted. SC/ST/BC community certificate, if applicable. BC Non-Creamy Layer certificate, if applicable. EWS Income and Asset Certificate, if applicable. PwBD certificate, if applicable. Ex-Servicemen/NCC/sports eligibility documents, where applicable. White Card or applicable fee-concession declaration, if claiming exemption. Computer qualification certificate for prescribed Accountant categories. Law degree or other post-specific qualification certificate, where required. Other supporting records requested during verification. The commission may reject applications containing incorrect eligibility, local-status or reservation claims, even after provisional admission to an examination.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Exam Centres 2027
content_sections.text: The Screening Test and Main Examination are planned at district examination centres across Andhra Pradesh. Candidates can indicate three examination-centre preferences for the Screening Test and Main Examination. However, APPSC reserves the right to allot an examination centre other than the candidate's preferred centres depending on availability and administrative requirements.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Hall Ticket 2027
content_sections.text: The APPSC Group 2 Screening Test Hall Ticket will be released through the Commission's official website before the examination scheduled for 21 February 2027 . The exact hall ticket release date has not been announced in the detailed notification. Candidates should regularly visit psc.ap.gov.in for hall tickets, examination instructions, schedules and results.

content_sections.heading: APPSC Group 2 Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Notification No. 37/2026 announces 720 vacancies. 471 vacancies are Executive posts and 249 are Non-Executive posts. Applications are open from 10 November to 11 December 2026. The online application closes at 11:59 PM on 11 December 2026. The Screening Test is scheduled for 21 February 2027. The Screening Test will be conducted in offline OMR mode. The Main Examination will be conducted in CBRT mode. The Main Examination date will be announced later. Age is calculated as on 1 July 2026. Academic qualifications must be possessed by the detailed notification date. OTPR registration alone does not constitute an application. The candidate must click Save & Submit and successfully complete payment. The examination carries one-third negative marking. The Screening Test is used for shortlisting to the Main Examination. Final merit is based on the Main Examination, subject to qualifying CPT. The Computer Proficiency Test is mandatory under the notified selection procedure. Local reservation applies to specified zonal and district-cadre posts. Applicants must possess the relevant study/local-status certificates. Post Code 07 has additional physical and medical requirements. Fee-exempt candidates must still pay the processing fee. The advertised vacancies are subject to official revision.

The selection process for Direct Recruitment consists of the following stages: Screening Test
Written Examination and Viva Voce.
100 multiple choice objective type questions for 100 marks

with a duration of 2 hours. Applicants securing 40% and above marks are short-listed in the ratio of 1:10 of the available vacancies for the Written Examination. Candidates with identical marks are all called for the Written Examination. The Screening Test marks are not added to the Written Examination marks and are not counted for the final order of merit. Securing the minimum qualifying marks does not vest any right to be considered for the Written Examination.

Questions must be answered only in English (except the translation test). Paper-III Part-I carries 40 marks: translating a passage from English to Telugu and from Telugu to English. Part-II carries 60 marks: essay writing on legal subjects only. Candidates must secure 40% marks in each part of Paper-III. Paper-II and Viva Voce are taken into account for selection.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can apply for AP High Court Civil Judge (Junior Division) Recruitment 2026 through online mode only. Follow the steps below:
Visit the official High Court of Andhra Pradesh website, https://aphc.gov.in, and open the online application portal (available from 01-10-2026 to 30-11-2026).
Read the notification carefully and select the category (Direct Recruitment or Recruitment by Transfer) and the applicable reservation category.
Fill in the application with correct details and opt for three Screening Test centres in the order of preference.

Upload the required documents. For Direct Recruitment: certificate of date of birth/SSC, Law Degree certificate, and community certificate for SC/ST/BC/Persons with Benchmark Disabilities/EWS claims. BC applicants must upload the latest Non-Creamy Layer certificate issued in 2025 or 2026 (otherwise the candidature is considered under Open Competition). EWS applicants must upload the latest EWS certificate issued in 2025 or 2026 by the Tahsildar, showing gross annual family income below Rs. 8,00,000/-. Persons with Benchmark Disabilities must upload the Medical Board certificate, and ex-servicemen the Discharge Certificate.

For Recruitment by Transfer, also upload proof of declaration of probation, the employer's proceedings permitting the Law Degree course after entering service, and the latest Service and Conduct Certificate. The latest No-objection Certificate from the employer must be submitted at the time of verification of original certificates.
Pay the application/examination fee online (Rs. 1,500/- or Rs. 750/-, as applicable) and submit the application on or before 30-11-2026 (11:59 PM).
Download the Hall Ticket from the High Court website one week before the Screening Test.

Once the application is submitted, candidates cannot edit options or replace documents. Original certificates must be produced on the day mentioned by the High Court for verification, failing which the candidature will be rejected. The High Court will not entertain correspondence, and no information will be sent to unsuccessful candidates. Candidates must regularly visit the High Court website for updates, as no separate information is provided in any other mode. No TA/DA will be paid for the Screening Test, Written Examination or Viva Voce.

Only applicants belonging to a community recognized as SC/ST in the State of Andhra Pradesh are entitled to this concession. Payment Mode: Online only. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for Direct Recruitment consists of the following stages: Screening Test, Written Examination and Viva Voce. 100 multiple choice objective type questions for 100 marks, with a duration of 2 hours. Applicants securing 40% and above marks are short-listed in the ratio of 1:10 of the available vacancies for the Written Examination. Candidates with identical marks are all called for the Written Examination. The Screening Test marks are not added to the Written Examination marks and are not counted for the final order of merit. Securing the minimum qualifying marks does not vest any right to be considered for the Written Examination. Questions must be answered only in English (except the translation test). Paper-III Part-I carries 40 marks: translating a passage from English to Telugu and from Telugu to English. Part-II carries 60 marks: essay writing on legal subjects only. Candidates must secure 40% marks in each part of Paper-III. Paper-III marks are not taken into account for eligibility for Viva Voce or for selection. Marks in Paper-I, Paper-II and Viva Voce are taken into account for selection. Direct Recruitment - Open Competition/EWS: Not less than 55% in each of Paper-I and Paper-II, and not less than 60% in aggregate. Direct Recruitment - Backward Class: Not less than 50% in each of Paper-I and Paper-II, and not less than 55% in aggregate. Direct Recruitment - SC, ST and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities: Not less than 45% in each of Paper-I and Paper-II, and not less than 50% in aggregate. Recruitment by Transfer: Not less than 55% in each of Paper-I and Paper-II, and not less than 60% in aggregate. The Viva Voce carries 50 marks. A candidate who remains absent is deemed disqualified. After the Written Examination result, qualified candidates are called for Viva Voce in the ratio of 1:3 of the available vacancies in the respective categories. Candidates with identical cut-off marks are all called. Minimum aggregate in Written Examination and Viva Voce: 60% for OC/EWS, 55% for BC, and 50% for SC/ST and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities under Direct Recruitment; 60% under Recruitment by Transfer. Tie-break: If two or more candidates secure equal marks, the elder in age is considered. If still tied, the candidate with the higher educational qualification, and then the one with the highest marks in the prescribed educational qualification, is considered. Provisional selection is subject to verification of antecedents. content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for AP High Court Civil Judge (Junior Division) Recruitment 2026 through online mode only. The latest No-objection Certificate from the employer must be submitted at the time of verification of original certificates. Pay the application/examination fee online (Rs. 1,500/- or Rs. 750/-, as applicable) and submit the application on or before 30-11-2026 (11:59 PM).
