content_sections.heading: About APDCL
content_sections.text: APDCL is a distribution licensee whose office of the Chief General Manager (HRA) is at Bijulee Bhawan, Guwahati. The State Level CGRF is the forum that hears consumer grievances, and its work is governed by the Assam Electricity Regulatory Commission (Redressal of Consumer Grievances) Regulations, 2022. This notice fills the seat of the Consumer Representative that APDCL nominates to the Forum.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria may send their application in the prescribed format (Annexure I) in hard copy only to this address: O/o the CGM (HRA), APDCL, Bijulee Bhawan, Paltanbazar, Ghy-781001 Use only the prescribed format, Annexure I. content_sections.text: The post is Consumer Representative (APDCL's nominated), a member of the State Level CGRF. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The member should have good antecedents. The member should not have any outstanding dues of electricity or cases pending with APDCL during the time of appointment. Desirable: members of CGRF are well conversant with the official language of the State. No member shall hold office after attaining the age of 70 (Seventy) years. The notice gives no other age limit. The nominated members of the State Level Forum are entitled to a sitting fee of Rs. 3000/- for every sitting of the Forum. This amount may be revised by the Commission (AERC) in consultation with APDCL from time to time. The nominated Members are also entitled to conveyance allowance for attending the official duties of the Forum. The duties and responsibilities are as stipulated in the Assam Electricity Regulatory Commission (Redressal of Consumer Grievances) Regulations, 2022, as amended from time to time by AERC/Competent Authority. Every nominated member holds office for a term of three years from the date of entry into the office. A selected Member will be given short notice to join in the respective office. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: About OIL Domain Expert (Critical Minerals)
content_sections.text: Oil India Limited describes itself in the notice as a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking and the second largest national upstream Oil & Gas Company with a pan India presence and global footprint. In line with the Government of India's National Critical Mineral Mission (NCMM), OIL has diversified into exploration and development of critical and strategic minerals and has secured two strategic critical mineral blocks under the Composite Licence (CL) regime: Phop Block in Arunachal Pradesh and Jorkian Block in Rajasthan. The Domain Expert is being empanelled for specialised assignments under this programme.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from retired officers . The essential requirements for the Domain Expert (Critical Minerals) post are: Masters in M.Sc./M. Tech. in Geology / Applied Geology from Government recognized College/ Universities/ Institution. Retired from a Government mining/geoscientific organization in the pay scale of at least ₹1,82,200– ₹2,24,100. A minimum of 25 years of relevant professional experience. Candidates who have worked with the Geological Survey of India and have at least one year of experience in Critical Mineral Assessment would be preferred. Good interpersonal, delegation, liaison, networking and communication skills to establish effective relationships internal and external to the organization. Experience in technical planning of an Exploration project for deep-seated and critical minerals. Preparation of Prospecting & Exploration plan for the composite and mining lease blocks, including Geological, Geophysical and Geochemical techniques. Estimation and evaluation of resource/reserve of bedded, deep-seated and critical minerals as per the United Nations Framework Classification for Resources (UNFC), with follow-up of The Minerals (Evidence of Mineral Contents) MEMC Rules 2015 and The Australasian Joint Ore Reserves Committee (JORC) Rules. Ability to provide expert advice for searching deep-seated minerals in uncovered areas. Experience in selecting and exploring lithium, cobalt, graphite, nickel, copper, potash, REE and other associated critical minerals. Experience and knowledge of various facets of work related to Geology & Mining, Policy & Regulation of Mines and Minerals. Good understanding of mining leases and familiarity with government procedures and policies. Ability to prepare technical components of RFPs for the engagement of consultants for critical mineral exploration. The candidate should not be more than 68 years of age as on 05/12/2026. The candidate must also have a minimum of 02 remaining years before attaining the maximum permissible age limit of 70 years at the time of application. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Domain Expert on call duty is paid a per-day honorarium according to level/grade: Travel, local conveyance, boarding and lodging will be arranged by OIL as per the entitlements of regular executives of their status in OIL. No other facilities will be extended or borne by OIL. The period of empanelment is 02 (Two) years, and the selected candidate shall be engaged on a contract basis. The engagement will be on-call basis from time to time during the project period. Domain experts will be engaged up to 100 days during the year, starting from the date of the empanelment. A non-binding understanding between the Project Proponent and the Domain Expert on the Project Plan will be the basis of engagement. The empanelment is terminable at any time by serving 01 (One) month notice in writing by either party. The expert will report at CoEES, OIL, Guwahati, and may be required to visit areas in and outside India occasionally for business development and as per operational requirements.

content_sections.heading: OIL Domain Expert (Critical Minerals) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Domain Expert shall provide technical guidance for ongoing and upcoming activities associated with the exploration and development of the Phop, Jorkian and other critical mineral blocks, including: Geological mapping Trenching and drilling Core studies and laboratory data interpretation Hydrogeological investigations Beneficiation studies Resource estimation and other associated activities

Paste your latest passport size photograph in the box on the proforma and sign it. Attach attested copies of your ACR/APARs for the preceding five years. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raipur State Newborn Care Quality Manager Job Description
content_sections.text: The Consultant works in consultation with the QI newborn and child health project team. The supervisor is the Principal Investigator of the project at AIIMS Raipur, and technical reporting is to the Health Specialist, UNICEF, Raipur, C.G. The duty station is AIIMS, Raipur, Chhattisgarh. Local and outstation travel is involved as required or suggested by the supervisor. The duties are: Contribute in State newborn AMR consortium as per need and suggested by supervisor. Facilitate for data collection, compilation, analysis and review related to project area. Regular coordination with district teams to promote the quality and timely data support. Field level supportive supervision/hand holding to ensure timely and standard data-based operations, as per project need. Do daily teleround of IOSNCU. Help the P.I. in conduct of trainings on Q.I, ETAT/HDU and newborn care and any other work assigned by P.I. Analyze the data, identify the gaps and facilitate implementation of suggestive inputs so as to get optimum quality data outputs. Coordination with different stakeholders for implementation of project interventions. Any other task assigned by supervisor/Technical reporting person.

content_sections.heading: About NLU Delhi
content_sections.text: National Law University Delhi is a law university at Sector-14, Dwarka, New Delhi. According to the notice, it was established in 2008 on the initiative of the High Court of Delhi and the Govt. of NCT of Delhi. Since May 2026 the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs has recognised it as one of its Regional Centres to research on Urban Housing affairs. The project is a comprehensive legal mapping of the framework in which the housing ecosystem of Delhi and Haryana operates. It identifies legal and procedural bottlenecks through stakeholder consultations. Its stated objective is to help the Ministry and other policymakers improve access to affordable housing, especially for the socioeconomically weaker sections of society.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one Research Associate on a contractual basis. The post table prints "Position: One (2)"; the text of the call and the figure "One" both point to a single post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualifications: LL.M. with specialisation (preferably in Constitutional Law/Real Estate Law and Urban Development Law) from a recognised Indian or foreign university with minimum 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever a grading system is followed), and a good academic record. Demonstrable research work/publication and interest in urban studies, urban development and the law, constitutional law, local land and municipal laws, real estate, and other allied areas/themes. Desirable qualifications: Familiarity with quantitative and/or qualitative research methods, and the ability to assist in literature review, instrument development, data collection, data analysis and report writing. Proficiency in MS Office applications and data analysis tools. Prior experience in research projects. Proficiency in academic writing and ability to manage multiple tasks and meet timelines. The notice does not print an age limit. It is not specified in the notice whether any relaxation applies. For the full eligibility conditions, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly remuneration is ₹ 50,000/- per month. The appointment is contractual for six months and is further extendable subject to project requirements and performance. The notice does not mention HRA or other allowances. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or interaction. The notice states that the position shall lie with the Principal Investigator of the Project, or as may be decided by the University subsequently. The rules and regulations of National Law University Delhi apply to the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: NLU Delhi Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The Research Associate is expected to: Assist in research, review and analysis of statutes, policies, guidelines, regulatory frameworks and other available literature on the core and allied areas of the Project. Conduct doctrinal, empirical and comparative research (including literature review, case/document analysis and data-driven inquiries). Support the drafting of research outputs, including reports, briefs, research papers and internal working papers. Coordinate with project investigators and external consultants where required.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NLU Delhi Research Associate
content_sections.text: Open the online application form at careers.nludelhi.ac.in, the address given in the notice. Prepare the six items the notice asks candidates to submit digitally, listed below. Submit the application through the online form by 20 November 2026, 23:59 Hrs. Physical or email applications will not be considered. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has two stages. First, applications are screened for completeness and relevance. Candidates are shortlisted on an assessment of the application materials submitted through the online form. Second, shortlisted candidates are invited for an interview. Shortlisting does not guarantee an interview or selection, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If a candidate hears nothing from the University within 2 weeks after the deadline, the application should be assumed unsuccessful. The interview date and mode are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: AAI Advisors Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following duties for each post code. Each also includes any other task assigned by the concerned ED (post codes 01 to 09) or the concerned GM (post codes 10 and 11). Post 01 (CAP): critical regulatory functions of licensing, training oversight and DGCA compliance, and timely disposal of regulatory matters. Post 02 (ATFM): training and capacity building, documentation, operational advisory services, ATFM system enhancement, international best practices and future technologies, future concept development, technical evaluation and system upgradation, interoperability and system integration, and stakeholder coordination. Post 03 (Survey & Carto): supervising the OLS Survey at airports (existing and proposed), water aerodromes and heliports; collecting vital data and critical obstacles and surfaces; checking DGPS results; assuring data quality in compliance with DGCA CAR and preparing FPD data; guiding GIS analysts on ICAO and DGCA survey requirements; supervising airport base maps, approach charts, vertical significance charts, OFZ charts and other charts; use of datums and colours such as True North and EGM-08; survey operations, data quality assurance and evaluation of obstacles. Post 04 (ASM): specialized airspace planning, route design and coordination with defence agencies. Post 05 (FPD): timely execution of procedure design and associated regulatory activities. Post 06 (ATS): CNS/ATM and PPP airport agreements, and coordination with stakeholders for meteorological services. Post 07 (SAR): critical SAR functions, including updation of SAR manuals, execution of SAR agreements, and conduct of training and exercises. Post 08 (HRD/TRG): ATM manpower planning, training oversight at ATSTO, long term training strategy, ATSTOs capacity building initiatives, and ensuring availability of competent ATCO manpower across AAI units. Post 09 (DoAS): processing of NOC/Appellate cases, stakeholder coordination, aeronautical assessments, and ensuring timely compliance with regulatory requirements related to airport infrastructure projects. Post 10 (CSMIA): INDRA Automation, airspace management, operational coordination and stakeholder liaison; and, for the future expansion of Navi Mumbai International airport, its traffic growth, coordination between nearby airports and management of complex airspace operations. Post 11 (RHQ Western Region): operational policy matters advice, strategic planning, regulatory compliance, coordination with field units, and implementation of ATM initiatives.

content_sections.heading: About CEPI Deputy Secretary (Level 12)
content_sections.text: The Office of the Custodian of Enemy Property for India (CEPI) is located in Lucknow and works under the Ministry of Home Affairs. The Deputy Secretary (Level 12) post in this office is a Non-Central Staffing Scheme post. The Office of the Establishment Officer, Department of Personnel and Training, Kartavya Bhawan-3, New Delhi, has circulated it to the Chief Secretaries of all State Governments/Union Territories and to the Secretaries of all Ministries/Departments of the Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Officers from the All India Services or any Organized Group 'A' Services of the Government of India who participate under the Central Staffing Scheme (CSS) and are eligible for appointment at Deputy Secretary level under CSS are eligible for the post. The circular asks that the post be circulated on priority basis among officers eligible to be appointed at Deputy Secretary or equivalent level in the Government of India under CSS. Preferred experience: officers possessing ten years of experience in Administration and three years experience in Land acquisition and disposal dealing with Estate/Properties matters would be preferable. Other conditions: For officers working in the cadre, the 'Cooling off' period after a previous stint on deputation, if any, must be completed. The officer must be eligible to be appointed on Central Deputation as per extant guidelines. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The level of the pay shall be as admissible to a Deputy Secretary level officer under CSS. The notice does not print a pay amount. The officer appointed will be given a tenure up to 31.12.2029, which is the period of validity of the post. On Government accommodation, the circular cites Rule 40 (1)(ix)(ii) of the CGGPRA Rules, 2017: the 'Mandatory Posting Certificate' for allotment/retention of Government accommodation will be issued by the Office of the Establishment Officer only to an appointed officer who has served and is currently serving on a CSS post at the same station for at least four years and requires to retain Government accommodation for his/her tenure on this Non-CSS post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CEPI Deputy Secretary (Level 12)
content_sections.text: Officers who have not applied for any other posts online during the current year route their nomination/application through DOPT's online interface: DOPT's website >> Offerings >> EO Wing >> Apply for post of CSS, CVO and others >> View Link (SUPREMO). In the SUPREMO web link (supremo.dopt.gov.in), choose Non-CSS. Officers who have already applied for CSS, CVO or other posts through the SUPREMO Portal can send their willingness for this post instead. Officers already working on central deputation under the CSS/Non-CSS of the Government of India have their applications forwarded by the Ministry/Department concerned, along with the approval of their respective Minister-in-Charge. Nominations and relevant correspondence may be sent to the email id [email protected] . Applications must be submitted by 14.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The post is a Non-Central Staffing Scheme post to be filled up through the Civil Services Board (CSB) procedure. The notice does not describe the stages of this procedure or mention an interview date.

content_sections.heading: About MTNL property Consultant
content_sections.text: According to the notice, Mahanagar Telephone Nigam Limited is a Navratna PSU under the Ministry of Telecommunication, providing a wide array of Telecom and IT services in the metro cities of Delhi and Mumbai. The property Consultant will work in MTNL Delhi and is expected to bring knowledge of prevailing land laws/ rules of costing, disposal, planning/ engineering of land management. The engagement is made under MTNL's Terms of Engagement (Annexure-II), "as per Company policy as amended from time to time".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice is open only to retired officers. An applicant must meet one of the two options below. Option 1: The applicant should have retired from Group 'A' services of any CPSE/ Government Department, preferably from DDA/ L&DO/ Noida Authority, having minimum three years experience & expertise in dealing with land, planning, engineering, and is supposed to coordinate with DDA, L&DO, MCD, DUSIB, Delhi Government, DSIIDC, Gram panchayt, Noida Authority in land matters. OR Option 2: The applicant should have retired from PSU/Autonomous body/ Govt. from the post of DGM and above (regular E-6 or above)/JAG, having mandatory expertise for the job. Retirement from DDA, L&DO or Noida Authority is a preference under Option 1, not a requirement. The three-year land experience condition is printed under Option 1; Option 2 asks for "mandatory expertise for the job". The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The Bio-Data form asks for educational and professional qualification, date of retirement and grade, and last pay drawn. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of the post. The maximum age limit is 65 years as on the last date for submission of application (27 November 2026). The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Consolidated fee: the difference between last pay drawn plus DA and Pension plus DA, or a lumpsum amount of Rs.51,000/-, whichever is less. Mobile: CMD, MTNL has power to consider a special request for mobile for discharge of official duties. No other charges: no other charges shall be admissible. Tax: Income Tax or any other tax liable to be deducted under prevailing rules will be deducted at source, and MTNL will issue a TDS certificate. Leave: Casual Leave on pro-rata basis is admissible for the period of contract, up to a maximum of 12 in a year. Tenure: purely on a short term contract basis, initially for six months, which can be further extended based on requirement and performance. Either party may terminate the consultancy/contract by giving 30 days prior written notice.

content_sections.heading: MTNL property Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: The scope of work printed in the notice is to handle asset monetization related work in the Company and handling/ liaisoning for land disposal related matters, as under: Resolving issues pertaining to property documents/ monetization with various local bodies like DDA, L&DO, MCD, DUSIB, Delhi Government, DSIIDC, Gram panchayt, Noida Authority etc.

content_sections.heading: About CAQM
content_sections.text: The Commission for Air Quality Management in National Capital Region and Adjoining Areas (CAQM) is a government commission with its office on the 17th Floor of Jawahar Vyapar Bhawan (STC Building), Tolstoy Marg, New Delhi. Through this notice, issued on 11 November 2026, the Commission is engaging retired government servants (PPS/PS/PA) as Consultant (PS) to provide secretarial assistance to its officers, as per the requirement of the Commission.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The CAQM Consultant (PS) posts are open only to retired employees. An applicant must meet each of the following conditions: Retirement level: Must have retired from Government/Statutory/Autonomous bodies at the level of Private Secretary/Principal Private Secretary (Level 8 or above, up to Level 11 of the Pay Matrix as per the 7th CPC) or Personal Assistant (Level 6 to 7 of the Pay Matrix as per the 7th CPC). Experience: Must have at least five years' experience and capabilities of rendering secretarial assistance to officers (the duties are listed in the job description below). Age limit: Candidates should not be more than 63 years of age on the last date of submission of application. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The application form, however, asks for educational and professional qualifications, and an application without supporting documents for them is liable to be rejected. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: A Consultant (PS) gets a consolidated remuneration equal to the last pay drawn minus pension, plus TA as per applicable rates in accordance with DoPT and DoE guidelines. The amount fixed remains unchanged for the term of the contract, and TDS will be deducted as per rules. Retired employees of non-pensionable statutory bodies/organisations are paid a fixed remuneration based on the pay level from which they retired: Other terms printed in the notice: The engagement is initially for one year from the date of engagement, which may be extended or curtailed as per requirement/performance of the individual. The engagement is purely on need basis, dependent on work performance. Leave: 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Normal office timings are 9.30 AM to 6.00 PM. The consultant may be required to devote extra time in exigencies.

content_sections.heading: CAQM Consultant (PS) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the secretarial assistance a Consultant (PS) gives to officers of the Commission: Taking dictation in shorthand and its transcription Assisting in drafting and issue of all correspondence as per direction of the officer Managing appointments/engagements Attending telephone calls and receiving visitors Maintaining the papers required to be retained by the officer

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is based in New Delhi. Under these Terms of Reference, it is recruiting on behalf of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare for the Central TB Division. The post deals with Public-Private Partnerships for TB control in India under the National TB Elimination Programme (NTEP).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following essential qualification and requirements for the Technical Officer (Public Private Partnership) post: M.A. in Sociology/ Master of Social Work (MSW)/ PGD in Social Work (PGDSW)/ PGD in Rural Development/ M.A. in Rural Development/ MBA in Rural Development/ M.A. in Social Science or PGD in Social Science, OR MBA. Working knowledge of computers. The notice lists these as preferential qualifications and skills. They are not part of the essential qualification. Experience of working in the field of public health programs at National/ State level, preferably in Public Private Partnerships and/ or the health system. At least five (05) years of experience in case of Post Graduate Diploma qualification, and three (03) years of experience in case of Post Graduate Degree qualification. At least 3 years' experience in project management is desirable. The age limit is "Upto 65 years". The notice does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. Along with the age requirement, the notice says that candidates must be ready to travel extensively. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following responsibilities for the Technical Officer (Public Private Partnership): To handle day to day correspondence at Central TB Division pertaining to Public-Private-Partnerships for TB control in India. To assist the CTD in maintaining database of stake holders in PPP (including mapping and regular updating). Coordination with different Core Committees and Technical Working Group for PPM. To assist in updating and revising PPP guidelines according to the policy revisions. To facilitate the national/regional trainings on PPP. Implement, review and evaluate NTEP partnership with medical colleges including facilitation of NTF, ZTF, STF and Core Committees of Medical Colleges involved in NTEP. Plan, coordinate and facilitate involvement of corporate hospitals and DNB institutions in NTEP. Coordinate and facilitate involvement of other public health sectors and institutions like CGHS, ESI, Railways etc. Coordinate with MCI, NCI, PCI and AYUSH councils for incorporation of NTEP in curricula. To conduct supervisory visits to states/districts to monitor PPP implementation and report to CTD. To assist in monitoring the enrolment of health facilities, Private Practitioners and NGOs under various PPP schemes, their performance and disbursal of Grand in Aids. To assist in monitoring the PPP performance of the States/UTs and districts based on relevant indicators derived from respective quarterly reports and PPP reports, and providing feedbacks to states/districts. To assist in compiling PPP reports to the Government of India and PPP stakeholders. To assist in conducting meetings with partners, documenting the minutes, compiling reports on action taken and providing feedbacks. To work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. To identify and foster innovative and sustainable financing mechanism for effective programme implementation and assist in stake holder consultation. To assist Central TB Division in organizing periodic review meeting of State PPM Coordinators at national level, and to facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT and Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation and its use for public health action. Any other job assigned as per programme need.

To ensure proper functioning of supply chain management of second line drugs, and to initiate actions to fill the gaps. This is done by reviewing: the quarterly PMDT reports; district/state quarterly reports on program management and logistics; monthly state drug store reports on second line drugs. To support mortality reduction activities like differential TB Care among TB patients. To assist in timely revisions/updates of technical and operation guidelines based on evidences and changes in policies. To assist in preparing reports on program performance for the government and stake holders based on pre-defined indicators. To support ADR monitoring and management activities. To conduct supervisory visits to states/districts as per program needs. To assist and or conduct in organising trainings/meetings. To work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. To facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT & Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation and its use for public health action. Any other job assigned as per programme need.

To facilitate change management with respect to use of ICT & Nikshay tools for concerned data entry, validation & its use for public health action. To identify various programme linkages across different national programmes, to develop NTEP programme on TB co- morbidities. To identify and facilitate operational research in TB- HIV/comorbidities. To assist CTD in collaborating with other National Programmes / partners. To assist in compiling comorbidity management reports to the Government of India and stakeholders. To assist in conducting meetings with partners, documenting the minutes, compiling reports on action taken and providing feedback. To work in collaboration with technical officers of other thematic areas of the program on cross cutting issues. content_sections.heading: About Saket Court
content_sections.text: The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge (South) is located at the District Court Complex, Saket, New Delhi. This engagement follows the "Guidelines for Engagement of Law Researchers for the District Judges (Commercial Courts) in Delhi, 2023", which the High Court of Delhi approved and enclosed with the notice. Under those guidelines, every District Judge (Commercial Court) in Delhi is entitled to the services of one Law Researcher.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Members of the Bar who meet these conditions: Qualification: A graduate in law from a recognized law school/college/university/institute established by law in India and recognized by the Bar Council of India. The candidate needs not less than 55% marks in the aggregate and must be eligible for enrolment as an Advocate with the Bar Council. Preference: Preference may be given to candidates having a Post Graduation Degree in Law or other relevant experience. Computer skills: The candidate must have good working knowledge of computers. Nationality: The candidate must be a citizen of India. Age: The candidate must not be above 32 years of age as on the date of making the application for engagement. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. The candidate must not be engaged, or appointed/employed elsewhere, on an honorarium/payment/salary basis during the engagement as Law Researcher. The candidate should not have been convicted of, or involved in, any criminal case relating to an offence involving moral turpitude. The candidate must not be facing any disciplinary proceedings before the Bar Council of India and/or the Bar Council of the State concerned or any other authority. For the complete eligibility conditions, refer to the official notification and the enclosed 2023 Guidelines.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Law Researcher will be paid a fixed monthly honorarium of Rs.50,000/- or such honorarium as may be revised from time to time. The Law Researcher is not entitled to any other allowance or perks. The engagement is on a purely short-term contractual basis for one year. It can be extended by another term of one year under the orders of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, on the recommendation of the District Judge (Commercial Court). The engagement does not confer any right or claim to regular appointment or to continuance in service beyond the actual period of engagement. A Law Researcher may be prematurely discharged with immediate effect, without any reason being given. A Law Researcher who wishes to leave early must give at least one month's prior notice in writing to the Principal District and Sessions Judge. This requirement may be waived in appropriate cases or extenuating circumstances. Casual leave may be granted up to a maximum of 12 days per year, in proportion to the period of engagement. Special casual leave may be granted for 10 days in June and 5 days during the winter vacation. Extraordinary medical leave of up to 10 days on half remuneration may be granted in extreme cases. No stipend is paid for unauthorized absence or for leave beyond the permissible limit. Leave needs approval from the District Judge (Commercial Court). In an emergency, the Law Researcher may proceed on leave after giving prior intimation. An experience certificate may be issued after a minimum of six months of engagement, subject to the approval of the Principal District and Sessions Judge.

content_sections.heading: Saket Court Law Researcher Job Description
content_sections.text: Render assistance to the concerned District Judge (Commercial Court) in judicial functions. Assist with the administrative functions of the District Judge (Commercial Court), as assigned. Work under the direct control and supervision of the District Judge (Commercial Court), and under the overall administrative control of the Principal District and Sessions Judge. Work during the Court working hours of the Delhi District Courts. The Law Researcher may also be required to work after Court hours, and to attend the office or residential office of the District Judge on gazetted or local holidays. The Law Researcher may be posted with any District Judge (Commercial Court) in the district and may be transferred from one Commercial Court to another within the district. During the engagement, the Law Researcher will have access to the Court room. At the discretion of the District Judge (Commercial Court), the Law Researcher may also have access to the Judge's chamber, the Library and the Residential Office.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Saket Court Law Researcher
content_sections.text: Use the prescribed application form (Schedule-I) attached to the notice. Address it to the Principal District & Sessions Judge (South), Saket Court Complex, New Delhi. Fill in all 13 items of the Applicant's Profile, including your qualifications with percentage of marks, your experience, your computer knowledge, the number and date of your enrolment as an Advocate with the place of enrolment, and your present employer, if any. Paste a latest passport-size coloured photograph on the form, then sign it with the place and date. Attach the relevant documents listed below. Submit the duly filled form in the General Branch, South District, Saket Courts Complex, New Delhi, through the Receipt and Issue Branch, (South District), Room No. 401, Saket Court Complex, New Delhi. Submit it on any working day between 10.00 A.M. and 05.00 P.M., latest by 20 November 2026. Applications received after the due date and time will not be entertained. A latest passport-size coloured photograph pasted on the form Documents pertaining to educational qualification(s) Documents pertaining to experience Documents pertaining to publication(s) Undertaking/Declaration in Schedule-II. The notice refers to the proforma "as per Schedule-I & II", and the guidelines require the selected candidate to sign it before joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has three stages: shortlisting, a personal interview, and verification of documents. Shortlisting: The office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge shortlists candidates from the applications received, according to the eligibility criteria in the guidelines. Selection Committee: The committee consists of the Principal District and Sessions Judge (Chairperson), the Principal Judge (Family Court) and the senior most District Judge (Commercial Court) of the district. Personal interview: Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview by the committee. The final selection is made on the basis of this interview. Merit list: A final merit list is prepared and published on the website, along with a waiting list. The waiting list is valid for one year. Candidates on it are offered engagement for the remaining period, in order of merit, if a selected candidate does not join, leaves early or is discharged. Engagement letter: Engagement/appointment letters are issued by the Principal District and Sessions Judge after the requisite documents are verified.

content_sections.heading: About the Ministry of External Affairs Notice
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Administration Division of the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India, from Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, New Delhi, and is dated 3 November 2026. It invites applications in the prescribed proforma (Annexure I) for engagement of one Consultant in the MEA, New Delhi. The engagement is strictly contractual.

content_sections.text: The notice does not print any age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.requirement: The applicant should only be an Indian national.

27-40 years as on the last date of submission of application.
Domain knowledge of various Indian Penal Code (IPC) / Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) Laws of India.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration package will be commensurate with the experience and profile of the selected candidate, subject to a maximum of Rs. 83,300/- (Rupees Eighty Three Thousand and Three Hundred only) per month and deduction of applicable taxes. The amount of consultancy fee so fixed shall remain unchanged during the term of engagement. No HRA shall be admissible. Period of consultancy: 01 (One) year. The contract can be extended further depending on assessment of performance, mutual willingness and the requirement. The contract may be terminated on one month's notice from either side or on payment of one month's pay in lieu thereof. Unauthorized absence may lead to termination of the engagement. The engagement is full time. Normal working hours are 0900 to 1730 hrs and are subject to change from time to time. Saturdays and Sundays remain closed as weekend off. In exigencies, the Consultant may be required to work beyond office hours and/or on holidays, with no extra allowance or remuneration. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Leave cannot be claimed as a matter of right and will not be allowed for more than 10 days at a time. Leave encashment is not permissible, and unspent leave lapses on commencement of the notice period. If the Consultant travels as part of duties, the Ministry will take care of travel, accommodation and per-diem costs as per Ministry's guidelines.

content_sections.text: Handling of various court cases in which Ministry/DE Division is party. Seeking legal opinion in various marital disputes, child abduction and matter related to Indian students abroad. Seeking legal opinion on various bills of DE Division including NRI Marriage bill. The job location is the Ministry of External Affairs (including Jawaharlal Nehru Bhawan, Sushma Swaraj Bhawan, Patiala House, ISIL Building and Kartavya Bhavan), New Delhi.

basic_details.short_information: GAIL (India) Limited, a Maharatna PSU, is filling one post of Chief General Manager (Law), grade E-8, on the pay scale of Rs. 1,20,000 to Rs. 2,80,000. The post needs a minimum of 24 years of post-qualification executive experience, and the upper age limit is 52 years. Indian nationals can apply only online at gailonline.com from 1100 hrs on 3 November 2026 to 1800 hrs on 2 December 2026 under Advt. No. GAIL/OPEN/LAW/2/2026. The single post is in the Unreserved (UR) category.

age_limit.details: Upper age limit: 52 years, reckoned as on 02.12.2026. The upper age is relaxable by 10 years for PwBD candidates, provided the post is identified suitable for them; the post is identified for the categories listed in the notice (B, LV; D, HH; OA, BA, OL, OAL, BL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV; MI; and MD involving these). Ex-servicemen with not less than six months continuous service in the Armed Forces may deduct that service from their actual age, and are treated as meeting the limit if the resultant age does not exceed the maximum by more than 03 years. The maximum upper age shall not exceed 56 years including all relaxations. Unreserved candidates get no age relaxation. | Only Indian nationals are eligible. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification.

qualification.details: Graduate Degree in any Discipline with minimum 50% marks and Bachelor Degree in Law (LLB) (minimum 3 years professional course) with minimum 50% marks, OR 5 years Integrated LLB Degree (Professional) with minimum 50% marks. Only full time regular courses are considered. Qualifications must be from a UGC recognised Indian University or Deemed University, or AICTE approved courses from autonomous Indian institutions or the concerned statutory council, wherever applicable. Unreserved candidates get no relaxation in minimum marks, and no rounding off is allowed: 49.99% is not treated as 50%.

selection_process: The selection process involves a Group Discussion and/or Interview before the Selection Committee. Only candidates who fulfil all eligibility criteria on the online application are considered further. If applications are large
GAIL may shortlist by raising the minimum eligibility standards.

Interview: minimum qualifying marks 60%. Group Discussion/Writing exercise (wherever applicable) or any other tool assessing legal acumen/competencies: minimum qualifying marks 40%. The process is tentative and may vary with administrative or business requirements. Shortlisted candidates are called by email
and the shortlist is posted in the career section of the GAIL website.
how_to_apply: Apply online only through the GAIL website (https://gailonline.com). No other mode of application is entertained.
Keep a valid email ID and mobile number, active through the whole recruitment process, and scanned colour photograph and signature (each 3.5 X 4.5 cm, up to 250 KB, in .JPG, .PNG or .JPEG).
Register with personal details, contact details and email ID. The user ID and password are sent to the registered email.
Log in, select the Advertisement No. and the post.
Complete the application form (personal details, qualification and experience details).
Pay the fee if applicable, using the "Please click on link for Payment" link under the Miscellaneous tab, next to "Experience Details".
Check the details with the "Final Preview" option and submit. The form cannot be edited after submission.

content_sections.heading: About GAIL
content_sections.text: The notice describes GAIL (India) Limited as a Maharatna PSU and India's flagship Natural Gas company, covering exploration and production, processing, transmission, distribution and marketing. Its office is at GAIL Bhawan, 16, Bhikaiji Cama Place, R.K. Puram, New Delhi-110 066. This recruitment is under the heading "Career Opportunities in Legal Discipline".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Graduate Degree in any Discipline with minimum 50% marks and Bachelor Degree in Law (LLB) (minimum 3 years professional course) with minimum 50% marks, OR 5 years Integrated LLB Degree (Professional) with minimum 50% marks. Only full time regular courses are considered. Qualifications must be from a UGC recognised Indian University or Deemed University, or AICTE approved courses from autonomous Indian institutions or the concerned statutory council, wherever applicable. Unreserved candidates get no relaxation in minimum marks, and no rounding off is allowed: 49.99% is not treated as 50%. Minimum 24 years of post-qualification executive experience, including experience as ET/MT, in State/Central Government departments, organisations or undertakings and/or large private sector organisations, institutions or companies of repute, as an employee. At least 16 of the 24 years must be in legal function. Up to 8 years as an advocate in a Large Law Firm, out of the 24 years, is also considered. Such candidates must have been enrolled with the concerned Bar Council during that period. Candidates currently in a large private sector organisation or Large Law Firm must have minimum annual CTC of Rs.35 Lakh as on the closing date of the online application. Candidates currently in Government organisations, PSUs or PSBs must have minimum 01 year experience in the next lower pay scale (IDA pattern) of Rs. 1,20,000-2,80,000 (revised scale of 2017) or equivalent. The next lower scales are E-7 (Rs 1,00,000-2,60,000) for CPSEs, Level 14 (Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200) for Central Government and Scale VI (Rs 1,40,500-1,56,500) for PSU Banks. Where the Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000 scale runs across two executive levels in a CPSE, 01 year in one level below the highest is needed. With three levels, 05 years in two levels below the highest is needed. Apprenticeship training under The Apprenticeship Act 1961 in the relevant industry counts as experience, with certificates from both the statutory body and the training organisation. Experience through an empanelled agency or contractor on contract deployment is not considered. Direct work experience, including fixed term employment, is. A large private sector organisation means one listed on NSE or group A or B of BSE, or with more than 500 regular employees, or annual turnover above Rs 250 crores in a relevant financial year. A Large Law Firm means annual turnover above Rs 10 crores. Master Degree in Law (LLM). Upper age limit: 52 years, reckoned as on 02.12.2026. The upper age is relaxable by 10 years for PwBD candidates, provided the post is identified suitable for them; the post is identified for the categories listed in the notice (B, LV; D, HH; OA, BA, OL, OAL, BL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV; MI; and MD involving these). Ex-servicemen with not less than six months continuous service in the Armed Forces may deduct that service from their actual age, and are treated as meeting the limit if the resultant age does not exceed the maximum by more than

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay scale: Rs. 1,20,000 to Rs. 2,80,000 (E-8). Initial basic pay: Rs 1,20,000. Selected candidates are on probation for one year. Pay and allowances: basic pay as applicable in the grade, Variable Dearness Allowance (VDA) at applicable rates, and perks and allowances under the Cafeteria Approach. Variable pay: Performance Related Pay as per the applicable policy. Other benefits as per company rules: company or leased accommodation or HRA, medical facility, group insurance, house building advance and conveyance advance. Superannuation, subject to terms and conditions: Contributory Provident Fund, Gratuity and Pension under the Defined Contributory Scheme. Post-Retirement Medical Benefits under the Defined Contributory Scheme go to those who superannuate from GAIL after a minimum of 15 years of continuous service. Pay protection applies to candidates joining from PSUs, Central/State Government departments, autonomous bodies, Public Sector Banks or semi-Government institutions. It is evaluated on CTC (excluding PRP) from the Last Pay Certificate or CTC statement, which the candidate must submit. GAIL's settlement is final and binding. Placement: selected candidates may be posted at any installation, project or office of GAIL or its subsidiaries/Joint Ventures, or deputed to a Government of India department or other PSUs. They may be assigned work as per business requirements, including shift operations. All benefits are governed by company policy as amended from time to time.

content_sections.text: The National Commission for Women, located at Plot No. 21, Jasola Institutional Area, New Delhi-110025, has been established as a statutory body. According to the notice, its work covers the constitutional and legal safeguards provided to women, reviewing existing legislation and suggesting amendments, looking into complaints involving deprivation of women's rights, and monitoring the implementation of laws enacted to protect the rights of women.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The Commission intends to engage professionals having LLB/LLM as Junior Technical Experts (Legal). The notice does not specify a minimum period of experience, but candidates will be shortlisted on the basis of their educational qualification and experience. The job requirements printed in the notice also include the ability to work under strict deadlines and allot priorities across multiple responsibilities, and willingness to undertake travel when required and adopt flexible working hours. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Remuneration: Rs. 4.8 lakh per annum. The engagement is on contract basis initially for a period of one year. The engagement shall be purely on contract basis for a short period from the date of joining, which may be extended/curtailed subject to satisfactory performance, on requirement basis. Leave: 12 (Twelve) days in a year on pro-rata basis, which may be availed during the period of contract. In addition, Medical Leave of 7 days and 2 days Restricted Holidays. Additional leave without pay is permitted only upon approval by the Competent Authority. The selected candidate will not be eligible for Government Accommodation, House Rent Allowance, CGHS facility etc. No TA/DA is admissible for joining the assignment or at the time of its completion. TA/DA for work-related travel on official business is given as per entitlement. Only basic working facilities/infrastructure will be provided. No telephone/internet facility at the residence and no subordinate staff will be provided.

content_sections.heading: NCW Junior Technical Experts (Legal) Job Description
content_sections.text: Putting up the precedents on matters referred for Legal Advice/conduct of litigation/proposing new bills/amendments in laws. Submission of notes and drafts on matters referred for Legal Advice/conduct of litigation/proposing new bills/amendments in laws. Reference and Research work, wherever necessary. Drafting of background notes for various consultations/seminars/programmes. Preparing para-wise comments for various court matters. Examining media reports/judgments passed by various courts wherein intervention of the Commission is warranted. Setting measurable/quantifiable targets for self and ensuring timely achievement. Preparing periodic/annual reports on the subject. Assisting the Expert/Working Group/committee that may be constituted by NCW, including its meetings, minutes and correspondence. Maintenance of data and updation of the database of the Commission on a regular basis. Relationship building and networking with Govt. resource agencies, academia and legal experts to achieve the mandate of the Commission. Initiating/organizing seminars/workshops/consultations on women-related issues to build opinion on developing and adopting progressive policy. Examining/reviewing the safeguards provided under various women laws for the protection of women's rights and suggesting measures for effective implementation. Any other work assigned by the superiors from time to time.

content_sections.heading: NMET Consultant (Accountant) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The pay is worked out once and stays the same for the whole contract. Each month's payment is released only after the concerned controlling officer gives a satisfactory performance certificate. content_sections.heading: NMET Consultant (Accountant) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must be below 63 years of age on the closing date of applications, 25 November 2026. They must also be in good health so they can carry out their official duties. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The mandatory conditions are: Retired from the post of SO/ASO in a Central Government Ministry or Department. At least 5 years of working experience in Government Accounts. Good knowledge of GFR, DFPR, PFMS and similar rules and systems. Fluent with MS Word and MS Excel, with skill in noting and drafting and in office procedure. Fair knowledge of computer applications such as MS Word, MS Excel and Power Point. Remuneration, eligibility, leave and working hours follow Department of Expenditure O.M. No. 3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 09.12.2020, as amended from time to time. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Duties of Consultant (Accountant)
content_sections.text: Work as a dealing hand and, if required, carry out supervisory functions. Process the claims of employees posted in NMET. Start proposals relating to claims in E-Office. Process bills in PFMS. Maintain the Bill Register, Expenditure Register, Grant in Aid Register, Advance Register and other registers. Report to the officers of the Finance & Accounts Division and do the tasks they assign.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Contract period: one (01) year at first. It may be extended or cut short depending on need and the Consultant's performance. The term cannot go beyond 5 years after superannuation. Place of posting: NMET office, New Delhi. Nature: purely contractual. It gives no right to a regular appointment in NMET. Working hours: normal office timings. The Consultant may also be called in on a Saturday, Sunday or holiday when work requires it. Leave: paid leave at 1.5 days for each completed month of service. Leave cannot be carried over beyond a calendar year. Confidentiality: the intellectual property in all data and deliverables belongs to NMET. Nothing may be shared with a third party without NMET's written consent. The full set of records must be handed over before the contract ends and before the final payment. Conflict of interest: the Consultant must not advise anyone against NMET's interest or take on any activity outside the contract. Termination: NMET may end the contract if the Consultant cannot handle the work, if the quality of work does not satisfy the Controlling Officer or Competent Authority, or if the Consultant is found lacking in honesty and integrity. The Competent Authority may also end it at any time without notice or reason. Resignation: 15 days' written notice is required. The Consultant is relieved only after handing over all files, records, data and assets. The Competent Authority may waive or shorten the notice period. NMET may accept or reject any or all applications, in part or in full, without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: CCI is filling 12 posts: 5 professional posts and 7 administrative posts. The vacancies are liable to change without notice, and the Commission reserves the right not to fill any or all of them. *One post of Office Manager (CS) is for posting at Regional Office Kolkata.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must be employees of the All India Services, the Central Civil Services, or autonomous organisations, regulatory authorities, universities or academic or research institutions etc. of the Central or State Governments. Their services must be able to be spared immediately on selection. The age limit and the other eligibility conditions in Annexures I and II must be met as on the closing date and time for receipt of applications in CCI, that is 24 December 2026 (5:00 PM). The maximum age limit for appointment on deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications by CCI. For each post, the eligible services and the post or experience required come from Annexures I and II, as below. The pre-revised pay scales printed there are also given. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is on deputation on foreign service terms basis for three years, subject to satisfactory performance. It is governed by the instructions in DOPT OM No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended from time to time. It is also governed by GoI Notification No. GSR 670 (E) dated 14 September 2009, as amended from time to time, on the conditions of service of Officers and other employees of CCI. Apart from basic pay, the post carries DA, HRA and Transport Allowance etc. at the rates applicable to Central Government employees from time to time. The fixation of pay and deputation (duty) allowance is governed by instructions issued by DOP&T from time to time. Medical reimbursement is admissible as per the CCI service rules. This is in lieu of CGHS benefits, which are not admissible to the Officers of CCI. CCI is an eligible office for allotment or retention of Government accommodation from the General Pool.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CCI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are submitted offline only, through the applicant's employer. They must reach CCI by 24 December 2026 (5:00 PM). Fill in the application in the prescribed pro-forma at Annexure-III. Write your name in block letters and paste a copy of a passport-size photograph in the box provided. Submit a separate application for each post you want to apply for. Complete item 12 by comparing the essential and desirable qualifications and experience with your own. Where a qualification has been treated as equivalent, name the authority that treated it as equivalent. List your employment history in chronological order (item 13). If you need more space, use a separate sheet in the same format, signed by you. Also give any experience of handling investigation or enforcement of economic or regulatory law, or experience in Competition Law, with the number of years (item 14). Sign the declaration. It states that your Curriculum Vitae, supported by documents, will also be assessed by the Selection Committee. Get the certificate on the last page of the form completed, signed and sealed by your Employer/Head of office/Forwarding authority. Have the application forwarded through proper channel, with all the documents listed below, to: Deputy Director (HR), Competition Commission of India, 9th Floor, Office Block-1, Kidwai Nagar (East), New Delhi-110023. Application in the Annexure-III pro-forma, with a copy of a passport-size photograph pasted on it Cadre Clearance Vigilance Clearance Integrity Certificate Attested copies of up-to-date APARs for the last five years, or the CR/APAR dossier in original. Photocopies of ACRs/APARs must be attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary to the Govt. of India or above. Employer's certificate confirming four things: no vigilance, disciplinary or criminal case is pending or contemplated; the applicant's integrity; that no major or minor penalty was imposed in the last ten years, or a list of such penalties; and that the cadre controlling authority has no objection to the applicant being considered For applicants not in the Central Government pay scales: the equivalence of their pay scale with the Central Government's pay scales, with supporting documents List of enclosures

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A candidate may be called for an interaction with the Selection Committee constituted for the post. No TA/DA is payable for attending this interaction. The Selection Committee will also assess the Curriculum Vitae, supported by the documents submitted, at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications forwarded conditionally by the employer, or received without the prescribed documents and the employer's certificate, will be summarily rejected. Applications received after 24 December 2026 (5:00 PM) will not be considered. The Commission takes no responsibility for any delay in receipt of applications or for their loss in postal transit. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. In the employer's certificate, the employer confirms that the candidate will be relieved immediately if selected.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility for DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 depends on the discipline. Candidates must possess the degrees, relevant specializations and experience, where prescribed, under the university's applicable recruitment rules. DTU provides links to the detailed recruitment rules covering qualifications, pay scale, relevant branches and experience. Applicants should check the recruitment rules for their chosen discipline before applying. Meeting the minimum qualification alone does not guarantee shortlisting for presentation or interview. Applicants for Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Electronics and other engineering disciplines must meet the prescribed undergraduate, postgraduate or other approved qualification combinations for the relevant branch. Applicants for Applied Chemistry, Applied Mathematics, Applied Physics, Humanities, Economics and related subjects must satisfy the qualifications and academic conditions under their respective DTU recruitment rules. content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 application fee is ₹2,000 for UR and OBC candidates, ₹1,000 for eligible EWS, SC and ST candidates, and nil for PwBD candidates. The reduced fee is available only where the applicant applies against an appropriately reserved vacancy and meets the applicable conditions. Payment Mode: Online only. The fee is non-refundable and cannot be transferred or adjusted against another recruitment process. Candidates applying for more than one discipline must submit separate applications and pay the applicable fee for each application.

content_sections.heading: DTU Assistant Professor Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The DTU Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 selection process includes initial academic screening, detailed scrutiny, document and point-mark verification, teaching presentation and interview. The final assessment considers academic record, teaching or research experience, research performance, teaching aptitude, domain knowledge and interview performance. Initial application screening based on the notified 100-point criteria. Publication of the provisional consideration-zone list. Submission and scrutiny of supporting documents by candidates in the consideration zone. Provisional shortlisting according to eligibility and screening scores. Document and Point Mark Verification. Teaching Aptitude and Ability Presentation. Domain Knowledge Assessment and Interview. DTU will use a 100-point initial screening system. The score is based on Ph.D. qualification, the prescribed pre-Ph.D. degree and qualifying national-level tests or scholarships. The pre-Ph.D. degree score is calculated according to the notification's formula: 35 + 0.5 × (X − 50), where X is the percentage obtained in the eligible pre-Ph.D. degree. The calculation is subject to the prescribed maximum score and recruitment rules. The online application also requires academic and research credentials under a separate 50-point framework. This is distinct from the 100-point initial screening criteria. The academic section considers undergraduate marks, postgraduate marks, Ph.D. qualification and relevant qualifying examinations. The experience and research section considers eligible teaching, research and industrial experience, publications, books, projects, patents and research guidance.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted in online mode only, by email to [email protected]. They must be sent by 23 November 2026.
Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of the notice) in the given format, typed or by hand.
Affix a recent self-attested passport-size photograph to the form, then scan the form.
Fill in and sign the declaration (Annexure-II) about relatives working at ICAR/IARI. Every candidate must send it, including those with no such relatives.
Scan self-attested copies of the documents listed below.
Email the scanned form, the declaration and all the documents to [email protected] by 23 November 2026.

Self-attested copies of all certificates and mark sheets from matriculation onwards
Date of birth certificate
NET/equivalent certificate
Proof of experience or experience certificate (the form asks only for experience of one year or more)

No Objection Certificate from the current employer, if employed
Publications (published research papers only, with proof)
Signed declaration (Annexure-II) about relatives working at ICAR/IARI

The application form also asks for your age on the date of interview, your correspondence and permanent addresses with PIN code, your mobile number and email address, your educational record from Class 10 onwards (with subjects and percentage of marks) and two references with their phone numbers and email addresses. It ends with a signed self-declaration that the details are true.

content_sections.text: The notice advertises one position in each of three rows, making 3 Young Professional-I positions in all. Each row is funded differently and has its own qualification and duties.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Emoluments: ₹30,000 per month (fixed) for each of the three positions. Duration: up to 31-03-2027, marked "Extendable" in the notice. The appointment is on a full-time basis. A Young Professional is not permitted to take up any other assignment during the period of engagement with ICAR/ICAR Institutes. Notwithstanding the duration of engagement, the Director can terminate the services at any time without assigning any reason by issuing one month's notice or one month's emoluments. A Young Professional may leave on their own volition by giving one month's notice. One month's emoluments will be withheld by the Institute as caution money and released after all dues are cleared. At the end of the assignment, the staff will not have any right to claim employment or engagement at the Institute, and no claim for regular employment at ICAR-CCARI, Ela, Old Goa or any other ICAR Institute.

content_sections.heading: ICAR-CCARI Young Professional-I Job Description
content_sections.text: Young Professional-I (Under SCSP Fund) – nature of duties: Aquaculture field work, fish sampling. Ornamental fish breeding, larval rearing. Fish training, exposure visits and training programmes. Data collection and analysis. Demonstration of fish culture. Recording observations on growth, feeding, water quality analysis. Field visit and fishing-gear-based sampling etc. Video documentation, preparation of social media stories and digital contents. Young Professional-I (Under STC Fund): activities involving farm animal research, field observations and lab analysis, management and handling of animals for collection of biological samples and data, recording of experimental data and biological sample analysis. Young Professional-I (Under Institute Fund): activities involving molecular breeding laboratory work, field observations and lab analysis, management and handling of biological samples and data recording of experimental data.

content_sections.heading: About SMC
content_sections.text: Surat Municipal Corporation is the municipal body of Surat, Gujarat, with its office at Shree Tapi Bhavan, Gordhandas Chokhawala Marg, Tapipura, Surat. The corporation runs the SMIMER hospitals, and these honorary super speciality consultant posts are for those hospitals. The recruitment follows the terms and conditions in resolution no. 915/2005 dated 14/10/2005 and the General Board resolution no. 630/2023 dated 27/10/2023.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications go to the Recruitment Department of Surat Municipal Corporation at this address: Fifth Floor, Recruitment Department, New Annexe Building, Tapipura, Surat. The notice says applications are invited at this office during office hours from 16/11/2026 to 30/11/2026. It does not mention sending applications by post or email. Get the application format from the Surat Municipal Corporation website ( www.suratmunicipal.gov.in ). The same form, titled "Application for the Honorary Post of ...", is printed on pages 3 and 4 of the notice. Write the name of the post you are applying for in the title line of the form. Fill the form in block letters with a black ball point pen only, as the form instructs. Give your name, correspondence address with PIN code, residence phone with STD code, mobile number, email ID, sex, date of birth, category, PAN number, mother tongue and other languages known. Fill in your educational qualifications (institute or university, examination, passing month and year, main subject, percentage and number of attempts) and your experience (institution, dates, designation and nature of work, salary drawn, years and months). Attach attested copies of the documents listed under Enclosures, and sign the declaration with place and date. Submit the application at the Recruitment Department, Fifth Floor, New Annexe Building, Tapipura, Surat, during office hours between 16 November 2026 and 30 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Surat Municipal Corporation has listed 25 honorary posts across six departments. The same honorarium applies to all posts: Rs. 4000/- per month for doctors with a graduate degree and Rs. 6000/- per month for doctors with a postgraduate degree, with recruitment up to 31/03/2027. The notice prints the number for each post but no overall total. The figure of 25 is the sum of the post-wise numbers. The notice gives the following qualification for each post: Gastroenterology: DM/DNB-Gastro Endocrinology: DM/DNB-Endocrino Neurology: DM/DNB-Neuro Haematology: DM/DNB-Heamato Nephrology: DM/DNB-Nephro Paediatric Surgery: M.Ch-Paediatric Surgery Plastic Surgery: M.Ch-Plastic Surgery Urology: M.Ch-Urology Cardio-Thoracic Surgery: M.Ch-Cardio-Thoracic Surgery Gastroenterologist: M.Ch, or DNB-Surgical Gastroenterologist and Liver Transplantation Ortho (Joint Replacement): M.Ch-Ortho Retina Surgeon: Fellow of National Board In Retinal Speciality (FNB) after MS Ophthalmology, or two years fellowship in retina from reputed institute after MS ophthalmology Interventional Radiologist: (A) Assistant Professor (Interventional Radiologist) Post M.D. (Radiologist), or DNB Radiology with atleast work in Interventional for two years; or (B) M.D. (Radiologist) with two years of fellowship in Interventional Radiology Neonatology: DM/DNB- Neonet Paediatric Cardiologists: DM/DNB Fellowship in Pediatric Cardiology For any of these posts that requires a registration certificate, the candidate must attach a copy of the registration certificate of the Gujarat Council. The notice makes this compulsory. The notice calls the pay a "honorary remuneration" (માનદ વેતન), following General Board resolution no. 630/2023 dated 27/10/2023. It is Rs. 4000/- per month for doctors with a graduate degree and Rs. 6000/- per month for doctors with a postgraduate degree. The notice does not mention any allowance in addition to this amount. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The notice requires attested copies of these documents with the application: School leaving certificate as proof of age Marksheet and certificate for educational qualification, and the degree certificate Experience certificate Proof of residence Contact number (mobile / phone number) EPIC card, Aadhaar card and PAN card Copy of the Gujarat Council registration certificate, for posts that require registration The application form also has a checklist of documents to tick: Birth Certificate; School leaving Certificate; Diploma, Graduation and Post Graduation mark sheets and certificates; Caste Certificate; Experience Certificate on letter pad only; CCC, CCC+ or any other certificate related to Computer Education; Attempt Certificate if any; PAN Card; Aadhaar Card; and other information, if any. content_sections.text: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board has released for the Gujarat Subordinate Services Class-3 (Group-A and Group-B) Combined Competitive Examination. The official 38-page Gujarati notification contains complete department-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age relaxation, fixed pay, reservation provisions, application instructions, examination fee, selection process and preliminary and main examination syllabi. Official Notification Source: GSSSB Official Website Detailed Notification: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026 468/202627.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government . Basic computer knowledge and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi are also required. The prescribed degree must be obtained from a university established or incorporated under the applicable Central or State legislation, a recognized institution or an institution meeting the relevant University Grants Commission provisions. Yes. Applicants must possess basic knowledge of computer applications under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. However, the notification permits candidates who do not currently possess the required computer knowledge certificate to apply. Such candidates must obtain and produce acceptable computer knowledge certification before appointment. The accepted evidence may include a recognized computer course certificate, degree or diploma involving computer studies, or Class 10 or Class 12 qualification with a computer subject, according to the applicable rules. The recruitment notification requires adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both . Candidates should also prepare for the Gujarati language portions of the competitive examination and the descriptive Gujarati paper where applicable.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment follows a two-stage competitive examination process: a common preliminary examination and separate main examinations for Group-A and Group-B. Online Application: Candidates register and submit the application through OJAS. Preliminary Examination: A common 150-mark objective examination is conducted for Group-A and Group-B. Shortlisting for Mains: Separate Group-A and Group-B eligibility lists are prepared based on preliminary examination performance. Main Examination: Group-A candidates appear for descriptive papers, while Group-B candidates appear for an objective main examination. Merit List: Final selection lists are prepared using the applicable main examination results, reservation provisions and qualifying standards. Document Verification: Shortlisted candidates must satisfy the prescribed educational, age, category and other eligibility conditions. GSSSB will shortlist candidates for the main examinations separately for Group-A and Group-B, generally up to seven times the number of category-wise vacancies , based on the prescribed preliminary examination merit process. Preliminary examination marks are used for screening and are not counted toward the final selection merit.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Preliminary Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The common preliminary examination will contain 150 multiple-choice questions for 150 marks , with a duration of 120 minutes. Eligible candidates with disabilities will receive additional examination time according to the notification's provisions, including 20 minutes per hour where applicable.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Group-A Main Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Group-A main examination is descriptive and consists of three papers carrying a combined total of 350 marks. The Gujarati descriptive paper carries 100 marks and includes essay writing, expansion of ideas, précis writing, prose comprehension, press notes, letter writing, discussion articles, reports, translation and Gujarati grammar. The English descriptive paper carries 100 marks and covers essay writing, formal letters, report writing, interpretation of visual information, formal speech, précis writing, reading comprehension, grammar and translation. The General Studies paper carries 150 marks. Its syllabus covers Indian history, Gujarat history, cultural heritage, the Constitution, governance, economy, geography, science, environment, current affairs and other subjects prescribed in Appendix-H of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB CCE 2.0 Group-B Main Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Group-B main examination is an objective-type examination carrying 200 marks with a duration of 120 minutes. The notification prescribes a minimum qualifying standard of 40% for the preliminary and main examinations, including the applicable papers. The qualifying standard cannot be reduced below 40% for any category. Meeting the minimum qualifying standard does not automatically guarantee shortlisting or selection, as the competitive merit cut-off may be higher.
