content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: * DNB in a subject from an Institute or Medical College recognized by MCI/NMC with experience according to NMC Guidelines. The notice reproduces clause 4A of the Minimum Qualifications for Teachers in Medical Institutions (Amendment) Regulations, 2018 on equivalence of DNB with MD/MS: (a) DNB training in an institution which now runs MCI recognized postgraduate degree courses in a given subject: the DNB is at par with the MCI recognized qualification in that subject only. (b) DNB training in a multi-speciality teaching hospital with at least 500 beds, involved in various postgraduate/super-speciality teaching programmes, provided one out of three DNB supervisors qualifies as postgraduate teacher as per MCI norms in his/her previous appointment and one out of the remaining two qualifies as postgraduate teacher as per MCI regulations: considered at par. (c) Three years teaching experience in the subject as Resident/Registrar/Demonstrator/Tutor, or work experience gained during DNB training, in other locations/institutions (100 or more bedded hospitals): one additional year as senior resident in an MCI recognized/permitted institution is required for equivalence. (d) The same three years of experience from an institution not covered in (a) to (c): two additional years as Sr. Resident/Research Associate (CSIR) in an MCI recognised/permitted medical college/institution are required for equivalence. The candidate should pass the qualifying examination by 28 February 2027 and the result should be declared on or before that date. Candidates who have appeared for the exam or viva voce with the result awaited may appear in the theory exam and/or interview provisionally. Mandatory qualification: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. Mandatory experience: applicants must be officers in the Central/State Government, Universities or other autonomous Organisations who meet one of these conditions: Holding an analogous position on regular basis in Pay Level 12 Five years of regular service in Pay Level 11 Eight years of regular service in Pay Level 10 Desirable: Experience in dealing with General Administration, Establishment Personnel and HR related affairs or Procurements Experience in dealing with N-Procure and GeM Stores, computer-based Finance and Accounts, Audit or Academics Knowledge of UGC Rules and Regulations and DoPT Rules Who is not eligible: Anyone convicted by a Court of Law at any time during their career Persons dismissed by, or involved in disciplinary cases with, the Union Government, a State Government, a Local Authority or a Government Corporation owned or controlled by the Central or State Government Employees of a Government Organisation or PSU with a Vigilance, Disciplinary or Criminal case pending or contemplated against them Check the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

content_sections.text: Place of posting: GNLU Silvassa Campus, Dadra & Nagar Haveli-396230. The selected candidate may also be deputed to the Gandhinagar campus as and when required. Tenure: three years initially. This may be extended year to year on need and performance, with due approval of the Competent Authority, up to a maximum of five years. No extension follows after that. Performance: reviewed annually. Services shall be terminated in case of unsatisfactory performance. No claim to a permanent post: the appointment gives no right to renewal, extension or conversion into permanent appointment, and it ends on expiry of tenure. Joining: the selected candidate must join on the date the University specifies. The University may decline to appoint a candidate who cannot join by then. Verification: antecedents may be verified at any time during recruitment or service. If the information is found incorrect, the application or service shall be terminated without notice.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: You need one of the following qualifications for the Laboratory technician post: Graduate in Medical Laboratory Technology from a recognized University/Institute/Hospital OR Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT), from a course of at least 2 years, from a recognized University OR Diploma/Certificate in Medical Laboratory Technology (MLT), from a course of at least one year, from a recognized University 1 year of experience working in a medical laboratory, for those with a diploma in MLT (2-year course), from a recognized Central Government/ State Government hospital/Institute/Autonomous/Private Institute. 2 years' experience working in a medical laboratory, for those with a diploma in MLT (1-year course), from a recognized Central Government/ Delhi Government hospital/Institute/Autonomous/Private Institute. 1 year of experience in a medical laboratory, for a Graduate in Science, from a recognized Central Government/ Delhi Government hospital/ Institute/Autonomous/Private Institute. Candidates with work experience in a "Quality assured Laboratory" shall be preferred. Your qualification and experience must be in a relevant discipline or field and from a recognized institution or organisation. Your experience must come after you gained the essential qualification. The Principal Investigator may relax or alter the qualification, the experience and the other terms and conditions. The age limit for the Laboratory technician post is up to 35 years. The cut-off date for age, educational qualification and experience is the last date of application, 30 November 2026. The application form also asks for your age as on 30 November 2026. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Laboratory technician gets Rs 30000, consolidated and without any allowances. The person appointed will not get any other financial or non-financial benefits, facilities or special allowances beyond the fixed consolidated emoluments set by the funding agency. One exception: House Rent Allowance (HRA), if the funding agency's guidelines allow it, will be paid at the rate for Rajkot city (Class 'Y'). The post is purely on contract, for an externally funded research project. The person engaged will have no claim to any regular post in AIIMS Rajkot at any time. They also have no claim to continue in this project or any other project. The person appointed will not be treated as a regular employee of AIIMS Rajkot or the Government of India. The job is purely temporary, for 11 months. The Principal Investigator may extend or shorten it. The contract ends automatically when its term is over. It can end earlier if the funding agency withdraws its support. Either side can end the contract at any time with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu of notice. Leave follows the Leave Policy of AIIMS Rajkot for project staff, as amended from time to time. The institute will not provide a hostel or any other accommodation. Project staff will normally be posted at the study site. They may be posted to other study sites for a time, in the interest of the project. The selected candidate may have to work shifts or night duty when required. They may also have to make field visits and travel outstation for project needs. The roles and responsibilities will follow the funding agency's guidelines and whatever the Principal Investigator assigns from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: A screening committee will scrutinise the applications. The Laboratory technician will then be selected through a written exam/skill test followed by an interview. Selection is based purely on merit. Written test: the test is MCQ-based. Up to six (6) candidates per available post with the highest marks in the written test will be called for the interview. Final merit: the written exam counts for 80% and the interview for 20%. Date, time and venue: the written test/interview is on 10 December 2026. Reporting time is 9 AM at the Research Cell, Academic block, 3rd Floor, AIIMS Rajkot. What to bring: the original documents, when you report for the written exam/interview. NOC: if you work in a Government or Public Sector undertaking, or in any other research project at AIIMS Rajkot, bring a "No Objection Certificate" to the interview. This notification invites reputed partnership firms, proprietary concerns, and Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) of Chartered Accountants for empanelment to carry out special audits under section 268(5) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 (u/s 142(2A) of the erstwhile Income-tax Act, 1961).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applicants must meet the following minimum eligibility criteria as of 31/03/2026: Firm Constitution: The applicant should be a reputed partnership firm, a proprietary concern, or a Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) having its office in the area(s) falling within the territorial jurisdiction of the Principal Chief Commissioner of Income Tax, Gujarat. Primary Profession: Primarily engaged in the profession of accountancy and auditing. Staff Strength: A staff strength of at least 15, including a minimum of 3 Chartered Accountants who have been working continuously with the applicant for at least the last one year as on 31/03/2026. Professional Receipts: Filed returns of income regularly up to AY 2026-27 with Gross Professional Receipts exclusively from professional services like accountancy and auditing of not less than Rs. 50 lakhs in any two out of the last five preceding financial years (from 2021-22 to 2025-26). basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Bilaspur, District Bilaspur (HP) has invited applications for the re-engagement of retired Tehsildar, Naib Tehsildar, and Kanungos on a remuneration basis as a stop-gap arrangement for vacant posts and posts likely to become vacant this year in district Bilaspur. Eligible retired officials must submit their applications to reach the office of the Deputy Commissioner, Bilaspur (HP) on or before 20/11/2026 within working hours.

qualification.details: Eligibility Conditions: Must have rendered minimum 5 years services in any wing of revenue Department of HP before their superannuation and having no departmental / disciplinary proceedings pending against them. The retirees to be engaged should not be more than 65 years of age on the date 31.10.2026.

selection_process: The retired Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar/Kanungos will be considered for the respective post by the concerned appointing authority on the recommendation of the committee duly constituted by the department. If the applications exceed the number of vacancies advertised by concerned appointing authority
the candidates who are junior in age will be given preference for engagement against such post.
important_instructions: The retired Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar/Kanungos will be re-engaged for 03 months in the first instance. It may be extended further depending upon the performance of the candidate & the requirement. The period of engagement will not be counted for any benefits whatsoever in the service rendered by them before their superannuation. The service of such retired persons will be purely on temporary basis and is liable to be terminated by the respective appointing authority at any time during the period of such re-engagement. The persons to be engaged will be entitled for one day's Causal Leave after putting one month service. No leave of any kind will be admissible to him/her. Unauthorized absence from the duty without the approval of the controlling officer shall automatically lead to the termination of such engagement. They will not be entitled for emoluments for the period of absence from duty. They will be entitled to TA/DA if required to go on tour in connection with his/her official duties at the same rate as applicable to regular counterpart officials at the minimum of pay scale. He/she shall continue to avail medical facilities and re-imbursement of Medical Expense as admissible to him/her as retiree. The monthly remuneration shall be paid to the re-engaged retirees on the basis of performance/work conduct certificate, which shall also include the details of cases dealt/disposed of by him/her. This certificate shall be issued by the concerned Controlling Authority to the re-engaged retiree at the end of the month. After clearance of pendency of revenue cases, the services of retired persons shall be terminated by the appointing authority. The promotion of existing Tehsildar/Naib Tehsildar/Kanungos shall not be affected on account of re-engagement of above retirees & the posts occupied by them will be considered vacant for the purpose of promotion. Their re-engagement is liable to be terminated on availability of regular officials.

application_fee.details: The requisite fee of Rs. 1200/- must be deposited through online mode after successful submission of the online application form.

selection_process: Part Subject / Papers Questions Marks Duration

Paper I Essay/Precise writing, Constitution of India, Legal Maxims, Translation (Urdu to English/Hindi), Judgment Writing, Partnership, Contracts, Arbitration, TPA, Agrarian Reforms Act, Evacuees Property Act, Alienation of Land Act, Specific Relief Act, Motor Vehicles Act, Personal Laws, CPC, Interpretation of Statutes, Acquisition/Requisition of immovable property, Guardianship, Probate, Eviction from public premises. Attempt 9 questions (3 from each part) 80 Marks 2 Hours

Paper II CrPC/BNSS, IPC/BNS, Juvenile Justice Act, Judgment Writing (Criminal), Indian Evidence Act/BSA, Penal Laws relating to Arms, Enemies, Terrorist activities, J&K Civil Service Regulations, General Financial Rules, Medical Jurisprudence, Prevention of Corruption Act, NDPS Act. Attempt 9 questions (3 from each part) 80 Marks 2 Hours
Viva-voce Oral Interview - 40 Marks -
The competitive examination for appointment of District Judges by direct recruitment consists of a written examination and a viva-voce examination.

Written Examination: Comprises two papers of two hours duration each. Each paper carries 80 marks and comprises three parts carrying equal number of questions. Candidates must attempt nine questions in each paper
three from each part. Viva-voce Examination: Carries 40 marks.

Only candidates obtaining 50% or more marks in the written examination (45% or more for SC/ST and PwBD candidates) will be called for the viva-voce test in the ratio of three candidates for one available vacancy. Candidates must obtain 50% marks out of the 40 marks earmarked for viva-voce (45% for SC/ST and PwBD candidates). Final selection is made on the cumulative grade value obtained in the written examination and viva-voce.

basic_details.short_information: Only domiciles of the UT of Ladakh can apply for the 21 Banking Associate posts advertised by Jammu & Kashmir Bank Ltd. (J&K Bank) under advertisement PO-Jobs2026@JKBank. Candidates must be graduates in any discipline and aged 20 to 30 years as on 01-01-2026. Applications are accepted only online through the Bank's website jkb.bank.in under the "Careers" tab from 7 November 2026 to 26 November 2026, and the online examination will be conducted by IBPS.

age_limit.details: Minimum: 20 years, Maximum: 30 years as on 01-01-2026. A candidate must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996 and not later than 01.01.2006 (both dates inclusive). The maximum age limit applies to General and EWS category candidates.

qualification.details: Graduate in any discipline from a university recognized by Government of India, or any other equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government/UGC, as on the last date of registration. The candidate must possess a valid marks sheet/degree certificate showing that he/she is a graduate as on the last date of registration, and must indicate the percentage of marks obtained in Graduation while registering online. The percentage is to be calculated to the nearest two decimals. Where CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it must be converted into percentage, and a certificate from the appropriate authority on the University's conversion norms must be produced. Percentage is calculated on total marks in all subjects in all semesters/years divided by the aggregate maximum marks (including honours/optional/additional optional subjects), multiplied by 100. Fractions are ignored: 59.99% is treated as less than 60%. | Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post.

selection_process: Test Questions Marks Medium Duration
English Language 30 30 English 20 Minutes
Quantitative Aptitude 35 30 English 20 Minutes
Reasoning Ability 35 40 English 20 Minutes
Total 100 100 60 Minutes
Selection is through an online examination; marks obtained in the online examination only are considered for shortlisting/provisional selection
according to the reservation rules and subject to all other selection parameters. Documents in original with a photocopy are verified before provisional appointment letters are issued.
Each test is separately timed

and candidates must qualify in each of the three tests by securing cut-off marks decided by IBPS with J&K Bank. Negative marking: one fourth of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer; blank questions carry no penalty. Cut-offs are applied on individual test scores and on the total score. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category candidates
subject to overall merit. Scores are equated across sessions and reported up to two decimal points. Ties are broken by date of birth
with the older candidate placed ahead.
Candidates must choose six centres
at least four of them outside Ladakh-UT. Within Ladakh-UT: Leh and Kargil. Outside Ladakh-UT: Delhi NCR
Patiala
Mohali
Ludhiana
Amritsar
Pathankot
Jalandhar
Bengaluru
Phagwara and others if need arise. The Bank may allot a centre other than those opted
and no request for change of centre
venue
date or session will be entertained.
how_to_apply: Applications are accepted online only from 7 November 2026 to 26 November 2026; no other mode is accepted. Registration is complete only when the fee is successfully paid online.
Go to https://jkb.bank.in/, open the relevant notification under the "Careers" tab and click "APPLY ONLINE".
Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter name, contact details and email-id; note the Provisional Registration Number and Password sent by email and SMS.
Click "Validate your details" and "Save & Next"; the "SAVE AND NEXT" facility lets you complete the form in more than one sitting.
Upload the photograph, signature, left thumb impression and handwritten declaration, and capture a live photograph by webcam or mobile phone.
Fill the other details, preview the form and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION"; no change is possible after this.
Click the "Payment" tab, pay the fee and click "Submit".
Print the e-Receipt and the online application form containing fee details.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only domiciles of the UT of Ladakh are eligible to apply. Selected candidates will have to submit the domicile certificate of the UT of Ladakh issued by the competent authority. Graduate in any discipline from a university recognized by Government of India, or any other equivalent qualification recognized as such by the Central Government/UGC, as on the last date of registration. The candidate must possess a valid marks sheet/degree certificate showing that he/she is a graduate as on the last date of registration, and must indicate the percentage of marks obtained in Graduation while registering online. The percentage is to be calculated to the nearest two decimals. Where CGPA/OGPA is awarded, it must be converted into percentage, and a certificate from the appropriate authority on the University's conversion norms must be produced. Percentage is calculated on total marks in all subjects in all semesters/years divided by the aggregate maximum marks (including honours/optional/additional optional subjects), multiplied by 100. Fractions are ignored: 59.99% is treated as less than 60%. Candidates should check the official notification for the complete eligibility conditions of the post. Minimum: 20 years, Maximum: 30 years as on 01-01-2026. A candidate must have been born not earlier than 01.01.1996 and not later than 01.01.2006 (both dates inclusive). The maximum age limit applies to General and EWS category candidates. Reservation follows the Union territory of Ladakh Reservation Rules, 2005 and S.O. 77 dated June 27, 2025 of the Social & Tribal Welfare Department, Administration of UT of Ladakh. The notice gives reservation as percentages; it does not print category-wise numbers of the 21 posts. The maximum age for Ex-Servicemen is capped at 48 years after relaxation. SC/ST/SEBC relaxation is allowed cumulatively with the relaxation for persons with benchmark disabilities. Apprentices who completed Apprenticeship Training with J&K Bank and are domiciles of UT of Ladakh get 1 year of age relaxation in addition to their category relaxation, plus additional marks equal to 2.5% of the maximum marks in the online examination. Within the 4% for benchmark disabilities, 1% each is for (a) blindness or low vision, (b) deaf and hard of hearing, (c) locomotor disability including cerebral palsy, leprosy cured, dwarfism, acid attack victims and muscular dystrophy, and (d) autism, intellectual disability, specific learning disability and mental illness; clause (e) covers multiple disabilities. PwBD candidates whose certificate shows a temporary disability "likely to improve" are not eligible for reservation. Outstanding Sportspersons must upload a certificate in the format prescribed under the UT of Ladakh Outstanding Sportspersons Rules at registration. content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through an online examination; marks obtained in the online examination only are considered for shortlisting/provisional selection, according to the reservation rules and subject to all other selection parameters. Documents in original with a photocopy are verified before provisional appointment letters are issued. Each test is separately timed, and candidates must qualify in each of the three tests by securing cut-off marks decided by IBPS with J&K Bank. Negative marking: one fourth of the marks assigned to a question is deducted for each wrong answer; blank questions carry no penalty. Cut-offs are applied on individual test scores and on the total score. The minimum aggregate qualifying marks are 40% for General Category and 35% for reserved category candidates, subject to overall merit. Scores are equated across sessions and reported up to two decimal points. Ties are broken by date of birth, with the older candidate placed ahead. Candidates must choose six centres, at least four of them outside Ladakh-UT. Within Ladakh-UT: Leh and Kargil. Outside Ladakh-UT: Delhi NCR, Patiala, Mohali, Ludhiana, Amritsar, Pathankot, Jalandhar, Bengaluru, Phagwara and others if need arise. The Bank may allot a centre other than those opted, and no request for change of centre, venue, date or session will be entertained.

content_sections.text: Open the online portal https://apply.iitjammu.ac.in/#/home . Apply through the [contract/project staff/JRF/SRF] tab on that portal, as the notice words it. Upload the duly filled application form with the requested details, scanned copies of certificates and other supporting documents. Upload all documents for educational qualification (10, 12, graduation, post-graduation etc.) and experience. Give a valid e-mail ID and phone number in the application, because shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail. Submit the application so that it is received by 22.11.2026. For correspondence, the notice gives: Dr. Guru Brahamam Ramani, Department of Chemistry, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu, Jagti, NH-44 Nagrota Bypass, Jammu, 182211, India. Email: [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Merely possessing the prescribed qualification does not ensure that a candidate will be called for an interview. Candidates may be shortlisted based on merit and need for the project, and only shortlisted candidates will be called. Shortlisted candidates are informed about the interview by e-mail, including the date and the time. The interview will be held using the online/offline platform. Shortlisted candidates must present themselves on the interview date with an updated CV and original and attested photocopies of mark sheets/certificates supporting their academic qualifications.

content_sections.heading: About Jharkhand Forest Department
content_sections.text: The Office of the Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation, Jharkhand, Ranchi is a Government of Jharkhand office under the Department of Forest, Environment & Climate Change, located at Van Bhawan, Doranda, Ranchi. This post is for the Scientific Forestry Management Unit (SFMU) of the Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation, Jharkhand, Ranchi, a project with a period of 4 years. The notice is signed by P. Rajendra Naidu, IFS, Conservator of Forest, Plantation, Research & Evaluation, and the office e-mail printed on the letterhead is [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: There is one temporary position under the SFMU project. The notice calls it Senior Research Associate in its text and "Senior Research Fellow (Senior Project Associate)" in the post table; it is the same single post. First Class M.Sc in Forestry/ Botany/ Agriculture/ Statistics/ Remote Sensing and Geographical Information Systems (GIS)/ Wildlife Science/ Zoology/ Biotechnology. 1st division or 60% marks or equivalent overall grade point average. Those with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree must have UGC/ CSIR/ ICAL/ ICFRE NET qualification or equivalent/ Ph.d in any of the above disciplines. Experience and willingness to work in forest with the forest communities. A good understanding of their respective subjects and its application in forestry sector. Good knowledge in drafting research articles, formal letters, computer operation/ application. 4 year work experience in research and development in their respective fields. Proficiency in computer application, especially MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point), may be an added benefit to the candidate. The candidate should be medically fit to work in different forest areas of the State of Jharkhand. Candidates should check the official notification for the full discipline-wise eligibility for this post. Age, as on the date of interview, i.e. 21.11.2026, should not exceed 35 years. A further relaxation of 4 years in age will be given to SC/ST/OBC/women candidates as per approved rules. The post is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project, with no provision for regularisation. The initial appointment will be for one year or up to the project period (as the case may be). The project period is printed as 4 years. The contract may be terminated even before the completion of the project, and no appeal will be entertained.

Desirable qualification and experience: experience in seed collection, field data recording, computer operations, and MS Office (Word, Excel, Power Point). Essential educational qualification: B.Sc in Agriculture Or B.Sc in Forestry Or B.Sc in Botany. Desirable qualification and experience: work experience in laboratory analysis of samples & data, data recording, analysis and computer knowledge. Proficiency in computer application, especially MS Office (MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point), may be an added benefit to the candidate. how_to_apply: Applications go only by post, in hard copy, in the Commission's own format.

Get the application format from the JSERC website (www.jserc.org). The format is also printed with the notice and asks for post applied for (Deputation / Contract), personal details, service and pay details, pension details for retired officers, CTC for private sector candidates, qualifications, experience and a signed declaration.
Fill the application in the given format. An incomplete application, or one in a different format, is liable to be rejected.
Paste a recent passport-size photograph and enclose a CV, a latest passport-size photograph and attested copies of all certificates and testimonials (all required documents self-attested).

Deputation candidates send the application through proper channel with attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, NOC and Vigilance Clearance Certificate; an advance copy may be sent directly to avoid delay.

Send the application by registered/speed post only to: The Secretary, Jharkhand State Electricity Regulatory Commission, 1st Floor, Jharkhand State Housing Board (Old Headquarter), Harmu Housing Colony, Ranchi – 834002.
The application must reach by 20 December 2026, 17:00 hrs. Applications received later will be summarily rejected, and JSERC is not responsible for postal delay or loss.

content_sections.heading: About JSERC
content_sections.text: Jharkhand State Electricity Regulatory Commission is a statutory body functioning under the Electricity Act, 2003. Under Section 86 of the Act its work includes determination of electricity tariffs, regulating power purchase and procurement processes, granting of licences and adjudication of disputes. Its office is on the 1st Floor, Jharkhand State Housing Board (Old Headquarter), Harmu Housing Colony, Ranchi - 834002.

Degree in Economics, Master's Degree in Business Administration, Electrical Engineering from a recognized university. 10 years of experience in analogous post. Long experience in government owned Power Sector/Utility or PSU/Commission (Central or State), or an officer holding an analogous post on regular basis in Central/State Government, any PSU under Central/State Government, or a Central or State Electricity Regulatory Commission. The candidate should have held a position of Director (Tariff) in a Central/State Electricity Regulatory Commission, or should have experience in the tariff determination process of Generating/Transmission/Distribution/Load Dispatch centre or any other utilities in the electricity sector in India. Degree in Economics, Master's Degree in Business Administration, Electrical Engineering from a recognized university. 10 years of experience in analogous post. Post-retirement experience in the power sector will also be considered. Bachelor Degree in Electrical Engineering/Economics or MBA from a recognized University. Experience in Regulatory Affairs, Tariff Determination process/Commercial function in a Power Utility or a Consultancy organization working in the power sector in India. The notice lists the same additional qualifications/experience for all routes: Professional experience in developing tariff modules in the interest of electricity consumers and expertise in commercial analysis. Professional experience in the power sector, including electricity generation, transmission and distribution in large public utilities, along with experience in developing electricity tariffs. Experience in handling administrative and establishment-related matters in Central/State Government organizations. Experience in managing litigation and related matters. Specialization in Regulatory Law. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: ₹ Pay Band ₹15600-39100, Grade Pay ₹7600/- (Pay Matrix Level as per 7th Pay Commission – Rs.78,800/-). Pay, allowances and other terms of deputation are regulated by the JSERC (Officers and Staff Recruitment Rules and Service Conditions) Regulation 2012. Tenure: initially one (01) year, which may be extendable as per the requirement of the Commission. The selected candidate may be sent back to his/her parent department before the deputation period ends, and shall have no lien or claim on the Commission's regular establishment. Retired Director (Tariff) and other retired officers: monthly contract pay is a lump sum calculated as Last Pay Drawn minus Full Pension, plus other allowances as approved by the Commission. Private sector: Initial Basic Pay of ₹78,800/- plus other allowances as approved by the Commission. Tenure: initially one (01) year, which may be further extended at the discretion of the Commission and on the candidate's annual performance. If not extended, the contract ends automatically on expiry, with no separate order. There will be an annual performance assessment during the contract period. TA/DA as applicable to regular officers in the equivalent cadre in the Commission, as per rules adopted from time to time. Leave: all holidays notified by the State Government and 13 days casual leave annually, subject to prior approval. Either party may end the contract early with one month's notice or one month's salary in lieu; the Commission reserves the right to waive the notice period or notice pay or both. The selected candidate will execute a contract agreement with the Commission. The Commission reserves the right to terminate it before the tenure ends, and the appointment confers no right or claim to a regular appointment in the Commission.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for JSERC Director
content_sections.text: Applications go only by post, in hard copy, in the Commission's own format. Get the application format from the JSERC website ( www.jserc.org ). The format is also printed with the notice and asks for post applied for (Deputation / Contract), personal details, service and pay details, pension details for retired officers, CTC for private sector candidates, qualifications, experience and a signed declaration. Fill the application in the given format. An incomplete application, or one in a different format, is liable to be rejected. Paste a recent passport-size photograph and enclose a CV, a latest passport-size photograph and attested copies of all certificates and testimonials (all required documents self-attested). Deputation candidates send the application through proper channel with attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, NOC and Vigilance Clearance Certificate; an advance copy may be sent directly to avoid delay. Send the application by registered/speed post only to: The Secretary, Jharkhand State Electricity Regulatory Commission, 1st Floor, Jharkhand State Housing Board (Old Headquarter), Harmu Housing Colony, Ranchi – 834002. The application must reach by 20 December 2026, 17:00 hrs . Applications received later will be summarily rejected, and JSERC is not responsible for postal delay or loss. Curriculum Vitae (CV) Latest passport-size photograph Attested copies of all certificates and testimonials For deputation: attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last 5 years, NOC and Vigilance Clearance Certificate SC/ST/OBC certificate, for those claiming such benefits

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be done by the Commission through an interview, and its decision is final and binding. Candidates may be provisionally admitted to the interview on the basis of the information in the application; an interview letter does not mean the candidature is finally cleared. Eligibility will be verified with original documents at the time of the interview or earlier, if called for. Deputation candidates must produce the No Objection Certificate from their organisation prior to or at the time of the interview; without it they will not be permitted to appear. Those working in Public Sector/Government Sector/Autonomous bodies may apply through proper channel, or submit the NOC at the interview, or submit a proper relieving order from their present employer at joining.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: A candidate found not to meet the eligibility criteria (age, education, professional qualification, post-qualification experience) at any stage will be cancelled and not allowed to appear for the interview; candidature may be cancelled even after the interview. Any canvassing, directly or indirectly, will disqualify the candidature. No person convicted by a court of law for an offence involving moral turpitude is eligible for appointment. The Commission reserves its right of discretion to relax any one of the provisions to ensure the suitability of the candidate. The Commission can be contacted on phone 0651-3167653 and email [email protected] .

basic_details.short_information: National Health Mission, Jharkhand (NHM Jharkhand), under the Jharkhand Rural Health Mission Society, Department of Health & Family Welfare, Govt. of Jharkhand, wants to empanel or engage Legal Retainer(s) / Advocate(s) on a case-to-case basis. Advocates enrolled with a Bar Council can apply on the Annexure-A form. Send the form by Registered/Speed Post to the Mission Director, National Health Mission, Jharkhand, in Namkum, Ranchi. The last date for submission is 20 November 2026 at 11:59 PM, and applications received after that may be rejected.

qualification.details: The EOI is for Advocates / Legal Professionals who will provide legal services and represent NHM Jharkhand in these places: | You must be enrolled with the Bar Council of India / concerned State Bar Council and hold a valid Certificate of Practice, wherever applicable. You must have qualified the All India Bar Examination (AIBE), wherever applicable. You should ordinarily have at least 10 years' professional experience in handling litigation and legal matters. This may preferably include matters relating to Government Departments, Government Institutions, PSUs, Health Institutions, service matters, constitutional matters, civil matters, criminal matters and allied areas. You should have adequate professional standing, infrastructure and capacity to attend to matters assigned by NHM Jharkhand within the prescribed timelines. You should have no conflict of interest with NHM Jharkhand, and you must furnish the prescribed declaration-cum-undertaking. You must send documentary evidence of eligibility and experience with the application. | Preference may be given to Advocates with demonstrable experience in healthcare / medical negligence / public health/service / constitutional / government litigation. Preference may also be given to Advocates who have represented Government Departments, Government Organizations, Institutions or PSUs before the Hon'ble High Court and other judicial / quasi-judicial forums. | The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. For the eligibility rules of the post in full, see the official notification. | No fixed monthly salary or consolidated monthly remuneration will be paid under this engagement. Professional fees are paid case by case, only for matters NHM Jharkhand specifically assigns. The fees follow the fee structure / approved rates in Letter no.-03/विधि–शुल्क–33/2020–1613/जे0, रांची, दिनांक-24 जुलाई, 2026, from the Legal Department, Jharkhand. A copy of that letter is attached to the notice. Payment depends on submitting the prescribed bill and supporting documents, and on satisfactory certification of the services, as applicable. Court fee, filing fee, certified-copy charges and other pre-approved out-of-pocket expenses are reimbursed at actual cost. You need valid supporting documents and the approval of the Competent Authority. No other fee, expense or reimbursement is allowed unless the Competent Authority specifically approves it. Taxes and statutory deductions, including TDS, are handled under the applicable rules. | The detailed fee schedule, if applicable, will form part of the engagement order / approved terms. NHM Jharkhand may revise it from time to time. | The engagement is purely professional, need-based and on a case-to-case basis. NHM Jharkhand assigns cases from time to time, depending on the nature, urgency and requirements of each matter. Empanelment gives no right to a minimum number of cases, a particular case, a fixed monthly remuneration, a regular appointment or any other employment-related benefit. The engagement does not create an employer-employee relationship. NHM Jharkhand remains free to engage any other Advocate, Senior Advocate, Government Counsel or Legal Officer for any matter. The empanelment normally stays valid for one (1) year from the date of the engagement/empanelment order, unless NHM Jharkhand ends it earlier. Any continuation or extension depends on satisfactory performance and the approval of the Competent Authority.

selection_process: Selection has four steps: scrutiny
shortlisting
a possible personal interaction / interview
and approval by the Competent Authority.

Scrutiny: A Screening / Evaluation Committee set up by NHM Jharkhand checks the applications received within the prescribed period. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates may be shortlisted on qualification
professional experience
the nature and volume of relevant litigation handled
experience with Government / Health Institutions
professional standing and other relevant parameters. Personal interaction / interview: Shortlisted candidates may be called for a personal interaction / interview
in person or online
at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Final empanelment: Final empanelment / engagement needs the approval of the Competent Authority.
NHM Jharkhand may accept or reject any or all applications
wholly or partly
without giving a reason. It may also increase
decrease or cancel the requirement at any stage. Applying
being shortlisted or being empanelled gives no right to engagement
work or any minimum remuneration.
important_instructions: You must disclose any actual, potential or perceived conflict of interest before accepting any matter. You must not take a brief against NHM Jharkhand where that would create a conflict of interest or break professional rules. All records, pleadings, opinions and communications of NHM Jharkhand must be kept strictly confidential. They may be disclosed only with prior written permission, or where the law or a competent judicial / statutory authority requires it. NHM Jharkhand may end the engagement at any time, for example for unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, conflict of interest, breach of confidentiality or negligence. The Competent Authority may also end it without giving a reason. If you want to leave the engagement, you should ordinarily give one month's written notice. You must hand over records and case status as directed. False, misleading or materially incorrect information may lead to rejection of the application or termination of the engagement. NHM Jharkhand may modify, amend, withdraw or cancel the EOI or any part of it at any stage. Disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the competent courts at Ranchi, Jharkhand.

content_sections.text: National Health Mission, Jharkhand was set up under the Societies Registration Act, 1860. It plans, implements and monitors health programmes and related administrative work across the State of Jharkhand. In that work it has to deal with legal matters before Courts, Tribunals, statutory authorities and other legal forums. This EOI is meant to get it timely legal help, representation and professional advice.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Fill in the application on the prescribed form at Annexure-A, which is printed in the notice. Put it in a sealed envelope with the documents the form lists. The notice gives these steps: The application must be in the prescribed format only. Applications received after the last date and time, or not sent in the prescribed manner, may be rejected. NHM Jharkhand is not responsible for postal delay, loss or non-receipt of an application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The EOI is for Advocates / Legal Professionals who will provide legal services and represent NHM Jharkhand in these places: You must be enrolled with the Bar Council of India / concerned State Bar Council and hold a valid Certificate of Practice, wherever applicable. You must have qualified the All India Bar Examination (AIBE), wherever applicable. You should ordinarily have at least 10 years' professional experience in handling litigation and legal matters. This may preferably include matters relating to Government Departments, Government Institutions, PSUs, Health Institutions, service matters, constitutional matters, civil matters, criminal matters and allied areas. You should have adequate professional standing, infrastructure and capacity to attend to matters assigned by NHM Jharkhand within the prescribed timelines. You should have no conflict of interest with NHM Jharkhand, and you must furnish the prescribed declaration-cum-undertaking. You must send documentary evidence of eligibility and experience with the application. Preference may be given to Advocates with demonstrable experience in healthcare / medical negligence / public health/service / constitutional / government litigation. Preference may also be given to Advocates who have represented Government Departments, Government Organizations, Institutions or PSUs before the Hon'ble High Court and other judicial / quasi-judicial forums. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. For the eligibility rules of the post in full, see the official notification. No fixed monthly salary or consolidated monthly remuneration will be paid under this engagement. Professional fees are paid case by case, only for matters NHM Jharkhand specifically assigns. The fees follow the fee structure / approved rates in Letter no.-03/विधि–शुल्क–33/2020–1613/जे0, रांची, दिनांक-24 जुलाई, 2026, from the Legal Department, Jharkhand. A copy of that letter is attached to the notice. Payment depends on submitting the prescribed bill and supporting documents, and on satisfactory certification of the services, as applicable. Court fee, filing fee, certified-copy charges and other pre-approved out-of-pocket expenses are reimbursed at actual cost. You need valid supporting documents and the approval of the Competent Authority. No other fee, expense or reimbursement is allowed unless the Competent Authority specifically approves it. Taxes and statutory deductions, including TDS, are handled under the applicable rules. The detailed fee schedule, if applicable, will form part of the engagement order / approved terms. NHM Jharkhand may revise it from time to time. The engagement is purely professional, need-based and on a case-to-case basis. NHM Jharkhand assigns cases from time to time, depending on the nature, urgency and requirements of each matter. content_sections.heading: NHM Jharkhand Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: When assigned, the Legal Retainer / Empanelled Advocate will: Appear and represent NHM Jharkhand before the concerned Court, Tribunal, authority or legal forum. Draft, settle, vet and file petitions, writ petitions, appeals, revisions, reviews, applications, affidavits, counter affidavits, replies, rejoinders, written submissions and other legal pleadings. Give legal opinions / advice on civil, criminal, service, contractual, administrative, constitutional and other matters. Do legal research, including on applicable laws, rules, notifications, judgments, precedents and relevant case law. Prepare case briefs, hearing notes, factual summaries and written submissions for officers / senior law officers. Coordinate with and brief Senior Advocates, Government Advocates or other Counsel, wherever required. Monitor cases, report hearing dates and give timely updates on material developments. Obtain and provide certified / authenticated copies of orders and judgments, wherever required. Advise on the legal implications of proposed actions, notices, contracts, agreements, claims and other matters. Take on any other legal work the Competent Authority may reasonably assign. Reporting duties: keep NHM Jharkhand informed of important developments, hearing dates, orders and directions. Submit a periodic statement of assigned cases in the prescribed format. Report any adverse order, urgent development or limitation issue to the concerned officer without delay. Failing to attend a matter, meet timelines or give timely updates may count against you when continuation is reviewed.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Completed and signed Application Form (Annexure-A) Valid Bar Council enrolment/registration certificate and Certificate of Practice, wherever applicable Proof of qualification and relevant professional experience Details/list of significant cases handled, with copies of judgments/orders wherever required Details of previous empanelment with Government Departments / Government Institutions / PSUs / other organizations, if any Proof of professional address and contact details Declaration-cum-Undertaking (Annexure-B) Any other document NHM Jharkhand specifically asks for

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection has four steps: scrutiny, shortlisting, a possible personal interaction / interview, and approval by the Competent Authority. Scrutiny: A Screening / Evaluation Committee set up by NHM Jharkhand checks the applications received within the prescribed period. Shortlisting: Eligible candidates may be shortlisted on qualification, professional experience, the nature and volume of relevant litigation handled, experience with Government / Health Institutions, professional standing and other relevant parameters. Personal interaction / interview: Shortlisted candidates may be called for a personal interaction / interview, in person or online, at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Final empanelment: Final empanelment / engagement needs the approval of the Competent Authority. NHM Jharkhand may accept or reject any or all applications, wholly or partly, without giving a reason. It may also increase, decrease or cancel the requirement at any stage. Applying, being shortlisted or being empanelled gives no right to engagement, work or any minimum remuneration.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: You must disclose any actual, potential or perceived conflict of interest before accepting any matter. You must not take a brief against NHM Jharkhand where that would create a conflict of interest or break professional rules. All records, pleadings, opinions and communications of NHM Jharkhand must be kept strictly confidential. They may be disclosed only with prior written permission, or where the law or a competent judicial / statutory authority requires it. NHM Jharkhand may end the engagement at any time, for example for unsatisfactory performance, misconduct, conflict of interest, breach of confidentiality or negligence. The Competent Authority may also end it without giving a reason. If you want to leave the engagement, you should ordinarily give one month's written notice. You must hand over records and case status as directed. False, misleading or materially incorrect information may lead to rejection of the application or termination of the engagement. NHM Jharkhand may modify, amend, withdraw or cancel the EOI or any part of it at any stage. Disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the competent courts at Ranchi, Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: About IIMB
content_sections.text: The notice describes the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) as a leading management school in Asia. Under the IIM Act of 2017, IIMB is an Institute of National Importance. Its sector is listed as Higher Education. This post sits in the Executive Education (EEP) open programmes team.

content_sections.heading: Role and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Open Enrolment programmes are either Short-duration Programmes (SDPs) of 3-6 days or Long-duration Programmes (LDPs) that run over 6 months to 1 year. This is an individual contributor Sales role in a B2C and B2B context. The job is to generate leads (aspirants), engage with them and turn them into paid participants for each cohort. The duties are: Handle all inbound and outbound leads and close each sale when the finalised candidate pays. Follow up with direct aspirants and sponsoring organisations by phone, email and in person. Provide data analytics and feedback on what is and is not working, to fine-tune Digital Marketing campaigns. Understand how social media campaigns are run and what goes into social media posts. Work with the DM team to design marketing collaterals, such as videos, graphic artwork and text for webpages, brochures and testimonials, across different media platforms. At the top end of the role, own the end-to-end Sales and Marketing of the assigned programmes and devise a go-to-market strategy for them. content_sections.heading: IIITB Physics Laboratory In-charge Job Description
content_sections.text: The primary responsibility of the Laboratory In-charge is to support the effective and efficient teaching and learning of Physics at the Institute. The selected candidate will perform the following duties across key functional areas: Prepares laboratory materials in the Two Semesters: Consult and plan with laboratory instructor(s); set up equipment for students and instructors; perform technical duties related to physics laboratory activities including giving technical assistance and conducting laboratory sessions; assist with preparation and/or lab cleanup for physics lecture demonstrations as appropriate. Upkeep of the Physics Laboratory: Assist instructor(s) regarding laboratory procedures, location and use of materials, and operation of equipment; recommend and/or perform general cleaning; recommend and/or perform maintenance or repairs of equipment; distribute laboratory equipment and materials; ensure laboratories are locked, and lights and equipment are switched off at the end of the day. Safe Environment: Keep current with safety regulations; carry out safety checks on equipment before and after use; explain safety procedures to individuals using the laboratories; dispose of and disassemble redundant or unsafe equipment in consultation with instructor(s). Stock and Purchasing: Operate and maintain stock control of equipment, undertake annual stock-take, and ensure the stock book is kept up to date; source and cost stock, ordering as necessary; monitor expenditure, keep accurate purchasing records, and assist with the departmental budget process. Design and Development: Construct and/or modify apparatus as required; improve on existing experiments or design new experiments and equipment as needed; suggest new experiments. General Duties: Attend and participate in meetings as required; help with conducting quizzes and tests associated with the physics curriculum.

Support management in financial decision-making through in-depth financial analysis and reports. Liaise with banks, financial institutions, and government agencies for financial transactions.

basic_details.job_title: Kerala High Court Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 48 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Law graduates and final year/semester law students can apply to the High Court of Kerala for 48 (Anticipatory) temporary Research Assistant vacancies on contract basis under Recruitment No. 23/2026. The tenure is 1 year and the honorarium is ₹35,000/- per month. Applications are accepted only online through hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in from 2 November 2026 to 30 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates shall apply online through the recruitment portal of the High Court. No other means or modes of application will be accepted.
Complete 'One Time Registration' using the 'One Time Registration Login' link at https://hckrecruitment.keralacourts.in. The steps are given in the 'How to apply' link on the website.
Keep ready the scanned images of photograph and signature, details of qualification, etc.
Enter the required details in 'My Profile'.
Apply for the post from 'Apply Now' in 'Dashboard' and proceed as per the instructions on the screen.
If you are a differently abled candidate who needs a scribe, indicate this in the online application form.
Check the preview of the application before submission. Once submitted, no changes, editing or modification can be made.

Candidates who wish to apply from abroad have to send an email detailing their location with public IP address to [email protected]. They will then be allowed access to the recruitment portal, and they also have to inform the High Court by email after completing the online application process.

The fee can be paid with the system generated Fee Payment Challan, or online through Debit Card, Credit Card or Net Banking by following the instructions on the screen. Bank transaction charges, if applicable, will have to be borne by the candidate.
Online fee payment closes on 30 November 2026, along with the online application. Offline fee payment runs from 4 December 2026 to 11 December 2026.

To claim the fee relaxation, the Caste/Community Certificate or Disability Certificate, as the case may be, must be valid on the last date of closure of filing of the online application or on the date of certificate verification. Failure to produce these documents will result in invalidation of the application.
important_instructions: An application once filed will not be allowed to be withdrawn. Applications that do not comply with this notification, the guidelines and the instructions on the recruitment portal shall be rejected. Documents in original to prove age, qualifications, etc. should be produced as and when called for, failing which candidature will be cancelled. Anything not specifically claimed in the application against the appropriate field will not be considered at a later stage. If a candidate is found not to fulfil the eligibility norms, or to have given incorrect or false information or suppressed material facts, the candidature will stand cancelled. If this is detected even after appointment, the service is liable to be terminated. A candidate who attempts to appear or appeared with an edited or modified admission ticket will be disqualified from the selection process and may be debarred permanently or for such period as decided by the High Court. Candidates who misbehave or commit any malpractice during the written test or interview are liable to be disqualified or debarred by the High Court and/or from applying for any post in the High Court, permanently or for any period it decides. The High Court reserves its right to modify or cancel the notification at any stage of the selection process. Its decisions on eligibility, conduct of tests and selection are final and binding, and no representation or correspondence will be entertained. For removal of doubts, candidates may call 0484-2562235 on all working days between 10.00 AM and 04.30 PM. The High Court's email is [email protected] and its fax number is 0484-2391720.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be on the basis of the written test and/or Scientific/Computer based Test and Viva Voce examination. Certificate verification takes place prior to the viva voce examination, with eligibility checked against original documents at that stage. Candidates should log in to their profile on the recruitment portal to download the Admission Ticket or Call Letter. Admission Tickets will be ready for download three weeks prior to the test, and Call Letters two weeks prior to the interview. Candidates will be intimated through SMS/e-mail. A candidate unable to download the document should contact the High Court at 0484-2562235. If no communication reaches the High Court at least one week before the test or interview, the candidate alone is responsible for non-receipt. The notice asks candidates to visit the recruitment portal at least once a week to know the schedule of the test or interview. Admission to the test or interview is purely provisional, based on the information in the online application and subject to verification of all eligibility conditions. Issue of an Admission Ticket or Call Letter does not mean that the candidature has been finally cleared or that the application entries have been accepted as true and correct. Differently abled candidates whose writing speed is affected can avail the services of a scribe, under the guidelines prescribed by the High Court. Such candidates must produce a medical certificate and declaration at the time of the test, in the prescribed format available in the recruitment portal. The scribe's qualification shall be at least one step below the minimum qualification prescribed for the post. Differently abled candidates, whether availing a scribe or not, will be allowed compensatory time of 20 minutes and/or part thereof for every hour of the examination. This requires a Medical Certificate stating that the candidate has a physical limitation to write. The format of the medical certificate is given in the 'Downloads' section of the recruitment portal.

basic_details.job_title: Cochin Port Authority Master Tugs Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Cochin Port Authority (CoPA), Willingdon Island, Kerala, is filling 2 posts of Master Tugs (Class – I). Both posts are unreserved (UR) and are filled on a regular basis by direct recruitment. The pay scale is Rs. 50000-160000, and candidates need a Certificate of Competency as Master (NCV) or Mate of a foreign going ship. Applications are accepted only through the online application portal. Online registration and fee payment run from 27 October 2026 to 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Candidates must apply through the online application portal linked on the Cochin Port careers page (www.cochinport.gov.in/careers). The notice says this is the only valid method and that no other application mode will be accepted. Documents relating to Age, Qualification, COC, CDC and so on must be submitted with the online application.
Open the online application portal from the Cochin Port careers page and complete the basic registration. Note the "Application reference No." you receive.

Go to State Bank Collect (onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect), click "Govt. Departments" and select "Cochin Port Trust" from the dropdown. You can also use the direct payment link in the "Payment details" window of the application portal.
In the payment category, select the post you are applying for. Enter your Application reference No., any remarks and the mandatory details.
Tick the box agreeing to the Terms and Conditions and enter the Captcha.
Pay the application processing fee of Rs.400/- by Net banking, card payment or another mode offered. You must also bear any extra payment gateway or bank charges.
Download the payment receipt and upload it in the "Payment details" window of the application portal.
Fill in all the necessary details, upload the documents relating to Age, Qualification, COC, CDC and so on, and make the final submission.

No changes or modifications are allowed after submission. Each candidate may submit only one complete application, and submitting more than one will lead to rejection of all of them. Candidates who apply on the last date may not get troubleshooting help or technical support by email or phone after 1600 hrs on 27 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill in the online application from 23 November 2026 to 22 December 2026 on www.mponline.gov.in or www.mppsc.mp.gov.in, either at an authorised MPOnline kiosk or from home or an internet cafe.

Keep scanned files of a recent passport-size colour photograph (light or white background, no cap, hat or dark glasses, no selfie) and your signature ready for upload; kiosks scan them free of charge.
Submit the form, check the details in the popup window (Cancel to correct, OK to submit), then click "proceed for payment"; the form stays "Unpaid" until the fee is paid.

Pay the fee by credit card, debit card or internet banking, or in cash at the kiosk (take the receipt). Check that the printout shows the amount and "Payment Done", and keep the application number for all correspondence.
Download the Attestation Form, Personal Details Sheet and Attendance Sheet from the "Download Formate" link on www.mppsc.mp.gov.in, fill them in and make three, six and one photocopies respectively.

Sign the online application at the marked place and attach self-attested copies of all documents and one copy each of the three forms. Keep the remaining copies for the interview, where they must be shown with the original documents.

Put the set in a large envelope marked "Advertisement No. 14/2026 dated 04.11.2026, Law Officer, Application for the post of Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission", with your name and address as sender, and send it by registered post or speed post to: Secretary, Madhya Pradesh Public Service Commission, Residency Area, Indore (Madhya Pradesh) PIN - 452001. An envelope without the advertisement number and post or department name will not be considered.

The application must reach the Commission office by 28 December 2026 at 6:00 PM. It may also be handed in at the office on working days between 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM, against a receipt. Keep one set of everything you send.

No bank draft or cheque is accepted. The fee is refunded online to the candidate's account only if the advertisement is cancelled, and refund claims for excess or wrong payment are not accepted. Apart from the application fee and portal fee, no other amount is payable; if a kiosk operator asks for more, complaints can be made to the MPOnline helpline 0755-6720200.
From 29 December 2026 to 04 January 2027, documents are accepted with a late fee of Rs. 3000/-.

For registered applicants who have not submitted documents even by 04 January 2027, the Commission will issue a notice of cancellation of candidature on its website; documents will then be accepted for 10 office days from that notice with a late fee of Rs. 25000/-.

Candidates submitting with a late fee must first give an undertaking that they hold all qualifications and experience as per the advertisement. The late fee is not refunded if the candidature is later cancelled.
Applications received late without the late fee are rejected, and the online fee is not refunded.

Government servants: No Objection Certificate from the department, or a copy of the NOC application made on or before 22 December 2026, plus an undertaking (1 original) if serving in Madhya Pradesh; non-government employees: a certificate of being in service.
Ex-servicemen: proof of ex-serviceman status issued on or before 22 December 2026 and a copy of the service details sheet.

Where a court case is involved, 3 photocopies of the related documents mentioned in the Attestation Form.
important_instructions: Corrections can be made online only, during 25 November to 24 December 2026, at Rs. 50/- per correction per session; the candidate's name cannot be corrected, and errors cannot be corrected at the interview stage. Results are declared on the category, gender and government-servant status filled in the form. A candidate who applies without meeting the essential qualifications may be debarred from the Commission's examinations. False information or more than one application leads to cancellation of candidature, debarment and possible legal action. Offline caste certificates without the issuing officer's signature, designation seal, caste name, case number and round seal will not be accepted on interview day. Name, date of birth, category and gender in the online form must match the original certificates, or the candidature will be cancelled. Calling a candidate for a written test or interview does not mean that eligibility has been accepted. The signature on the application must be used on the interview attendance sheet and all correspondence; a mismatch may cancel the candidature. Notices and results are published only on www.mppsc.mp.gov.in, and the Commission may send updates by e-mail and SMS to the contact details given in the form. content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection for the MPPSC Law Officer post will be made on the basis of an interview. After scrutiny of documents, 12 candidates, in order of the marks obtained in the qualifying examination, and candidates with marks equal to the cut-off, will be called for interview, subject to eligible candidates being available. The interview carries 100 marks, and the minimum qualifying mark is 41. Final selection will be in order of merit of marks obtained in the interview. If more than 500 candidates apply, a written examination will be held. Candidates equal to three times the advertised posts in each category or sub-category, and those with equal marks, will then be called for interview. Final selection will be on the combined written and interview marks, and in that case there are no minimum qualifying marks for the interview. content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Pune is a premier institute dedicated to research and teaching in the basic sciences. According to the notice, it was established in 2006 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development (renamed Ministry of Education in August 2020). In 2012 it was declared an Institute of National Importance by an Act of Parliament.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The Institute invites applications from Indian nationals. The prescribed educational qualification should have been obtained from recognized Universities / Institutions. Age: not more than 35 years on the last date of application. Age relaxation commensurate with educational qualification/s and / or experience/s may be considered for candidates having qualification and experience higher than the advertised, with the prior approval of the competent authority. The date for determining the upper age limit, educational qualifications or experience is the last date for submitting applications. The experience requirement may be relaxed based on the cohort of applications received, with the prior approval of the competent authority. The prescribed qualifications are the bare minimum, and possessing them does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. Applicants should therefore mention all their educational qualifications and experience in the relevant field when applying.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate receives consolidated emoluments of Rs. 80,000/- per month. The appointment is initially for one year and is extendable for a further period, subject to satisfactory performance of the incumbent and continuation of the project. The appointment is purely temporary and ends automatically, without notice or compensation, on termination of the project. It will be governed by the terms and conditions of the funding agency applicable to this project.

content_sections.heading: IISER Pune Research Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: The incumbent is expected to contribute towards thin film growth and characterization of oxide specimens for spintronic applications. Working knowledge of magnetic/electronic transport measurements would be an added advantage.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: If many applications are received, it may not be convenient or possible to interview everyone. Based on the recommendations of the Screening Committee, the Project Investigator may restrict the number of candidates called for interview to a reasonable limit. This is done after considering the minimum qualifications and any experience over and above the minimum prescribed. If a selected candidate does not join or resigns after joining, waitlisted candidates may be offered the position. The notice does not mention an interview date.

It aims at socio-legal and economic rehabilitation of persons at risk of being criminalized, exploited for commercial sex, and those in destitute states. Familiarity with the use of MS Office, Excel, emails, and the internet. Ability to work effectively in teams as well as independently. The post is unreserved, but candidates belonging to the reserved category can apply. The Institute reserves the right to relax qualification and working conditions based on work experience, and to relax age for persons already holding comparable positions in a University/Research Institution of repute. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The gross emoluments payable per month depend on the tonnage slab. The notice gives them as follows (Rs per month). The fixed incentive includes transport and mobile expenses. After one year as a full tonnage pilot, a Pilot on fixed term employment is eligible for a yearly increment of 6% of the (B+FI) amount. Working on a day off or public holiday is paid at (B+FI)/30*1.5, and leave encashment is at (B+FI)/30 per day. Remuneration is for one calendar month, and one day's remuneration is pro-rata on a 30-day month. The pilotage incentive shown is for 20 working days or pro-rata. It is paid only for working days and casual leave, and not for earned leave or leave encashment. Extra movements are paid by length overall (LOA) of the vessel, in Rs. Other terms in the notice: The initial contract is for 3 years. It may be extended for 3 years each, with at least a minimum one-day break at mutual consent. The Pilot is employed as a Trainee Pilot on FTE basis until he obtains the Pilotage licence from MoPSW. Training is six months or more, including 2 months at MbPA and the ELPT course conducted by IMU. Rs 20,000 per year or pro-rata is paid for purchase of PPE, which excludes the life jacket. Lodging and boarding at the JNPA Guest House is free during working hours, with the cost of meals restricted to Rs 2,250 per month. Any expense above that is deducted from the monthly remuneration. Leave: 30 days earned leave and 20 days casual leave, or pro-rata, per calendar year. Earned leave is credited at 2.5 days per month. Earned leave may be carried forward or encashed within the 3-year contract period, while casual leave is neither encashed nor carried forward. Health insurance up to Rs 60,000 is reimbursed for self, spouse, parents and two children (up to age 25 years) for the first contract appointment after completion of one year. On renewal it is reimbursed on submitting the receipt. The Pilot is covered by JNPA's Group Personal Accident Insurance policy. Transport within the port area and up to the JNPA port township is provided, and accommodation in the port township is allotted if available, on a chargeable basis.

content_sections.heading: JNPA Pilot Job Description
content_sections.text: Duties and responsibility are as defined in the operational manual of Marine. Carry out a minimum of two movements per 12-hour day shift and one movement in the night shift, on a cycle of 2 days, 2 nights, shift off and weekly off over six days. Day shift is 0800 to 2000 hrs and night shift 2000 hrs to 0800 hrs next day. Carry out all duties assigned during the twelve-hour shift on a rotational basis, including early arrival or late departure as the movements require. Keep the Pilotage licence and the Master (F.G.) certificate valid throughout the contract period and while piloting. Complete all movements allotted during duty hours as directed by the Dock Masters / Harbour Master / Deputy Conservator. Inform the Deputy Conservator / Harbour Master when out of station (Mumbai Metropolitan Region area). Wear the uniform as per the Harbour Master Office Circular while on pilotage duty.

basic_details.job_title: MERC Chairperson Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 33 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission (MERC) has 33 Chairperson posts to fill in Consumer Grievance Redressal Forums (CGRF) across the State of Maharashtra, one post for each location. The posts are for retired senior judicial officers, retired civil servants, retired engineering principals or professors, and retired senior electrical engineers of the Government. Applications go by post to The Secretary, MERC, Mumbai, and must reach by 25 November 2026, 5:00 pm.

qualification.details: There are 33 Chairperson posts, one for each CGRF location in the table below. Twenty-seven of them are with the distribution licensee MSEDCL. | The posts marked ** fall vacant on the dates given under Important Dates below. | The notice says the Chairperson of the Forum shall be one of the following: | a retired senior judicial officer; or a retired civil servant not below the rank of an Additional Collector or equivalent; or a retired Principal of a reputed Engineering college; or a retired Professor of the Electrical Engineering Department of a reputed institute; or a retired senior electrical engineer of the Government. | The Chairperson should preferably have a working knowledge of the vernacular language of the State of Maharashtra. These qualifications are the minimum, and having them does not by itself entitle a candidate to selection. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification. | Under Regulation 4.5 of the MERC (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum & Electricity Ombudsman) Regulation 2020, the Chairperson of the Forum holds office for a fixed term of three (3) years. The Commission may extend the term for up to two (2) more years, subject to an overall age limit of sixty-five (65) years. | The monthly remuneration for each location is shown in the table above: Rs. 50,000/- per month for Kalyan-1 Circle, Thane Urban Circle, Gigaplex Estate Private Limited and Adani Electricity Mumbai Ltd., and Rs. 40,000/- per month for the other locations. The remuneration already includes all allowances, such as sitting fees, honorarium, conveyance allowance and telephone charges. Statutory taxes will be deducted at source. A Chairperson who also holds the additional charge of Chairperson or Independent Member of another CGRF gets 25% additional remuneration. TA/DA is then paid at the rate that applies to a Chief Engineer or equivalent.

selection_process: If necessary

the selection may be based on an interview conducted by the Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission. The Commission will check the integrity and background of the applicants. It may appoint a candidate to one of the locations the candidate chose
or to any other vacant position
based on the discussion during the interview or appointment process.
important_instructions: Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate. If false or incorrect information from a candidate is found at any stage of the recruitment, the candidature will not be considered. A candidate who knowingly or wilfully gives false particulars, or hides material information, will be disqualified. If already appointed, the candidate is liable for dismissal without notice and without being given any reason. MERC's decision on all matters relating to the recruitment is final, and no individual correspondence will be entertained.
