content_sections.heading: About MERC
content_sections.text: The Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission is based at the World Trade Centre, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai. It is filling these posts under Section 42(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003. The appointments follow the Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum & Ombudsman) Regulations, 2020 and the MERC (Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum & Electricity Ombudsman) (First Amendment) Regulations, 2024. These Regulations govern the appointment, the terms of service and the functioning of the posts.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send your personal profile or application form "as per format", with attested copies of the certificates that support your qualification, experience, age and so on, to this address: The Secretary, Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission, 13th Floor, Centre-1, World Trade Centre, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai 400 005. content_sections.heading: About MACS-ARI
content_sections.text: MACS-Agharkar Research Institute (ARI), Pune is an autonomous institute of the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India. It describes itself as committed to promoting science and technology, with emphasis on high standards of research and development. Its research covers the biological sciences in six thematic areas: Biodiversity & Palaeobiology, Bioenergy, Bioprospecting, Developmental Biology, Genetics & Plant Breeding, and Nanobioscience.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 2 Scientist-C posts on a direct recruitment basis. The place of work for the first post is the Genetics & Plant Breeding Group of ARI, Pune. For the second post, it is the Developmental Biology Group of ARI, Pune.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: ARI invites applications from eligible Indian citizens and from scientists and employees of Central or State Governments, universities, recognised research institutions, public sector undertakings and other government-funded organisations. Essential: First Class M.Sc in Agriculture with specialisation in Genetics and Plant Breeding or allied disciplines from a recognised university or Institute, or equivalent qualifications. Four years of research and development experience in the required areas, as evidenced by publications in journals of repute, after obtaining an academic degree. Desirable: Doctoral degree in Genetics & Plant Breeding/ Plant Breeding/ Crop Improvement or allied disciplines from a recognised University or Institute. Proven experience in crop breeding and genomics-assisted research. Hands-on experience with field experimentation, phenotyping and data analysis. A demonstrated record of high-impact scientific publications and of taking part in acquiring and carrying out research projects. Ability to work collaboratively in interdisciplinary research programs. Experience in a research laboratory after obtaining an M.Sc in the relevant field. Essential: First Class M.Sc in Life Sciences, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or related fields, or equivalent qualifications. Four years of research and development experience in the required areas, evidenced by publications in reputed journals, after obtaining an academic degree. Desirable: Ph.D in areas of life science including Molecular biology, cell biology, and developmental biology or related areas. At least 3-5 years of post-doctoral experience in cell and developmental biology, with experience in cell culture and model organism research, and a good publication record in reputed journals. Experience of working in a research laboratory after obtaining an M.Sc. Time spent acquiring the essential qualifications does not count towards experience. However, time spent on a Doctorate degree from a recognised University or Institution (up to a maximum of two years) counts as experience. So does time spent on Post Doctorate research in a University or research institute, up to a maximum of two years, when it is shown by a certificate from that University or Institute and by research published in journals of repute. All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from a recognised Board or University. For both posts, the upper age limit for direct recruitment shall not exceed 40 years. The crucial date for deciding the age limit and eligibility is the closing date for submission of applications. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: ARI Pune Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Undertake a breeding programme in wheat, soybean and grape for high yield, improved quality and tolerance to biotic and abiotic stresses. Implement genomic-assisted breeding approaches, including GWAS, QTL mapping, SNP-based analyses and genomic selection (GS). Develop, manage and evaluate bi-parental, multi-parent (MAGIC/NAAM) and RIL breeding populations. Conduct biofortification research and trait discovery for nutritional and quality-related traits. Plan, conduct and analyse multi-location and multi-season field trials. Carry out germplasm characterisation, evaluation and core collection development. Apply marker-assisted selection (MAS) and integrate molecular tools into breeding pipelines. Perform plant phenotyping using morphological, physiological and biochemical methods. Conduct quality analyses, including oil, protein, minerals, fatty acid compositions and volatile profiling. Contribute to seed production programmes and varietal release pipelines as per institutional and national guidelines. Publish research outcomes in peer-reviewed journals with a high impact factor. Prepare and submit research project proposals and secure extramural funding from national and international agencies. Assist in mentoring research scholars and contribute to departmental and institutional academic and other activities. Initiate and develop independent projects in new and emerging frontiers of cell and developmental biology, organelle biology and diseases. Secure extramural funding. Enthuse, motivate and supervise research scholars. Take part in teaching and training programs, and in teaching and training students. Contribute towards the development and maintenance of Institutional infrastructure. Facilitate and carry out various academic outreach activities. Advance research in cell and developmental biology and start new transnational areas of research. Contribute to Institutional work as entrusted from time to time.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Having the essential qualifications does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview. A committee decides whether a qualification is equivalent to the essential and desirable qualifications. If many applications are received, the Institute may limit the number of candidates called for interview through shortlisting. The shortlisting criteria may include desirable qualifications and/or experience beyond the minimum. Only shortlisted candidates will be informed by email of the date, time and venue of the next stage of selection. basic_details.short_information: Graduates with a shorthand speed of 80 words per minute and a typewriting speed of 40 words per minute can apply for 33 posts of Junior Stenographer (Group-'C') in the Establishment of the High Court of Orissa, Cuttack, under Advertisement No. 06/2026, in the scale of pay of ₹25,500 – 81,100/- (Level 7). Applications are accepted only online on www.orissahighcourt.nic.in from 10:00 A.M. on 13 November 2026 till 11:59 P.M. on 7 December 2026.

important_dates.examination centre and dates: To be conveyed through the Court's website and e-Admit Card

application_fee.details: The fee is non-refundable and non-adjustable and is paid online by Debit Card, Credit Card, UPI or Net Banking.

age_limit.details: A candidate must be above 21 years of age and not exceeding 42 years of age as on 12.11.2026, that is, born not earlier than 12.11.1984 and not later than 11.11.2005.

qualification.details: A candidate must possess a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University. He/She should have a minimum speed of 80 words per minute in shorthand and 40 words per minute in typewriting along with adequate knowledge in Computer Application. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

selection_process: PartMarks
An Essay in English20
Translation of Passage from Odia to English20
Re-translation of passage from English to Odia20
Knowledge in English Grammar40
PartMarksDuration
Theory5030 minutes
Skill Test5030 minutes
The recruitment examination has three stages in this order: Qualifying Test in English Subject
Computer Application Test (Qualifying in nature) and Skill Test. Candidates must also attend document verification.
A general category candidate scoring less than 35% and an SC or ST candidate scoring less than 30% is disqualified from the Computer Application Test.
It covers MS Office (Word
Excel and Power Point)
MS Access and Internet Operation / File Uploading and downloading. A candidate scoring less than 50% is disqualified and is not called to the Skill Test.
Dictation of an English passage of 400 words at 80 words per minute (5 minutes)

transcribed on computer at 40 words per minute (10 minutes). 0.25 marks are awarded for each correct word. The maximum permissible limit of mistakes and/or omissions is 10% of total words; beyond that the candidate is disqualified. A mistake means wrong spelling
substitution or overlapping of words
and wrong punctuation marks.
The merit list is prepared on the basis of marks in the Skill Test
first for all candidates and then separately for general and reserved categories
in descending order of total marks.
how_to_apply: Read this advertisement and the "INSTRUCTIONS TO CANDIDATES" available on the Court's website.
Visit www.orissahighcourt.nic.in and go to Recruitment Corner, then Examination Portal, then "Recruitment to the posts of Junior Stenographer (Advertisement No. 06 of 2026)".

Fill in the online application between 10:00 A.M. of 13.11.2026 and 11:59 P.M. of 07.12.2026, using the name as in the High School Certificate (or the changed name, with the gazette notification uploaded).
Upload scanned copies of the original documents listed below.
Pay the fee of Rs.500/- online, unless exempted.
Take a printout of the submitted online application form for future use.

Applications through any other mode, and incomplete or incorrect applications, will be summarily rejected. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the latest one with the higher Acknowledgement Number will be considered.
High School Certificate / 10th Board Examination or equivalent certificate as proof of age.
Certificate of Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University or equivalent qualification.
Certificate showing adequate knowledge in Computer Application.
Certificate from a recognized institute showing 80 wpm in shorthand and 40 wpm in typewriting.

Good character certificate from the Institution last attended, or two certificates from two persons of repute (one a Gazetted Officer), issued within 3 months of the date of online application; the notice includes a Character Certificate format.
Recent passport size photograph and full signature (clearly visible, proper orientation; signature on white background).
Aadhaar card.
Caste certificate from the competent authority for SC, ST or SEBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates claiming reservation.
Discharge Certificate from the Commanding Officer of the Unit last served and an Affidavit of not being appointed against any civil post after Military Service (Ex-Servicemen).
Medical or Disability Certificate from the competent Medical Board or Authority showing 40% to 50% disability (PwBD).
For a changed name: copy of publication in a local leading daily newspaper and copy of the Odisha Gazette notification.
important_instructions: Requests for change of examination centre will not be entertained. No Admission Letter will be sent by post; updates on the date and time of each stage appear on www.orissahighcourt.nic.in. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The High Court of Orissa has advertised 33 Junior Stenographer (Group-'C') posts, of which 11 are reserved for women. The category-wise position is: Within the total, 2 posts are for PwBDs and 2 posts are for Ex-Servicemen, shown in the notice against all categories together. These posts are filled as per the relevant Acts, Rules, Orders or instructions of the State Government. If women's vacancies in a category remain unfilled for want of eligible or suitable women candidates of that category, they will be filled by eligible or suitable male candidates of the same category. Exchange of reservation between Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe will not be considered. The number of vacancies is subject to change at the discretion of the Court.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must possess a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University. He/She should have a minimum speed of 80 words per minute in shorthand and 40 words per minute in typewriting along with adequate knowledge in Computer Application. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. A candidate must be above 21 years of age and not exceeding 42 years of age as on 12.11.2026, that is, born not earlier than 12.11.1984 and not later than 11.11.2005. A candidate who comes under more than one category gets only one age relaxation, the one most beneficial to him/her. The notice states that, save as provided above, the age limit can in no case be relaxed. The name and date of birth in the High School Certificate / 10th Board Examination or equivalent certificate alone will be accepted. Must be a citizen of India, have the requisite qualification(s) and be of good character. Must be of sound health and mind, good physique, free from any contagious or communicable disease, and not with bodily infirmity of more than 50%. Must not have more than one spouse living, if married. Must not have any past criminal antecedent and/or record, and must not have been convicted by any Criminal Court for an offence involving moral turpitude. Must not have been debarred by any Government, Court, Public Service Commission or any other Commission from appearing in any Recruitment Test. Government servants may apply if qualified and within the age limit; they must inform their Heads of Offices in writing and produce a "No Objection Certificate" as and when directed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Orissa High Court Junior Stenographer (Group-'C')
content_sections.text: Applications through any other mode, and incomplete or incorrect applications, will be summarily rejected. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the latest one with the higher Acknowledgement Number will be considered. High School Certificate / 10th Board Examination or equivalent certificate as proof of age. Certificate of Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University or equivalent qualification. Certificate showing adequate knowledge in Computer Application. Certificate from a recognized institute showing 80 wpm in shorthand and 40 wpm in typewriting. Good character certificate from the Institution last attended, or two certificates from two persons of repute (one a Gazetted Officer), issued within 3 months of the date of online application; the notice includes a Character Certificate format. Recent passport size photograph and full signature (clearly visible, proper orientation; signature on white background). Aadhaar card. Caste certificate from the competent authority for SC, ST or SEBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates claiming reservation. Discharge Certificate from the Commanding Officer of the Unit last served and an Affidavit of not being appointed against any civil post after Military Service (Ex-Servicemen). Medical or Disability Certificate from the competent Medical Board or Authority showing 40% to 50% disability (PwBD). For a changed name: copy of publication in a local leading daily newspaper and copy of the Odisha Gazette notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The recruitment examination has three stages in this order: Qualifying Test in English Subject, Computer Application Test (Qualifying in nature) and Skill Test. Candidates must also attend document verification. A general category candidate scoring less than 35% and an SC or ST candidate scoring less than 30% is disqualified from the Computer Application Test. It covers MS Office (Word, Excel and Power Point), MS Access and Internet Operation / File Uploading and downloading. A candidate scoring less than 50% is disqualified and is not called to the Skill Test. Dictation of an English passage of 400 words at 80 words per minute (5 minutes), transcribed on computer at 40 words per minute (10 minutes). 0.25 marks are awarded for each correct word. The maximum permissible limit of mistakes and/or omissions is 10% of total words; beyond that the candidate is disqualified. A mistake means wrong spelling, substitution or overlapping of words, and wrong punctuation marks. The merit list is prepared on the basis of marks in the Skill Test, first for all candidates and then separately for general and reserved categories, in descending order of total marks.

basic_details.job_title: Orissa High Court District Judge Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 38 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The High Court of Orissa, Cuttack is filling 38 posts in the cadre of District Judge by direct recruitment under Advertisement No. 03 of 2026, in the pay scale of ₹ 1,44,840 – ₹ 1,94,660 with usual D.A. and other allowances. Law graduates who are advocates with not less than seven years of continuous practice, or who have the combined advocate and judicial officer experience the notice allows, and who are not below 35 and not above 45 years of age as on the date of application, can apply online at www.orissahighcourt.nic.in from 10:00 A.M. of 9 November 2026 till 11:59 P.M. of 25 November 2026

important_dates.examination dates: To be published on the Court's website

age_limit.details: The candidate must not be below 35 years of age and not above 45 years of age as on the date of application.

qualification.details: The candidate must be a graduate in Law from a recognized University or an Institution recognized by the Government.

how_to_apply: Go through this advertisement and the "Instructions to Candidates for Filling up of Online Application Form" on the Court's website.
Log in to www.orissahighcourt.nic.in and open Recruitment Corner → Examination Portal → Direct Recruitment to the Posts in the Cadre of District Judge, 2026.
Fill the online form, choosing the correct category; enter the name exactly as in the High School Certificate, or the changed name if it has been changed.
Upload clear and legible scanned copies of the documents listed below.
Pay the fee online, unless exempted.
Submit between 10:00 A.M. of 9 November 2026 and 11:59 P.M. of 25 November 2026. Applications sent in any other mode will be rejected.
The fee is non-refundable and non-adjustable and is paid online by Net Banking, Debit card, Credit card or UPI.
Aadhaar card.
Matriculation/High School Certificate Examination or equivalent certificate for name and date of birth.
Certificate from the competent authority showing passing of Odia of Middle School Standard.
Bachelor's Degree in Law.
Certificate of legal practice (Annexure-I) showing years of practice at the Bar, wherever applicable.
Certificate of Judicial Service (Annexure-II) showing years served as a Judicial Officer, wherever applicable; applicants with both Bar practice and judicial service submit both annexures.
Public Prosecutors: appointment letter containing the date of joining, or the appointment letter with the notification containing the date of joining.
Recent passport size colour photograph and full signature (signature on white background), both clearly visible with proper orientation.
Category certificate from the Competent Authority for S.C./S.T./S.E.B.C. (Non-Creamy Layer); disability or medical certificate from the Competent Medical Board or Authority for PwBD.
Gazette notification for change of name/surname and No Objection Certificate/Standing Order of NOC or undertaking for government servants, wherever applicable.

The certificate of legal practice must be certified by the Principal Judicial Officer of a Court, or by an advocate of that Court with at least 10 years' standing endorsed by the Principal Judicial Officer of the district or station.

Advocates practising before the High Courts or Supreme Court need a certificate from an advocate with 10 years' standing, endorsed by the Registrar (Judicial) of this Court or the equivalent officer of the other High Court or Supreme Court.
Judicial officers obtain their experience certificate from the Registrar (Administration) of the High Court of Orissa, or the equivalent officer of other High Courts.
The S.E.B.C. (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate must not be more than 3 years old by the last date of online application; an O.B.C. certificate will not be accepted in place of it.
Women of S.C./S.T./S.E.B.C. (Non-Creamy Layer) must submit caste certificates by birth ("Daughter of"); a certificate by virtue of marriage ("Wife of") is not acceptable.
A name change after the High School examination needs a copy of the newspaper publication and the Odisha Gazette notification; unsupported name discrepancies lead to rejection.
important_instructions: Incomplete or incorrect online applications will be summarily rejected. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the latest one with the higher Acknowledgement Number is considered. Admission to every stage is provisional; candidature is liable to rejection if eligibility is not met. No Admission Letter is sent by post; the dates and the e-Admit Card are published on www.orissahighcourt.nic.in, and the list of eligible applicants on the Court's website/notice board. Missing any stage of the examination or document verification leads to rejection. No T.A./D.A. is paid for appearing in the Examination, and canvassing in any form is a disqualification. Impersonation, fabricated or tampered documents or false statements may lead to debarment, permanently or for a period, besides criminal prosecution. For help with the online application, contact the Recruitment Cell on 9437498780 or [email protected], on working days between 10:30 A.M. and 04:30 P.M., during the application period.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Out of the 38 posts, 03 posts will be filled by horizontal reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities having physical disability as specified in the Schedule to the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 (49 of 2016), excluding cerebral palsy. If eligible women candidates of a category are not available or are insufficient, the remaining vacancies will be filled by eligible male candidates of that category. If candidates of the S.C., S.T. and S.E.B.C. (Non-Creamy Layer) categories are not available or are insufficient, the vacancy will be filled by eligible candidates of the unreserved category. The number of vacancies is subject to change at the discretion of the Court, and the Court reserves the right to cancel the entire recruitment process or any part of it at any stage.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a graduate in Law from a recognized University or an Institution recognized by the Government. The candidate must meet one of these four conditions: be an advocate in continuous practice for not less than seven years as on the date of application; or be an advocate who has previously served in the judicial service and possesses a combined experience of not less than seven years as judicial officer and as an advocate, as on the date of application; or be a Judicial Officer who has completed seven years of continuous practice as an advocate before joining the judicial service; or be a Judicial Officer who possesses a combined experience of not less than seven years as an advocate and as a judicial officer, as on the date of application. Years of practice are counted from the date of provisional enrolment or registration with the concerned State Bar Council. Public Prosecutors may apply if they have the required qualification, experience and age; they must inform their Heads of Offices in writing and obtain a No Objection Certificate from their controlling authority. The candidate must be able to speak, read and write Odia fluently and must have passed an examination in Odia Language equivalent to Middle English School standard. The candidate must not be below 35 years of age and not above 45 years of age as on the date of application. A candidate who comes under more than one category gets only one age relaxation, the one most beneficial to him or her. A person who is not a citizen of India. A person dismissed from service by any High Court, Government or Statutory or Local Authority. A person convicted of an offence involving moral turpitude, or permanently debarred or disqualified by any High Court, the Union Public Service Commission or any State Public Service Commission from its examinations or selections. A person who directly or indirectly influences the recruiting authority for his or her candidature. A married candidate with more than one spouse living, unless the Government exempts the person on the grounds stated in the notice. A person who cannot speak, read and write Odia, or has not passed a test in Odia equivalent to Middle School Standard. Candidates should check the full eligibility conditions in the official notification before applying.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has two parts: a Written Examination and an Interview, held under the O.S.J.S. and O.J.S. Rules, 2007. Paper-1 group (3), 40 marks, covers the Transfer of Property Act, the Specific Relief Act, the Limitation Act, the Law of Contract, the Odisha Consolidation of Holding and Prevention of Fragmentation of Land Act, the Odisha Estate Abolition Act, the Odisha Land Reforms Act, the Law relating to Motor Accident and Claims, the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 and the Commercial Courts Act, 2015. Paper-2 group (4), 10 marks, covers the Narcotics Drugs and Psychotropic Substance Act, the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, the Prevention of Corruption Act, the Essential Commodities Act, the Environment Protection Act, the Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974, the SC and ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005, the POCSO Act, 2012 and the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015. Paper-3 (General English) has translation from Odia to English, ten lines (10 marks); re-translation from English to Odia, ten lines (10); a short essay of about 150 words (30); précis writing of 300 words (30); and one passage of maximum 500 words with 5 questions (20). Candidates must secure a minimum of 45% in Paper-3. The interview carries 30 marks. Candidates are called in the proportion of 1:10, provided they get at least 45% in each of the written papers and 50% in aggregate. Candidates with benchmark disabilities are called in the proportion of 1:10 with at least 40% in each paper and 45% in aggregate. Document verification is held before the interview; candidates must bring original certificates, Aadhaar Card, photograph (same as uploaded), a self-attested copy of the online application and self-attested copies of the uploaded certificates, failing which they will be debarred from the interview. The final merit list is prepared on the marks of Paper-1, Paper-2 and the Interview. A candidate is not included unless he or she secures at least 40% in the interview.

content_sections.heading: About Orissa High Court Civil Judge (Senior Division)
content_sections.text: The High Court of Orissa at Cuttack conducts this recruitment through its Registrar, Examination. The Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2026 fills vacancies in the cadre of Civil Judge (Senior Division) on the basis of merit from among officers already serving as Civil Judge (Junior Division). The recruitment is conducted under the O.S.J.S. and O.J.S. Rules, 2007 and the amendments made to them.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: This is an in-service examination. The notice invites applications only from eligible Judicial Officers in the cadre of Civil Judge (Junior Division). Open-market candidates are not invited. Qualifying service: an officer must have completed three years of qualifying service as Civil Judge (Junior Division) as on 01.04.2026. How service is counted: the date of entry into judicial service as Civil Judge (Junior Division) will be taken into consideration for calculating the three years. Intimation: officers must apply under intimation to their concerned Controlling Authorities. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, as eligibility rests on service in the Civil Judge (Junior Division) cadre. The notice prints no age limit. Candidates should check the official notification and the O.S.J.S. and O.J.S. Rules, 2007 for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The scale of pay for Civil Judge (Senior Division) is ₹1,11,000 – ₹1,63,030 with usual D.A. and other allowances as admissible from time to time. Every candidate promoted to the posts in the cadre of Civil Judge (Senior Division) through this examination shall be on probation as per Rule 33 of the O.S.J.S. & O.J.S. Rules, 2007.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Orissa High Court Civil Judge (Senior Division)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only online, from 10:00 A.M. of 09.11.2026 till 11:59 P.M. of 25.11.2026. Recent passport size colour photograph. The photograph must be clearly visible with proper orientation. Full signature with proper orientation. The signature must be clearly visible with proper orientation and on a white background. Incomplete or incorrect applications, and forms submitted through modes other than the prescribed online format, will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected without assigning any reason. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the latest application, the one with the higher Acknowledgement Number, will be considered. For guidance on the online application, applicants may contact the Recruitment Cell of the Court on Mobile Number 9437498780 or e-mail [email protected] . Help is available on working days between 10:30 A.M. and 04:30 P.M., from the opening date to the closing date of the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has three parts: a written examination of two papers, a viva-voce, and an evaluation of CCRs / PARs / ACRs. A merit list is then drawn up. The written examination has two papers. Each paper carries 100 marks and lasts 2 (Two) hours. The 40-mark part of Paper-1 also covers: The Odisha Consolidation of Holding and Prevention of Fragmentation of Land Act The Odisha Estate Abolition Act and The Odisha Land Reforms Act The Arbitration and Conciliation Act and The Commercial Courts Act The Odisha Survey and Settlement Act and The Odisha Prevention of Land Encroachment Act The Odisha Hindu Religious Endowments Act The 25-mark special Acts part of Paper-2 covers: The Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and The Essential Commodities Act The Environment Protection Act and The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 The Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act Candidates who secure a minimum of 50 per cent of marks in aggregate in both written papers, and not less than 45 per cent of marks in each individual written paper, shall be called for the viva-voce test. The candidate's CCRs / PARs / ACRs for the three years immediately preceding the year of examination shall be evaluated. This evaluation carries 15 marks. The final selection shall be made on the basis of the total marks obtained in the written test, the viva-voce test and the evaluation of CCRs/PARs/ACRs. A candidate shall not be selected unless he or she secures 40% of marks in the viva-voce test.

content_sections.heading: NITJ TBI Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Job Description
content_sections.text: The CEO will be responsible primarily for achieving the objectives and goals of the NITJ Technology Business Incubator in a sustainable and growth-oriented manner. The CEO will be the prime interface for entrepreneurs and will manage the operations, planning, marketing and development of NITJ TBI. The notice says the position requires a team player with proven leadership qualities, excellent marketing and organisation skills, and a professional attitude. The CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, growth and management of NITJ TBI. The duties include, but are not limited to: Developing and implementing strategic plans for incubation and entrepreneurship development. Creating incubation plans and implementing them, assisting in writing business plans, keeping track of the incubation process, and helping incubatees prepare proposals for funding. Marketing the Incubator and actively promoting it through various channels. Identifying, attracting, mentoring and supporting startups and innovators. Building partnerships with industry, government agencies, investors, incubators, accelerators and other ecosystem stakeholders. Facilitating access to funding through venture capitalists, angel investors, government schemes and CSR initiatives. Managing incubation programs, startup support services, events, workshops and outreach activities. Strengthening the mentor and expert network of the incubator. Ensuring compliance with guidelines of the Government of India and other funding agencies. Managing financial resources, statutory requirements and administrative functions of the Incubator. Promoting innovation, intellectual property creation and technology commercialization. Coordinating with faculty, students, researchers, alumni and industry partners to foster entrepreneurship. Preparing proposals, reports, utilization certificates and other documents required by funding agencies and stakeholders. Undertaking any other responsibilities assigned by the Board of Directors/Governing Body of NITJ TBI.

how_to_apply: Go to the website www.niab.res.in; online applications are available from 26 October 2026.
Register with a username, password and valid email id. Already registered candidates may log in with their existing username and password.

Keep soft copies ready in PDF/JPEG format: recent passport size photograph, all educational certificates, all experience certificates, caste/category certificates, NOC from employer, and any other certificates or testimonials.
Pay the application fee by Demand Draft or through the payment link given above.

Upload self-attested copies of certificates, mark sheets and testimonials in support of age, educational qualifications, experience and caste (if applicable), along with the curriculum vitae and the fee payment receipt or DD copy (PDF format only), in the relevant part of the application format on or before the last date. The notice says a hard copy is not required.

If paying by Demand Draft, write the Advertisement Number, candidate's name, category and post applied for on the back of the draft. The notice asks for it to be sent in an envelope super-scribed "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ________________" by post to the Director, National Institute of Animal Biotechnology, Sy.No. 37, Opp. Journalist Colony, Extended Q City Road, Gowlidoddi, Gachibowli, Hyderabad, Telangana, India 500 032.
Submit the application and keep the printout of the PDF for reference and record.
For technical queries while filling the application, the notice gives the email [email protected].
important_instructions: Government, Semi-Government, Autonomous Body and PSU employees should route their applications through proper channel. They may upload a No Objection Certificate, Vigilance Certificate and Integrity certificate at the time of online application and produce the original hard copy at interview, along with a certificate that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated. OBC candidates must belong to the Central List of OBCs and the Non Creamy Layer. The Non Creamy Layer certificate must be obtained on or after 01.04.2026. EWS candidates are those outside SC/ST/OBC (NCL) reservation whose family gross annual income is below ₹ 8.00 Lakh. The Income and Asset Certificate must be obtained on or after 01.04.2026 in the format of Annexure – III; certificates obtained before 01.04.2026 are not valid. SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD candidates must produce the latest certificate in the prescribed Government of India format at document verification for posts reserved for their category. A request to change category from General to a reserved one, or from one reserved category to another, will not be entertained. Canvassing in any form or bringing influence automatically disqualifies the candidate. Applications without signature, received after the due date and time, incomplete, or without fee payment will be summarily rejected. No interim enquiries about the recruitment will be entertained. The courts at Hyderabad, Telangana have jurisdiction over legal disputes.

content_sections.heading: About BRIC-NIAB
content_sections.text: The National Institute of Animal Biotechnology (NIAB) is an autonomous research institute at Gachibowli, Hyderabad. According to the notice, it aims to harness novel and emerging biotechnologies for improving animal health and productivity. Its research focus is on animal genetics and genomics, transgenic technology, reproductive technology, diseases, nutritional enrichment and bioinformatics.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice offers 5 positions in total. The Scientist-D post is for Unreserved (UR) candidates. The four Scientist-C posts are divided as shown below.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on the closing date for receipt of applications. Age relaxation is as per Government of India guidelines and is granted only where the posts are reserved for the respective categories. For Persons with Benchmark Disabilities, age relaxation applies whether or not the post is reserved for them, provided the post is identified as suitable for the relevant category of disability. Essential: Ph.D. in any discipline of Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Chemistry/Computational Biology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Molecular Biology/Agricultural Sciences/Plant Sciences/related disciplines; or Ph.D. in Engineering or Technology in disciplines like Chemical/Biomedical/Pharmaceutical engineering or Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) in any branch of medicine/MDS/MVSc, from a recognised University or Institute or relevant areas of research. Experience: minimum three years of post-qualification experience in responsible higher position in research/teaching Institute/University/industry with published research of highest standards and/or technologies of established utility. Deputation/absorption: Scientists of the Central Govt/State Govt/Universities/Public Sector Undertakings or Government funded research organisations/institutes, subject to (a) possessing the qualification for direct recruits, and (b) either holding an analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre, or having 5 years regular service in Level-11 in the relevant field. Essential: Ph.D. in any discipline of Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Biochemistry/Chemistry/Computational Biology/Pharmaceutical Sciences/Molecular Biology/Agricultural Sciences/Plant Sciences/related disciplines; or Ph.D. in Engineering or Technology in disciplines like Chemical/Biomedical/Pharmaceutical engineering or Doctor of Medicine (M.D.) in any branch of medicine/MDS/MVSc, from a recognised University or Institute or relevant areas of research. The notice states that experience for the position is reckoned from the date of acquiring the qualification prescribed for the position. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, refer to the official notification. The notice says applicants can apply in any one of the following research areas. Molecular Virology and Virus-Host Interactions: expertise in livestock and poultry viral pathogens, mechanisms of infection and host adaptation, and systems biology and multiomics approaches to viral disease research. Bacterial Pathogenesis and Antimicrobial Resistance: expertise in livestock and poultry bacterial pathogens, mechanisms of virulence, antimicrobial resistance, and functional genomics approaches to bacterial disease control. Precision Animal Nutrition and Nutritional Physiology: expertise in nutrient metabolism, feed utilisation, diet-microbiome interactions, and nutritional interventions to improve livestock and poultry health and productivity. Immunology and Vaccine Science: expertise in protective immune responses, antigen discovery, vaccine design

content_sections.text: Scientist-D is placed in Pay Level 12 and Scientist-C in Pay Level 11 as per the 7th CPC; the notice does not print rupee amounts. The posts carry the usual allowances admissible to Central Government employees of the same pay and status posted at Hyderabad, Telangana. Appointment is initially on probation for two years, which may be extended at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Further continuation depends on the candidate's performance during the probation period.

The Institute reserves the right to call only the requisite number of candidates after shortlisting, to convert desirable qualification into essential qualification, and to enhance the shortlisting criteria beyond the advertised qualification and experience. content_sections.heading: About the High Court of Tripura
content_sections.text: The High Court of Tripura is the High Court at Agartala. The posts are filled under the "Scheme for Law Clerks-cum-Legal Research Assistant of the High Court of Tripura" (as amended till date). Each Law Clerk works under the direct control of the Hon'ble Judge with whom he/she is attached.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A candidate must be a citizen of India as defined in Articles 5 and 6 of the Constitution of India. The educational requirement is a degree in Law from a recognized University established by Law in India. A fresh law graduate can also apply for the post with the provisional certificate. Experience is not made a condition in the notice, but the application form has a column for experience, if any. Please check the official notification for the full eligibility terms.

rows.essential_qualification: Degree in Law from a recognized University established by Law in India; fresh law graduate can apply with the provisional certificate

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The engagement is on a fixed honorarium of Rs.40,000/- per month on contractual basis for a term of one year. It is a full-time engagement. The notice does not mention HRA or any other allowance.

content_sections.heading: Tripura High Court Law Clerks-cum-Legal Research Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: To assist the Hon'ble Judge in discharging judicial functions, the Law Clerk-cum-Legal Research Assistant performs the following duties under the direct control of the Hon'ble Judge to whom he/she is attached: To read the case files and prepare the case, that is, case summary, notes and chronology of events of such comprehensive nature that they give the Hon'ble Judge a complete view of the matter, including the legal questions involved and the latest case-law having bearing on the subject matter. To search and research legal points and principles under the control and guidance of the Hon'ble Judge. To search out case law, articles, papers and other relevant material required in discharging judicial function. To take down notes of arguments and to prepare notes of cases. To identify facts, issues and questions that may arise in the course of arguments, or as may be relevant for judgment. To maintain record of judgments by the Hon'ble Judge along with the point of law decided in that particular case, in such a manner as to be very conveniently retrievable, as and when needed by the Judge, for any purpose whatever. To perform whatever is directed by the Hon'ble Judges as regards research or formulation. Maintenance of record of administrative correspondence, administrative files and, if specifically entrusted, of particular judicial file(s). Duty hours: the Law Clerk will be required to attend the residential office of the concerned Hon'ble Judge, in addition to normal duty during office hours, as per the direction of the Hon'ble Judge. He/she may be required to attend office or residential office even on gazetted or local holidays.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Tripura High Court Law Clerks-cum-Legal Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Take the prescribed application form from the official website of the High Court of Tripura. The same form is printed on the last two pages of the notice. Fill in the form with the particulars it asks for: name in capital letters, father's/husband's name, present and permanent address, date of birth, age on the date of application, educational and other qualifications, experience if any, marital status, sex, SC/ST/General/other category, and contact number and e-mail ID. Attach the documents and photographs listed below, and a Postal Order or Bank Draft for the fee. Send the application to: The Registrar General, High Court of Tripura, Agartala. It must reach the office by 5:00 P.M. on 25 November 2026 (Wednesday). Belated and incomplete applications will not be entertained and will be rejected summarily. The notice does not say how the application is to be sent (post or by hand). Copy of certificates relating to educational qualifications, along with experience certificates, if any. Copy of certificate relating to date of birth. Copy of certificate relating to nationality (Citizenship/PRTC/Aadhaar Card/Voter ID Card). Four copies of self-attested recent passport size photographs. Postal Order/Bank Draft of Rs.500/- (Rs.300/- in case of Scheduled Tribes and Scheduled Castes candidates), payable at Agartala in favour of the Registrar General, High Court of Tripura, Agartala.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates have to appear in an oral test. If a large number of applications are received, it is open to the High Court to conduct a screening test. The notice does not give the date, venue or marking of either test.

content_sections.text: The maximum age is 65 (sixty five) years as on the last date of receipt of application. The notice says this limit may be relaxed for a deserving candidate. CA/ ICWA with F.C.S. Mandatory: At least 20 (twenty) years of experience in budgeting, corporate planning, financial management, accounting, procurement and contracting, tariff formulation and regulatory matters, internal audit, works account, and the statutory functions of a Company Secretary. Experience in Central/ State owned Companies is preferred, especially in Central/ State power Utilities. Desirable: Familiarity with computer applications, programming, and implementing computerisation in financial/ accounting/ store/ personnel management. For deserving candidates, the 20-year experience limit may be trimmed down. The job specifications are minimum requirements. Meeting them does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview call. Please read the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for this post.

content_sections.heading: Job Description
content_sections.text: Manage the finance and accounts functions with proper systems and controls. Set up systems and procedures that bring positive results, and arrange random checks on how they work. Get feedback and take corrective measures to improve systems and procedures. Manage company affairs and related legal matters. Build skills in managing company affairs, and create a work culture with less scope for conflict. Assign responsibilities to executives and staff according to their skills, and keep working relations sound within groups, between departments and with other organisations. Motivate staff to work effectively as a group. Overall charge of developing and maintaining financial and accounting policies and procedures. Corporate fund planning and financial management. Statutory compliance in finance functions and under company law and other legislation. Advising on material procurement/ work contracts. Controlling billing and revenue collection, and monitoring outstanding dues through recovery action plans. Providing information for ARR and tariff filing, and implementing Regulatory Commission matters. Coordinating with other functionaries and outside agencies. Giving guidance on company law and other legal issues, with special emphasis on company law. Training and development to upgrade the skills of officers and staff.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on interview only. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview. If necessary, applicants may be shortlisted by written test, academic records, or higher educational qualifications and experience. The decision of the Screening Committee and Appointing authority on shortlisting is binding. No T.A. / D.A. will be paid for attending the interview. The selection committee may relax any of the terms for selection and appointment.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is contractual for 3 (three) years. The appointing authority may extend it by mutual consent. There is no pension from the Government of Tripura or TPGL. EPF benefits are available if desired and applicable. Either party can end the contract by giving 30 days' notice or paying 1 (one) month's salary. Other service conditions will be the same as for Tripura State Civil Service Officers of equivalent grade. A Government of Tripura officer appointed on deputation will be governed by the service conditions of his original employment. In-service candidates may apply directly to TPGL. If selected, they must submit a 'Release Order' or 'Deputation Order' from their present employer when joining, or the joining will not be accepted. The number of posts may increase or decrease. The Corporation may also choose not to fill the vacancy.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Raebareli
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Raebareli is an autonomous institute under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, located at Munshiganj, Raebareli. The post is in its Department of Physiology (Integrative Neurophysiology Lab). It serves the research project "Aspartame and Neurotoxicity: A Neurobiology and Translational Genomics Study", funded by CSIR-HRDG, New Delhi under the CSIR-HRDG Research Scheme (File No. 60(0126)/26/EMR-II).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post has been sanctioned. The project is led by Dr. Arbind Kumar Choudhary, Associate Professor, Department of Physiology, AIIMS Raebareli (Principal Investigator). The Co-PIs are Dr. Sanjay Yadav, Prof and HOD, Department of Biochemistry, AIIMS Raebareli, and Dr. Prem N. Yadav, Principal Scientist, CSIR-CDRI, Lucknow. The notice lists a valid CSIR-UGC NET (LS) and GATE qualification as "(Desirable)". The documents list asks for a valid CSIR-UGC NET (JRF) certificate or scorecard. The age limit for JRF is not more than 28 years, as per the revised CSIR JRF-NET guidelines (w.e.f. 01.03.2023). The notice prints no date for counting age. The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, OBC (Non-Creamy Layer), women and physically handicapped (PwD) candidates. The JRF fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, plus HRA as admissible under CSIR norms. On Ph.D. registration within two years and satisfactory assessment by the Expert Committee, the fellow may be upgraded to SRF at Rs. 42,000/- per month from the third year. The notice says upgradation is subject to Ph.D. registration and assessment by a three-member Expert Committee. No application fee applies: the notice lists the fee as Nil. The project tenure is 36 months from the date of commencement. The fellowship is co-terminus with the project and the post is purely temporary.

rows.qualification: Master's degree life sciences or equivalent (CSIR/UGC norms) with at least 55% marks (50% for OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwD/Third gender)
rows.pay: Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years, plus HRA as admissible under CSIR norms

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the work as full-time work on the project, covering: Animal handling and neuro-behavioural studies Molecular biology techniques (RNA/DNA extraction, RT-PCR, western blot, immunohistochemistry) Cognitive and EEG/ERP assessments Sample collection and storage Data entry and analysis Coordination with CSIR-CDRI, Lucknow, and report writing

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice says interested candidates with the stated eligibility can appear directly for the walk-in interview. The documents to bring are: Filled CSIR Form-G application (given on page 4 of the notice) Photo identity proof (Aadhaar card/ Driving Licence/ Voter ID card/ PAN card/ Passport) Address proof Proof of date of birth (10th Certificate/ Birth certificate) One recent passport size photograph Relevant mark sheets and certificates (10th, 12th, Bachelor's and Master's degree) Valid CSIR-UGC NET (JRF) certificate / scorecard Category certificate (OBC-NCL/SC/ST/EWS/PwD), if applicable Experience certificates clearly showing date of joining and relieving, if any Original certificates and one set of self-attested photocopies must be produced. Without them the candidate will not be allowed to participate in the interview. A candidate already in service must submit a No Objection Certificate from the present employer at the time of interview. Form-G is the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research application form for Junior/Senior Research Fellowships under a CSIR Research Scheme. It asks for: Name, present and permanent address, date of birth, nationality and father's/husband's name Whether the applicant belongs to SC/ST/OBC, with the certificate enclosed Educational qualifications from Bachelor's degree onwards, in a table of degree, university, subject, year of passing, division/grade and marks % Whether registered for a higher degree, or proposing to register Research or teaching experience, previous research fellowships, and publications with reprints or copies attached A signed declaration that the candidate will work whole time on the research under the Principal Investigator The form also has an attestation section for the Principal Investigator and the Head of the Institution.

content_sections.heading: About IIT BHU
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) is a technical institute in Varanasi. This JRF post belongs to its Department of Pharmaceutical Engineering and Technology. The project is funded by the National Mission for Clean Ganga. The notice gives its full title as "Characterization of Microbes and Micro-pollutants in the Ganga Basin: A Fingerprint Analysis Approach Based on the water sources and their implication in the Ganga Basin". The notice also says the post is part of the Smart Laboratory on Clean Rivers (SLCR) project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives this essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M. Pharm, M.S.(pharm.), M.Tech (pharm) in Pharma/Medicinal chemistry, Natural product Pharmacognosy, Analysis, etc with GATE/GPAT/CSIR-NET equivalent examination. Experience: Prior research experience in the relevant research fields. Experience in Analytical, HPLC, LCMS and Spectroscopic characterization is desirable. Microbial experience: collection, DNA isolation, Sequencing. Research Skills: Understanding of Sample preparation, water quality assessment, and environmental science. Technical Skills: Proficiency in statistical software, data analysis tools. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills for reporting and presenting research findings. Analytical Skills: Good problem-solving skills and the ability to interpret complex data. Personal Qualities: Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to contribute to innovative research solutions. The upper age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is 28 years. The post table gives a relaxation of 5 years to "SC/ST/Physically Handicapped Female candidates". The general conditions add that relaxation of marks and age may be granted to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Women/physically challenged candidates as per GOI norms. All things being equal, SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GOI rules. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice says the JRF will work on scientific research and help develop new solutions for identifying micro-pollutants and microbes in small rivers. The work covers quantitative and qualitative analysis of micro-pollutants and microbes. The JRF will work closely with the other JRF and PA. The JRF will be responsible for: Design and execute the experiment, data acquisition and analysis, and preparation of project report and manuscripts. Research Support: Expertise in advanced analytical method for water quality assessment, knowledge of sophisticated state-of-art technology (Spectroscopic Techniques). Data Management: Analyse complex data sets and provide strategic insights to inform project decisions. Report Preparation: Prepare comprehensive research reports, Papers, Posters and technical reports.

content_sections.heading: SGPGIMS Technical Coordinator Job Description
content_sections.text: The Key Responsibilities assigned to the Technical Coordinator include: Act as a focal point for the Rare Diseases Clinic at the CoE. Provide technical and strategic support for planning, coordination, and implementation of rare disease-related activities. Coordinate with clinical departments for diagnosis, investigations, and formulation of treatment plans. Facilitate documentation, application review, and approval processes for patient support. Liaise with MoHFW, State Governments, and other stakeholders for fund disbursement and compliance. Coordinate with spokes in matters of proposal for equipment and consumables procurement, demand for funds, and submission of Utilization Certificates. Track drug procurement and ensure timely availability and logistics for therapy. Guide and monitor ABHA ID generation and digital health record maintenance. Ensure timely and accurate data reporting and analytics for MoHFW and internal reviews. Organize capacity-building sessions, trainings, and awareness programs at the CoE. Develop and disseminate IEC materials and media content for public and stakeholder awareness. Support development of treatment guidelines, SOPs, and other technical documentation. Manage patient data and regularly update the Rare Disease Registry and associated digital platforms. Assist in preparation of reports, summaries, and digital dashboards. Maintain proper patient records in both digital and physical formats, ensuring confidentiality. Provide counseling, guidance, and continuous support to rare disease patients and their caregivers.

Amethi, Uttar Pradesh. Bachelor’s Degree in Graphic Design / Visual Communication / Fine Arts / Mass Communication / Multimedia OR Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline OR equivalent from a recognized University / Institution. Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva etc. Strong writing and content development skills in English (knowledge of Hindi or regional language desirable). Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in graphic designing and content development. Experience in digital media, social media management, website content, or publication design is desirable. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration between Rs. 50,000 and Rs. 60,000 per month based on experience. The engagement is purely on contractual basis, initially for a period of one year, which may be extended maximum upto 3 years on yearly renewal basis subject to evaluation of performance and requirement. No DA, HRA, PF, Pension, Insurance, Gratuity, Seniority, Promotion, LTC, Medical claim, Education allowances etc. are admissible for contractual engagement under the University. Subject to availability, the engaged person may be given suitable accommodation in university campus as per allotment rules of RGNAU, as amended from time to time, on payment of prescribed license fee / rent.

content_sections.heading: RGNAU Designer-cum-Content Developer Job Description
content_sections.text: The required skills and proficiency areas associated with the role include: Design & Creative Skills: Strong understanding of layout design, typography, color theory, and academic presentation standards; ability to integrate AI-assisted design workflows with traditional creative processes. Content Development Skills: Excellent academic and professional writing skills; ability to simplify complex research concepts for broader audiences; proficiency in using AI tools responsibly for drafting, editing, and ideation. Technical & Analytical Skills: Familiarity with website and social media content management and digital publishing; understanding of SEO, analytics, and AI-assisted content optimization. Soft Skills: Strong attention to detail and accuracy; ethical awareness in AI usage (plagiarism, bias, authorship concerns); ability to work collaboratively with academic and administrative staff; time management and ability to meet multiple deadlines. Tools & Software Proficiency: Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, Canva, Microsoft Word / Google Docs, WordPress, Grammarly, DALL·E, Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Jasper AI, Google Analytics, basic video editing tools (e.g., Adobe Premiere Pro), Figma (for wireframing and prototyping), Adobe XD, Sketch (preferred), InVision, and basic knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript).

content_sections.heading: About IIT Roorkee Post-Doctoral Fellow (PDF)
content_sections.text: The Institute Instrumentation Centre is a centre of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee in Roorkee, Uttarakhand. It is offering this Post-Doctoral Fellowship to work on a research project on GaN-on-diamond heterostructures that use magnetron sputtered AlN interfacial layers for advanced electronic devices. The mentor is Prof. Ramesh Chandra of the Institute Instrumentation Centre, IIT Roorkee.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PhD in Physics / Applied Physics. The PhD/research work should be in areas related to thin-film fabrication, surface/interface engineering. Hands-on experience with material characterisation techniques such as Thin Film XRD for crystal quality and Epitaxial growth, XPS, AFM, and Spectroscopic Ellipsometry, etc. Prior experience working with RF magnetron sputtering, particularly for the deposition and optimization of AlN thin films. Exposure to thin-film fabrication and heterostructure development, particularly involving AlN/diamond and GaN/AlN/diamond systems, including studies of crystallographic orientation, surface morphology, interface quality, optical properties, and film adhesion. The institute invites applications from "outstanding and enthusiastic researchers" and says the candidate should be passionate about working on cutting-edge research, leading to high-impact publications. See the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The position is full-time for two years. PDF positions are purely temporary. Post-Doctoral Fellows will be registered as students and may use the library, the computer centre and the available hospital facilities. Fellows get 2.5 days of leave per completed calendar month. Leave cannot be carried forward beyond a calendar year. The selected candidate is expected to join the Centre as soon as the offer letter is released.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I, the last page of the notification). Only hard copies are accepted. Put the complete application in a sealed envelope and write this on it clearly: "Application for the post of Sr. Assistant Secretary (Official Language) at KDS of Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, Kolkata (erstwhile Kolkata Port Trust)". Address the envelope to: The Secretary, General Administration Department, Syama Prasad Mookerjee Port, 15 Strand Road, Kolkata – 700001. Fill in the Annexure-I form. It asks for your name, father's or husband's name, date of birth (Board Admit Card/Adhaar/Voter ID/Passport), permanent address (Adhaar/Driving License/Voter ID/Passport), address for communication, phone number, e-mail address, nationality, marital status, religion and category (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/UR). Fill in your educational qualifications with the percentage of marks and the class or division for Secondary/Madhyamik (or equivalent) Diploma, Higher Secondary, Graduation and Post Graduation. Then add your professional qualification. Fill in your working experience: company name, scale of pay and present basic pay, post or designation, and the period (DDMMYYYY to DDMMYYYY) with its duration. You can add any other relevant information. Paste one recent passport-size photograph, duly signed, in the place marked on Annexure-I. Sign the form, write the date, and attach the enclosures listed below. Seal everything in the envelope with the superscription above and send it to the address so that it is received by 26 November 2026. Applications that are incomplete, unsigned or received after the deadline may not be considered. Submit only one application. If a candidate sends more than one, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.

The qualifications must be from a recognized Indian University approved by the UGC or a recognized Indian Institute approved by AICTE. Candidates must hold a valid Mark-sheet / Degree / Diploma / Certificate / Membership for the necessary qualification and experience as on 01.10.2026. content_sections.text: ZSI has advertised one (01) Project Scientist post. The details are as printed in the notice. The upper age limit is 40 years on the date of interview. Experience in the identification, documentation and compilation of faunal diversity, preferably from wetlands or other aquatic ecosystems. Good scientific writing and documentation skills, with publications in peer-reviewed journals. Working knowledge of MS Office, data management and biodiversity-related databases.
